title: Copper Lungs: Updated
description: Create x Miner's Lung: Use the Copper Backtank in low-air areas
body:
# Overview
This mod was made on commission by [tfarecnim](https://www.curseforge.com/members/tfarecnim/projects)

This is a port of Copper Lungs under the MIT license designed to support Create 0.5.1

_This mod activates the Diving Helmet/Copper Backtank when in "red/yellow" air quality zones to use the air supply instead of drowning. This gives you Water Breathing ("Free Breathing") and uses time/air from the tank as usual. Air is used at the same rate in either zone._

## Requirements
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
- [Miner's Lung](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/miners-lung)

title: Weaver
description: An origin that utilizes its dash to travel through walls and to heal from battles.
body:
# 🕸️ Weaver
### (Impact 2)
_Tangled in webs that transcend the laws of reality, the Weavers can move gracefully around the world._

### Powerlist

<details>
<summary>👁️ Eight-Eyed</summary>

You have night vision when not exposed to the sun.

</details>

<details>
<summary>☁️ Spinneret</summary>

At the cost of hunger and when on the ground, you're capable of dashing. You're invisible and able to phase through walls during the duration, Being attacked will put this on a three second cooldown.

- _You can use this with an elytra however it exhausts you more._

- _When attacking somebody a second after dashing, you can inflict Widow's Mark onto your opponent._

</details>

<details>
<summary>❤️ Itsy Bitsy</summary>

You have two less hearts and can avoid fall damage by crouching.

- _You cannot naturally regenerate._

</details>

<details>
<summary>🕸️ Crawling</summary>

For a limited time you're capable of climbing walls. While climbing, jumping will push you off the wall.

</details>

<details>
<summary>🕷️ Arthropod</summary>

You take more damage from the Bane of Arthropod enchant.

</details>

<details>
<summary>🥴 Continual Hunt</summary>

You passively exhaust, this is much faster when sprinting.

</details>

<details>
<summary>🩸 Widow's Mark</summary>

Entities under this effect cannot see or heal and continually exhaust, you are fed during the duration of this effect.

</details>

### Additional
Icon by me, inspired by Vortex Agent from Somnia.

## The Ursakin is a power human-bear hybrid. It is a natural protector, aggressive, and loyal.

### /!\ IMPORTANT /!\
This is both a datapack & resource pack. Please put the zip file in your resourcepack and datapack folder.
This datapack was tested in the Forge port of the Origins mod.

<details>
<summary>🟢 Muscles</summary>

Your thicker muscles have allowed you to withstand many more blows as well as protect those around you while scavenging easier.

- +2 hearts
- +2 armor
- 50% knockback resistance
- +20% attack damage
- Can break any block of hardness 2.5 or less with just your fists

Mmmm... Honey...

Honey gives you an extra shank of hunger + regeneration I for 2 seconds

Your primal instinct take over, anger consumes you as you desperately protect those around you. Your blood rushes and the adrenaline pumps through you.

press [Primary Key] to become enraged

- All entities glow red
- Become much faster
- Press [Primary Key] to damage those infront of you with a 2 second cooldown

The enraged state lasts for 15 seconds and has a 3 minute cooldown

Those muscles are pretty heavy, so heavy that it impedes your movement by a ton and takes a ton of energy

- Can barely jump a single block

title: tucann's insane fun pack V2
description: My first "big" Minecraft mod made using MCreator (not intended to be taken fully seriously). Requires Geckolib!
body:
![The logo lol](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/456eb3106b79034b8ca424cee4d1fb18a43ec5f9.png)

## This is my first "Big" Minecraft mod, made using MCreator. It adds a bunch of new mobs, weapons, dimensions and gimmicks!

More information can be found in the following YouTube video:

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Uhh1uFOuY0E" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## This mod requires [Geckolib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib)! Be sure to download it as well.


## FEATURES:


## The Zeta Hammer
![The Zeta Hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a342caa8c0942772987249fff208ffea2831a86f_0.webp)

Crafted using Sculk, Heart of the seas and other elements, this powerful hammer deals 13 damage per hit and can prevent fall damage! It also provides water breathing as long as the player holds it in either hand.

## The Ritual Block
![The Ritual Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1cb226e43fb0fbbd90230fb64fbd90a8448f9a34_0.webp)

This strange block is the first part of the puzzle to take down Facade Flandre in the Delta Dystopia. It severely slows down anyone standing on it, so it can be great to use for traps, mob farms and other components!

## Sculk Wood
![Sculk Wood](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d99f32b5733bdfb1f9bc8472fa510432fce571e_0.webp)

A new type of wood found in the Delta Dystopia. It can help you begin your journey if you start your survival world in the Delta Dystopia! Craft planks, tools, and other useful wood-related items with it!

## Sculk Planks
![Sculk Planks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71768ec52a233f9fde46a2f03251f717be4497f7_0.webp)

Aside from being a bizarre-looking decoration block, it can provide you with useful equipment as mentioned previously.

## Sculk Leaves
![Sculk Leaves](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/939180f65c65039e8c57da8e96408e979f73f20b_0.webp)

A new type of leaf found in the Delta Dystopia. However, the key to obtaining it was never discovered by the ancient builders. They say only 1 being possesses the knowledge of obtaining this strange collection of leaves, but refuses to elaborate. Instead, this being will offer to trade one for something specific...

## Flandre Fumo
![Flandre Fumo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23e07f5ed62d8b0a84a36a3f444c540534781693_0.webp)

She's so soft and cuddly! She's also the second part of the puzzle to take down Facade Flandre in the Delta Dystopia. when held in your off-hand, she gives you infinite Resistance at level 4!

## Potion of Sun Immunity
![Potion of Sun Immunity](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f12f5c2008dee1986e1d9f0a6ff5462adb7f81b5_0.webp)

A mysterious potion, not brewed through usual means. In order to contain its power, one must encase the essence within a vampiric potion bottle. Instead of drinking it, the essence flows through the bottle and into the fibres of the player, granting them 10 minutes of immunity to sun damage while wearing Flandre Scarlet's Wings.

## Chaos Ore
![Chaos Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85caec724d90324a921df14e3eb210751727f452_0.webp)

This ore contains the power of the 7 Chaos Emeralds, and yet it works in mysterious ways. It shall only offer a portion of its power to those who have completed its previous requirements.

## The Master Emerald
![The Master Emerald](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e6f5042495ed206817319534ace78d046d831b0_0.webp)

The result of forming all 7 Chaos Emeralds together. The wielder must align their Chaos Energy in the form of a specific structure in order to unlock the ability to forge the Emeralds into the Master Emerald. In addition, this wielder must put in 100% of their lifelong experience to attain such an alignment. Once the Master Emerald has been forged, the wielder can harness the power of a Super Transformation, causing them to be immune to all damage as long as they have rings.

## The Nexus Desolator
![The Nexus Desolator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03d82e0285acaf7970e73ff9d2672f417651a5b0_0.webp)

The final boss of this mod's (loose) storyline. A divergent evolution of the Warden, this being seeks nothing but destruction to those that dare summon such a foul beast. Many heroes have tried to slay the Nexus Desolator and obtain the creature's soul, but none have been successful.



More information about the mod and its features, as well as a full walkthrough, can be found in the YouTube video at the top of the page!

If you're the type of player that wants to extend the end goal of "completing" a survival world, and enjoy longer challenges and progression, then this mod is just for you! That is, if you don't take the lore too seriously. Hehe.

✨ **The DEVSMP Modpack** ✨ provides a mix of **optimization**, **tweaks**, and **visual enhancements** to make the game more beautiful overall. While it may not outperform the most popular optimization modpacks, it runs **perfectly** on our SMP server—offering a smooth multiplayer experience while still keeping that **classic Vanilla feel!** 🌿🎮

This modpack is designed with **our server in mind**, but you can use it as a **baseline** for your own! Feel free to **add or remove** mods to suit your preferences. However, we **only** take recommendations from DEVSMP players to add to the official releases.  

💡 **Need Help?** 💡  
If you're having trouble adding your own mods to this pack, I can try to help! 🛠️ [**Join the Discord**](https://discord.gg/qUxunKMSFq) and contact **Timothy** for assistance.

This modpack updates **only when our server does**. We usually switch to the newest **Minecraft update** as soon as it’s available, so it shouldn’t take long! ⏳ However, if you always want to play on the **latest version**, you can **copy the instance in the Modrinth app** and manually update **Fabric** yourself. 🔄  

Happy crafting! 🏗️🔥

title: PigCart
description: Restores the inversely controlled minecart pig that got patched out in 1.21.3
body:
This simple mod restores the pig minecart (dubbed "PigCart") functionality that was lost in 1.21.3 as described in this bug report.

 

Before 1.21.3, players were able to move in a minecart at 8m/s (same speed granted by a powered rail), but this behaviour was patched out.

With this mod you'll be able to (once again) have minecart transportation systems without a need for expensive powered rails to reach decent (for a minecart) speeds.

 

To move forward in a pigcart, press your backwards movement key [S]. To move backwards, press your forward movement key [W]. To move right, press your left movement key [A]. To move left, press your right movement key [D].

title: Xfilter
description: Xfilter is a Minecraft plugin that lets admins filter unlimited words from chat, ensuring clean communication.
body:
**Xfilter** is a powerful Minecraft plugin designed to maintain clean and safe communication within your server by filtering out unwanted words from player messages. Server administrators can easily manage the list of filtered words using commands, and the plugin supports an unlimited number of filtered words. When a player attempts to send a message containing any filtered word, the message is blocked, and a notification is sent to the player. Xfilter provides full flexibility to customize and update the filtered word list in real-time, ensuring smooth moderation without disrupting gameplay.

## Key Features:

Unlimited filtered words.

Real-time filtering of chat messages.

Easy-to-use commands for managing filtered words.

Only operators (OPs) can add or remove words from the filtered list.


# How to Use Xfilter:

- 1. Adding a Filtered Word:

Command: /xfilterword add <word> or /xfw add <word>

Example: /xfw add badword

This adds the specified word to the filtered word list. If the word is already filtered, you will receive a message saying it's already in the list.



- 2. Removing a Filtered Word:

Command: /xfilterword remove <word> or /xfw remove <word>

Example: /xfw remove badword

This removes the word from the filtered list. If the word is not found, you will be notified.



- 3. What Happens When a Player Uses a Filtered Word:

If a player sends a message containing a filtered word, the message will not be sent, and the player will receive a message: "Sorry, you can't send this message because you used a filtered word."




# Permissions:

Only OPs can use the commands to add or remove words from the filtered list.


Filtered words are stored in filteredwords.yml, and the plugin allows you to add unlimited words for filtering.

title: BetterWeather
description: The perfect weather mod for any modpack. Adds immersive auroras, solar eclipses with daytime mob spawning, sandstorms, and overhauled rain/fog.
body:
## Better Weather (Dynamic Skies & Events)
Better Weather is a highly immersive, atmospheric mod that completely overhauls the weather, skies, and environmental effects of Minecraft. Say goodbye to static, boring skies and hello to a living, breathing world!

This mod was built with maximum compatibility in mind, making it the perfect addition to any modpack — whether you're building a hardcore survival experience, an RPG adventure, or a cozy exploration pack, Better Weather will drastically enhance your world's atmosphere without breaking balance.

## 🌟 Key Features
**🌧️ Overhauled Rain, Snow & Sounds**
Vanilla weather has been completely reworked to feel much more realistic and immersive.

Heavy Rain & Snow: Raindrops and snowflakes are now denser, faster, and more atmospheric.
Dynamic Rain Sounds: The default loud and repetitive rain noise is replaced with a soothing, realistic ambient rain sound that won't give you a headache.

**🌫️ Immersive Fog**
Explore a more mysterious world with dynamic fog.

Thick, atmospheric fog now naturally rolls into the world.
Blends perfectly with rain and snow to create a truly moody environment.
Makes exploring forests and oceans much more atmospheric and cinematic.

**🌑 Solar Eclipses**
Experience the awe-inspiring beauty of a total solar eclipse!

The sky gradually darkens in the middle of the day.
A stunning, glowing Solar Corona appears around the moon.
Cinematic "Diamond Ring" effect just before and after totality.
Gameplay impact: The world becomes dark enough for hostile mobs to spawn during the day!

**🌌 Aurora Borealis (Northern Lights)**
Travel to cold biomes (like Snowy Taiga, Ice Spikes, or Tundras) at night to witness spectacular Auroras.

Fully animated, dynamic waves of light dancing across the sky.
Smooth color blending (from deep greens to vibrant purples and pinks).
Naturally fades in and out, making cold nights feel magical and serene.

**🌕 Realistic Moon Phases**
The default pixelated square moon has been entirely replaced.

High-resolution, mathematically generated moon texture.
Realistic lunar Maria (dark spots) and bright craters.
Beautiful Earthshine effect (the dark side of the moon subtly glows from Earth's reflected light).
All 8 moon phases are fully supported and dynamically rendered.

**🏜️ Blinding Sandstorms**
Surviving the desert just got a lot harder.

Dense, orange-tinted dust clouds that severely reduce visibility (down to just a few blocks!).
Sweeping sand particles and custom wind ambient sounds.
Transforms bright, sunny deserts into chaotic, immersive survival experiences.

## 🛠️ Compatibility & Performance
Built for Forge 1.20.1.
Highly optimized rendering using custom shaders and Blaze3D.
Modpack friendly: Fully compatible with vanilla survival, multiplayer servers, and most major biome/world-gen mods.

title: Functional Fluids
description: Fluid tutorial mod - adds a few useful fluids to Minecraft. Check the repo to see how!
body:
**Fun**ctional **Fluids** is a tutorial mod, designed to fill in the gap in (Neo)Forge documentation. Like any good tutorial, it has fun examples:

- **Cool Lava** - Tired of cobble gens that burn your cobble? Want to live in a fire lake, but don't want to burn down your base or guzzle fire resistance potions? Cool lava is the stuff for you - all the properties of real lava, with none of the burn. Supports boats.
- **Thick Air** - A balanced alternative to creatived flight. Invisible by default, thick air can be walked through just like the regular stuff. However, when you start sprinting, (or leave the ground for any reason) you'll start swimming! Safe to breathe; can fall, but doesn't flow sideways. Ideal for invisible paths and airlocks. Most mobs are afraid to touch it, but can be pushed through.
- **Configurable Fluid** - Need a custom fluid for your modpack, but not sure how to add it? The configurable fluid has (most) of its properties controlled by the config file. Push strength up to max for a fast transit system, or change the color with the season for automatic festive decorations. Change the fall damage multiplier to 100 and make compact death pits or disable drowning and build an underwater base.
- **River of Time** - Children flow up the timestream, adults flow down. Timeless entities (players, golems, and inanimates) don't flow at all.
- **Flood** - Grows to fill any container. Perfect for swimming pools, watery megafarms, and artificial lakes. This is dangerous (CAUTION: don't use on top of a mountain!), so there's no default recipe. It can flood your world.
 
---
I'll probably make the fluids individually disableable at some point - for now, you can use a datapack or crafttweaker/kubejs to manually remove the recipes.

Now with Wiki! (A fluid API wiki, that is. This is an example mod.)

---
As of Minecraft 26.1, NeoForge no longer ships with a fluid API (implementation). Instead, **Fun**ctional **Fluids** versions above 2.1.3 now use the Community Fluid API. This can be downloaded from CurseForge (public) or Modrinth (direct link required - see Wiki).

🚀 **Features Overview** ### 🆓 **Free Version** - ✅ **Basic grave system** with real server-side entities and holograms - ✅ **Advanced holograms** - Enhanced hologram features and customization - ✅ **Particle navigation** - Dynamic particle trails that guide players to graves - ✅ **Remote restoration** - Restore items from graves without visiting them (permission-based) - ✅ **Void death protection** with smart safe location placement - ✅ **Keep inventory integration** - respects vanilla and plugin keep settings - ✅ **XP protection** with configurable keep percentages - ✅ **Multi-grave support** - players can have multiple active graves - ✅ **Auto-respawn** with configurable delay - ✅ **Safe teleportation** - prevents teleporting into walls or lava - ✅ **Basic commands** - list, locate, teleport to graves - ✅ **Multi-world support** - works across all dimensions and custom worlds - ✅ **Performance optimized** - spatial partitioning for 500+ players ### ⭐ **Premium Version** - ⭐ **Admin Recovery System** - Death backup system with SQLite-backed backups and admin GUI - ⭐ **Stash** - Overflow storage when inventory is full (per-grave packages) - ⭐ **Black Market** - Expired graves become purchasable with economy integration - ⭐ **Trust System** - Share grave access with friends - ⭐ **Economy Integration** - Vault support for grave costs and marketplace --- ## 📦 **Installation** 1. **Download** the plugin JAR file 2. **Place** it in your server's `plugins` folder 3. **Start/Restart** your server 4. **(Optional)** For premium features, buy a license key from [M5LB Store](https://m5lb.run.place/) 5. **Place license key** in `config.yml` 6. **Reload** the plugin ```bash # Quick setup commands /rd help # View all commands /rd info # Check plugin status /rd reload # Reload configuration ``` --- ## 🎮 **Commands & Usage** ### 👤 **Player Commands** | Command | Description | Example | |---------|-------------|---------| | `/rd list` | Show your active graves | `/rd list` | | `/rd locate [#]` | Track route to grave with particles | `/rd locate 1` | | `/rd restore [#]` | Restore items from grave remotely | `/rd restore 2` | | `/rd stash` ⭐ | Open your stash | `/rd stash` | | `/rd trust ` ⭐ | Add player to trusted list | `/rd trust Steve` | | `/rd untrust ` ⭐ | Remove player from trusted list | `/rd untrust Steve` | | `/rd unlock [#]` | Make grave public | `/rd unlock 1` | | `/rd blackmarket` ⭐ | Browse black market | `/rd blackmarket` | | `/rd info` | Plugin statistics | `/rd info` | ### 👑 **Admin Commands** | Command | Description | Example | |---------|-------------|---------| | `/rd tp\|teleport [#]` | Teleport to your grave | `/rd tp 1` | | `/rd reload` | Reload configuration | `/rd reload` | | `/rd saves` ⭐ | Open admin death backups GUI | `/rd saves` | | `/rd license` | View license status and premium feature availability | `/rd license` | --- ## 🔧 **Configuration** ### **Core Setup** ```yaml # plugins/RelishDeath/config.yml language: en license-key: "INSERT_KEY_HERE" ``` ### ⏱️ **Timers** ```yaml timers: groups: default: 5 vip: 30 premium: 60 admin: 120 permanent: -1 # Continue timer countdown when player is offline continue-offline: true ``` ### ⚰️ **Grave Expiration** ```yaml graves: # Options: black-market, stash, drop on-expire: black-market ``` ### ⚡ **Timer Permissions** - `relishdeath.timer.vip` - `relishdeath.timer.premium` - `relishdeath.timer.admin` - `relishdeath.timer.permanent` ### 🎯 **Particle Navigation** ```yaml particles: activation-distance: 50.0 types: far: FLAME close: SOUL_FIRE_FLAME very-close: END_ROD ``` ### 🧭 **Teleport Mode** ```yaml teleport: # Options: far, close, very-close mode: close ``` ### 🔔 **Notifications** ```yaml notifications: periodic-reminders: true reminder-intervals: [180, 120, 60] reminders: display: chat: true actionbar: false title: false bossbar: false bossbar-seconds: 5 ``` ### 🎒 **Stash (Premium)** ```yaml stash: expiration-hours: 24 ``` ### 🛒 **Black Market (Premium)** ```yaml economy: enabled: true marketplace-enabled: true black-market: enabled: true # Use -1 to keep listings until purchased expiration-hours: -1 ``` --- ## ⚰️ **Grave System** ### 🗿 **Real Server-Side Entities** RelishDeath creates **real server-side entities** for graves with full Geyser compatibility:
![Grave](https://github.com/iM5LB/RelishDeath/blob/master/docs/assets/Grave.png?raw=true)
**Entity Components:** - **ItemDisplay** entities show the player's helmet/head - **TextDisplay** entities show countdown and item count - **Interaction** entities handle right-click grave opening - **Fully compatible** with Geyser (Bedrock players) ### 🕳️ **Void Death Protection** Smart grave placement system for void deaths: **Protection Features:** - **Automatic detection** when players die below world minimum height + threshold - **Area search** in configurable radius for safe locations using Minecraft's height maps - **Performance optimized** with O(1) operations (no loops) - **Safe placement** ensures graves spawn on solid ground with air space above ### 🎯 **Particle Navigation System** Dynamic particle trails guide players to their graves: **Navigation Features:** - **Automatic activation** when near graves (configurable distance) - **Ground-following paths** that navigate around obstacles - **Distance indicators** show remaining distance to grave - **Multiple trail types** with customizable particle effects - **Performance optimized** with smart rendering limits
![particle-trail](https://github.com/iM5LB/RelishDeath/blob/master/docs/assets/particle-trail.gif?raw=true)
--- ## 🎒 **Stash System** ⭐ RelishDeath can safely stash overflow items **without overwriting your inventory**. **Stash Features:** - **Per-grave packages** - overflow items stay tied to the grave they came from - **Click-to-claim items** - take items one-by-one without losing slots - **Expiration** - stash packages are kept for a limited time (configurable) Command: `/rd stash` ⭐ --- ## 🛒 **Black Market System** ⭐ When graves expire, they can be listed on the black market for other players to purchase.
![BlackMarket ](https://github.com/iM5LB/RelishDeath/blob/master/docs/assets/BlackMarket.png?raw=true)
**Market Features:** - **Automatic listing** when graves expire naturally - **Economy integration** with Vault-compatible plugins - **Configurable pricing** based on grave contents value - **Optional listing expiration** (`expiration-hours`, use `-1` to keep until purchased) - **Full content transfer** - buyer receives all grave items ### 💪 **Market Configuration** ```yaml economy: enabled: true marketplace-enabled: true black-market: enabled: true expiration-hours: -1 graves: on-expire: black-market stash: expiration-hours: 24 ``` --- ## 💾 **Death Backup System** ⭐ ### 🔄 **Admin Recovery Tools** Comprehensive backup and recovery system for server administrators:
![DeathBackups](https://github.com/iM5LB/RelishDeath/blob/master/docs/assets/DeathBackups.png?raw=true)
**Backup Features:** - **Automatic backups** of every death event (stored in SQLite) - **Admin GUI interface** for browsing all player deaths - **Inventory restoration** with overflow protection system - **Detailed death information** including cause, location, time, and XP ### 📊 **Death Information Tracking** Death backups are stored in `plugins/RelishDeath/relishdeath.db` (SQLite) and include inventory, XP, cause, time, and location. --- ## 🤝 **Trust System** ⭐ ### 👥 **Player Trust Management** Players can share grave access with friends: **Trust Features:** - **Individual trust** - Add specific players to your trusted list - **Configurable limits** - Trust limits per permission group - **Easy management** - Simple commands for adding/removing trusted players ### 🔒 **Security Options** ```yaml trust: enabled: true max-trusted-players: 10 ``` ## 🌍 **Multi-Language Support** ### 🗣️ **Built-in Languages** - `en` (English) - `ar` (Arabic) ### 🌐 **Custom Languages** 1. Create a new file: `plugins/RelishDeath/lang/es.yml` 2. Set the language in `config.yml`: ```yaml language: es ``` RelishDeath uses MiniMessage in its language files (``, ``, ``, etc.). --- ## 🎨 **GUI Features** ⭐ RelishDeath premium GUIs are fully MiniMessage-based and include page navigation arrows: - **Black Market GUI** - browse listings and purchase full graves - **Stash GUI** - open a package and take items by clicking them - **Admin Backups GUI** - browse and restore death backups --- ## 📈 **Performance & Scalability** ### ⚡ **Optimization Features** - **Spatial Partitioning** - Efficient hologram rendering for 500+ players - **Async Database Operations** - Non-blocking SQLite operations - **Height Map Usage** - O(1) void protection using Minecraft's cached data - **Entity Culling** - Holograms only render when players are nearby - **Particle Optimization** - Smart trail rendering with distance limits ### 📊 **Scalability Options** - **SQLite** for small-medium servers (0-200 players) - **Configurable render distances** for performance tuning - **Memory-efficient caching** with automatic cleanup --- ## 📄 **License** **RelishDeath is proprietary software. All rights reserved.** ### License Types #### 🆓 Free Version - Available without license key - Includes basic grave system, advanced holograms, particle navigation, remote restoration, void protection, auto-respawn, and core commands - May be used on unlimited servers - **NOT open source** - modification and redistribution prohibited #### ⭐ Premium Version - Requires valid license key from M5LB - Includes premium-only features such as Admin Recovery System, Black Market, Trust System, and Economy Integration - License key tied to purchaser and server count - **NOT open source** - modification and redistribution prohibited For full license terms, see [LICENSE](https://github.com/iM5LB/relishdeath?tab=License-1-ov-file) file. ### Obtain Premium License To get a premium license key: - 🛒 **Buy a key from [M5LB Store](https://m5lb.run.place/)** ---

title: CityChan's RNGdle
description: CityChan's RNGdle rolls your fate once per Minecraft day, applying a set of potion effects that last the full day and cannot be removed. Similar to RNGdle.com.
body:
![RNGdle banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a508d0785aca8f1e7fa8132ff293b3f3abf4518_0.webp)
# CityChan's RNGdle

> *Every morning, fate decides - if you let it.*

*Based on / inspired by [rngdle.com](https://www.rngdle.com)*

---

## 🎲 How It Works

When a new Minecraft day begins, every opted-in player automatically
receives a fate roll. A spin animation plays on your screen revealing
your tier and effects for the day. Effects last until the next day comes (when you roll again)

**Players are opted out by default.** Use `/rngdle toggle` to opt in.
If you opt out while effects are active, they last until the next day.

---

## 🏆 Tiers

| Tier | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **Neutral** | A quiet day. Nothing special. |
| **Good** | Fortune smiles on you. |
| **Bad** | Today will test your patience. |
| **Godtier** | The stars align. Rare and powerful. |
| **Hell** | Fate has chosen to make an example of you. |
| **Mahjong** | A secret tier with 10 unique hand outcomes. |
| **Funny Numbers** | A secret tier with 4 funny outcomes. |

---

## ✨ Features

- **Opt-in system** - players choose whether to participate
- **Suspense animations** - the spin can fake
  tick over, or slow crawl before revealing your true fate
- **Milk and death and multiplayer proof** - fate effects cannot be removed by any means
- **Server broadcast** - notable rolls announced to all players
- **Custom effects** - some custom effects added to enhance the randomness
- **Full customisation** - either through the config file located at "world/serverconfig/citychanrngdle.json" or ingame admin commands

---

## 🧪 Custom Effects

| Effect | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Broken Legs** | You cannot jump for the duration of the day. |
| **Enlightened** | Gain 70% more experience from all sources. |
| **Bountiful Harvest** | Harvesting crops drops one extra of each item. |
| **Weeping Angel** | You can't move while another player is looking directly at you. |
| **Slippery** | You slide like you're on ice. |
| **Colorblind** | Your entire view is rendered in greyscale. |
| **Lightweight** | You take 3x more knockback. |
| **Frail** | You take 50% more damage from all sources. |

Note: for singleplayer playthroughs, disable the "Weeping Angel" effect through the config, as its a multiplayer only effect

---

## 💬 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/rngdle help` | Show all available commands |
| `/rngdle toggle` | Opt in or out of daily fate rolls |
| `/rngdle profile [player]` | View a player's tier roll history |
| `/rngdle today [player]` | View a player's current day roll and effects |

---

## 🧪 Admin Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/rngdle admin reroll <player>` | Force a new fate roll for a player |
| `/rngdle admin toggle` | Enable or disable the mod server-wide |
| `/rngdle admin optout <player>` | Toggle a player's opt-out status |
| `/rngdle admin reload` | Reload config from disk without restarting |
| `/rngdle admin config list <tiers\|effects>` | View all current config values |
| `/rngdle admin config get <tier\|effect> <name>` | Inspect a specific config entry |
| `/rngdle admin config set tier <TIER> weight <int>` | Adjust a tier's draw weight |
| `/rngdle admin config set effect <EFFECT> enabled <bool>` | Enable or disable an effect |
| `/rngdle admin config set effect <EFFECT> tier <TIER>` | Move an effect to a different tier |
| `/rngdle admin config set effect <EFFECT> weight <int>` | Adjust an effect's draw weight within its tier |
| `/rngdle admin config set effect <EFFECT> amplifier <int>` | Set effect level (0 = level I, 1 = level II, etc.) |
| `/rngdle admin config set defaultOptedIn <bool>` | Set whether new players are opted in by default |
| `/rngdle admin config set preset <VANILLA\|DEFAULT\|KRIHCITY>` | Apply a preset |
| `/rngdle admin config save` | Write in-memory config changes to disk |

`/rngdle admin toggle` immediately removes all active fate effects when disabled, and restores them when re-enabled.

`set` commands apply changes in memory only — use `config save` to persist them to disk.

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

- NeoForge 1.21.1
- Required on both client and server

---

title: Rewinder
description: This mod gives you the power to bend time.
body:
Rewind — Reverse Time Itself

Undo the chaos.

Rewind is a powerful _server-side_ Minecraft time manipulation mod that records the world every tick and lets you reverse it in real time. Explosions, block destruction, flying arrows, mob movement, dropped items, player states, End Crystals, and even the day/night cycle can all be pulled backward exactly as they happened.

Built around a global frame-based rewind system, Rewind restores the world with smooth and accurate reverse playback while giving you full control over what gets affected.

<hr>

✨ _**Features**_

• **True Tick-Based Rewind** — records the world every tick for accurate reverse playback

• **Block Rewind** — restores destroyed, placed, or modified blocks in reverse order

• **Mob Rewind** — rewinds mob movement, position, state, and existence

• **Projectile Rewind** — reverses arrows, tridents, snowballs, and all projectile motion

• **Item Rewind** — restores dropped items and reverses item movement

• **Player Rewind** — rewinds player position, inventory state, and actions

• **End Crystal Rewind** — restores destroyed End Crystals and their states

• **Time Rewind** — reverses the sun and moon while rewinding

• **Live Rewind Countdown** — optional action-bar rewind timer while time reversal is active

• **Selective Categories** — enable or disable exactly what gets rewound

• **Instant Presets** — quickly switch between different rewind setups

• **Custom Rewind Duration** — configure rewind history from seconds up to long sessions

• **Global Frame System** — synchronized rewind across entities, blocks, and world events

• **Rewind Controller** — a crafted control item used for managing time manipulation

<hr>

🧠 _**How It Works**_

Every server tick, Rewind stores a complete frame of the world state.

That includes:

• Block changes

• Entity snapshots

• Projectile positions

• Item states

• Player data

• End Crystals

• Time progression

When rewinding begins, frames are restored backwards one-by-one in a carefully optimized order:

Players → End Crystals → Projectiles → Items → Mobs → Blocks → Time

This keeps visual playback smooth and prevents desync between entities and world changes.

<hr>

🎮 _**Commands**_

/rewind  
• Toggle rewinding ON/OFF

/rewind status  
• Displays current rewind information

/rewind limit <seconds>  
• Sets the maximum rewind history

/rewind give  
• Gives the Rewind Controller item

/rewind details <true|false>  
• Enables or disables rewind countdown/action bar details

<hr>

⚙ _**Category Controls**_

Enable or disable individual rewind systems:

/rewind category blocks <true|false>

/rewind category mobs <true|false>

/rewind category projectiles <true|false>

/rewind category items <true|false>

/rewind category players <true|false>

/rewind category endcrystals <true|false>

/rewind category time <true|false>

<hr>

📦 _**Presets**_

Quickly apply ready-made rewind configurations:

• all

• no_players

• blocks_only

• mobs_only

• projectiles_only

• items_only

• endcrystals_only

• time_only

• none

<hr>

🕹 _**Rewind Clock**_

Craft the mysterious Rewind Clock to gain access to temporal manipulation.

Recipe:

• 8 Echo Shards surrounding 1 Clock
![Rewind Clock Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ec47c328f0ed866f21b6fc5eead0acb3d395bf9.jpeg)

<hr>

⚠️ _**Important Notes**_

• Rewind is fully server-side

• Best experienced in singleplayer or dedicated servers with the mod installed

• Large rewind histories may increase memory usage depending on world activity

• Rewind restores entities that no longer exist and removes entities created in the “future”

<hr>

🛠 _**Compatibility**_

• Minecraft 1.21.10, 26.1.2

• Fabric

• Server-side

• No extra dependencies

<hr>

_**Installation**_

1. Download the latest .jar

2. Place it inside your mods folder

3. Launch Minecraft

4. Use /rewind give to obtain the Rewind Controller

<hr>

Perfect for:

• Cinematic gameplay

• PvP rollback moments

• Boss fight recovery

• Adventure maps

• Time-based mechanics

• Experimental survival gameplay

• Anyone who ever said “wait… can I undo that?”

title: Atlas-Map
description: New map mode, that will not feel like you are cheating
body:
# Atlas

**One map. Always growing. Always in your hands.**

Atlas replaces Minecraft's chunk-by-chunk map clutter with a single, expanding map you
craft, equip, and explore with. As you travel, it charts the world for you — for *exactly*
the empty maps vanilla would cost, so it never feels like cheating.

The map is drawn by Minecraft's **own** map engine, so it looks pixel-for-pixel identical
to a vanilla map — just bigger, and in your hands while you walk.

## How it works

1. **Craft** one Atlas from leather, empty maps, and a book.
2. **Equip** it in the dedicated Atlas slot (in your inventory, above the offhand).
3. **Load it** with empty maps — right-click the held Atlas to open its storage.
4. **Explore.** While equipped, the Atlas spends one empty map per new 128×128 area it
   charts — true vanilla parity.
5. **Press M** to raise it in your hands like a vanilla map and *keep walking*.

## Features

- 🗺️ **A single growing map** — no chests full of paper, no item frames.
- ✋ **Held in your hands** — press M and explore with the map up, just like holding a
  vanilla map. No full-screen menu breaking your immersion.
- 🔍 **Scroll to zoom**, stand still to grab a cursor and **drag to pan**.

🎯 QuickPearls

--- ### ✨ What is QuickPearls? **QuickPearls** is the most advanced, high-performance Ender Pearl management plugin designed for modern networks. It replaces buggy vanilla pearl mechanics with a **dynamic, packet-level architecture** supporting intense anti-glitch protection, custom physics, and smart cooldowns. Whether you run a **Survival, Lifesteal, Duels, or Practice** server, QuickPearls is the universal solution to eliminate pearl exploits and improve the gameplay experience. --- ### 🛡️ Core Anti-Glitch Engine Protect your players and their bases. Prevent players from glitching into grief-protected regions, claims, or exploiting Minecraft's physics. * **Zero TPS Drop:** Intercepts pearls directly at the packet level (via Netty/PacketEvents) for **Complex Container Fixes:** Prevents glitching through chests or hoppers placed under blocks. * **Suffocation Prevention:** Automatically cancels pearls that land in risky, 1x1, or suffocating Anvils, or Crafting Tables (No more opening UIs by accident!). * **Custom Pearl-Thru:** Grant pearls the ability to pass cleanly through specific transparent blocks like string, cobwebs, or slabs. * title: Plaster Up!
description: A small mod that will allow you to put plaster on cobblestone blocks.
body:
Don't know what to do with all the cobblestone you've gathered during your mining expeditions?

Want bright, stark white walls to make your base truly pop, but you're tired of gathering gravel and sand for concrete?

This mod will help you solve exactly these issues!
### Introducing:

# Plaster Up!

A small mod introducing the star of medieval construction: **whitewash**. Now you can rid yourself of dingy cobblestone keeps in favour of lush, clean and fresh white walls!


### What does this mod do?
The core mechanic of this mod is the new Whitewash Paste item. It can be made using one block sand, one block bone or calcite, and one bucket of water.
![Whitewash Paste recipe with Calcite](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4392ca70c8b6402591fc4ae1511c3b1d35b8320.jpeg)
![Whitewash Paste recipe with Bone Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e0ad3c7359300f840fba00d4dd245e37fcf597ca.jpeg)

Once you've prepared your Whitewash Paste, you can start plastering up all the cobblestone blocks you want.
Walk up to the bare cobblestone and right click it while holding Whitewash Paste in your main hand. You've successfully whitewashed your cobblestone!

Whitewashing comes in four stages:
- Barely Whitewashed
- Slightly Whitewashed
- Half Whitewashed
- Whitewashed

For increasing the amount of whitewash on your blocks, simply continue right clicking them with Whitewash Paste in your main hand until you're satisfied.

Like I mentioned before, this can be applied to all types of cobblestone blocks: regular blocks, stairs, slabs, and walls.

![Whitewash stages among all blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e12eacb5f679e838cbd4950c78ddc2e2f872a31e.jpeg)

Whitewashed blocks are slightly more durable than bare cobblestone.

Currently the only available colour is white. I might introduce some other earth colours later, like a couple reds, yellows, greens and browns. I might also not do that. All is subject to change.

Thank you for listening to this Public Service Announcement.

title: TabChannel
description: Create public or private chat channels, manage staff discussions, organize faction communication, and improve multiplayer communication with a modern tab-based chat system inspired by large community servers.
body:
# TabChannel

**Minecraft 1.21.x** · Tabbed chat channels, **TabColor**, PMs, staff tools, log search, client HUD, and optional **Twitch stream** overlay (client-only).



---

## Compatibility

| Setup | Result |
|-------|--------|
| Fabric client + Fabric server with TabChannel | Channels, tab sync, server commands |
| NeoForge on Youer | **NeoForge** jar on **both** server and client |
| **LuckPerms** | **Compatible and optional** |


---

## TabColor — all colors
Chat colors is # exemple #Red or #FF000
Commands: `/tabchannel color <channel> <COLOR>` or `/setchannel tabcolors <channel> <COLOR>`

Use the **exact** name in UPPERCASE (underscores).

### Standard

BLACK · DARK_BLUE · DARK_GREEN · DARK_AQUA · DARK_RED · DARK_PURPLE · GOLD · GRAY · DARK_GRAY · GREEN · AQUA · LIGHT_PURPLE · YELLOW · WHITE · ORANGE · PINK · MAGENTA · CYAN · LIME · BROWN · SILVER · NAVY · TEAL · OLIVE · MAROON · INDIGO · VIOLET · TURQUOISE · SKY_BLUE · MINT · SALMON · CORAL · CRIMSON · BEIGE · IVORY · CHARCOAL · EMERALD · RUBY · AMBER · BRONZE · ROSE · HOT_PINK · DEEP_PINK · FUCHSIA · LAVENDER · PLUM · ORCHID · SCARLET · FIRE_RED · BLOOD_RED · CHERRY · ICE_BLUE · BABY_BLUE · OCEAN_BLUE · ROYAL_BLUE · MIDNIGHT_BLUE · FOREST_GREEN · DARK_FOREST · MOSS_GREEN · JADE · SUNSET_ORANGE · TANGERINE · PEACH · APRICOT · LEMON · CANARY · HONEY · COFFEE · CHOCOLATE · CARAMEL · SAND · SNOW · PEARL · SMOKE · ASH · OBSIDIAN · VOID · NIGHT

### “Premium” theme (no admin restriction in the mod)

ELECTRIC_BLUE · LASER_GREEN · TOXIC_GREEN · RADIOACTIVE · GALAXY_PURPLE · COSMIC_PINK · MANA_BLUE · ENDER_PURPLE · DIAMOND · RUBY_RED · SAPPHIRE · TOPAZ · AMETHYST · EMERALD_GREEN

### Admin only (OP 2 or `tabchannel.admin`)

**BLUE** · **RED** · **NEON_GREEN**

---

## Commands

Root aliases: `/tabchannel`, `/tc`, `/tb`, `/channel`, `/ch`

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/channel create <name> <public\|private\|prive\|faction>` | Create (`staff` channel = admin) |
| `/channel join <channel>` | Join |
| `/channel leave <channel>` | Leave |
| `/channel list` | List |
| `/channel delete <channel>` | Delete |
| `/channel color <channel> <TabColor>` | Tab color |
| `/channel invite <player> <channel>` | Invite |
| `/channelcreate <name> <type>` | Create (shortcut) |
| `/channeljoin <channel>` | Join (shortcut) |
| `/channellist` | List (shortcut) |

### `/setchannel`

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/setchannel delete <channel>` | Delete |

**Built-in channels:** `global` (vanilla / global chat), **staff** channel (creation: admin, access: staff).

**Mentions:** `@staff`, `@admin`, `@mod`, `@modo` in messages (configurable anti-spam).

## Client commands

## LuckPerms

**LuckPerms is compatible and optional.** Without LuckPerms: OP level 2 for some actions, per-member permissions on each channel, and default Bukkit permissions on **Youer / Paper** (`HybridBukkitPermissions`).

title: VRX Economy
description: 🌟 Robust economic framework providing a stable currency system and essential financial commands to power your server's entire marketplace and trade. 🌟
body:
# 💰 VRX Economy
**The definitive, high-performance Vault economy ecosystem for modern Minecraft servers.**

VRX Economy redefines server economies by combining premium features with a lightweight, zero-lag architecture. Whether you run a Survival, Factions, or CityBuild network, VRX provides everything you need—from a fully visual Auction House and Secure Trading to Dynamic Pricing and Offline Mailboxes—without the clutter of outdated plugins.

---

### ✨ Premium Gameplay Features

* 🛒 **Visual Auction House (`/ah`)** A seamless, GUI-driven marketplace where players can list, browse, and purchase items securely. Offline sales are directly deposited and trigger an offline notification.
* 📉 **Dynamic Market Pricing (`/sellhand`)** Combat server inflation automatically. Server sell prices dynamically adjust based on supply and demand, dropping when items are over-farmed and naturally recovering over time.
* 🤝 **Scam-Proof Trading (`/trade`)** A bulletproof GUI for safe player-to-player exchanges. Includes an exclusive **AI Server NPC** (`/trade Server`) that allows players to gamble items and money against the server itself!
* 🎯 **Bounty Hunting (`/bounty`)** Fuel PvP engagement by letting players place hits on their rivals. The killer automatically claims the prize. Includes a dedicated `/bounty top` leaderboard.
* 💵 **Physical Banknotes (`/withdraw`)** Transform virtual balances into NBT-secured, forgery-proof paper notes for physical trading and roleplay.
* 📭 **Offline Mailbox** Players receive beautiful, stylized notifications upon logging in if their auctions sold, they received money, or their balance was adjusted while they were offline.
* 🎁 **Player Retention (`/daily` & `/paytoggle`)** Boost activity with configurable 24-hour login bonuses, and protect your streamers or top players from spam with a built-in toggle for incoming payments.

---

### 🚀 Engineered for Extreme Performance

* **Zero-Lag Architecture**: All heavy database queries (SQLite & MySQL) are executed asynchronously in the background. Your server's TPS remains at a perfect 20.0, even with hundreds of concurrent players.
* **Intelligent Memory Caching**: Player balances and offline UUIDs are cached in RAM for instant GUI rendering and lightning-fast Vault API responses. Bypasses slow Mojang API rate limits entirely.
* **Modern Aesthetics**: Full support for `&#RRGGBB` hex color codes and gradients. Make your chat, prefixes, and menus look stunningly modern.
* **100% Customizable**: Modify every single prefix, message, and currency setting. The built-in auto-updater safely adds new configuration lines during future updates without overwriting your custom setup.
* **Security & Auditing**: Every transaction (payments, withdrawals, admin commands) is securely logged to `transactions.log` to help admins track down real-money trading or exploits.

---

### 📜 Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/money [player]` | Check your or someone else's balance | *None* |
| `/pay <player> <amount>` | Send money to another player | *None* |
| `/paytoggle` | Block/Allow incoming payments | *None* |
| `/baltop` | View the top 10 richest players | *None* |
| `/withdraw <amount>` | Create a physical banknote | *None* |
| `/daily` | Claim your 24h reward | *None* |
| `/sellhand` | Sell the item in your main hand | *None* |
| `/ah [sell <price>]` | Open the Auction House or list an item | *None* |
| `/trade <player/Server>` | Safely trade items and money | *None* |
| `/bounty <add/check/top>`| Manage bounties on players | *None* |
| `/eco <give/take/set/reload>`| Admin economy management | `vrx.economy.admin` |

---

### 🔗 Dependencies
To unlock the full potential of VRX Economy, **[Vault](https://modrinth.com/plugin/vault)** is required. This ensures flawless integration with all your other plugins, such as ChestShops, Holograms, and Scoreboards.

---

**Install VRX Economy today and build a stable, engaging, and lag-free economy for your community!**

title: shieldtimer
description: A PvP focused mod that displays a precise timer whenever a shield is stunned, making it easier to predict enemy actions and time your attacks, rather than relying on guesswork
body:
Shield Timer  
Have you ever found yourself guessing exactly when your shield will be ready to use again? Vanilla Minecraft's sliding gray box doesn't give you the precise timing you need in the heat of battle.  

Shield Timer fixes this by replacing the vague vanilla animation with a clean, precise visual countdown timer for your shield cooldown.  

🚀 Features  
Visual Cooldown Timer: Replaces the standard sliding box with a precise countdown timer on your hotbar.  

Custom Placement: Don't like where the timer sits? You can fully customize exactly where the timer appears on your HUD to fit your perfect UI setup.  

Enemy Stun Tracker: Keep the upper hand in PvP! If you stun an enemy's shield—or if your own shield gets stunned—the mod displays a clear, 100-tick (5-second) countdown tracker so you know exactly how long they (or you) are vulnerable.  

🛠️ Requirements & Installation  
Mod Loader: Fabric  

Minecraft Version: 1.21.11  

To use this mod and customize the timer positions, you must install the following dependencies:  

Mod Loader: Fabric (Minecraft 1.21.11)  

WalksyLibs: Required for the mod to function properly.  

Mod Menu: Required so you can open the configuration screen and move the timer

title: World Panel
description: The all-in-one in-game control panel for Minecraft.
body:
The all-in-one in-game control panel for Minecraft. Open a single GUI with the M key and run your world — weather, time, mobs, items, abilities, buildings, schematics, players, permissions, photo mode and dozens more tools — without ever typing a command.


## Quick start

Drop the jar into your mods/ folder
Launch Minecraft with NeoForge 21.11.42
Press M in-game to open WorldPanel
(Optional) Bind extra hotkeys via Esc → Options → Controls → WorldPanel
(Optional) Drop .litematic / .nbt files into worldpanel-schematics/ or worldpanel-houses/
Full feature list

🌍 World tab
Weather: Clear / Rain / Thunder + Weather lock (server keeps the chosen weather)
Time presets: Morning / Noon / Sunset / Night / Dawn
Time slider (0–24000) + Freeze time + Time speed multiplier (0–100×)
Difficulty: Peaceful / Easy / Normal / Hard
Biome painter: replace biome in a sphere around you (any vanilla biome)
World backup: one-click snapshot to worldpanel-backups/<world>-<timestamp>/
Keep inventory toggle
Anti-AFK auto-kick (configurable minutes)

🧑 Player tab
Sub-tabs: Mode / Movement / Vitals / Teleport / Misc

Game mode switch (Survival / Creative / Adventure / Spectator)
Walk / Fly / Jump / Swim speed sliders (with No fall damage + Reset)
Heal / Feed / Max health (HP) up to 200 / No hunger drain
God mode / Infinite breath / Invisible / Auto-eat from hotbar / Reach extender
Teleport to coordinates / Teleport home / Waypoints (save & jump)
XP add/reset / Wear held item as helmet
Free-cam (spectator-detach, body stays in place)
Run server command sender

🎒 Inventory tab
Give item (count input) / Fill empty slots with picked item
Clear inventory / Repair all / Unlock all recipes

🗡 Items tab
Sub-tabs: Basic / Enchants / Stats

Custom name (with formatting) / Repair held / Unbreakable / Hide enchant glint / Apply all curses
Add any enchantment at any level (1–255) / Max all valid enchants in one click / Clear all
Damage / Attack speed / Mining speed / Reach / Max durability boosts (attribute modifiers)

✨ Effects tab
Apply any vanilla potion effect at any duration/amplifier (timed or infinite)
Clear all
Potion crafting: assemble a custom potion with multiple effects, give as Drink / Splash / Lingering

💥 Abilities tab
Sub-tabs: Bombardment / Waves / Powers / Midas

Bombardment: Lightning at crosshair, Smite, Lightning storm, Fireball, Fireball volley, Explosion, TNT rain, Nuke (any radius), TNT power multiplier (up to 2000×)
Waves: Wind burst, Knockback wave, Vacuum, Levitate, Freeze nearby, Heal & buff wave
Powers: Player scale (×0.1..×10), Velocity boost (rocket-self), Ender chain dash, Withering touch, Break wave, Berserker mode (Strength X + Speed X + Regen X + Resistance IV + Haste V + Fire Resistance), Annihilate (instakill in look line), Apocalypse combo, Meteor shower
Midas Touch: walk-mode (turn ground under your feet into the chosen block) or attack-mode (every block you break converts instead of dropping)

🧟 Entities tab
Spawn any vanilla mob (count + HP / Damage / Scale sliders)
Mob variants: Armored / Diamond / Baby Zombie, Husk with sword, Drowned with trident, Skeleton with iron sword, Armored Wither Skeleton, Spider Jockey, Chicken Jockey, Giant / Tiny Slime, Giant Magma Cube, Pink / Rainbow Sheep, Angry Wolf, Piglin Brute, Huge / Tiny Zombie / Creeper / Skeleton, Huge Spider, Huge Enderman, Tank Zombie (500 HP + armored), Glass Zombie (1 HP)
Kill hostile mobs in radius (filter: hostile only / + neutral / + passive / everything)
Freeze mobs / Disable mob spawning
Live nearby-entity counter

⚙ Gamerules tab
Every gamerule in the world — sliders for ints, toggles for bools, instant apply.

🛠 Tools tab
Tree feller (only with axe, configurable: damage axe? max logs?)
Vein miner / Instant mine / Fullbright (client-side)
Auto-grow: Trees / Crops / Grass / Other (in 10-block radius)

🏗 Build tab
Sub-tabs: Shapes / Replace / Schematics / Editor / Structures / Houses

Shapes: Sphere / Cube / Pyramid / Cylinder / Dome / Ring / Floor / Wall (any block, size up to 128×128×128, optional hollow)
Replace: swap block A → B in a radius
Schematics: load .litematic and vanilla .nbt from disk, library persists in worldpanel-schematics/; ghost preview (look-aimed, 90° rotate, build/cancel)
Editor (click-based world editor):
Start selection → LMB block = corner A → RMB block = corner B (wireframe ghost between them)
Wall / Roof / Floor templates (separate picker each):
11 wall templates (Cottage, Tudor, Brick facade, Castle stone, Castle slits, Modern glass tower, Japanese shoji, Gothic cathedral, Nether fortress, Dungeon, Plain)
7 roof templates (Flat, Flat + cornice, Pitched oak/dark/brick, Hipped, Dome)
7 floor templates (Plain, 3 checker variants, Carpet over oak, Stone path, Polished pattern)
Fill solid / Hollow / Walls / Floor / Roof / Replace / Clear within selection

Structures: 26 vanilla structures one-click (villages, fortresses, monuments, ancient cities, end city…)
Houses: pre-built houses library from worldpanel-houses/ (drop your .litematic files there)

🎨 Photo / FX tab
Photo mode (FOV slider 20°–170°, optional Hide HUD)
Free-cam
Cosmetic particles on self: Halo / Fire / Sparkle / Hearts / Notes
Movement trails: Fire / Ice / Flowers / Lava / Portal
Live HUD overlay toggle — corner display of every active toggle

👥 Players tab (server admin)
Full per-player admin screen:

View / edit target's inventory (6×9) and ender chest (3×9)
Game mode quick-switch (current highlighted)
Fly / God / Invisible ON/OFF (live status)
Lightning / TNT rain on player
Apply any effect with duration/amplifier

Server enforces and shows on-cooldown message
⌨ Hotkeys tab
Every action has a bindable keybind, visible in this tab

🩺 Diagnostics tab
Live server / player / system info
Chat command sender

🔎 Spotlight
Cmd-K style global search: type "fly speed" → jump straight to the setting
~110 indexed features
Permission system
Every action belongs to one of 36 fine-grained Features (e.g. WORLD_BIOME, ABILITY_POWERS, BUILD_SCHEMATICS, PLAYER_ADMIN…).

OP players always bypass the check (you can never lock yourself out)

title: ChatViramble
description: ChatViramble is a lightweight Paper 1.21.x plugin offering faction chats, private messaging, staff spy tools, and personal GUI settings.
body:
🇬🇧 English Description (EN)
ChatViramble — The Ultimate Chat Management Plugin

ChatViramble is a powerful, highly optimized, and feature-rich chat manager for your server. It combines local/global chat, private messaging, chat tags (titles), anti-spam, and user-friendly GUI menus into one lightweight plugin. It runs on a built-in SQLite database (no MySQL setup required) and is fully asynchronous to prevent server lag!

🔥 What's new in Version 1.4 (Major Update):

Critical GUI Bug Fix: Completely rewritten menu protection. Players can no longer steal items from the /chat menu using Shift-clicks, hotbar keys (1-9), or drag-and-drop.

Global Chat Fix: Fixed a bug where messages starting with ! would sometimes fail to reach players in other dimensions.

SQLite Optimization: All database queries are now fully asynchronous, ensuring zero server freezes.

Tab-Completer: Added tab-completion for player names in /msg and /ignore commands.

✨ Key Features:

Local & Global Chat: Radius-based local chat. Simply add ! before your message to speak globally.

Interactive Mentions (Pings): Type a player's name in chat to ping them! They will hear a sound, see an on-screen title, and get particles spawned above their head.

Item Showcase [item]: Players can show off the item they are holding in chat by typing [item].

Secure GUI Menu (/chat): A sleek interface where players can toggle chat sounds, enable/disable private messages, and equip chat tags.

Tags (Titles) System: Create unlimited custom chat tags in the config and unlock them for players via permissions.

Private Messages & Ignore List: Advanced PM system (/msg, /reply) with an Admin Spy mode (/spy). Bothered by someone? Use /ignore.

Smart Moderation: Built-in anti-caps, auto-punctuation (auto-capitalization and periods), and an anti-spam cooldown system.

PlaceholderAPI Support: Use any placeholders in your chat formats!

🛠️ Commands & Permissions:

/chat — Open chat settings GUI (chatviramble.chat - default true).

/msg <player> <text> — Send a private message (chatviramble.msg).

/reply <text> — Reply to the last PM (chatviramble.msg).

/ignore <player> — Add a player to your ignore list (chatviramble.ignore).

/sc <text> — Staff-only private chat (chatviramble.staff).

/cc — Clear the public chat (chatviramble.admin).

/spy — Toggle PM spy mode (chatviramble.spy).

/chatviramble reload — Reload plugin configuration (chatviramble.admin).



🇷🇺 Описание на русском (RU)
ChatViramble — Универсальный менеджер чата для вашего сервера

ChatViramble — это мощный, оптимизированный и многофункциональный плагин для управления чатом. Он объединяет в себе локальный и глобальный чат, систему личных сообщений, титулы, защиту от спама и удобные GUI-меню в одном легком плагине. Не требует подключения к внешним базам данных (работает на встроенной SQLite) и не нагружает сервер!

🔥 Что нового в версии 1.4 (Глобальное обновление):

Исправление критического бага GUI: Полностью переписана защита меню. Теперь игроки физически не могут украсть предметы (стекло, бирки) из меню /chat с помощью Shift-клика, горячих клавиш (1-9) или перетаскивания.

Починка Глобального чата: Исправлен баг, из-за которого сообщения с ! могли не отправляться в другие миры.

Оптимизация SQLite: Все запросы к базе данных переведены в асинхронный режим. Плагин больше никогда не вызовет фризов сервера.

Tab-Completer: Добавлено удобное автодополнение ников при вводе команд /msg и /ignore.

✨ Главные особенности:

Глобальный и Локальный чат: Разделение чата по радиусу. Напишите ! перед сообщением, чтобы написать в глобальный чат.

Интерактивные упоминания (Пинги): Если написать ник игрока в чате, он подсветится, игрок услышит приятный звук, увидит сообщение на экране и сердечки над головой.

Демонстрация предметов [item]: Игроки могут показать предмет из рук прямо в чате, написав [item].

Защищенное GUI-меню (/chat): Удобный интерфейс, где игроки могут включать/выключать звуки чата, личные сообщения и выбирать себе титулы (теги).

Система титулов (Тегов): Создавайте неограниченное количество кастомных префиксов в конфиге и выдавайте их игрокам по правам (permissions).

Личные сообщения и Игнор-лист: Продвинутая система ЛС (/msg, /reply) с возможностью для администрации включить "Шпионаж" (/spy). Достают игроки? Есть команда /ignore.

Умная модерация: Встроенный анти-капс, авто-пунктуация (автоматические точки и заглавные буквы) и защита от спама.

Поддержка PlaceholderAPI: Используйте любые плейсхолдеры в форматах чата!

🛠️ Команды и Права (Permissions):

/chat — Открыть настройки чата (chatviramble.chat - доступно всем по умолчанию).

/msg <ник> <текст> — Написать в ЛС (chatviramble.msg).

/reply <текст> — Ответить на последнее ЛС (chatviramble.msg).

/ignore <ник> — Добавить игрока в черный список (chatviramble.ignore).

/sc <текст> — Секретный чат для персонала (chatviramble.staff).

/cc — Очистить чат всем игрокам (chatviramble.admin).

/spy — Включить/выключить прослушку ЛС игроков (chatviramble.spy).

/chatviramble reload — Перезагрузить конфиг плагина (chatviramble.admin).

title: SpeedyHoppers
description: Customize hopper speed by transferring multiple items per cycle instead of vanilla's slow 1 item.
body:
## ⚡ SpeedyHoppers

SpeedyHoppers improves Minecraft hopper performance by allowing you to control how many items are transferred per cycle.

Instead of the default 1 item every ~0.4 seconds, you can configure hoppers to move multiple items at once — making item transport faster and more efficient.

---

## 🚀 Features

* 🔧 Adjustable items per transfer (`/hopper <amount>`)
* ⚡ Faster hopper systems without instant spam
* 💾 Persistent config (saves automatically)
* 👑 OP-only command control
* 🔁 Keeps vanilla-style timing (~0.4s per transfer)
* 🔥 Instant mode support (`/hopper 0`)

---

## ⚙️ Usage

```bash
/hopper <amount>
```

Examples:

* `/hopper 1` → Vanilla behavior
* `/hopper 8` → Transfers 8 items per cycle
* `/hopper 64` → Full stack per cycle
* `/hopper 0` → Instant transfer

---

## 📄 Configuration

```yaml
hopper_amount: 8
```

* This value is automatically updated when using the command
* Stored in `config.yml`

---

## 🧠 How it works

HopperFlux replaces vanilla hopper logic and processes item transfers manually, allowing precise control over transfer amounts while keeping consistent timing.

---

## ⚠️ Notes

* Designed for Paper 1.21+
* Large hopper networks may impact performance due to chunk scanning
* Redstone timing may differ slightly from vanilla

---

## 📦 Perfect for

* Survival servers
* Technical players
* Performance optimization
* Faster farms and item transport systems

title: Resource Pack Editor Mod
description: A Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that lets you create, edit, and share resource packs without ever leaving the game.
body:
# Resource Pack Editor Mod

A Fabric mod for **Minecraft 1.21.1** that lets you create, edit, and share resource packs without ever leaving the game. No external image editor required — pixel-edit any block or item texture from inside Minecraft, and export the finished pack as a `.zip` with one click.

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.1**
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) **0.16.10** or newer
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) **0.116.10+1.21.1** or newer
- Java **21**

## Installation

1. Install the Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.1.
2. Drop **Fabric API** into your `mods/` folder.
3. Drop **`resourcepackeditormod-1.0.0.jar`** into the same `mods/` folder.
4. Launch Minecraft.

Your `mods/` folder lives at:

- **Windows:** `%APPDATA%\.minecraft\mods`
- **macOS:** `~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/mods`
- **Linux:** `~/.minecraft/mods`

## Usage

Everything lives inside the vanilla **Options → Resource Packs** screen. The mod adds two buttons above the existing row:

### Create New Pack

With **no pack selected** (or only the default selected), the left button reads **Create New Pack**. Click it to:

1. Enter a **name** and a **description**.
2. Hit **Create** — the mod generates a new folder under `resourcepacks/<name>/`, writes a valid `pack.mcmeta`, creates a white default icon, and extracts every block/item texture from your currently-loaded resources as a starting template.
3. You'll land in the **Texture Selector** — see [Editing](#editing).

### Edit Pack

When you **select an existing pack** in the list, the left button changes to **Edit Pack: <name>**. Click it and the mod opens the **Texture Selector** pointed at that pack's `assets/minecraft/textures/` directory.

**Edits save directly to the original pack — no copy is made.**

### Share Pack

The right button, **Share Pack**, is greyed out until you select a pack. When active, click it to open your operating system's native file dialog. Choose a destination, and the mod zips the entire pack folder into a `<PackName>.zip` you can drop into Discord, upload to Modrinth, send to a friend, etc.

The zipping runs in the background so the game doesn't freeze on large packs.

## Editing

### Texture Selector

A file browser scoped to your pack's textures. Click a `[DIR]` entry to descend; click a `.png` to open it in the **Pixel Editor**. Use **Back** to go up a folder (or to return to the resource pack screen from the root). The **Edit Icon** button jumps straight to your pack's `pack.png`.

### Pixel Editor

The pixel editor renders the texture at high zoom with a grid overlay and a checkered transparency background. Click and drag to draw.

**Tools** (right side of the screen — hover for tooltips):

| Button | Tool          | Behavior |
|--------|---------------|----------|
| **P**  | Pencil        | Click or drag to paint single pixels. |
| **L**  | Line          | Click-drag from start to end, release to draw a straight line. |
| **R**  | Rectangle     | Click-drag a rectangle outline. |
| **C**  | Circle        | Click-drag from center to define radius. |
| **F**  | Flood Fill    | Click to fill a contiguous area with the current color. |

**Color palette** (left side): 20 preset colors. Click to select; hover to see the hex code. Scroll if your screen is too short to show them all.

**Undo / Redo**: arrows under the tool list. History is capped at 50 steps. A whole pencil drag counts as one step, so you can revert a full stroke without spamming undo.

**Save**: writes the edited image back to its original file. **Cancel** discards changes.

## Tips

- Edits are saved straight to disk — if the pack is currently active in Minecraft, hit **F3+T** (or toggle the pack off/on) to reload textures and see your changes immediately.
- Resource pack format version is set to **34** (Minecraft 1.21.1). If you want to use the exported zip on a different Minecraft version, edit `pack.mcmeta` accordingly.
- The default texture extraction pulls from **all currently-loaded resources**, so if you have other resource packs enabled when you click **Create New Pack**, those packs' textures will be used as the baseline.
- The texture editor uses nearest-neighbor sampling — what you see in the editor is exactly what Minecraft will render.

## License

[ARR](https://everett2323.github.io/rpemodLICENSE/)

title: Health Extended
description: Extends the game's health mechanics with locational damage and persistent medical statuses, integrated right into your inventory screen.
body:
# Details:

**Health Extended** replaces the generic vanilla health system with a more elaborate approach that adds so-called "hediffs" _(HEalth DIFFerence)_, or persistent medical statuses for every wound or status effect on your body. Other similar mods rely on secondary menus or using hotkeys that take you out of the immersion, but this system is built directly into your existing inventory screen, keeping a somewhat cohesive and integrated vanilla feel.

# Content and technicalities:

Your body is now divided into functional parts: the Head, Torso, and limbs, each with their own health pool. Death is no longer a matter of losing all your hearts; it is the direct result of your most important part, the Head's HP reaching zero. 
Each body part has a special condition that will give you a debuff if their HP reaches 0: 
- Arms: Mining fatigue and weakness (only really matters if you get it on your dominant arm).
- Legs: Slowness.
- Torso: Gives you the "Heart Attack" condition, slowly stacking Suffocation on your Head until you die.
- Head: Death. This one just kills you. So don't lose your head.

Healing works the same as in vanilla, but instead of directly healing your hearts back, it's spent on removing the wound hediffs, which in turn return their "consumed" hearts to their respective body part. So healing still works the same as in vanilla, it just looks and sounds more complex.

The vanilla health bar above your hotbar is still there, but it is simply a representation of your overall body part HP pool (with weights for your more important parts like the torso and head). It's not like it really matters though, since a big blow to the head will still mean an instant game over. And if that sounds unbalanced, well, that is just the nature of locational damage mods.

---

# Known issues:
_I dont know of any bugs right now, but I can definitely smell them._

If you encounter a bug, please submit a report in the issue tracker. This is an alpha release and my very first mod that I've been working on as a very lowkey side hobby, so bugs are to be expected.

---

# Roadmap:
- Mod compats
- Balance, balance, balance
- Visual improvements to the health panel
- Better integration of vanilla status effects
- More configurability
- Organs, bones, etc (possibly enabled through config through a difficulty option)
- probably something very important i forgot about


---
Afterword:
Yes, this is just Rimworld. Rimworld in Minecraft. Rimcraft if you will. Mineworld even.

title: hPotionStack
description: Potion stacking for inventories and dropped items with separate limits for regular, splash and lingering potions, configurable delays, allowed inventory types and permissions.
body:
# hPotionStack

**hPotionStack** is a lightweight plugin that allows potions to stack in inventories and as dropped items on the ground.

The plugin supports regular potions, splash potions and lingering potions. Each potion type can have separate settings for inventory stacking and ground item stacking, including custom stack limits and spawn delays.

---

## Features

- Inventory potion stacking
- Ground item potion stacking
- Support for `POTION`
- Support for `SPLASH_POTION`
- Support for `LINGERING_POTION`
- Separate settings per potion type
- Separate inventory and ground stack limits
- Configurable delay before ground item stacking
- Configurable allowed inventory types
- Permission check for inventory stacking
- Custom messages
- Custom actions
- Reload command
- Inventory type debug command
- Hex color support

---

## Stacking

hPotionStack works with three potion item types:

```text
POTION
SPLASH_POTION
LINGERING_POTION
```

When inventory stacking is enabled, the plugin checks potion clicks inside allowed inventory types and combines similar potions up to the configured limit.

When ground stacking is enabled, the plugin checks spawned potion items after a configurable delay and merges similar nearby potion items up to the configured limit.

---

## Inventory

Inventory stacking can be enabled globally and separately for every potion type.

Players need this permission to stack potions inside inventories:

```text
hpotionstack.stack
```

If the player does not have permission, the plugin can run actions from:

```text
actions.noPermsInventory
```

Default allowed inventory types:

```text
CRAFTING
ENDER_CHEST
BARREL
SHULKER_BOX
CHEST
```

---

## Ground Items

Ground item stacking can be enabled globally and separately for every potion type.

When a potion item spawns on the ground, the plugin waits for the configured delay and then tries to merge it with similar nearby potion items.

The ground stacking behavior is controlled through:

```text
settings.enable.itemSpawn
settings.stackSettings.<type>.itemSpawn.enable
settings.stackSettings.<type>.itemSpawn.maxStack
settings.stackSettings.<type>.itemSpawn.delay
```

---

## Config

Default configuration example:

```yaml
settings:
  prefix: "&7[#FDBE00Server&7]"
  debug: true
  enable:
    inventory: true
    itemSpawn: true
  stackSettings:
    potion:
      inventory:
        enable: true
        maxStack: 3
      itemSpawn:
        enable: true
        maxStack: 5
        delay: 4
    splashPotion:
      inventory:
        enable: true
        maxStack: 64
      itemSpawn:
        enable: true
        maxStack: 64
        delay: 4
    lingeringPotion:
      inventory:
        enable: true
        maxStack: 48
      itemSpawn:
        enable: true
        maxStack: 48
        delay: 4
  inventories:
    - "CRAFTING"
    - "ENDER_CHEST"
    - "BARREL"
    - "SHULKER_BOX"
    - "CHEST"
```

---

## Actions

The plugin includes action sections for inventory stacking feedback.

```yaml
actions:
  noPermsInventory:
    - "[Message] {prefix} You do not have permission to stack potions in inventories!"
  onStackInventory:
    - "[Sound] ENTITY_VILLAGER_YES"
    - "[Message] {prefix} Potions have been stacked!"
```

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/hpotionstack` | Shows the help message |
| `/hpotionstack reload` | Reloads the configuration |
| `/hpotionstack inventory <player>` | Shows the open inventory type of a player |

The inventory command is useful when configuring the allowed inventory type list.

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Description |
|---|---|
| `hpotionstack.admin` | Access to administrative commands |
| `hpotionstack.stack` | Allows potion stacking inside inventories |

Ground item stacking works automatically according to the configuration.

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.16 or newer
- Spigot, Paper or a compatible server fork

Optional soft dependencies:

- Vault
- PlaceholderAPI

---

## Install

1. Place `hPotionStack.jar` into your server's `plugins` folder.
2. Restart the server.
3. Open the generated configuration file.
4. Configure potion stack limits and enabled modules.
5. Give players `hpotionstack.stack` if they should be able to stack potions in inventories.
6. Use `/hpotionstack reload` after editing the configuration.

Configuration file:

```text
plugins/hPotionStack/config.yml
```

---

## Notes

- Only similar potions are stacked together.
- Inventory stacking requires `hpotionstack.stack`.
- Ground item stacking is controlled by the configuration.
- Every potion type can have its own inventory and ground stack limit.
- Allowed inventory types can be configured to prevent unwanted stacking behavior.
- Use `/hpotionstack inventory <player>` to check the type of the inventory a player currently has open.

title: snapcam
description: Placeable camera for Minecraft fabric 1.21.1 — enter its view, shoot handheld, or use the self-timer. No commands, no custom keybinds. Inspired by the Education Cam.
body:
# Snapcam

Snapcam adds a placeable camera to Minecraft. Point it at a scene, then shoot in
whichever style suits the moment:

- **Handheld** — hold the camera item, crouch and press Use to enter handheld
  mode, then shoot at any time while crouching. Release crouch to exit.
- **Live view** — place the camera in the world, walk up to it, and step inside:
  look around freely, zoom in/out, and shoot whenever you're ready.
- **Self-timer** — place the camera, crouch-click it from close range to start a
  5-second countdown, then get into the shot before it fires.

No commands. No custom keybinds — only Use and Sneak. Works on controllers and Steam Deck.

Inspired by the Minecraft: Education Edition camera. Requires **Fabric** on
**Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1**, installed on both server and client.

## Features

### Placing a camera

Hold the **Camera** item (creative inventory → Tools & Utilities) and
press Use on any block face:

- **On a flat surface** — places a tripod camera on the ground, lens facing toward
  you.
- **On a side face** — mounts the camera to the wall, lens pointing outward.
- **On the underside of a block** — mounts the camera to the ceiling. A centred
  plate grips the block above; a rod hangs down to the pan/tilt head.

The camera is a server-side entity: every player on the server sees it.

### Entering camera view

Use an unoccupied camera to switch your POV to it. While inside:

- Your character stays at its original position (visible to other players and in
  your own screenshots).
- Mouse / stick input rotates the camera view.
- Scroll wheel or **W / S** zooms in and out (12–200 mm equivalent focal length,
  shown in the viewfinder HUD). Zoom is saved per camera and restored the next
  time any player enters it. The lens barrel extends on the model as a visual cue.
- All movement input is suppressed — the camera is fixed.
- The vanilla HUD (hotbar, crosshair, health bar) is hidden.
- Press **Sneak** to exit and return to your own body.

Only one player can occupy a camera at a time.

### Taking a screenshot

| Situation | Input | Result |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| Inside camera view | Use / trigger | Screenshot from camera POV |
| Inside camera view | Scroll / W / S | Zoom in or out |
| Outside, holding Camera item | Hold Shift + Use (not aimed at a camera) | Enters hand-held mode — Use to shoot, release Shift to exit |
| Outside, holding Camera item (within ~20 blocks of a camera) | Shift + Use the camera | 5-second countdown, then auto-shot from that camera |

Screenshots are saved by Minecraft's normal screenshot system
(`screenshots/` folder, sequential numbering). A white flash confirms each
shot.

### Timed shot (self-timer)

Step close to a placed camera you are **not** inside and Shift + Use it. A large countdown
number (5 → 1) appears on screen. After five seconds the mod briefly enters the
camera's POV, takes the screenshot, and returns you to normal play — so you can
step in front of the camera before it fires.

The timer cancels automatically if the targeted camera is removed or claimed by
another player.

### Removing a camera

Hit the camera entity to break it. It drops the Camera item regardless of who
placed it.

## Compatibility

| Mod | Status |
|-----|--------|
| Xaero's Minimap | Supported — minimap is hidden while in camera view |
| Mod Menu | Supported — mod appears in the list (no config screen yet) |
| Controlify | Supported — set Sneak to **held** mode (not toggle) in Controlify settings |
| Other HUD mods | May render on top of camera view; MIT licensed, feel free to patch |

Requires the mod on **both server and client**. The POV switch is coordinated
server-side; clients without the mod cannot accidentally enter camera view on a
modded server.

### Recommended server setting — interaction range

Holding the Camera item extends entity interaction range to ~20 blocks on the
client, allowing timed shots to be triggered from across a room. On **Paper**
servers, raise the server-side limit to match so the extended reach isn't
silently clamped:

```yaml
# paper-global.yml
misc:
  max-entity-reach: 20.0
```

On a **Fabric** server the equivalent is provided by the
[Reach Entity Attributes](https://modrinth.com/mod/reach-entity-attributes) mod.

## Dependencies

| Dependency | Side | Required |
|------------|------|----------|
| Fabric Loader ≥ 0.15 | Both | Yes |
| Fabric API 0.116.x + 1.21.1 | Both | Yes |
| Mod Menu | Client | No (recommended) |


## License

MIT — © 2026 Lasrach <lasrach@gmail.com>
