description: Let your players have their own storage to store items when they mined or picked up it, and more...
body:
## Info

This plugin introduces virtual storage for players to store their mined/picked items. The players can filter what items to store, sort items in the storage, or sell items from the storage.

## Feature

- Support multiple versions: from 1.16 to the latest version
- Support Folia
- Support most popular skyblock plugins
- Support multiple currency plugins
- Support multiple marketplaces
- Support multiple custom item plugins
- PlaceholderAPI Supported
- HeadDatabase for custom head
- ItemsAdder and Oraxen for custom UI texture
- Very detailed explanation in every configuration files
- And a lot more that are not mentioned here

## FREE VERSION

This version is a free version, for the users who just want to try the plugin. The functionality is the same as the paid version. The only difference is:
- Free version doesn't receive official support for bug tracker or feature suggestion.
- Free version has a message to tell the user about the free version and where to buy the paid version.

If you like the plugin and want to support the development, or you want to receive official support, you can buy the paid version from [this page](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/extrastorage.90379/) or [this page](https://voxel.shop/product/860/extrastorage).

title: EnvironmentDetector (API)
description: EnvironmentDetector is a lightweight Fabric API that automatically detects launcher, platform, modpack, loader, and environment information through a simple placeholder and developer API system.
body:
[![Join DC \[middle small\]](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bfca91ef533789255f946e0c21aa5a6f4925876f_0.webp)](https://discord.gg/mP23dpVQ6V)

# EnvironmentDetector API

A lightweight and crash-safe Minecraft environment detection API for Fabric, Quilt and modern modpack launchers.

EnvironmentDetector automatically identifies:

* Launcher
* Modpack instance
* Loader
* Minecraft version
* Special client environments

The API is designed for:

* Mods
* HUDs
* Placeholder systems
* Analytics
* Compatibility layers
* Launcher-aware integrations

---

# ✨ Features

## Automatic Launcher Detection

EnvironmentDetector can automatically detect:

* Modrinth App
* CurseForge
* GDLauncher
* Prism Launcher
* MultiMC
* ATLauncher
* Feather Client
* NoRisk Client
* Lunar Client
* Badlion Client
* Official Minecraft Launcher

No manual configuration required.

---

# 🧩 Compatibility

## Supported Minecraft Versions

### Primary Support

* Minecraft `1.21.x` (`1.21`, `1.21.1`, `1.21.2`, etc.)
* Optimized and tested for modern Minecraft environments.

The project currently targets:

* `Java 21`
* modern Fabric Loader versions
* current launcher ecosystems

---

## Backwards Compatibility

EnvironmentDetector mainly relies on:

* Fabric Loader APIs
* filesystem checks
* runtime analysis

The API does NOT deeply modify Minecraft internals and avoids complex mixins for detection logic.

Because of this, the project can also be ported to older versions like:

* `1.20.1`
* `1.19.4`

with only minimal adjustments:

* lowering the Java target from `21` → `17`
* adjusting `fabric.mod.json`
* rebuilding the project

---

## Supported Mod Loaders

### Fabric

✅ Full native support
(Main target platform)

### Quilt

✅ Full native support

Quilt supports Fabric mods natively and EnvironmentDetector includes dedicated Quilt detection logic.

This means logs will correctly show:

```text
Loader=Quilt
```

instead of Fabric when running on Quilt.

### NeoForge / Forge

⚡ Not natively supported

EnvironmentDetector is primarily a Fabric mod.

However, the mod works correctly through compatibility layers such as:

* Sinytra Connector
* Fabric Connector implementations

When used through these layers, the API can even detect that the environment is running on:

* Forge
* NeoForge

---

## Technical Requirements

### Java Version

* Java `21` required for Minecraft `1.20.5+`

### Fabric Loader

* Fabric Loader `0.16.0+`

---

## Compatibility Overview

| Feature          | Status               |
| :--------------- | :------------------- |
| Minecraft 1.21.x | ✅ Optimized & Tested |
| Fabric           | ✅ Native Support     |
| Quilt            | ✅ Native Support     |
| NeoForge / Forge | ⚡ Via Connector Only |
| Dedicated Server | ✅ Fully Compatible   |
| Java 21          | 🛠️ Required         |

---

# 🧠 High Precision Detection System

Unlike many other mods, EnvironmentDetector does NOT rely on process names only.

Instead, it uses:

* file-based validation
* recursive directory scanning
* launcher metadata verification
* classpath analysis
* runtime environment analysis

This avoids false positives and duplicate detections.

Example:
Other mods may simply scan for `"Modrinth"` running on the system.

EnvironmentDetector instead uses a more advanced runtime-based detection system.

## 1. JVM Argument Scan

The API scans Minecraft startup arguments (the same information normally visible in logs and runtime launch parameters).

If the word:

```text
modrinth
```

appears inside JVM arguments, launch paths or runtime parameters, the launcher is automatically detected as:

```text
Modrinth App
```

This works reliably because the Modrinth launcher usually injects Modrinth-related paths or identifiers into the Minecraft runtime environment.

---

## 2. Manual Configuration Fallback

On first startup, EnvironmentDetector automatically creates:

```text
config/environmentdetector.properties
```

Inside this file, custom values can be manually configured:

```properties
manual_pack_name=Your Modpack Name
manual_launcher_name=Your Custom Launcher
```

If these values are set, they always take highest priority and override automatic detection.

This allows:

* custom launchers
* private modpacks
* unsupported launchers
* development environments
* portable instances

to work reliably with the API.

---

# 🔍 Detection Logic

The API scans multiple directory levels to identify launcher structures.

## Supported Markers

### Modrinth App

* Runtime JVM analysis
* launch argument analysis
* optional metadata validation

### CurseForge

* `CURSEFORGE_INSTANCE_NAME`
* `minecraftinstance.json`
* `.curseclient`

### Feather Client

* `feather`
* `feather-core`
* `.feather`

### NoRisk Client

* `norisk.config`
* Mod ID: `norisk`

### GDLauncher

* `gd-launcher.json`
* `gdlauncher.json`

### Prism Launcher / MultiMC

* `prism.config`
* `prism.json`
* `multimc.cfg`

### ATLauncher

* `instance.json`
* `atlauncher.json`

### Lunar / Badlion

Classpath keyword analysis:

* `lunar`
* `badlion`

### Official Launcher

* `launcher_profiles.json`

---

# 📜 Standardized Logging

After initialization, EnvironmentDetector outputs a unified log entry.

Example:

```text
[EnvironmentDetector] Launcher=Modrinth App, Instance=Ultra Survival, NoRisk=false, Loader=Fabric, Version=1.21.1
```

Other examples:

```text
[EnvironmentDetector] Launcher=CurseForge, Instance=BetterMC, NoRisk=false, Loader=Fabric, Version=1.21.1
```

```text
[EnvironmentDetector] Launcher=NoRisk Client, Instance=Unknown Pack, NoRisk=true, Loader=Fabric, Version=1.21.1
```

Fallback:

```text
[EnvironmentDetector] Unknown Environment
```

---

# ⚡ Performance

* Single startup scan
* Cached results
* Thread-safe internals
* Minimal overhead
* No background scanning

EnvironmentDetector runs once during startup and afterwards only serves cached data.

---

# 🛠 Developer Integration

## Gradle Setup

```gradle
repositories {
    exclusiveContent {
        forRepository {
            maven {
                name = "Modrinth"
                url = "https://api.modrinth.com/maven"
            }
        }
        filter {
            includeGroup "maven.modrinth"
        }
    }
}
```

## Dependency

```gradle
dependencies {
    modImplementation "maven.modrinth:environmentdetector-api:VERSION"
}
```

Replace `VERSION` with the latest release.

---

# 💻 Usage Example

```java
public String getLauncherName() {
    if (FabricLoader.getInstance().isModLoaded("environmentdetector")) {
        return de.felixfgf.environmentdetector.EnvironmentDetectorAPI
                .getEnvironment()
                .launcher();
    }

    return "Vanilla";
}
```

---

# ⚠ Best Practices

## Always use optional integration

Do NOT hard depend on EnvironmentDetector.

Always check:

```java
FabricLoader.getInstance().isModLoaded("environmentdetector")
```

before using the API.

---

# 🚫 Common Mistakes

## Wrong package

Correct package:

```text
de.felixfgf.environmentdetector
```

NOT:

```text
de.felixfgf.environmentdetector.api
```

---

## Missing modLoaded check

Direct API access without checking if the mod exists can crash other mods.

---

## Using placeholders every frame

Do not resolve placeholders every render frame.
Cache values when opening menus or HUDs.

---

# 🐛 Bug Reports & Support

Found a bug or detection issue?

Please report:

* launcher used
* Minecraft version
* loader
* latest.log
* detected environment output

Join the Discord server for support, bug reports and API discussions:

[![Join DC \[middle small\]](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bfca91ef533789255f946e0c21aa5a6f4925876f_0.webp)](https://discord.gg/mP23dpVQ6V)

---

# 🎯 Goals

* Maximum environment transparency
* Reliable launcher identification
* High compatibility
* Zero-config setup
* Crash-safe integration
* Lightweight architecture

EnvironmentDetector is built to become the standard environment API for modern Minecraft launcher ecosystems 🚀

# Bilingual Search

Search the creative inventory and recipe book in **both your game language and English** — no matter what language you play in.

title: SeeThrough - Second Person Minecraft
description: This mod makes second person in minecraft possible
body:
# SeeThrough

**A paired-vision mod where two players see the world through each other's eyes.**

You move your own character. You control your own hotbar. You take your own damage. But the world you see on your screen? That belongs to your partner. To navigate intentionally, you have to keep each other in sight — because the only way you can see yourself is through their eyes.

Originally built for duo recordings on the [BubboSMP](https://youtube.com/@bubbo) channel, but it works for any number of pairs on a server.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zVxEh1tBijw&t=278s

---

## How it works

Each pair is symmetric. When player A is paired with player B:

- A's screen shows what B sees — B's position, B's rotation, B's view of the world.
- B's screen shows what A sees — A's position, A's rotation, A's view of the world.
- **Your HUD stays normal.** Hotbar, hearts, hunger, crosshair, experience — all yours. Only the world view is swapped.
- **Sound, chunk loading, and damage stay tied to you.** You don't get teleported, you don't take your partner's damage — only your vision moves.

### Smart fallbacks

The mod automatically falls back to your own view when seeing through your partner would break the game:

- Partner is **offline** → see your own view until they reconnect
- Partner is **dead** → see your own view until they respawn (no getting stuck on a death screen)
- Partner is **out of render distance** → see your own view until they're back in range

Pairings persist across these states, so when your partner comes back, the swap resumes automatically.

---

## Commands

All commands require op level 2.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/seethrough pair <playerA> <playerB>` | Pairs two players. Either player being already paired? Those pairings are cleared first. |
| `/seethrough unpair <player>` | Removes this player from their current pair. Their partner is unpaired too. |
| `/seethrough clear` | Removes every pairing on the server. |
| `/seethrough status` | Shows your current partner. |

### Example

```
/seethrough pair Bubbo Baablu
```

Both clients immediately swap to seeing through each other. To end the swap:

```
/seethrough clear
```

---

## Requirements

- **Minecraft 26.1.2**
- **Fabric Loader 0.18.4+**
- **Fabric API**
- **Java 25+**

Required on both the server and the client. A vanilla client cannot connect to a server running SeeThrough — both sides need the mod installed.

---

## What it's good for

- **Duo collab videos** where the chaos comes from forced cooperation.
- **Server events** where you want a "blind leading the blind" challenge round.
- **Speedrun twists** — try beating the dragon when you can't directly see your own character.
- **Puzzle maps** built around the swapped-vision constraint.

The mod imposes no goal of its own. It's just the mechanic. What you do with it is up to you.

---

## Known limitations

- Combat is genuinely hard when paired. This is intentional — it's the design — but be aware that solo PvP isn't really the format this mod was built for.
- If your partner is far underground while you're on the surface, your screen will show a cave (or pitch black, if it's unlit). This is the mechanic working correctly, but it can feel jarring. Communicate before you split up.
- Players can only be in one pair at a time. Pairing someone who's already paired automatically clears their previous pair.

---

## Compatibility

SeeThrough only modifies the client camera and adds server-side commands. It should be compatible with most other mods. If you find a conflict, please open an issue.

---

## License

MIT. Do whatever you want with it.

title: Sweet Apocalypse Biome
description: Dive into a world transformed by confectionery chaos with the Sweet Apocalypse Biome mod!
body:
🍬 Sweet Apocalypse Biome: The Ultimate Confectionery Expansion

Welcome to the Sweet Apocalypse Biome, a transformative Minecraft experience that reimagines the world through a sugar-coated lens. This isn't just a simple biome mod; it's a complete overhaul of how you interact with the environment, offering a whimsical yet challenging "apocalypse" where the world has been reclaimed by candy, chocolate, and all things sweet. Built for Minecraft 1.21.1 on the NeoForge loader, this mod brings a burst of color and creativity to your survival adventures.




🌍 The World of the Sweet Apocalypse

The heart of this mod lies in its unique world generation. Forget the murky waters of a standard swamp; step into the Candy Swamp. This vibrant ecosystem is a feast for the senses, featuring a palette of pinks, purples, and deep chocolate browns.

The Candy Swamp Biome

The Candy Swamp is a dense, atmospheric region where the very earth has turned into treats.

•
Candy Dirt & Grass: The foundation of the biome, these blocks provide a colorful alternative to standard greenery. They are perfect for terraforming your own candy kingdom.

•
Chocolate Trees: Towering giants with trunks made of rich Chocolate Logs and canopies of Chocolate Leaves. These trees are the primary source of lumber in the biome.

•
Natural Structures: Keep an eye out for the Chocolate House. These pre-generated structures offer a cozy (and edible-looking) place to take shelter during your first night in the apocalypse.




🏗️ Building with Confectionery

For the builders and decorators, the Sweet Apocalypse Biome introduces a massive array of new blocks. The Chocolate Wood set is a complete replacement for traditional wood types, offering a warm, dark aesthetic that fits perfectly in both whimsical and professional builds.

The Chocolate Wood Index

Every piece of the chocolate tree can be utilized:

•
Logs & Planks: The core building blocks. Planks can be crafted into Stairs, Slabs, Fences, and Fence Gates.

•
Doors & Trapdoors: Secure your home with style. The chocolate variants feature unique textures that set them apart from vanilla wood.

•
Utility & Decoration: Craft Chocolate Buttons, Pressure Plates, and even Chocolate Signs or Hanging Signs to label your sweet storage.

•
Stripped Variants: For those who prefer a smoother texture, all chocolate wood blocks come in stripped versions, providing a polished look for interior design.

Geological Wonders: Cookie Stone

The sweetness goes deep underground. Replace your standard stone with Cooky Stone.

•
Variants: Just like vanilla stone, you can find and craft Cooky Cobblestone and Cooky Smooth Stone.

•
Smelting & Blasting: Use your furnace or blast furnace to transition between these states, allowing for a variety of "baked" textures in your castle walls.




⚔️ Advanced Materials & Equipment

Survival in the Sweet Apocalypse requires more than just sugar; it requires strength.

Candy Titanium

Deep within the candy-infused crust of the earth lies Candy Titanium Ore. This rare mineral is the pinnacle of confectionery technology.

•
Smelting: Process the ore into Titanium Candy Ingots.

•
Construction: Combine these ingots to create the Candy Titanium Block, a dense and highly resistant block that serves as the ultimate flex in your base building.

Nautical Exploration

Traverse the sugary waters of the Candy Swamp with specialized transport:

•
Chocolate Boat: A sturdy vessel crafted from chocolate planks.

•
Chocolate Chest Boat: Don't leave your treats behind! This variant allows you to transport your inventory across the sweet seas.




🧪 Alchemy of the Sweet God

The mod introduces a unique brewing system that rewards experimentation with high-tier vanilla items and sweet treats.

•
Potion of a Cookie God: By combining a Totem of Undying with a Cookie in a brewing stand, you can ascend to a higher state of being. This potion is the ultimate reward for any survivor.

•
Potion of "It's Not Good for the Skin": A cautionary brew. What does it do? Only the bravest alchemists will find out.

•
Potion of "Sticky Situation": Harness the viscous nature of sugar to manipulate your environment or your enemies.




🛠️ Technical Specifications & Installation

To ensure the best experience, please note the following technical requirements:

•
Minecraft Version: 1.21.1

•
Mod Loader: NeoForge (Version 21.1.190 or higher is recommended).

•
Compatibility: Designed to work seamlessly with other NeoForge mods.

•
Development: Proudly created using MCreator, showcasing the power of community-driven modding tools.




📜 Final Words

The Sweet Apocalypse Biome is more than just a mod; it's an invitation to see Minecraft in a new light. Whether you're a builder looking for new textures, an explorer seeking unique biomes, or an alchemist hunting for powerful new brews, there is something here for everyone.

Download now and start your sweet journey!

title: Player Last Seen
description: /seen [player] — when was this player last online? The last-seen that vanilla NeoForge servers don't have.
body:
# Player Last Seen

`/seen [player]` — when was this player last online? The last-seen lookup that vanilla NeoForge and Fabric servers don't have.

Vanilla has no last-seen, and the plugin that does (EssentialsX) only runs on Paper, not on vanilla NeoForge/Fabric servers. This adds the command as a mod.

```
/seen Steve  → Steve is online right now.
/seen Alex   → Alex was last seen 2026-05-15 14:30 (about 1 day ago).
                 also seen 2026-05-13 22:10 (about 3 days ago)
```

It tracks login/logout server-side, keeps the last 3 sightings per player, and persists across restarts. `/seen` is open to all players, like EssentialsX's — anyone can query anyone's last-online, so it does reveal players' activity windows server-wide. In single-player, leave and re-enter the world to populate it. Output is localized in 9 languages.

It's a login/logout listener, persistent world data, and one command — no mixin, no config, no blocks or items.

Server-side — install on the server only.

Free to use in any modpack. Source and issues: https://github.com/KURONAMI333/last-seen

title: Backstabbing-Fix
description: A lightweight server-side fix for Farmer's Delight knives and similar mods, validating attack angles to prevent backstabbing exploits.
body:
## Overview

Backstabbing Fix is a server-side Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that patches the backstabbing damage exploit from Farmer's Delight. It keeps the enchantment behavior limited to standard player melee attacks instead of allowing amplified damage from unrelated sources.

The mod is intentionally small and focused. It does one job: prevent the backstabbing bonus from being abused by modded damage sources such as spells, projectiles, or other non-melee attacks.

## The Problem

Farmer's Delight backstabbing is meant to reward proper melee positioning. Without a fix, the damage bonus can be triggered by sources that were never intended to count as normal knife attacks.

That means players can sometimes:

1.  Use spells instead of melee hits
2.  Trigger the bonus with projectiles or other modded damage
3.  Bypass the intended combat rules of the enchantment

In modded servers, that creates inconsistent and unfair damage behavior.

## How It Works

Backstabbing Fix listens to the Farmer's Delight backstabbing hook and validates the incoming damage source before the bonus is applied.

The fix only allows the amplification when the damage source is a standard player melee attack. If the hit comes from anything else, the backstab bonus is cancelled.

This keeps the enchantment tied to the combat style it was designed for.

## Features

*   Server-side only
*   Lightweight and focused
*   Prevents backstabbing amplification from non-melee damage
*   Compatible with modded combat setups
*   Optional behavior: the mod can load even if Farmer's Delight is not installed

## Configuration

The mod includes a simple server config:

```
[fixes]
fixBackstabbingExploit = true
```

🌍 Level Border Challenge
Welcome to the Level Border Challenge! A professional and highly customizable challenge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1.

In this mod, your world is restricted by a World Border that starts tiny (e.g., 1x1). The only way to expand your territory? Gain experience! For every level you climb, the border expands, giving you more space to explore, mine, and survive.

XP-Based Growth: The border size is tied to your experience level. Level up to survive!

Custom Spawn Logic: Start every challenge by being teleported to the world spawn, where a tree is automatically generated for you to stand on. No more dying in a 1x1 hole!

Interactive GUI: A full-blown configuration menu with a sleek gray-glass design.

Real-time Config: Change settings on the fly without restarting your world.

🛠 Commands
/challenge start – Initializes the challenge, shrinks the border, builds the spawn tree, and teleports you.

NEW: /challenge configurations – Opens the interactive GUI to customize your experience.

/challenge stop – Pauses the border growth logic.

/challenge reset – Resets the World Border to the vanilla maximum.

⚙️ Configuration
You can adjust the following settings directly in the game menu:

Start Size: How big the border is at Level 0.

Blocks per Level: How many blocks the border grows for each XP level.

Border Damage: Toggle whether being outside the border should hurt you.

📦 Installation
Make sure you are on Fabric 1.20.1.

Install the Fabric API (required).

Drop the mod jar into your mods folder.

Start the game and use /challenge start to begin!

title: Sudo plugin
description: This plugin introduces a command that alllows you or command blocks to execute any command as another player.
body:
# SudoPlugin

Run any command as another player — from the console, in-game, or triggered by a command block.

---

## Features

- Run any command (vanilla or plugin) as another player
- Full Minecraft selector support: `@p`, `@a`, `@r`, `@s`, or a player name
- Works from command blocks, console, and in-game
- Bypass permission to protect specific players
- No unnecessary listeners — pure command dispatch

---

## Requirements

- Paper 1.21.1
- Java 21

---

## Installation

1. Download `SudoPlugin-1.0.0.jar`
2. Drop it into your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Restart the server

---

## Usage

```
/sudo <selector> <command>
```

| Selector | Target |
|---|---|
| `@p` | Nearest player to the sender (or command block) |
| `@a` | All online players |
| `@r` | A random online player |
| `@s` | The player who ran the command |
| `<name>` | A specific player by name |

### Examples

```
/sudo @p tp ~ ~10 ~
/sudo @a give @s diamond 1
/sudo mieprenzo gamemode creative
```

### Command Block Setup

Place a command block and enter:

```
sudo @p <command>
```

`@p` resolves to the player nearest to the command block. No pressure plate listener or special setup required — Minecraft's own redstone triggers it.

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sudo.use` | OP | Allows use of the `/sudo` command |
| `sudo.bypass` | false | Player cannot be targeted by `/sudo` from other players |

> **Note:** `sudo.bypass` only applies when another *player* runs `/sudo`. Command blocks and console always execute regardless.

---

*Made by mieprenzo*

body:
![Plasma](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1138ff91a86494bbb1b1a49bb89cbaeeb2f6b714.png)

The Plasma - A mod that will add many things related to a new material better than netherite - Plasma!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Geckolib is required for this to work!**


# Description:
With this mod, you now have the Plasma material.
There are two ways to obtain Plasma (Plasma Ingot).
### 1.
#### Take a Netherite Ingot, drop it, and wait for lightning to strike it or nearby. Then it will turn into a Plasma Ingot.
### 2.
#### Craft a Thunderer's Table. Go to its menu and place the trident in the trident slot. Place the trident in the second slot. Then press "Charge." The item will be charged, but the trident's durability will be consumed.
---
YOU CANNOT CHARGE WEAPONS OR TOOLS IMMEDIATELY IN ANY WAY!
List of items that can be charged using methods 1 or 2:
Netherite Ingot
Any Netherite Armor (will charge, but not completely)
Blaze Rod
To obtain working Plasma Armor, you need to:
Charge it using any method
then combine the half-charged armor with 3 Plasma Ingots.
Tools are crafted like regular ones, but with Plasma Rods instead of sticks and Plasma as the material.
Plasma has the properties of lightning—that's its advantage.
There's also Ectoplasm, which has a chance to drop from lightning strikes or when using a Thunderer's Table. It can be made into a soup that, when consumed, strikes mobs within a 6-block radius with lightning. If there are no mobs, it can strike any nearby chargeable item, otherwise it'll just go nowhere.
Also, if you place a plasma core block and surround it with 6 plasma blocks, a Plasma Golem will appear, which behaves similarly to an iron one, but is stronger.

Version 1.0.5 introduced a new item: the Plasma Dagger. When hitting an entity, it teleports the player to its coordinates, and the entity to the player's coordinates, swapping them. On a critical hit, it teleports the player a little further away and the mob to the player's position.

However, the Plasma Dagger does not have lightning properties.

The new versions also have a couple of new blocks such as: Plasma Drawer, which allows you to store a lot of things and is solid and explosion-proof, and Plasma Lantern - a bright lamp and also solid and explosion-proof.

There is also a Plasma Haste effect - during it, if the player is struck by lightning, he will receive level 3 haste for a while.

Ectoplasm can be used to brew a Lightning potion (but it can also be obtained with a full armor set).

In new versions, a Plasma Apple will appear that gives buffs when converging.



Version 1.0.4.5 introduced Plasma Nuggets, 9 of which can be crafted into 1 ingot, and 1 ingot into 9 nuggets.
8 plasma nuggets and 1 emerald in the center can be crafted into a music disk.

The mod also includes its own weapon, the Plasma Hammer. It works like the others, striking with a hammer and having a longer cooldown, but it also explodes the target on impact. It has a slower attack speed.

You can also create a Plasma Pulsar from Gold, Echo Shards, and an Ectoplasm Artifact in the center. It can be used to knock back and damage nearby creatures!



Plasma tools and weapons strike the target with lightning on impact with a cooldown.

There's also the lightning effect, and if you have it and get struck by lightning, it will make you stronger!

With a full set of plasma armor, the player will receive a lightning effect.

Ectoplasm can be obtained from the Thunderer's table or if lightning strikes somewhere with some chance!

In version 1.0.2 and higher, a profession for the villager is available - Thunderer on the Thunderer's table.



The mod also includes item Plasma Throwing dynamite (not a block) , which can be thrown and when it hits a block, it will explode and cause lightning. There is also a Plasma TNT block, which, when ignited, like regular TNT, will flash and emit smoke and then explode along with lightning. It has an animation of the explosion starting after being set on fire.



In the new versions of the mod, there will be a companion called Bob. Make it from a plasma apple, and this creature will talk to you whenever you want! Just right-click on it. Bob, although an alive object, looks like a plasma apple with eyes and a smile.

Plasma can easily be used for a beacon.



### In version 1.0.5, a small amount of content not related to plasma will be provided.

 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
### This mod is still in development, so errors are possible.
### Russian, Italian and English languages ​​are supported.

When you send a trigger message (for example Hey AI ...), the mod sends the prompt to your local AI backend and posts the response in chat. By default, AI replies are sent to server chat so all players can see them. Triggers, model settings, and behavior are fully configurable in Mod Menu.

Features:
- Configurable trigger prefixes (Hey AI, KI mach, etc.)
- Toggle AI feature on/off
- Option to send or block the trigger message
- Option to send AI replies to server chat
- Local AI backend support via Ollama
- In-game configuration via Mod Menu + Cloth Config

Requirements:
- Minecraft 1.21.8
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Mod Menu
- Cloth Config
- Java 21
- Ollama running locally
- Recommended model: qwen2.5:3b

How to run:
 1. Install Ollama (https://ollama.com/download)
 2. Open a new Powershell and paste in following command "ollama pull qwen2.5:3b"
 3. Start Minecraft and chat with your new AI friend

This project was fully programmed with AI and inspired by l33T on YouTube.

title: Potion Disabler
description: A simple, lightweight QoL plugin that lets server admins completely disable specific potion effects using an easy in-game GUI.
body:
# PotionDisabler

A simple, lightweight QoL plugin that lets server admins completely disable specific potion effects using an easy in-game GUI. 

Ever needed to disable Invisibility, Strength, or the new 1.21 effects for a PvP event, but didn't want to mess with complex config files? This plugin handles it instantly. If an effect is disabled, players simply won't get it from drinking potions, splash potions, lingering clouds, or tipped arrows.

### Features
* **In-Game GUI:** Type `/pd` to open a clean menu showing every potion effect in the game.
* **Toggle with a Click:** Click any effect in the GUI to disable or enable it instantly. No reloads required.
* **Built-in Search:** Looking for a specific effect? Use the GUI search button to find it quickly instead of scrolling through pages.
* **Complete Coverage:** Blocks effects from normal potions, splash potions, lingering clouds, tipped arrows, and even beacons/conduits.
* **Modern API:** Built specifically for 1.21.x, fully supporting the newest effects (Wind Charged, Weaving, Oozing, Infested).

### Commands & Permissions
* `/potiondisabler` (Alias: `/pd`) - Opens the main GUI.
* `/potiondisabler search <effect>` - Search for an effect directly.
* **Permission:** `potiondisabler.admin` (Required to use the commands and GUI).

![GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3m8moUmh/images/57a95110ca0e5261d9f9abd97ab9a4b1a8f21ead.png)

### How it works
When you disable an effect in the GUI, the plugin intercepts any event where a player would receive that specific effect and cancels it. Mobs are unaffected, meaning your server's PvE balance remains exactly the same.


**Supported Versions:** 1.21.x (Paper/Purpur/Spigot)

All Rights Reserved.

title: Simple Turret Block
description: A simple turret block that can use bow enchantments and uses different fuel sources to work
body:
# Turret Block

This mod was a mod request via Willfurr's Series

A Mod that adds an automated, placeable turret block that defends your base against mobs — or players.

## Features

### Automated Defense
Place a turret and it will automatically detect and shoot hostile mobs within range. The turret uses line-of-sight raycasting, so placement matters — walls will block targeting.

### Seven Targeting Modes
Cycle through targeting modes via the turret GUI:
- **All Hostile** (default) — targets any hostile mob
- **Zombies / Skeletons / Creepers / Spiders** 
- **All Mobs** — any living entity except players
- **Players** — all players except the turret's owner 

### Fuel System
Turrets require fuel to operate, using a familiar furnace-style system:

| Fuel | Burn Time | Bonus |
|------|-----------|-------|
| Coal / Charcoal | 1600 ticks | — |
| Blaze Rod | 2400 ticks | Faster fire rate |
| Blaze Powder | 1200 ticks | — |
| Gunpowder | 800 ticks | — |

### Enchantment Books
Slot up to 3 enchanted books into the turret to enhance its arrows:
- **Power**
- **Flame**
- **Punch**
- **Infinity** — still requires at least 1 arrow

Each active enchantment produces animated spiral particles around the turret.

### Soul Torch Range Boost
Place soul torches or soul lanterns within 8 blocks of the turret to extend its range. Each torch adds +5 blocks (base 20, max 40 with 4 torches). Connected torches create a visible particle funnel effect flowing into the turret.

## Crafting Recipe

```
 I B I
 I D I
 I R I
```

| Key | Item |
|-----|------|
| I | Iron Ingot |
| B | Bow |
| D | Dispenser |
| R | Redstone |

title: Trident Channeling Enhanced（三叉戟引雷增强 ）
description:
Channeling up to Lv.5 with a chance of non-thunderstorm lightning & chain damage. Adds "Trident Shot" for Crossbows to fire powerful Tridents.

引雷上限至 5 级，支持非雷雨天概率落雷与连锁闪电。新增“海神之引”附魔，使弩能发射高伤三叉戟。
body:
# Description

## Mechanism Changes: Channeling Enchantment

- Level cap increased to 5
- Channeling Level X deals X chains of damage
  - When attacking while holding (the weapon), it deals X-1 hits of damage.
  - Chain radius: (1.75 + Chain Level × 0.25) blocks
  - Chain effect can trigger even without hitting a mob.
- The X-th chain damage is: Base Damage * (1 - (X / Total Chains))
- Base Damage:
  - Held attack: base damage is melee attack damage
  - Throw attack: base damage is 8
  - Loaded into Crossbow attack: base damage mechanism is similar to arrows, but base damage is higher (2.0-->3.0)
    - Note: If a trident fired from a crossbow fails to hit a mob, the base damage is 8.
- Channeling Level X has 2*(X-1)% chance to summon lightning in non-thunder weather

## New Enchantment: Trident Shot

- Effect: Allows Tridents to be loaded into Crossbows
- Acquisition: 10% chance to obtain from Treasure Map Chests

## New Enchantment: Chain Reach

- Effect: Increases the chain detection distance
- Acquisition:
  - Treasure Map Chests: 15% chance to obtain (enchantment level 1-4 randomly assigned)
  - Shipwrecks: 15% chance to obtain (enchantment level 1-5 randomly assigned)

# 简介

## 机制修改：引雷附魔

- 上限增加至5级
- 引雷x级，能造成x段连锁伤害
  - 手持攻击时造成x-1段伤害
  - 连锁半径为（1.75+连锁等级*0.25）格
  - 未击中生物也可连锁
- 第x段伤害为：基础伤害*（1-（x/总段数））
- 基础伤害：
  - 手持攻击，基础伤害为手持攻击伤害
  - 投掷攻击，基础伤害为8
  - 装填至弩上攻击，基础伤害机制与弩箭类似，但基础伤害更高（2.0-->3.0）
    - 注：弩射击的三叉戟若未击中生物，则基础伤害为8
- 引雷x级，在非雷雨天有2*(x-1)%的概率召唤闪电

## 附魔新增：海神之引

- 效果：使三叉戟可以装填至弩上
- 获取方式：藏宝图宝箱有10%概率开出

## 附魔新增：连锁
- 效果：增加连锁的判定距离
- 获取方式：
  - 藏宝图宝箱有15%概率开出（附魔等级1-4随机分配）
  - 沉船有15%概率开出（附魔等级1-5随机分配）

title: TerraNugget SMP
description: TerraNugget SMP is a Vanilla+ survival modpack designed for having fun with friends, featuring expanded world generation and new structures built entirely from vanilla blocks.
body:
# TerraNugget SMP

The TerraNugget SMP Pack was originally created for a small SMP-Project with friends to achieve a Vanilla+ experience. It focuses on enhancing world generation, adding new structures, and integrating performance, graphical, and Quality of Life (QoL) mods to improve gameplay. It also includes multiplayer features to make SMP more enjoyable.

**No modded blocks or items are added to the game!**

## Features

Based on the included mods, players can expect the following additions and tweaks:

### World Generation & Structures
* **Overworld:** Modified terrain and biome generation using **Terralith** and **Tectonic**.
* **Dimensions:** Updated Nether and End generation via **Amplified Nether** and **Nullscape**.
* **Structures:** Overhauled vanilla structures (such as Desert Temples, Ocean Monuments, Pillager Outposts, and Mansions) using the **Dungeons and Taverns** mods.

### Multiplayer 
* **Proximity Chat:** Integrated **Simple Voice Chat** for in-game communication.
* **Host Anywhere:** Includes **e4mc** to easily share single-player worlds with friends.
* **Server Utilities:** Features **Ledger** for block logging and **Universal Graves** to handle player deaths.

### Performance
* **Core Optimization:** Includes standard Fabric performance mods such as **Sodium**, **Lithium**, and **FerriteCore**.
* **World Generation:** Fast chunk calculation using **C2ME** and **NoisiumForked**.

### Visuals & Audio
* **Graphics:** Shader support via **Iris Shaders** and connected textures through **Continuity**.
* **Models & Animations:** Updated entity models and player features via **Fresh Animations** and **3D Skin Layers**.
* **Audio:** Adjusted acoustics and reverberation using **Sound Physics Remastered**.

### Quality of Life & Technical Tools
* **Mapping:** Navigation support with **Xaero's Minimap** and **Xaero's World Map**.
* **Technical Mods:** Client-side tools for technical players, including **Litematica**, **MiniHUD**, **Tweakeroo**, and **Carpet**.
* **Building:** **Axiom** is included for advanced creative building.

---

## Installation
**Usage on Servers** It is recommended to use [mrpack-install](https://github.com/nothub/mrpack-install) to create a server for this modpack.

title: RadialHotbarMOVE
description: A console-style radial item wheel inspired by Animal Crossing and GTA V to redefine your inventory navigation.
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47473410b6f927310a2dcda773e0b5c524cfeb8e.png)

**RadialHotbarMOVE** transforms the classic linear Minecraft hotbar into a fluid, circular selection wheel.

Inspired by the polished UI of Animal Crossing: New Horizons and the quick-access weapon wheel of Grand Theft Auto V, this mod is designed for players who want a more immersive and modern way to swap items.


## Quick Select System 🎡
Hold TAB to bring up the radial wheel. Simply move your mouse or use the scroll wheel to highlight a slot, then release to equip.
- Zero Mouse Clicks: Everything is handled by movement and key release.
- Vertical Sensitivity: Move your mouse up or down to cycle through items instantly.

## Dynamic Interface 🖥️
To keep your screen clean and cinematic:
- Auto-Hide Hotbar: The vanilla hotbar is hidden by default but can be toggled in settings.
  Focus Mode: The crosshair and player list (TAB) are automatically hidden while the wheel is open to let you focus on your items.
- Smooth Fade: No jarring pop-ups. The wheel appears with a professional alpha-fade and background blur effect.

## Visual Themes 🎨
Customize the look of your wheel via the in-game settings menu (Default key: Y):
- Animal Crossing Theme: Clean, minimalist floating circles for each item.
- GTA V Theme: A classic segmented ring with high-contrast selection paths.
- Custom Colors: Palette optimized with #e8e7d5 (Cream) for normal states and #ffde86 (Sunlight Yellow) for selected items.

## Full Customization ⚙️
Access the Radial Settings menu to tweak:
- Vanilla Hotbar Toggle: Choose if you want to keep the old hotbar visible or go full minimal.
- Wheel Scaling: Three size modes (Small, Medium, Large) or "Synced" to match your Minecraft GUI scale automatically.
- Sound Feedback: Satisfying UI "clicks" when navigating, with pitch variation based on the slot position.
![settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d5162fd45b31619177f4ff5418533d368541149_0.webp)

## Compatibility 🎮
**100% Client-Side:** Since it only changes your UI, you can use it on any vanilla or modded server without being banned or needing the mod installed on the server.
Shader Friendly: Works perfectly with Iris and Sodium.

title: MyCoords
description: Lightweight Minecraft Paper plugin that provides a simple and configurable way for players to view their current coordinates directly in chat.
body:
**MyCoords** is a lightweight Minecraft Paper plugin that provides a simple and configurable way for players to view their current coordinates directly in chat. ### Key Features * View coordinates using a single command * Toggle the command on or off * Change coordinate text color * Show or hide the X/Y/Z prefix * Adjustable decimal precision * Lightweight and server-friendly * Server-side only (no client mods required) ### Functionality In vanilla Minecraft, players typically rely on the debug screen to check their coordinates, which can be distracting during gameplay. MyCoords allows players to quickly display their current X, Y, and Z coordinates in chat using `/c`. Players can customize how the coordinates are displayed, including color, precision, and formatting, all without requiring a server restart. ### Commands | Command | Description | | ---------------------- | -------------------------------------- | | `/c` | Displays your current coordinates | | `/c toggle` | Enables or disables coordinate display | | `/c color ` | Changes the coordinate text color | | `/c prefix` | Shows or hides the X/Y/Z prefix | | `/c decimals ` | Sets how many decimal places are shown | ### Installation MyCoords is a server-side plugin and does not need to be installed on the client. --- ### Credits Special thanks to my girlfriend for making the project icon!

🛠 Support & Bug Reports

Report issues directly on Discord.

It improves textures and sounds just enough to feel cleaner, and fixes little rough spots that can make vanilla feel clunky. Nothing major is changed—you’ll still be playing the game you know, only slightly better.

## Features

**Visual and Audio Tweaks**
- Cleaner textures and sounds that don’t feel out of place
- Works with shaders like Complementary for brighter lighting
- Keeps the classic Minecraft look intact

**Vanilla-Focused Survival**
- Game mechanics and progression remain unchanged
- Ready for singleplayer or hardcore mode
- Small improvements that help without adding complexity

**Optimized for Mid-Range Hardware**
- Doesn’t require a high-end computer
- Balances nicer visuals with smooth performance
- Focused on stability

**Beginner-Friendly Modpack**
- A good starting point if you’re new to modding
- Only includes mods that make survival easier or more pleasant
- Provides a foundation you can expand on as you get more comfortable

## Why Try It?

If you want survival to feel a little fresher, this pack does that without changing the core of the game. Exploring, building, and surviving all run a bit smoother and feel more engaging, while still keeping the charm of vanilla Minecraft.

description: A fun plugin to play with friends, which syncs the inventory, health, saturation, hotbar slot selected, to all the players who are linked using the command
body:
# SyncPlayers

**Paper 1.21.1 Plugin** - Link player states across your server!

## Description
SyncPlayers lets server admins link multiple players together using `/link <player1> <player2> ...`, instantly syncing their **inventory**, **health**, **food saturation**, and **hotbar slot** in real-time. Use `/resync` to refresh all links anytime. Perfect for playing with friends as a fun challenge.

## Features
- 🔗 Syncs inventory, health, saturation, and hotbar slot
- 👥 Supports 2+ players per link (unlimited)
- ⚡ `/resync` for instant updates for all according to the person who ran the command (just in case something goes wrong)
- 🏗️ Optimized for Paper 1.21.1 (Spigot compatible)
- 🎯 Lightweight - no performance impact

## Commands
- `/link <player1> <player2> ...` - Link players (syncplayers.link)
- `/resync` - Refresh all links (syncplayers.resync)

## Permissions
- `syncplayers.link` - Use /link command
- `syncplayers.resync` - Use /resync command

title: MultiMOTD
description: Manage multiple MOTDs with one plugin, select and change on the fly
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80f7a734f349df9a51f6d3d000886f5f90735846_0.webp)
# MultiMOTD – Advanced MOTD Management Made Simple

MultiMOTD is a modern, lightweight plugin that allows server owners to manage multiple server MOTDs from a single plugin.  
Each MOTD can be configured independently, previewed in-game, and switched instantly without restarting the server.

Designed for modern Minecraft versions, MultiMOTD supports gradients, hex colors, animations, and placeholders while remaining fast, stable, and easy to use.

---

## ✨ Features

- Multiple MOTDs stored in separate configuration files
- In-game GUI for selecting and applying MOTDs
- Per-ping animated MOTDs (no repeating tasks required)
- Native hex color and gradient support
- Optional bold gradient text rendering
- PlaceholderAPI integration
- GUI preview matches the server list output exactly
- Active MOTD highlighted in the GUI
- Pagination support for large MOTD collections
- Reload command for instant config updates
- Built-in update checker using the Spigot API
- Clean startup logging with status output

---

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft Versions:** 1.16.5+
- **Server Software:** Spigot, Paper, Purpur
- **Java Version:** Java 16
- **Optional Dependency:** PlaceholderAPI

PlaceholderAPI is optional. The plugin works without it, but placeholders will only be parsed if it is installed.

---

## Commands

### `/multimotd`
Displays command usage.

### `/multimotd menu`
Opens the MOTD selection GUI.

### `/multimotd reload`
Reloads all configuration files and MOTDs.

### `/multimotd version`
Displays the installed plugin version.

### `/multimotd update`
Checks for available updates.

**Aliases:**
- `/mmotd`

---

## Permissions

| Permission         | Description                                      | Default |
|-------------------|--------------------------------------------------|---------|
| `multimotd.admin` | Full access to MultiMOTD commands and GUI        | OP      |

---

## Configuration

All MOTDs are stored individually inside:
### `/plugins/MultiMOTD/motds`

Each MOTD supports:

- Animated frames
- Gradients
- Hex colors
- Placeholders

Changes can be applied instantly using `/multimotd reload`.

---

## Notes

- Animated MOTDs are displayed per server ping for smooth, lightweight animations
- GUI previews always reflect the exact MOTD shown in the server list
- No legacy hacks or outdated APIs are used
- Built with performance and reliability in mind

---

## Support & Updates

Updates are announced in-console and to operators on join.

title: Phantom Warning
description: Warns you exactly 3 minutes before Phantoms spawn due to lack of sleep. Includes a hotkey to check your status and a personal record tracker!
body:
# Phantom Warning

Never get caught off guard by Phantoms again! Phantom Warning is a highly focused Quality of Life (QoL) mod that alerts you exactly when you are in danger, while also keeping track of your longest sleepless streaks. 🦇

![Phantom Warning Alert](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/X2FbamUI/images/0b8bd4699d24c281c064ee7ef6ed9aa523af7bff.png)

***

## Core Features

**The 3-Minute Alert**
The mod securely tracks your sleep statistics in the background. If you haven't slept for 3 in-game days, it will display a large, unmissable on-screen warning exactly **3 real-time minutes** before the sun sets and Phantoms start spawning. You'll have just enough time to safely find a bed or prepare your weapons for a fight! ⚔️

![Breaking Your Record](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/X2FbamUI/images/5c3bab1165abe00908e00052386c501743ca832c.png)

**Personal Record Tracker**
Are you trying to survive as long as possible without sleeping? The mod permanently saves your highest consecutive days awake per world. If you surpass your previous limit, it will cheer you on with a special on-screen notification. 🏆

![Checking Phantom Status](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/X2FbamUI/images/0acfd2e63a42a9424a7752c224e958493452a006.png)

**On-Demand Status Check**
Don't remember how many days it's been since you last slept? Simply press the dedicated hotkey to instantly view your current days awake and your all-time personal record directly on the screen. 📊

![Custom Keybind Integration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/X2FbamUI/images/84b575ebdef5ea7dc837619bb2401bfcd39f35ea.png)

**Native Integration**
The status check keybind is fully integrated into the Vanilla controls menu. By default, it is bound to the **N** key, but you can change it to whatever fits your playstyle. ⌨️

***

## Supported Languages

The mod automatically adapts to your client's language settings. It currently supports out of the box:
* English (US)
* Spanish (Spain)
* Portuguese (Brazil)
* Russian
* Italian
* German
* French
* Simplified Chinese
* Japanese
* Arabic
* Korean

***

## Installation Requirements

This mod uses custom networking channels to communicate the hotkey presses to the server logic. Therefore, it is **Required on both Client and Server**. 
* **Singleplayer:** Just drop it in your `mods` folder.
* **Multiplayer:** Both the dedicated server and the connecting players must have the mod installed to avoid network kicks.

title: RankedSystem
description: Take your ranked to the NEXT LEVEL
body:
# 🏆 RankedSystem: MMR-Based Progression

Take your server's competition to the next level. **RankedSystem** introduces a dynamic, skill-based MMR (Matchmaking Rating) system that tracks player performance across PvP, PvE, and world progression.

Unlike simple leveling plugins, this system allows players to fall into the negatives, creating a high-stakes environment where every death matters.

---

## 📈 The Ranking Ladder

Rise through the ranks from a lowly Unranked survivor to the legendary **NETHERITE** tier. Your rank is displayed as a colored prefix on your nametag and in the tab list for all to see.

* **Netherite:** 20,000+ MMR
* **Diamond:** 7,000 — 20,000 MMR
* **Emerald:** 1,000 — 7,000 MMR
* **Iron:** 200 — 1,000 MMR
* **Copper:** 1 — 200 MMR
* **Unranked:** 0 MMR or below

---

## ⚔️ How to Earn (and Lose) MMR

The system is fully automated and rewards active, skilled gameplay:

### **Gains**

* **PvP Victory:** Defeat another player (+1 to +15 MMR).
* **Boss Slayer:** Slay the Ender Dragon, Wither, or Raid leaders like Evokers and Pillagers (+1 to +15 MMR).
* **Progression:** Complete advancements (+1 to +10 MMR).

### **Losses**

* **Defeat:** Slain by another player (-5 to -20 MMR).
* **Boss Failure:** Dying to bosses or raid mobs (-5 to -20 MMR).
* **Survival:** Any other death (-5 to -15 MMR).
* **Banned:** Getting banned by staff results in an **immediate 2-rank penalty**.

---

## 🛠 Commands & Permissions

The plugin is designed to be lightweight and easy to use.

| Command | Description | Permission |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/ranked check {player}` | Check your own or another player's MMR and rank. | *None* |
| `/ranked xp give {player} {qty}` | Add MMR to a player. | `ranked.admin` |
| `/ranked xp remove {player} {qty}` | Deduct MMR from a player. | `ranked.admin` |

> **Note:** Admins (OPs) have access to all commands by default.

---

## ⚙️ Fully Configurable

Want to change the thresholds? You can easily modify the `config.yml` to set your own MMR requirements for each rank, change the display names, or adjust the colors to match your server's theme.

### **Installation**

1. Drop the `.jar` into your `plugins` folder.
2. Restart your server.
3. (Optional) Customize the `config.yml` and use `/reload`.

title: AdminActivityTracker
description: A Minecraft plugin for tracking and logging administrator activity on your server.
body:
![Available for Paper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/intergrav/devins-badges/v2/assets/compact/supported/paper_46h.png)
![Available for Purpur](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/intergrav/devins-badges/v2/assets/compact/supported/purpur_46h.png)

# AdminActivityTracker

A Minecraft plugin for tracking and logging administrator activity on your server.

## Description

AdminActivityTracker is a lightweight plugin that automatically tracks and saves all activities of players with administrator permissions to text files. Perfect for monitoring staff activity and preventing abuse.

## Features

- **Command logging** - Records all commands executed by administrators
- **Creative inventory tracking** - Logs items taken from creative inventory
- **Dropped items monitoring** - Tracks items dropped by admins
- **Item movement tracking** - Records item transfers from admin inventory to chests or other players
- **Individual log files** - Each administrator has their own activity history file
- **Configurable system** - Ability to enable/disable individual features

## Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 1.20+
- **Java**: 21
- **Server**: Paper/Purpur

## Installation

1. Download the latest version from Releases
2. Place the `.jar` file in your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Start/restart the server
4. Plugin will automatically create `plugins/AdminActivityTracker/admin/` folder and config file

## Configuration

After first launch, the plugin generates `config.yml`:

```yaml
# Admin Activity Tracker Configuration

# Should the plugin log commands executed by administrators?
logAdminCommands: true

# Should the plugin log items dropped by the administrators?
logDroppedItems: true

# Should the plugin log items, which administators got from creative inventory?
logCreativeItems: true

# Should the plugin log items moved from the adminstrators inventory?
# For example, from administator inventory to chest/other player inventory
logMovedItems: true
```

## Permissions

```aat.admin - Player with this permission is tracked by the plugin```



## Example Logs

All activities are saved to `plugins/AdminActivityTracker/admin/<player_name>.txt`:

```
[04-12-2025 14:23:45] Admin issued server command: /give @s diamond 64
[04-12-2025 14:24:12] Admin got from creative inventory: DIAMOND_BLOCK x64
[04-12-2025 14:25:33] Admin dropped the item: DIAMOND x32
[04-12-2025 14:25:45] Player picked item DIAMOND SWORD 1x dropped by: Admin
[04-12-2025 14:26:01] Admin moved the item from inventory: GOLDEN_APPLE x16

```

# SwapHand

**Switch your main hand (left/right) with one key press** — the same setting as in *Options → Skin Customization*, but without opening menus.

---

## ✨ Features

| Feature | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **One-key swap** | Toggle main hand (left ↔ right) instantly with your chosen key. |
| **Configurable** | Enable/disable the mod and set your keybind in the mod menu. |
| **Two entry points** | Open SwapHand settings from the **main menu** or the **in-game pause menu** (ESC). |
| **Layout-independent** | Keybind is bound by physical key (scan code), so it works with any keyboard layout (e.g. English, Russian). |
| **Priority over vanilla** | Your swap key is checked first, so it won't be blocked by vanilla keybinds. |

---

## 📖 How to use

1. Install **Fabric** and **Fabric API** for Minecraft 1.20.1+.
2. Put the SwapHand jar into your `mods` folder.
3. In the **main menu** or **pause menu** (ESC), click **SwapHand** (bottom-left corner).
4. Turn the mod **On/Off** and set the **Swap key** — click the key button, then press the key you want.
5. In-game, press your swap key to switch main hand.

---

## 📋 Requirements

- **Minecraft** 1.20.1+
- **Fabric Loader**
- **Fabric API**

---

## 🔧 Configuration

- Config file: `config/swaphand.json`
- You can enable/disable the mod and change the swap key from the in-game menu (no need to edit the file manually).

---

*SwapHand is a client-side Fabric mod. No server installation required.*

title: Advance
description: adds a gui where builders can get block in advance for builds, but they have to pay interest
body:
# Advance

A Minecraft plugin enabling players to borrow materials with interest for large builds. Players request items, admins approve, and repayment is tracked with configurable penalties for missed deadlines.

## Key Features

- **Admin-Approved Loans**: Players request materials → admins review → items granted on approval (or auto-approve mode)
- **Configurable Advance Limits**: Set max concurrent advances per player (default: 1)
- **Interest-Based System**: Amount owed increases based on quantity and repayment term
- **Flexible Terms**: 1 hour, 1 day, 1 week, or 1 month repayment periods
- **Flexible Block Configuration**: Choose between specific item lists, all obtainable blocks, or all blocks
- **Search Functionality**: Quick search in the GUI to find items by name
- **Onboarding Tutorial**: `/advance onboard` command guides new players through the system
- **Autocollect**: Optional automatic payment when picking up matching items
- **Overdue Penalties**: Grace period → health loss → optional death penalty
- **GUI Interface**: Inventory-based menus for requesting, managing, and approving advances
- **Player Blocklist**: Block problematic players from using the advance system
- **Audit Logging**: Track all admin actions for accountability
- **Persistent Storage**: SQLite database tracks all advances and transactions

## Quick Start

### For Players

**0. New to Advance?**
```
/advance onboard
```
Get an interactive tutorial explaining how the system works, interest rates, and how to make payments.

**1. Request an Advance**
```
/advance → Request New Advance → Pick item → Select amount → Choose term → Confirm
```
**Tip**: Use the **Search** button in the item menu to quickly find specific blocks by name!

**2. Check Status**
```
/advance status
```
Shows: item type, amount owed, amount paid, remaining balance, time left, autocollect status

**3. Make Payments**
- **Manual**: `/advance pay <amount>` (requires items in inventory)
- **Auto**: `/advance autocollect on` (auto-applies picked-up items to debt)

**4. Avoid Penalties**
- Pay before deadline
- Grace period (default: 24h) before penalties start
- Overdue = increased debt + daily health loss

### For Admins

**Review Requests**
```
/advance admin
```
- Left-click: Approve (items given to player if online, otherwise held for pickup)
- Right-click: Deny

**Manage Allowed Items**
```
/advance items list
/advance items add <material>
/advance items add inventory  # Add all items from your inventory
/advance items remove <material>
```

**Player Blocklist**
```
/advance block <player> [reason]   # Block a player from using advances
/advance unblock <player>          # Unblock a player
/advance blocklist                 # View all blocked players
```

**Audit Log**
```
/advance auditlog              # View last 10 entries
/advance auditlog <limit>      # View last N entries
/advance auditlog <player>     # View entries for a player
```

**Reload Config**
```
/advance reload
```

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission | Default |
|---------|-------------|------------|---------|
| `/advance` | Open main menu | `advance.use` | All players |
| `/advance onboard` | Learn how to use Advance | `advance.onboard` | All players |
| `/advance status` | View advance details | `advance.status` | All players |
| `/advance pay <amount>` | Manual payment | `advance.pay` | All players |
| `/advance autocollect <on\|off>` | Toggle autocollect | `advance.autocollect` | All players |
| `/advance admin` | Admin approval panel | `advance.admin` | Operators |
| `/advance items <list\|add\|remove>` | Manage allowed items | `advance.admin.items` | Operators |
| `/advance block <player> [reason]` | Block player from advances | `advance.admin.blocklist` | Operators |
| `/advance unblock <player>` | Unblock a player | `advance.admin.blocklist` | Operators |
| `/advance blocklist` | View blocked players | `advance.admin.blocklist` | Operators |
| `/advance auditlog [player\|limit]` | View audit log | `advance.admin.auditlog` | Operators |
| `/advance reload` | Reload configuration | `advance.admin.reload` | Operators |

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `advance.use` | Basic commands (grants `advance.request` + `advance.status` + `advance.onboard`) | true |
| `advance.request` | Request advances | true |
| `advance.status` | View status | true |
| `advance.pay` | Make payments | true |
| `advance.onboard` | Use onboard command | true |
| `advance.autocollect` | Use autocollect | true |
| `advance.admin` | Admin panel (grants all `advance.admin.*`) | op |
| `advance.admin.approve` | Approve requests | op |
| `advance.admin.deny` | Deny requests | op |
| `advance.admin.items` | Manage allowed items | op |
| `advance.admin.blocklist` | Manage player blocklist | op |
| `advance.admin.auditlog` | View audit logs | op |
| `advance.admin.reload` | Reload config | op |

## Configuration

Edit `plugins/Advance/config.yml`:

### Allowed Items

You can configure which blocks players can request using three methods:

**Option 1: Specific Item List (Default)**
```yaml
allowed-items:
  - STONE
  - DIRT
  - NETHERRACK
  - WHITE_WOOL

advance:
  allow_all_obtainable_blocks: false
  allow_all_blocks: false
```
Use Bukkit Material names (e.g., `DIAMOND_ORE`, not `minecraft:diamond_ore`). Managed in-game via `/advance items add/remove`.

**Option 2: All Obtainable Blocks**
```yaml
advance:
  allow_all_obtainable_blocks: true  # Allows all survival-obtainable blocks
  allow_all_blocks: false
```
Automatically allows any block that can be obtained in survival mode (excludes command blocks, barriers, etc.).

**Option 3: All Blocks (Use with Caution)**
```yaml
advance:
  allow_all_obtainable_blocks: false  # Ignored when allow_all_blocks is true
  allow_all_blocks: true  # WARNING: Allows ALL blocks including unobtainable ones
```
Allows every block in the game, including normally unobtainable items like command blocks and barriers. **Use with caution!**

**Precedence**: `allow_all_blocks` > `allow_all_obtainable_blocks` > `allowed-items` list

### Auto-Approve Mode
```yaml
advance:
  # When true, advance requests are automatically approved without admin review.
  # The request will still fail if the player is blocked or at max advances.
  auto_accept: false
```

### Maximum Concurrent Advances
```yaml
advance:
  # Maximum number of active advances a player can have at once.
  # Set to 1 for traditional single-advance behavior (UI remains unchanged).
  # Set higher to allow multiple concurrent advances.
  max_advances: 1
```

### Request Limits
```yaml
max-request-amount: 512  # Maximum items per request
```

### Interest Rates
```yaml
interest-calculation:
  base-rate: 0.05  # 5%
  term-multipliers:
    "1h": 1.0   # No extra interest for 1 hour
    "1d": 1.5   # 50% more interest for 1 day
    "1w": 2.0   # 100% more for 1 week
    "1m": 4.0   # 300% more for 1 month
  quantity-multiplier-per-stack: 0.01  # +1% per stack (64 items)
```

**Formula**: `Interest = Amount × Base Rate × Term Multiplier × (1 + Stacks × Quantity Multiplier)`

**Example** (64 stone, 1 day):
- Interest = 64 × 0.05 × 1.5 × 1.01 = 4.85
- **Total Owed: 69 items** (64 + 5 rounded)

### Penalties
```yaml
penalties:
  overdue-interest-increase: 0.10  # +10% debt immediately when overdue
  grace-period-hours: 24           # Time before health penalties start
  
  health-penalty:
    enabled: true
    hearts-lost-per-day: 1         # Hearts (0.5 HP) lost per day overdue
    minimum-health-hearts: 1       # Won't go below 0.5 HP
  
  final-death-penalty:
    enabled: false                 # DANGER: Kills player after max days
    max-overdue-days: 10
  
  dangerous-actions-enabled: false # MUST be true to enable death penalty
```

### Autocollect
```yaml
autocollect:
  enabled-by-default: false
  notification-style: "ACTION_BAR"  # or "CHAT"
```

### Logging
```yaml
logging:
  level: "INFO"              # INFO, WARNING, or SEVERE
  log-player-names: false    # Privacy: log only UUIDs if false
  log-amounts: true          # Log transaction amounts
```

## How It Works

1. **Request**: Player selects item, amount, and term → calculates total owed (principal + interest)
2. **Approval**: Admin reviews → approves/denies → items given to player
3. **Repayment**: Player pays with manual commands or autocollect
4. **Completion**: Debt paid → advance closes → player can request again
5. **Penalties**: Miss deadline → grace period → overdue interest → health loss → (optional) death

**Status Progression**: `PENDING` → `APPROVED` → `PAID` (or `DENIED`, `EXPIRED`)

title: InKeyAll
description: InKeyAll is a professional, high-performance Minecraft plugin that automates community engagement through repeating timed rewards and player-count milestones.
body:
# InKeyAll
InKeyAll is a Minecraft plugin that boosts player engagement by automating "KeyAll" rewards and community-driven milestones.

## Core Functions
- Timed KeyAlls: Create unlimited repeating rewards with unique intervals and permissions. Whether it is a daily reward or a VIP event, the plugin handles the timing automatically.
- Community Goals: Automatically reward the entire server when player-count milestones are reached. This incentivizes players to invite friends and stay online.
- Dynamic /goals Command: Provides a fully customizable, multi-line interface for players to track server progress in real-time.
- PlaceholderAPI Support: Includes integrated timers and milestone counters that can be displayed on Scoreboards, Tab lists, or Holograms.
- Smart Logic: Built-in cooldowns and reload-handling ensure that rewards are distributed fairly and prevent abuse after server restarts.
## Why Choose InKeyAll?
Unlike basic reward scripts, InKeyAll offers a dual-placeholder system. It features Internal Placeholders (like %online% and %required%) for easy configuration of in-game messages, and External Placeholders (like %inkeyall_timer_<id>%) for universal compatibility with other plugins via PlaceholderAPI. This ensures a seamless experience for both server administrators and players.

## Commands
- /goals - View current community goal progress.
- /inkeyall reload - Instantly reload configurations without a server restart.
- /inkeyall <id> - Manually trigger a specific KeyAll event.
## Installation
1. Download the InKeyAll.jar.
2. Place the file into your server's /plugins/ folder.
3. Restart your server to generate the default configuration.
4. Customize your rewards in the config.yml and run /inkeyall reload.

## Links & Documentation
For full configuration examples, permission nodes, and developer updates, visit our official repository: [View on GitHub](https://innocent-dev-yt.github.io/InKeyAll/)

© 2025 InnocentDevYT. Built for the Minecraft Community.

(And please note that starting the modpack up may take a while depending on your pc specs as there are a LOT of mods)**

Tell me, do you like exploring? Do you like to get lost? Do like going places that don't lead anywhere? Do you like the serenity of exploring biomes? With **5 major mods** that add to- and modify the overworld, you'll sure enjoy the vast scenerys that are waiting for you in this pack!

### Structures and villages! 
Why explore when there's nothing to find? With over 20 structure mods you'll always come across something interesting on your travels! Of course we can't forget about all the new village changes that turn them from small bunches to sprawling towns! Having trouble finding a village? Try looking up! Some villagers have took to the skies to escape the dangers of the nights!
> With so many structure mods it's hard to name any without spoiling too much so if you really want to see them all, the dependencies list in the versions tab should be able to help you out. **:)**

## **The Nether**
**More beautiful than ever, still as dangerous**

**STARRING:**
- **BetterNether [BetterX/quiqueck]** - An absolutely stunning rework of the nether dimension so big that I couldn't ask anything else of the mod. With a plethora of new changes ranging from **tons** of new biomes all the way down to new mobs, items, and structures.

With an abundance of content it's hard to stay away, but do take care to not wake the residents.

# F.A.Q.
1. **Q** I want to visit the Otherside but it's all so confusing that I don't know where to start?\

Antiarmordura is a lightweight Minecraft plugin designed to provide a tactical advantage by spoofing the durability of equipped armor to other players. Utilizing ProtocolLib, it intercepts server packets to display armor as either fully repaired or having randomized durability, effectively hiding its true condition from opponents. This prevents enemies from targeting players based on low armor integrity, while ensuring the wearer can still track their own durability accurately. The plugin features per-player toggles and configurable strategies, making it a versatile tool for PvP environments.

Command:
```
/antiarmordura <player> <on|off>
```
On will spoof, off will reverse that, or else do nothing

title: Jumpaura
description: Add jumpaura for minecraft!
body:
# Jump Aura
Add a unique visual spectacle to every jump! Jump Aura is a highly customizable client-side mod that generates elegant and华丽 (gorgeous) ring particle effects at your feet whenever you jump or land.

# ✨ Key Features
🎨 Three Pre-built Styles
Choose from three carefully designed aura styles with a simple config change:

Style 1: Outer circle with an inner rotating triangle.

Style 2: Full shape composed of rotating diamonds/rhombuses.

Style 3: Outer circle with an inner rotating diamond/rhombus.

**The color cannot be customized, but it will cycle through all RGB colors.**

# ⚙️ High Customizability
Want something unique? The mod offers extensive customization through its JSON config file.

JSON Configuration: Every visual and behavioral aspect is controlled via a clear, well-documented JSON file.

Fine-Tuned Control:

Visuals: Toggle the effect, choose the style (1-3), and adjust the circle's radius, thickness and opacity.

Animation: Control the color cycle speed, maximum scale, and the timing for grow, stay, and fade phases.

Gameplay Logic: Configure cooldowns, allow or disallow effects during flight (e.g., creative mode), and enable/disable multi-jump detection.

# 📖 How to Use
Install: Place the mod jar file into your Minecraft mods folder.

Configure:

Locate the configuration file at config/jumpaura_config.json.

Edit the file with any text editor to customize the effect to your liking (see example below).

Save the file. After saving, click '重新加载配置' to take effect.

Jump: Press spacebar in-game and enjoy your personal aura!

# ⚙️ Configuration Example
Here is the default configuration file with explanations for key options:


```
{
  "enabled": true,          // Master toggle for the mod.
  "showCircle": true,       // Toggles the visibility of the main ring/circle base.
  "circleRadius": 1,        // The base radius of the effect.
  "circleThickness": 0.15,  // The thickness of the ring lines.
  "alpha": 180,             // Opacity of the effect (0-255).
  "colorSpeed": 1.0,        // Speed of the automatic color cycling.
  "maxScale": 1.0,          // Maximum scale the effect grows to during animation.
  "growTime": 0.2,          // Time (in seconds) for the effect to grow to maxScale.
  "stayTime": 0.5,          // Time (in seconds) the effect stays at maxScale.
  "fadeTime": 0.3,          // Time (in seconds) for the effect to fade out.
  "allowFlightJump": false, // Whether the effect triggers from jumps while flying (creative/elytra).
  "jumpCooldown": 0.3,      // Minimum time (in seconds) between triggered effects.
  "allowMultiJump": true,   // Whether effects can trigger from multi-jump mods or abilities.
  "style": 2                // The visual style (1, 2, or 3).
}
```


# 🔧 Compatibility & Notes
Loader: Forge. Minecraft: 1.8.9.

Side: Client-side only. It only needs to be installed on the player's client. Servers do not need it.

Performance: The mod uses efficient rendering. Significant performance impact is unlikely unless circleRadius is set extremely high.

# ❓ FAQ
Q: Is there an in-game configuration menu?
A: Not currently. All configuration is done by manually editing the config/jump_aura.json file. This allows for precise control and easy sharing of configs.

Q: Does this mod add new particles or blocks?
A: No. This mod creates its visual effects using custom rendering, not Minecraft's particle system. It does not add any new items, blocks, or standard particles.



Happy Jumping!

GrimTactics is a Hardcore-only Minecraft plugin that enhances hostile mob behavior
without using artificial difficulty or unfair mechanics.

This plugin focuses on intelligence, positioning, and consequences.

Hostile mobs do not simply rush the player anymore:
• Zombies and skeletons coordinate their attacks
• Some apply pressure while others flank using real pathfinding
• Cheese tactics (doors, boats, immobile traps) are progressively punished
• Real combat is rewarded with smarter loot drops

GrimTactics does NOT:
• Increase mob damage or health
• Teleport mobs
• Break vanilla mechanics
• Affect non-hardcore worlds

The plugin activates automatically on Hardcore servers, regardless of the world name.
On non-hardcore servers, it runs in passive mode and does nothing.

Philosophy:
If you die, it’s because you made a mistake — not because the game cheated.

Recommended:
• Paper / Purpur
• Java 21
• Minecraft 1.21+

This plugin is designed for players who enjoy real Hardcore gameplay,
where positioning, awareness, and decision-making matter.

# Simple Vanilla+ Pack

![Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1865975562aab1200bafa2daf83cffb0e79633e.jpeg)

Ultra-light, 100 % vanilla-faithful modpack that keeps Minecraft exactly as you know it.
**No heavy mods, no extra mechanics**—just faster performance and a handful of quality-of-life tweaks (zoom, litemertica, dynamic lights, etc.).
Includes mods that also supports building, redstones, etc.

Simple Vanilla+ is just lightweight gameplay and richer functions for building, readstone, or even if you want a modpack that still preserve the feeling of vanilla.

Litematica lets you save, share and paste huge schematics in seconds; WorldEdit hands you a wand for continent-scale edits; and the included XK Redstone Display resource pack paints power levels right on the dust so red-stone wiring finally makes sense at a glance.

Everything else—MiniHUD, Xaero maps, Tweakeroo, Jade—waits to enhance your gameplay. The pack is tiny, starts in moments, and uninstalls cleanly, leaving vanilla worlds untouched. title: AxMinesEnhanced
description:
This is a custom fork of AxMines that adds a new Random Respawn Mine feature.
Mines can now randomly spawn and despawn based on customizable timers..
body:
**AxMines – Random Respawn Mine Feature (Custom Fork)**

This is a custom fork of the open‑source AxMines plugin, created to introduce a fully configurable **Random Respawn Mine System**. We built this feature for our unreleased Minecraft server, but we are now releasing it publicly for free so other developers and server owners can benefit from it.

### ⭐ New Feature: Random Respawn Mine

This update adds the ability for any created mine to **spawn and despawn randomly**, based on user‑defined timers.

### 🔧 Fully Configurable

You can adjust all settings from:

* **Config file**
* **In‑game GUI** using `/axmines editor`

### ⚙️ What You Can Customize

* **Minimum spawn time** (how soon the mine can appear)
* **Maximum spawn time** (latest time the mine may appear)
* **Mine active time** (how long the mine stays spawned)
* **Mine despawn time** (how long the mine stays disappeared)
* All options are easily editable inside the GUI: `/axmines editor` → select the mine → configure the new Random Respawn settings.

### 📌 Purpose of This Fork

We needed special mine behavior for our own server, but since this feature can help others too, we are releasing it free on Modrinth. This fork keeps all existing AxMines features intact while adding our new Random Respawn system.

### ✔️ Open & Helpful for Developers

This fork aims to provide a useful expansion to the original plugin so developers can study, improve, or expand upon it.

Feel free to use, modify!

### 🔵 Examplemine Config

``` 
# Random spawn configuration
# When enabled, the mine will spawn randomly instead of being always active
# The normal reset system (ticks and percent) will be automatically disabled
random-spawn:
  #Enable random spawning for this mine
  #When enabled, the mine will spawn randomly instead of being always active
  #The normal reset system will be automatically disabled
  enabled: true
  #Minimum time (in ticks) the mine stays spawned
  #20 ticks = 1 second
  #Default: 6000 ticks = 5 minutes
  min-time: 200 # Minimum time (in ticks) the mine stays spawned (5 minutes)
  #Maximum time (in ticks) the mine stays spawned
  #20 ticks = 1 second
  #Default: 12000 ticks = 10 minutes
  max-time: 300 # Maximum time (in ticks) the mine stays spawned (10 minutes)
  #Time (in ticks) the mine stays despawned before respawning
  #20 ticks = 1 second
  #Default: 6000 ticks = 5 minutes
  despawn-time: 100 # Time (in ticks) the mine stays despawned (5 minutes)
  #Enable debug logging for random spawn feature
  #Shows detailed information about spawn/despawn cycles, timings, and state changes
  #Only affects random spawn feature, not the main plugin debug
  debug: false # Enable detailed logging for random spawn feature only
#The format of the time placeholder
#1 -> HH:MM:SS, for example 01:25:35
#2 -> short format, for example 20m
#3 - text format, for example 01h 25m 35s
timer-format: 2
#What blocksetter should we use to set the blocks?
#Options:
#parallel - Best performance, does not lag the server thread. Sometimes can be a little bit inaccurate - CURRENTLY NOT AVAILABLE
#fast - Sets the blocks on the main thread using faster methods
#bukkit - Uses the Bukkit API to set the blocks. This is the slowest out of all the setters
#
#If you are having issues with blocks not being set correctly, we suggest using bukkit.
setter: fast

```
