title: Crossnotes
description: A highly customizable client-side Minecraft Fabric mod for easily taking and managing notes in-game, cross server&worlds, with markdown rendering, HUD display, interactive control and quick command to write notes.
body:
# CrossNotes

A client-side Minecraft Fabric mod for easily taking and managing notes in-game, cross server&worlds, with markdown rendering, HUD display, interactive control and quick command to write notes.

## Features

- **In-Game Note Editor** — Create, edit, and delete notes without leaving the game. Full text editor with click-to-position, arrow key navigation, text selection, and clipboard support (Ctrl+C/X/V).
- **Markdown Rendering** — Notes support headers, bold, italic, inline code, links, lists, blockquotes, and interactive checkboxes.
- **HUD Overlay** — Pin a note to your screen as a customizable HUD widget. Adjust position, width, height, and choose whether overflow shows first or last lines.
- **Cross-World Persistence** — Notes are stored locally in your config folder, so they follow you across singleplayer worlds and multiplayer servers.
- **Quick-Access Slots** — Bind up to 3 notes to keyboard shortcuts for instant HUD toggling.
- **Commands** — Manage notes entirely from chat with the `/cn` command.

This project is still under active development and debugging. If you encounter any new-found bugs or have feature suggestions, please submit an issue on GitHub.

## Keybinds

All keybinds are rebindable under **Options → Controls → CrossNotes**.

| Action | Default Key | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Open Notebook | **Ctrl+C** | Opens the notebook screen. If a note is pinned to the HUD, opens that note's view instead. |
| Toggle HUD | **H** | Show or hide the HUD note overlay. |
| Notebook Slot 1–3 | *Unbound* | Toggle the bound note on the HUD. |

## Commands

All commands use the `/cn` prefix.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/cn new [title]` | Create a new note. Uses a timestamp title if omitted. |
| `/cn add <content>` | Append text to the currently displayed HUD note. Creates a new note if none is active. |
| `/cn list` | List all saved notes with titles, previews, and IDs. |
| `/cn show [id]` | Toggle the HUD, or pin a specific note by its ID. |
| `/cn delete [id]` | Delete the currently displayed note, or a specific note by ID. |
| `/cn bind <slot> <noteId>` | Bind a note to a quick-access slot (1–3). |

## Markdown Support

The note viewer and HUD render the following markdown elements(Some might not work normally due to minecraft display settings):

| Syntax | Result |
|---|---|
| `**bold**` | **Bold text** |
| `*italic*` | *Italic text* |
| `` `code` `` | Inline code |
| `[text](url)` | Clickable link |
| `- item` | Bulleted list |
| `> quote` | Blockquote |
| `- [ ] task` | Unchecked checkbox |
| `- [x] task` | ~~Checked checkbox~~ (strikethrough) |

Checkboxes are **interactive** — click them in the note view or directly on the HUD(open Chat or use other mods to free cursor) to toggle their state.

## Settings

Open the settings screen from the notebook UI. Available options:

- **HUD Toggle** — Enable or disable the HUD overlay.
- **HUD X / Y Position** — Slide to position the HUD anywhere on screen.
- **HUD Width** — Adjust the HUD width (100–500 px).
- **HUD Height** — Adjust the HUD height (50–400 px).
- **HUD Overflow** — Choose whether to show the **first lines** or **last lines** when the note is too long for the HUD.
- **Slot Bindings** — View and clear note-to-slot bindings.

## Storage

Notes are saved as individual JSON files under:

```
.minecraft/config/crossnotes/notes/
```

Configuration (HUD settings, slot bindings) is stored in:

```
.minecraft/config/crossnotes/config.json
```

All data is client-side and persists across worlds and servers.

## Demo Images

![HUD Overlay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ShawnNotFound/Crossnotes/refs/heads/main/images/HUD.png)

![Note List](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ShawnNotFound/Crossnotes/refs/heads/main/images/NoteList.png)

![Note View](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ShawnNotFound/Crossnotes/refs/heads/main/images/Note.png)

![Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ShawnNotFound/Crossnotes/refs/heads/main/images/Settings.png)

## Disclaimer

Portions of this project were generated or assisted by AI tools. All code has been reviewed and integrated by the author.

This mod is provided as-is. Do not use it to store important or valuable content. Users are responsible for any data loss or issues that may occur while using this mod.

## License

This project is licensed under the MIT License.

body:
# Horror Economy : Apocalypse Hardcore Economy Modpack

## What is this modpack?
**Horror Economy** is a survival, horror‑themed hardcore modpack built around a player economy. Fight the Spore infection, tune your base defenses, and use shops & money generators to survive — but every death costs you money. Expect a gradual difficulty ramp: early game is calmer, then threats intensify.

---

## Quickstart (important commands) 
- `/shop` — open the server shop UI 
- `/money` — check your balance 
- `/pay <player> <value>` — send money to someone 
- `/ah` — open Auction House
- `/ah sell <price>` — list an item on AH for sale

> Tip: Use `/shop` and `/ah` often — ammo, medical supplies and generators are available.

---

## Core Gameplay Loop 
1. Secure a small, well‑lit base (light levels reduce spawns). 
2. Complete early exploration and collect Spore drops to sell. 
3. Buy an **Iron Money Generator** (or higher tiers) to produce passive income. 
4. Invest in ammo, vehicles and base defenses; death costs part of your balance. 

---

## Economy & Shops
- Economy enabled: virtual currency, server shops, auction house, and physical money item.
- **Starting balance:** 1000
- **Death penalty:** configured in `config/migueleconomy-common.toml` (currently set to 5%). If you want a harsher penalty (e.g., lose half on death), the setting `deathPenaltyPercentage` can be changed to `50`.

---

## Difficulty Progression 

- **Day‑based progression** (InControl `spawn.json`):
  - **Day 1:** almost all hostiles are denied (calm early game).
  - **Days 2–3:** only basic infected can spawn in darkness.
  - **Day 4–7:** evolved mobs begin appearing with light restrictions.
  - **Day 8–14:** most mobs available; light still limits spawns.
  - **Day 15+:** full difficulty, but light still offers protection.

---

## Loot & Progression Notes
- SuperbWarfare loot has been added to structure loot tables so guns and ammo can be found in abandoned structures and chests.
- Starter kits provide class-based gear, ammo and medical items; thirst was removed and starter water bottles removed.

---

## Credits & Mods Included
Key mods: Spore, InControl, MiguelEconomy, SuperbWarfare, Lost Cities, UndeadNights, BadMobs, Marbled's First Aid and more.

Crop Harvest is a lightweight, vanilla-friendly quality-of-life mod for Fabric focused on maximum compatibility with other mods.

The crop drops its harvest

1 seed is consumed from your inventory

The crop is replanted automatically

Beetroots

No automation or redstone interaction

No new items or blocks

No changes to world generation

Designed to avoid conflicts with other mods

Safe to use in existing worlds

This makes Crop Harvest ideal for large modpacks, long-term Survival, and Hardcore worlds.

Right-click harvesting

Automatic replanting using inventory seeds

High compatibility with other mods

Works in Survival and Hardcore

Multiplayer-safe

title: I Wanna [The End... Alone...]
description: Giving the 'The End... Again...' advancement only to the brave soul who actually placed the crystals.
body:
# I Wanna The End Alone

**I Wanna The End... Alone...** is a lightweight Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that reworks how the "The End... Again..." (respawning the Ender Dragon) advancement is awarded.

## 📖 What does it do?

In vanilla Minecraft, whenever the Ender Dragon is respawned using End Crystals, **every single player** currently in the End dimension receives the advancement. This often leads to "achievement leaching," where players stand around doing nothing while one person does all the work.

This mod changes that logic to be **participation-based**:
*   **Only contributors** receive the advancement.
*   A "contributor" is defined as any player who manually placed at least one of the four End Crystals used for the ritual.
*   If you help by placing 1 crystal, you get the credit. If you just watch, you get nothing.

## ✨ Features

*   **Fair Rewards:** Supports teamwork! If four different players each place one crystal, all four will receive the advancement.
*   **Anti-Leech:** Players idling near the portal will no longer automatically "complete" the task.
*   **Vanilla Feel:** Does not change any other dragon fight mechanics; it only tweaks the advancement trigger logic.
*   **Server-Side:** This mod only needs to be installed on the server.

## 📜 License

This project is licensed under the GPLv3 License

title: AnkiCamera
description: A cinematic camera cutscene plugin for Minecraft servers
body:
A cinematic camera cutscene plugin for Minecraft servers. Supports Paper, Folia, and Spigot, covering 1.21 and above.
一个服务端过场动画摄像机插件，支持 Paper、Folia 和 Spigot，覆盖 1.21 及以上版本。

---

![EASY](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/99e930e01a3051f9749e2fad5c53031b9e0100c7.png)
## Features / 特点

- Smooth spline camera paths with 4 interpolation modes (Catmull-Rom, B-Spline, Hermite, Linear)
  平滑样条摄像机路径，4 种插值模式（Catmull-Rom、B-Spline、Hermite、线性）

- Visual hotbar editing tools with clickable chat UI
  可视化快捷栏编辑工具 + 可点击聊天 UI

- Point events: trigger titles, sounds, commands, scripts at any camera point
  点位事件：在任意摄像机点位触发标题、音效、指令、脚本

- AC Script system for chaining scenes, delays, dialogues, and rewards
  AC 脚本系统，串联场景、延迟、对话和奖励

- Trigger system: auto-play on region enter, block click, or command
  触发器系统：区域进入、方块点击或指令自动播放

- Recording mode: walk to auto-capture camera points
  录制模式：行走自动捕获摄像机点位

- Packet-based camera: no entity flicker, smooth spectator-mode playback
  基于数据包的摄像机：无实体闪烁，流畅旁观者模式播放

---

## Requirements / 依赖

- Paper 1.21+ / Folia 1.21+ / Spigot 1.21+
- Java 21
- [PacketEvents](https://github.com/retrooper/packetevents) (place in plugins folder)

---

## Installation / 安装

1. Install Paper, Folia, or Spigot 1.21+.
   安装 Paper、Folia 或 Spigot 1.21+

2. Place `packetevents.jar` into `plugins/`.
   将 `packetevents.jar` 放入 `plugins/` 目录

3. Place `AnkiCamera.jar` into `plugins/`.
   将 `AnkiCamera.jar` 放入 `plugins/` 目录

4. Start the server.
   启动服务器

---

## Usage / 使用方法

1. Create a scene: `/acam new <id>`
   创建场景：`/acam new <id>`

2. Enter edit mode: `/acam edit <id>`
   进入编辑模式：`/acam edit <id>`

3. Use hotbar tools to add points, preview, record, and toggle path particles.
   使用快捷栏工具添加点位、预览、录制、开关路径粒子

4. Play the scene: `/acam play <id>`
   播放场景：`/acam play <id>`

5. Hold Shift to exit playback.
   长按 Shift 退出播放

---

## Commands / 指令

| Command / 指令 | Description / 说明 |
|:---|:---|
| `/acam new <id>` | Create a new scene / 创建新场景 |
| `/acam del <id>` | Delete a scene / 删除场景 |
| `/acam list` | List all scenes / 列出所有场景 |
| `/acam edit <id>` | Enter edit mode / 进入编辑模式 |
| `/acam exit` | Exit edit mode / 退出编辑模式 |
| `/acam add` | Add point at current position / 在当前位置添加点位 |
| `/acam insert <idx>` | Insert point at index / 在指定位置插入点位 |
| `/acam rm <idx>` | Remove a point / 删除点位 |
| `/acam set <idx> <param> [val]` | Set point parameter / 设置点位参数 |
| `/acam points [id]` | View point list / 查看点位列表 |
| `/acam pt <idx>` | View point detail (clickable UI) / 查看点位详情（可点击 UI） |
| `/acam play <id> [player\|all]` | Play a scene / 播放场景 |
| `/acam stop [player\|all]` | Stop playback / 停止播放 |
| `/acam pause` | Pause/resume playback / 暂停/恢复播放 |
| `/acam rec start\|stop` | Start/stop recording / 开始/停止录制 |
| `/acam setting <param> <val>` | Modify scene settings / 修改场景设置 |
| `/acam path [on\|off]` | Toggle path particles / 开关路径粒子 |
| `/acam smooth <id>` | Smooth path / 平滑路径 |
| `/acam reverse <id>` | Reverse point order / 反转点位顺序 |
| `/acam copy <src> <dst>` | Copy a scene / 复制场景 |
| `/acam tp <idx>` | Teleport to point / 传送到点位 |
| `/acam export <id>` | Export scene / 导出场景 |
| `/acam import <file>` | Import scene / 导入场景 |
| `/acam trigger <sub>` | Trigger management / 触发器管理 |
| `/acam action <idx> <sub>` | Point event management / 点位事件管理 |
| `/acam script <name>` | Run AC script / 执行 AC 脚本 |
| `/acam reload` | Reload config and lang / 重载配置和语言 |

---

## Permissions / 权限

| Permission / 权限 | Description / 说明 |
|:---|:---|
| `ankicamera.admin` | Full access to all commands / 所有指令完整权限 |
| `ankicamera.play` | Play scenes / 播放场景 |
| `ankicamera.play.other` | Play scenes for other players / 为其他玩家播放场景 |

---

## Languages / 语言

Configure in `config.yml`:
在 `config.yml` 中配置：

```yaml
language: en_US
```

Available / 可用语言: `zh_CN`, `en_US`, `ja_JP`, `ko_KR`, `ru_RU`, `de_DE`, `fr_FR`, `es_ES`, `pt_BR`

---

## AC Script / AC 脚本

Place `.ac` files in `plugins/AnkiCamera/scripts/`. Example:
将 `.ac` 文件放入 `plugins/AnkiCamera/scripts/`。示例：

```
@scene intro
  title "<gold>Welcome!</gold>" "<gray>Enjoy the tour</gray>"
  sound entity.experience_orb.pickup 1.0 1.2
  delay 40
  play my_scene
  wait 0
  msg "<green>Tour complete!</green>"
```

See `plugins/AnkiCamera/scripts/` for more examples after first launch.
首次启动后查看 `plugins/AnkiCamera/scripts/` 获取更多示例。

---

## Configuration / 配置

`plugins/AnkiCamera/config.yml` — main config with speed, recording interval, particles, edit tools, etc.
`plugins/AnkiCamera/config.yml` — 主配置文件，包含速度、录制间隔、粒子、编辑工具等设置。

`plugins/AnkiCamera/lang/` — language files, editable for customization.
`plugins/AnkiCamera/lang/` — 语言文件，可自定义编辑。

---

A wiki page is coming soon!

title: +Immersive Vanilla
description: No new items. No new biomes. No new dimensions. Just the Minecraft you know, evolved into a seamless, immersive, and living experience.
body:
English This modpack preserves the fundamental essence of Minecraft, elevating it to a new standard of fidelity and immersion. Rather than straying from the original identity, this collection polishes it, focusing on the profound interaction between the player and the world around them. The environment becomes more responsive and vibrant. Through fluid animations, a dense atmosphere, and meticulous quality-of-life improvements, the pack invites you to slow down and appreciate the details. Every particle, sound, and movement works in harmony to make the world feel more organic, transforming exploration into a seamless sensory experience. The result is the Minecraft you have always known, but with the depth it has always deserved. A natural evolution that respects the past while delivering an impeccable present. Every detail of the modpack was planned based on three fundamental pillars: **Ambience**, **Animation**, and **Interface**. # Features ## 🌿 Immersive Ambience The world around you ceases to be static and becomes vibrant and detailed. The focus here is on visual depth and a sense of presence: * **The World**: _Visual Effects+_ is the heart of this category, adding an extra layer of dynamism to every interaction. It revolutionizes the visual experience by altering vanilla particles, adding dozens of new ones, and introducing a new weather system. This ecosystem is expanded by _Particle Interactions_, which adds particles to more interactions in the game, such as when placing a block or stripping a log, and by _Particle Effects_, which introduces unique textured particles for every effect in vanilla Minecraft. Combined with _Subtle Effects_, every small action in the world generates elegant and subtle visual feedback. * **Atmospheric Underground Exploration**: Mining gains a new layer of depth with _Cave Dust_. For maximum immersion, as you descend into the depths, the suspended dust becomes denser, creating a claustrophobic and immersive atmosphere that transforms the cave exploration experience. * **Vibrant and Organic Nature**: Vegetation has been completely revitalized. With _Fancy Full Block Grass_, _Grass+_ and _Wisp's Colourful Wildflowers_, the ground gains dense floral diversity. _Lushier Forests_, _3D Crops_, and _Jerm's Better Leaves_ bring a three-dimensionality that fills the scenery. * **Winter and Visual Cohesion**: Cold regions convey a unique sense of isolation. _Better Snow Coverage_, _Snow Under Trees_, and _Snow Side Texture_ ensure that snow covers the world entirely, eliminating dry block edges and creating integrated winter landscapes. * **Cycles and Dynamics**: Time passes more naturally with Better Days, while the horizon receives a cinematic look through Chase the Skies, which dramatically improves skyboxes with better sunrises and sunsets. This scenery is complemented by Story Mode Clouds, bringing stylized clouds to the firmament. The world reacts to your presence with Wakes and the Sounds mod, which adds a deep auditory layer to accompany the visual changes from ReShaded. ## ⚔️ Dynamic Animations Movement is the key to life. The focus here is on eliminating stiffness and bringing total fluidity to the player and creatures: * **Total First-Person Immersion**: The main mod of this category, _Hold My Items_, along with the _Gous's Hand Poses_ pack, redefines how you interact with what you carry. It displays dynamic and unique hand poses for every item held. _I See My Armored Hand_ ensures you see the details of your armor on your arms, reinforcing a sense of physical presence. * **Living Ecosystem and Characters**: The acclaimed _Fresh Animations_ is pushed to the limit with its addons. _Player Extension_ brings expressiveness to the player model, while extensions for horses, foxes, and baby animals ensure organic movements across all fauna. For dangers, _Enhanced Evil_ remodels hostile mobs, increasing visual variety. * **Physics and Objects**: Doors feature smooth movements with _Fancy Door Animations_. _3D skin layers_, _Elytra physics_, and capes that react to the wind ensure your character moves elegantly through the environment. Additionally, the _Animated+_ pack brings life to specific items with unique animations. ## 🖥️ GUI and Modern Interface The interface has been redesigned to be elegant and functional, focusing on a premium aesthetic and connectivity: * **Connectivity and Social Environment**: Through the _Essential mod_, the modpack offers a complete social environment. It allows you to play with your friends directly, without the need for third-party programs or complex server setups, integrating friend lists and invites directly into the interface. * **Visual Identity**: The entire menu system uses _Unique Dark_, providing a sophisticated and modern dark interface, while the _Icons_ pack adds intuitive and stylized icons across all windows. * **3D Items**: Item modeling has been elevated with _Weskerson's 3D Items_, _Randomly 3D_ and _Fyoncle's 3D Trims_, providing detailed three-dimensional models for items when dropped or held, while maintaining the classic 2D sprite on the hotbar. * **Elite Equipment**: Combat aesthetics have been enhanced. _Glowing 3D Armor_ brings real depth to armor with three-dimensional relief. Now, Elytras can also be trimmed. To complete the set, the _Fresh Weapons & Tools_ pack completely revitalizes the appearance of your tools and weapons. * **Fluidity and Menu Feedback**: _Inventory Particles_ and _Immersive UI_ work together: while one adds dynamic particles when selecting items, the other brings smooth animations when moving items through slots. _Smooth Gui_ ensures the transition between windows is flawless. The HUD gains dynamism with _Immersive Hotbar_, and writing is transformed by the _Scholar_ mod, which remodels the Book and Quill interface. * **Refinement and Utility**: _AppleSkin_ displays essential details regarding nutrition and health recovered by food. For organization, _Shulker Box Tooltip_ allows you to view the contents of Shulker boxes without needing to place them on the ground, while _Status Effect Bars_ and _BetterF3_ deliver technical data with a clean design. * **Enchantment Lore**: Every enchanted book now carries its own history and depth. Thanks to the _Enchantment Lore_ mod, you can access a unique lore for each enchantment by simply holding the book and clicking with the right mouse button.
Português Este modpack preserva a essência fundamental de Minecraft, elevando-o a um novo padrão de fidelidade e imersão. Em vez de se afastar da identidade original, esta coleção a lapida, focando na profunda interação entre o jogador e o mundo ao seu redor. O ambiente torna-se mais responsivo e vibrante. Através de animações fluidas, uma atmosfera densa e melhorias minuciosas de qualidade de vida, o pack convida você a desacelerar e apreciar os detalhes. Cada partícula, som e movimento trabalha em harmonia para tornar o mundo mais orgânico, transformando a exploração em uma experiência sensorial contínua. O resultado é o Minecraft que você sempre conheceu, mas com a profundidade que ele sempre mereceu. Uma evolução natural que respeita o passado enquanto entrega um presente impecável. Cada detalhe do modpack foi planejado com base em três pilares fundamentais: **Ambiência**, **Animação** e **Interface**. # Recursos ## 🌿 Ambiente Imersivo O mundo ao seu redor deixa de ser estático e se torna vibrante e detalhado. O foco aqui é na profundidade visual e no senso de presença: * **O Mundo**: _Visual Effects+_ é o coração desta categoria, adicionando uma camada extra de dinamismo a cada interação. Ele revoluciona a experiência visual alterando partículas vanilla, adicionando dezenas de novas e introduzindo um novo sistema de clima. Este ecossistema é expandido por _Particle Interactions_, que adiciona partículas a mais interações no jogo, como ao colocar um bloco ou descascar um tronco, e por _Particle Effects_, que introduz partículas texturizadas únicas para cada efeito no Minecraft vanilla. Combinado com _Subtle Effects_, cada pequena ação no mundo gera feedback visual elegante e sutil. * **Exploração Subterrânea Atmosférica**: A mineração ganha uma nova camada de profundidade com _Cave Dust_. Para máxima imersão, à medida que você desce às profundezas, a poeira suspensa se torna mais densa, criando uma atmosfera claustrofóbica e imersiva que transforma a experiência de exploração de cavernas. * **Natureza Vibrante e Orgânica**: A vegetação foi completamente revitalizada. Com _Fancy Full Block Grass_, _Grass+_ e _Wisp's Colourful Wildflowers_, o chão ganha diversidade floral densa. _Lushier Forests_, _3D Crops_ e _Jerm's Better Leaves_ trazem tridimensionalidade que preenche a paisagem. * **Inverno e Coesão Visual**: Regiões frias transmitem um senso único de isolamento. _Better Snow Coverage_, _Snow Under Trees_ e _Snow Side Texture_ garantem que a neve cubra o mundo inteiramente, eliminando bordas secas de blocos e criando paisagens invernais integradas. * **Ciclos e Dinâmicas**: O tempo passa de forma mais natural com Better Days, enquanto o horizonte ganha um visual cinematográfico através de Chase the Skies, que melhora dramaticamente as skyboxes com amanheceres e pores do sol melhores. Esta paisagem é complementada por Story Mode Clouds, trazendo nuvens estilizadas ao firmamento. O mundo reage à sua presença com Wakes e o mod Sounds, que adiciona uma camada auditiva profunda para acompanhar as mudanças visuais de ReShaded. ## ⚔️ Animações Dinâmicas O movimento é a chave para a vida. O foco aqui é eliminar a rigidez e trazer fluidez total ao jogador e às criaturas: * **Imersão Total em Primeira Pessoa**: O principal mod desta categoria, _Hold My Items_, junto com o pack _Gous's Hand Poses_, redefine como você interage com o que carrega. Ele exibe poses de mãos dinâmicas e únicas para cada item segurado. _I See My Armored Hand_ garante que você veja os detalhes da sua armadura nos braços, reforçando o senso de presença física. * **Ecossistema Vivo e Personagens**: O aclamado _Fresh Animations_ é levado ao limite com seus addons. _Player Extension_ traz expressividade ao modelo do jogador, enquanto extensões para cavalos, raposas e animais bebês garantem movimentos orgânicos em toda a fauna. Para perigos, _Enhanced Evil_ remodela mobs hostis, aumentando a variedade visual. * **Física e Objetos**: Portas apresentam movimentos suaves com _Fancy Door Animations_. _3D skin layers_, _Elytra physics_ e capas que reagem ao vento garantem que seu personagem se mova elegantemente pelo ambiente. Além disso, o pack _Animated+_ traz vida a itens específicos com animações únicas. ## 🖥️ GUI e Interface Moderna A interface foi redesenhada para ser elegante e funcional, focando em uma estética premium e conectividade: * **Conectividade e Ambiente Social**: Através do _Essential mod_, o modpack oferece um ambiente social completo. Ele permite que você jogue com seus amigos diretamente, sem a necessidade de programas de terceiros ou configurações complexas de servidor, integrando listas de amigos e convites diretamente na interface. * **Identidade Visual**: Todo o sistema de menus usa _Unique Dark_, fornecendo uma interface escura sofisticada e moderna, enquanto o pack _Icons_ adiciona ícones intuitivos e estilizados em todas as janelas. * **Itens 3D**: A modelagem de itens foi elevada com _Weskerson's 3D Items_, _Randomly 3D_ e _Fyoncle's 3D Trims_, fornecendo modelos tridimensionais detalhados para itens quando dropados ou segurados, mantendo o sprite 2D clássico na hotbar. * **Equipamento de Elite**: A estética de combate foi aprimorada. _Glowing 3D Armor_ traz profundidade real à armadura com relevo tridimensional. Agora, Elytras também podem ser adornadas. Para completar o conjunto, o pack _Fresh Weapons & Tools_ revitaliza completamente a aparência das suas ferramentas e armas. * **Fluidez e Feedback de Menu**: _Inventory Particles_ e _Immersive UI_ trabalham juntos: enquanto um adiciona partículas dinâmicas ao selecionar itens, o outro traz animações suaves ao mover itens entre slots. _Smooth Gui_ garante que a transição entre janelas seja impecável. O HUD ganha dinamismo com _Immersive Hotbar_, e a escrita é transformada pelo mod _Scholar_, que remodela a interface do Book and Quill. * **Refinamento e Utilidade**: _AppleSkin_ exibe detalhes essenciais sobre nutrição e saúde recuperada por comida. Para organização, _Shulker Box Tooltip_ permite visualizar o conteúdo de caixas Shulker sem precisar colocá-las no chão, enquanto _Status Effect Bars_ e _BetterF3_ entregam dados técnicos com um design limpo. * **Lore de Encantamentos**: Cada livro encantado agora carrega sua própria história e profundidade. Graças ao mod _Enchantment Lore_, você pode acessar um lore único para cada encantamento simplesmente segurando o livro e clicando com o botão direito do mouse.

title: Cobble Helper
description: Cobble Helper adds a helpful mob that automates cobblestone generation by working directly at a Cobblestone Generator. The mob harvests cobblestone for you, turning a simple early game setup into an efficient automation solution without complex machines.
body: ![curseforge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/curseforge_64h.png) # Cobble Helper Cobble Helper adds a small but surprisingly capable automation mob that takes care of one of the most annoying early-game tasks in Minecraft (especially Skyblock): **mining blocks from generators**. By default, it is used for cobblestone generators, but the mined block can be fully **configured**. Instead of standing around AFK and holding down your mouse button, you can hand that job over to a dedicated helper that mines blocks for you and puts them straight into an inventory. --- ## What does the Cobble Helper do? - Automatically mines a **configurable block** in front of it (Cobblestone by default) - Inserts mined blocks into an **inventory placed behind it** - Plays a mining animation and sound while working - Can be **paused using Redstone** - Can be **upgraded** to improve speed and mining range ![gif](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f710f14afb6c58e46b6cee304a9f7a734c0bde2c.gif) --- ## How to obtain the Cobble Helper The Cobble Helper cannot be crafted. Instead, you obtain it by **converting a regular Minecraft Zombie** through a special interaction: 1. Apply a **configurable status effect** to a normal Zombie (Slowness by default) 2. Right-click the affected Zombie with the configured block (Cobblestone by default) 3. The Zombie will convert and drop a **Cobble Helper Spawn Item** This interaction is intentionally designed to feel more like a ritual than a normal recipe and is documented via EMI world interaction hints. --- ## Upgrades: Speed & Range With the latest update, the Cobble Helper can now be **upgraded** to make it more efficient. - **Speed Upgrade** Makes the helper mine blocks faster. - **Range Upgrade** Increases how far in front of itself the helper can mine. Upgrades follow the same **ritual-based concept** as creating the Cobble Helper itself: - Capture the required mob - **Baby Zombie** for the Speed Upgrade - **Enderman** for the Range Upgrade - Perform the same type of conversion ritual - Apply the upgrade directly to an existing Cobble Helper --- ## Redstone & Inventory Behavior - An inventory (chest, barrel, hopper, etc.) **must** be placed behind the helper - If no inventory is found, the helper will stop working and notify nearby players - If the inventory is full, mining pauses automatically until space is available The Cobble Helper can also be **disabled using Redstone**: - If the block **below the helper** receives a Redstone signal, mining stops immediately - While powered, no blocks are mined or inserted - A small particle effect appears around the helper’s head to indicate the paused state ![redstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b7ed1d770b5e037ea29d8aef70476e1721b1b4f.png) --- ## Notes - The Cobble Helper does **not** load chunks - It only works while its chunk is loaded - Intended as **lightweight automation**, not a full quarry replacement --- ### Planned Improvements - Better textures

body:
denizen-velocity
---------------

- **Depenizen**: https://github.com/DenizenScript/Depenizen
- **Support Discord**: https://discord.gg/SVwEmsvpjN

The plugin requires a second port, which must be specified in /plugins/denizen-velocity/config.yml.
In Depenizen, specify this connected second port.

If you encounter any issues, please report them on our Discord server or GitHub.

title: AvStash
description: AvStash - Next-Gen Stash System
body:
# AvStash — Next-Gen Stash System

**AvStash** is a high-performance stash plugin powered by the **Paper API**, specifically designed for competitive PvP servers.

Stop hunting for items on the ground! AvStash turns your victim's entire inventory into a single package. Fast loot, seamless action.

### Why AvStash?
* **Optimized:** Zero-lag architecture designed for high-traffic networks.
* **Anti-Dupe:** Atomic transactions prevent all item duplication exploits.
* **Restricted Zones:** Prevent stash creation in specific **WorldGuard regions** like Spawns or Arenas.

### Features
* **Overflow:** Excess items move to a secure virtual `/stash` menu with 100% safety.
* **Storage:** Multi-database support including H2, SQLite, and MySQL.
* **Discord:** Detailed Embed messages when a stash is created, claimed, or deleted.

![example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c54d036ef02d9fd8708c1537c04ec56a70d7098.png)
![example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38a38eadf2583d780e5929c132d78b25a1532174.png)

### Technical Details
* **NBT Sync:** Full support for enchantments, names, and Custom Model Data.
* **Auto-Cleanup:** Configurable expiration for unclaimed stashes.
* **Localization:** Built-in English and Turkish support.

### Commands & Permissions
| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/stash` | Open overflow storage. | None |
| `/stashadmin list` | List all active stashes. | `avstash.admin` |
| `/stashadmin info` | View stash metadata. | `avstash.admin` |
| `/stashadmin preview` | View contents via GUI. | `avstash.admin` |
| `/stashadmin give` | Give physical stash item. | `avstash.admin` |
| `/stashadmin delete` | Delete specific/all stashes. | `avstash.admin` |
| `/stashadmin restore` | Restore from archive. | `avstash.admin` |
| `/stashadmin reload` | Reload configuration. | `avstash.admin` |

### Support
If you find a bug or have a suggestion, please contact us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/AnBGXUzTpK)

# 🔍 ModDetails

**The ultimate lightweight utility to inspect your modpack, both client-side and server-side.**

**ModDetails** is a streamlined Fabric mod designed for players and developers who need quick access to mod information without opening menus or restarting the game. With simple commands and interactive tooltips, you can see exactly what's running under the hood.

---

## ✨ Key Features

- **Dual-Sided Listing**: Separate logic for client and server mods.
- **Interactive Tooltips**:
  - **Version**: Exactly which build is installed.
  - **Authors**: Credits to the creators.
  - **Mod ID**: Useful for configuration and debugging.
- **LuckPerms Integration**: Secure your server information by restricting server-side list to authorized staff only.
- **Clean UI**: A minimalist, comma-separated list that doesn't clutter your chat history.

---

## 🛠 Commands & Permissions

### 💻 Client-Side
Available to everyone, even when playing on external servers.
 
- **/clientmods** (Aliases: `/cmods`)
- *Displays: Your locally installed mods.*

### 🖥️ Server-Side
Requires specific permission to prevent information leaks.

- **/mods**
- *Permission*: `moddetails.use` (via LuckPerms)
- *Displays: The mods currently running on the server instance.*

---

## 📦 Installation & Dependencies

1. Ensure you hve the **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API** installed.
2. Install **[LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/download)** to manage access to the `/mods` command.
3. Drop the `ModDetail.jar` into your mods folder.

# Primum Opus - First Creation

**Primum Opus** (Latin for "First Creation") is a challenging early-game overhaul that resets Minecraft progression to absolute zero. Start with bare hands, discover primitive toolmaking, and earn every technological advancement through hands-on survival.

## 🪨 THE PRIMITIVE START

Forget everything you know about early Minecraft. In Primum Opus:

- **No punching trees** - You need proper tools from day one
- **Start from grass and sticks** - Build up from literal nothing
- **Discover toolmaking** - Flint doesn't come from crafting tables
- **Earned progression** - Every recipe unlocked through discovery

Begin by harvesting grass for fiber, crafting primitive drying racks, and making your first twine. Find flint stones and learn to knap them into usable tools through physical interaction, not UI crafting.

## 🔨 AUTHENTIC PROGRESSION

Primum Opus replaces Minecraft's instant gratification with meaningful progression:

- **2x2 crafting only** initially - workbenches require achievement
- **Tools degrade realistically** - maintenance is part of survival
- **Logical tech tree** - each step builds naturally on the last
- **Integration-ready** - gates naturally into Create, IE, Botania

This isn't artificial difficulty—it's about rediscovering the satisfaction of earning your first tools, your first shelter, your first real accomplishments.

## 🎯 DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

We believe survival should feel like survival. Primum Opus follows three principles:

1. **Nothing is free** - Resources require proper tools
2. **Discovery over recipes** - Learn through experimentation
3. **Meaningful milestones** - Every advancement feels earned

## ⚙️ TECHNICAL SPECS

- **Minecraft 1.19.2** with Forge
- **Client & Server compatible**
- **Fully configurable** difficulty
- **Modpack friendly** with advancement gates
  
## 🎮 WHO IS THIS FOR?

Primum Opus is for players who want:
- A fresh start from absolute zero
- Challenging but logical progression
- Satisfaction from earned achievements
- A foundation for hardcore modpacks

If you're tired of the same old "punch tree, get wood, instant tools" routine and want to actually **survive** your first days, Primum Opus is your mod.

---

*"Civilization begins with the first tool. Will you discover it?"*

**Start from nothing. Build everything.**

title: Adaptive Entity Prioritization (AEP)
description: AEP dynamically reduces lag by throttling mob AI and item merge checks based on server strain.
body:
### AEP (Adaptive Entity Prioritization)

AEP is a lightweight, server-side performance optimization mod designed to automatically manage and reduce load caused by entity ticking and physics.

Unlike blanket optimizations, AEP uses an **adaptive throttling system**. The mod only steps in to reduce work when the server needs it—primarily during periods of high server load (high MSPT/TPS drops). When the server runs smoothly, entities and item stacks behave normally.

When the server strains, AEP selectively and temporarily slows down the tick rate for:

1.  **Mob AI:** Pathfinding and general behavior ticks for non-player entities are throttled (mobs might only tick once every few game ticks).
2.  **Item Merging:** The process of item entities searching for nearby stacks to merge with is throttled, reducing physics checks.

AEP uses high mixin priority to apply its throttling logic *before* the corresponding vanilla methods run, making it effective at reducing server work immediately upon detection of lag.

***

### 🛑 IMPORTANT COMPATIBILITY NOTE

**AEP is NOT COMPATIBLE with Lithium.**

Both AEP and Lithium patch the same core server loops. **Lithium's advanced optimizations will completely override and disable AEP's logic,** rendering AEP ineffective, and **crashing Minecraft**. For the best performance, **do not run AEP alongside Lithium.**

**Creator:** Will5Plays

body:
📦 GesaPlugin — Advanced Particle Zone & Animation Tool for Minecraft

GesaPlugin is a Minecraft Spigot plugin designed to create and manage fully customizable particle zones. Its purpose is to give players, builders, and map creators an intuitive visual tool for placing, editing, and animating particles directly inside the game world.

With GesaPlugin, players can create zones, add or remove particle points, adjust RGB particle colors, and build multi-frame animations that can be played, paused, or edited at any moment. Special wands let users interact with zones naturally through simple right-click actions.

✨ How to Use Create or select a zone

📝 Command: /gesa <name> Creates or selects a GESA zone and makes it your active zone.

Get a tool (wand)

🪄 Command: /gsssda <proj|sest|gsgsa>

Wand Purpose PROJ Add new particle points SEST Edit or adjust points GSGSA Delete the nearest particle point Add or remove particles

🖱️ Right-click with your wand:

PROJ — adds a new particle point

GSGSA — removes the nearest point within 2 blocks

Change your particle color

🎨 Command: /gsa <R> <G> Values must be from 0.0 to 1.0

RGB color generator: https://orkm5516-dot.github.io/GSA-RGB-Generator.github.io/

Create animations

🎞️ Commands:

/animatic <zone> <frame> — switch or create a frame

/animatic start <zone> — start animation playback

/animatic stop <zone> — stop animation

/animatic del <zone> — delete all frames of the zone

Clear the zone

🧹 Command: /gss_clear Removes all particles and all animation frames in your active zone.

Get command help

❓ Command: /gss Shows a list of all GesaPlugin commands.

🌐 System Language

Command: /system <eng|rus>

Changes the plugin’s interface language between English and Russian.

title: PetalDisconnect
description: A lightweight quick-disconnect mod that triggers instant disconnects via keybind or focus-loss detection.
body:
# PetalDisconnect

PetalDisconnect is a lightweight client-side utility mod that gives you full control over how and when you disconnect from Minecraft servers.  
Whether you need an instant panic key, automatic disconnects when the game loses focus, or optional smart auto-reconnect behavior, this mod keeps you safe, fast, and in control.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🔌 Quick Disconnect Keybind  
Instantly drop your server connection using a dedicated keybind.  
Perfect for panic exits, privacy, or quickly switching tasks.

> **Note:** The quick-disconnect keybind is configured under:  
> **Options → Controls → Keybinds**, not in the mod’s settings menu.

---

### 🪟 Auto-Disconnect on Lost Focus  
Optionally disconnects the moment your game window loses focus.  
Ideal for multitaskers, frequent alt-tabbers, or anyone who wants the game to pause safely when not active.

---

### 🔄 Optional Auto-Reconnect  
If enabled, the mod can automatically reconnect **only when PetalDisconnect itself caused the disconnect**.  
Normal disconnects (server kicks or manually leaving) will never trigger auto-reconnect.

---

### ⚙️ In-Game Settings Menu  
Accessible through Mod Menu, offering clean toggles for:

- Enable Quick Disconnect  
- Disconnect on Focus Loss  
- Auto Reconnect  

> **Reminder:** The quick-disconnect keybind is still configured under **Controls → Keybinds**.

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Install **Fabric Loader**  
2. Install **Fabric API**  
3. Download the latest version of **PetalDisconnect**  
4. Drop the `.jar` into your `mods/` folder

This mod is **client-side only** — it does **not** need to be installed on servers.

---

## 🛠 Compatibility

- Minecraft **1.21.1**  
- Fabric Loader **0.16.7+**  
- Works with **Mod Menu**  
- No server-side installation required  
- Compatible with most client-side mods

---

## 🧪 How It Works

PetalDisconnect listens for:

- Window focus changes  
- Client disconnect events  
- Your quick-disconnect keybind  

It then intelligently decides whether to disconnect or reconnect based on:

- Your configuration  
- Whether *PetalDisconnect* triggered the disconnect  
- Whether a valid server entry is available  

---

## 🔧 Configuration

You can configure options through:

- **Mod Menu → PetalDisconnect → Configure**  
- Or directly via:  
  `~/.minecraft/config/petaldisconnect.json`

---

## 🤝 Credits

Made with ❤️ by **PetalCat**

title: Decorative Player Heads

body:
# Decorative Heads

## Overview

**Decorative Heads** is a custom datapack that allows players to craft and customize player heads for decorative purposes. This datapack introduces a simple crafting recipe and an innovative renaming system that transforms generic heads into player-specific ones.

## Features

### 🎨 Custom Crafting Recipe
Craft decorative player heads using common materials:
- **Recipe**: 8 Leather + 1 Carved Pumpkin
- **Result**: 1 Decorative Player Head with special properties

![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/419ea61d5e0cf2a3022e8b4ecb2d8f98612fa7f7.png)

### 🏷️ Dynamic Head Transformation
- Rename any crafted head to a player's username
- The datapack automatically applies that player's skin texture
- Perfect for creating memorial walls, decoration displays, or trophy collections

### ⚙️ How It Works
1. Craft a "Decorative Player Head" using the recipe above
2. Use an anvil to rename the head to any Minecraft username
3. The datapack detects the rename and transforms the head texture automatically
4. The head now displays the skin of the specified player

## Installation

1. Download the datapack
2. Place it in your world's `datapacks` folder
3. Reload datapacks with `/reload` or restart the world if you're on a server
4. Start crafting decorative heads!

---

*This datapack enhances your building and decorating experience by making player heads easily accessible and customizable for any creative project.*

# 🎮 Iniciativa Cobblemon 🚀

> ***✨ ¡La Experiencia Pokémon Definitiva en Minecraft! ✨***

¿Cansado del mismo Minecraft de siempre? ¿Listo para una épica aventura? Iniciativa Cobblemon es un modpack meticulosamente creado que combina perfectamente el amado mundo de Pokémon con la libertad creativa de Minecraft, ¡creando la experiencia más completa y emocionante disponible!

### 🏆 ¿Qué Te Espera?
**⚔️ Una Épica Aventura Pokémon**
**🏛️ Conviértete en Campeón:** ¡Enfréntate a poderosos Líderes de Gimnasio y demuestra tu habilidad en un sistema de progresión inspirado en los juegos clásicos de Pokémon!

**🌍 Templos y Leyendas:** Descubre templos antiguos esparcidos por el mundo y resuelve sus misterios para invocar y luchar contra ¡Pokémon Legendarios!

**🏕️ Incursiones Dinámicas:** ¡Únete a tus amigos para derrotar incursiones desafiantes y obtener recompensas épicas!

**🗺️ Progresión Estructurada:** Sigue un camino claro de combate y exploración, ¡como en los juegos oficiales!

### 🛠️ Gameplay de Minecraft Mejorado
**🌾 Automatización Inteligente:** ¡Di adiós a la grind! Con mods como Easy Mob Farm y Botany Pots, puedes farmear automáticamente tanto mobs como recursos sin esfuerzo.

**📦 Almacenamiento Elegante:** Gestiona tus objetos fácilmente con el potente sistema Refined Storage, manteniendo tu base ordenada y eficiente.

**🏡 Construcciones Hermosas:** Mejora tu mundo con mods decorativos como Supplementaries, Handcrafted y Chipped para crear la región Pokémon de tus sueños.

**⚡ Rendimiento Optimizado:** Disfruta de una experiencia fluida con mods de rendimiento como Sodium, Lithium y ModernFix. Recomendamos 4GB de RAM asignada para el mejor rendimiento.

### 🎨 Visuales Inmersivos y Calidad de Vida
**🎨 Texturas y Animaciones Frescas:** Incluye el impresionante pack de recursos Fresh Animations y otros para dar vida a tus Pokémon y al mundo.

**🎵 Adiciones de Cobblemon:** Benefíciate de una gran selección de addons como Mega Showdown, SimpleTMs, CobbleNav y muchos más que expanden el gameplay, movimientos y características.

**✅ Tweaks Amigables para el Usuario:** Lleno de mods de calidad de vida como Jade (para tooltips), Xaero's Minimap, Better Advancements e Inventory Management para hacer tu vida más fácil.

## ⚠️ Notas Importantes

Advertencia del Mod Space Cube

> **🚨 CRÍTICO:** Al usar el mod Space Cube:

**NO rompas los Space Cubes después de colocarlos** - esto los desvinculará de la dimensión espacial y causará problemas

**NO cierres el juego mientras estés dentro de un Space Cube** - esto a veces puede romper tu juego al reconectarte e intentar salir del Space Cube

¡Siempre sal al overworld antes de cerrar sesión o romper el cubo!

**🐾 Principal**

Cobblemon, Mega Evoluciones, Pokémon Alfa, Templos Legendarios, Líderes de Gimnasio, Guaridas de Incursiones

**🏗️ Automatización y Tecnología**

Refined Storage, Botany Pots, Easy Mob Farm, Growable Ores, Vein Miner

title: JourneyMapTeleporter
description: Created to allow custom servers use of JourneyMap's teleport.
body:
# JourneyMapTeleporter

A simple server-side plugin that lets players teleport using coordinates while blocking direct player-to-player teleports.

## What does it do?

This plugin restricts the `/tp` command for regular players to coordinate-based teleportation only. Perfect for servers that want to allow JourneyMap waypoint teleports without giving players the ability to teleport to each other.

**Players can:**
- `/tp 100 64 200` - Teleport to coordinates
- `/tp @s 100 64 200` - Use JourneyMap format
- `/tp PlayerName 100 64 200` - Only if PlayerName is the sender

**Players cannot:**
- `/tp OtherPlayer` - Teleport to another player
- `/tp PlayerOne PlayerTwo` - Teleport others

Admins with the `safetp.bypass` permission have full `/tp` functionality.

## Installation

Drop the plugin into your `plugins/` folder and restart the server. That's it.

## Permissions

- `safetp.bypass` (default: op) - Bypass teleport restrictions

title: VoidWorldPlugin
description: This plugin creates a special Void world, in which players can travel between the normal and Void world using the commands /void and /world.
body:
# **VoidWorldPlugin**

**VoidWorldPlugin** creates a completely empty world of the **NETHER** type, which is perfectly suited for building projects, mini-games, or creative hubs. The plugin provides complete fall protection and disables mob spawning, making the Void a safe place to play.

## ✨ Key Features

* **🛡️ Complete Fall Protection:** Players falling below Y=0 are **automatically teleported** to the set spawn point (`/sv`) instead of dying.
* **🚫 Disabled Mob Spawning:** Natural mob spawning is completely disabled in the Void world (except, potentially, for mobs whose spawning is forcefully triggered by other plugins or commands).
* **🌎 Convenient Travel:** Easy-to-use commands for quickly switching to the Void and back.
* **🔧 Simple Configuration:** You can easily configure messages, permissions, and the world name via `config.yml`.



## 🚀 Commands and Permissions

| Command | Description | Default Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`/void`** | Teleports you to the Void world. | `voidworld.use` |
| **`/world`** | Returns you to the exact spot where you entered the Void world. | `voidworld.return` |
| **`/sv`** (`/spawnvoid`) | Sets a new spawn point in the Void world (the teleportation point when using `/void` and upon falling). | `voidworld.setspawn` (op) |

### Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `voidworld.use` | Allows the use of the `/void` command. | `true` |
| `voidworld.return` | Allows the use of the `/world` command. | `true` |
| `voidworld.setspawn` | Allows setting the spawn point with the `/sv` command. | `op` |



## ⚙️ Installation and Configuration

### Installation

1.  Download the `VoidWorldPlugin-1.0.jar` file.
2.  Move it to your server's `/plugins` folder.
3.  Restart or reload the server. The plugin will automatically create the `void_world` world and the configuration file.

### Configuration (`config.yml`)

The plugin generates a complete `config.yml` file. After the first run, you can configure:

1.  **`void-world-name`**: Change the world name if `void_world` is unsuitable for you.
2.  **`spawn.fallback-y-on-fall`**: The Y coordinate where the player is teleported if the `/sv` point has not yet been set (default is 0.0).
3.  **`messages`**: Change all plugin messages. Color codes (`&`) are supported.

> ⚠️ **Important:** If you change the world name (`void-world-name`), you will need to delete the old world folder (if it was created) and restart the server.

## 🐞 Support and Bug Reports

If you find any bugs or have suggestions, please let me know on Discord - lipton\_sad.

title: Dumb Stuff
description: An expansion of many under-used mechanics + Early game QoL! Includes automatic bundles.
body:
This is the result of me avoiding a decent sleep schedule by adding random ideas into a mod. May or may not be inspired by Stardew Valley. This mod falls inbetween being a QoL and content mod. I don't want to completely change any vanilla features, but instead improve what already exists by adding additional features. A few things I'm trying to improve:
Early-game food gathering + Making alternative food sources viable (e.g. Fishing) > Early on, things like fishing don't provide much upfront, and usually either cost you time (campfire), or your limited amount of coal (furnaces). > By the time you can get enchantments to improve output, you likely already have a way to make tonnes of gold carrots, and fishing becomes far less useful. Current items: Fishing Bait, Farming Resource Bundle.
Minecraft's "Inventory Problem", and lack of inventory automation > Every update, I feel like the addition of new items makes inventory management harder and harder keep doing, or increases the amount of travelling you have to do to get enough of certain items. > Even bundles, which are supposed to ease this issue early-game, fall short of doing so. A bundle doesn't let you store backups of tools, or multiple stacks of similar items. Current items: Resource Bundles.
Currently has: ### Resource Bundles (currently implemented as Farming and Stone Bundles) These are Bundles which automatically fill themselves with dropped items of the same category as the bundle. (Farming, Stones, Wood, Fish, and probably more to come!) For some reason, I haven't really seen anything attempt this? This can reduce a lot of clutter that builds up when exploring the world. These bundles can store a stack of each item type it accepts. This makes transporting basic resources (various seeds and various stones) a lot easier to do. Instead of needing a shulker box to store stacks of different stones for a build, one bundle might give enough storage for previously difficult builds to be feasible early-game.
Crafting Recipe > seeds > stone
### Fishing Bait Crafted out of one Bread, this gives an early game way of greatly increasing fishing drops. Fishing Bait is consumed when a fish is caught, and can give up to +3 extra fish. This gives a good early-game fish farming method that still encourages traditional farming. Could also work well with 'diet' mods.
Crafting Recipe
### Letters/Mailbox it's currently a bit... primitive, but adds pretty letters which are sent to players through the Mailbox. The letter's recipient is determined based off the first online username detected in the first page. Small warning, I plan on _not_ teleporting mail to the recipient once I update the mail system. Instead, mail will just get stored privately inside a mailbox(/to be accessed at any mailbox). I also hope to add item attachments later.
Crafting Recipe
### _Planned Features_ I'll add these whenever I end up procrastinating on something again. - Furniture that provides some functionality/benefit. I have ideas for customizable furniture which grant bonuses based on their level of quality/decoration. - potentially some additions to cooking mechanics - Marriage as a cursed way to share an XP bar (of which levelling is still not linear!) and pet ownership. Not sure if it belongs here. - Mail system overhaul - possibly other fishing changes (Nets?)

title: Survival-Friend
description: prevents creeper block damage and crop trampling, enables portal based farms on SMP, offers /tpa features and global totem pop messages and the ability to make the ender dragon a bit harder.
body:
# Survival Friend - The only plugin you'll need!

## This plugin provides advanced features to enhance your SMP:
- **No creeper damage to blocks and/or players**
- **No crop-trampling for players or mobs**
- **/ec , /wb , /compass  commands**
- **Mobs far away don't despawn anymore (Portal based farms)**
- **/tpa  feature with 60 minutes cooldown between requests**
- **Custom HP for the Ender Dragon**
- **Totem of undying pops will be broadcasted to global chat**
- everything can be disabled or enabled via the  /menufs  command

## Setup instructions:
1. Download the latest release from modrinth
2. Put the .jar-File into your /plugins/ folder and start the server
3. Use /menufs as an op to enable/disable the features

## Detailed features list:
- **Creeper**: You can toggle whether creepers should be able to _destroy blocks_ or _damage players_. (You can toggle both options on or off)
- **Crop Trampling**: You can toggle whether players or mobs should be able to destroy crops by stepping on them. (You can toggle both options on or off)
- **TPA**: Players are able to send /tpa requests to other players. This command has a 60 minutes cooldown between requests. The cooldown is not editable right now.
- **Portal based farms**: This plugin enables portal based farms on SMP-Servers by preventing _Guardians, Iron Golems, Creepers, Whither Skeletons_ and _Piglins_ from despawning when far away from a player. The moblist cannot be edited right now.
- **Harder Dragon**: The Dragon's health can be edited in the config file. When the feature is enabled, the ender dragon will (re)spawn with more or less HP.
- **Totem pop notification**: If a totem of undying is used to prevent death, the plugin will broadcast a message to the enrie server with a "totem pop message", similar to the default death message.
- **Enderchest, Workbench**: This plugin offers the ability to open your enderchest and a workbench when using /ec or /wb . These features can be toggled to be on/of or to be only used by admins (op).
- **Compass**: You can use this command to let your compass point to a player or to given coordinated. Useful when you dont play with a minimap/bluemap.

title: The Heaven System
description: This is a LITRPG System minecraft plugin that makes the game into a RPG WORLD with classes, stats, and MORE!
body:
The Heaven System transforms Minecraft into a mythic progression framework where players evolve from mortals to divine beings capable of reshaping reality itself. This isn't just another RPG plugin - it's a complete reimagining of Minecraft as a realm of growth, mastery, and divine recognition.

Players gain four core stats through their actions: Strength affects combat damage and mining speed, Agility influences movement and dodge chance, Intelligence boosts experience gain and crafting efficiency, and Charisma improves trading and social interactions. Every block mined, mob defeated, and structure built contributes to your statistical growth, creating a meaningful progression system that rewards all playstyles.

The title system recognizes extraordinary feats with mythic titles that grant both statistical bonuses and visual prestige. Slay 100 hostile mobs to become a Beast Slayer, mine 100 diamond ore to earn Diamond Seeker, or place 10,000 blocks to achieve Master Builder. Each title comes with particle effects, custom prefixes, and substantial stat bonuses. Titles are upgradeable - Beast Slayer evolves into Apex Predator and eventually Mythic Hunter, with each tier providing greater power and more dramatic visual effects.

As you accomplish feats and earn titles, you accumulate Potential - a hidden stat that reflects how deeply the Heaven System recognizes your impact on the world. When your Potential reaches critical thresholds, you become eligible for ascension to divine roles. System Mediators gain semi-divine powers including teleportation, entity inspection, and the ability to grant temporary buffs to other players. System Architects achieve near-godlike status with world-shaping abilities, event creation powers, and the capacity to modify the System itself.

The class system offers four distinct paths: Duelists excel in combat with weapon mastery and battle rage abilities, Arcanists wield mystical forces with spell casting and mana manipulation, Artisans master crafting with resource efficiency and blueprint mastery, and Tricksters embrace stealth and deception with invisibility and trap-setting skills. Each class has unique stat preferences and abilities that fundamentally change how you interact with the world.

Dynamic system events keep the world alive and mythic. Divine Blessings randomly grant players substantial Potential boosts, Stat Surges temporarily increase all stat gains by 50%, Mob Invasions spawn challenging encounters with bonus rewards, and Mystical Phenomena create reality-bending effects like random teleportation or magical auras. These events ensure that no two play sessions feel the same.

The plugin features a comprehensive command system for both players and administrators. Use /heaven to access the main menu and view system information, /heaven gui to open your interactive stats display showing all four core stats with their multipliers and effects, /heaven titles to browse and manage your earned titles, /stats to view detailed statistics for yourself or other players including total playtime and progression milestones, /titles to examine title collections and achievements, and /ascend accept or /ascend decline to respond to ascension offers when you've accumulated sufficient Potential.

Administrators have access to powerful management tools including /heaven reload to refresh all configuration files, /ascend [player] [role] to force ascension of specific players to Mediator or Architect status, and extensive permission nodes for fine-grained access control. The heavensystem.mediator and heavensystem.architect permissions grant the respective ascended abilities, while heavensystem.admin provides full administrative access.

The system is highly configurable through YAML files that allow server owners to customize stat multipliers, ascension requirements, title definitions, class abilities, and event frequencies. Want to make Strength more impactful in combat? Adjust the combat-multiplier. Need to change how much Potential is required for ascension? Modify the ascension thresholds. Every aspect of the system can be tailored to your server's needs.

Visual feedback is central to the Heaven System experience. Title acquisitions trigger dramatic chat sequences with particle effects and epic sounds. Ascensions clear the entire chat and display cinematic messages with reality-bending particle displays. The GUI system provides real-time stat tracking with color-coded displays and detailed tooltips explaining each system component.

The plugin tracks extensive player statistics including blocks placed and broken by type, mobs killed, rare ores mined, total playtime, and custom achievement progress. This data drives the title system and provides rich analytics for understanding player progression patterns.

Whether you're a casual builder slowly accumulating Intelligence through construction projects, a dedicated warrior climbing the combat title hierarchy, or an ambitious player seeking divine ascension, the Heaven System provides meaningful progression that transforms every action into part of your mythic journey. The system rewards creativity, persistence, and bold gameplay while maintaining perfect balance between different playstyles.

This is more than a plugin - it's a complete transformation of Minecraft into a realm where mortals can achieve divinity through dedication and skill. Every block placed, every mob defeated, and every structure built brings you closer to transcending the mortal realm and joining the ranks of those who shape reality itself

title: TooMuchPhantoms
description: This mod is server-side so feel free to use it on "vanill-ish" servers. No need to install it on client.
body:
# **TooMuchPhantoms**  
**Fully Customize Phantom Spawning in Minecraft!**  

Tired of phantoms being too annoying—or not annoying enough? This mod gives **server admins** precise control over phantom spawning mechanics via a simple config file. Adjust spawn rates, timers, light restrictions, and more!  

## **Features**  
✔ **Enable/disable insomnia-based spawning** (`doInsomnia`)  
✔ **Customize spawn delay** (`insomniaSpawnStartTimer`)  
✔ **Control spawn frequency** (`insomniaMinCycleTime`)  
✔ **Block spawns in bright areas** (`insomniaLightStopsPhantoms`)  
✔ **Set phantom-free zones** (`phantomFreeArea`)  
✔ **Tweak group spawn sizes** (`minAmountPerSpawn`/`maxAmountPerSpawn`)  

## **Default Configuration**  
```ini
# Спаунятся ли фантомы после отсутствия сна (примечание: игровое правило не работает)
doInsomnia=true

# Через сколько секунд начинают спауниться фантомы из-за бессонницы (Ванилла: 3600)
insomniaSpawnStartTimer=3600

# Минимальное время в секундах между спаунами фантомов (Ванилла: 60)
insomniaMinCycleTime=90

# Максимальное случайное время, добавляемое к минимальному времени между спаунами (Ванилла: 60)
insomniaRandomizationTime=80

# Уровень освещения, при котором фантомы не спаунятся (Ванилла: 999 (отключено))
insomniaLightStopsPhantoms=15

# Радиус вокруг точки спауна мира, где фантомы не появляются (Ванилла: 0 (отключено))
phantomFreeArea=0

# Лимиты количества фантомов в одной группе при спауне
minAmountPerSpawn=1
maxAmountPerSpawn=3
```  

## **Downloads & Support**

title: FastCMD
description: A command block, but as a command with unique capabilities
body:
# FastCMD [RUS] 

FastCMD - это мощный плагин для Minecraft Spigot, который добавляет виртуальные командные блоки на ваш сервер. Создавайте, управляйте и выполняйте команды с расширенными возможностями планирования и связки, используя простые команды в чате.

## Возможности  

- **Виртуальные командные блоки**: Создавайте командные блоки без физического размещения
- **Разные типы блоков**: Поддержка Обычных, Цепных и Циклических командных блоков
- **Планирование**: Настраиваемые задержки и таймеры отключения
- **Цепочки команд**: Связывайте командные блоки для последовательного выполнения
- **Мультиязычность**: Встроенная поддержка английского и русского языков
- **UTF-8 кодировка**: Корректное отображение в Windows CMD и на всех платформах
- **Гибкий синтаксис**: Современные флаги аргументов с обратной совместимостью
- **Автодополнение**: Умное автодополнение для команд и параметров
- **Система прав**: Детальный контроль доступа к функциям
- **Сохранение данных**: Хранение в YAML-файлах с автоматическим сохранением

## Установка  

1. Скачайте последнюю версию FastCMD.jar из релизов
2. Поместите jar-файл в папку `plugins` вашего сервера
3. Перезапустите сервер
4. Настройте плагин через файл `plugins/FastCMD/config.yml`

## Команды  

Все команды поддерживают как основной вариант `/fastcmd`, так и алиас `/fcmd`.

### Создание командного блока
```
/fcmd create `команда` --name:имя --type:Normal --delay:20 --disable:6000 --connected:другой_блок
```

### Запуск командного блока
```
/fcmd run --name:имя
/fcmd run имя (старый синтаксис)
```

### Удаление командного блока
```
/fcmd delete --name:имя
/fcmd delete имя (старый синтаксис)
```

### Изменение командного блока
```
/fcmd change --name:имя `новая команда` --type:Repeating --delay:40
```

### Остановка командного блока
```
/fcmd stop --name:имя
/fcmd stop имя (старый синтаксис)
```

### Команды языка
```
/fcmd lang en
/fcmd lang ru
/fcmd lang (переключение между языками)
```

### Помощь
```
/fcmd help
```

## Типы командных блоков  

- **Обычный**: Выполняется один раз с указанной задержкой
- **Цепной**: Выполняется и сразу активирует связанный блок
- **Циклический**: Повторяет выполнение пока не будет отключен

## Права  

| Право | Описание | По умолчанию |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `fastcmd.use` | Доступ к командам FastCMD | op |
| `fastcmd.create` | Создание командных блоков | op |
| `fastcmd.run` | Запуск командных блоков | op |
| `fastcmd.delete` | Удаление командных блоков | op |
| `fastcmd.change` | Изменение командных блоков | op |
| `fastcmd.stop` | Остановка командных блоков | op |
| `fastcmd.help` | Просмотр справки | op |
| `fastcmd.lang` | Смена языка | op |

## Конфигурация  

Плагин создает несколько конфигурационных файлов:

- `config.yml`: Основные настройки, включая язык и автодополнение
- `storage.yml`: Хранение данных командных блоков
- `lang/en.yml`: Английские тексты
- `lang/ru.yml`: Русские тексты

### Основные настройки  

```yaml
# Язык (en/ru)
language: ru

# Вкл/выкл автодополнение
tab-completion: true

# Значения по умолчанию
default-delay: 0
default-disable-time: 0
max-delay: 72000
max-disable-time: 72000
```

## Поддерживаемые версии  

- **Основная поддержка**: Minecraft 1.16.5 (Spigot/Paper)
- **Ожидаемая совместимость**: Minecraft 1.16.5 - 1.20.x
- **Java**: Java 8 или выше

## Сборка из исходников  

1. Клонируйте репозиторий
2. Убедитесь что установлены Java 8+ и Maven
3. Выполните `mvn clean compile package`
4. Собранный jar будет в `target/FastCMD-1.0.0.jar`

## Участие в разработке  

1. Форкните репозиторий
2. Создайте ветку для вашей функции
3. Зафиксируйте изменения
4. Запушьте ветку
5. Создайте Pull Request

## Лицензия  

Проект лицензирован под MIT License - подробности в файле LICENSE.

## Поддержка  

Для помощи, багрепортов или запросов функций создавайте issue на GitHub.

# FastCMD [ENG]

FastCMD is a powerful Minecraft Spigot plugin that brings virtual command blocks to your server. Create, manage, and execute commands with advanced scheduling and chaining capabilities, all through simple chat commands.

## Features

- **Virtual Command Blocks**: Create command blocks without placing physical blocks
- **Multiple Block Types**: Support for Normal, Chain, and Repeating command blocks
- **Advanced Scheduling**: Configurable delays and auto-disable timers
- **Command Chaining**: Connect command blocks for sequential execution
- **Multilingual Support**: Built-in English and Russian localization
- **UTF-8 Encoding**: Proper display support for Windows CMD and all platforms
- **Flexible Syntax**: Modern flag-based arguments with backward compatibility
- **Tab Completion**: Smart auto-completion for all commands and parameters
- **Permission System**: Granular permission control for all features
- **Persistent Storage**: YAML-based storage with automatic saving

## Installation

1. Download the latest FastCMD.jar from releases
2. Place the jar file in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Configure the plugin by editing `plugins/FastCMD/config.yml`

## Commands

All commands support both the main command `/fastcmd` and the alias `/fcmd`.

### Create Command Block
```
/fcmd create `command` --name:myblock --type:Normal --delay:20 --disable:6000 --connected:otherblock
```

### Run Command Block
```
/fcmd run --name:myblock
/fcmd run myblock (old syntax)
```

### Delete Command Block
```
/fcmd delete --name:myblock
/fcmd delete myblock (old syntax)
```

### Modify Command Block
```
/fcmd change --name:myblock `new command` --type:Repeating --delay:40
```

### Stop Command Block
```
/fcmd stop --name:myblock
/fcmd stop myblock (old syntax)
```

### Language Commands
```
/fcmd lang en
/fcmd lang ru
/fcmd lang (toggle between languages)
```

### Help
```
/fcmd help
```

## Command Block Types

- **Normal**: Executes once with specified delay
- **Chain**: Executes once and immediately triggers connected block
- **Repeating**: Executes repeatedly until disabled or stopped

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `fastcmd.use` | Access to FastCMD commands | op |
| `fastcmd.create` | Create new command blocks | op |
| `fastcmd.run` | Execute command blocks | op |
| `fastcmd.delete` | Delete command blocks | op |
| `fastcmd.change` | Modify command blocks | op |
| `fastcmd.stop` | Stop running command blocks | op |
| `fastcmd.help` | View help information | op |
| `fastcmd.lang` | Change language settings | op |

## Configuration

The plugin creates several configuration files:

- `config.yml`: Main plugin settings including language and tab completion
- `storage.yml`: Persistent storage for command blocks
- `lang/en.yml`: English localization
- `lang/ru.yml`: Russian localization

### Key Configuration Options

```yaml
# Language setting (en/ru)
language: en

# Enable/disable tab completion
tab-completion: true

# Default values for command blocks
default-delay: 0
default-disable-time: 0
max-delay: 72000
max-disable-time: 72000
```

## Supported Versions

- **Primary Support**: Minecraft 1.16.5 (Spigot/Paper)
- **Expected Compatibility**: Minecraft 1.16.5 - 1.20.x
- **Java**: Java 8 or higher

## Building from Source

1. Clone the repository
2. Ensure Java 8+ and Maven are installed
3. Run `mvn clean compile package`
4. Find the compiled jar in `target/FastCMD-1.0.0.jar`

## Contributing

1. Fork the repository
2. Create your feature branch
3. Commit your changes
4. Push to the branch
5. Create a Pull Request

## License

This project is licensed under the MIT License - see the LICENSE file for details.

## Support

For support, bug reports, or feature requests, please open an issue on GitHub.

title: NotClickable
description: Mod that lets you mark blocks as unclickable, preventing players from interacting with them.
body:
---

# 🚫 NotClickable

> 🛑 Prevent players from interacting with specific blocks — fully configurable and lightweight!

### 📜 Description

**NotClickable** is a lightweight utility mod for server admins and map creators that allows you to mark specific blocks as **non-interactable** — meaning players will no longer be able to right-click them.

This is useful for:

* Adventure or puzzle maps
* Spawn protection or admin zones
* Technical redstone builds
* Custom SMP mechanics

### 🛠️ Features

* 🔒 Block right-click interaction on marked blocks
* 🎯 Use `/notclickable` command to mark blocks manually or by looking at them
* 📃 `/notclickable list` shows all protected positions (with clickable TP links)
* ✨ Temporary particle outlines around protected blocks for easy visualization 
  (when using the command `/notclickable list` for 5 seconds)
* ⚙️ Configurable permission level via `config/notclickable-common.toml`
* 💾 World-persistent storage using Minecraft's `SavedData`

---

### 🔧 Configuration

After first launch, a config file will be created at:

```
/config/notclickable-common.toml
```

```toml
# Permission level required to use /notclickable command (0–4)
commandPermissionLevel = 2
```

This controls who can use the `/notclickable` command (2 = command blocks & trusted operators).

---

### 💬 Commands

| Command                            | Description                                 |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `/notclickable true/false`         | Marks the block you're looking at           |
| `/notclickable <x y z> true/false` | Marks a specific block by coordinates       |
| `/notclickable list`               | Lists all protected blocks (with /tp links) |

---

### 🌐 Wiki

📚 Full documentation is available on the [NotClickable GitHub Wiki](https://github.com/Netlifex/NotClickable/wiki/NotClickableModWiki)

---

### 🐞 Bug Reports

🛠 Found a bug or need help? Join the **[Netlifex Development Discord](https://discord.gg/CTb5XHZ5c6)** to report issues or ask questions

---

### 📦 Compatibility

* ✔️ Forge 1.20.1
* ❌ Not compatible with Fabric
* 💡 Client-side installation is **not required**

---
