# 🟣 Amethyst Guard
“Protect the growth of your Amethyst crystals.”
## 📖 Overview

Amethyst Guard is a lightweight and client-side Fabric mod that lets you control which stages of Amethyst growth can be mined.
You can freely toggle mining permissions for each stage — from small buds to full clusters — and even protect Budding Amethyst from being broken.

> 💎 Prevent accidental destruction of your Amethyst farm forever!

## ⚙️ Features

✅ Per-Stage Mining Control
Configure whether players can mine:

Small Amethyst Bud

Medium Amethyst Bud

Large Amethyst Bud

Amethyst Cluster

✅ Protect Budding Amethyst
Prevents breaking the block that grows new crystals.

✅ Client-Side Restriction
Each player can configure their own preferences — no server installation required.

✅ No Break Motion
Disabled blocks can’t even be swung at — no arm swing, no crack animation, no partial mining.

✅ YACL + ModMenu Integration

Configure directly from the in-game menu

Toggle “Show Message on Blocked” option

🌐 Full English & Korean localization

## 🧩 Configuration

Open Mod Menu → Amethyst Guard

Toggle each Amethyst growth stage to allow or block mining

(Optional) Toggle “Show Messages” to enable/disable on-screen alerts

All settings are automatically saved in config/amethyst-guard.json.

title: Copper Plus
description: Add game mechanics about the copper.
body:
# CopperPlus - Advanced Copper Oxidation Plugin

[![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21-brightgreen.svg)](https://www.minecraft.net/)
[![Paper API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper%20API-1.21-blue.svg)](https://papermc.io/)
[![Languages](https://img.shields.io/badge/Languages-11-orange.svg)](#supported-languages)

## 🎮 Overview

CopperPlus is a quality-of-life plugin for Minecraft 1.21+ that revolutionizes copper oxidation mechanics. Transform the slow, natural oxidation process into a rapid, controlled system using campfires and water - perfect for builders and redstone engineers who need oxidized copper quickly!

## ✨ Key Features

### ⚡ Accelerated Oxidation System
- **Rapid Oxidation**: Place copper blocks above lit campfires with water nearby to speed up oxidation dramatically
- **Smart Detection**: Automatically detects valid setups and begins the oxidation process
- **Water Speed Multiplier**: More water blocks = faster oxidation (configurable bonus per water block)
- **Visual Feedback**: Particle effects and sound notifications during oxidation
- **Progress Tracking**: Real-time oxidation progress messages

### 🌍 Multi-Language Support (11 Languages!)
- **English** (en_US) - Default
- **Chinese Simplified** (zh_CN) - 简体中文
- **Spanish** (es_ES) - Español
- **Hindi** (hi_IN) - हिन्दी
- **Arabic** (ar_SA) - العربية
- **Portuguese** (pt_BR) - Português
- **Russian** (ru_RU) - Русский
- **Japanese** (ja_JP) - 日本語
- **German** (de_DE) - Deutsch
- **French** (fr_FR) - Français
- **Korean** (ko_KR) - 한국어

### 🛠️ Additional Features
- **Starter Kit**: Quick-start kit with campfire, copper blocks, water bucket, and flint & steel
- **Dispenser Support**: Dispensers can place copper blocks that automatically start oxidizing
- **Message Toggle**: Players can enable/disable oxidation notifications
- **Smart Chunk Management**: Efficient processing with configurable limits per chunk
- **Fully Configurable**: Extensive configuration options for all features

## 📋 Commands

All commands use the main `/copperplus` command (aliases: `/cp`, `/copper+`):

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/copperplus help` | Show all available commands | `copperplus.use` |
| `/copperplus kit` | Get the copper oxidation starter kit | `copperplus.kit` |
| `/copperplus language` | View your current language | `copperplus.use` |
| `/copperplus language set <code>` | Change your language | `copperplus.use` |
| `/copperplus language list` | List all available languages | `copperplus.use` |
| `/copperplus language admin <code>` | Set server default language | `copperplus.admin` |
| `/copperplus togglemsg` | Toggle oxidation messages on/off | `copperplus.use` |
| `/copperplus reload` | Reload plugin configuration | `copperplus.admin` |

## 🔧 How It Works

### Basic Setup
1. Place a **Campfire** (regular or soul campfire)
2. Place a **Copper Block** directly above the campfire
3. Place **Water** blocks nearby (within 1 block radius)
4. The campfire must be **lit** for oxidation to occur
5. Watch as your copper oxidizes in seconds instead of hours!

### Oxidation Speed Formula
- **Base Speed**: Configurable duration (default: 60 seconds for full oxidation)
- **Water Bonus**: Each water block adds a speed multiplier
- **Maximum**: Up to 26 water blocks can affect oxidation speed
- **Formula**: `Speed = 1.0 + (water_blocks × water_speed_bonus)`

### Oxidation Stages
The plugin supports all vanilla copper oxidation stages:
- Copper Block → Exposed Copper
- Exposed Copper → Weathered Copper
- Weathered Copper → Oxidized Copper

Works with all copper variants: blocks, stairs, slabs, and cut copper!

## ⚙️ Configuration

### Key Configuration Options

```yaml
general:
  enabled: true                    # Enable/disable the plugin
  debug: false                      # Debug mode for troubleshooting

oxidation:
  duration-seconds: 60              # Base time for one oxidation stage
  water-speed-bonus: 0.25           # Speed multiplier per water block
  max-water-blocks: 26              # Maximum water blocks counted
  require-lit-campfire: true        # Campfire must be lit
  water-check-radius: 1             # Radius to check for water

effects:
  particles: true                   # Enable particle effects
  particle-type: "WAX_ON"          # Particle type to use
  sounds: true                      # Enable sound effects

performance:
  check-interval: 20                # Ticks between oxidation checks
  max-per-chunk: 50                 # Max oxidizing blocks per chunk

kit:
  items:
    campfire: 4                     # Number of campfires in kit
    copper-block: 64                # Number of copper blocks
    water-bucket: 2                 # Number of water buckets
    flint-and-steel: 1              # Flint and steel for lighting
```

## 🔑 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `copperplus.use` | Access to basic commands | All players |
| `copperplus.kit` | Use the `/copperplus kit` command | All players |
| `copperplus.admin` | Admin commands (reload, set default language) | Operators |

## 📦 Installation

1. **Requirements**:
   - Paper server 1.21 or higher
   - Java 21 or higher

2. **Installation Steps**:
   - Download the latest `copper-plus-1.0.jar` from releases
   - Place the JAR file in your server's `plugins` folder
   - Restart your server
   - Configure settings in `plugins/CopperPlus/config.yml`
   - (Optional) Customize language files in `plugins/CopperPlus/languages/`

## 🎯 Use Cases

### For Builders
- Quickly obtain oxidized copper for builds without waiting hours
- Create gradient effects with different oxidation stages
- Mass-produce weathered copper for roofing and decoration

### For Redstone Engineers
- Rapidly test copper bulb oxidation states
- Create controlled oxidation farms
- Experiment with different oxidation patterns

### For Server Admins
- Provide quality-of-life improvement for players
- Reduce server load compared to tick acceleration methods
- Full control over oxidation speed and mechanics

## 🌟 Unique Features

### Why CopperPlus?

1. **Realistic Mechanism**: Uses campfire heat and water (like real oxidation chemistry!)
2. **Performance Optimized**: Efficient chunk-based processing
3. **Fully Integrated**: Works with dispensers, all copper types, and vanilla mechanics
4. **Player Choice**: Optional notifications, per-player language preferences
5. **Admin Friendly**: Extensive configuration and reload without restart

## 🔄 Update Roadmap

### Planned Features
- [ ] Custom oxidation patterns and templates
- [ ] Waxing automation system
- [ ] Oxidation reversal with lightning integration
- [ ] GUI for language and settings management
- [ ] PlaceholderAPI support
- [ ] Economy integration for kit purchases
- [ ] Custom crafting recipes for oxidized variants

## 📊 Performance

- **Lightweight**: Minimal server impact with smart check intervals
- **Scalable**: Configurable limits prevent performance issues
- **Efficient**: Only processes active oxidation setups
- **Clean**: Automatic cleanup when chunks unload

## 🐛 Troubleshooting

### Common Issues

**Oxidation not starting:**
- Ensure campfire is lit (not just placed)
- Check water is within 1 block radius
- Verify copper block is directly above campfire
- Make sure the plugin is enabled in config

**Messages not showing:**
- Check if you've toggled messages off with `/copperplus togglemsg`
- Verify your language file exists and is valid
- Ensure you're within 16 blocks of oxidizing copper

**Performance issues:**
- Reduce `max-per-chunk` in config
- Increase `check-interval` for less frequent updates
- Enable `clear-on-unload` for better memory management

- **Feature Requests**: Suggest features through GitHub discussions
- **Discord**: Join our community server for live support

title: Arken
description: A simple mod designed for modpacks that adds a singular deepslate ore, orb that drops from it, and a block that can be crafted from the orb. Right-clicking this mystical orb has near infinite potential, and the block it creates also has unique properties.
body:
Is your name Justin? Because you're just-in time to check out the latest in redstone/lootbox/OreGen mods!

This mod has been specifically designed with larger modpacks in mind, providing a nice extra to mining towards the end game while still keeping things balanced - but also highly configurable.

Adds;

**1x New ore** **- Deepslate Arken Ore**
Spawns between layers -1 and -52 (_adjustable between 0-63_)
average default spawn rate is 1 vein (_up to 8 ore which can be adjusted between the minimum and maximum ore spawns 1-8_) every 3 chunks. Something about the ancient cities promote the ores development, resulting in 1 vein every 2 chunks around the Deep Dark Biomes. Majority of ores by default spawn with at least 1 ore facing air (_70% default - configurable 0-100% with an option to spawn facing blocks, increasing difficulty in finding them_), combined with the energy of the orb inside the ore causes the ore block to give off a feint glow (_configurable 0-15, 3 by default_) - making these rare ores somewhat easier to find, though when an adventurer does come across one - they must make sure they have the proper equipment to mine it, something as hard as diamond (_configurable_) is likely going to be required to separate the deepslate from the pure Arken inside. The ancient power of the Arken Orb that lies within seems to be somewhat dampening of fortune also, which while it won't reject fortune pickaxes completely - their functionality is cut in half when mining the ore (_configurable 0.0-1.0, default is half effectiveness which is 0.5_).

**1x New item - Arken Orb**
Drops from the Deepslate Arken Ore, this powerful orb thrums with near infinite potential. On right click, it morphs into nearly any item in the base game OR from any mod (_blacklist by default, white list is optional_).

**1x New block - Arken Block**
Created by 9x Arken Orbs in a crafting table, the Arken Block has some very unique behaviour. Firstly, the power from each individual Orb bound together in this block causes the block to emit a strong light (_configurable 0-15, 15 by default_), while also providing power not disimilar to a redstone block (_configurable_ true by default_). Interestingly, if a direct strong redstone signal is received to the block (_not by dust, but by a lever, repeater or similar_) the block will respond as if it's light and redstoned power is being suppressed for the duration of exposure - resulting in the light being cut out along with it's ability to project redstone power (_redstone block suppression and light suppression are both controlled by the same config setting DirectSignalSuppressesBlock_), true by default_). On redstone, the block itself has some strange behavior in that any redstone signal applied to the block itself cannot pass through, meaning that an active lever on the block will not power redstone next to the Arken blocl itself until the redstone signal is turned off from the lever, thereby allowing the blocks redstone behavior to resume. This block can also be used as a Beacon block that also required diamond at the very least to successfully mine it, for the adventurer that has absolutely no time at all and wants to gather up enough to do such a thing while looking at their friends with a _Smaug_ look on their face.

Housekeeping; the mod itself has been designed with a pretty robust config file included which users can adjust according to their needs for things like increasing the spawn of ores, e.g;
#~1 extra vein every N chunks (overworld). 1 = always. (Default)
	#Range: 1 ~ 1024
	rarityOneIn = 3
    this means that 1 vein will spawn in the overworld for every 3 chunks
    while
    	#Base number of veins per chunk (overworld). 0 = none. (Default)
	#Range: 0 ~ 1000
	countPerChunk = 0
    this means that extra veins will be added on top of the default chunk - for users who feel that the current amount is not enough spawn.

    Developers note; I made this mod for my own playthrough and to fill a gap I saw in redstone mechanics and lootboxes, the odds of this being updated are highly unlikely - however if you are a developer yourself and want to port this forwards, just reach out to me in the comments and we can go from there! Otherwise no amount of requests to update this mod or downgrade this mod will be taken onboard - I have too much going on to warrant it currently.

    Warning - adjusting this spawn quantity can become pretty OP since without any blacklist adjustments you have the ability to get modded endgame items pretty early on if you're lucky - so balance to your own preferences, the defaults have been set as such that I believe a good balance has been struck but you be your own judge.

title: Minechat
description: Minecraft chat plugin with ranks, friends, groups, MongoDB logging, and a real-time web interface (REST + WebSocket).
body:
# Minechat

Minechat brings modern, real‑time chat to your Minecraft server with a Minecraft‑themed web interface, REST API, and WebSocket gateway. Players can chat from the browser or in‑game, send offline DMs, manage friends and groups, and see ranks and online status—everything stays in sync.

## Note
  - You can get the web interface from the minechat repository inside the /web folder 
  - [https://github.com/HarshitKumar9030/minechat/web](https://github.com/HarshitKumar9030/minechat/tree/master/web)
## Features

- Real‑time chat
  - WebSocket live updates between web and in‑game
  - Group chat with announcements and basic moderation
  - Offline‑friendly DMs (web↔web and web↔MC; messages persist)
- Friends and groups
  - Friend list, requests, and removal
  - Create/join/leave groups, invite flow with membership checks
  - Group roles (owner/admin/member) and member counts
- Ranks and presence
  - Renders Minecraft "§" color/style codes on web
  - Online/offline indicators and member lists
- Web API + WebSocket
  - REST for authentication, lists, history
  - WebSocket for live events and sending messages
  - CORS enabled for development
- Production‑ready
  - Error handling, session tokens, rate limiting basics
  - Nginx reverse proxy examples and HTTPS guidance
  - Works great alongside Vault/LuckPerms/PowerRanks (optional for rank data)

## Quick Start

1) Install
- Drop the plugin jar into your server’s plugins folder.
- Start the server once to generate configs.

2) Configure
- In `config.yml`:
```yaml
web:
  enable-api: true
  port: 8080          # HTTP REST API
  websocket-port: 8081 # WebSocket (real-time)
```

3) Enable web access
- In-game, each player runs:
```
/friend webaccess enable <password>
```

4) Connect from the web
- REST API: http://localhost:8080/api/
- WebSocket: ws://localhost:8081/ws

## Web API (highlights)

- POST `/api/auth` — authenticate with username + web password
- GET `/api/friends?playerUUID={uuid}`
- GET `/api/groups?playerUUID={uuid}`
- GET `/api/messages?groupId={uuid}&limit=50`
- GET `/api/users`, GET `/api/ranks`
- Group invites: GET `/api/group-invites`, POST accept/reject

Example login request:
```json
POST /api/auth
{ "username": "Player", "password": "web_password" }
```

## WebSocket (highlights)

- Connect: `ws://localhost:8081/ws`
- Authenticate:
```json
{ "type": "auth", "data": { "username": "Player", "password": "web_password" } }
```
- Send:
  - Friend: `type: "friend_message"`
  - Group: `type: "group_message"`
- Receive:
  - `friend_message`, `group_message`, `message_sent`, `error`, etc.

## Commands (selection)

- Web access
  - `/friend webaccess enable <password>`
  - `/friend webaccess disable`
- Groups (examples)
  - `/group create <name> [description]`
  - `/group join <name>`
  - `/group leave <name>`
  - `/group invite <name> <player>`
  - `/group accept <name>` | `/group deny <name>`
  - `/group chat <name> <message>`

Note: Admin/owner actions and settings are enforced server‑side.

## Compatibility

- Server: Paper/Spigot/Purpur (Paper recommended)
- Java: 17+
- MC versions: 1.20.x–1.21.x (adjust as needed for your environment)
- Optional: Vault/LuckPerms/PowerRanks for richer rank display

## Security Notes

- Players control web access via an in‑game password.
- Session tokens and basic rate limiting included.
- Supports reverse proxy + HTTPS (see Nginx examples).
- Input is sanitized on the web UI; still validate on integrations.

## Links

- Source: https://github.com/HarshitKumar9030/minechat
- Issues: https://github.com/HarshitKumar9030/minechat/issues
- License: MIT

title: Data Tables
description: A lightweight mod for Fabric which adds data tables: data-driven key-value pairs which can be used by modders or data pack creators!
body:
# Data Tables

Adds a new data pack resource known as **data tables**, which allow you to map identifiers (like item, block, or entity type IDs) to different integer values. These data tables are accessible to both modders and data pack creators who can use them to implement a wide variety of data-driven features.

## Features

* Server-side, with optional syncing to client if the client also has the mod
* Supports tags, not just individual IDs!
* Refreshes on `/reload` like other data pack resources
* Supports modded items
* Query data tables using the `/table` command, or a simple API for modders! 
* Supports datagen! No need for modders to write data tables by hand.

See the [README](https://github.com/Drakonkinst/DataTables/blob/main/README.md) for more info!

## Example Data Table

Data tables are extremely simple to write and use.

```json
{
  "type": "block",
  "default": 0,
  "entries": {
    "#my_data_pack:gem_blocks": 3,
    "minecraft:emerald_block": 5,
    "minecraft:diamond_block": 5,
    "minecraft:diamond_ore": 4
  }
}
```

Pixel Creature is a Neoforge mod that adds two new hostile mobs to Minecraft. These creatures attack in a special way, instead of just running straight toward the player like most monsters, they move around the player in circles. title: PostSpawner
description: A lightweight Minecraft plugin for managing Monster Spawner
body:
[简体中文](https://github.com/postyizhan/PostSpawner/blob/main/README.md) | English

# PostSpawner

![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/postyizhan/PostSpawner?color=blue&label=Version)
![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.13+-green)
![Language](https://img.shields.io/badge/Language-简体中文|English-orange)

PostSpawner is a lightweight Minecraft plugin for managing monster spawners, providing control over spawner mining and placement.

## 📚 Features

- ✅ **Spawner Management**: Supports silk touch and normal tool mining of spawners
- ✅ **Multi-language Support**: Built-in Chinese and English language files, easily extendable
- ✅ **Rich Action System**: Supports various actions like command execution, item drops, sound effects, etc.
- ✅ **Hook System**: Compatible with PlaceholderAPI, ItemsAdder, MythicMobs, NeigeItems, Oraxen and more
- ✅ **Flexible Configuration**: Fully customizable config and message system
- ✅ **Update Check**: Optional update checking feature

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/981563d6112dd0fd8a6ff2013ce5d1f1fe241576.png)
![2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bcbc3f9287a4a28717b5a6cc86811de2d39a5f7c.png)

## 💻 Installation

1. Download the latest PostSpawner.jar
2. Place the plugin in your server's plugins folder
3. Start/Restart the server
4. Edit plugins/PostSpawner/config.yml for customization
5. Use `/ps reload` to reload plugin configuration

## 🔧 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/ps reload` | Reload plugin config and language files | `postspawner.command.reload` |
| `/ps version` | Show version information | `postspawner.command.version` |
| `/ps help` | Show help information | `postspawner.command.help` |
| `/ps update` | Check for updates | `postspawner.command.update` |

## 🔒 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `postspawner.use.place` | Place spawners | All players |
| `postspawner.use.break` | Break spawners | All players |
| `postspawner.command.reload` | Reload command | OP |
| `postspawner.command.version` | Version command | All players |
| `postspawner.command.help` | Help command | All players |
| `postspawner.command.update` | Update command | OP |
| `postspawner.admin` | Includes all permissions | OP |

## 🛠️ Actions

PostSpawner provides a rich action system. Use the following action formats in config:

Format: `[]` for required parameters, `()` for optional parameters

| Action Syntax | Description | Example |
|---------------|-------------|---------|
| `[command] [command]` | Make player execute command | `[command] spawn` |
| `[op] [command]` | Temporarily give player OP to execute command | `[op] gamemode creative` |
| `[console] [command]` | Execute command from console | `[console] broadcast Someone mined a spawner!` |
| `[sound] [sound] (volume) (pitch)` | Play sound for player | `[sound] BLOCK_ANVIL_LAND 1.0 1.5` |
| `[message] [text]` | Send message to player | `[message] &aYou successfully mined a spawner!` |
| `[title] [title] (subtitle)` | Show title to player | `[title] &aMining Success &7Got a spawner` |
| `[drop_monster_spawner]` | Drop the broken spawner | `[drop_monster_spawner]` |
| `[drop] [itemID] (amount)` | Drop item at location | `[drop] DIAMOND 5` |
| `[give] [itemID] (amount)` | Give item to player | `[give] DIAMOND_SWORD 1` |
| `[buff] [potion] (duration) (level)` | Give player potion effect | `[buff] SPEED 30 2` |
| `[money] [action] [amount]` | Control player economy | `[money] give 100`, `[money] take 200`, `[money] set 50` |
| `[points] [action] [amount]` | Control player points | `[points] give 100`, `[points] take 200`, `[points] set 50` |

Note: Breaking spawners in creative mode won't trigger any actions.

## 📦 Item Library Support

When using `[drop]` and `[give]` actions, the following item libraries are supported:

| Library | Format | Example |
|---------|--------|---------|
| Minecraft | `minecraft:itemID [amount]` | `minecraft:diamond_sword`, `diamond:5` |
| ItemsAdder | `itemsadder:itemID [amount]` | `itemsadder:ruby_sword` |
| MMOItems | `mmoitems:type:ID [amount]` | `mmoitems:SWORD:EXCALIBUR` |
| NeigeItems | `neigeitems:itemID [amount]` | `neigeitems:test_item` |
| Oraxen | `oraxen:itemID [amount]` | `oraxen:amethyst_helmet` |
| MythicMobs | `mythicmobs:itemID [amount]` | `mythicmobs:special_bow` |
| SX-Item | `sxitem:itemID [arg1:arg2...] [amount]` | `sxitem:magic_wand:arg1:arg2` |
| Zaphkiel | `zaphkiel:itemID [amount]` | `zaphkiel:legendary_axe` |
| CraftEngine | `craftengine:itemID [amount]` | `craftengine:magic_staff` |
| AzureFlow | `azureflow:itemID [amount]` | `azureflow:wizard_robe` |

Simplified formats:
- Default source is minecraft (can be omitted), e.g. `diamond:5` equals `minecraft:diamond:5`
- If amount is 1, can be omitted, e.g. `itemsadder:ruby_sword` equals `itemsadder:ruby_sword 1`

### 📊 Variables

You can use these built-in variables in actions:

- `%player%` - Player name
- `%block_x%` - Block X coordinate
- `%block_y%` - Block Y coordinate
- `%block_z%` - Block Z coordinate
- `%block_world%` - Block world
- `%entity_type%` - Entity type

Additionally, if PlaceholderAPI is installed, you can use PlaceholderAPI variables.

title: Oops all Beds
description: Everything is a bed now :)
body:
You thought you were placing a furnace? **WRONG**. It’s a bed now.

Welcome to Oops All Beds — the mod that turns your beautiful Minecraft world into a surreal nightmare of cozy slumber. Any block you try to place may instead become a bed. A randomly colored one. And yes, it’s a full bed. Foot and head. No half measures here.

This mod is a fever dream brought to life. A comedy of errors in quilted form. A woolen virus for the world.

## **Features**

- Replaces placed blocks with a random bed. Seriously. You place dirt— you get a pink bed. Why? Because I said so 
- Blocks in the way? Obliterated. If another block dares to stand where the bed will go, it gets deleted without mercy. Not dropped. Not replaced. Just gone. 
- EVERYTHING is optional. What block gets placed/replaced? What direction the beds get placed. If you ask for more stuff, I'll add it if I find it funny enough.

## **Configuration**

**Whitelist mode**

_"whitelist": false_ 
If set to true only blocks listed in "whitelistBlocks" **WILL** be replaced.

If false then blocks listed in "blacklistBlocks" **WILL NOT** be replaced.

**Beds mode**

_"useBeds": true_

If set to false you can use the _"bedReplacements"_ list to add Custom blocks.

**Facing based Rotation**

_"placeBedFacingPlayer": false_

If set to false it will place the beds in Random rotations.

## 🌌 What is ArcaneMobs?

**ArcaneMobs** transforms your Minecraft server into a rich, RPG-like experience with dynamic scaling mobs, player leveling, a robust questing system, and a custom economy. Whether you're hunting elite creatures or climbing the skill tree, there's always something to strive for.

### I. RPG-Style Player Progression & Skill System
- Players gain XP by defeating ArcaneMobs and completing quests.

- Allocate **skill points** to boost damage, defense, and max HP.

body:
Broken Bows(The MOD) is a unique mod for Java Minecraft 1.19.2 (Forge) that introduces a realistic bow degradation and repair system. It adds three broken variants: Bow with Broken String, Bow with Broken Stick, and Fully Broken Bow, which cannot be used normally but can be restored via crafting.

Key Features:
Dynamic Breaking System

When a normal bow’s durability depletes, it has a 60% chance to break (20% string, 20% stick, 20% both) or 40% chance to vanish.

Holding a drawn bow for over 6 seconds may damage it (47% string, 47% stick, 6% both), with arrows flying only 2 to 4 blocks.

Repair Mechanics (shapeless):

Broken String Bow + String → Normal Bow

Broken Stick Bow + Stick → Normal Bow

Fully Broken Bow + String + Stick → Normal Bow

Immersive Details:

Broken bows cannot be drawn and play a "snap" sound when clicked.

All variants are grouped under a Creative Mode tab named "Bow Workshop"

title: FrpPlugin - Minecraft服务器内网穿透插件
description: FrpPlugin is a Bukkit plugin for Minecraft servers that facilitates intranet penetration by integrating with the frp client. This plugin offers features such as automatic downloads and updates of the frpc client, mirror acceleration for faster downloads, s
body:
# FrpPlugin - Minecraft Server Intranet Penetration Plugin

## Introduction

FrpPlugin is a Bukkit plugin for Minecraft servers that integrates with the [frp](https://github.com/fatedier/frp) client, enabling server administrators to easily implement intranet penetration functionality, allowing players to connect to your Minecraft server from the extranet.

## Features

- **Automatic downloads and updates**: Automatically downloads the latest version of the frpc client from GitHub for Windows, Linux and Mac.
- **Mirror Acceleration**: Built-in domestic mirror source to solve the problem of slow download speed of GitHub.
- **Simple Configuration**: Set frpc parameters through a simple configuration file.
- **Command Control**: Provides a complete command system to start, stop and restart frpc in-game.
- **Status Monitoring**: Monitor the status of frpc in real time.
- **Autostart**: start frpc service automatically when the server starts.

## Installation

1. download the latest version of FrpPlugin.jar file
2. Place the JAR file in the server's plugins directory.
3. Restart the server or use the plugin manager to load the plugin.

## Configuration instructions

### Plugin configuration (config.yml)

```yaml
## Whether to automatically start frpc when the server starts up
auto_start: true

# Whether or not to display detailed logging of frpc in the console.
verbose_logging: true

# Download settings
download.
  # Whether to check for updates on startup
  check_update: false
  # Download timeout (seconds)
  timeout: 30
```

### frpc configuration (frpc.toml)

```toml
# frpc.toml - frp client configuration file

serverAddr = “” # frp server address
serverPort = # frp server port
token = “” # Authentication token

[[proxies]]
name = “” # proxy name
type = “tcp” # proxy type
localIP = “127.0.0.1” # Local IP
localPort = 25565 # Minecraft server port
remotePort = # remote port
```

## Usage

### List of commands

- `/frp start` - Starts the frpc client.
- `/frp stop` - stops the frpc client
- `/frp restart` - Restarts the frpc client.
- `/frp status` - Checks the status of frpc.
- `/frp config` - Reloads the configuration file.

### Privilege nodes

- `/frpplugin.admin` - Allow use of all FrpPlugin commands (owned by default OP)

### Configuration example

### Use public frp server

``toml
serverAddr = “frp.example.com” # Replace with public frp server address
serverPort = 7000
token = “your_token” # if needed

[[proxies]]
name = “minecraft-server”
type = “tcp”
localIP = “127.0.0.1”
localPort = 25565 # your Minecraft server port
remotePort = 12345 # The remote port assigned to you

## Burlan Noteblocks (Feel Free to Dm me (kane44hd on discord) if you have play types i can add :3)

## Overview
Burlan Noteblocks is a Minecraft plugin that allows players to select, save, and play sequences of note blocks. Players can create musical sequences by selecting note blocks, saving those selections, and playing them back with adjustable intervals. The plugin supports both one-time playback and continuous looping of selections.

## Commands
1. /burlannoteblocks startselection: Starts the selection mode. Players can left-click note blocks to select them.

2. /burlannoteblocks stopselection <interval>: Stops the selection mode and sets the interval between note playback. The interval must be between 0.1 and 120 seconds.
3. /burlannoteblocks save <name>: Saves the current selection under the specified name. If no selections have been made, an error message will be displayed.
4. /burlannoteblocks play <name1> [name2 ...]: Plays the saved selections specified by name once.
5. /burlannoteblocks playrepeat <name1> [name2 ...]: Plays the saved selections repeatedly.
6. /burlannoteblocks playrepeatstop: Stops any currently repeating playback of selections.

## Data Storage
The plugin saves selections in the plugins/BurlanNoteblocks/ directory. Each selection is stored in a text file with the following format:

interval=<interval_time>

<world_name>,<x>,<y>,<z>

<world_name>,<x>,<y>,<z>

etc

title: FlagPointers
description: Converts Hypixel lobby compasses to flags based on selected languages
body:
**FlagPointers** transforms the compasses held by players in Hypixel lobbies into flags representing their chosen language on Hypixel.

## Language Support
FlagPointers supports these following mods:
- Korean
- English
- Russian
- German
- Spanish
- Greek
- French
- Swedish
- Dutch
- Czech
- Polish
- Romanian
- Finnish
- Brazilian Portuguese
- Norwegian
- Simplified Chinese
- Portuguese
- Hungarian
- Traditional Chinese
- Danish
- Japanese
- "Pirate Speak" _(Minecraft joke language)_
- Turkish
- Italian
- Ukrainian

## Use Cases
- Find Like-Minded Players: Easily connect with others who share your language for seamless gameplay.
- Discover Your Friends' Languages: Curious about the languages your Hypixel friends speak? Warp them into a lobby, and have them hold their compass to find out!

title: nazar's rainbow
description:
a self-assignable chat colours datapack for changing the colour code of your name in text using teams. doubles as a faction pack

(please wait for update)
body:
java 1.21 - 1.21.1, fabric, geyser

this datapack lets players self-assign chat name colours, and doubles as a faction datapack

use '/trigger n_colour_reset' to bring up the text prompt with clickable links.

use '/trigger n_select_(colour)' to manually choose a colour, especially if you're on bedrock.

use '/function nazars_rainbow:guildyes' and '/function nazars_rainbow:guildno' to turn friendlyfire off and on respectively.

use '/function nazars_rainbow:uninstall' to delete the teams and scoreboards.
uncomment a line in colour_prompt to enable those apples again.

title: The Bore
description: Adds Bores to the game amongst other boring things
body:
We have the Blaze and the Breeze, now the Bore.
Conecpt by u/Starninja999 on Reddit [[Direct Link](https://www.reddit.com/r/PhoenixSC/comments/1d8hyms/comment/l77qx1t/?context=3)]

Things in the mod:
- "Bore" mob. Has the AI of a Blaze. Hostile, deals 8 damage per hit and drops boron rods. Spawns in Nether Wastes and Badlands
- "Boron Rod" item, can be crafted into Boron Dust with a crafting table. Edible but I advise against it
- "Boron Dust" item used to make Boring Potions and Arrows
- "Boring Potion" effects you with Bored and lasts 15 mins. Traps you until you die from boredom or you remove the effect with a milk bucket (Stand in the centre to remove it correctly)
- "Boing Stand" uses stacks of clay and turns it into Bore spawn eggs (will probably be chaned in the future)

title: Unholy Mobs
description: Randomly empowers hostile mobs with powerful variant types when they spawn, making them significantly tougher.
body:
Unholy Mobs randomly empowers spawning hostile mobs with powerful variant types, making them significantly tougher. *** ## The mod currently introduces four variants of special mobs: | Variant |Default spawn chance | | ------- |-------------------- | | Insane |~1% | | Extreme |~0.2% | | Grandpa |~0.04% | | Silent |~0.008% | 1. Each higher tier includes all strengths of the previous ones and adds more on top. Power grows roughly exponentially between tiers. 2. Empowered mobs gain an particle aura effect and prefix to its name. Making them distinguishable from normal ones. *** ## Enhanced mobs receive: * Increased **health**, **damage**, and **movement speed** * **Regeneration**, **resistance** and **knockback resistance** * **On-hit debuffs** applied to the player, such as Slowness, Weakness, Poison, Blindness, Wither or Nausea * Special behaviour for the strongest variants, like teleportation, periods of invisibility or sound reduction *** ## Improved loot for defeating Unholy mobs: * Significantly more experience * Extra items (ores, resources, rare materials) * Enchanted books with low to high-level enchantments * Special Variant Cores *** ## Unholy Mob Variants Modifiers: Attributes: | Variant |Health |Damage |Speed |Knockback Resistance |Armor and Armor Toughness | | ------- |------ |------ |----- |-------------------- |------------------------- | | Insane |2x |2x |1.3x |+0.25 |+4 | | Extreme |4x |3x |1.6x |+0.5 |+8 | | Grandpa |8x |4x |2x |+0.75 |+12 | | Silent |16x |6x |2.5x |+1 |+16 |   Levels of Pernament Effects: | Variant |Resistance |Regeneration |Fire Resistance |Water Breathing |Dolphins Grace | | ------- |---------- |------------ |--------------- |--------------- |-------------- | | Insane |1 |2 |1 |1 |2 | | Extreme |2 |3 |1 |1 |2 | | Grandpa |3 |4 |1 |1 |2 | | Silent |4 |5 |1 |1 |2 | *** ## Random events:

Silent Night:

At the begining of night when the moon rises (12990 - 13000 in-game time), there is a chance (~0,1% default) for the night to be "Silent" - if this happens, spawn rates of the silent mob variant are increased 400x times, event ends with the sunrise (22990 - 23000 in-game time).

Unholy Night:

At the begining of night when the moon rises (12990 - 13000 in-game time), there is a chance (~1% default) for the night to be "Unholy" - if this happens, spawn rates for unholy mobs are increased 10x times for each variant, event ends with the sunrise (22990 - 23000 in-game time).

  *** ## Configuration & Commands: Unholy Mobs allows you to adjust Unholy Mobs spawn rates and chances for random events: Using "**/unholy\_spawn\_chance**" command you can **set**/**_get_**/**multiply** the spawn chances of each variant: * /unholy_spawn_chance <variant> set <percent> percent - _sets the spawn chance to provided percentage._ * /unholy_spawn_chance <variant> multiply_times <multiplier>  \- _multiplies current spawn chance for variant._ * /unholy_spawn_chance <variant> get - _shows you current spawn chance of variant._ **E.g.:** * /unholy\_spawn\_chance Insane set 4 percent * /unholy\_spawn\_chance Extreme multiply\_times 6 * /unholy\_spawn\_chance Silent get Similarly using "**/unholy\_event\_chance**" command you can **set**/**_get_**/**multiply** the chance for specific event:  

Note that lower variants take priority when spawning. This means that if the chances are set to 100% for both Insane and Extreme, the mob will attempt to become Insane first, in this case causing its variant to always be set to Insane.

*** ## Items & Recipes:

Variant Cores and Swords:

  • - Insane Core, Netherite Insanity Breaker
  • - Extreme Core, Netherite Extremeness Blade
  • - Grandpa Core, Netherite Elder Madness
  • - Silent Core, Netherite Hushed Blade

Sword and Core Recipes:

*** "Unholy Mobs" is intended for players who want standard Minecraft combat to be more challenging and less predictable, especially in hardcore or harder difficulty settings.

title: Mobs can think
description: This mod upgrades mobs' brains, making them really smart!
body:
This mod makes so that mobs are now smarter, adding new functions to their brains, here's a list of all the current features:
- Mobs flee from nearby running players.
- Skeletons have a 50% chance of switching their weapons to swords if a player is too close.
- Mobs taller than 2 blocks now run away if their target is camping under a tiny space.
- Mobs can now see behind glass, fences, gates and iron bars.
- Mobs that are currently burning in the sun will seek nearby dark spots.
- If a sun-sensitive mob targets someone out in the open, it will wait in the shade until the target steps into a dark spot.
- Mobs stay far from you if you build a pillar too high for them to reach.
- Mobs call for help if hurt in a radius of 64 blocks.
- Spiders can throw webs that give Slowness 1 for 2 seconds.
- Creepers assume your position and explode after hiding behind a wall.
- Baby zombies launch towards you if they were riding a chicken

Embark on an unforgettable adventure across a world shaped by towering mountains, ancient kingdoms, forgotten ruins, and dangerous dungeons. Travel across a completely overhauled world featuring breathtaking landscapes, diverse biomes, massive mountain ranges, dense forests, and realistic terrain generation. Every region feels unique, rewarding exploration with new structures, resources, and adventures.

- 🌳 Natural environmental improvements with **Geophilic**
- 🏞️ Enhanced rivers, forests, caves, and landscapes

The world is filled with abandoned kingdoms, ancient ruins, villages, castles, towers, temples, and countless handcrafted structures waiting to be explored.

Every expedition rewards curiosity.

Adventure includes:

- **GPU:** NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB VRAM) or equivalent

title: pv-LazoDiscs
description: Server-side custom music discs using Plasmo Voice positional audio.
body:
# LazoDiscs

**LazoDiscs** is a server-side NeoForge mod that lets players burn custom audio links onto vanilla Minecraft music discs and play them through **Plasmo Voice** positional audio.

The mod itself is designed to run on the **server only**.
Players do **not** need LazoDiscs on the client, but they still need **Plasmo Voice** installed to hear the audio.

## Features

* Burn custom audio links onto vanilla music discs
* Play custom discs through **Plasmo Voice** positional audio
* Separate Plasmo Voice source line for disc volume control
* Search for songs from in-game chat
* Clickable chat search results
* Search page switching with chat arrows
* Direct MP3 link support
* YouTube / YouTube Music support
* SoundCloud support
* Spotify links supported through metadata/search matching
* Sable / Create Aeronautics moving platform position support
* No external programs required: no yt-dlp, no spotDL, no ffmpeg

## Commands

```mcfunction
/lazodiscs burn <url> [title]
/lazodiscs clear
/lazodiscs search "<song name>"
```

## How to use

Hold a vanilla music disc in your main hand and run:

```mcfunction
/lazodiscs burn "https://example.com/song.mp3" My Song
```

Then put the disc into a jukebox.

The audio will play through **Plasmo Voice**, so nearby players hear it as positional audio.

## Song search

You can search for songs directly from chat:

```mcfunction
/lazodiscs search "song name"
```

Search results appear in chat.
Click a song title to automatically fill the burn command.

Search pages can be switched using chat arrows:

```text
◀  Page 1/4  ▶
```

## Spotify note

Spotify links are not played directly, because normal Spotify track links do not provide direct audio streams.

LazoDiscs reads Spotify metadata when possible and then searches for a matching track through YouTube Music.

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* NeoForge
* Plasmo Voice

Plasmo Voice links:

* Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/plugin/plasmo-voice
* GitHub: https://github.com/plasmoapp/plasmo-voice
* CurseForge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/plasmo-voice

## Environment

* Server: Required
* Client: Not required
* Client still needs Plasmo Voice to hear audio

## Compatibility

Made for:

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* NeoForge
* Plasmo Voice
* Sable / Create Aeronautics physics assemblies

## Credits

Made by **EyeCrasher**.

This project uses **Plasmo Voice** for positional audio playback.

LazoDiscs is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Plasmo Voice developers.

title: Fronsky Vanish
description: Become truly invisible in Minecraft. Zero traces. Full control.
body:
# 👻 Fronsky Vanish

A modern, high-performance vanish plugin for Paper and Spigot servers (Minecraft 1.20+). Become truly invisible: no join messages, no quit messages, no mob aggro, no sound, no traces.

[Website](https://fronsky.nl/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/fronsky-development/vanish) · [API Docs](https://github.com/fronsky-development/vanish/blob/main/API.md) · [Support](mailto:support@fronsky.nl)

---

## Overview

Fronsky Vanish is designed for staff, moderators, and server admins who need reliable, trace-free invisibility with full control over every aspect of vanished behavior. One command, complete invisibility, and a clean API for third-party integration.

Built for moderation, cheater detection, world exploration, content creation, and any situation where staff need to operate without being seen.

## Features

- **True invisibility**: no join or quit messages, no particles, no detectable traces
- **Silent containers**: open chests, ender chests, shulker boxes, and barrels without sound or animation (via ProtocolLib)
- **Boss bar indicator**: a persistent, customizable boss bar shows when you are vanished
- **Per-player preferences**: each staff member toggles their own sound and silent-join settings
- **Customizable accent color**: set the plugin's color used in boss bars and chat
- **Granular permissions**: 18 permission nodes for fine-grained control
- **Interactive GUI**: manage vanished players through a clean player-head inventory
- **Developer API**: public API for plugins to integrate with vanish state
- **Live reload**: `/vanish reload` applies changes without a restart
- **Fully configurable**: every disabled action and message is editable

## Disabled Actions

All of the following can be individually toggled in `config.yml`.

| Action | Description |
| ------ | ----------- |
| Damage | Vanished players cannot take damage |
| Hunger | Food level stays frozen |
| Mob targeting | Mobs ignore vanished players |
| Silent chests | Open chests without sound or animation |
| Silent ender chests | Same silent behavior for ender chests |
| Silent shulker boxes and barrels | Silent opening for all container types |
| Pressure plates | Vanished players do not trigger pressure plates |
| Death messages | Death messages are hidden from public chat |
| Player push | Disable collision so vanished players cannot be pushed |
| Item pickup | Prevent vanished players from picking up items |

## Integrations

All integrations are optional: the plugin works without them, but unlocks extra features when present.

| Plugin | Integration |
| ------ | ----------- |
| [ProtocolLib](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/protocollib.1997/) | Packet-level player hiding, accurate server list player count, silent container opening. Recommended. |
| [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/) | 7 placeholders for scoreboards, tab lists, chat formats, and more |
| [Dynmap](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/dynmap.274/) | Automatically hides vanished players from the web map |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| ------- | ----------- |
| `/vanish` (alias `/v`) | Toggle vanish for yourself |
| `/vanish <player>` | Toggle vanish for another player |
| `/vanish gui` | Open the vanish player GUI |
| `/vanish list` | List all currently vanished players |
| `/vanish tp <player>` | Teleport to a player while vanished |
| `/vanish join` | Send a fake join message |
| `/vanish quit` | Send a fake quit message |
| `/vanish sound` | Toggle your vanish sound effect |
| `/vanish silent` | Toggle silent join mode |
| `/vanish color` | Change the plugin accent color |
| `/vanish reload` | Reload configuration files |
| `/vanish info` | Show plugin info and build metadata |
| `/vanish help` | Show the help overview |
| `/vanish permissions` | Show all permission nodes |
| `/vanish placeholders` | Show available PlaceholderAPI placeholders |

## Permissions

All permissions default to OP only unless noted otherwise.

### Core

| Permission | Description |
| ---------- | ----------- |
| `vanish.*` | Full access to all Vanish features |
| `vanish.see` | See vanished players |
| `vanish.join` | Auto-vanish on join (silent join) |

### Per Command

| Permission | Command |
| ---------- | ------- |
| `vanish.cmd.vanish` | `/vanish` |
| `vanish.cmd.vanish.others` | `/vanish <player>` |
| `vanish.cmd.vanish.gui` | `/vanish gui` |

## PlaceholderAPI Placeholders

Requires [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/).

| Placeholder | Output | Example |
| ----------- | ------ | ------- |
| `%vanish_isvanished%` | Whether the player is vanished | `true` / `false` |
| `%vanish_status%` | Vanish status as text | `Vanished` / `Visible` |
| `%vanish_count%` | Number of currently vanished players | `3` |
| `%vanish_cansee%` | Whether the player can see vanished players | `true` / `false` |
| `%vanish_total_online%` | Online player count minus vanished players | `42` |
| `%vanish_color%` | Current plugin accent color | `BLUE` |
| `%vanish_silent%` | Whether the player has silent join enabled | `true` / `false` |

## Configuration

### config.yml

```yaml
# Enable debug logging for troubleshooting
debug-mode: false

# Vanish sound settings
sound-enable: true
sound: 'AMBIENT_CAVE'

# Toggle individual actions while vanished
disabled-actions:
  damage: true
  hunger: true
  mob-target: true
  silent-chest: true
  silent-ender-chest: true
  pressure-plates: true
  death-messages: true
  player-push: true
  pickup-items: true

# Plugin accent color (used in boss bar and messages)
plugin-color: 'BLUE'
```

### messages.yml

Every player-facing message is fully customizable, from vanish notifications to permission headers. Supports color codes with `§`.

## Developer API

Fronsky Vanish provides a public API so other plugins can interact with vanish state programmatically.

```java
import nl.fronsky.vanish.api.VanishAPI;

// Check if Vanish is available
if (VanishAPI.isAvailable()) {

    // Check if a player is vanished
    boolean vanished = VanishAPI.isVanished(player);

    // Toggle vanish state
    VanishAPI.toggleVanish(player);

    // Get the vanished player count
    int count = VanishAPI.getVanishedPlayerCount();

    // Check if a player can see vanished players
    boolean canSee = VanishAPI.canSeeVanished(player);
}
```

Full documentation: [API Documentation on GitHub](https://github.com/fronsky-development/vanish/blob/main/API.md).

## Use Cases

| Use case | How Fronsky Vanish helps |
| -------- | ------------------------ |
| Staff moderation | Monitor players without them knowing staff is online |
| Cheater detection | Observe suspected cheaters invisibly in real time |
| Map exploration | Explore your world without mobs, damage, or hunger |
| Stealth gameplay | Build unique game modes or events with invisible players |
| Testing and development | Test server features without interference from players |
| Content creation | Record or stream without appearing on the server |

## Installation

1. Download the latest version from this page.
2. Place `Vanish-x.x.x.jar` in your server's `plugins/` folder.
3. _(Optional)_ Install [ProtocolLib](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/protocollib.1997/), [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/), and/or [Dynmap](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/dynmap.274/) for additional features.
4. Restart your server.
5. Configure `plugins/Vanish/config.yml` and `plugins/Vanish/messages.yml`.
6. Run `/vanish` to get started.

## Requirements

| Requirement | Version |
| ----------- | ------- |
| Minecraft | 1.20+ |
| Server software | Paper or Spigot |
| Java | 17 or higher |

# Introduction
This mod is a community version of Tiny Mob Farm. It is currently planned for versions 1.12.2 and 1.16.5, with the 1.12.2 version already completed.

## Changes
Compared to the original 1.12.2 version of Tiny Mob Farm, the following content has been added/changed:
* Added a Mechanical Mob Farm—allowing lassos to be piped in and out.
* Added a config toggle: when the container beneath the farm is full, it will stop working, halting durability consumption and preventing item drops.

# Overview
This mod adds several miniature mob farms and a lasso that can be used to capture mobs. 
It helps you automate the acquisition of hard-to-get materials, such as Wither Skeleton Skulls, Ghast Tears, and more.
Mob farms generate mob drops over time, with different tiers of farms operating at different speeds.
The Wooden Mob Farm is the slowest, followed by the Stone Mob Farm, while the Ender Mob Farm is the fastest.

title: The Umbral Eye / 虚空の蝕王オクルス
description:
A floating, void-themed endgame boss summoned by ritual. The Umbral Eye fights across three telegraphed phases — tuned so that even full netherite, a beacon, and golden apples make for only a knife's-edge win.

祭壇の儀式で召喚する浮遊ボス「虚空の蝕王オクルス」を追加。予兆付きの3段階で戦う
body:
> ▶ **Showcase / 制作・紹介動画:** https://youtu.be/KL-8WdwvcSg

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/KL-8WdwvcSg" title="The Umbral Eye" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# The Umbral Eye — 虚空の蝕王オクルス

A floating, void-themed boss for Minecraft **26.1.2** (Fabric), built around one idea: a **barely-winnable** endgame fight.

## ⚔️ The Fight
The Umbral Eye is **not** another humanoid mob — it's a levitating eldritch eye that circles you in the air and rains **telegraphed** attacks across **three escalating phases**. Every attack has a clear wind-up (particles + sound), so the fight is about **reading and dodging**, not tanking.

It's tuned so that even **full-enchanted netherite + a beacon + golden apples** is a knife's-edge victory. "Just swing and shoot" gets you killed — you'll need potions, positioning, and timing.

**Attack patterns**
- **Void Volley** – spread of homing void bolts (magic damage, ignores armor)
- **Umbral Lunge** – telegraphed dash with knockback
- **Shard Nova** – radial shockwave; back out of the ring
- **Umbral Wisps** – fast flying adds (phase 2+)
- **Eclipse Beam** – tracks, then locks; dodge sideways during the lock (phase 3)
- **Void Meteors** – marked ground impacts that force you to move (phase 3)
- Phase shifts apply **Wither / Hunger / Darkness** — pressure that bypasses armor and punishes passive play

## 🌑 Summoning (Survival)
1. **Craft the Umbral Catalyst** — the recipe unlocks the moment you obtain an Echo Shard, Eye of Ender, or Crying Obsidian:
```
E C E     E = Eye of Ender
C S C     C = Crying Obsidian
E C E     S = Echo Shard
```
2. **Build the altar** — a 3×3 with a **Sculk Catalyst** in the center, ringed by **8 Crying Obsidian**.
3. **Right-click the center** with the Catalyst, **at night under open sky**. The void tears open.

*(A creative-only spawn egg is also included.)*

## 🏆 Rewards
A curated drop table — Netherite Ingots, Diamonds, Enchanted Golden Apples, Echo Shards (to re-summon), and a guaranteed **Nether Star** — plus a big XP payout and a full advancement line from *Whispers of the Void* to the *Eclipse's End* challenge.

## ⚙️ Multiplayer & Config
- **Player scaling** — boss HP scales with nearby players (fair in groups; solo top-gear stays "barely winnable").
- `config/umbraleye.json` — HP multiplier, scaling, XP, boss music, ritual toggle.
- **Server-friendly: no block griefing.**

## 📋 Requirements
- Minecraft **26.1.2** · Fabric Loader 0.19.2+ · **Fabric API** · Java 25
- Required on **both client and server** (custom model + server-side AI)

🌐 **Languages:** English & 日本語 (auto by client language).

🎬 *Created & showcased in [this video](https://youtu.be/KL-8WdwvcSg).*
If you use this mod in a video or livestream, please credit this Modrinth page or the original video.
---

## 日本語

宙に浮く眼球状の高難度ボス「**虚空の蝕王オクルス**」を追加します（Minecraft 26.1.2 / Fabric）。コンセプトは一つ——**「ギリギリ勝てる」終盤ボス**。

人型ではない浮遊ボスが、空中から**予兆付きの攻撃を3段階**で繰り出します。各攻撃にパーティクルとSEの溜めがあるので、本質は**読んで回避**すること。**フルエンチャ・ネザライト＋ビーコン＋金リンゴでも薄氷の勝利**になるよう調整しており、素直に殴る／撃つだけでは倒せません。

**攻撃パターン**：虚空の弾幕（防具貫通）／影の突進／虚空衝撃波／ウィスプ召喚（P2〜）／蝕の光線（P3・横回避）／虚空隕石（P3）。フェーズ移行で**ウィザー・空腹・暗闇**を付与。

**召喚（サバイバル）**
1. 「**蝕みの瞳**」をクラフト（エコーシャード／エンダーアイ／泣く黒曜石のいずれか入手でレシピ解放）
```
E C E   E=エンダーアイ
C S C   C=泣く黒曜石
E C E   S=エコーシャード
```
2. **祭壇**＝中央：スカルクカタリスト／周囲8マス：泣く黒曜石
3. **夜・開けた空の下**で中央を触媒で右クリック

**報酬**：ネザライト・ダイヤ・エンチャ金リンゴ・エコーシャード・**ネザースター**＋大量XP、進捗4種。
**マルチ・設定**：人数でHPスケール、`config/umbraleye.json` で調整、ブロック破壊なし。

🎬 *このMODは[こちらの動画](https://youtu.be/KL-8WdwvcSg)で制作・紹介しています。*

title: TotemRefill
description: Automatically refills your offhand with a new Totem of Undying after one is used.
body:
TotemRefill is a simple client-side QoL mod that automatically places a new Totem of Undying into your offhand after your current one is used.

The mod is designed to stay out of your way. It does not put a totem in your offhand for no reason, and it will not fight against you when you manually remove one. If you take the totem out with F or move it from your inventory, TotemRefill leaves it alone. It only refills your offhand after a totem is actually used.

This makes it useful for PvP, crystal fights, hardcore worlds, survival challenges, and any situation where having another totem ready can save you. It is lightweight, automatic, and focused on doing one thing cleanly.

title: LG UHC
description: This plugin is an adaptation of the popular board game "Werewolf." It allows you to host your own games. However, it is currently in beta, meaning it is not yet fully developed. It will continue to evolve over time.
body:
# 🐺 LGUHC - Minecraft Werewolf UHC Plugin

**LGUHC** is a Werewolf UHC game plugin currently in **Beta**. It allows you to organize games combining survival, strategy, and hidden roles.

## 🚀 Main Features

The plugin includes several "Fast-UHC" mechanics to speed up the early game:
* **Timber / Fast Leaf Decay**: Trees break automatically for fast wood gathering.
* **Auto-Smelt**: Ores are automatically smelted when mined.
* **Auto-Enchant**: Tools are automatically enchanted to speed up preparation.
* **Meetup Mode**: Configurable option to enable "Meetup" mode (with pre-distributed gear).
* **Auto-Revive**: Automatic respawn system for any player dying before the official role announcement.
* **Dynamic Role Distribution**: Intelligent system ensuring balanced camps even with few players (2 players = 1 wolf + 1 village).
* **Vengeance System**: Players have a 15-second window to be revived by special roles before being permanently eliminated.

---

## 🛠️ Commands

### Administration & Management
* **/lgstart**: Starts the Werewolf UHC game.
* **/lgstop**: Stops the current game.
* **/lgconfig**: Opens the configuration management interface.
* **/lgworld**: Manage worlds dedicated to the LG game.
    * `create [--stop]`: Creates a new world.
    * `load`: Loads chunks around pre-generated spawn/respawn positions.
    * `prepare <spawns_per_map> <respawns_per_map> <nb_maps>`: Prepares safe coordinates.
    * `delete`: Deletes all worlds.
* **/lgspawn [all]**: Returns to the main spawn (world).

### Players
* **/lgrole**: Review your role description and allies.
* **/lginfo**: Alternative command for role info.
* **/lgvoyante <player>**: (Seer) See a player's role.
* **/lgrenard**: (Fox) Detect nearby wolves (3 charges).
* **/lggrimer [role]**: (Disguise Wolf) Change your appearance for the Seer.
* **/lgsacrifice [player]**: (White Wolf) Sacrifice a wolf to gain power.

---

## 🎭 Roles List

### 🌲 The Village
* **Simple Villager** 🧑: Basic member of the village.
* **Seer** 🔮: Can see a player's role every 10/20 minutes.
* **Fox** 🦊: Can detect if a werewolf is within 10 blocks (3 uses).
* **Little Girl** 👧: Can become invisible at night by removing armor (once per night, 10 min).
* **Hunter** 🏹: On final death, can curse an attacker to reduce their max health to 4 hearts.
* **Salvateur** 🛡️: Can protect a player each episode, giving them Resistance I.
* **Witch** 🧙: Possesses one revival potion to save a dying player.

### 🐺 The Werewolves
* **Werewolf** 🐾: Base wolf, gains Strength I at night.
* **Alpha Wolf** 🐺: Leader of the pack, gains extra raw damage at night.
* **Disguise Wolf** 🎭: Can disguise themselves as any village role to deceive the Seer.
* **Infectious Wolf (IPDL)** ☣️: Can infect a player dying to a wolf, turning them into a werewolf.
* **Treacherous Wolf** 👤: Can become invisible like the Little Girl but never gets Strength at night.

### 💜 Neutral / Solitaires
* **White Wolf** ❄️: Must be the last survivor. Can sacrifice other wolves to gain permanent health and strength.
* **Assassin** 🔪: Must kill everyone. Gains permanent Speed I and Strength I during the day.

---

## 🧪 Project Status (Beta)

This plugin is currently in **Beta**. It is expected to evolve regularly with new features and balancing.

---

## ⚙️ Installation

1. Drop the `LGUHC.jar` file into your `plugins` folder.
2. Restart your server (API Version 1.8+).
3. Configure your options via `/lgconfig`.
4. Setup your world with `/lgworld create` and then `/lgworld prepare`.

---
---

title: Unforgiving Skies
description: A heavy, atmosphere-driven weather survival modpack featuring dynamic seasons, severe localized storms, and harsh environmental temperature cycles.
body:
##### Unforgiving Skies overhauls the predictable weather patterns of vanilla Minecraft, turning the climate and atmosphere into an active element of your survival.

## What This Pack Adds
- Dynamic Weather Systems: Rain is replaced by moving pressure fronts. Light drizzles can naturally develop into heavy downpours, thick fog, or blinding blizzards depending on your current biome and elevation.

- Full Seasonal Cycles: The world constantly shifts through four distinct seasons. These cycles alter local temperatures, affect how fast your crops grow, and change animal behavior.

- Severe Storms and Tornadoes: High-pressure systems can trigger violent windstorms and localized tornadoes that are capable of ripping up unreinforced blocks, knocking down trees, and causing flash floods.

## Critical Information Before Downloading
- Shelter Mechanics: Standard wooden or open-air shelters will not survive this pack. Lightning routinely sparks massive wildfires, and wind storms will damage weak blocks. Upgrading to stone, reinforced materials, or building underground is highly recommended.

- Navigation Hazards: Severe weather events drastically reduce your render distance to near-zero visibility. Always carry a compass, maps, or directional markers when exploring, as it is incredibly easy to get permanently lost during a sudden blizzard or thick fog roll.

title: Planting Dispensers
description: Vanilla dispensers are now able to plant seeds, saplings, netherwart and more, including crops from any mod!
body:
# 🌱 Planting Dispensers
Bring organic, Vanilla+ automation to your farms! This lightweight mod upgrades the functionality of standard dispensers, allowing them to automatically plant seeds, crops, and saplings without the need for massive, complex redstone contraptions. 

## ✨ Features

Comprehensive Vanilla Support: Dispensers can now plant standard seeds, root vegetables, Nether Wart, Saplings, Sugar Cane, Cactus, Sweet Berries, and Bamboo! 


Smart Soil Detection: The mod utilizes Minecraft's native canSurvive() logic to check the soil before planting. This means seeds demand farmland, nether wart demands soul sand, and cactus demands sand—preventing players from illegally placing crops! 

Aesthetic Freedom: You don't have to awkwardly hover your dispensers above your farm. You can place the dispenser facing the empty air directly above the soil, OR embed it in the wall facing the soil block directly. 


Universal Mod Compatibility (Zero Config): Built with dynamic registry scanning, your dispensers will automatically know how to plant custom crops and saplings added by other mods (like Farmer's Delight) without you needing to change any configuration files! 

## ⚙️ Clean Architecture

No Mixins Needed: This mod hooks directly into Minecraft's native OptionalDispenseItemBehavior registry. By avoiding mixins, it ensures absolute compatibility with other mods that interact with dispensers. 

## 📦 Compatibility

Built natively for Minecraft version 26.1.2 with Java JDK 25. 

Tested and fully working on Minecraft 26.2.

Requires the Fabric API.

title: Tropical World
description: All-ocean overworld: a sunlit tropical sea of turquoise water and sandy islands with hidden oases. Built on Isekai API.
body:
**The overworld becomes a single sunlit tropical sea.** Turquoise water from horizon to horizon, scattered sand islets, and rare lush oases tucked among the islands. Powered by Isekai API.

## What it does

Tropical World turns the entire overworld into a warm, bright tropical ocean. Sea level rises and the surface reads as open turquoise water broken by sandy islands — a sunlit archipelago instead of continents. Vanilla biomes, ores, structures, and mobs still generate, so it plays like Minecraft, just at sea.

Hidden on the larger islands are **oases** — clear water pools ringed with grass, reeds, and clustered palms — placed as hand-authored set-pieces that only spawn on flat, dry ground (never half-sunk in the surf), via [Isekai API](https://modrinth.com/mod/isekai-api).

## Features

**All-ocean overworld** — turquoise tropical sea with sandy islets, not a continent in sight.

**Lush oases** — rare, coordinated water-and-palm set-pieces that sit cleanly on island interiors.

**Vanilla content preserved** — ores, structures, and mobs still generate; this is a reskin of where land is, not an empty water world.

## Requirements

**Isekai API is required** — Tropical World is a worldshape built entirely on Isekai's worldgen primitives.

## Compatibility

Coexists with TerraBlender, YUNG's structure mods, map mods (Journeymap etc.), and dimension mods. Mutually exclusive with other overworld-overhaul mods (Terralith, William Wythers') — only one mod can own the overworld; no crash, last-loaded wins.

## License & links

**Related projects**

- [Isekai API](https://modrinth.com/mod/isekai-api) — required worldgen framework these worlds are built on
- [Mountain World](https://modrinth.com/mod/mountain-world) — sister world: the overworld reforged as endless mountains
- [Sky World](https://modrinth.com/mod/sky-world) — sister world: the overworld as a vertical sea of floating islands
- [Tundra World](https://modrinth.com/mod/tundra-world) — sister world: the overworld frozen end to end

MIT. Source & issues: https://github.com/KURONAMI333/tropical-world

Built on [Isekai API](https://modrinth.com/mod/isekai-api).

title: SecureExplosion
description: Prevent some explosions from damaging blocks.
body:
# Secure Explosions
Secure Explosions gives you fine‑grained control over which explosions can destroy blocks or damage entities. Instead of a global on/off switch, you define rules based on what caused the explosion – for example, a creeper, TNT, or a fireball.

## What it does
Prevents specific explosions from destroying blocks and/or hurting entities

Clears the explosion’s affected block list, entity list, or both

Works with any explosion source that has a direct source entity (Creeper, TNT, Ghast fireball, etc.)

Also handles explosions without a direct source (e.g., commands) with a separate option

## Why you might want it
Stop creepers from wrecking your builds – let them deal damage to players but keep terrain intact

Protect mob farms – TNT minecarts no longer kill your precious loot carriers

Create custom game modes – only certain entities can destroy blocks

Fix griefing issues – on servers, prevent specific explosion types from ruining structures

## Default behavior
Default ensures that explosions no longer destroy terrain (blocks are removed from the destruction list), but they still damage and kill mobs/players – a common "grief protection" use case.

## How it works (critical info)
The mod doesn't disable explosions – it only removes blocks and entities from the explosion’s “to‑destroy” list.

You control everything through configuration files (.toml). Rules are based on regular expressions.

title: Bleach Captains in Cobblemon
description: Add Gotei 13 Captains from the famous anime Bleach into Cobblemon
body:
# Bleach Captains Cobblemon

Bring the power of the Soul Society into Cobblemon.

**Bleach Captains Cobblemon** is a fan-made Cobblemon addon that adds custom captain-inspired Pokémon based on the captains of Bleach, complete with custom species data, models, textures, animations, abilities, signature moves, action effects, spawn data, and Mega Showdown integration.

This pack is designed for players who want anime-style boss Pokémon, lore-inspired movesets, and powerful captain-themed battles inside Cobblemon.

![Gotei 13 meeting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eefeb202924670ddd3c8991ef64c212f91fd226a.png)

## Features

* 12 custom Bleach captain-inspired Cobblemon:

  * Aizen
  * Byakuya
  * Gin
  * Hitsugaya
  * Kenpachi
  * Komamura
  * Mayuri
  * Shunsui
  * Soi Fon
  * Tosen
  * Ukitake
  * Unohana

* Custom Bedrock-style Cobblemon models

* Custom textures and animated poses

* Custom battle animations and action effects

* Signature Zanpakutō-inspired moves

* Custom abilities based on each captain’s fighting style

* Spawn pool data for the custom captains

* Mega Showdown support for Bankai/Mega-style transformations

* Lore-inspired typing, stats, and mechanics

* Designed for Cobblemon 1.7.3

## Gameplay Style

Each captain is built to feel different in battle.

Some examples:

* **Aizen** uses illusion and hypnosis-based control.
* **Byakuya** fights with precise Senbonzakura blade pressure.
* **Gin** uses hidden poison and assassination-style attacks.
* **Hitsugaya** controls snow, ice, and freezing pressure.
* **Kenpachi** is a raw physical monster built around battle instinct.
* **Komamura** uses giant avatar-style physical power.
* **Mayuri** focuses on poison, nerve control, and cruel research.
* **Shunsui** fights through dangerous game-based rules.
* **Soi Fon** is a fast assassination-style attacker.
* **Tosen** uses blindness, sound, and sensory deprivation.
* **Ukitake** specializes in special-attack reflection and support.
* **Unohana** focuses on healing, pressure, and medical mastery.

This addon is not meant to be a normal vanilla-balanced Pokémon pack. The captains are intentionally powerful and are built more like boss-tier custom Pokémon.

## Requirements

This pack requires:

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* Fabric
* Cobblemon 1.7.3
* Mega Showdown

Some Bankai/Mega-style transformations require Mega Showdown compatibility. Make sure Mega Showdown is installed if you want the full battle mechanics to work correctly.

## Installation

This pack contains both datapack and resourcepack content.

For singleplayer/world installation:

1. Put the pack in your world’s `datapacks` folder.
2. Also enable the pack as a resource pack.
3. Make sure Cobblemon and Mega Showdown are installed.
4. Run `/reload` or restart the world.

title: NoSpread
description: Removes vanilla projectile spread randomness, making supported projectiles fire consistently. Works in singleplayer or when installed server-side.
body:
# NoSpread

NoSpread removes vanilla launch randomness from standard projectile shots, making bow accuracy deterministic and improving projectile-based mace techniques like pearl catching.

Without NoSpread, bow shots and pearl catches can depend partly on random spread instead of only player aim and timing.

## Installation

Install on the server, or in singleplayer. A client-only install on multiplayer servers will not affect server-authoritative projectile behavior.

## Behavior

- Removes vanilla projectile launch randomness.
- Keeps projectile accuracy determined by aim and timing.
- Affects server-authoritative projectile behavior.

## Supported versions

- Minecraft Java 1.21 through 1.21.11
- Minecraft Java 26.1 through 26.1.2

## License

NoSpread is released under the Unlicense.

title: FourLeafClover
description: Lucky four-leaf clover: eat for saturation or shift+right-click to get a random vanilla item.
body:
Four Leaf Clover

A rare lucky clover that can be eaten for saturation or shift-right-clicked to receive a random vanilla item.

How to obtain
- Breaking grass / ferns: 10% drop chance (similar to wheat seeds but rarer).
- Crafting: Fill the entire 3x3 crafting grid with 9 wheat seeds to craft one clover.

How to use
- Right-click: Eat the clover to restore 1 hunger and gain 5 seconds of Saturation.
- Shift + right-click (air or block): Consume one clover to receive a random vanilla item.

What can you get?
- The clover picks randomly from all vanilla items (including rare ones like diamonds, netherite, elytra, etc.).
- Extremely rare items (dragon egg, nether star, ancient debris...) have their chances significantly reduced to keep gameplay balanced.
- Some useless or debug items (barriers, command blocks, spawn eggs, structure blocks, sculk family...) are completely blocked.

Features
- Only grants one item per use (stack size is always 1).
- Works on both air and blocks when sneaking, ensuring compatibility with other mods.
- Client and server friendly - works perfectly in singleplayer and multiplayer.

Modpack & technical info
- Minecraft: 1.19.2
- Loader: Forge
- Environment: Both (client + server)
- No dependencies.
- Feel free to include in modpacks!

title: UnlockedEnchants
description: Unlocked Enchants was designed to bypass standard Minecraft enchantment restrictions, allowing those with permission to apply, remove, and manage enchantments at levels far exceeding vanilla limits.
body:
![SplashImage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e67862f6fec087e21fe7ff230371c446029f6bc_0.webp)
**UnlockedEnchants** is a Paper plugin designed to bypass standard Minecraft enchantment restrictions, allowing players to apply, remove, and manage enchantments at levels far exceeding vanilla limits.


The plugin enables "unsafe" enchanting, which means it ignores standard level caps (e.g., Sharpness V) and item-type restrictions. Its primary features include:

    Maximum Level Expansion: Allows enchantments to reach up to level 255.

    Command-Based Application: Users can apply specific enchantments directly to the item in their main hand via commands.

    Enchantment Removal: Provides functionality to strip specific enchantments or completely clear all enchantments from an item.

    Information Display: Includes a list command to view current enchantments on a held item, often highlighting which levels exceed vanilla maximums.

Command Structure

The plugin operates through the base command /uenchant with several subcommands:

    /uenchant <enchantment> <level>: Applies the specified enchantment at the chosen level (1–255) to the held item.

    /uenchant remove <enchantment>: Removes a specific enchantment from the item.

    /uenchant clear: Completely strips all enchantments from the held item.

    /uenchant list: Displays all enchantments currently on the held item.

    /uenchant help: Shows the command menu and usage instructions.

Technical Details

    Permissions: Access is controlled via the blsmr.uenchant.use permission node.

    Tab Completion: The plugin features intelligent tab-completion for enchantment names and subcommands to improve ease of use.

    Visual Feedback: It uses color-coded messages (e.g., gold for levels above vanilla max, green for successful applications) to provide clear feedback to the user.

    Safety Checks: The plugin verifies that a player is holding an item before attempting to apply or modify enchantments.

title: Hide AFK from Tab List
description: Client-side Fabric mod that filters AFK players from the tab list. Toggle with a keybind to declutter your player list on busy servers.
body:
# Hide AFK from Tab List

A lightweight **client-side** Fabric mod that lets you filter out AFK players from the tab list (player list). Perfect for busy multiplayer servers where the player list gets cluttered with inactive players.

## Features

- **One-Key Toggle** - Instantly show/hide AFK players
- **Tag-Based Detection** - Filters players with "AFK" in their display name or tab list entry
- **Lightweight** - Minimal performance impact, client-side only
- **Configurable Keybind** - Change the toggle key in Minecraft controls

## How to Use

1. Join any multiplayer server
2. Press **F6** (default) to toggle AFK player visibility
3. AFK players will be hidden from your tab list
4. Press **F6** again to show all players

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.4+
- Fabric Loader 0.15.0+
- Fabric API

## Configuration

The keybind can be changed in:
**Options > Controls > Key Binds > Hide AFK from Tab List**

## How It Works

The mod scans player entries in the tab list and hides those containing "AFK" (case-insensitive) in their name or display text. This works with most server AFK plugins that add an AFK tag or prefix to player names.

## Compatibility

- Works with most multiplayer servers
- Compatible with other client-side mods
- Works with server AFK plugins (EssentialsX, CMI, etc.)
- Server-side installation not required

---

*Found a bug or have a suggestion? Feel free to reach out!*

title: Simple Right-Click Harvest

body:
# Simple Right-Click Harvest 🌱

Make your Minecraft farming experience realistic, balanced, and effortless! This lightweight Quality of Life (QoL) mod allows you to harvest and replant crops quickly, but with a balanced twist to fit perfectly into vanilla gameplay.

## ✨ Key Features
* **Hoe Requirement:** To keep the game balanced, you must be holding a **Hoe** (any tier) in your hand to use the right-click harvest feature.
* **Smart Harvesting:** The mod only works on **fully grown (100%)** crops. Say goodbye to accidentally breaking unripe plants!
* **Instant Auto-Replant:** Automatically replants the crop on the exact same spot by consuming a seed directly from your inventory.
* **Vanilla Friendly:** Fits seamlessly into survival mode and large modpacks without feeling like a cheat.

## ⚙️ Requirements
* **Mod Loader:** Fabric
* **Dependencies:** Fabric API

## 🎮 Compatibility
Fully compatible with Minecraft **fabric** and works beautifully on both single-player worlds and multiplayer servers (Required on both Client and Server).

title: Mods Updater
description: Fabric mod for Minecraft that checks installed mods against Modrinth and shows which ones have updates.
body:
# Mods Updater

Fabric mod for Minecraft that checks installed mods against [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/) and shows which ones have updates.

## Features

- Hash-based lookup against the Modrinth `/version_files/update` endpoint, with a slug-based fallback for mods that aren't matched by hash.
- Toast notification on world join when updates are available.
- Dedicated screen accessible from [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu): click the configure icon next to "Mod Updates" to open the list. Double-click an entry to open its Modrinth page.
- Single locale-bundled with English and Russian.

## Requirements

- Minecraft `>= 26.1.2`
- Java `25`
- Fabric Loader `>= 0.19.2`
- Fabric API
- (Optional) ModMenu — recommended for the UI screen.

## Building

```sh
./gradlew build
```

The resulting jar is in `build/libs/`.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](https://github.com/erruqie/modsupdater/blob/main/LICENSE).

**Oxidation Machine** adds the **Oxidizer**, a machine block that accelerates copper oxidation using Forge Energy (FE). Instead of waiting for natural oxidation, players can process copper blocks directly with an efficient powered alternative.

The Oxidizer supports waxed and unwaxed copper block variants and uses **stage chips** to control the target oxidation stage. It also supports waxing with vanilla honeycombs, with planned support for custom oil-tagged items in the future.

The machine works with hoppers and item pipes, and has been tested with ATM10.

If you run into any issues, please report them on my Discord or GitHub.
