title: Short Stack Count
description: mod that shortens big numbers by adding suffixes, e.g. 1,234 → 1.2K
body:
# short stack count
this is a mod that shortens numbers above 1,000 to their suffixed counterparts in any GUI that calls `GuiGraphics.drawString`, for example, 1,234 → 1.2K, 1,234,567,890 → 1.2B, etc. up to 10¹⁸ (quintillion / Qn)

## config
the mod has multiple configuration options (`shortstackcount.toml`):
- `enabled` - controls whether the number formatting is enabled
- `convertMbToLiters` - toggles optional fluid support which converts buckets into metric liters
- `precision` - the number of decimal places in formatted numbers

## preview
the functionality is best seen in something like [EMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi)'s recipe tree:
![a screenshot of an EMI recipe tree with big numbers that are formatted by the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/acdc4366cb4fe5961457e0b1e96b878c9bb11de8.png)

## credit
[Phoenixvine](https://modrinth.com/user/Phoenixvine) - original idea and code that i revamped

[yumbofocus](https://modrinth.com/user/yumbofocus) - mod icon and the idea for adding bucket support

# 🌌 Wynnium — The Ultimate Wynncraft Experience

Elevate your journey through the provinces of Wynn and Gavel.

**Wynnium** is a meticulously curated performance and enhancement modpack built specifically for the Wynncraft MMORPG server.  
It refines Minecraft into a smooth, immersive, and information-rich MMO client — without altering gameplay or breaking server compatibility.

---

## 🏰 Made for Wynncraft

Standard Minecraft isn’t designed for a massive MMORPG.  
Wynnium bridges that gap by focusing on three core pillars:

> ⚡ **Performance**  
> 🌍 **Immersion**  
> 📊 **Information**

Whether you're questing through Gavel, raiding dungeons, or trading in Detlas — Wynnium ensures your experience feels responsive, beautiful, and optimized.

---

## 🚀 Why Wynnium?

Wynnium enhances your Wynncraft experience with:

- Stable FPS even in crowded cities and raids  
- Advanced quest, map, and stat tracking  
- MMO-friendly UI improvements  
- Shader compatibility without sacrificing performance  
- Fully client-side and server-safe setup  

---

## ✨ Key Features

### ⚡ Butter-Smooth Performance
Powered by Sodium, Lithium, Starlight, and FerriteCore to ensure stable FPS even in crowded areas like Detlas or during intense combat.

### 🧭 Wynn-Specific Enhancements
Includes the best community-made tools (like Wynntils) to track quests, minimaps, objectives, and player stats efficiently. Voices Of Wynn is also included for a great voice over.

### 🌄 Visual Overhaul
Full Iris shader compatibility and visual enhancement mods that respect the Wynncraft aesthetic while making the world feel more alive.

### 🎯 Quality of Life Improvements
Enhanced chat, better HUD elements, smoother animations, and useful UI tweaks designed for MMO gameplay.

## 🛠️ What's Inside?

| Category | Featured Mods |
|----------|---------------|
| Core | Wynntils (The heart of the experience) |
| Optimization | Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ScalableLux |
| Visuals | Iris Shaders, Continuity, Camera Overhaul |


---


---

## ⚠️ Recommendations

Wynnium includes Iris.  
For the best “Wynn” atmosphere, we suggest using **BLISS or BSL**.


---

## 📌 Important

> This modpack is a fan-made project and is not officially affiliated with the Wynncraft Team.  
> Always follow the official Wynncraft server rules.

---

Download **Wynnium** and experience Wynncraft the refined way.

title: [Minigame] - Don't be Last
description: Minecraft but Last player to complete a task gets eliminated!
body:
**Don't be last** is a minigame plugin: every competing player gets one random challenge per round (mining, placing blocks, eating, ...). You have to do this challenge as fast as possible. If you are the last one to complete the challenge you will be eliminated.

Designed for a medium group of friends who want quick, tense challenges against each other.

![Last To Kill A Chicken Dies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48ad5eb50534d32cc963cc1b0b515a33bf3644bd_0.webp)

---

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| **Server** | [Paper](https://papermc.io/) (or compatible fork) **1.21+** |
| **Java** | **21** |
| **Players** | At least **2** survival (non-spectator) players to start a session (configurable) |
| **Dependencies** | **None** |

Built against **Paper `1.21.11`**; test on the Paper build you run in production.

---

## How it works

1. An admin runs **`/lastcall start`**. Everyone who is in Survival (not Spectator) at that moment is locked into the roster for this match.

2. Each round, the plugin picks a challenge from a large pool. Difficulty is limited by how many players are still competing.

3. While the round is active
   - If exactly one competing player has not completed the challenge, they get a large title + chat message and are eliminated.
   - If two or more players are still incomplete, no elimination countdown runs until someone catches up.

4. If everyone has completed at least once this round:
   - With mercy enabled, and everyone has completed it within time, everyone survives.
   - Without mercy, the last player will be eliminated.

5. **Eliminated** players become **spectators** until the match ends or an admin runs.

6. The last competing player wins.

**Mid-join:** players who were not on the roster when the session started are set to Spectator if they join during a match.

---

## Commands

Main command: **`/lastcall`** — alias **`/lc`**.

| Command | Who | Permission | Description |
|--------|-----|------------|-------------|
| `/lastcall start` | Console / player | `lastcall.admin.start` | Start a LastCall session (locks roster). |
| `/lastcall stop` | Console / player | `lastcall.admin.stop` | Stop the session; revive spectators. |
| `/lastcall reload` | Console / player | `lastcall.admin.reload` | Reload `config.yml` from disk. |
| `/lastcall times` | Console / player | `lastcall.admin.reload` | Print loaded timing values (seconds) and YAML keys; use after `reload` to verify. |
| `/lastcall mercy window <seconds>` | Console / player | `lastcall.admin.reload` | Writes `mercy.all-must-complete-within-seconds-from-round-start` to `config.yml` and applies it. **`0`** = no time limit when everyone finishes. |
| `/lastcall mercy venster …` | Console / player | `lastcall.admin.reload` | Same as `mercy window`. |
| `/lastcall mercy survive on` / `off` | Console / player | `lastcall.admin.reload` | Writes `mercy.everyone-survives-when-all-completed` (must be **on** for the window rule to apply when all complete). |
| `/lastcall mercy iedereen …` | Console / player | `lastcall.admin.reload` | Same as `mercy survive`. |
| `/lastcall status` | Player only | *(none)* | Open GUI: who completed this round. |
| `/lastcall gui` | Player only | *(none)* | Same as `status`. |
| `/lastcall scoreboard` | Player only | `lastcall.scoreboard` | Toggle LastCall **sidebar** on/off for you. |
| `/lastcall scoreboard on` | Player only | `lastcall.scoreboard` | Force sidebar **on** (`on`, `true`, `1`, `aan`). |
| `/lastcall scoreboard off` | Player only | `lastcall.scoreboard` | Force sidebar **off** (`off`, `false`, `0`, `uit`). |
| `/lastcall sb …` | Player only | `lastcall.scoreboard` | Short alias for `scoreboard`. |
| `/lastcall help` | Anyone | *(none)* | Full command list, permissions, and how to configure timings. |

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Purpose |
|------------|---------|---------|
| `lastcall.admin.start` | **op** | Start a session |
| `lastcall.admin.stop` | **op** | Stop a session |
| `lastcall.admin.reload` | **op** | Reload config; **`mercy`** subcommands also save `config.yml` |
| `lastcall.scoreboard` | **true** | Toggle the LastCall sidebar |

---

## Configuration (`config.yml`)

On the server, edit **`plugins/LastCall/config.yml`**. The bundled file starts with a **comment block** listing every **time-related key** (all in **seconds**).

After editing by hand, run **`/lastcall reload`** (or restart), then **`/lastcall times`** to confirm what the server loaded.

### `game`

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|-----|---------|---------|
| `min-players` | `2` | Minimum survival players online to allow `/lastcall start`. |
| `first-round-delay-seconds` | `3` | Wait after start before the first round begins. |

### `round`

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|-----|---------|---------|
| `between-rounds-seconds` | `4` | Pause after a round ends before the next challenge. |
| `last-sole-player-elimination-delay-seconds` | `3` | When only one player has not completed, how long until they are eliminated if they still fail. |

### `mercy`

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|-----|---------|---------|
| `everyone-survives-when-all-completed` | `true` | If **true** and everyone completed, normally nobody dies that round. |
| `all-must-complete-within-seconds-from-round-start` | `90` | If **> 0**, each first completion must be within this many seconds from **round start** for full mercy. If everyone finishes but the window is violated, the **last** player to complete is eliminated. **`0`** disables this rule. |

In-game without editing the file: **`/lastcall mercy window <seconds>`** (alias **`venster`**) and **`/lastcall mercy survive on|off`** (alias **`iedereen`**).

### `season`

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|-----|---------|---------|
| `after-winner-delay-seconds` | `10` | After a winner, wait this long before reviving everyone / reset. |
| `auto-start-next-delay-seconds` | `0` | If **> 0**, after reset automatically start a **new** match after this many seconds. **`0`** = require `/lastcall start` again. |

### `difficulty`

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|-----|---------|---------|
| `tier-1-min-alive` | `10` | While at least this many players are alive, only **tier 1** challenges. |
| `tier-2-min-alive` | `7` | From this count upward (and below tier-1 threshold), up to **tier 2**. |
| `tier-3-min-alive` | `4` | From this count upward, up to **tier 3**. |
| `max-tier-when-few-alive` | `2` | When alive count is **below** `tier-3-min-alive`, never pick challenges above this tier (caps brutality for small lobbies). |

---

## HUD (what players see)

- **Title** (center of the screen) when a new round starts — the task stays visible for several seconds. Competing roster players who join mid-round get the same title.
- **Boss bar** — the green fill matches completion progress.
- **Sidebar scoreboard** — task line, progress, and per-player completion. Toggle with **`/lastcall scoreboard`**.

---

## Installation

1. Download `lastcall-1.0.1.jar` from your build output (`build/libs/`) or from Modrinth.
2. Place it in the server's `plugins` folder.
3. Start or restart the server.
4. Edit `plugins/LastCall/config.yml` if you want non-default timings or difficulty.
5. Run `/lastcall start` when enough players are online.

---

## Author

**yopshop** — plugin metadata in `plugin.yml`.

title: VoidChat+
description: VoidChat | A high-performance, lightweight local and global chat system for servers.
body:
# 💬 VoidChat+ | Advanced Communication

**VoidChat+** is a professional, high-performance communication solution for modern Minecraft servers. It provides a complete chat management system by splitting communication into local and global channels, while maintaining top-tier security with integrated Anti-Swear and Anti-Bot mining requirements.

### 🛠️ Key Features

  * **Dual-Channel System** – Seamless transition between local (proximity-based) and global communication (using the `!` prefix).
  * **Infinite Local Mode** – Configure local chat range to `-1` to cover the entire world or dimension, perfect for specialized survival modes.
  * **Anti-Bot Security** – Unique system requiring new players to mine a specific amount of blocks before they are granted the ability to chat.
  * **HEX & PAPI Support** – Full support for modern HEX colors and PlaceholderAPI integration for dynamic, beautiful chat formats.
  * **Admin Chat Spy** – Allows staff members to monitor local conversations to ensure community guidelines are followed.

-----

### 💻 Installation & Setup

1.  Download the `.jar` file.
2.  Drop the file into your server's `/plugins` folder.
3.  Restart your server to generate the configuration files.
4.  Customize your settings and word filters in `config.yml`.

-----

### 📜〢 Configuration Example

```yaml
############################################################
#                                                          #
#             VOIDCHAT - CREATED BY KUBA_121               #
#         Professional local & global chat system          #
#                                                          #
############################################################

############################################################
#                                                          #
#  PERMISSIONS:                                            #
#  - voidchat.use: Access to basic commands                #
#  - voidchat.reload: Access to /voidchat reload           #
#  - voidchat.admin: Access to Admin/Spy/Clear/Toggle      #
#  - voidchat.color: Ability to use & and HEX colors       #
#  - voidchat.bypass: Bypass block break requirement       #
#  - voidchat.globalbypass: Bypass global cooldown         #
#                                                          #
############################################################

# --- GENERAL SETTINGS ---

# Time in seconds for global message (!) cooldown.
# Bypass this with voidchat.globalbypass permission.
global-message-cooldown: 30

# Distance in blocks for the local chat.
# Set to -1 for infinite range (everyone in the world hears you).
local-chat-range: 100.0

# Number of blocks a player must break before they can use the chat.
blocks-required: 10

# Should the block requirement be active?
chat-requirement-enabled: true

# --- ANTI SWEAR ---
anti-swear:
  # List of words that will be replaced with ****
  banned-words:
    - "badword1"
    - "badword2"
    - "badword3"

# --- CHAT FORMATTING ---
# You can use Placeholders from PAPI (if installed) using %placeholder%
# {player} and {message} are internal placeholders.

# Format for global chat (triggered by ! at the start)
global-format: "&a&lGLOBAL &r&8»&7 {player}: {message}"

# Format for local chat (based on range)
local-format: "&e&lLOCAL &r&8»&7 {player}: {message}"

# --- SYSTEM MESSAGES ---

messages:
  # The global prefix for all system messages
  prefix: "&b&lVoidChat &r&8»&7"

  # Error when player lacks required permissions
  no-permission: "%prefix% You lack the &bvoid power &7to do this."
  
  # Notification for successful config reload
  reload-success: "%prefix% Configuration &bpurged &7and &breloaded &7successfully."

  # Message when no one is in range for local chat
  no-one-in-range: "%prefix% &7The void is silent. No one is close enough to hear you."

  # Requirement message. Use {blocks_required} for remaining count.
  requirement-not-met: "%prefix% &7Your voice is weak. Break &b{blocks_required} &7more blocks to speak."

  # Global chat cooldown notification
  global-cooldown: "%prefix% &7The void needs &b{time_remaining}s &7to resonate again."

  # Admin Spy mode toggles
  admin-enabled: "%prefix% &bAdmin Spy &7is now &aactive&7. All whispers are yours."
  admin-disabled: "%prefix% &bAdmin Spy &7has been &cdisactivated&7."

  # Global mute notifications (self-toggle)
  global-muted: "%prefix% &7You have &cclosed &7your ears to the global void."
  global-unmuted: "%prefix% &7You can now &ahear &7the global resonance again."
  global-muted-error: "%prefix% &cYou cannot speak while your global ears are closed."

  # Chat Management (Clear & Toggle)
  chat-cleared: "%prefix% &7The chat has been &bpurified &7by &b{player}&7."
  chat-toggled-on: "%prefix% &aGlobal resonance has been restored. Chat is now enabled."
  chat-toggled-off: "%prefix% &cThe void has been silenced. Chat is now disabled."
  chat-disabled-error: "%prefix% &cThe chat is currently suppressed by an administrator."

  # Command usage and help
  usage-voidchat: "%prefix% Usage: &b/voidchat &8<&7help/reload/admin/clear/toggle&8>"
```

description: Makes Nether Portals not show up on ESP, Xray, and Pie-Chart
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94efd0ae3101791b7be062ea09065abf1223e532.png)
# Phantom Portals

**By StarRinth**

---

## What is Phantom Portals?

Phantom Portals is a lightweight Paper plugin designed to protect your server's Nether portals from exploitation. When a Nether portal is outside of a player's direct line of sight, it becomes hidden by being replaced silently with stone. The moment a legitimate player looks at it, the portal is seamlessly restored.

This makes it significantly harder for hacked clients using X-ray, ESP, or other visibility exploits to locate and abuse Nether portals across your world.

---

## How It Works

Phantom Portals continuously monitors all tracked Nether portals on your server. Using a combination of distance checking, raycasting, and field of view detection, it determines whether any online player can genuinely see a portal at any given moment. If no player can see it, the portal is hidden. If a player looks toward it, it comes back — instantly and seamlessly.

---

## Features

- Portals hide automatically when outside player line of sight
- Seamless restoration when a player looks at the portal
- Async pre-checks to keep server performance impact minimal
- Automatically tracks newly created and destroyed portals
- All hidden portals are restored cleanly on server shutdown

---

## Requirements

- 1.18 or higher

---

## Support

For bug reports or feature requests make a ticket on our discord!

---

title: Beatable Superflat
description: Access the Nether and the End on Structureless Superflat!
body:
![Banner: BEATABLE SUPERFLAT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fa462c39c9e6e991a180921a1a1b3729c9076998.png)

## 📖 About

Beatable Superflat lets you actually defeat the Ender Dragon in the **Structureless Superflat Survival challenge**. It adds methods to get essential items that you can’t find in this kind of world, like: **Lava Buckets**, **Blaze Rods**, and **End Portal Frames**. _If you’re wondering how to grab those, check out the “How to Beat” section down below for the details._

## 🌍 Versions

Since this pack enables access to both **the Nether** and **the End** in a superflat world, there are **two versions** available:

- **Version 1 (v1.x)** – Allows access to both the Nether and the End without changing how those dimensions generate. (The End and the Nether stay the same as in a normal vanilla world).
- **Version 2 (v2.x)** – Works the same as Version 1 (in terms of getting to other dimensions), but generates **both the Nether and the End as superflat worlds**. 

_Image below - superflat Nether. (v2.x)_

![Superflat Nether](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/068273d381fa97eadbe930364680a2b49e2cbf89.jpeg)

💡 *Note: **If you aren't playing the Structureless Challenge**, Version 2 can still generate structures if you enable them. This means you’ll still be able to find locations like End Cities and Bastions, even though the dimensions are superflat. In this case, **all the datapack does is make all dimensions superflat**; the custom methods for obtaining End Portal Frames, Lava, or Blaze Rods are simply alternatives to finding them within structures.*

## 🏆 How to Beat the Challenge

To complete **Structureless Superflat Survival**, you need the three items mentioned earlier. Here is how you can obtain them:

- **Lava Bucket** – First, defeat an Illager Raid to gain the **Hero of the Village effect**. While the effect is active, find a **Toolsmith**. As a reward for protecting the village, they may **throw you a Lava Bucket as a gift**.

- **Blaze Rod** – This works the same way as the Lava Bucket. Once you have Hero of the Village, **a Librarian can gift you a Blaze Rod**.

- **End Portal Frame** – These can be obtained through **Piglin bartering**. Each trade has roughly a **1 in 250 chance** of giving you an End Portal Frame, so building a gold farm is highly recommended.

## 📦 Installation

### Datapack
1. Download the datapack file.
2. Place it in your world's `datapacks` folder.
3. Run `/reload` or restart the world.

### Mod
1. Install the required mod loader.
2. Place the `.jar` file into the `mods` folder.
3. Launch the game.

## ⚙️ Compatibility

This pack is designed primarily for the Structureless Superflat Survival challenge.

It is compatible with all vanilla gameplay features; however, other datapacks or mods that modify the following may conflict with it:

- villager gifts (not trading!)
- piglin bartering
- world generation

**CubeClash PvP Event** is a PvP event pack for Minecraft that provides a complete multi-phase last-player-standing event system with automated setup, join handling, world border control, combat rules, and winner detection.

It is built for organized server events and includes functions to manage the full event flow from preparation to the final battle.

**Features**

- full event phase system
  - setup
  - prejoin
  - map opening
  - PvP activation
  - finale
  - winner sequence
- bossbar support
- world border control
- join and respawn handling
- combat logging detection
- temporary ban / punishment logic
- automatic winner detection
- admin functions for setup and control

**Commands**

- "/function cubeclash:admin/setup" — creates the required scoreboards, teams, and base systems for the event
- "/function cubeclash:admin/set_anchor" — sets the anchor point used for teleports and event flow
- "/function cubeclash:admin/prejoin" — starts the prejoin phase so players can join the event
- "/function cubeclash:admin/open_map" — opens the map or starts the next event phase
- "/function cubeclash:admin/pvp_on" — enables PvP for the combat phase
- "/function cubeclash:admin/finale" — starts the final phase of the event
- "/function cubeclash:admin/reset" — resets the event and clears active states

title: Echoes of Antiquity
description: Echoes of Antiquity is a Minecraft mod inspired by Game Theory's exploration of Minecraft lore.  It introduces items, specialized gear, and mechanics centered around the Void/End, Pillagers and the "Ancient Builders".
body:
![Mod's name render](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d29b0b770afb8224c6639f2f6702ee69e98cb94.png)

---

Echoes of Antiquity is a Minecraft mod inspired by Game Theory's exploration
of Minecraft lore. It introduces ancient artifacts, specialized
gear, and mechanics centered around the Void and the End. Just download it and have some fun !

---

## 🛠 Materials & Ingredients
<details> 
  <summary> Spoiler </summary>


### 🌑 End Steel Ingot 🟣
* A core material for advanced crafting.
* **Recipe:** Shapeless crafting with 1 Iron Ingot, 1 Popped Chorus Fruit, and 1 Ender Pearl.

### 🖤 Void Treated Leather 🟣
* Leather infused with End energies.
* **Recipe:** 1 Leather and 4 Chorus Fruits in a cross pattern.

### 📜 Ancient Scrip ⚪
* An ancient material used in crafting.
</details>
---

## ⚔️ Weaponry
<details> 
  <summary> Spoiler </summary>
### 🏹 Dragon Bow 🟣
* A powerful long-range weapon.
* Shoots with **twice the velocity** of the vanilla bow and is **more precise**

### 🗡 Relic Blade 🟣
* A sharp blade forged from pure End Steel.
* **Recipe:** 3 End Steel Ingots arranged in a vertical column.

### 🗡️ Relic Greatsword 🟣
* A massive sword with custom animations for holding and attacking.
* **Recipe:** Place a **Relic Blade** (top), a **Stick** (middle), and **Void Treated Leather** (bottom) in a vertical column.
* Has **8.5** Attack damage, but with a **0.6** Attack Speed (lower = slower)

### 🗡️ Soul Siphon 🔵
* Has the **same** Attack Damage as a **Stone Sword** but with an **2.6** Attack Speed
* Entities killed by the **Soul Siphon** will drop a **Soul Fragment**
  </details>
---

## ⬛ Blocks
<details> 
  <summary> Spoiler </summary>
   
### 👣 Ender Boots 🟣
* Grants stealth by stopping vibration signals (Sculk sensors won't detect you).
* **Recipe:** Combine Leather Boots with Void Treated Leather at a Smithing Table.

### 🔮 Void Pedestal 🟣
* Allows the player to showcase one item.
* Prevents teleportation within a **20-block radius** when active.
* **Activation:** Place an **Ender Eye** inside.
* **Visuals:** The Eye rotates and tracks nearby players.
* **Effect:** Applies the `void_pedestal_suppressed` tag to entities in range.

### ⚓ Void Anchor 🟣
* Used as an "anchor" for the **Static Pearl**
* Right-click the Void Anchor with a **magenta dye** to change its texture. You can **wash** the dye with a water bucket.

### 🪚 Uncrafter ⚪
* Takes items and blocks as inputs, outputs a **random** ingredient from its crafting **and** smelting recipes.
* Will **not** output blocks/items that would allow for too big of a **duplication** (ex iron block from iron ingot)

### 🪨 Waystone ⚪
* A teleportation marker.
* **Activation:** Right-click with **10 Soul Fragments** to activate it.
* Remembers the player who placed/activated it and will tp them back if health gets under 2.5 hearts

### 🧲 Gravity Anchor ⚪
* **Activation:** Powered by Redstone.
* **Effect:** When active, it projects an energy field in a **10-block radius** that freezes falling blocks (like Sand or Gravel) in mid-air.
* **Sound Effect:** Humming sound when activated
  </details>
---

## Items
<details> 
  <summary> Spoiler </summary>
   
### 🔘 Static Pearl 🟣
* **Mechanics:** Use once on a Void Anchor to link it to **this** Static Pearl, use again to instantly teleport back to it.
* **Shift + Right-Click** on a new Void Anchor to change which the Pearl is linked to
* Can be used **20 times**

### 🧿 Soul Fragments 🔵
* Used to activate **Waystones** (Costs 10 fragments).

### 🕷️ Climbing Spider Leg ⚪
* Allows any player holding this item (main hand or offhand) to climb walls just like a spider
* Has a 0.5% drop chance from cave spiders

### 📏 Measuring Tape ⚪
* Right-Click a block to set its position has the starting point for the measure.
* Shift + Right-Click a block to set its position has the ending point for the measure.
* Shift + Right-Click in the air to change the distance calculation method.
* Has 2 distance calculations method :
    * Vector distance : Calculates the norm of the vector linking both blocks.
    * Manhattan distance : Calculates the distance between both blocks while staying on the block grid.

### 🪣 Infinite Water Bucket ⚪
* Places water just like a normal bucket.
* **Mechanics:** **Shift + Right-Click** directly on a fluid block to drain/absorb it.

### 📐 Level (Architect's Level) ⚪
* **Mechanics:** Right-click a block to instantly flatten a **3x3 area** around it.
* It will automatically shave off up to 2 blocks above the target level.
* It will automatically fill in holes using **Dirt** from your inventory.

### 🥽 Obsidian Goggles 🟣
* Crafted with Obsidian, Glass Panes, and a Static Pearl.
* Allows the player **to look at Endermen** without angering them. Unlike **Carved Pumpkin**, it **won't** partially cover your view.
</details>
---

## ✨ Potions & Effects 🥛

### 👻 Phasing 🥛
* **Effect:** Allows walking through walls that are **maximum 1 block thick**.
* **Brewing:** Popped Chorus Fruit into an Awkward Potion.
* **Note:** This effect is disabled near an active Void Anchor.

### 📏 Long Arms (Reach) 🥛
* **Effect:** Increases interaction range by **+2.0 blocks**.
* **Brewing:** Popped Chorus Fruit into a Potion of Phasing.

---

## 📦 Creative Tab

* Find all items and blocks annotated with "🟣" in **"The Fallen Humans"** tab.
* Find all items and blocks annotated with "🔵" in **"The Failed Clones"** tab.
* Find all items and blocks annotated with "⚪" in **"The Architect's Tools"** tab.
* Find all items annotated with "🥛" in the vanilla **"Food & Drinks"** tab.

# ChaosSMP

This modpack is for:

*   Anyone looking for a **fresh**, **immersive**, and **optimized** Minecraft experience

***

### Poor performance

*   Open the modpack settings and **allocate more RAM** to Minecraft _(e.g. for 16 GB RAM → allocate 12 GB)_
*   In Minecraft, open **video settings**, click the **square icon** to the left of the FoV slider, and **lower the render distance and quality preset**.

### Can’t join the server

*   Verify your **internet connection**
*   Ensure you haven’t installed any **unethical mods**
*   Confirm you're using the **latest version of the modpack**
*   **Wait a few minutes** and try again

***

## Need help?

If you encounter **bugs**, **issues**, or have any **questions**, please leave a comment or join the [official ChaosSMP Discord](https://discord.gg/H6ZFxhjYSJ).

title: Life Swap
description: Kill Enemies, Swap Health, but be careful or you might lose it all
body:
# 🔄 Life Swap
Kill or be killed. Literally.

Life Swap turns every fight into a gamble — when you kill a mob or player, you inherit their max health. Take down a Warden and walk away nearly unkillable. Finish off by a Silverfish and, well... good luck.

---

## 💀 How It Works

Every kill swaps your max health with your target's. No grinding, no tiers — just pure risk and reward.

- **Kill a player?** You take their max health. They respawn with yours.
- **Kill a mob?** Your max health becomes theirs.
- **Die naturally?** Your health resets to 20 HP by default — unless you enable persist mode.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

A config file is automatically generated on first launch at:
```
config/lifeswap_config.json
```
```json
{
  "persistAfterDeath": false
}
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `persistAfterDeath` | `false` | If true, your max health carries over through death instead of resetting to 20 HP |

---

## 🔧 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/lifeswap toggle` | Toggle persist after death on or off |

---

## 📋 Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.9–1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

### Configuration
- `config.yml` — locale, render distance, tick rate, auto-equip, static mode

| Command | Description | Permission |

| `shinex.trail.*` | All trail effects | OP |
| `shinex.head.*` | All head effects | OP |

### Combination Modes

- **PER-CATEGORY** — one per category, all categories simultaneously
- **Custom pairs** — define exactly which categories can coexist (e.g. `AURA+TRAIL`)

### PlaceholderAPI Support

| `%shinex_has_any%` | `true` / `false` |
| `%shinex_count_aura%` | Number of available auras for player |
| `%shinex_total_active%` | Total active cosmetics count |
| `%shinex_total_available%` | Total available cosmetics for player |
| `%shinex_active_list%` | Comma-separated list of active names |
| `%shinex_auto_equip%` | `true` / `false` |

---

## 📋 Requirements

- **Paper 1.21.4+** (or forks like Purpur)
- **Java 21+**
- **PlaceholderAPI** *(optional)* — for placeholder support

---

title: Ritter
description: A medieval hardcore Fabric mod featuring a permanent vitality system, synchronized PvP combat, and real consequences. Every hit matters, every death counts, and every decision shapes your fate. (Formerly a plugin — now a full Fabric mod.)
body:
🔥 Important Project Update
Knight has officially transitioned from a Spigot/Paper plugin to a full Fabric mod.
This change was necessary to support advanced features such as client‑side HUDs, networking, custom items, synchronized combat systems, and a modern vitality framework.
The old plugin is now discontinued and has been removed.
Knight is no longer a plugin — it is a Fabric mod that must be installed on both server and client.

⚔️ Overview
Knight is a medieval‑themed hardcore Fabric mod that introduces a high‑stakes vitality system, synchronized PvP combat mechanics, and permanent consequences. Every decision matters, every fight has weight, and survival becomes a tactical challenge.
The mod is designed for competitive worlds, hardcore SMPs, medieval servers, and any environment where death should have real meaning.

✨ Core Features
❤️ Vitality System
- Each player has 0–5 vitality points
- Every death removes 1 vitality
- At 0 vitality, the player is permanently eliminated
- Vitality persists across restarts and cannot be bypassed
- Automatic revival when vitality is restored
⚔️ Advanced Combat System
A fully server‑synchronized PvP system:
- Every hit adds +30 seconds of combat time (stacking)
- Combat timer is identical for both players
- Actionbar displays the remaining combat time
- Combat ends instantly when a player dies or logs out
- Combat‑logout or combat‑death → lose 1 vitality
- Anti‑combat‑abuse:
- No combat from fire, lava, fall damage, mobs, explosions, ender pearls, snowballs, fishing rods, etc.
- Combat starts only from real PvP damage

body: # 💎 VirtualFilter v1.5 **Professional Independent Virtual Filtering System** An advanced item management system designed for high-performance Minecraft servers (1.21.1+). --- ## 🛡️ Chest Guard System (v1.5) **This system prevents item loss when breaking chests or containers. When a chest is destroyed, the plugin processes items in three stages: first, it attempts to send them to the ISF virtual storage; next, to the player's inventory; and finally, if no space remains, it drops the rest on the ground with total security.** ## 📊 Detailed Collection Report **Whenever a chest is broken, the player receives a color-coded chat log informing the exact destination of each item. You can see how many items went to the ISF, how many entered the inventory, and if anything was dropped due to lack of space. This function can be toggled via command.** ## 🏗️ Infinite Building with ISF **The AutoFillHand system is integrated with the database. If the block in your hand runs out while you are building, the plugin automatically fetches a new stack of 64 units directly from your virtual storage, allowing for uninterrupted construction.** ## 📱 Full Bedrock Compatibility **Developed to work perfectly with GeyserMC. Mobile and console players can manage filters, add items, remove by slot ID, and withdraw from storage using short commands without relying on menu clicks that may fail.** --- ## 💻 Player Commands | Command | Description | | :---: | :--- | | `/vf` or `/vfilter` | **Opens the main help menu with all commands.** | | `/isg ` | **Withdraws items from the ISF virtual storage using the slot number.** | | `/addasf /addisf /addabf` | **Adds the item in hand to the AutoSell, Storage, or Block filters.** | | `/remasf /remisf /remabf` | **Removes the filter for the item in hand or from a specific slot.** | | `/al` | **Toggles automatic item pickup (AutoLoot) on or off.** | | `/afh` | **Toggles automatic block replenishment (AutoFill) on or off.** | | `/vfcb` or `/chestdebug` | **Toggles report messages when breaking chests on or off.** | | `/vflang ` | **Changes the plugin's message language for the player.** | | `/vfreload` | **Reloads plugin configurations and prices (Admin).** | --- ## 🔑 System Permissions * **virtualfilter.admin** - **Full access to administration and reload commands.** * **virtualfilter.chestdebug** - **Allows the player to see and toggle chest messages.** * **virtualfilter.asf.** - **Defines available slots in the AutoSell filter.** * **virtualfilter.isf.** - **Defines available slots in the InfinityStack filter.** * **virtualfilter.abf.** - **Defines available slots in the AutoBlock filter.** --- *Developed by **comonier**.*

title: WDegisken
description: Adds custom placeholders (variables) to your Minecraft server that can be used with PlaceholderAPI-compatible plugins such as TAB, AnimatedScoreboard, and Skript.
body:
# WDegisken

**WDegisken** is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that allows server administrators to create and use **custom variables (placeholders)** on their server.

These variables work with **PlaceholderAPI**, making them compatible with many popular plugins such as:

* TAB
* AnimatedScoreboard
* Skript
* Chat plugins
* Scoreboard plugins
* GUI plugins
* and many more

This allows you to easily display custom values anywhere placeholders are supported.

---

## ✨ Features

* Create custom server variables
* PlaceholderAPI support
* Works with scoreboard and tablist plugins
* Compatible with Skript
* Lightweight and simple
* Easy placeholder format

---

## 🔧 Placeholder Format

Example usage:

```
%wd_variableName%
```

Example output:

```
%wd_money% → 1000
%wd_rank% → VIP
```

---

## 📦 Requirements

This plugin **requires PlaceholderAPI** to work.

Make sure PlaceholderAPI is installed on your server.

---

## 💡 Possible Use Cases

WDegisken can be used for many different purposes:

* Custom scoreboard values
* Server statistics
* Player data display
* Integration with Skript variables
* Custom server systems
* Dynamic chat formatting

---

# 🇹🇷 Türkçe Açıklama

**WDegisken**, Minecraft sunucunuza **özel değişkenler (placeholder)** eklemenizi sağlayan hafif bir eklentidir.

Bu değişkenler **PlaceholderAPI ile uyumludur** ve aşağıdaki gibi birçok plugin ile birlikte kullanılabilir:

* TAB
* AnimatedScoreBoard
* Skript
* Chat pluginleri
* Scoreboard pluginleri
* GUI pluginleri
* ve daha fazlası

Bu sayede placeholder destekleyen her yerde **kendi değişkenlerinizi gösterebilirsiniz.**

---

## ✨ Özellikler

* Sunucuya özel değişken ekleme
* PlaceholderAPI desteği
* Scoreboard ve TAB pluginleri ile uyumlu
* Skript ile birlikte kullanılabilir
* Hafif ve basit yapı
* Kolay placeholder kullanımı

---

## 🔧 Kullanım

Örnek placeholder kullanımı:

```
%wd_degiskenAdi%
```

Örnek çıktı:

```
%wd_para% → 1000
%wd_rank% → VIP
```

---

## 📦 Gereksinimler

Bu pluginin çalışması için **PlaceholderAPI gereklidir.**

Sunucunuzda PlaceholderAPI kurulu olduğundan emin olun.

body:
BETTERSPECTATE

BETTERSPECTATE is a Minecraft plugin designed to enhance the spectator experience by allowing players to cycle through all online players in spectator mode with customizable timers. Perfect for server administrators, streamers, or anyone who wants to easily spectate multiple players without manual switching.

FEATURES

- AUTOMATIC CYCLING: Seamlessly cycle through all online players in spectator mode.
- CUSTOMIZABLE TIMERS: Set custom intervals for how long to spectate each player (default 15 seconds).
- INFINITE MODE: Enable infinite cycling to continuously loop through players.
- REAL-TIME FEEDBACK: Action bar displays current target and countdown timer.
- SOUND NOTIFICATIONS: Plays a sound when switching to a new player.
- PERMISSION-BASED: Restrict usage with permissions.
- PLUGMAN COMPATIBLE: Can be loaded/unloaded without server restart.
- TAB COMPLETION: Supports tab completion for commands and arguments.

COMMANDS

/speccycle start [time]
Starts a one-time cycle through all online players.
- [time]: Optional. Interval in seconds (minimum 1). Default is 15 seconds.
- Example: /speccycle start 10 (cycles every 10 seconds)

/speccycle start infinite [time]
Starts an infinite cycle that loops continuously.
- [time]: Optional. Interval in seconds (minimum 1). Default is 15 seconds.
- Example: /speccycle start infinite 20 (infinite cycle every 20 seconds)

/speccycle stop
Stops the current spectate cycle and restores the player's original game mode and location.

/speccycle help
Displays the help message with command usage.

PERMISSIONS

- betterspectate.cycle: Allows players to use the /speccycle command. Default: OP only.

REQUIREMENTS
- Minecraft 1.21+
- Spigot/Paper server software
- Java 17+

USAGE

1. Ensure you have the betterspectate.cycle permission (or OP status).
2. Enter spectator mode by running /speccycle start (or with custom time).
3. The plugin will automatically switch your spectator target every interval.
4. Use the action bar to see the current player and remaining time.
5. Stop at any time with /speccycle stop.

EXAMPLE SCENARIOS
- STREAMERS: Cycle through players during a live stream to showcase different perspectives.
- ADMINS: Quickly check on all players without manual teleportation.
- EVENTS: Use infinite mode for continuous monitoring during server events.

SUPPORT

For issues, suggestions, or questions, contact the author:

- DISCORD: stingplayer
- MINECRAFT USERNAME: Stingplayer_

# SleepBuff

*SleepBuff* is a lightweight Fabric mod that enhances Minecraft’s vanilla sleep mechanic by granting temporary status effects when a player wakes up. Instead of sleep simply skipping the night, waking up now provides a short-lived gameplay bonus.  

This mod is designed to complement vanilla — not replace it. Beds function exactly as they normally do, and sleeping is never required. *SleepBuff* simply adds a small incentive for players who choose to rest.



## ✨ Features

- *Grants temporary positive status effects upon waking*  
- *Encourages consistent sleep without forcing it*  
- *Adds no new items, blocks, GUIs, or complex systems*  
- *Fully server-side compatible* (no client-side requirement if implemented that way)  



## 🎯 Design Philosophy

*SleepBuff* is intentionally minimal and focused. It enhances one specific moment — waking up — without introducing survival overhauls, stamina systems, or fatigue mechanics.  

The changes are subtle, self-contained, and respectful of vanilla balance. Players who choose not to sleep can continue playing exactly as usual.



## ⚙ Technical Details

- *Built for Minecraft 1.21.11*  
- *Requires Fabric Loader*  
- *Requires Fabric API* (if applicable to your implementation)  
- *Uses mixins to hook into the player wake-up event*  



## 📦 Installation

1. *Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.11*  
2. *Install Fabric API (if required)*  
3. *Place the SleepBuff `.jar` file into your `mods` folder*  
4. *Launch the game*  



## 🔗 Compatibility

*SleepBuff* is designed to work alongside other gameplay mods. It does not modify world generation, entities, items, or core systems. Conflicts are unlikely unless another mod directly alters the sleep wake-up logic.

description: GUI-based dungeon loot editor for Spigot / Paper / Purpur 1.21.10-1.21.11
body:
# DungeonLootManager

![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.10--1.21.11-3C8527?style=for-the-badge&logo=minecraft&logoColor=white)
![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Paper%20%7C%20Spigot%20%7C%20Purpur-2EA043?style=for-the-badge)
![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-17%2B-ED8B00?style=for-the-badge&logo=openjdk&logoColor=white)
![Side](https://img.shields.io/badge/Side-Server%20Only-1f6feb?style=for-the-badge)
![GUI](https://img.shields.io/badge/Editor-In--Game%20GUI-F59E0B?style=for-the-badge)

Author: `_4rubka_`

`DungeonLootManager` is a GUI-based loot editor for Paper/Spigot/Purpur that lets you customize vanilla chest loot tables (`minecraft:chests/*`) directly in-game.

## Features

- Browse all vanilla `minecraft:chests/*` loot table IDs.
- Create multiple loot variants per dungeon/structure.
- Set `weight` per variant for weighted random selection.
- Configure per-item `chance`, `min`, and `max` amount.
- Keep full item metadata (name, lore, enchants, and more).
- Choose mode per dungeon: `REPLACE` or `APPEND`.
- Safe delete actions with `Shift + Right Click` confirmation.

## How It Works

1. The plugin listens to `LootGenerateEvent` when chest loot is generated.
2. One variant is selected using weighted random (`weight`).
3. Each entry rolls independently by `chance` and `min/max`.
4. Loot is applied in `REPLACE` or `APPEND` mode.

## Commands & Permissions

- Command: `/dungeonloot`
- Aliases: `/dloot`, `/dlm`
- Permission: `dungeonloot.admin` (default: `op`)
- GUI is player-only (not console)

## Installation

1. Download the plugin `.jar`.
2. Put it into your server `plugins/` folder.
3. Restart the server.
4. Run `/dungeonloot` in-game.

## Config Files

- `plugins/DungeonLootManager/config.yml`
- `plugins/DungeonLootManager/dungeons.yml`
- `settings.fallback-to-vanilla-if-no-variant: true` keeps vanilla loot when no variant is available

body:
# ☁️ Untethered Skies

> *"Solid ground is nothing but a distant memory. Here, the horizon is infinite, and silence is king."*

**Untethered Skies** is not just a survival modpack. It is a solitary expedition across a fractured world, designed to feel like a nostalgic memory. A visual and auditory experience where the void is not an end, but an ocean to cross.

## ⚓ The Call of the Void

You awake on a drifting islet. The ground below is gone. The sky stretches in every direction, vibrant and bottomless.

Forget static bases. In **Untethered Skies**, your home travels with you. Assemble your ship, hoist the balloons, and take the helm. Your vessel is your only refuge against the immensity.

## 🎨 A "Trailer" Aesthetic

The world has been reimagined to capture the essence of official cinematic trailers.

* **Clean Visuals:** Smooth textures, vibrant colors, and a stylized atmosphere that turns every landscape into a painting.
* **Living Physics:** The wind blows, and lanterns sway at the prow of your ship.
* **The Blue Horizon:** No oppressive black void fog. Just the sky, eternally blue, calling you downwards as well as upwards.

## 🎵 Echoes of the Past

The silence of the skies is broken only by a carefully curated soundtrack. Experience the complete collection of **C418**'s melodies, playing continuously. A permanent nostalgia that accompanies every swing of the pickaxe and every sunset.

---

### 📜 Captain's Log

* **Immersion:** This modpack is designed to be experienced. Turn off the HUD (F1), take a breath, and watch the clouds pass.
* **Visuals:** Shaders are highly recommended (and included) to get the intended look of the screenshots.

*Fair winds, traveler.*

title: SecureRedirect
description: Hashed server redirect service.
body:
# SecureRedirect Setup Guide This guide explains how to install and configure the **SecureRedirect** Paper plugin so players can be securely redirected from one server ("main") to another ("dest") using transfer packets and cookies. > Recommended Paper version: **1.21.11** (or later with `Player#transfer` support) > **DISCLAIMER!!! YOU MUST JOIN THE SERVER WITH A PORT, UNLESS THE SERVER HAS AN SRV SET UP (USUALLY ONLY ON SELF-HOSTED SERVERS)** ---
1. Install the plugin ### 1.1. Build or download the JAR If you are using this repo directly: 1. Run: ```bash gradle build ``` 2. The plugin JAR will be at: - `build/libs/SecureRedirect-1.0.2.jar` Copy that JAR to each Paper server that should participate in redirects. ### 1.2. Drop the plugin into each server For **each** Paper server (main and dest): 1. Stop the server if it is running. 2. Place `SecureRedirect-1.0.2.jar` into the `plugins/` folder. 3. Start the server once so it generates `plugins/SecureRedirect/config.yml`.
---
2. Configure the main (source) server This is the server where players join normally and run `/redirect`. Edit `plugins/SecureRedirect/config.yml` on the **main** server. ### 2.1. Basic redirect target ```yaml # Where to send players when using /redirect on MAIN target-host: "your-dest-host" # e.g. "hello.exaroton.me" # Optional. If omitted or invalid, defaults to 25565. # target-port: 25565 # Will be filled by /redirect gen-hash send-hash: "" # Not required on MAIN, can be left empty receive-hash: "" # Players can join MAIN directly require-transfer: false ``` Notes: - If your destination uses the **default port 25565**, you can omit `target-port` entirely. - If your destination uses a custom port (e.g. `25566`), set it explicitly: ```yaml target-port: 25566 ``` ### 2.2. Origin ID (optional) ```yaml # Identifier this server uses when redirecting players origin-id: "main" # On MAIN you typically allow redirects from anywhere, so this list can stay empty allowed-origins: [] ``` You only need to care about `origin-id` and `allowed-origins` if you want to restrict which servers are allowed to redirect **into** another server (see the dest config section). ### 2.3. Generate the send-hash On the **main** server, in-game as an OP or from the console: ```text /redirect gen-hash ``` This will: - Generate a random hex hash. - Save it into `send-hash` in `config.yml`. - Print the value in chat / console. Copy this value; you will paste it into the **dest** server `receive-hash`.
---
3. Configure the destination server This is the server that players are redirected TO. ### 3.1. Enable transfers in server.properties Edit `server.properties` on the **dest** server: ```properties accepts-transfers=true ``` Then **fully restart** the dest server. ### 3.2. Basic config.yml Edit `plugins/SecureRedirect/config.yml` on the **dest** server: ```yaml # target-host/target-port are only needed if DEST will redirect players onward. # For a simple two-server setup you can leave them as defaults. target-host: "127.0.0.1" # Optional. If omitted or invalid, defaults to 25565. # target-port: 25565 # Optional on DEST unless you want it to send players further. send-hash: "" # IMPORTANT: must match MAIN's send-hash receive-hash: "" # Identifier this server uses when redirecting players origin-id: "dest" # Which origin servers are allowed to redirect into DEST. # Make sure this list contains MAIN's origin-id. allowed-origins: - "main" # Block direct joins; only transfers are allowed require-transfer: true kick-no-transfer-message: "You must join this server via secure redirect." kick-bad-hash-message: "Invalid or missing redirect token." ``` ### 3.3. Restart after editing After changing `config.yml` on DEST, **restart the server** (or at least reload the plugin) so the new values are applied.
---
4. Using the plugin ### 4.1. Redirect yourself On the **main** server, as a player with permission: ```text /redirect ``` This will: - Attach a cookie to you containing `:` from MAIN. - Use Mojang's transfer packet to move you to `target-host:target-port`. ### 4.2. Redirect another player ```text /redirect ``` Permissions: - `secureredirect.redirect` – use `/redirect` on yourself. - `secureredirect.redirect.others` – use `/redirect `. - `secureredirect.genhash` – use `/redirect gen-hash`. ### 4.3. Rotating the token Any time you want to change the secret token: 1. On MAIN, run: ```text /redirect gen-hash ``` 2. Copy the new `send-hash` value. 3. On DEST, update `receive-hash` in `config.yml` to this new value. 4. Restart DEST so it reads the new config.
---
5. Advanced: origin-id and allowed-origins The plugin encodes the redirect token as: ```text : ``` On DEST, when a player joins via transfer, the plugin: 1. Verifies `player.isTransferred()`. 2. Reads and parses the cookie into `origin-id` and `hash`. 3. Checks that `hash` matches `receive-hash`. 4. If `allowed-origins` is **non-empty**, checks that `origin-id` is listed there. This lets you restrict which servers are allowed to redirect into DEST. **Example multi-origin setup:** - MAIN server: ```yaml origin-id: "main" allowed-origins: [] ``` - LOBBY server: ```yaml origin-id: "lobby" allowed-origins: [] ``` - DEST server: ```yaml origin-id: "dest" allowed-origins: - "main" - "lobby" ``` Now only `main` and `lobby` can send players into `dest` (provided their hashes also match `receive-hash`).
---
6. Troubleshooting ### 6.1. Stuck on "Transferring to a new server..." If the client never finishes transferring and no errors appear in the console: - Check on the **DEST** server: - `accepts-transfers=true` is set in `server.properties`. - The server is actually Paper 1.21.x (not Spigot or a proxy binary). - Check on the **MAIN** server: - `target-host` and `target-port` point to the correct DEST address. - Watch the DEST console while running `/redirect`: - If no login/join messages appear, the client is not reaching that server (host/port/host limitations). ### 6.2. Direct join still works on DEST - Ensure on DEST `config.yml`: ```yaml require-transfer: true ``` - Restart DEST after changing the config. - Make sure `SecureRedirect` is listed as enabled in `/plugins`. ### 6.3. "Invalid or missing redirect token" - Confirm that on DEST: - `receive-hash` exactly matches MAIN's `send-hash`. - Confirm that on DEST: - `allowed-origins` contains MAIN's `origin-id` (or is empty to allow any).

title: Kris's texts
description: Replaces Minecraft’s English (US) text with clean, consistent sentence case for improved readability, while preserving proper nouns, dimensions, and boss names.
body:
# Sentence case language pack

A lightweight resource pack for **Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11** that converts the default **English (US)** language file from widespread Title Case to consistent, readable **sentence case**.

This pack replaces **only** `en_us.json`. No textures, models, sounds, or gameplay mechanics are changed.

## Purpose

Minecraft’s default UI capitalizes nearly everything (“Diamond Sword”, “Monster Hunter”), which is visually loud and inconsistent with normal English usage.

This pack aims to:
- Improve readability
- Make UI text feel more natural
- Preserve Minecraft’s established terminology and proper nouns
- Stay stylistically consistent across the entire game

## What this pack changes

Only text capitalization is modified. Specifically:

- Item and block names
- UI labels, menus, and buttons
- Advancement titles and descriptions
- Tooltips, subtitles, and system messages

No wording, punctuation, or formatting logic is altered.

## Capitalization rules used

This pack follows a **strict and consistent rule set**:

### Sentence case
- Most strings use sentence case:
  - “Diamond sword”
  - “Pause menu”
  - “Monster hunter”
  - “Crafting a new look”

### Proper nouns preserved
The following always remain capitalized:
- **Minecraft**, **Mojang**, **Microsoft**
- **Java** (e.g. “Java Virtual Machine”)
- **Realm / Realms**
- **Snapshot / Snapshots**
- **PvP**
- **The Nether**, **The End**, **Overworld**
- **Ender** (always capitalized)

### Mob names in sentences
- **Generic mobs are lowercase** in sentences:
  - villager, breeze, phantom, zombie, skeleton, etc.
- **Boss / titled mobs stay capitalized** everywhere:
  - **Ender Dragon**
  - **Wither**
  - **Elder Guardian**

Examples:
- “Kill a breeze with a deflected breeze-shot wind charge”
- “Follow an eye of Ender”
- “Look at the Ender Dragon through a spyglass”

### Items, blocks, and variants
- Items and blocks use sentence case:
  - “Weathered copper golem statue”
  - “Block of amethyst”
- Canonical entity names are lowercased when used adjectivally:
  - “copper golem statue” (not “Copper Golem statue”)

### Other rules
- Difficulty names are lowercase in sentences:
  - peaceful, easy, normal, hard
- Keyboard keys are capitalized:
  - Enter, Escape, Shift
- Acronyms remain uppercase:
  - TNT, CPU, GPU, ID, GUI

### Creative and artistic content untouched
The following are intentionally preserved:
- Music disc titles
- Artist names
- Painting titles
- Lore-style proper names

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft version:** Java Edition 1.21.11  
- **Mod loaders:** Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Quilt  
- **Language:** English (US) only  
- **Conflicts:** None (only replaces `en_us.json`)

## Installation

Downloadable on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/kris-texts)

1. Download the resource pack `.zip`
2. Place it into your `resourcepacks` folder
3. Launch Minecraft
4. Go to **Options → Resource Packs**
5. Enable the pack
6. Ensure **English (US)** is selected under **Options → Language**

## Credits

Created by **Kris** - [kristianbenko.com](https://www.kristianbenko.com/)

## License

Free to use and modify. Credit appreciated but not required.

title: Bingus SMP Content
description: Extra content made for the Bingus SMP.
body:
This mod features various new blocks, items, and features made for the Bingus SMP, a publicly available SMP. These include, but are not limited to:
- Prismarine Ore: Gives Prismarine Shards and Crystals upon mining, which is boosted by Fortune. Includes a Deepslate variant and naturally spawns underground beneath oceans.
- End Respawn Anchor: Allows players to set their respawn point in the End. Takes Ender Pearls as charge. (Can be disabled in the config)
- New decorative blocks, such as a scarecrow block, new mob heads, and colored paint blocks.
- Paint Bombs: TNT-like blocks that spread their respective paint upon exploding.
- Ebony Wood: A new wood type. Includes trees that naturally spawn in Sparse Jungles.
- Redstone Shrieker: Releases the Warden's shriek attack when recieving a Redstone signal. Has low damage and very high knockback.
- Genetic Compass: A compass-like item that tracks the nearest player within 64 blocks. (Range can be defined in the config)
- Cleavers: A new tiered weapon that has a 30% chance to drop mob heads on kill. Also works with Player heads and the new mob heads.
- Can now load Echo Shards into Crossbows. Shoots Echo Shard projectiles that inflict entities with Darkness and convert blocks to Sculk. (Can be disabled in the config)
- Trial vaults are now infinitely reusable for players. (Can be disabled in the config)
- Backported the Lava Chicken music disc from 1.21.7.

Just Enough Items is recommended for the best experience.
You are allowed to use this mod in your own modpacks and release them to the public. However, you cannot redistribute this mod to other sites. CurseForge and Modrinth are the only official release sites for this mod.

title: chest auto close
description: A small mod that automatically closes the chest if the required item is not found.
body:
### **!!!PEPELAND MODERATION APPROVED!!!**
A small mod that automatically closes the chest if the required item is not found.
  When the item is found, the chest can stay open for a short configurable delay.

  Usage:


```
  /chestautoclose {item} {count}

```

  Closes chest if there are <{count} number of items inside.


```
  /chestautoclose {item}

```

  Closes chest if there are no {item} inside.


```
  /chestautoclose

```

  Disables the mod.


```
  /founddelay {ticks}

```

  Sets delay (in ticks) before closing when the item is found. Default: 2.


```
  /notfounddelay {ticks}

```

  Sets delay (in ticks) before closing when the item is not found. Default: 0.

# DoorKnock - Interactive Door Sounds
DoorKnock adds knock sounds to doors in Minecraft, enhancing immersion and player interaction. Players can knock on doors with different variations, while server administrators have full control over permissions and configuration.

![Cover](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dfc1038cef3294d453d80edab575dd46b450c5ad.png)

## Features
- Sounds - Different knock sounds for various door materials
- Soft Knocks - Hold Shift for quiet knocking
- Permission System - Fine-grained control over who can knock and hear
- Color Support - Full hex color support in messages
- Customizable - Extensive configuration options

## How to Use
- Normal Knock: Left-click on any door
- Soft Knock: Hold Shift + Left-click for quiet knocking
- Admin Commands: ``/doorknock reload`` to refresh configuration
  
## Commands & Permissions
### Commands
- ``/doorknock reload`` - Reload plugin configuration
- ``/dk reload`` - Short alias for reload command
### Permissions
- ``doorknock.knock`` - Allows players to knock on doors (default: true)
- ``doorknock.hear`` - Allows players to hear door knocks (default: true)
- ``doorknock.admin`` - Allows admin commands like reload (default: op)

title: Soulflow
description: A social-based soul-exchanging Mod!
body:
# Soulflow
![A totem of Transference](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/86f047d6fb24e9b3e9a41bd9061f986086b935f6.png)

The Soulflow Mod uses the Impersonate library to add a variety of items that let you swap identities with other players! You can find these items in structures or from mob drops, and you can also craft them at the Alchemy Table.

##  Soulexchanging Items:

![A totem of Transference](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b122fc8d0afb52226e248d6619f3839f4389789.png)
### Totem of Transference
The Totem of Transference will exchange your soul with that of a targeted player!

Obtained from:
- The Alchemy Table
- Killing Witches
- Woodland Mansions 
- Pillager Outposts



![A totem of the Void](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0209a9175e029069d65d56a3c3171083c526af6f.png)
### Totem of the Void
The Totem of the Void exchanges your soul with someone random nearby!

Obtained from:
- The Alchemy Table
- End Cities 
- Strongholds



![A Totem of Spores](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f6422142680d69b4456f0d5b9084f8f0cb4c2c6.png)
### Totem of Spores
The Totem of Spores mimics another player's appearance!

Obtained from:
- The Alchemy Table
- Killing Mooshrooms



![a sunken grimoire](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/99e0cbbe328d869b582cfeef8a155a1b6cbdc44a.png)
### Sunken Grimoire
The Sunken Grimoire will turn you back into your real self!

Obtained from:
- Killing Drowneds
- Buried Treasure
- Shipwrecks

##  Crafting Items:



![Hollow Totem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3d1ec31fe168c64cc471cf97631062baad642dd.png)
### Hollow Totem
Used as a base totem for the Alchemy Table!

Obtained from:
- Crafting it! (1 Netherite Scrap, 4 Iron Nuggets)
- Mineshafts 
- Mob Spawners 
- Ruined Portals 
- Woodland Mansions



![Soul](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41fadde1de24bb666ac5a10797a87122b959d1e0.png)
### Soul
Used for crafting things in the Alchemy Table!

A soul is only obtained by smelting Soul Sand or Soul Soil!



![Alchemy Table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9d91ce251c7eff2021ad9bbb34a53dfa671232b.png)
### Alchemy Table
Used to craft totems!

It can only be obtained from crafting it! (6 Blackstone, 2 Amethyst Shards, 1 Soul)

Recipes:
- Fermented Spider Eye + Hollow Totem + Soul -> Totem of Transference
- Ender Eye + Hollow Totem + Soul -> Totem of the Void
- Red Mushroom Block + Hollow Totem + Soul -> Totem of Spores


## Commands

### /soultransform
A command exclusive to operators! It lets you set/clear anyone's appearance!

*The Impersonate Library brings its own command to do this, however it is recommended to use this one!*

### Gamerules:

| *Gamerule*  | *Purpose* |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| ```soulflow:exchangeInventories```  | Whether a soul exchange will swap the inventories of players!  |
| ```soulflow:exchangeEnderchest```  | Whether a soul exchange will swap the contents of players' ender chests!  |
| ```soulflow:exchangeHealth```  | Whether a soul exchange will swap the health of players!  |
| ```soulflow:exchangeEffects```  | Whether a soul exchange will swap the effects of players!  |
| ```soulflow:disablePrivateMessages```  | Disables the /msg command, so that it's harder to tell who's who!  |

On Default, all Gamerules are enabled!

However, the Impersonate Library adds its own gamerules!

| *Gamerule*  | *Purpose* |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| ```impersonate:fakeCapes```  | Whether impersonators should get the cape and elytra of impersonated players.   |
| ```impersonate:opRevealImpersonations```  | Whether ongoing impersonations should be revealed to online server operators.  |
| ```impersonate:logRevealImpersonations```  | Whether ongoing impersonations should be revealed in the server logs.   |

## Libraries

This project uses Impersonate by Pyrofab, licensed under LGPL-3.0-only.

The library's source code can be obtained from: https://github.com/Ladysnake/Impersonate

title: Waxed Lightly Weathered Cut Copper Moon

## 🌙 Waxed Lightly Weathered Cut Copper Moon

This project is inspired by the original idea posted on Reddit, where [u/Squirelwithabaguette](https://www.reddit.com/user/Squirelwithabaguette/) showcased a full **“cycle of the Waxed Lightly Weathered Cut Copper Moon”** using Minecraft’s copper oxidation stages. So, Imade it!
 
### 📝 Original Idea Credit

# Minecraft Together

**Minecraft Together** is a comprehensive modpack designed to enhance the multiplayer experience. It strikes a perfect balance between stunning visuals, immersive social features, and high-performance optimization, making it the ideal choice for playing with friends.

## 🌟 Key Features

### 🗣️ Social & Immersion
Play together like never before with integrated voice chat and visual interactions.
*   **Voice Chat:** Powered by **Plasmo Voice**, including add-ons for groups and broadcasting.
*   **Visual Interactions:** See who is talking with **TalkingHeads** and view chat avatars with **Chat Heads**.
*   **Party System:** Easily manage teams and protect your land with **Open Parties and Claims**.

### 🎨 Visuals & Realism
A completely overhauled visual experience without sacrificing the vanilla feel.
*   **Stunning Graphics:** Pre-configured with **Iris Shaders** and the **Complementary Reimagined** shader pack.
*   **High Fidelity:** Includes **Faithful 64x**, **Fresh Animations**, **Round Trees**, and **Better Leaves**.
*   **Physics & Lighting:** enhanced by **Physics Mod** and **LambDynamicLights**.
*   **LOD Rendering:** See further than ever with **Distant Horizons**.

### 🛠️ Quality of Life (QoL)
Essential improvements to make gameplay smoother and more convenient.
*   **Navigation:** Never get lost with **Xaero's Minimap & World Map**, featuring remote player waypoints.
*   **Inventory Management:** Organize effortlessly with **Inventory Profiles Next** and search items with **REI**.
*   **Visual Helpers:** Includes **AppleSkin** (food saturation), **Visual Workbench**, and **Redstone Auxiliary**.

### ⚙️ Gameplay & Tech
Expand your creative and technical possibilities.
*   **Automation:** Build complex computers and robots with **CC: Tweaked**.
*   **Building Tools:** Use **WorldEdit** and **Blueprints** for grand constructions.
*   **Exploration:** Utilize **Freecam** for better viewing and **FallingTree** for quick timber gathering.

### 🚀 Performance & Optimization
Optimized to run smoothly on both clients and servers.
*   **Rendering Core:** Built on **Sodium**, **Lithium**, and **Indium** for maximum FPS.
*   **Smart Optimization:** Features **Dynamic FPS**, **Entity Culling**, and **ImmediatelyFast**.
*   **Server Health:** Includes **Tick Stasis** to pause the server when empty, saving resources.

---
*This modpack focuses on a "Vanilla+" experience with added technical and social layers.*

Setting this up with a server host is likely more work than most players will want to do, so I recommend using a mod like [e4mc](https://modrinth.com/mod/e4mc), [World Host](https://modrinth.com/mod/world-host), or [Essential](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential).

<details>
<summary>🕹️ Player Roles 🕹️</summary>

# Slime

**Your role is to remain unseen. Yet you must fulfill the needs of the slime colony to prevent exposure.**

**🟩 Oozing Mimicry [Primary]:** Your body is mutable clay. Focus on a common interactable object, and your form will ripple into a flawless facsimile. Release your focus, and the disguise melts away into your natural state.

**🟩 Cloak in Stillness [Sneak]:** When wearing a stolen shape, you may still yourself entirely, sinking into the world’s grid like a shadow slipping between cracks. Only the keenest eyes will sense the wrongness in your stillness.

**🟩 Corrosive Touch [Left Click]:** Focus your acidic essence onto a single block, causing it to dissolve instantly. This ability can only be performed once every 30 seconds. Use it to create new hiding spots.

**🟡 Gravity's Paradox:** The ground is your tar and your trampoline. It clings to your every step, yet rewards every leap with a resilient, gravity-defying bounce.

**🔴 Peril of Desiccation:** The seekers wield weapons of pure desiccation, designed to shrivel your mass. A single touch means instantaneous dissolution. Disguise and evasion are your only defense.

**🔴 Slimy Imperative:** Periodically, your kind is driven by a primal need. If no slime fulfills this need, a psychic backlash will ripple through the hive, revealing all of your locations to the hunters.

# Seeker

**Your role is to hunt down and contain the infestation. Complete this goal in time or suffer failure.**

**🟢 Desiccator’s Blade:** Your blade emits a field of rapid desiccation. It is anathema to the slime’s gelatinous biology. A clean strike will instantly dehydrate a mimic, reducing it to an inert stain.

**🟢 Desiccation Launcher:** A ranged instrument that fires concentrated absorbent packets, allowing you to test suspicious objects and eliminate targets from a distance.

**🟢 Keen Senses:** Your hunter's vision pierces the deepest shadows, and your movements are unnervingly swift and powerful. The environment offers you no resistance.

**🟢 Unyielding Form:** You are a warden of order. Even the slimes' pathetic struggles cannot harm you. Your only vulnerability is failure.

**🔴 Sterilization Protocol:** The contagion must be contained within the operational window. If a single slime organism remains undissolved at zero, the area is considered lost to the infestation, and you have failed.

# Spectator

**You cannot interact with the world, nor can it interact with you. Your role is to watch, learn, and await the next round.**

SpringWalk is a mod focused on transforming how walking through the Minecraft world sounds and feels, inspired by the heavy, metallic footsteps of Springtrap. Designed for NeoForge 1.21.1, it adds a special pair of boots with a unique look and a fully custom audio system that reacts dynamically to the player’s movement.

title: Lost Loot
description: Trade for loot which has been destroyed, broken, or despawned
body:
# Lost Loot
**Lost Loot** is a vanilla-friendly Spigot plugin that allows you to trade for previously destroyed items.

![Trade menu with a wandering trader for an item previously deleted](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ba2d08b1c87bdc8bbcce603e77e69f4c12bce80.png)

Minecraft is one of the harshest games concerning inventory contents. It will genuinely delete your items with very little concern for backing them up or saving them. Sometimes when you die, your gear doesn’t just drop, it's *destroyed*. Maybe it falls into lava, gets blown up, despawns, or gets blasted into oblivion. Either way, the result is the same: **your items are gone forever**.

**Lost Loot** introduces a vanilla-friendly system for recovering gear that would normally be unrecoverable.

Instead of deleting items when they break, burn, or vanish, this plugin quietly stores them in a hidden **Lost Loot inventory** unique to each player.

## 🧳 Retrieving Your Lost Loot

#### **You buy your lost items back from Wandering Traders.**

When you interact with a Wandering Trader, Lost Loot temporarily adds special trades offering your lost items for emeralds. These trades are visible only to you, ensuring no one else can buy your items before you do.

#### **How it works**
- Each lost item appears as a custom trade.
- Prices are determined by:
  - Item rarity  
  - Enchantments  
  - Damage state  
  - A balanced random price curve  
- When the menu closes, the trader’s trades return to normal.
- Items you recover are removed from your Lost Loot pool.

This keeps the whole system optional, balanced, and immersive.

---

## 🔑 Key Features

### 💾 **Automatic Lost-Item Tracking**
Lost Loot intercepts items that would otherwise be destroyed, including:

- Durability-broken gear  
- Items burned in lava or fire  
- Items blown up by TNT or creepers  
- Items that despawn  
- Items removed when chunks unload  
- Death drops that spawn in dangerous or inaccessible areas  

If the item has value (enchantments, rarity, custom name), it is rescued instead of deleted.

## 🎁 **Condensed & Organized Storage**
Items are sorted into three rarity tiers:

- **Uncommon**  
- **Rare**  
- **Epic**

Each tier is automatically:

- **Condensed** (smart stacking)  
- Saved per player in JSON  
- Persisted across server restarts  

## ✨ **Smart Rarity Assignment**
Items that don’t naturally have a rarity get one assigned dynamically if they are:

- Enchanted  
- Custom-named  
- Broken from durability  

This ensures that important equipment is always recoverable, while trivial items are ignored.

## 🛠 **Safe & Exploit-Resistant**
Lost Loot includes strong protections:

- No duplication (trade caching + recipe validation)  
- Restores original Wandering Trader trades upon closing  
- Recognizes chunk unload to avoid false “loss” events  
- Only stores *destroyed* items, never intentional drops  

## 📚 **Commands**

#### `/lostloot`
- Operator-only  
- Instantly returns all stored Lost Loot to the executing player  
- Mainly for debugging, emergencies, or testing  

## 💾 **Persistent Per-Player Data**
Every player has a dedicated file at: ``plugins/LostLoot/lostloot/<uuid>.json``

Lost items survive:

- Restarts  
- Crashes  
- World reloads  
- Player absence  

Everything is completely automatic.

# Hardcore Realism

This is a hardcore realism-focused modpack created for a long-term survival world with Mogusguy and Chunk_Borderzzz. Every mechanic is designed to make Minecraft feel more grounded, intense, and unforgiving, while still being fun to master.

Survival is no longer simple. Food spoils, temperatures matter, tools wear down faster, and the environment is just as dangerous as the mobs. You will need to plan ahead, manage resources carefully, and think realistically about how you build, travel, and fight.

Exploration is slower and more meaningful. The world feels alive, dangerous, and immersive, with tougher enemies, deeper progression, and limited second chances. Death is heavily punished, making every decision count.

## This modpack is built for:
- Hardcore survival experience  
- Maximum immersion and realism  
- Long-term worlds with real risk  
- Players who enjoy challenge, preparation, and strategy  

There are no shortcuts. Only skill, planning, and teamwork will keep you alive.

title: Burgeon
description: Flower based progression, tools and weapons!
body:
Burgeon expands the definition of flora in Minecraft, transforming plants from static scenery into active tools for survival, combat, and cultivation. The pack introduces a variety of organic equipment and interactive blocks that bridge the gap between nature and technology.

[WIKI](https://asdru22.github.io/Burgeon/burgeon.pdf)

### **Living Weaponry and Utilities**
Plants in Burgeon are often harvested for their latent abilities, serving as biological alternatives to standard gear.

* **The Bursting Blossom:** This plant functions as a volatile explosive. When powered by redstone, it pops and shoots 6 homing petals, dealing damage to hostile entities nearby before destroying itself.
* **Healing Flora:**
    * **Blooming Bulb:** This item acts as a potent regenerative consumable. Using it instantly heals the player 6 health.
    * **Scarlet Fang:** This weapon drains the player's health to spawn a homing spore that damages hit enemies while also restoring the consumed health.
* **Rootsplit Sickle:** This weapon can be used on its own, but also combined into a **Rootsplit Staff**. Upon being combined, it grants the player a burst of **Speed** and **Hunger**
* **Pointerpod:** Acting as a navigational trinket, this item can be used to guide the player toward a mysterious structure.

### **Functional Decoration**
The new decorative blocks are designed with intricate interaction mechanics, serving as the backbone for the pack's "tech" progression.

* **The Spile:** Far from a simple aesthetic tap, the Spile is a functional device used for resource extraction. When placed on a **Creaking Heart** that is in an "awake" state, it has a chance to fill a bottle with **Goop**. However, here is a 5% chance the Spile will drain the life from the tree, converting the Heart into a Pale Oak Log.
* **The Etched Vase:** This block serves as a highly interactive planter. Unlike standard flower pots, the Etched Vase accepts different types of **soil** and **seeds**. It can be powered by Redstone to remove harbored plants and allows the player to use **Goop** (extracted via the Spile) to accelerate the growth of the planted

description: An add-on for FancyMenu that adds support for my NBTApi mod.
body:
### NBTApi FancyMenu Add-on
The add-on has only been tested on Minecraft 1.20.1 with FancyMenu 3.7.0. If you can get the mod to work on other versions, please report it on issues.

This mod adds support for the NBTApi mod to FancyMenu, allowing you to view or edit world data directly in the menu.

This add-on adds:
- Set NBT Action - this action allows you to change the value of an NBT parameter in the format world|path|value

  For example:

```
New World|Data.LevelName|New Name
```


- NBT Value Placeholder - allows you to display the NBT value from the world in any text field, in the format of a regular FancyMenu placeholder, parameters - world and path.

  For example:

```
{“placeholder”:“nbt_value”,“values”:{“world”:“New World”,‘path’:“Data.LevelName”}}
```


- NBT Value Requirement - this is a requirement for a specific NBT value in the format world|path|operator|value.
The operators are simple - ==, !=, >, <, >=, <=, and contains (for strings).

  For example:

```
New World|Data.GameType|==|1
```

```
New World|Data.LevelName|contains|Test
```

```
New World|Data.Difficulty|>|0
```

title: FrostBoat
description: Frost Walker now works with BOAT!
body:
# FrostBoat

A Minecraft (Paper/Spigot) plugin that allows you to use the Frost Walker enchantment in boats.

## Description

FrostBoat extends the functionality of the Frost Walker enchantment, allowing you to freeze the water surface around your boat. When a player is in a boat and wearing boots with the Frost Walker enchantment, the water around the boat will automatically freeze, creating an icy path.

## Features

- ✅ Works with Frost Walker enchantment on boots
- ✅ Freezes the water surface around the boat
- ✅ Effect radius depends on enchantment level (2 + level)
- ✅ Uses frosted ice that melts over time
- ✅ Compatible with Paper/Spigot 1.21+

## How to Use

1. Install the plugin on your server
2. Equip boots with the Frost Walker enchantment
3. Get into a boat
4. As you move in the boat, the water around you will freeze!
