description: Restores balance in cross-play PvP matches. Enables Bedrock Edition Geyser players to pop totems straight from inventory, mitigating physical touch-control lag.
body:
# RetroBedrockTotem **A lightweight plugin that gives your Bedrock (Floodgate) players a custom PvP buff!**
**RetroBedrockTotem** is a simple, plug-and-play plugin that gives your Bedrock (Floodgate) players a special advantage, perfect for PvP, anarchy, or any fast-paced server. Normally, totems only work from your hands. This plugin changes the rules **for Bedrock players only**, allowing their totems to activate from **anywhere in their inventory**! --- ## ✨ Features * **Activates Totems From Anywhere:** Scans the entire inventory for a Totem of Undying on fatal damage. * **Bedrock (Floodgate) Only:** This buff applies *only* to players connected via Floodgate. Your Java players keep vanilla mechanics. * **Lightweight & Efficient:** Optimized to add zero lag to combat. It only runs checks on a fatal blow. * **Vanilla-Friendly Effects:** Plays all the standard totem sounds, particles, and applies the correct Regeneration/Absorption effects. * **Zero Config:** Just drag, drop, and play. No setup needed! --- ## 📦 Requirements This plugin **requires** two things to function: 1. **A Spigot/Paper/Folia Server:** Works on Spigot and any of its forks (Paper, Pufferfish, Purpur, Folia, etc.). 2. **[Floodgate](https://modrinth.com/plugin/floodgate):** This is essential for detecting Bedrock players. The plugin will not work without it. --- ## 💾 Installation 1. Download the latest `.jar` file from the "Versions" tab. 2. Drop the `RetroBedrockTotem.jar` into your server's `/plugins` folder. 3. Restart your server. There are no configs, commands, or permissions. It just works! --- ### 💬 Support & Source Code Got an idea or found a bug? Please create an issue on the [**Official GitHub Repository**](https://github.com/AJARETRO/RetroBedrockTotem)!

title: ValeTickets
description: ValeTickets intends to make it easy for players to ask for help and for staff to keep track of it. It’s a small plugin with in‑game commands and a tiny web page for staff. I run this in my spare time, so I try to keep it practical and safe.
body:
# ValeTickets - simple ticketing for your server

ValeTickets intends to make it easy for players to ask for help and for staff to keep track of it. It’s a small plugin with in‑game commands and a tiny web page for staff. I run this in my spare time, so I try to keep it practical and safe.

## ▶️ Quick start
1. Drop the jar in `plugins/` and start the server once.
2. In‑game (as OP), run `/ticketsetup` to create the owner account.
3. Visit `http://<server-ip>:<configured-port>/admin` and sign in.
4. Add admins with `/ticketadmin add <username>`.
5. Players use `/ticket` to file tickets and `/ticket check` to see updates.

If `/admin` returns 401, the owner account may not exist yet or the credentials are wrong.

## 📖 What it does
- Players can open tickets in chat with a short guided flow.
- Staff can view tickets on a small web dashboard.
- Optional file uploads (screenshots/logs) with type/size limits.
- Simple roles: `OWNER` (can manage accounts) and `ADMIN`.
- Basic rate limiting on the public form to reduce spam.
- In-game notifications when tickets are updated.
- *DiscordSRV integration support planned for future versions.*

## 🎮 Commands
Players
- `/ticket` - start a short guided flow to create a ticket
- `/ticket check` - view your tickets and their status

Admins
- `/ticketadmin passwd` - change your own password

Owner
- `/ticketsetup` - create the first owner account (permission: `valetickets.setup`)
- `/ticketadmin add <username>` - add an admin
- `/ticketadmin reset <username>` - reset an admin’s password
- `/ticketadmin list` - list accounts
- `/ticketreload` - reload plugin config and restart the web server (permission: `valetickets.reload`)

Examples
- `/ticketadmin add alice`
- `/ticketadmin reset bob`

## 🌐 Web interface
- Public form: `http://<server-ip>:8765/`
- Admin dashboard: `http://<server-ip>:8765/admin`
- Change password: `http://<server-ip>:8765/change-password`

## 🔒 Security
- Passwords are hashed with **Argon2id**. No plaintext, ever.
- The plugin ships as a single jar with needed libraries inside.

## ⚙️ Config
`plugins/ValeTickets/config.yml`

```yml
web:
  enabled: true
  bind: 0.0.0.0
  port: 8765
  # How to show ticket URLs to players
  urlDisplay:
    mode: "ip"                                # "ip", "domain", or "custom"
    domain: "your-server.com"                 # Used when mode is "domain"
    customMessage: "Check our website!"       # Used when mode is "custom"
  uploads:
    enabled: true
    dir: uploads
    maxBytesPerTicket: 104857600   # 100 MB total
    maxBytesPerFile:   10485760    # 10 MB per file
    allowedTypes: ["png", "jpg", "jpeg", "txt"]
  rateLimit:
    windowSeconds: 600
    maxTicketsPerWindow: 3
```

If anything’s unclear, feel free to open an issue. The plugin is intended to be simple to run on a normal Paper server.

This Plugin was built with the use of GPT-5, Gemini 2.5, and Claude Sonnet 4. As such, profiting off this plugin through redistribution or use in servers with P2W features is **prohibited**. 
Please see license file for more information.

title: FakeThings
description: Add fake item & fake block for your game.
body:
Add fake item & fake block for your game.

Has been open-sourced on [GitHub](https://github.com/yiyuyan/FakeThings).

This command can spawn a fake item:
```
/give-fake <item> (count) (damage) (player(s))
```
or this command:
```
/give <player(s)> <item>{fake_item:<item>} (count)
```
The maximum durability and item stack limit of a fake item disguised as a specified item, as well as properties like attack animation, are the same as those of the disguised item.

However, the fake item cannot be used, and its actual attack damage is 0, with a mining speed of 1.0, rather than the values displayed in the non-item tooltip.

When fake item are worn by players, they do not provide actual armor values, armor toughness, or other attributes.

When the disguised item is a block, the placed block will automatically turn into a fake block.

Fake block have no drops and have the same hardness as stone.

Tips:
- Fake items do not have durability, and you can use this method to distinguish whether a specified item is a fake item;
- Fake blocks will be removed when the game save is closed;
- The items displayed in the gallery are all fake.

Fabric 1.17-1.20: [Persistent Pearls](https://modrinth.com/mod/persistent-pearls) adds a similar gamerule. However, their mixin may break other mods that modify vanilla pearl behavior.

title: Vanilluxe
description: A Vanilla+ modpack for 1.21.1, bringing improved performance, terrain generation, aesthetics, and many useful utilities!
body:
A Vanilla+ modpack for 1.21.1, bringing improved performance, terrain generation, aesthetics, and many useful utilities!

With [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith) and [Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tectonic), terrain generation is vastly improved! Explore the world with a few bits and bobs from [Dungeons and Taverns](https://modrinth.com/user/NovaWostra)! With [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons), you can see the beautiful terrain and structures! This is further improved by [Complementary Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-unbound)! Truly, the most beautiful way to see Minecraft.

But that's not all! Performance mods like [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) (for rendering) and [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) (for game logic) bring your FPS to new heights! Maybe enough to counter the effects of Distant Horizons and Shaders??

Finally, I have included resource packs from [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/)! These include:
* More Zombies
* Various Retro MC Resources
* Unobtrusive Utilities
* Various Aesthetics (mostly my personal preferences)
* Some 3D Textures
* Consistency and General Fixes

## Vanilla Incompatibility
Most mods in this pack were chosen to be compatible with Vanilla clients. However, one major choice prevented compatibility - that being [Vanilla Backport](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanillabackport), which brings features from 1.21.4 and 1.21.8 to 1.21.1 (namely, The Garden Awakens and Chase the Skies). Due to this major compatibility breaker, I added a few more non-compatible mods:
* Fast Paintings
* Staaaaaaaaaaaack (Stxck)
* Trash Slot

Besides those listed, all mods *should* work with Vanilla clients. Feel free to remove the incompatible mods and use on a server :)

title: Provide Pack Hashes
description: A plugin for automatic caching of server resourcepack's SHA1 hash. This allows you to not specify hash manually, while letting players join with downloading the pack only once
body:
## Remember Url Hashes


### What It Does
This plugin helps your players avoid re-downloading server resource packs when you already have them.  


### Why Is This Plugin Needed?
- Vanilla Minecraft already tries to do this, but **if the server doesn't have** SHA1 hash manually specified in server.properties, the client downloads the pack every time  
- The plugin **stores the previous hash** and other resource pack data (based on the url), so the server can send that hash to players  
- If your pack url stays the same between updates, you can easily run a command **to update the hash**  
- You can even **set a new pack URL** from console and automatically prepare its hash!  


### Commands

![Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb3b74d7a127740add47585b07e0cf940b925831.png)

The plugin keeps track of your server resource pack's Id, URL **and SHA-1 hash**:  
You can check that with **`/urlhashesstate`**:  

![Plugin's Data State](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0f5621c76b9d0b06cef1b7adee4857cd6b0827e.png)


#### Updating the hash or changing the URL
If you updated the pack's url, the plugin will update the hash automatically, because the URL changed.  
But if your link is always the same, you can easily run a command to **update the hash** whenever you want:  

- **`/urlHashesUpdateHash`** to **update the SHA-1 hash**  

Or even tell the plugin to completely change the link to a new version and update the hash:  

- **`/urlHashesChangePackUrl`** to **change the resource pack link** and update hashes  
Note: this command can only be executed from console by default for security reasons  

Both will tell you that it started to download the pack to determine it's hash:

![Hash Update Or Full Pack URL Change](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c7398cfe5f40062b7026e675976e19c832be6719.png)

And everything will always be visible in your console too:

![Console On Hash Update Or URL Change](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1bbad261a6cc23de6270302ff2c34548c77db7a3.png)

You can tell the plugin to save the data between restarts:

- **`/urlhashestogglesaving`** to toggle **data saving**

![Toggling Saving Data](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94248dd84da4cfa7c8924dda0ff30ad84ea73932.png)

So when the server restarts or reloads, it won't download the pack again:

![Loaded With Saved Data](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4384bdbb6bad0e6f6e2ea3ccaeb4ae166210ffc.png)

Note, that with saving and the same link all the time, you'll need to run **`/urlHashesUpdateHash`** yourself. Again, only if your link stays the same between updates.

### Config Options

You can edit plugin's settings in the config (**`plugins/config/ProvidePackHashes`**)
The only exclusive option there at the moment is whether you allow players (with permissions) to change the pack URL, or just console (by default).


### Supported Environment
Paper servers (1.21 - 1.21.8)  

### Alternative approach
You can have the same behaviour on your client, if you play on a server with this issue and you aren't an administrator.  
For this, use my Fabric client-side mod: [Remember Url Hashes](https://modrinth.com/mod/rememberurlhashes/)

title: Comms Array Uplink
description: A server-side fabric mod for restricting the chat to people that you've met
body:
A server-side mod for restricting the chat to people you've met.
When two players get close enough to each other (less than 16 blocks by default), they discover each others' contacts and can see chat messages from each other.

### Commands
- `/contacts` - Lists the players that can see your chat messages. Usable by anyone
- `/contacts <playername>` - Shows the contacts of another player. Needs op (permission level 2)
- `/contacts add <player1> <player2>` - Gives two players each others' contact information. Note that this does not send a message to those players. Needs OP (permission level 2)
- `/contacts remove <player1> <player2>` - Removes two players' contact information from each other. Needs OP (permission level 4)
- `/killdante` - Kills Dante (does nothing except send an ominous message to the person who used it)

### Config
Config is at `comms_array_uplink.json`. Messages sent to players can also be configured at `config/messages/comms_array.json`.

- `discovery_range` - The range that players discover contact information from. This is a box, not a sphere. 

### Compatibility
This mod uses [Placeholder API](https://modrinth.com/mod/placeholder-api) and [Message API](https://modrinth.com/mod/message-api).

This mod is compatible with [Factions](https://modrinth.com/mod/factions), but will likely break some parts of other mods that change the look of chat, such as [Styled Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/styled-chat).

title: ClickCopyChat
description: Allows one click copy of any Paper server message in chat (Server-side only)
body:
**ClickCopyChat - make every chat line copyable, not just player messages.**

**Requirements / Dependencies**

- **_ProtocolLib (https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/protocollib.1997/) !Required!_**
- Paper 1.21.x (not tested below 1.21.8)
- Java 17+ runtime.

**How it works:**

For player chat, it wraps the rendered Adventure Component.
For plugin/system chat, it uses ProtocolLib to intercept PLAY→SERVER chat packets (e.g., SYSTEM_CHAT, DISGUISED_CHAT, CHAT), decorates their payloads (Adventure, WrappedChatComponent, or raw JSON), and writes them back. If mutation isn’t possible, it cancels and resends a decorated copy-avoiding duplicates and action-bar overlays.

**Highlights**

- Click-to-copy on player chat and most plugin messages (Essentials, Skript broadcasts/errors, LuckPerms replies, etc.).
- Deep application to child components—entire line is copyable.
- Preserves formatting; adds hover hint; minimal overhead.
- Built-in diagnostics: /cccdebug (toggle logs), /cccpackets (show hooked packet types).
- Graceful degrade: without ProtocolLib, still enables copy-to-clipboard for player chat.

**Limitations**

- Client-side constraint: copy_to_clipboard is a Java client feature; Bedrock (via Geyser/floodgate) won’t copy.

- Non-chat UIs (titles/subtitles/action bar, boss bars) aren’t standard chat; optional mirroring can be added if desired.

**Commands / Permissions**

/cccdebug - toggle debug logs (permission: clickcopychat.debug).

/cccpackets - list hooked packet types (permission: clickcopychat.debug).

**Vanilla Choc** is a Minecraft modpack designed for players who love the core vanilla experience but want a touch of extra flavor. Think of it as classic Minecraft with a sprinkle of chocolate—slightly richer, a bit smoother, and just enough variety to keep things interesting.

Whether you’re looking for quality-of-life enhancements, a few new biomes to explore, or lightweight systems like better storage or small mobs, Vanilla Choc keeps things simple, smooth, and familiar. It's perfect for casual players, servers with friends, or anyone who wants to preserve the vanilla vibe while avoiding the overwhelming complexity of larger packs.

Enjoy Minecraft the way you remember it—_just a little tastier_.


<details>

## ✨ Light & Vanilla-Friendly Mods
Carefully selected mods that enhance gameplay without straying from the vanilla spirit.

Subtle biome tweaks and terrain improvements to make exploration feel fresh—but not foreign.

##   📦 Improved Inventory & Storage
Small enhancements like backpacks, better sorting, and simple storage solutions that won’t overwhelm you.

##   🔧 Quality of Life Tweaks
Minor changes such as auto-replanting crops, tooltips, better F3 info, and smoother interfaces.

Visual mods that preserve Minecraft’s original style while adding a layer of polish (like dynamic lighting and ambient sounds).

A few additional creatures to liven up the world—nothing game-changing, just fun and flavorful.

##   🤝 Server-Friendly
Lightweight enough to run on small servers with friends without lag or complicated setup (will be supported eventually).

With no game-breaking mechanics or massive overhauls, Vanilla Choc is ideal for those who love building, adventuring, and chill survival.

Enhance your server with a simple yet intuitive brewing system inspired by vanilla mechanics!

![](https://i.imgur.com/pV6SPdM.gif)

Features include:

title: Tangerine Warfare
description: Throw tangerines that tint people's screens!
body:
![_Pm7 throwing a tangerine at Piffin380, tinting the screen orange upon impact](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pm7-dev/Tangerine/refs/heads/master/promogif_small.gif)

# Tangerine Warfare
This is a fairly simple plugin that adds Tangerines into the game. But instead of being eaten, Tangerines are for throwing. When a player is hit with a tangerine, their screen is tinted orange temporarily, along with a familiar cartoon splat sound playing. A point is given to a player every time they hit someone with a tangerine, and the point leaderboard can be viewed with `/tangerineleaderboard` or `/tleader`. Points can be disabled in config if the server owner so chooses.  

Tangerines have a 33% chance to be dropped by any of the four main passive mobs (Cow, Chicken, Pig, Sheep) upon death. There is no lore reason as to why this happens, I just didn't have any other way planned to make them drop.  

If you get bored of the orange color, you can color tangerines with any [hex color code](https://www.rapidtables.com/web/color/color-picker.html) (ex: #7f5cb8, #36d93e) by renaming them in an anvil to whichever color you want! 
![Recoloring a tangerine using an anvil by naming it "#8e6ed4" to get a nice violet color](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pm7-dev/Tangerine/refs/heads/master/tangerinepromo_anvil.png)

This plugin makes use of a resource pack, which is by default added to players upon joining the game. If this conflicts with your server's resource pack (it should only change the snowball's model data and one default font character), you can disable this automatic pack applying in config, and the resource pack can be found on [(the github page)](https://github.com/Pm7-dev/Tangerine) if you would like to merge them.

title: Bronze Age Mod - A Dip In The Past
description: Immerse yourself in the Bronze Age! Meet new metals, building blocks and foodstuff which will bring you back to an Age of Heroes.
body:
![Logo of beta 1.0.x of the Bronze Age Mod.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/685b273abba9b38368f90fdba3cf566e6282d2f8.png)

# Welcome to the Bronze Age Mod!
And to its first release, named "A Dip In The Past".
The aim of this mod is to introduce several features revolving around a history-changing alloy, bronze, and around the age named after it.

# Current state of the mod
Being in beta, the mod currently has only a handful of features - the basics to allow the player to experience a light modding, allowing for a more historically accurate early game.

## Features
The mod has currently added bronze ingots, which can be crafted from a tin nugget and a copper ingot - similarly to how netherite ingots are crafted - and all the tools and weapons made of such a material. Bronze is slightly more durable and stronger than iron; despite this being debatable, it's meant to mirror the mainly aesthetical use of iron during the Bronze Age, and to give players more reasons to mine copper and tin and to use bronze instead of iron.

In addition, new sets of easily accessible building blocks have been added, in order to allow players to mimic the materials that would have been used to build a shelter during the Bronze Age.

## Planned Features
Among the planned features there are new sets of coloured blocks, decorative blocks, a new functional block (which already exists in the beta 1.0.0, but lacks a real purpose beyond aesthetics), new structures and mechanics. Stay tuned!

title: Horse Call
description: Use a goat horn to locate your mount from up to 160 blocks away.
body:
# ![Reveal Mount Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bbc940681ed0f4f2890e14f6ba5e462b73bff245_0.webp)

When using a goat horn of any variant, the nearest saddled mount will **reveal their location** by making a sound and glowing for a few seconds.

This data pack **prioritizes owned mounts** (e.g., horses, mules). If an owned mount cannot be found it looks for tamed mounts (e.g., camels, skeleton horses). If a tamed mount cannot be found it looks for stick-led mounts (e.g., pigs, striders). If a saddled mount still cannot be found, the goat horn acts as usual.

The search for a saddled mount reaches out **160 blocks** from the player. This is around where the glow effect drops off. If the player is standing too close to their mount it will look for the next closest saddled mount, making the assumption that the player knows where the one they're standing next to is.

## Support
I do not have plans to backport Horse Call. If you have issues with the data pack, contact me through Discord (`1cale`) or create a new issue on GitHub.

## Credit
Horse Call is an extended version of Horse Trumpet made by [misterk7_-](https://modrinth.com/user/misterk7_-). I originally planned on just updating it for personal use, but I ended up making it look for more than just horses, so here I am.

title: gWhitelist
description: just a simple whitelist plugin
body:
# GWhitelist

GWhitelist is a simple and efficient Minecraft plugin to manage a whitelist. It allows you to easily add, remove, and list whitelisted players, as well as enable or disable the whitelist.

## Features

- **Add/Remove players**: Add or remove players from the whitelist with simple commands.
- **Enable/Disable whitelist**: Turn the whitelist on or off at any time.
- **List whitelisted players**: View all whitelisted players in one command.
- **Reload support**: Reload the whitelist and configuration without restarting the server.

## Commands

- **`/gwhitelist add <player>`**: Add a player to the whitelist.
- **`/gwhitelist remove <player>`**: Remove a player from the whitelist.
- **`/gwhitelist list`**: List all whitelisted players.
- **`/gwhitelist on`**: Enable the whitelist.
- **`/gwhitelist off`**: Disable the whitelist.
- **`/gwhitelist status`**: Check if the whitelist is enabled or disabled.
- **`/gwhitelist reload`**: Reload the whitelist and configuration.

## Permissions

- **`gwhitelist.manage`**: Allows access to all commands.

By default, only server operators have these permissions.

## Installation

1. Download the latest `.jar` file.
2. Place the `.jar` file in your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart the server.

## Configuration

The plugin uses two files:

1. **`whitelist.json`**: Stores the list of whitelisted players.
2. **`config.yml`**: Stores the whitelist status (enabled/disabled).

You can manually edit these files, and use `/gwhitelist reload` to apply changes.

---

# Cauthon Info Hoster

1. Server Info Over HTTP: This plugin lets you see important stats about your server
2. Latest Chat Messages: It keeps track of the latest chat message on the server.
3. Discord Integration: Send messages from Discord to Minecraft and see them in Minecraft chat.

1. Find Config: Go to plugins/CauthonInfo/config.yml.

### Checking Server Stats
After setting the plugin up, you can view server stats by going to:

http://<your-server-ip>:<port>/tps

This page shows:

1. Current TPS: Ticks per second, the speed the server is running.
2. CPU Usage: How much of the CPU the server is using.
3. Memory (RAM) Usage: How much memory the server is using.
4. Storage Usage: How much disk space is in use.
5. Server Uptime: How long the server has been running since the last start.
6. Unique Player Joins: Number of unique players who have joined since the server started.

### View the Latest Chat Message

http://<your-server-ip>:<port>/chat

If you have a bot or program set up to send HTTP POST requests to this plugin, use the following address:

body:
# BuildContest Plugin

BuildContest is a Velocity plugin that simplifies the setup of dedicated servers for each team in a building contest. The plugin uses Docker Compose to start sub-servers and automatically transfers players to their respective sub-servers for the contest. Team configurations and server information are persistently stored.

## Features

- **Automatic Sub-Server Creation**: Create team servers using HTTP API calls with Docker Compose, and register them with Velocity.
- **Automatic Player Transfer**: Players are automatically transferred to their corresponding sub-servers when joining the main server.
- **Permission Control**: Authenticate HTTP requests using Bearer Token.
- **Prevent Duplicate Participation**: When adding a team, if a player already exists in another team, they cannot join other teams.

## Installation Steps

1. **Prepare the Environment**
    - Install [Velocity](https://velocitypowered.com/) proxy server.
    - Ensure Docker and Docker Compose are installed and properly configured.

2. **Create a Minecraft Contest Server Image (Sub-Server)**
    - It's recommended to use [Little Wrench](https://www.minebbs.com/resources/1-20-4.8372/) as the server base.
    - Set the port to `25565` and ensure it can be accessed correctly via the proxy, including proper `forwarding-mode` settings.
    - Create a Dockerfile for building the server image.
    - Build the image, e.g., `docker build -t minecraft-contest:latest .`
    - Create a `docker-compose.yml` file for starting the sub-server.

3. **Download the Plugin**
    - Jump to [version page](https://github.com/Hanamizu2002/BuildContest/releases)

4. **Configure the Plugin**
    - Place the plugin jar file in the `plugins/` directory of Velocity.
    - Start the Velocity server once to generate the configuration files, then stop the server to adjust settings.

5. **Configure Files**
    - Modify `config.yml` in the `plugins/BuilderContest/` directory to set up ports and other settings.
    - Place `docker-compose-default.yml` in the plugin directory as the template for starting sub-servers.

6. **Start the Server**
    - Start the server and retrieve the `bearer-token` from the generated `config.yml`.

## Configuration File Description

**config.yml**
```yaml
ktor:
  http-port: 8080 # HTTP service port.
  port-start: 30000 # Starting port for sub-servers.
  bearer-token: # Bearer Token; leave this empty on first use.
  allow-host: "*" # Allowed host addresses.
```

**docker-compose-default.yml Example**
- Use `#SERVER_NAME_PLACEHOLDER` as the placeholder for the Docker container name.
- Use `#SERVER_PORT_PLACEHOLDER` as the placeholder for the port.
```yaml
version: '3.8'
services:
  minecraft_server:
    image: minecraft-contest:latest
    container_name: "#SERVER_NAME_PLACEHOLDER"
    ports:
      - #SERVER_PORT_PLACEHOLDER:25565
    volumes:
      # Mount the local world directory to the specified path in the container
      - ./worlds/#SERVER_NAME_PLACEHOLDER/world:/app/world
    environment:
      EULA: "TRUE"
    restart: unless-stopped
```

## Usage Instructions

### HTTP API

- After the plugin starts, an HTTP service will be launched on port `8080` by default.
- Key API endpoint:
    - **Add Team**: `POST /team/add`, requires Bearer Token authentication, with `teamId`, `teamName`, and `members` as payload fields.

### Example Request

```bash
curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8080/team/add' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer sSCj4piDoEfV2zIo_C8lD7S4ul0YlVOyBr2BkKpdsTI (Retrieve this from config.yml)' \
--data-raw '{
    "teamId": "team_1",
    "teamName": "Team 1",
    "members": ["Hanamizu_", "user1"]
}'
```

body:
# ![DryEye](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d83cd06df6a0525b997c4d64ec9f22da2e70f5b0.png)

## ![About](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d22e8d0ed94efd42746bfc1715bdcbedcb3fccc0.png)

DryEye is a proof-of-concept **Fabric, Forge and NeoForge mod** that **automatically
modifies player skins so that they can blink
periodically**. It injects a lightweight callback into
the ``AvatarRenderer`` to substitute player skins with a
computed "blink variant" based on complex heuristics. This is
a fuzzy system that won't always work properly, so
[click here](https://github.com/WasabiThumb/dryeye/issues/new/?body=Please+provide+a+detailed+screenshot+here.&labels=eye+schemes)
if you want to report an issue with your skin and improve the mod!

title: Jake's Economy
description: A dynamic player-driven economy mod with a live market, coin currency, real-time price trends, and an Auction House.
body:
Jake's Economy adds a fully server-compatible player-driven economy to your world. A live market with real-time price trends, a physical and virtual currency, and an achievement-gated item system — all configurable in the config.
 
Features
- Live Market Prices rise and fall based on supply and demand using a logarithmic curve. Buying items drives prices up, selling items drives them down. Trend arrows (↑ ↓ —) show recent movement so players can speculate or react.

![An in game image of the market](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48f4bba988ed21a4eba5e30053d8fd8029bd48d7_0.webp)

- Coin Currency Eight physical coin denominations from Copper to Platinum, with craftable coin sacks to use in physcial trading. Coins can be deposited/withdrawn into your virtual balance and can be found in vanilla loot chests.

![The various coins added in the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3437e11f24e2fd6c86cb110eb054b9fe7f01b310.png)

- Market GUI Browse items by category, search across all tabs, and sort alphabetically. Each item has a detail screen with single, bulk (×64), or custom quantity transactions. 

![Trendline Graph](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d07c297c8134df8bb7721aee2fc79342d52e6180.png)

- Price history graph - All items have their prices saved at set intervals, and viewable via a graph in the market GUI. Just press on the trend arrow!

![Emerald market page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75cb68e1db009a87c9370c244af399f6ef9f7b4c_0.webp)

- Auction House - List any item not sold in the market as an open auction or Buy It Now listing. Bids are tracked in real time, previous bidders are refunded instantly when outbid, and an anti-snipe system extends auctions when last-minute bids arrive. All money and items are held in server-side escrow — nothing is lost even if the server crashes mid-auction.

![Auction house page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0d27e453445ca64c27b176a1972f9ad7d414c0d_0.webp)

- Achievement Locks Gate market items behind advancements. Players must earn the unlock before they can buy or sell — great for progression servers.

![An in game image of the market, with achievement locks visible](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a86d906766a27da5d65f0b1df22eab68893b669.png)

- Multiplayer Ready Full dedicated server support. Prices and trends sync live to all online players after every trade. New players receive the full market config on join.

- Configurable Edit jakeseconomy-prices.json to define categories, items (even modded items), base prices, and advancement locks. Useful for modpack creators or server owners to customize the market. Tune market sensitivity, decay rate, and rate limits in jakeseconomy-server.json.

- Jake's Economy includes native integration with the [CobbleDollars] mod — both mods sync their currency values automatically when installed together. (1.2.1+ required for CobbleDollars integration)


Requires Fabric API.

Future Plans:

More Built-in mod support — pre-made price configs for popular mods like AE2, Cobblemon, Create, and more!

More config options — per-category depth overrides, and more!

More port versions — porting to newer (and older) versions of Minecraft.

NeoForge port — bring Jake's Economy to NeoForge.

body:
![ZeroLag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5fd70d6d26a8109da5eb4ab8325acbed2c4097f7.png)

---

**ZeroLag** is a cutting-edge optimization pack built for Fabric that extracts every drop of performance out of your game while maintaining a clean, highly functional Vanilla+ feel. Whether you are running on a high-end rig or a low-spec laptop, this pack stabilizes your frame rates, fixes underlying engine bugs, and modernizes your gameplay experience.

---

## 🚀 Key Features

### 💻 Ultimate Performance & Engine Fixes

We feature industry-standard optimization mods alongside advanced engine improvements to ensure smooth, responsive, and stutter-free gameplay:

* **Rendering & Logic:** Powered by modern rendering optimizations to dramatically improve frame rates and frame consistency.
* **Memory & Optimization:** Includes advanced memory management and performance enhancements to reduce overhead and improve stability.
* **Culling Tweaks:** Intelligent culling systems prevent unnecessary rendering of hidden entities, blocks, and other visual elements.
* **Engine Enhancements:** Multi-threaded world loading, optimized game logic, and faster world generation help Minecraft run more efficiently.
* **Bug Fixes:** Comprehensive vanilla bug fixes and gameplay improvements provide a more polished experience.

### 🛠️ Vanilla+ Quality of Life & UI Updates

Performance means nothing if the game isn't comfortable to play. ZeroLag includes carefully selected quality-of-life improvements while remaining lightweight and unobtrusive:

* **Quality of Life:** Helpful gameplay utilities, inventory improvements, recipe viewing, and interface enhancements designed to make everyday gameplay smoother.
* **Clean Interface:** A refined UI experience with optional dark-themed elements and improved menu presentation.
* **Custom Menus:** Includes multiple custom panorama backgrounds to give the pack a unique identity while keeping the vanilla aesthetic intact.
* **Cactus Mod Client:** Access utility features by pressing **Right Shift (`RShift`)**; to learn more about its capabilities, visit their official page [here](https://modrinth.com/mod/cactus).
* **Privacy & Safety:** Includes features that help preserve the traditional multiplayer chat experience while maintaining compatibility with modern servers.

---

## 📦 Manual Recommendation Note

To comply with platform restrictions, a few highly recommended client-side optimizations are hosted under restrictive licenses. For the absolute best stability against VRAM issues, we highly recommend manually downloading:

* **[Fix GPU Memory Leak](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fix-gpu-memory-leak)** from CurseForge and placing it directly into your local `mods/` folder.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration & Keybinds

ZeroLag ships pre-configured with streamlined settings designed for optimal performance right out of the box. Most options can be customized through **Mod Menu**, powered behind the scenes by **YetAnotherConfigLib** and **Cloth Config API**.

Whether you're playing on integrated graphics, a gaming laptop, or a high-end desktop, ZeroLag is designed to deliver a fast, stable, and hassle-free Minecraft experience.

---

**Less clutter. More FPS.**

# Tie Players
This datapack adds the ability to tie any players with a lead

**No resource pack required!**

![Preview](https://i.imgur.com/HUroGQb.gif)

## How to tie a player
- To tie a player, simply hold a lead near a player, and to untie it, use a sword.
- The lead used to tie a player will be cleared from your inventory
- Tied players can't move at all and can't use their hands
- The player must have a health inferior to 4 (2 hearts) to be tied

_A message in-game will appear to every new player explaining briefly how to tie a player_

### Known issue
- The rope is following the head movement instead of the body movement

title: Instant Actions
description: Adds toggles that make common interactions faster and more convenient.
body:
# Instant Actions

**Adds toggles that make common interactions faster and more convenient.**

Available on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/instant-actions) and [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/instant-actions).

## 📖 Features

* **Instant crop growth:** Fully grow any crop with a single click, consuming the required amount of bone meal.
* **Bone meal with spread:** Applying bone meal to a crop also applies it to adjacent crops of the same type.
* **Chain harvest:** Breaking a fully grown crop harvests all connected crops of the same type within a 3-block radius.
* **Instant composting:** Fill a composter with a single click, consuming as much of the item as needed.
* **Instant taming:** Tame any tameable animal (e.g. horse, wolf) on first attempt.
* **Restore hunger instantly:** Consuming food uses as many of the same item as needed to fully restore hunger.
* **Double seeding:** Planting a crop also plants the same item on adjacent empty plantable blocks.
* **Double tilling:** Tilling a block also tills any adjacent tillable blocks.

## 📋 Usage

1. Open the config screen via **Mod Menu**, or by running `/instant-actions config` in chat.
2. Enable whatever toggles you want.
3. Save to apply changes

## 💡 Examples

[![crops](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/victorfaurschou/instant-actions/26.1/.github/examples/crops.gif)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/victorfaurschou/instant-actions/26.1/.github/examples/crops.gif)

[![harvesting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/victorfaurschou/instant-actions/26.1/.github/examples/harvesting.gif)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/victorfaurschou/instant-actions/26.1/.github/examples/harvesting.gif)

[![hunger](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/victorfaurschou/instant-actions/26.2/.github/examples/hunger.gif)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/victorfaurschou/instant-actions/26.2/.github/examples/hunger.gif)

[![double seeding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/victorfaurschou/instant-actions/26.2/.github/examples/double-seeding.gif)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/victorfaurschou/instant-actions/26.2/.github/examples/double-seeding.gif)

[![double tilling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/victorfaurschou/instant-actions/26.2/.github/examples/double-tilling.gif)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/victorfaurschou/instant-actions/26.2/.github/examples/double-tilling.gif)

and more...

## 📌 Notes

This is a **client-side mod**. It works in singleplayer and with the integrated (Open to LAN) server.

Each player controls their own toggles independently. If you host a world and enable a toggle, it applies only to you. Another player who joins with the mod installed uses their own toggle settings. Another player who joins without the mod is unaffected.

Joining a world where the host doesn't have the mod will make it have no effect and a warning will be shown.

The mod does not work on dedicated servers.

title: BlxckoutFX

body: ![Minecraft Versions](https://img.shields.io/badge/MINECRAFT-26.1.2_|_1.21.1_|_1.20.1-darkgreen?style=for-the-badge) ![Loaders](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loaders-Forge_|_NeoForge_|_Fabric-orange?style=for-the-badge) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue?style=for-the-badge) # BlxckoutFX A lightweight Minecraft mod that applies a consistent dark theme to buttons and in-game GUI surfaces using shader-based rendering. By transforming the default white panels into a sleek custom **mode**, this shader-based solution brings a refined **dark** aesthetic to your interface **everywhere** you look, delivering an eye-friendly experience across all screens. _Let darkness fall everywhere for your eyes._ *** ## 📖 About This is my very first Minecraft mod. I originally created it because bright and white Minecraft interfaces were uncomfortable for my eyes. After building it for myself, I decided to share it with other players who might want the same kind of darker GUI experience. BlxckoutFX is intentionally focused: it changes GUI rendering, not the world itself. Menu backgrounds, the Minecraft logo, and mod images are kept intact, while buttons and in-game GUI panels receive the darkening effect. *** ## ✨ Features ### ⚙️ Core Principles * **Shader-Based:** The effect is handled through shader rendering instead of replacing vanilla textures. * **GUI Focused:** The mod targets interface elements only. * **Lightweight:** It avoids extra systems and keeps the feature set focused. * **Menu-Safe:** Main menu backgrounds, logos, and mod list images are not darkened. ### 🎮 Mod Details * **Button Darkening in Menus:** Menu screens darken buttons only. * **In-Game GUI Dark Theme:** In-game screens can darken both buttons and GUI panels. * **Shader-Based Visual Styling:** No manual shader setup is required. * **Loader Support:** Supports NeoForge and Fabric Loader. * **Draggable FX Button:** The on-screen `FX` button cycles themes on left click and can be moved by holding and dragging. * **Config Screen:** Toggle the inventory button and adjust its saved position. * **Readable Text Handling:** Soft, Balanced, and Dark modes use fixed readable text colors for better consistency. ### 🌑 Available Themes / Modes * **⚪ Off:** Disables the visual effect. * **🔘 Soft:** A lighter darkening mode for subtle interface dimming. * **⚫ Balanced:** The default mode, designed for regular use. * **⬛ Dark:** A stronger darkening mode for brighter interfaces. * **👁️‍🗨️ Blxckout:** The strongest preset for users who want the darkest look. *** ## 📥 Versions | Minecraft Version |Loader |Mod Version |Status | | ----------------- |----------------- |----------- |---------------- | | 26.1.2 |NeoForge + Fabric |1.1.0 |Main Release | | 1.21.1 |NeoForge + Fabric |1.1.0 |Legacy Branch | | 1.20.1 |Forge + Fabric |1.1.0 |Unsupported Port | | 1.12.2 |Forge |- |In Development | *** ## 🚀 Installation 1. Install your target Minecraft version via the Minecraft Launcher. 2. Install NeoForge or Fabric Loader. 3. Place the matching BlxckoutFX jar file into the `mods` folder. 4. Launch the game. > 💡 **Important Version Notice:** The mod prioritizes support for the latest NeoForge and Fabric versions available for its target Minecraft version. If a compatibility issue appears, update to the minimum loader version listed on the release page. *** ## 📂 Branch Structure * `main` → Minecraft 26.1.2 development * `1.21.1` → Minecraft 1.21.1 support branch * `1.20.1` → Minecraft 1.20.1 unsupport branch * `1.12.2` → Minecraft 1.12.2 backport branch (In Development) *** ## 🛠️ Support & Maintenance Policy > ⚠️ **Note for 1.20.1:** This specific version has no active support. Issues may be fixed in bulk batches or left as-is depending on necessity. If you encounter bugs, issues, or have suggestions, you can report them through either of the following channels: * **GitHub Issues:** Open an issue directly in this repository. * **Discord Server:** Join the community via [Discord](https://discord.gg/rUD6tynDaK). title: waterupgrade
description: A Sophisticated Backpacks addon that adds a Drinking Upgrade to automatically hydrate the player from backpack inventory, compatible with Tough As Nails, Legendary Survival Overhaul, and Homeostatic.
body:
Water Upgrade is an addon for Sophisticated Backpacks that introduces two new items: the Drinking Upgrade and the Advanced Drinking Upgrade. Once installed in a backpack, they automatically consume water-compatible items stored in the backpack to restore the player's thirst.

The basic Drinking Upgrade provides filter slots to specify which drinks to consume. The Advanced Drinking Upgrade adds a thirst level threshold setting (any / moderate / full) and a toggle to drink immediately when hurt. The upgrade also works when the backpack is placed as a block, hydrating players within 3 blocks.

Note: This mod requires at least one of the following thirst mods to function: Tough As Nails, Legendary Survival Overhaul, Homeostatic, or Thirst Mod.

Each upgrade type is limited to one per backpack, and filter slot counts are configurable via the server config file.

title: Tags: Smeltable Items
description: Adds item tags for items that can be smelted, blasted or smoked.
body:
This datapack simply adds three **item tags**:
- `#smeltable:via_smelting` - items that can be smelted in the furnace
- `#smeltable:via_blasting` - items that can be blasted in the blast furnace
- `#smeltable:via_smoking` - items that can be smoked in the smoker

The `#smeltable:via_smelting` tag includes all items a normal furnace supports, including those that can also go into the blast furnace or smoker.

These tags are based on the **vanilla** smelting recipes and won't account for any custom smelting recipes added by other datapacks or mods.

### Why
The tags provided by this datapack are useful for filtering/routing items.

For example, I use the `#smeltable:via_smelting` tag to make sure my super smelter furnaces don't get blocked by non-smeltable items if I accidentally put them in the input chest (I use [Classic Pipes](https://modrinth.com/mod/classic-pipes) to route items which allow filtering by tags).

### When
The datapack is updated automatically as soon as a new version of Minecraft Java Edition is released.

title: The Archivist
description: A fourth-wall-breaking psychological horror mod that uses your real-life PC info to scare you.
body:
The Archivist

"You are not playing a game; the game is playing you."

About the Mod

The Archivist is a psychological horror mod that transcends the boundaries of Minecraft by actively breaking the fourth wall. Instead of simply adding monsters that chase you, it messes with your mind. It delivers a series of realistic, paranoia-inducing events intertwined with psychological manipulation to make you question your reality.


Key Features

  • Breaking the Fourth Wall: The mod truly knows who you are. It uses real-world information against you—such as your local time, operating system, and hardware specs—to pull the terror out of the game and into your room.
  • System Interactions: The horror isn't confined to Minecraft. You might experience windows opening on their own in the background or find unsettling files dropped directly onto your actual desktop.
  • Realistic Paranoia: Experience the sound of a ghost miner breaking blocks when you are alone, torches extinguishing themselves, fake fatal crash screens, and a Doppelganger that silently mimics your every move when you look behind you.
  • No Cheating Allowed: If you get too scared and try to switch to Creative or Spectator mode, The Archivist will immediately intervene, force you back into Survival mode, and punish you for trying to escape.
  • Sleepless Nights: Sleeping is no longer a safe haven. Whenever you try to rest, there is a constant risk of being violently awakened and attacked.
  • Chat Manipulation: You might see desperate cries for help or strange whispers sent to the chat under your own username without you ever typing them.

🎥 For Streamers and Content Creators

This mod may display highly personal data (such as your real IP address or Windows username) on screen as part of its horror elements. If you are recording or streaming, immediately type the /archivist safeip command upon joining the world to hide sensitive data (prevent doxxing).

title: Simplifium
description: A lightweight, high-performance optimization modpack that boosts FPS while keeping the vanilla feel with essential quality-of-life features.
body:
_Want a version of this modpack without all of the quality-of-life features? Use [Smallifium](https://modrinth.com/modpack/smallifium)._

NeoForge support coming soon.
# What is Simplifium?
Simplifium is a lightweight optimization modpack designed to significantly boost performance using a list of only **25 mods**.

The name is a blend of "Simplify" and the "-um" suffix, following the naming convention of many popular optimization mods (like Sodium or Lithium). True to its name, Simplifium avoids bloat and keeps the experience as close to vanilla as possible. While most of the mods focus on performance (settings can be found under Video Settings), a few others add essential quality-of-life features.

## Why should I use Simplifium?
### Performance
This modpack **highly increases performance** using mods like Sodium, Lithium, Entity Culling, FerriteCore, and more!

### Quality-of-life features
Also, there are plenty of **simple quality-of-life features** like zoom; toggleable fullbright; shader and resourcepack support; the ability to browse, install and update resourcepacks, datapacks, shaderpacks and worlds and lots of useful settings like disabling fog or showing FPS.

### Easy to play
Install the modpack, launch it, create a world and you're ready to play **without even touching the settings**.

### Quick support for new versions
Small amount of mods=Not having to wait a lot for all of them to be updated=**Not having to wait a lot for the modpack to be updated**.

### Fully client-side
This mod **only uses client-side mods**, which means when you have the modpack installed you can join servers.

### Customizable
You can add **any shaderpack, resourcepack, datapack, world**, (everything mentioned before can be installed in-game) **or mod** you want.

### Lightweight
This modpack can do everything mentioned before using just **25 mods** (very little compared to other optimization modpacks).

## Can I use this as a base for my own modpack?
Sure! Just give credits and don't just reupload the modpack without changing anything or with changing it just a little bit (Don't just add a few mods, make a big change to the modpack).

## Credits
A huge thanks to all the mod creators who made this possible. You can find the specific mod list and links to their respective pages by checking any release in the Versions tab.

**Thank you for downloading and supporting Simplifium!**
By the way if you have any suggestions or found a bug create an issue [here](https://github.com/StolkiMC/Simplifium/issues).

title: RPGSouls
description: A hardcore RPG mod: collect souls from slain enemies, upgrade active skills, craft the Devourer set, and try not to lose everything upon death. / Хардкорный RPG-мод: собирай души, прокачивай навыки и крафть сет Пожирателя.
body:
### 🇬🇧 English Description
*The mod wiki and support are available on our Discord server.*

**RPGSouls** is a global mod that turns Minecraft survival into a hardcore dark fantasy experience. Forget about boring XP farming. Now, your main currency and your greatest weakness are Souls.

**Key Mechanics:**
* **Soul Economy:** Kill enemies and absorb their souls. Use them to purchase upgrades, but be careful: death will take everything from you.
* **Skill System:** A special GUI menu for purchasing skills. Upgrade the Shadow Dash for mobility, Lifesteal for combat sustain, and Passive Regeneration.
* **Devourer Armor:** Late-game equipment crafted from Netherite, a Nether Star, and souls at the Smithing Table. Beware: the armor merges with its wearer (comes with the Curse of Binding).
* **Living Weapon:** Your sword is not just a piece of metal. It thirsts for blood, speaks to you, and goes insane if you hoard too many souls in your inventory.
* **Personal Guard:** Spend souls to summon squads of the undead that will fight by your side.
* **Smart Multitool:** A tool that auto-smelts ores and burns wood into charcoal directly in your inventory while holding Shift.

*Survive. Kill. Devour.*

---

### 🇷🇺 Русское описание
*Вики по моду есть в нашем Discord канале.*

**RPGSouls** — это глобальный мод, который превращает выживание в Minecraft в хардкорное темное фэнтези. Забудь про скучный фарм опыта. Теперь твоя главная валюта и твоя главная слабость — это Души.

**Ключевые механики:**
* **Экономика Душ:** Убивай врагов и поглощай их души. Используй их для покупки улучшений, но будь осторожен: смерть заберет у тебя всё.
* **Система Прокачки:** Специальное меню (GUI) для покупки навыков. Прокачай Теневой рывок для мобильности, Кражу жизни для отжора в бою и Пассивную регенерацию.
* **Броня Пожирателя Душ:** Лейтгейм-экипировка, которая крафтится из незерита, звезды Незера и душ на столе кузнеца. Осторожно: броня сливается с носителем (Проклятие несъемности).
* **Живое Оружие:** Твой меч — не просто кусок металла. Он чувствует жажду крови, разговаривает с тобой и сходит с ума, если ты накапливаешь слишком много душ.
* **Личная Гвардия:** Трать души, чтобы призывать отряды нежити, которые будут сражаться на твоей стороне.
* **Умный Мультитул:** Инструмент, который плавит руду и выжигает уголь из дерева прямо в инвентаре при зажатом Shift.

*Выживай. Убивай. Поглощай.*

title: AutoRun Key
description: Toggle key (K) for hands-free walking and sprinting forward.
body:
**AutoRun** is a tiny, client-only Fabric mod that lets you walk and sprint forward without holding any key. Press **K** once to start moving — your character will walk and sprint until you press **K** again, press **S** (backward), or open any screen.

### Features
- **One key, two states.** Press **K** to toggle hands-free forward movement on/off.
- **Sprinting included.** Auto-sprint is on by default — covers ground fast.
- **Safe defaults.** Pressing **S** (move backward) cancels auto-run instantly, so you never get stuck running off a cliff while you grab a drink. Auto-run also disables itself if you die, mount a vehicle, fall asleep, or open any inventory/menu.
- **Tiny footprint.** Only one small `KeyboardInput.tick` tail hook — other movement mods keep working as expected.
- **Client-only.** Works on any server (singleplayer or multiplayer), no server install needed.

### How it works
On every client tick, the mod rebuilds the `PlayerInput` record with `forward = true` and `sprint = true` while auto-run is active. The change is invisible to the server — it's the same packet your fingers would send.

### Compatibility
Tested on **Minecraft 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, and 1.21.11** (Fabric Loader 0.16+). One JAR for all four versions.

### Default key
The toggle is bound to **K** (hard-coded for now). Want a different key or a config screen? Open an issue.

CC Satellites is a Fabric addon for CC: Tweaked which adds an orbital satellite system to Minecraft.

  Launch Advanced Computers into orbit as GPS satellites, build a real satellite-based positioning network, and connect it to orbital laser platforms for coordinate-targeted strikes.
  The mod also adds a Satellite Receiver Turtle upgrade, letting turtles locate themselves through your satellite network.

  Features

  - Satellite rockets for launching GPS satellites
  - Orbital laser rockets for launching laser platforms
  - Satellite Launcher peripheral for CC computers
  - Satellite GPS Receiver block and turtle upgrade
  - Satellite Receiver Turtle crafting support
  - Orbital Laser Controller peripheral
  - Built-in Lua helper programs:
      - satlaunch
      - satlocate
      - satlaser
  - Custom item and block textures
  - Hungarian and English language support

  How It Works
  Launch at least 4 GPS satellites in the same dimension to create a GPS lock. Once the network is online, Satellite GPS Receivers and Satellite Receiver Turtles can locate
  themselves.

  Orbital laser platforms can fire at coordinates only when the target has GPS lock and at least one laser platform is available.

  Basic Usage
  Place a Satellite Launcher next to a CC computer and an inventory containing rockets.

  Launch 4 GPS satellites:

  satlaunch gps4

  Check your position:

  satlocate

  Launch an orbital laser platform:

  satlaunch laser laser-1

  Fire the orbital laser:

  satlaser fire 100 64 100

No one knows how skeletons came alive... some skeletons even mutated to embrace the sun and now burn eternally...

## Abilities

### Cinder Body
Permanent flame aura. Body burns with continuous flame particles. Renders glow with dynamic-light mods.

Does not burn in daylight. Hunts you in the open at noon.

### Cinder Shot
Every arrow ignites the target. Default 5-second burn (configurable).

The bow itself is wreathed in fire while held. Visible to all players.

20% chance per shot to fire a 3-arrow rapid burst (configurable count, chance, interval).

### Ash Cloak
Fades from view when out of combat (~25% opacity). Reveal triggers: takes damage OR fires a shot. Distance-graded — visible up close, ghostly far away.

### Pyre Feast
Heals when any nearby undead dies (8-block radius). Each kill stacks +2 max HP, capped at 8 stacks (+16 max HP). Strong in raids and dungeons.

- Splash water bottle: ×1.5 damage
- Water source / rain contact: continuous HP bleed

- Native Nether spawn entry (Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley)

- Snowballs deal real damage
- Splash water bottles
- Don't fight near other undead — Pyre Feast snowballs hard
- Force them into rain

Every stat is configurable in-game (/flamingskeletons set <key> <value>) or via config/flamingskeletons.json. Spawn rate, ignite duration, burst chance, stealth opacity, heal amount, water multiplier, XP multiplier — all knobs exposed.

title: MultiWorldSystem
description:
Create and manage multiple worlds directly on your server without requiring a restart. Players can teleport between worlds or travel through interactive NPC portal guardians.

All worlds are automatically saved and loaded again on the next server startup.
body:
# 🌍 MultiWorldSystem
 
**Create, manage, and explore multiple worlds with ease!**
 
MultiWorldSystem revolutionizes how Minecraft servers handle multiple worlds. Whether you're running a massive survival network, creative hub, or adventure server, this plugin provides a seamless, intuitive solution for world management that feels native to your server.
 
---
 
## English
 
### What This Plugin Does
 
MultiWorldSystem is a comprehensive world management solution for Spigot/Paper servers. It eliminates the complexity of manually handling multiple worlds and provides players with an intuitive way to explore different dimensions and environments without leaving your server. Gone are the days of confusing console commands or complex setup procedures—MultiWorldSystem makes world creation and teleportation as simple as typing a command.
 
This plugin is designed for server administrators who want to:
- Expand gameplay possibilities beyond a single world
- Create themed worlds (Survival, Creative, PvP, Minigames, etc.)
- Offer seamless world transitions with portals and NPC hubs
- Maintain server performance with proper world isolation
- Support multilingual communities with built-in language switching
### Core Features Explained
 
#### Multi-World Creation System
Create unlimited worlds on-the-fly without restarting your server. Choose from four distinct world types:
- **Normal Worlds** - Traditional Minecraft survival with grass, trees, and mobs
- **Nether Worlds** - Fiery dimensions for mining rare materials and exploration
- **End Worlds** - The final dimension with dragons and valuable loot
- **Flat Worlds** - Perfect for creative building, minigames, or custom terrain
Each world is completely isolated, meaning player data, inventories, and resources stay separate. This prevents griefing and allows different gameplay modes on the same server.
 
#### Advanced Portal System
Two ways to transport players between worlds:
 
**Type Portals** - Automatically generated Nether and End portals that link worlds together. Walk through a Nether portal in World A, and you'll emerge in your Nether World. Simple, intuitive, and exactly what players expect.
 
**NPC Portals** - Place interactive NPCs in your hub world that act as teleportation stations. Perfect for creating a central lobby where players can choose their destination visually. Customize NPC locations to match your server's aesthetic.
 
#### Seamless Teleportation
The `/wtp` command makes world-hopping instant and lag-free. Players can quickly jump between worlds without loading screens or console commands. Administrators can also teleport other players or groups to specific worlds for events or activities.
 
#### World Management Tools
- **List all worlds** with `/wlist` - See every available world at a glance
- **Create new worlds** with `/wcreate` - Spawn new dimensions in seconds
- **Auto-load worlds** on server startup - Worlds are ready when your server starts
- **Custom world generation** - Configure terrain generation per world
#### Multi-Language Support
Built-in support for three major languages allowing players from different regions to use the plugin in their native language.
 
#### Fine-Grained Permission System
Complete control over who can do what:
- **Operators only** - Restrict world creation to admins
- **Everyone can teleport** - Allow players to explore all worlds
- **Custom permissions** - Assign specific permissions to ranks or groups
- **Permission inheritance** - Parent permissions automatically grant child permissions
### Complete Command Reference
 
```
/wcreate <name> [type]
  Create a new world with optional type (normal|nether|end|flat)
  Example: /wcreate survival_nether nether
  Permission: pocketdimension.multiworld.create
 
/wtp <world>
  Instantly teleport to any loaded world
  Example: /wtp creative_world
  Permission: pocketdimension.multiworld.tp
 
/wportal <type> [world]
  Create Nether/End portals or NPC teleporters
  Example: /wportal nether sky_world
  Permission: pocketdimension.multiworld.portal
 
/wlist
  Display all currently loaded worlds
  Permission: pocketdimension.multiworld.list
 
/wlang <language>
  Change plugin language (en|es|de)
  Example: /wlang de
  Permission: pocketdimension.multiworld.lang
```
 
### Permission Structure
 
```
pocketdimension.multiworld.*
  └─ Parent permission - grants all permissions below
 
pocketdimension.multiworld.create
  └─ Create new worlds [Default: OP only]
 
pocketdimension.multiworld.tp
  └─ Teleport to worlds [Default: Everyone]
 
pocketdimension.multiworld.portal
  └─ Create portals and NPCs [Default: OP only]
 
pocketdimension.multiworld.list
  └─ List all worlds [Default: Everyone]
 
pocketdimension.multiworld.lang
  └─ Change language [Default: OP only]
```
 
### Use Cases & Server Types
 
#### Survival Networks
Create separate survival worlds for different themes:
- Main survival world
- Nether dimension
- End dimension
- Resource gathering world
Players can gather resources from multiple worlds without destroying the main landscape.
#### Creative Servers
- Unlimited creative building worlds
- Dedicated worlds for different builders/teams
- Separate minigame arenas
- Admin building spaces
#### PvP/Factions
- Main PvP arena
- Safe zone/Spawn world
- Resource worlds for faction gathering
- Event worlds for special competitions
#### Adventure/RPG Servers
- Hub world for questing
- Multiple adventure dimensions
- Boss arenas in separate worlds
- Story-driven world progression
#### Minigame Networks
- Separate world per minigame
- No cross-world interference

## Deutsch
 
### Was dieses Plugin macht
 
MultiWorldSystem ist eine umfassende Weltmanagement-Lösung für Spigot/Paper-Server. Es beseitigt die Komplexität der manuellen Verwaltung mehrerer Welten und bietet Spielern eine intuitive Möglichkeit, verschiedene Dimensionen und Umgebungen zu erkunden, ohne Ihren Server zu verlassen. Vorbei sind die Zeiten von verwirrenden Konsolenbefehlen oder komplizierten Einrichtungsverfahren - MultiWorldSystem macht die Welterstellung und Teleportation so einfach wie das Eingeben eines Befehls.
 
Dieses Plugin ist für Serveradministratoren konzipiert, die:
- Die Spielmöglichkeiten über eine einzelne Welt hinaus erweitern möchten
- Thematische Welten erstellen möchten (Survival, Creative, PvP, Minigames, etc.)
- Nahtlose Weltenübergänge mit Portalen und NPC-Hubs anbieten möchten
- Die Serverleistung mit ordnungsgemäßer Weltisolation beibehalten möchten
- Mehrsprachige Communities mit integriertem Sprachwechsel unterstützen möchten
### Kernfunktionen erklärt
 
#### Multi-Welt-Erstellungssystem
Erstellen Sie unbegrenzt viele Welten spontan, ohne Ihren Server neu zu starten. Wählen Sie aus vier verschiedenen Welttypen:
- **Normal-Welten** - Traditionelles Minecraft-Survival mit Gras, Bäumen und Mobs
- **Nether-Welten** - Feurige Dimensionen zum Abbau seltener Materialien und Erkundung
- **End-Welten** - Die finale Dimension mit Drachen und wertvollen Beuten
- **Flache Welten** - Perfekt zum kreativen Bauen, für Minigames oder benutzerdefiniertes Terrain
Jede Welt ist völlig isoliert, was bedeutet, dass Spielerdaten, Inventare und Ressourcen separat bleiben. Dies verhindert Griefing und ermöglicht verschiedene Spielmodi auf demselben Server.
 
#### Erweitertes Portal-System
Zwei Möglichkeiten zum Transportieren von Spielern zwischen Welten:
 
**Typ-Portale** - Automatisch generierte Nether- und End-Portale, die Welten verbinden. Gehen Sie durch ein Nether-Portal in Welt A und Sie landen in Ihrer Nether-Welt. Einfach, intuitiv und genau das, was Spieler erwarten.
 
**NPC-Portale** - Platzieren Sie interaktive NPCs in Ihrer Hub-Welt, die als Teleportationsstationen fungieren. Perfekt zum Erstellen einer zentralen Lobby, in der Spieler ihr Ziel visuell wählen können. Passen Sie NPC-Standorte an die Ästhetik Ihres Servers an.
 
#### Nahtlose Teleportation
Der `/wtp`-Befehl ermöglicht augenblickliches und lagfreies Springen zwischen Welten. Spieler können schnell zwischen Welten springen, ohne Ladebildschirme oder Konsolenbefehle. Administratoren können auch andere Spieler oder Gruppen zu bestimmten Welten für Veranstaltungen oder Aktivitäten teleportieren.
 
#### Weltverwaltungs-Tools
- **Alle Welten auflisten** mit `/wlist` - Sehen Sie auf einen Blick alle verfügbaren Welten
- **Neue Welten erstellen** mit `/wcreate` - Spawnen Sie neue Dimensionen in Sekunden
- **Auto-Load-Welten** beim Serverstart - Welten sind bereit, wenn Ihr Server startet
- **Benutzerdefinierte Weltgenerierung** - Konfigurieren Sie die Terrainvererbeitung pro Welt
#### Mehrsprachige Unterstützung
Integrierte Unterstützung für drei große Sprachen, damit Spieler aus verschiedenen Regionen das Plugin in ihrer Muttersprache verwenden können.
 
#### Differenziertes Berechtigungssystem
Vollständige Kontrolle darüber, wer was tun kann:
- **Nur Operatoren** - Beschränken Sie die Welterstellung auf Admins
- **Jeder kann teleportieren** - Erlauben Sie Spielern, alle Welten zu erkunden
- **Benutzerdefinierte Berechtigungen** - Weisen Sie bestimmten Rängen oder Gruppen spezifische Berechtigungen zu
- **Berechtigungsvererbung** - Übergeordnete Berechtigungen gewähren automatisch untergeordnete Berechtigungen
### Vollständige Befehlsreferenz
 
```
/wcreate <name> [type]
  Erstellen Sie eine neue Welt mit optionalem Typ (normal|nether|end|flat)
  Beispiel: /wcreate survival_nether nether
  Berechtigung: pocketdimension.multiworld.create
 
/wtp <world>
  Sofortige Teleportation zu einer beliebigen geladenen Welt
  Beispiel: /wtp creative_world
  Berechtigung: pocketdimension.multiworld.tp
 
/wportal <type> [world]
  Erstellen Sie Nether-/End-Portale oder NPC-Teleporter

  Berechtigung: pocketdimension.multiworld.portal
 
/wlist
  Zeigen Sie alle aktuell geladenen Welten an

/wlang <language>
  Plugin-Sprache ändern (en|es|de)
  Beispiel: /wlang de
  Berechtigung: pocketdimension.multiworld.lang
```

```
  └─ Neue Welten erstellen [Standard: Nur OP]
 
pocketdimension.multiworld.tp

pocketdimension.multiworld.portal

pocketdimension.multiworld.list

pocketdimension.multiworld.lang
  └─ Sprache ändern [Standard: Nur OP]
```

- Nether-Dimension

Spieler können Ressourcen aus mehreren Welten sammeln, ohne die Hauptlandschaft zu zerstören.

Das Plugin wird mit einer vollständig dokumentierten `config.yml` geliefert:
 
**Auto-Load-Welten** - Geben Sie an, welche Welten beim Serverstart geladen werden

## Español
 
### Que hace este plugin
 
MultiWorldSystem es una solución integral de gestión de mundos para servidores Spigot/Paper. Elimina la complejidad de manejar manualmente múltiples mundos y proporciona a los jugadores una forma intuitiva de explorar diferentes dimensiones y entornos sin abandonar su servidor. Se acabaron los días de comandos de consola confusos o procedimientos de configuración complejos: MultiWorldSystem hace que la creación de mundos y la teletransportación sean tan simple como escribir un comando.
 
Este plugin está diseñado para administradores de servidores que desean:
- Expandir las posibilidades de juego más allá de un solo mundo
- Crear mundos temáticos (Supervivencia, Creativo, PvP, Minijuegos, etc.)
- Ofrecer transiciones de mundo sin problemas con portales y centros de NPC
- Mantener el rendimiento del servidor con aislamiento adecuado de mundos
- Apoyar comunidades multilingües con cambio de idioma integrado
### Características principales explicadas
 
#### Sistema de creación de multi-mundos
Cree mundos ilimitados sobre la marcha sin reiniciar su servidor. Elija entre cuatro tipos de mundos distintos:
- **Mundos Normales** - Supervivencia tradicional de Minecraft con pasto, árboles y mobs
- **Mundos Nether** - Dimensiones ígneas para extraer materiales raros y exploración
- **Mundos End** - La dimensión final con dragones y botín valioso
- **Mundos Planos** - Perfecto para construir creativamente, minijuegos o terreno personalizado
Cada mundo está completamente aislado, lo que significa que los datos del jugador, inventarios y recursos permanecen separados. Esto previene griefing y permite diferentes modos de juego en el mismo servidor.
 
#### Sistema de portales avanzado
Dos formas de transportar jugadores entre mundos:
 
**Portales de tipo** - Portales Nether y End generados automáticamente que vinculan mundos juntos. Camina a través de un portal Nether en el Mundo A y aparecerás en tu Mundo Nether. Simple, intuitivo y exactamente lo que los jugadores esperan.
 
**Portales de NPC** - Coloque NPCs interactivos en su mundo central que actúen como estaciones de teletransportación. Perfecto para crear un vestíbulo central donde los jugadores pueden elegir su destino visualmente. Personaliza las ubicaciones de NPC para que coincidan con la estética de tu servidor.
 
#### Teletransportación sin problemas
El comando `/wtp` permite saltos entre mundos instantáneos y sin lag. Los jugadores pueden saltar rápidamente entre mundos sin pantallas de carga ni comandos de consola. Los administradores también pueden teletransportar a otros jugadores o grupos a mundos específicos para eventos o actividades.
 
#### Herramientas de gestión de mundos
- **Listar todos los mundos** con `/wlist` - Vea todos los mundos disponibles de un vistazo
- **Crear nuevos mundos** con `/wcreate` - Genere nuevas dimensiones en segundos
- **Auto-cargar mundos** al iniciar el servidor - Los mundos están listos cuando su servidor se inicia
- **Generación de mundo personalizada** - Configure la generación de terreno por mundo
#### Soporte multilingüe
Soporte integrado para tres idiomas principales que permite a jugadores de diferentes regiones usar el plugin en su idioma nativo.
 
#### Sistema de permisos granular
Control completo sobre quién puede hacer qué:
- **Solo operadores** - Restrinja la creación de mundos a admins
- **Todos pueden teletransportarse** - Permita que los jugadores exploren todos los mundos
- **Permisos personalizados** - Asigne permisos específicos a rangos o grupos
- **Herencia de permisos** - Los permisos principales otorgan automáticamente permisos secundarios
### Referencia de comandos completa
 
```
/wcreate <name> [type]
  Crea un nuevo mundo con tipo opcional (normal|nether|end|flat)
  Ejemplo: /wcreate survival_nether nether
  Permiso: pocketdimension.multiworld.create
 
/wtp <world>
  Teletransportación instantánea a cualquier mundo cargado
  Ejemplo: /wtp creative_world
  Permiso: pocketdimension.multiworld.tp
 
/wportal <type> [world]
  Crear portales Nether/End o teletransportadores de NPC
  Ejemplo: /wportal nether sky_world
  Permiso: pocketdimension.multiworld.portal
 
/wlist
  Mostrar todos los mundos actualmente cargados
  Permiso: pocketdimension.multiworld.list
 
/wlang <language>
  Cambiar idioma del plugin (en|es|de)
  Ejemplo: /wlang es
  Permiso: pocketdimension.multiworld.lang
```
 
### Estructura de permisos
 
```
pocketdimension.multiworld.*
  └─ Permiso principal - otorga todos los permisos a continuación
 
pocketdimension.multiworld.create
  └─ Crear nuevos mundos [Por defecto: Solo OP]
 
pocketdimension.multiworld.tp
  └─ Teletransportarse a mundos [Por defecto: Todos]
 
pocketdimension.multiworld.portal
  └─ Crear portales y NPCs [Por defecto: Solo OP]
 
pocketdimension.multiworld.list
  └─ Listar mundos [Por defecto: Todos]
 
pocketdimension.multiworld.lang
  └─ Cambiar idioma [Por defecto: Solo OP]
```
 
### Casos de uso y tipos de servidor
 
#### Redes de supervivencia
Cree mundos de supervivencia separados con diferentes temas:
- Mundo de supervivencia principal
- Dimensión Nether
- Dimensión End
- Mundo de recolección de recursos
Los jugadores pueden recopilar recursos de múltiples mundos sin destruir el paisaje principal.
#### Servidores creativos
- Mundos de construcción creativos ilimitados
- Mundos dedicados para diferentes constructores/equipos
- Arenas de minijuegos separadas
- Espacios de construcción para administradores
#### PvP/Facciones

- Zona segura/Mundo de aparición
- Mundos de recursos para recolección de facciones
- Mundos de eventos para competencias especiales
#### Servidores de aventura/RPG
- Mundo central para búsquedas
- Múltiples dimensiones de aventura
- Arenas de jefes en mundos separados
- Progresión de mundo impulsada por historias
#### Redes de minijuegos
- Mundo separado por minijuego
- Sin interferencia entre mundos
- Terreno personalizado por modo de juego
- Configuración de torneo fácil
### Configuración y personalización
 
El plugin viene con un `config.yml` completamente documentado:
 
**Mundos de carga automática** - Especifique qué mundos se cargan al iniciar el servidor
**Ambiente predeterminado** - Establezca el tipo de mundo predeterminado para mundos nuevos
