title: Sunbreaking
description: The Minecraft Mod inspired by the Destiny game series!
body:
# Eyes Up, Guardian!

Sunbreaking is a mod created by BrandRobKus that aims to insert the Supers from Destiny into Minecraft!

![Left: Solar Light, Center: Void Light, Right: Arc Light - Crafting Materials](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9dc2a2c8f4eb9a8a1587e3a052a323c5984fa099.png)

While Beyond Light and Lightfall introduced the player to the concept of harnessing the Darkness, Sunbreaking is currently only focusing on some of the fan-favorite Light subclasses. In particular, the mod introduces the Subclasses that released during the Taken King era of Destiny: Sunbreaker, Nightstalker, and Stormcaller. These three Subclasses can be fully harnessed by donning the weapon and armor associated with them, and slotting in their Aspects and Fragments to fully take advantage of the buildcrafting opportunities this mod provides!

## Weapons:
![From Left: Iron Throwing Hammer Inventory Sprite, Shadowshot Bow, Hammer of Sol Inventory Sprite, Stormcaller's Bond Inventory Sprite, Iron Glaive](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97840d7cd78fc4795e6250fbffa9fd026c23c765.png)
The mod introduces two new weapon types and three new Super Weapons! While the Super Weapons are post Netherite and are geared more towards end game Vanilla+, the Throwing Hammer and Glaive can be found decently early in a playthrough.

![A player holding a Netherite Throwing Hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8173f5a3c6b4925e428b0f8d7f3f4bd4808f014_0.webp)
The Throwing Hammer is fairly self explanatory: it hits slightly less hard than an axe, but can be thrown like a Trident, albeit with slightly less reach. It also has three enchantments exclusive to it.

- Recall: a Hammer exclusive version of Loyalty
- Bludgeoning: A damage buff enchantment similar to Sharpness on Swords and Axes
- Bulk: A damage buff that trade off speed and throwing distance for extra damage and the ability do disarm shields like how Axes do. Is Mutually Exclusive with Bludgeoning

![A player holding a Diamond Glaive](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ab82020ea14c810ba93f8ff7d29a8e611a6d192.png)
Glaives are fairly interesting. Like their Destiny Counterpart, they have three functions:
- They can melee hit for solid up close damage
- They can shoot a projectile from their spear head
- They can block incoming damage like a Shield

These effects have a limit, which will be disclosed further down.
Glaives are coded as an extension of Swords, and as such, have all of the Sword enchantments available to them.

## Super Weapons:
![A player holding the Hammer of Sol item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d73f856a6148cd06fc1af5f166f040086bd1789.png)
### Hammer of Sol
The Hammer of Sol is the whole reason this mod exists in the first place, as inferred by the name of the mod Sunbreaking. It is an upgrade of the Throwing Hammer that throws further and explodes on impact. It's meant to be more aggressive and flexible with how you dispatch targets.

![A player holding the Shadowshot Bow item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2029638a9651baf743c37625b0ad81231fbe9800.png)
### Shadowshot
The Shadowshot Bow is an upgrade of the Bow, and as such can have all of the Bow enchantments, both vanilla and modded. It is slightly stronger as the arrows it shoots are slightly faster. However, shooting a Shadowshot Arrow from it (which can be toggled between using them and using other arrows by hitting the [R] key) will summon a Shadowshot Node at the location of where the arrow lands. This Node will create a particle field around it, which anything caught within the field gets Weakness I, Slowness III, and Glowing for their duration within. This is the most support-oriented effect of the three Super weapons, as it is designed to control the field and to give your allies the upper hand, rather than outright doing damage all the time.

![A player who has equipped the Stormcaller's Bond item on their arm](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9fc1cfda4e53bdb2acbaee8183e62b8d61a7ae36.png)
### Stormcaller's Bond
The Stormcaller's Bond is worn on the arm, but does not require any dependency such as Trinkets. It's a mere trick! A ruse! The Bond only appears this way when you're holding the Bond in your hand, as it's just a 3d item model. NOTE: It's untested, but for any mods that adjust the Player's animations, the item may look weird if the arms do not stay straight like how Vanilla does it.

The Bond differs from the Destiny Stormcaller the most, as rather than having electrical wizard fingers, the player throws out a Storm Ball, which on contact with any surface, will bounce up and create a Conductive Zone. Anything within the zone, save for the Player, will be struck with lightning, which does more damage then regular lightning and does not set the struck location on fire. It is a great way to get chip damage on someone or something, and can catch opposing players or mobs by surprise if you corner them in a tight room.

## Armor:
![From Left - Stormcaller's Armor, Sunbreaker's Armor, Nightstalker's Armor, all around a Ruined Portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a058bd65430d47c7188e6c389d5eaa6edf348e6.png)
Sunbreaking adds three new armor sets to the game: Stormcaller's Armor, Sunbreaker's Armor, and Nightstalker's Armor. All three sets are loosely based off of armor you can find in the game. These armor sets do nothing on their own, save for the Nightstalker's set, which goes invisible when the player has the Invisibility effect, though you lose it when melee hitting a target. Something of note, the Stormcaller's and Nightstalker's have a slightly lower toughness than Netherite (2.5 and 2 respectively). However, this is made up by their Aspects.

## Meters
![Top: Gear Meter, with some of it unfilled, and the cost of using something in between the used and unused parts. Bottom: Super Meter, with Solar, Arc, and Void coloration in it. Some of it is used.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00f4f25e2e0008a5a89938fccec4f59fa189910e.png)
Almost everything in Sunbreaking revolves around two meters: the Gear meter (top) and the Super meter (bottom). These will only be visible if you have an item that uses them in your inventory or if you have one of the Sunbreaking Armor sets equipped. When holding an item that uses one of these meters, it will show you the meter cost at the end of your available Meter - the red for the Gear, and the orange, blue, or purple for the Hammer, Bond, and bow respectively. The meters fill up passively, but they also fill up by dealing melee damage to a target, with the Gear meter filling up much faster than the Super meter.

## Aspects
![Each aspect used in Sunbreaking, cycling between Solar, Arc, and Void](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c84d4bfd7e52e880e7e233e8978c5a74e2f5d00b.png)
Aspects can be slotted into a Chestplate of one of the Sunbreaking Armor Chestplates like a Bundle, and by default can store up to two different Aspects. These Aspects give additional buffs to the Player when they have the full respective armor set on. The list is as follows:

### Sunbreaker Aspects:
- **Aspect of Tempering**: Being on fire grants increased Gear meter recharge speed. Pressing the Armor Effect Toggle button [V] grants Fire Resistance, but being on fire with Fire Resistance reduces your Super meter.
- **Aspect of Radiance**: Defeating a target with a melee blow grants Strength for 7 seconds.
- **Aspect of Solace**: Defeating a target while at low health grants Regeneration for 7 seconds.
- **Aspect of Resolve**: Defeating a target with the Hammer of Sol grants increased Super meter charge speed for 7 seconds.
- **Aspect of Benevolence**: Damage you deal with hammers or explosions contribute to your Super and Gear meters, but reduces Super and Gear meter contributions from all other damage sources.

### Nightstalker Aspects:
- **Aspect of Obscurity**: Pressing the Armor Effect Toggle button [V] grants Invisibilty, though this drains your Super meter. Thrown Smoke Bombs will make your Fireteam members invisible if they are within its radius.
- **Aspect of Execution**: You have Strength II for the duration of your Invisibility effects placed on you.
- **Aspect of Dilation**: Defeating a target while at low health grants Absorption 2.
- **Aspect of Renewal**: Defeating a target with the Shadowshot Bow grants increased Super meter charge speed for 4 seconds.
- **Aspect of Harvest**: Damage you deal with arrows contribute to your Super and Gear meters, but reduces Super and Gear meter contributions from all other damage sources.

### Stormcaller Aspects:
- **Aspect of Surge**: Pressing the Armor Effect Toggle button [V] after sprinting for a short time grants Speed, and sprinting for an additional amount of time afterwards grants Speed II, though it does drain your Super meter for the duration. While Speed II is active, melee hitting a target strikes them with Lightning.
- **Aspect of Brilliance**: Lightning strikes you cause blind targets.
- **Aspect of Resistance**: Getting struck by Lightning grants Resistance for 5 seconds.
- **Aspect of Recharge**: Defeating a target with the Stormcaller's Bond grants increased Super meter charge speed for 7 seconds.
- **Aspect of Frequency**: Damage you deal with lightning strikes contribute to your Super and Gear meters, but reduces Super and Gear meter contributions from all other damage sources.

Since each armor set can store up to two of their respective Aspects, and due to their hot-swappable nature, it is encouraged to try new tings with them, and to find a build that works for you!

## Fragments
![The full selection of Fragments, cycling between, Solar, Arc, and Void](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee7e5c81ab2401c856bcf4c2bb924ca0698c218d.png)
Like Aspects, Fragments can be equipped into your Super Weapons like they are a bundle, can hold up to 2 unique Fragments, and grant additional effects depending on the Fragments equipped. Unlike Aspects, however, some Fragments can be stacked, and have more potent effects depending on how many can be equipped at once in their respective items.

### Hammer of Sol Fragments
- **Fragment of Combustion**: Increases Blast Radius and Damage of the Hammer of Sol's explosion, but increases Super meter cost with each stack. Stacks up to VI.
- **Fragment of Blistering**: Ignites the ground at the point of impact.
- **Fragment of Ashes**: Spawns three Explosive Cluster Bombs at the point of impact that travel a short distance and explode on contact.
- **Fragment of Searing**: Ignites targets on melee hit, with burn duration dependent on how many stacks are equipped. Stacks up to IV.

### Shadowshot Bow Fragments
- **Fragment of Expulsion**: Increases the Radius of the Shadowshot Node Field. Stacks up to IV.
- **Fragment of Instability**: The Shadowshot Node will pull in mobs for the duration of its lifetime.
- **Fragment of Cessation**: On despawn, the Shadowshot Node will explode.
- **Fragment of Vigilance**: Shooting a Shadowshot Arrow has a 25% chance to not consume it. Stacks up to IV.

### Stormcaller's Bond Fragments
- **Fragment of Shock**: Press the Toggle Weapon Effect Button [R] to switch to "Precision Mode" which costs less of your Super meter, but only spawns one Lightning Bolt at the struck location.
- **Fragment of Volts**: Throws out an additional Storm Ball per stack, but increases Super meter cost. Stacks up to II.
- **Fragment of Feedback**: Reduces Super cost, but increases time between throws.
- **Fragment of Beacons**: Striking a target with a Lightning Bolt gives them the Glowing effect, with increased stacks giving it for a higher duration. Defeating a Glowing target while the Stormcaller's Bond is equipped slightly fills your Super meter.

## Other Cool Things

### /Fireteam
_/Fireteam_ gives you and your allies a way to get into the fray without affecting each other. not only do effects like the Conduction Zone and the Shadowshot Node not affect your Fireteam members, but they have complete invulnerability to everything you throw at them, and vice versa. Use /Fireteam Invite [Player] to send out an invite, /Fireteam Accept [Inviter] to approve it! From there, you can spend as much time in a fireteam as you'd like until you leave with /Fireteam Leave.

### Smoke Bomb
The _Smoke Bomb_ is something that can be used to grant the Nightstalker temporary invisibility when they have the full Nightstalker armor set on.

### New Crafting Materials
- **Solar Light, Void Light, Arc Light**: Materials used to craft all of the Super weapons and armor. Requires their respective Dimmed Light and a Nether Star to craft.
- **Diminished Solar Light, Fleeting Void Light, Fliskering Arc Light**: Rare, Dimmed forms of Light. Can be found in Bastions, End Cities and Ancient Cities respectively.
- **Solar, Void, and Arc Smithing Templates**: As the Hammer of Sol and all of the Armor sets are upgrades of their Netherite counterparts, they require a Smithing table to craft them. A Smithing Template requires the respective Dimmed Light, and the Table requires the Template and the respective Light to craft your desired item
- **Void Light Shard**: Breaking down Void Light gives you 9 Shards, which can be used to craft Shadowshot Arrows and Smoke Bombs.

## Thank you
I appreciate everyone who gives this mod a try, even if it's not for you! Destiny 2 is a fun game, despite issues within it at the moment, and I wanted to bring some of its charm and fun to Minecraft as well!

_Destiny 2 & all related media © Bungie_

title: PicoFBT
description: Pico Full Body Tracking support for QuestCraft
body:
# PicoFBT - Full Body Tracking for QuestCraft
**Bring your whole body into Minecraft VR! PicoFBT adds native support for Pico Motion Trackers to QuestCraft, enabling full-body tracking with up to 7 tracking points (waist, feet, elbows, and knees).**

## Features:
- **Native Pico Tracker Support** - Seamlessly integrates with Pico Motion Trackers on your Pico 4, 4 Ultra, or Neo 3 headset
- **Auto-Calibration** - Hold a T-pose in the calibration screen for 3 seconds and you're ready to go
- **Low Latency** - Built on Pico's native body tracking API for responsive, real-time movement
- **Pico-Optimized** - Specifically designed for standalone VR on Pico headsets running QuestCraft

## Requirements:
- QuestCraft (Minecraft 1.21.1 with Vivecraft)
- Pico 4, Pico 4 Ultra, or Pico Neo 3 headset
- Pico Motion Trackers (minimum 2 trackers - Pico will estimate additional tracking points)

## How to Use:
- Install the mod JAR into your QuestCraft mods folder, or install it from the mod manager
- Pair your Pico Motion Trackers
- Launch Minecraft VR
- Open Settings → Calibrate FBT...
- Stand in a T-pose with all trackers visible for 3 seconds
- Enjoy full-body immersion in Minecraft!
Transform your Minecraft VR experience from a floating torso to a fully-tracked avatar. Dance, crouch, kick, and move naturally in your blocky world!

title: Unfriendly Creature
description: All living things became unfriendly
body:
你是否厌倦了只会近战冲锋的僵尸和毫无威胁的家畜？《不友好的生物》彻底颠覆了 Minecraft 的生物底层逻辑。现在，这个世界不再有“旁观者”，每一个存在的生灵都对你抱有极深的敌意，并掌握了炼金术的禁忌力量。

✨ 核心功能
众生皆敌 (Universal Hostility)： 模组通过重写 AI 目标选择器，使包括动物、村民、铁傀儡在内的所有生物都会主动锁定并追踪最近的玩家。

远程打击 (Alchemical Artillery)： 赋予所有生物“药水投掷”能力。它们不再依赖身体接触，而是向你投掷具有负面效果的喷溅药水。

混乱诅咒 (Curse of Chaos)： 生物会随机投掷迟缓、虚弱、中毒或剧毒药水。一旦被包围，你将陷入无尽的负面状态循环。

无处可藏 (No Escape)： 无论是温顺的猪羊还是强大的怪物，只要你进入它们的视线，迎接你的就是致命的药水洗礼。

----------------------------------

Have you grown tired of zombies that only know how to charge and livestock that pose no threat? Unfriendly Creature completely overhauls the fundamental logic of Minecraft entities. In this world, there are no "bystanders." Every living creature harbors deep hostility toward you and has mastered the forbidden art of alchemy.

✨ Core Features
Universal Hostility: By rewriting AI target selectors, all entities—including animals, villagers, and Iron Golems—will actively lock onto and track the nearest player.

Alchemical Artillery: Grants all entities the "Potion Throwing" ability. They no longer rely on physical contact; instead, they bombard you with splash potions.

Curse of Chaos: Entities randomly throw Slowness, Weakness, Poison, or Long-lasting Poison. Once surrounded, you'll be trapped in an endless loop of debuffs.

No Sanctuary: Whether it's a humble pig or a fearsome monster, the moment you enter their line of sight, you'll be met with a lethal alchemical barrage.

title: Amethyst weapons and tools

Tired of the monotony of diamond? The Amethyst Tools Mod offers a new, magical choice! We've unlocked the hidden potential of amethyst, transforming it into a powerful and unique set of tools and weapons.

These tools occupy a clever niche in performance: their mining speed surpasses diamond, they swing with swift force, and boast solid, reliable durability. Their true core appeal lies in their unparalleled magical affinity—**the exceptionally high enchantability** of amethyst tools far exceeds conventional materials. This allows you to easily bestow a pickaxe with "Efficiency V" or "Fortune III," or imbue a sword with powerful combat magic, significantly enhancing the rewards and enjoyment of enchanting.

Whether you're seeking to bridge the performance gap between iron and diamond, or simply drawn to the unique aesthetic of deep purple crystals, this toolset perfectly meets your needs. All tools can be crafted using vanilla recipes and repaired with amethyst shards, creating an elegant resource loop.

The Amethyst Tools Mod is thoughtfully designed and balanced within the vanilla ecosystem, aiming to add a touch of efficient and mysterious purple brilliance to your mid-to-late game survival and building experience.

title: Russian translation picker: Villager

body:
<details>
<summary>English description</summary>

# Description

This resource pack adds the ability to replace all mentions of villagers from Russian and pre-revolutionary Russian translation with one of three options:
- Житель (approximate translation: Resident) (the most popular and most commonly used among players)
- Селянин (approximate translation: Rustic) (as translated in Bedrock Edition)
- Деревенский житель (approximate translation: Country Villager) (as in the [Minecraft Wiki](https://ru.mc.wiki/%D0%94%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B9_%D0%B6%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C))

It is also possible to use the original version "Крестьянин" (approximate translation: Peasant).

# Usage

- After installing this resource pack, go to Options —> Language —> Translation option (to the left of the Done button; without the resource pack, Font Settings are located instead of this button).
- Select the translation option you need (the selected option is displayed at the top of the screen).
- If you are using a different language, switch it to Russian or pre-revolutionary Russian.
- Have a nice game!


**This resource pack does NOT work with packs that replace the font or add new characters: the selected translation option may stand out. (See gallery)**
</details>

<details>
<summary>Русское описание</summary>

# Описание

Этот набор ресурсов добавляет возможность заменить все упоминания крестьян (villagers) в русском и дореформенном русском переводе на одно из трёх вариантов:
- Житель (самый популярный и чаще используемый среди игроков)
- Селянин (как в переводе Bedrock Edition)
- Деревенский житель (как на [Minecraft Wiki](https://ru.mc.wiki/%D0%94%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B9_%D0%B6%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BB%D1%8C))

Также сохранена возможность использовать оригинальный вариант «Крестьянин».

# Использование

- После установки этого набора ресурсов, перейдите в Настройки —> Язык —> Вариант перевода (слева от кнопки «Готово»; без набора ресурсов вместо этой кнопки находятся настройки шрифта).
- Выберите необходимый вам вариант перевода (выбранный вариант отображается сверху экрана).

title: Shadow
description: Block VPN and Proxy connections on your server with the best antivpn and antiproxy plugin.
body:
Shadow is a lightweight server-side AntiVPN/AntiProxy plugin for Paper/Spigot (1.20+). When a player connects, Shadow checks whether their IP appears to be a VPN, proxy, Tor exit node, or other anonymized connection. If the connection is flagged, the player is denied entry with a configurable kick message.

Shadow can also detect and block hosting or datacenter IP ranges separately from typical consumer VPNs, so you can choose how strict you want to be. Trusted players or staff can bypass checks with a permission, and the plugin supports in-game reloads for quick config changes.

Commands:
/shadow reload (permission: shadow.reload)
Bypass permission: shadow.bypass

Config options: toggle VPN/proxy/Tor blocking, toggle hosting blocking, custom kick message

title: CmdRelay
description: Automated event engine: execute random commands with weighted chances (%), auto-cooldowns, and dynamic player timers.
body:
# 🚀 CmdRelay
**CmdRelay** is a lightweight and professional event automation engine for Minecraft servers. It allows you to create automated "Event Groups" that execute random commands based on **weighted chances** and **custom intervals**.

### ✨ Key Features
* **🎯 Smart Weight System:** Add commands with simple weights or use percentages (e.g., `99%`). The plugin automatically calculates the math for you.
* **⏰ Auto-Execution:** No manual input needed! Events run on a repeating cycle based on your cooldown settings.
* **⏳ Dynamic Player Commands:** Automatically generates commands like `/eventdelay` (customizable) so players can check the time remaining until the next event.
* **🛡 Permission-Ready:** Fully compatible with **LuckPerms**. Separate access for admins and players.
* **⚡ High Performance:** Optimized code using Bukkit Schedulers to ensure your server stays lag-free (Zero TPS impact).

### 🛠 Commands & Permissions
* `/cmdrelay register <name>` — Create a new event type.
* `/cmdrelay addtoevent <name> <chance%> <command>` — Add an action to the cycle.
* `/cmdrelay reload` — Instantly refresh configuration.
* **Player Command:** `/<event>delay` — Check the cooldown (e.g., `/airdropdelay`).

#### Permissions:
* `cmdrelay.admin` — Access to all plugin settings.
* `cmdrelay.event.time` — Allows players to check event timers.

### ⚙️ Quick Configuration Example
```yaml
events:
  airdrop:
    find-out-time-to-left: 'delay' # Creates /airdropdelay
    cooldown: 12000 # 10 minutes in ticks
    actions:
      - command: "broadcast A legendary crate is falling!"
        chance: 90%
      - command: "spawn_boss_mega"
        chance: 10%

title: Watchdog
description: Notifies admins when monitored staff run sensitive commands in-game or in the console.
body:
## About
Watchdog provides real-time command auditing of staff and console activity for administrators. Command detection is fully configuration-driven, including support for multi-word commands. The plugin monitors sensitive commands executed in-game or from the server console and notifies administrators both in-game (via an alert in chat) and externally through a Discord webhook. Each alert includes the timestamp, world, executor, target, and the full command issued.
## Features
- Config-driven detection (including support for multi-word commands)
- Discord webhook embeds that include the executor, command, target, source (player/console), world, server time, and the full command string
- Asynchronous webhook delivery to avoid impacting server performance
- Permission-based monitoring and notifying 
- Simple and easy configuration
## Setup
1. Install the jar and put it in your plugins folder
2. Create a discord webhook and add it to the config file
3. Use luckperms to give the staff you want to monitor ```watchdog.listen```
4. Give admins who should receive the alerts: ```watchdog.notify```
5. Add any commands you want to the config file and run ```/watchdog reload``` in game or on the console
## In game alerts and Webhooks

NotItem is a lightweight plugin that restricts specific items per world or globally.
Manage restricted items easily via a GUI — no item IDs required.

Perfect for lobby servers, adventure maps, and controlled survival environments.

---

## Features

* Multi-World Support
* Simple GUI-based management (`/notitem gui`)
* Instant item removal with minimal performance impact
* Operator (OP) exemption for administrators
* Fully customizable messages via `language.yml`

---

## Commands & Permissions

### Commands

```
/notitem gui [world|all]      - Open the GUI to manage restricted items
/notitem list [world|all]     - View restricted items
/notitem add <world|all> <item>    - Add a restricted item
/notitem remove <world|all> <item> - Remove a restricted item
/notitem reload               - Reload the configuration
```

### Permission
`notitem.admin`

Required for all commands.

---

## Configuration

### config.yml

```yml
restricted-items:
  world:
    - TNT
    - BEDROCK
```

You can replace `world` with a specific world name, or use `all` to apply restrictions globally.

title: BoatLimiter
description: BoatLimiter prevents boat spam by limiting boat placement per radius and per chunk, including dispenser-based placement. Fully configurable, permission-based, and multilingual.
body:
## 🛥️ BoatLimiter

BoatLimiter is a plugin I created to stop excessive boat spam and the massive lag it can cause on servers.

The main reason for this was a common problem: players building so-called **elytra launchers**, where hundreds of boats get stacked into one spot using dispensers. This can easily drop your server’s TPS down to **0** within seconds. That’s exactly what BoatLimiter is designed to prevent.

With this plugin, you can control how many boats are allowed in a small area (radius) and per chunk — no matter if they’re placed by players or automatically through dispensers or droppers.

It’s easy to set up, simple to configure, and works right away without needing anything else.

---

## ✨ Features

- Limit how many boats can be placed in a certain radius  
- Limit how many boats are allowed per chunk  
- Stops players and machines from stacking boats in one spot  
- Fully configurable via `config.yml`  
- Can be enabled or disabled per world  
- Logs blocked actions (with built-in anti-spam)  
- Includes a small stats system to track abuse  
- Detailed permission & bypass system  
- Supports English & German (with fallback)  
- Works perfectly with LuckPerms  
- Made for real server use  

---

⚠️ **Dispenser & Dropper Protection**

BoatLimiter also handles boat spam coming from:

- Dispensers  
- Droppers  
- Redstone builds using dispensers  

> Important: This plugin does **not** break normal redstone.  
> It only limits boat placement from dispensers and droppers.

---

## ⚙️ Commands

- `/boatlimiter reload` – Reload the config  
- `/boatlimiter stats` – Show stats about blocked actions  
- `/boatlimiter clearchunk` – Remove all boats in the current chunk  

---

## 🔐 Permissions

- `boatlimiter.bypass` – Ignore all limits  
- `boatlimiter.bypass.radius` – Ignore radius limit  
- `boatlimiter.bypass.chunk` – Ignore chunk limit  
- `boatlimiter.reload` – Reload the config  
- `boatlimiter.stats` – View stats  
- `boatlimiter.clearchunk` – Clear boats in the current chunk  

---

## Check Out my other Plugins
- [InfernalForge Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/infernalforge)
- [ScoreTab Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/scoretab)
- [ClearDrop+ Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/cleardropsplus)
- [ItemCoreX Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/itemcorex)

---

## 🌍 Compatibility

- Tested on **Paper 1.21.11**  
- Works with **Minecraft 1.21.x**  
- No dependencies needed

# Chocolate Cake Pack

title: ShellOpUtility
description: this mod gives you useful utility's for finding bases and more
body:
ShellOp

ShellOp is a sleek, customizable client-side and server side toolkit that gives you a power-user terminal, quick-run forms, overlays, and smart scanners — all designed to feel like a natural part of Minecraft.

Carefully crafted for explorers, PvP players, builders, and server regulars alike, ShellOp lets you pull intel fast: see nearby entities, find containers and spawners, scan for ores, jump to saved marks, and run one‑click “Quick Run” forms. It’s lightweight, fully client-side, and plays nice anywhere.

Features

Terminal + Manual:
    In-game terminal: /shellop-ui with history, tab-completion, and clickable outputs
    Book-style manual: /shellop-help with categories, pages, tooltips, and right-click “Quick Run”
    Quick Run forms: right-click in the manual to open friendly forms (entities, blocks, find, ores, containers, spawners, portals, redstone, beehives, vein, marks, convert, ping, overlay, watch)

Smart Scans (client-only data, non-blocking):
    blocks [radius] [be|blocks] [max] — summary with sample coords
    find <id> [radius] [be|blocks|both] [max]
    ores [radius] <name> [max]
    spawners, containers, portals, redstone, beehives
    Progress shown while scanning; results echo to chat with clickable /tp suggestions

Watchers + Alerts:
    watch players [radius] [names…] — notify when players enter range
    watch clusters [radius] [min] — detects chunk hotspots (block-entity density)
    Optional ding sound; clickable coords in chat

Overlay HUD:
    overlay on/off [players hostiles marks] — minimal, readable overlay (players, mobs, marks)

Navigation & Utilities:
    mark add/goto/del/list/clear — fast local waypoints (session-based)
    look — info on what your crosshair hits (block/entity) with coords
    ping — send a clickable coord to chat
    convert <nether|overworld> [x y z] — coordinate conversion
    chunk — chunk/region/dimension/time readout
    vein [limit] — follow a connected vein from your crosshair block

Lightweight:
    Non-blocking background tasks
    Only inspects what your client receives (no extra server load)
    Fully client-side — works on any server

What makes ShellOp different

Instant intel without clutter: CLI when you want it, clean HUD/overlays when you don’t
Manual + Quick Run forms: don’t memorize syntax — just click and run
Clickable outputs: coords show in chat with “click to insert /tp”
Safe by design: scans are limited to loaded chunks/entities (no server hooks or unfair extras)

Install

Requirements:
    Fabric Loader (latest for your Minecraft version)
    Fabric API



Steps:
    Drop the JAR into .minecraft/mods
    Launch the game
    Open the terminal with /shellop-ui or the manual with /shellop-help

How to use

Open terminal: /shellop-ui
    Type help to open the manual UI, or /shellop-help to open it directly
    Tab-completion for commands/args, history with Up/Down
Manual UI:
    Hover for detailed tooltips
    Left-click: copy example
    Shift+Left-click: send clickable suggestion to chat
    Right-click (or Ctrl+Left-click): open a Quick Run form

Quick command reference

Info/navigation
    look
    chunk
    ping [x y z]
    convert <nether|overworld> [x y z]
    mark add <name> [x y z], mark goto <name>, mark del <name>, mark list, mark clear

Overlays/watchers
    overlay on|off [players hostiles marks]
    watch players [radius] [names…]
    watch clusters [radius] [min]
    watch stop

Scans/finders
    entities [radius] [type] [max] (players|hostiles|passives|items|boats|minecarts|all)
    blocks [radius] [be|blocks] [maxPerType]
    find <id> [radius] [be|blocks|both] [max]
    ores [radius] <name> [max]
    spawners [radius] [max]
    redstone [radius] [max]
    beehives [radius] [max]
    containers [radius] [max]
    portals [radius] [max]
    vein [limit]

Notes & limitations

Client-only: you will only see entities and blocks the server actually sends to your client (same dimension, within tracking range)
No server dependency
Background scans avoid freezing; progress shows in action bar/terminal
Marks are session-based (persistence planned)

Configuration

Everything essential is available in the terminal, manual, and Quick Run forms.
If you want a Mod Menu/Cloth Config screen as well, it can be added (this version ships with built-in UIs).

Credits

Frqme — Mod author and developer
XtreaMC — Owner of the QoLabs Organization
FabricMC and Cloth Config teams for their APIs
Minecraft community for ideas and support

License

All rights reserved

title: Sky Dimension Pack
description: Add a dimension based on Minecraft's early planned dimension
body:
# Appereance
The Sky dimension consists of floating islands above the clouds. It's always at noon and has no precipitation. Only chickens spawn naturally here. Plain villages and features like monster rooms, plants and ores also generate here, similiar to the plain biome in the Overworld. Besides there're currently two custom structures here: undead castle and witch house.
# Travel
To enter the Sky dimension, you should defeat the Ender Dragon first. Then craft a dream pillow (the recipe will be unlocked upon killing an ender dragon) and sleep with it in the Overworld.
To leave the Sky dimension, two methods are available. The first is the same as entering the Sky dimension. However, in the Sky dimension you can sleep regardless of time and weather. The second is by just falling into the void. Players will be teleported to the Overworld when below Y=96. (The max Y-value of taking damage from the void is 64, so don't worry about that.) 
# Mobs
Currently, three custom mobs only.
## Corpse
A glowing zombie spawned in the undead castle. It has much higher attack damage, armor and health than a normal zombie.
## Sorceress
A glowing witch spawned in the witch house. It throws and drinks potions with higher level than a normal witch does. Also it has 1/2 chance to throw a lingering potion.
## Sky remains
Currently the final boss in the Sky dimension. It does not spawn naturally. Instead, it is constructed by players like the Wither. Before summoning it, killing a Corpse and a Sorceress is needed. Place an iron block at (0,513,0), a bone block at (0,514,0) and a standing white banner with a black skull pattern at (0,515,0). Throw a blaze powder on the bone block. Then a platform of stones spawns at Y=512 and the Sky Remains appears on it. The Sky remains is a large glowing skeleton, but much stronger than a normal skeleton. It has two phases: in the first phase it uses melee attack while in the second phase it shoots tipped arrows and wither skulls as well as unlocks other skills like arrow trap and regeneration. Prepare yourself before challenging it!
## 
The spawn eggs of custom mobs are provided. Run command /function minecraft:spawn_egg to get them. (Note that Sky Remains summoned by spawn eggs do not behave the same as a normal summoned Sky Remains does.)

# 
This is my first data pack and is still in an early test. It may get updated in the future if I have enough time. Thanks for playing!

# KOHATS
KOHATS is a datapack and resourcepack. That adds hats and easier system for them using new dialog system. Also it's fully support English and Russian.
## How to use
1. Install and enable both datapack and resourcepack.
2. Hold helmet you want to convert in your hand and open KOHATS menu using button in `Pause Menu` or by pressing `Quick Action` (`G` by default).
![KOHATS Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4b1e275d94f4e6f182cbfb880207fe8b74b0e61.png)
3. Select hat you want (There you can see hat previews). If hat supports dye coloring. You can set color you want. For example you want color #EB4034. Open any hex to decimal converter and convert your color. For #EB4034 it will be 15417396. Press `Ok`.
![KOHATS Select Hat Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/776d9c2e903fbd92696032227685be462ccd8af6.png)
4. Minecraft will ask a confirmation. Press `Yes` and your helmet will be replaced with hat.
![Helmet replaced by hat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a827a52bc03ee1bafd4818a4cd9ace4a2f8a155_0.webp)
## Custom hats
You can use your custom hats. Model and translation key is required, tint is optional. However your hat wont appear in `Select Hat` dialog, but you still can get it in `Select Custom Hat` dialog by manually writing translation key and item model. Take a look at resource pack for examples.
## QA
1. Why use `Leather Horse Armor` instead of `Curved Pumpkin`?
    * `Leather Horse Armor` allow both, changing item model and dye coloring.
2. Why color select so ugly?
    * Currently it's best I can do with dialog limitations.
3. I can't get hat in multiplayer.
    * It's due dialog limitation of running at user permissions. So to use it you must have access to `/function` command.

description: RealtimeSynth automatically synchronizes Minecraft's day-night cycle with your real-world time
body:
# RealtimeSynth
**RealtimeSynth synchronizes your real-world time with Minecraft's day-night cycle, creating an immersive experience where the game world reflects the actual time of day. Perfect for players who want their Minecraft adventures to match the rhythm of real life!**
# Features

**Real-Time Synchronization:** Your Minecraft world time automatically matches your system clock

**Seamless World Creation:** New worlds spawn with the correct time of day based on when you 
create them

**Automatic Updates:** Time syncs every 10 seconds without any performance impact

**Smart Mapping:** 6:00 AM real time = sunrise in-game, 12:00 PM = noon, 6:00 PM = sunset, 12:00 AM = midnight

**Configurable Notifications:** Toggle sync messages on/off to your preference

**Time Display Commands:** Check both real and in-game time with simple commands

**Server Compatible:** Works perfectly on both singleplayer and multiplayer servers

# How It Works
Once installed, RealtimeSynth runs completely automatically in the background. The mod disables Minecraft's default day-night cycle and takes full control of time progression based on your computer's clock. If you create a world at 7:00 PM in real life, you'll spawn into a world that's already experiencing evening/night time.

# Technical Details

**Performance Optimized:** Uses efficient tick-based updates every 200 game ticks

**Server-Side Logic:** All synchronization happens server-side for multiplayer compatibility

**Non-Intrusive:** Doesn't interfere with other time-related mods or vanilla mechanics

**Memory Efficient:** Minimal memory footprint with smart caching

# Installation

Download the mod file
Place it in your mods folder
Launch Minecraft with Forge 1.16.5
Time synchronization starts automatically!

title: AetherSentiel
description: simple powerful anticheat named AetherSentiel
body:
**AetherSentinel** is a powerful and flexible anti-cheat solution for Minecraft 1.21.x servers running on Java 21. It includes a wide range of detection modules: Horizontal Motion (Speed, LongJump, HClip), Vertical Motion (Fly, Spider, HighJump, VClip, Step), Water Motion (Jesus, WaterSpeed, WaterFly), Balance (Timer), NoSlow (including NoSlowSneak), RayCast (Reach, HitBoxes), Rotation (AimBot, AimAssist), Velocity (AntiKnockBack, NoVelocity), GroundSpoof (NoFall), as well as WrongPlace and WrongBreak detections.

The system is fully configurable via `config.yml`, allowing you to enable or disable checks, define violation thresholds, and set custom punishment commands (e.g., kick or ban). To reduce false positives, AetherSentinel accounts for special conditions: players using elytra, riding boats, being in creative or spectator mode, or moving in water (where separate water-motion checks apply) are excluded from standard movement checks.

When severe violations occur, the anti-cheat applies its setback system — teleporting players back to their last legitimate position. In addition, administrators have access to built-in alerts that can be toggled with `/aethersentinel alerts`, and the configuration can be reloaded at runtime with `/aethersentinel reload`.

By combining advanced detection techniques, customizable punishments, and smart handling of edge cases, **AetherSentinel** provides reliable protection while keeping gameplay smooth and fair for legitimate players.

title: Advanced Gift
description: Easier gift giving without falling into teleport traps!
body:
Tired of having to send a teleport request to a player to give them a gift? Don't want to risk falling into a death trap when teleporting to a player? Just want an easy way to send gifts? **Then this may be for you!**

With **Advanced Gift**, the players can
- Send any holdable items to other players from any distance
- Attach a message to the gift
- Block gifts from a specific player or everyone
  
For server managers the plugin also offers
- Ability to spy on gift transactions
- Option to set a command cooldown on gifts
- Option to restrict gift transactions per world or per world group
- Option to blacklist gift transactions entirely from a world
- Option to block certain words in gift message
- Customizable plugin messages (_Currently the plugin has built-in translations for en_US and sas_SY. You may submit a translation file for another locale on Github or Discord._)

### Commands:
> **/gift <player> <amount | all> <message>**  
>   Send the item in hand to the targeted player, with an optional amount and an optional message.
>   For now, amount is required if you want to include a message.
> 
> **/gifttoggle**  
>   Block or allow gifts in general
> 
> **/giftblock <player>**  
>   Block gifts from a specific player
> 
> **/giftblocklist**  
>   Check who are blocked, with an option to clear the entire list
> 
> **/giftspy**  
>   Secretly view gift transactions between players
> 
> **/agreload**  
>   Reload configuration files
> 
> **/agtranslate <locale>**  
>   Copy the plugin's language file to disk for customization, with optional locale. If a locale is given, the name of the copied file will include it.
> 
### Permissions:
> **advancedgift.gift.send**  
>   Required to use /gift command. Defaulted to everyone.
> 
> **advancedgift.gift.message**  
>   Required to attach a message to the gift. Defaulted to everyone.
> 
> **advancedgift.gift.spy**

# MultipleSessions

**MultipleSessions** is a simple Minecraft plugin that lets players have separate gameplay _sessions_ on the same server.

A _session_ is like starting over. Different inventory, position, etc. You can create as many as you want and switch between them.

# Commands:
```
    /createsession <id-number>
    Creates a new session with the given ID.

    /changesession <id-number>
    Switches you to the session with that ID.

    /viewsession
    Shows your current session ID.
```


This is useful if you want to start fresh without deleting your current progress, or try different playthroughs without needing a new server.

title: Roll Master
description: Introduce a powerful and fully customizable Gacha/ reward system to your Minecraft server.
body:
# RollMaster
## Build Your Own Rewarding Experience!
---
**RollMaster brings a complete, feature-rich reward rolling system to your server. Designed to boost player engagement and provide a meaningful currency sink, this plugin allows you to create fully customized loot banners that your community will love. From the intuitive player GUI to the powerful in-game editor for admins, RollMaster is the all-in-one solution for server rewards.**

---
## EULA Compliant & Fair Play
RollMaster is a powerful tool designed with Minecraft's commercial usage guidelines in mind. The plugin itself is a mechanism for item distribution and does not inherently violate any rules. **Compliance depends entirely on how you configure the rewards.**

* **For Real-Money Servers:** To remain EULA compliant, any banners that can be rolled using real money (or a virtual currency purchased with real money) should **only grant cosmetic items** that do not give a gameplay advantage (e.g., particle effects, chat titles, non-combat pets, cosmetic armor).
* **For In-Game Currency Servers:** If your rolls are purchased with a currency that can **only be earned through gameplay**, you are free to include any items as rewards, as this is considered part of your server's natural game progression.

RollMaster gives you the complete control to create a fair, engaging, and compliant reward system for your players.

---
## Features
* **GUI-Based System:** Players can browse and roll on banners through a clean, intuitive, and paginated graphical menu.
* **In-Game Banner Editor:** No more fiddling with YAML files! Create, populate, and set prices for your reward banners entirely in-game with a simple command.
* **Weighted Rewards & Pity System:** Configure multiple reward tiers with different drop chances. The built-in guarantee system ensures players get a top-tier reward after a set number of rolls, keeping them motivated.
* **Fully Configurable:** Customize everything from messages and GUI titles to banner items and guarantee counts in the detailed `config.yml`.
* **Vault Economy Integration:** Seamlessly connect to your server's economy. Charge players for rolls and create a balanced currency sink.
* **Admin-Friendly:** A full suite of commands and permissions allows staff to create, toggle, and manage banners, as well as reload the configuration on the fly.
* **Lightweight & Performant:** Designed to be efficient and have a minimal impact on your server's performance.

---
## Requirements
* **[Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/)** - This plugin is **required** for all economy features to work.
* **An Economy Plugin** - You also need an economy plugin that hooks into Vault, such as **EssentialsX**, **CMI**, or any other economy manager.

---
## How It Works (A Quick Guide)
<details>
  <summary>Click to see the process for Players and Admins...</summary>
  
  **For Players:**
  1. **Open the Menu:** Use the `/rollmaster` command to open the banner selection menu.
  2. **Choose and Roll:** Browse the available banners. Clicking on an active banner will charge your account and give you a random reward from its loot table!
  3. **Check Your Progress:** Use `/rollmaster pity` at any time to see how many rolls you have left until you get a guaranteed rare reward on each banner.
  
  **For Admins (Creating a Banner):**
  1. **Start the Creation:** Use the `/rollmaster create <BannerName> <Price>` command.
  2. **Populate the Loot Table:** An editor GUI will open. Place the items you want as rewards into the rows. Each row corresponds to a different chance, configured in `config.yml`.
  3. **Save and Finish:** Simply close the inventory. The banner is now saved and will immediately appear in the player menu!
</details>

---
## Commands & Permissions

### Player Commands
* **`/rollmaster`**
  * **Description:** Opens the main banner selection GUI.
  * **Permission:** rollmaster.use

* **`/rollmaster pity`**
  * **Description:** Shows your personal roll count towards the guarantee on each banner.
  * **Permission:** rollmaster.pity

### Admin Commands
* **`/rollmaster create <name> <price>`**
  * **Description:** Opens the in-game editor to create a new banner.
  * **Permission:** rollmaster.create

* **`/rollmaster toggle <banner_name>`**
  * **Description:** Activates or deactivates an existing banner.
  * **Permission:** rollmaster.toggle

* **`/rollmaster reload`**
  * **Description:** Reloads the `config.yml` and `banners.yml` files from disk.
  * **Permission:** rollmaster.reload

title: CommandQueue
description: CommandQueue is a Minecraft plugin that allows you to queue commands for when a player joins the server.
body:
# CommandQueue
CommandQueue is a Minecraft plugin that allows you to queue commands for when a player joins the server.

## Features
### Commands
- `/commandqueue add <type> <player> <command>` - Adds a command to the queue for a player.
- `/commandqueue remove <type> <player>` - Removes a command from the queue for a player.
- `/commandqueue clear <type> <player>` - Clears all commands in the queue for a player.
- `/commandqueue list <type> <player>` - Lists all commands in the queue for a player.

### Permissions
- `commandqueue.command` - Allows the player to use the `/commandqueue` command.

### Queue Types
- `player` - Makes the player execute the command.
- `console` - Makes the console execute the command.

### Command Placeholders
The following are placeholders that can be used in the command:
- `%player%` - The name of the player.

## Feedback / Bugs
If you have any feedback or suggestions or find any bugs for the plugin, please feel free to open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/tarna/CommandQueue/issues) or join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/SScnNymExa) and let me know.

title: FlameAntiCraft
description: Toggle the crafting & more in different minecraft worlds (optional: multiverse-core)
body:
# FlameCraft - World-Based Crafting Management for Minecraft 🛠️🌍
FlameCraft is a handy Minecraft plugin that allows server administrators to specifically control crafting in different worlds. It offers an easy way to enable or disable crafting for individual worlds, thus enabling customized gaming experiences. ✨
Perfect for servers that want to enforce specific crafting rules in specific worlds, FlameCraft is the ideal solution for dynamically adjusting game mechanics. 🔧🎮

**Key Features:**
World-Based Crafting Management 🌍🛠️
FlameCraft allows server administrators to individually enable or disable crafting in each world. Ideal for Adventure, Hardcore, or Skyblock servers where crafting should be restricted or completely disabled in certain worlds. 🚫🛠️

**Easy control via commands ⚡**
With the command /fc <world> <true/false>, you can easily enable or disable crafting in a world.

true – Enables crafting for the specified world ✅

false – Disables crafting for the specified world ❌

**No restarts required 🔄**
Changes to a world's crafting status take effect immediately, without requiring a server restart. You can dynamically adjust the settings during gameplay. ⚡

**User-friendly configuration ⚙️**
The configuration file is easy to understand and allows you to use both AltColorCodes and MiniMessage for messages. You can flexibly customize the plugin to your needs. ✍️

**⚙️Installation:**
Download the latest version of FlameCraft from Modrinth. 📥

Place the .jar file in the plugins folder of your Minecraft server. 💾

Restart the server or reload the plugin with /reload (if supported). 🔄

Adjust the settings in config.yml to configure crafting management to your liking. ⚙️

**Commands and Permissions:**
Command: /fc <world> <true/false>
Description: Enables or disables crafting for the specified world. 🛠️
Permission: flamecraft.set
Description: Only players with this permission can change the crafting status of a world. 🔑

Why FlameCraft? 🤔
Flexibility: Control crafting individually for each world. 🌍🔧
User-friendly: Easy to configure and use. 🖥️💡
Powerful: No restarts required, instant in-game changes. ⚡
Versatility: Support for MiniMessage and AltColorCodes for engaging messages. 🎨

title: Scrap Yard - Mini Mod
description: A way to bring some extra uses to those under-used items.
body:
NOTICE -=- This mod is in development, so elements are, and most likely will be, subject to change. As of 0.1, all of the textures are currently placeholders, not the final version.

Scrapyard is a small, lightweight, Minecraft mod that aims to help the under-used items of the game, by bringing some new uses to the table. The primary additions of the mod are the new Scrap Compactor block, the Scrapper villager profession, and the Scrap block.

Additions :
Scrap Compactor -=- The Scrap Compactor lets you take four of any non-Scrap item, and compact it into Scrap. The Scrap Compactor can be either crafted or bought from a Scrapper villager.

Scrapper Villager Profession -=- The new Scrapper villager profession comes with a new dedicated structure and two new trades. The Scrapper can be found in his Scrapper House, found throughout the world. His two new trades allow you to sell him Scrap and buy the Scrap Compactor.

Scrapper House -=- This small new structure generates throughout the world in a few of the same biomes as villages. The Scrapper naturally spawns here and it even comes with a Scrap Compactor inside.

New Blocks -=- This mod comes with a few new blocks to play around with. These are, the Rusted Iron Door, the Rusted Iron Trapdoor, the Scrap block, and the Mesh Fence.

title: MopsIsLand

# RU
# MopsisLand — Плагин для создания денежных островов с античит-защитой  
*Настраиваемая система заработка в регионах с интеграцией экономики и защитой от креатива*  

---

## 🌟 Особенности

### 💰 **Гибкая настройка выплат**  
- Минимальное/максимальное количество монет за интервал  
- Шанс получения денег (в процентах)  
- Настраиваемый интервал выплат (в секундах)  

### 🛡️ **Античит-система**  
- Автоматическая телепортация игроков в креативе из региона  
- Поддержка команд `/spawn` через Essentials/CMI  

### 🗺️ **Интеграция с WorldEdit**  
- Установка регионов через `//wand` одной командой  
- Поддержка FAWE для высокопроизводительных серверов  

---

## ⚙️ Требования

| Плагин | Назначение | Ссылка |  
|--------|------------|--------|  
| **Vault** | Работа с экономикой | [Скачать](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) |  
| **EssentialsX** или **CMI** | Команда `/spawn`, экономика | [EssentialsX](https://essentialsx.net/) / [CMI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/cmi-298-commands-insane-kits-portals-essentials-economy-mysql-sqlite-much-more.3742/) |  
| **FAWE** или **WorldEdit** | Работа с регионами | [FAWE](https://intellectualsites.github.io/download/fawe.html) / [WorldEdit](https://enginehub.org/worldedit/) |  
| **LuckPerms** | Управление правами | [Скачать](https://luckperms.net/) |  

---

## 🚀 Установка

1. Скачайте последнюю версию `Mopsisland.jar` из релизов  
2. Переместите файл в папку `./plugins/`  
3. Перезапустите сервер  
4. Настройте регион через `/mi set` (требуются права `mopsisland.admin`)  

---

## ⚡ Быстрый старт

1. **Настройте регион**:  
   ```bash
   /mi set # С выделением WorldEdit
   
2. **Пример конфигурации**:
```bash
payout:
  interval: 5
  min: 10
  max: 50
  chance: 80

check-gm:
  enabled: true
  ```
---

neon4ick & Mopsik9000

title: Book Binder
description: A small, outdated data pack for generating random books. Mainly meant to be incorporated into other data packs.
body:
Pretty much what the summary says: "A small, outdated data pack for generating random books. Mainly meant to be incorporated into other data packs."

--- ### Functions
`book_binder:book/upload {no arguments}`: Attempts to upload the pages of the currently held book to storage. Fails if the executer isn't a player with a book and quill or written book in their main-hand. Overwrites any previous data if successful. `book_binder:book/add_pages {no arguments}`: Attempts to append the pages of the currently held book to the pages within storage. Fails if the executer isn't a player with a book and quill or written book in their main-hand. `book_binder:book/add_page {page:}`: Appends the data of argument "page" to the pages within storage. Data of argument "page" is treated as a string enclosed in double quotes, even if it wasn't originally. In most cases, I'd suggest using `book_binder:book/add_pages` instead. `book_binder:book/clear {no arguments}`: Removes all pages within storage. Simple as that. `book_binder:book/remove_page {page:}`: Attempts to remove the page at index "page" within storage. Fails if the targeted page doesn't exist. `book_binder:book/output {no arguments}`: Attempts to create a writen book item entity containing a copy of the pages within storage. Note: said item entity despawns in 2 game ticks, to prevent clutter. Fails if there aren't any pages within storage. `book_binder:book/generate {pages:}`: Attempts to create a writen book item entity containing "pages" number of random pages from storage. Note: said item entity despawns in 2 game ticks, to prevent clutter. Each page within storage can occur only once in the generated book, and are randomly arranged in said book. Attempting to generate a book with more pages then what's been stored will result in a book with as many pages as what's in storage. Attempting to use integers less than or equal to one for the argument "pages" results in a book with only one page. Fails if there aren't any pages within storage. `book_binder:construct/add {page:}`: Attempts to append the page at index "page" within storage to a second set of pages within storage. Changes made to one set of pages isn't reflected in the other set. Fails if the targeted page doesn't exist. `book_binder:construct/remove {page:}`: Attempts to remove the page at index "page" from the second set of pages within storage. Fails if the targeted page doesn't exist. `book_binder:construct/output {no arguments}`: Attempts to create a writen book item entity containing a copy of the second set of pages within storage. Note: said item entity despawns in 2 game ticks, to prevent clutter. Fails if there aren't any pages in the second set of pages within storage. `book_binder:construct/clear {no arguments}`: Removes all pages from the second set of pages within storage. --- I'll probably make a simple video to demonstrate these functions.

title: SkyAttack
description: Experience a completely new way to play Skyblock, with MMO elements and multiplayer systems—all set in the Void!
body:
# ☁️ Sky Attack

**Sky Attack** is a feature-rich Skyblock datapack for **Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.x**.

Start on a tiny island suspended above the void and build your way up from limited resources. With a custom skill system, reworked fishing rewards, custom recipes, and unique progression mechanics, Sky Attack offers its own take on the classic Skyblock experience.

> 🌐 Currently available in **English**. Some untranslated German text may still appear and will be updated in future releases.

---

### 🚧 Active Development

Sky Attack is an actively developed project. While the core gameplay is fully playable, new content, mechanics, and improvements are continuously being added.

⚠️ **Important:** Due to ongoing development, updates may introduce changes that are not compatible with existing worlds. In some cases, updating to a newer version may cause issues or break existing worlds.

Creating regular backups before updating is strongly recommended.

Feedback, suggestions, and bug reports are always welcome and help shape future updates.


---

## 🌍 The World

The **Overworld** and **Nether** are completely empty. No terrain, no structures — only the void.

Biomes still exist and affect weather, lighting, mob spawning, and fishing rewards. Be careful when exploring the Nether; there is nothing below you.

---

## ⚙️ Gamerules

| Setting           | Value    |
| ----------------- | -------- |
| Keep Inventory    | Enabled  |
| Difficulty        | Hard     |
| Random Tick Speed | 15       |
| Mob Griefing      | Disabled |

---

## 🎮 Features

### ⛏️ Skill System

Level up different skills while playing:

* Mining
* Fishing
* Farming
* Combat
* Logging

Each skill grants bonuses and improved drops as your level increases.

### 🎣 Reworked Fishing

Fishing is one of the core progression systems in Sky Attack.

* Completely reworked fish, junk, and treasure loot pools
* Many otherwise unobtainable resources can be obtained through fishing
* Special creature spawns can appear while fishing
* Spawned creatures depend on the biome you're fishing in

### 📦 Custom Recipes

Resources that would normally be unavailable in Skyblock can be crafted through custom recipes.

Use the in-game Wiki to discover them.

### 🗺️ In-Game Wiki

Access guides, mechanics, and gameplay information directly in-game through the built-in menu.

---

## 🚀 Getting Started

When joining for the first time, you will spawn in a central hub with an NPC.

Talk to the NPC to create your personal Skyblock island and begin your adventure.

The Minecraft Quick Actions menu (default key: **G**) provides access to:

* The Sky Attack Wiki
* Player statistics (work in progress)
* Teleportation features that expand as you progress

---

## 🔧 Development Status

| System                           | Status         |
| -------------------------------- | -------------- |
| Multiplayer / Island Join System | Finished       |
| Fishing Rewards Expansion        | In Development |
| Nether & End Content             | Planned        |

---

## 📋 Requirements

* Minecraft Java Edition **1.21.11**
* No mods required
* Pure datapack

---

## 💡 Inspirations

Sky Attack takes inspiration from:

* SparkofPhoenix's Elements project
* Hypixel Skyblock

This project is **not** a recreation of Elements. All systems were developed independently and are designed to create a unique Skyblock experience.

---

💬 Have feedback, found a bug, or have ideas for future features?

Feel free to leave a comment or get in touch.

title: BlueMap Biomes Textures Correction
description: BMBTC is a pack for BlueMap which aims to fix the white-ish bug with some modded biomes
body:
[Bluemap](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bluemap) is a really cool plugin, but when using it on an hybrid launcher (e.g.: Youer) there might be some glitches, for example with modded biomes !

# Why

So instead of having a beautiful 3d map full of colors, you get white-colored trees and plants as if the pale garden invaded the overworld, which is quite annoying. This is due to some blocks that depend on the biomes they are placed in.
For instance, the vanilla grass block: if it's in the Savanna or the Jungle, its color will be drastically different, but it's still the same block. (The vanilla grass block has no issues, it's just an example to make it easy to understand)![The grass block in various biomes (by u/NamrednE125)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39f4cc30588ab5bc990e5ae4a4a7b13ee4f8b3a6.webp)

This pack addresses these bluemap biomes texturing issues for the following mods :


```
- Twilight Forest (twilightforest-1.21.1-4.8.3287-universal.jar)
- Regions Unexplored (regions_unexplored-neoforge-1.21.1-0.5.8.jar)
- Biomes O' Plenty (BiomesOPlenty-neoforge-1.21.1-21.1.0.13.jar)
- Nature's Spirit (natures_spirit-2.2.5-1.21.1.jar)
```


# How to use

To use the pack, simply put it in ```\plugins\BlueMap\packs```, then execute the command ```/bluemap reload```. Don't forget to purge the bluemap map in which the glitched blocks were with ```/bluemap purge [map]```, because otherwise the blocks won't patch by themselves in the old render !


It should also work for future versions of the mods. If there are new blocks you'll just have to edit the pack by adding the glitched blocks in both the assets and data folders, obviously in the same format as the other blocks. I will only be updating this pack for my own needs when I find a glitched block.

# Help

If you have any questions about this pack or any other Bluemap related things, feel free to go on [Bluemap's Official Discord](https://discord.gg/zmkyJa3), people will be happy to help you !

title: Rotten To Beef
description: Rotten To Beef is a simple, lightweight Fabric mod that lets you smelt rotten flesh into raw beef in a furnace.
body:
# Rotten To Beef

**Rotten To Beef** is a simple, lightweight Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2 / Chaos Cubed that gives rotten flesh a useful survival purpose.

Instead of throwing away stacks of rotten flesh from zombies, mob farms, dungeons, or early-game combat, you can smelt rotten flesh in a furnace and turn it into raw beef. It is a small quality-of-life recipe mod that fits naturally into vanilla Minecraft without adding new blocks, new items, new mobs, or complicated mechanics.

## Features

* Smelt rotten flesh into raw beef
* Uses a normal furnace recipe
* Lightweight and vanilla-friendly
* Great for survival worlds, zombie farms, and food-focused gameplay
* No extra items, blocks, or clutter
* Built for Fabric on Minecraft 26.2

## Why use this mod?

Rotten flesh is one of the most common mob drops in Minecraft, but it often becomes useless very quickly. This mod makes rotten flesh worth keeping by letting players convert it into beef through smelting. It is useful for survival players who want a fair way to turn zombie drops into food without making the game feel overpowered.

## Important information

This mod only adds one simple recipe: rotten flesh can be smelted into raw beef. It does not change zombie drops, cow drops, hunger values, furnace behavior, or vanilla food mechanics.

# Create: Just for Fun

A casual Neoforge 1.21.1 modpile built around the Create ecosystem, designed for players who want a rich mechanical sandbox without the hassle of choosing dozens of mods themselves.

## What's Inside

This modpack centers on Create and expands it with a set of addons and complementary mods:

- Create - The core mechanical engineering mod: gears, conveyors, trains, and contraptions.
- Create: Aero - Take Create to the skies with airships and aerial contraptions.
- CC: Tweaked - Programmable computers and turtles, great for complex automation.
- Addons & extras - A collection of supporting mods that extend and enhance the above.

Everything (with small exceptions) is left at default configuration, following each mod creator's intended experience.

## Why This Modpack?

- Plug and play - A pre-assembled collection of compatible Create-family mods so you don't have to chase down versions and dependencies yourself.
- Focused on a single thing - Adds engineering challenge, without overhauling unrelated systems.
- Open development - Don't like something? Want a mod added? Suggest changes on the GitHub repo.

## Before You Download

## Known Issues

- None for this momemt :)


### Hardware Requirements

| Component        | Required                  | Recommended       |
| ---------------- | ------------------------- | ----------------- |
| CPU              | Coffee Lake Refresh/Zen 2 | Raptor Lake/Zen 4 |
| RAM/Allocated    | 16/8GB                    | 16/8GB            |
| Storage          | SATA SSD                  | NVMe SSD          |
| GPU              | Iris Xe/Vega 7            | ARC B570/RX 7600  |
| OS               | Linux                     | Linux             |

Performance issues on systems below the `Required` specification will be closed, unless the issue can also be replicated on supported hardware.

## Alternative method of installation

This modpack is developed using packwiz. This opens up a possiblity of using it instead of modrinth for installation. Why would you do that? It's a more native way and you will get (Automatic!) updates as soon as they're pushed.

1. Create minecraft instance with Neoforge 1.21.1
2.  Go to [this github page](https://github.com/packwiz/packwiz-installer-bootstrap) and download packwiz installer bootstrap from releases
3. Put the downloaded .jar file to your minecraft instance root
4. Add the following:`"$INST_JAVA" -jar packwiz-installer-bootstrap.jar https://first-non-interesting-username.github.io/create-just-for-fun/pack.toml` to your instance extra launch arguments

title: Power Mobs
description: A vanilla+ plugin for custom mobs and items!
body:
# **Welcome to the Power Mobs plugin!**

**Why was the Power Mobs plugin created?**

I was a user of many free plugins over the years for my family server. However, some plugins didn't allow the customizability I needed or intruded too much on the vanilla experience. So I created this plugin for a customizable Vanilla+ experience that can allow you to still do everything you can do in vanilla Minecraft (such as mob farms). Initially, it was only going to be for personal use with my family, but I decided to make it open to everyone!

**What are Power Mobs?**

Simply put, they are custom mobs that can spawn within your Minecraft world with special equipment, abilities, and attributes. This special equipment is also obtainable. All of it is configurable!

**What features are included?** 

* Customizable items (attributes, custom model data, enchantments, potion effect interaction, and more)
* Power Mobs that are fully customizable with stats, drops, equipment, and some special abilities!
* Limit Power Mobs from spawning based on the defined spawn context, such as biome, mob type, coordinates, and more.
* In-game UI for editing Power Mobs easily
* Spawn blockers to prevent these Power Mobs from spawning where you don't want them to. Mob farms are saved! (Current limit of a 5x5 chunk radius)
* Timers to prevent these unique mobs from spawning too frequently or too much in a given area
* Spawn Keys for spawning in Power Mobs with dialogue and effects.

**How do I use the plugin?**

Eventually, it will be more plug-and-play with more default Power mobs and items, but everything is still ready for personal configuration!
Main things to be aware of:
1) In the Minecraft world, use the command /powemob config, which will pull up a UI to add, remove, or alter Power Mob settings.
2) Most of the related config files have all the information needed to know how to create/edit your own special items and mobs, or tweak global settings and abilities.

**Possible future updates:**

* Add custom potions config
* ~~Make ability config per Power Mob instead of being universal~~
* Have Power Mobs settings to have world-specific settings
* Add more item customization
* Add more Power Mobs and create items for easier plug and play
* Add more custom abilities
* UI capability to copy mobs for rapid mob variations
* Config for default created Power Mob settings
* Predefined drop settings packs(for common drops among many mobs)
* Tutorial video
* Optimizations
* Bug fixes, tweak default settings, and more!

**Aditional Info**

This is the first plugin I have created and have been working on for a long time. If you encounter any bugs, typos, or odd settings that I've missed, please report them in the [Discord](https://discord.gg/q2fdtuwjze). 

Compatibility for Leveled Mobs and Infernal Mobs has been tested, and info about it is in the README.md on [GitHub](https://github.com/littleexxgames/powermobs)

Should be compatible with Minecraft 1.21.4 - 26.1.2 for Paper/Spigot. Maybe ones before that as well.

If you enjoy the plugin, consider -

* Donating through my [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/littleexx)
* Joining the [Discord](https://discord.gg/q2fdtuwjze) to say hi!

title: MSMP Entity
description: Extends the Minecraft Server Management Protocol (MSMP) by providing additional functions for getting and setting entity data
body:
# MSMP Entity

A server-side Fabric mod that extends the [Minecraft Server Management Protocol](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Server_Management_Protocol) (MSMP) by providing additional functions for getting and setting entity data.

This mod is designed for tooling, dashboards, automation systems, external monitoring tools, and integrations that need structured access to entity information without relying on command parsing or RCON hacks.


## Installation

1. Download the mod `.jar` and place it in your server's `mods/` folder.
2. Enable the Management Server in `server.properties`:
   ```properties
   management-server-enabled=true
   ```
3. Start the server. The Management Server will listen on `localhost:25576` by default.


## Configuration

On first start, the mod generates a configuration file at `<server_root_dir>/config/msmp/entity/config.yml`, where you can tune the notification system for the tracked events that use threshold/interval-based polling:

```yaml
# Main configuration file for MSMP Entity.

# Configuration for position-related settings.
position:
  # Settings for notifications.
  notification:
    # Number of server ticks between position change checks for subscribed entities.
    # Lower values result in more frequent checks and potentially more notifications, but can increase server load.
    # @default: 20
    interval-ticks: 20
    # Minimum distance in blocks that an entity must move to trigger a position change notification.
    # Setting this to 0.0 will trigger a notification for any movement.
    # @default: 1.0
    block-delta: 1.0
# Configuration for rotation-related settings.
rotation:
  # Settings for notifications.
  notification:
    # Number of server ticks between rotation change checks for subscribed entities.
    # Lower values result in more frequent checks and potentially more notifications, but can increase server load.
    # @default: 20
    interval-ticks: 20
    # Minimum change in yaw or pitch, in degrees, that an entity must rotate to trigger a rotation change notification.
    # Setting this to 0.0 will trigger a notification for any rotation change.
    # @default: 10.0
    rotation-delta: 10.0
```

Lower interval values mean more frequent checks (and potentially more notifications), at the cost of slightly more server load. Setting a delta to `0.0` triggers a notification on any change, however small.


## RPC Methods

The mod currently provides the following MSMP RPC methods. All of these methods are also automatically discoverable through the standard `rpc.discover` MSMP endpoint.

| Method                            | Description                                                                                   |
| --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `entity:dimension`                | Returns the current dimension of any loaded entity by UUID, or a player by name               |
| `entity:dimension/set`            | Transfers any loaded entity to the given dimension, keeping its current position and rotation |
| `entity:dimension/changed`        | Returns a list of all tracked entities for the dimension changed event                        |
| `entity:dimension/changed/add`    | Add entities to the dimension change notification tracker                                     |
| `entity:dimension/changed/clear`  | Clear all entities for the dimension changed event                                            |
| `entity:dimension/changed/remove` | Remove entities from the dimension change notification tracker                                |
| `entity:health`                   | Returns the current and maximum health of any LivingEntity                                    |
| `entity:health/set`               | Partially updates the health and/or maximum health of any LivingEntity                        |
| `entity:health/changed`           | Returns a list of all tracked entities for the health changed event                           |
| `entity:health/changed/add`       | Add entities to the health change notification tracker                                        |
| `entity:health/changed/remove`    | Remove entities from the health change notification tracker                                   |
| `entity:items`                    | Returns all occupied inventory slots of an online player in Vanilla NBT format                |
| `entity:items/set`                | Partially updates an online player's inventory using a diff approach                          |
| `entity:items/changed`            | Returns a list of all tracked entities for the items changed event                            |
| `entity:items/changed/add`        | Add players to the items change notification tracker                                          |
| `entity:items/changed/remove`     | Remove entities from the items change notification tracker                                    |
| `entity:position`                 | Returns the current position of any loaded entity                                             |
| `entity:position/set`             | Teleports any loaded entity to the given position within its current dimension                |
| `entity:position/changed`         | Returns a list of all tracked entities for the position changed event                         |
| `entity:position/changed/add`     | Add entities to the position change notification tracker                                      |
| `entity:position/changed/remove`  | Remove entities from the position change notification tracker                                 |
| `entity:rotation`                 | Returns the current rotation of any loaded entity by UUID, or a player by name                |
| `entity:rotation/set`             | Sets the rotation of any loaded entity, preserving its position and dimension                 |
| `entity:rotation/changed`         | Returns a list of all tracked entities for the rotation changed event                         |
| `entity:rotation/changed/add`     | Add entities to the rotation change notification tracker                                      |
| `entity:rotation/changed/remove`  | Remove entities from the rotation change notification tracker                                 |
| `entity:saturation`               | Returns the current food level and saturation of an online player                             |
| `entity:saturation/set`           | Partially updates the food level and/or saturation of an online player                        |
| `entity:saturation/changed`       | Returns a list of all tracked entities for the saturation changed event                       |
| `entity:saturation/changed/add`   | Add players to the saturation change notification tracker                                     |
| `entity:saturation/changed/remove`| Remove entities from the saturation change notification tracker                               |
| `entity:uuid`                     | Returns the UUID of an online player by name                                                  |


## RPC Notifications

The mod also provides the following MSMP RPC notifications that clients can subscribe to:

| Method                                    | Description                                                          |
| ----------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `entity:notification/dimension/changed`   | Fires when a tracked entity changes dimension                        |
| `entity:notification/health/changed`      | Fires when a tracked LivingEntity's health changes                   |
| `entity:notification/items/changed`       | Fires when a tracked player's inventory or equipment changes         |
| `entity:notification/position/changed`    | Fires when a tracked entity moves at least `blockDelta` blocks       |
| `entity:notification/rotation/changed`    | Fires when a tracked entity rotates at least `rotationDelta` degrees |
| `entity:notification/saturation/changed`  | Fires when a tracked player's food level or saturation changes       |

> If you want more methods or notifications for other purposes, please [open an issue](https://github.com/MinecraftPlayground/msmp-entity-mod/issues/new?template=new_method_or_notification_suggesetion.yml)
