body:
Maze Runners is a competitive Minecraft Fabric mod that turns procedurally generated mazes into a full tournament-style minigame.

Players race through large mazes filled with traps, effects, and tactical items while a global timer tracks performance across multiple tournament stages.

Perfect for events, livestreams, and competitive servers.

**Features**

 Procedural Maze Generation

 Tournament System (32 → 16 → 8 → 4)

 Global Tournament Timer (Bossbar)
 Best-Time Tracking & Leaderboard
 Player GUI Menu
 Advanced Spectator Mode
 Strategic Traps (Carpets)
 Teleport Swap Item
 Custom Maze Center Placement
 Admin-Controlled Flow (no automation chaos)

**General**
/maze menu
Open the Maze GUI

/maze join
Join the event (if open)

/maze leave
Leave the event

**Event Control**
/maze event open
Allow players to join

/maze event close
Close joining

**Maze Center**

/maze center here
Set maze center to your position

/maze center set <x y z>
Set maze center manually

/maze center get
Show current center

/maze center clear
Remove center

Maze Generation (Testing / Freebuild)

title: PetProtector
description: Protects tamed pets (wolves, cats, parrots) from selected damage types with per-entity configuration.
body:
## 🐾 PetProtector

### 🇬🇧 English

**PetProtector** is a lightweight plugin that protects tamed pets on Minecraft Java servers.

The plugin prevents **tamed wolves, cats, and parrots** from dying due to common environmental damage such as:

- fall damage  
- fire and lava  
- explosions  
- block-related damage (cactus, etc.)

Each damage type can be configured individually via the **config file**, allowing server owners to fine-tune protection *without breaking game balance*.

**PetProtector does not interfere with PvP** or damage from players and mobs — protection applies **only to environmental sources**.

The plugin is optimized, has **minimal performance impact**, and works on **Paper** and **Purpur** servers.

---

### 🇷🇺 Русский

**PetProtector** — это лёгкий плагин для защиты приручённых питомцев на Minecraft Java серверах.

Плагин предотвращает гибель **приручённых волков, кошек и попугаев** от распространённых источников урона окружающей среды, таких как:

- урон от падения  
- огонь и лава  
- взрывы  
- контакт с блоками (кактус и т.п.)

Каждый тип урона настраивается отдельно через **config-файл**, что позволяет гибко настраивать защиту *без нарушения игрового баланса*.

**PetProtector не вмешивается в PvP** и не блокирует урон от игроков или мобов — защита применяется **только к урону от окружения**.

Плагин оптимизирован, практически не влияет на производительность и работает на **Paper** и **Purpur**.

title: Oggvik's Inventory Freeze
description: Let's you "freeze" configurable inventory slots globally for all players
body:
# `Oggvik's Inventory Freeze`
A simple Minecraft Forge mod written in Java that lets you "freeze" configurable inventory slots globally for all players. It's main purpose is to be used on a server (e.g. an RP server with roleplaying events where you'd want to limit the number of inventory slots for the sake of added immersion) or as part of modpacks (e.g. ultra hardcore survival ones).

The mod provides a single command to enable globally "freezing" specific inventory slots using the command:
#### `/inventory-lock [true/false]`

## `DESIGN`
- 🪷 Very clean and simple code written in Java
- 🔒 Server-side watchdog to prevent item duping exploits & item deletion
- 🚀 Could easily be ported to newer Minecraft/Forge versions
- 😎 Custom item pickup logic to prevent picking up items into "frozen"/"locked" inventory slots
- 🎨 GUI effects (frontend) code isolated from the rest of the program's internal logic (backend)
- 🩷 Tiny size (currently a mere `~330 KB`)
- 👋 Tested to work in both survival and on multiplayer with many people / on a server

## `FUNCTIONALITY`
- 🧊 "Freeze" parts of the players' inventories while `/inventory-lock true` is set.
- ❌ When `/inventory-lock` is `true` players cannot put in, take out, or delete items from *their own* "frozen"/locked inventory slots.
- 👗 Only freezes the inventory slots configured. Aka doesn't affect inventory slots such as chests, other mods (e.g. backpacks), armor, capes, and other custom inventory slots related to cosmetics.
- 🔢 The inventory slots to be frozen are to be easily configurable by server admins.
- 🪽 Automatically unfreezes the inventories of players when they switch to creative mode, then re-freezes them again if they exit creative mode while the `/inventory-lock` is `true`.
- 🖼️ The slots that are frozen will be indicated with a gray transparent square overlay (indicator appearance might be altered in future versions).
- [WIP] ~~🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Optionally exclude specific players from the `/inventory-lock`. For example whoever is hosting an RP event on a server or playing an actor could be excluded from the `/inventory-lock` for the duration of that time.~~

## `COMPATIBLE VERSIONS`
Minecraft: `1.16.5`
Mod Launcher: Forge (tested on `36.2.42`)

## `BUILDING THE PROJECT`
To build the project for the first time you'll need to go to its root directory and run:
`./gradlew build --refresh-dependencies`
Though on subsequent compiles it is enough to simply run `./gradlew build`
Compilation has been tested to work with Java 17 OpenJDK but some versions above that and any version lower until at least Java 8 should also work.
The above will generate an `inventoryfreeeze-X.X.X.jar` in the `./build/libs` directory, which you can then add to a Minecraft 1.16.5 Forge profile to play.

Also, if you're using IntelliJ IDEA (which I'd recommend), you can also compile Forge Gradle Runs by executing:
`./gradlew genIntellijRuns`

## `EXAMPLE SCREENSHOTS`
### Example 1 – With custom mod config
![Locked slots gray overlay example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65c5f9bc8619ef33c210a07af918265006a47817_0.webp)
`Example 1` shows locked inventory slots according to the custom server config below:
![Custom inventory slot selection server-side config example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a33ddeebfb595af722d21f576cccf1e9114963c4.png)

### Example 2 – With a modpack
Here is an example of the inventory freeze feature in action as part of a modpack:
![Locked slots gray overlay in a modpack example](https://gitlab.com/oggviks-minecraft-mods/oggviks-inventory-freeze/-/raw/master/images/example-2-modpack.png?ref_type=heads)

Credits: ["Dawn of Humanity"](https://dawnofhumanity.net/) AoT-inspired modpack

### Example 3 – With a modpack + resource pack
![Locked slots gray overlay with a resource pack example](https://gitlab.com/oggviks-minecraft-mods/oggviks-inventory-freeze/-/raw/master/images/example-3-modpack-with-custom-resource-pack.png?ref_type=heads)
Same as `example 2` but showing the overlay indicator effect also working when a resource pack is applied.
Notice the locked inventory slots appear darker than the unlocked hotbar slots, whereas in this resource pack they would normally all have the same color.

Credits: ["Dawn of Humanity: RP!" Resource pack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/dawn-of-humanity-rp/gallery)

title: BassetBlocks: Creator
description: The BassetBlocks Creator modpack is a comprehensive collection of client-side mods and resource packs specifically curated for Minecraft content creators.
body:
# The BassetBlocks Creator Modpack

The **BassetBlocks Creator** modpack is a comprehensive collection of client-side mods and resource packs specifically curated for Minecraft content creators. It is built to provide a stable, high-performance foundation using optimization mods like **Sodium**, **Lithium**, and **FerriteCore**, ensuring smooth gameplay for recording and streaming.

The pack features powerful cinematic tools such as **ReplayMod**, **Flashback**, and **Camera Utils**, allowing for sophisticated recording and editing. It also enhances the creative workflow with utility mods like **Litematica** for schematics and **Armor Poser** for scene setup. Visuals are significantly upgraded through resource packs like **Fresh Animations** and a wide array of VanillaTweaks collections, which add detail, consistency, and utility to the game's appearance. Finally, social and multiplayer features like **Simple Voice Chat** and **Status** are included to facilitate collaboration and community interaction.

### Easy Customization

  - **Before Launch:** You can decide exactly what your experience will be like using the **Modrinth App**. Just go to your modpack's content list and use the simple toggles to turn any mod on or off for that session. Once you're happy with your selection, you hit "Play."![Modrinth App Toggle Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f03d7bbce57c2b3eb2fb14dca8c7e0951b7cdfc0.png)
  - **In-Game Menu:** When you get to the main menu, the **Mod Menu** mod adds a "Mods" button to your options screen. This is your in-game command center. From here, you can click on any mod and, if it has a gear icon, dive into its specific settings to tweak it to your liking.![Configure Mod Setting In Game With Mod Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d38fa77b590b5f32eca7e3f59ee97194f4d5fcd2.png)
  - **Deeper Integration:** For even deeper customization, **VTDownloader** integrates directly into that same Mod Menu. Open its configuration screen, and you can browse and install any VanillaTweaks resource pack or data pack you want, all without ever leaving the game.![Download VT Resources In Game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9a20de8f7be8dc2c2f3b18dd4982445dda1d8c1.png)

## Our Purpose

The three BassetBlocks Modpacks—**Core**, **Community**, and **Creator**—are a user-friendly solution designed to simplify the process of installing and managing the mods, datapacks, and resource packs for use on the BassetBlocks server. Our purpose is to ensure all players, regardless of their technical expertise, can easily get started on the server with the correct and most current mods, eliminating the frustration of manual installation and versioning. The modpacks make it simple to stay updated with every Minecraft release, allowing you to focus on what matters most—playing on the BassetBlocks server.

> ### Tired of the hassle?
>
> Tired of the complicated, time-consuming process of manually installing mods, datapacks, and resource packs just to play on the BassetBlocks server? The BassetBlocks Modpacks are here to help. With a single click using the Modrinth App, you can get everything you need to jump into the action. No more searching for individual mods, dealing with compatibility issues, or struggling with updates. The modpack is built for convenience, making sure you have a seamless experience from the moment you launch Minecraft.

## The BassetBlocks Modpack Collection

### BassetBlocks: Core

The **BassetBlocks: Core** modpack is the essential modpack required to connect and play on the BassetBlocks server. It contains the absolute minimum of mods needed for core gameplay mechanics and performance, ensuring a smooth and stable experience. If you are new to the server or prefer a lightweight, vanilla-plus experience, this is the perfect place to start.

### BassetBlocks: Community

Building upon the Core modpack, the **BassetBlocks: Community** modpack is the recommended choice for the definitive BassetBlocks experience. It includes all essential mods plus a curated selection of popular, player-requested additions that enhance gameplay with quality-of-life features, aesthetic blocks, and visual tweaks. This pack is perfect for players who want to enjoy everything the server community has to offer.

### BassetBlocks: Creator

Designed specifically for streamers and video producers, the **BassetBlocks: Creator** modpack is the all-in-one solution for content creation. It includes everything from the Core and Community modpacks, plus powerful client-side tools for recording, creating cinematic shots, and managing your visual presentation. If you plan on sharing your BassetBlocks adventures with an audience, this pack provides all the tools you need.

### BassetBlocks: ServerSide

This is a modpack collection for server administration purposes only and should **not** be downloaded by players. It contains all the necessary backend mods, datapacks, and configuration files that run the BassetBlocks world, manage performance, and provide support for player-side features. This pack runs exclusively on the server to make the magic happen for everyone. The modpack is available for admins that want to set up a server similar to BassetBlocks.

-----

## What's Inside?

### Key Mods for Creators

  * **Cinematic Tools:** Record, replay, and create stunning camera shots with **ReplayMod**, **Flashback**, and **Camera Utils**. Includes **Replay Voice Chat** for full audio capture.
  * **Creative Utilities:** Plan and execute complex builds with **Litematica**, get detailed information with **MiniHUD**, customize game mechanics with **Tweakeroo**, and set up scenes perfectly with **Armor Poser**.
  * **Performance:** Get the smoothest recording experience possible with a full suite of optimization mods, including **Sodium**, **Lithium**, **FerriteCore**, and **Bobby**.
  * **Quality of Life & Visuals:** See recipes with **REI**, map your world with **JourneyMap**, get realistic **Sound Physics Remastered**, and see inside containers with **Peek**.
  * **Social:** Collaborate and interact with your community using **Simple Voice Chat**, **Chat Heads**, and the **Status** mod.

### Key Resource Packs

  * **Animations & Models:** Bring your world to life with the incredible mob animations of **Fresh Animations** and add depth to your builds with **3D Textures**.
  * **Visual Polish:** Create a more dynamic and consistent look with block **Variations**, **More Zombies**, and a collection of **Fixes and Consistency** tweaks.
  * **Utility & UI:** Get a cleaner interface with the **GUI** pack and clear visual cues for **Farming**, **Mining**, and **Redstone**.
  * **Sound:** Enjoy a more peaceful recording environment with the **Quieter Sounds** pack.

title: LTS End Staff
description: LTS End Staff is a utility mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge) that adds an Ender Staff to the game for instant teleportation.
body:
# LTS End Staff

Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge mod that adds an **Ender Staff** for instant teleportation.

## Features
- **Teleportation**: Right-click with the Ender Staff to teleport to the point you are looking at.
- **Configurable**: Adjust teleport distance and cooldown via the config file.
- **Visuals & Sound**: Includes Enderman teleport sounds and portal particles.
- **Safety**: Automatically resets fall distance upon teleportation to prevent fall damage.

## Configuration
The configuration file is located at `config/lts_end_staff-common.toml`.

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `teleportDistance` | 50.0 | Maximum distance you can teleport (1.0 - 500.0). |
| `teleportCooldown` | 40 | Cooldown in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). |

## Localization
- English (US)
- Russian (RU)

## Creative Tab
The Ender Staff can be found in the **Tools & Utilities** creative tab.

body: Biome Variety is a mod that adds a handful of biomes to your Minecraft world. Each biome strieves to be unique unlike other biomes, focussing heavily on beauty blended with a vanilla-like aesthetic. The current biomes are. * Baobab plains. An arid sandy plains like biome litter with hollow baobab trees. * Antarctic. Dry with glacial ice floors and small patches of forestry areas, as if the Antarctic past is peaking through. * Redwood Forest. A overgrown and neutral biome with tall Redwood trees that have roots borrowing into the weathered dirt. * Sweets. A sugary biome made out of cake with large cake structures scattered around. This mod requires Terrablender and the Fabric Api. With optional support for Cobblemon. [Click here for a Cobblemon spawn spreadsheet.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1kOdc46l7Wi6U5S2sz7fME3K0nwtKPQgpJDEMjFMIEcw/edit?usp=sharing) This mod is currently in beta and will undergo severe changes, it is not reccomended to use for permanent worlds. This mod is open to feedback. [Click here for a form.](https://forms.gle/D7M1gDAPG3eiCGdL8)

title: The Ancient End
description: Have you ever wondered if The End was once home to an... Ancestral Civilization?
body:
🌌 The Ancient End

Have you ever wondered if The End was once home to an... Ancestral Civilization? Thousands of years later, the ancient ruins and spirits of that era still linger in the void. The Ancient End lets you bridge that gap, uncovering technology so advanced it feels like magic (but let’s be honest, it’s actually just really shiny purple rocks).

Here’s what you’ll find in this legendary journey:

🛡️ Ancient Ender Armor: Elite Gear

This is the gear used by the ancient gods of the End.

DASH Ability: Equip the full set and double-tap "Space"... BAM! You’ll propel forward like you’ve been shot out of a cannon.

Ancestral Respect: Wearing even one piece makes Endermans respect you enough to not attack when you look at them. Finally, you can stand there and appreciate those beautiful purple eyes without them trying to delete your save file.

💜 The Ancient Enderman: Your New Best Friend (Literally)

Who said Endermans can’t be friend? These guys had a deep bond with humans back in the day.

Void Rescue: If you’re exploring the End and accidentally fall... don't panic! Your tamed Enderman will teleport and bring you back to safety.

Loyalty Until the End: He’ll fight by your side, but watch out: if you fall into the void while he’s following you, he will sacrifice himself and die with you. A tragic, poetic, and very sad ending for your inventory. (PS: He is not lava-proof, don't abuse his faith).

🐎 Ancient Ender Horse: Breaking Newton's Laws

The only ride that doesn't care about the laws of physics.

Passive Powers: Tame it with an Ancient Eye to get permanent Night Vision and Zero Fall Damage.

Lava Walker: It can walk on lava. Perfect for strolling through the Nether like it’s a Sunday walk in the park.

💎 Resources & Tools: The Building Blocks of Power

Ancient Ender Pearl: This isn't just a "throw-and-hope-for-the-best" pearl. It’s the pure essence of the End, essential for forging all your ancestral gear.

Ancient Ender Eye: The "Swiss Army Knife" of the mod. Use them to tame and heal your horse or as the core of your Enderman's spawn egg. Crafted like a normal Eye (with Blaze Powder), but using the Ancient Pearl.

The Egg Recipe: Head to the crafting table and place an Ancient Eye in the center, then surround it with Ancient Pearls in a cross pattern (+). It’s like a secret handshake, but with more purple glitter.

Ancestral Tools: Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, and Shovel. Forged from the very soul of the dimension, they are faster and stronger than anything you’ve used before.

Developed by NicoDelux22.

title: MinecraftMPRIS
description: Display and control media within Minecraft, with MPRIS.
body:
## NOTE
This mod currently does not work on Windows (due to the dependency on MPRIS), but Windows support is planned!
The mod will be renamed by then.

# MinecraftMPRIS

A Minecraft mod that allows you to display media (as an overlay) and control it in-game!

## Features

- Display the currently playing media with an awesome overlay
- Shows all the metadata you want
- Customizable (thanks to [YACL](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)!)
- Lightweight

## Requirements

- Linux
- playerctl
- A MPRIS-compatible player (Spotify, mpv,...)

## Compatibility with web browsers
- Please consider installing [Plasma Browser Integration](https://community.kde.org/Plasma/Browser_Integration) if you plan on playing media in web browsers, as it will provide better metadata

## Known Issues

- Some media players may have incomplete metadata

## License

This mod is under the GNU Lesser General Public License, v3.0.

title: MONSTER_PLUGIN_1
description: A CS:GO-style spin based colour ability SMP plugin with rare powers, secure boxes, and hardcore anti-grief protection.
body:
# 🔥 MONSTER_PLUGIN_1

**MONSTER_PLUGIN_1** is a legendary SMP plugin designed for Paper servers that introduces a **CS:GO-style spin system**, **colour-based abilities**, and a **hardcore anti-grief security system**.

Each player gets **one-time spin on first join**, where they receive a random **Colour Box**. Every colour grants a unique ability, making each player special and different.

---

## 🎮 Spin & Join System
- Automatic rolling spin animation on first join
- One-time spin per player (data saved permanently)
- Re-joining does NOT give another spin
- Admin can reset spin using commands

---

## 🎨 Colour Abilities
- 🔴 **RED** – Strength I + Sharpness-style extra damage  
- 🟢 **GREEN** – Luck II + Auto-Mending for armor & tools  
- 🔵 **BLUE** – Speed II  
- ⚪ **WHITE** – Jump Boost II  
- 🌸 **PINK** – Haste II (fast mining)

---

## 🎡 Rarity System
Each box has a different chance:
- Red: 2% (Ultra Rare)
- Green: 5% (Rare)
- Blue: 13%
- White: 20%
- Pink: 60% (Common)

---

## 🛡️ Anti-Grief & Security
- Boxes cannot be placed, dropped, or stored in chests
- EnderChest protection enabled
- Soulbound system: box never drops on death
- Box is restored automatically on respawn

---

## 💬 Chat Prefix System
Players get a coloured chat tag based on their box.

Example:  
`[RED] Monster: Hello!`

---

## ⚙️ Server Compatibility
- Platform: **Paper**
- Minecraft Version: **1.21.4**
- Optimized for SMP / Hardcore SMP / RPG Servers

---

## 👑 Author
**MONSTER**

> Power is rare. Luck decides your fate.

title: CraftedInks
description: A simple datapack that allows crafting of black dye, ink sacs and leather
body:
# Ever had the pressing need to automate book production?
No? Well, I did.

## Introducing CraftedInks
Craft together 6 coal (or charcoal) with a bit of paper to produce 6 black dye.
Bind 6 black dye into a pouch with some paper, dried kelp, or leather to create an ink sac

There are some other recipies too - making string from wool, or leather from rotten flesh (in a furnace).

_But why are the recipies not efficient?_
I thought it was only fair that this easier method wasn't as effective as the vanilla one. But to be honest I just made this pack for my own server so, feel free to tweak it for your own :)

title: Tea Prophet
description: The modification adds my friend "Cairairos". He can now appear in the world, but if you kill him, he will show his diabolical form.
body:
I have created a modification that adds my friend Cairairos to the world of our virtual adventure. This mysterious character can suddenly appear in various corners of the game world, bringing with him an atmosphere of mystery and intrigue.

However, be careful: if you decide to attack Cairairos, he will reveal his true, devilish form. In this guise, he becomes a bloodthirsty boss with an impressive 1,000 health points, ready to challenge you. His power and fury will make you sweat in battle, as he uses all his abilities to gain the upper hand.

But for defeating this powerful opponent, you will receive a generous reward — the best tea in the world. This unique drink not only restores your health and increases your gaming performance, but also gives you special bonuses that will help you in further adventures. Tea made from the rarest ingredients collected in the most inaccessible corners of the game world will become your faithful companion in the fight against other enemies and challenging quests.

So you're faced with a difficult dilemma: take a chance and fight Cairairos to test his power and get the coveted tea, or leave him alone and escape the wrath of the mystical creatures guarding him. Every choice you make will have consequences, and every encounter will have unique emotions. Immerse yourself in this exciting adventure and discover the world of Cairairos!

Mod from the series - Kentavrs

Cobblemon as the central gameplay experience.

title: Immersive Tools
description: Adds Perks and Tiers to normal and new tools!
body:
# Immersive Tools

### **Stop!**

Stop replacing your tools. Start evolving them. A non-destructive, upgrade system for your vanilla equipment **WITH TIERS**.

---

### **The Mod**

Ever crafted that *perfect* Netherite pickaxe, fully enchanted, only to feel like the progression has stopped?

**Immersive Tools** is an end-game expansion mod that introduces a deep, **non-destructive Perk System** for your tools and weapons. Instead of crafting new items, you apply permanent enhancements to the gear you already love, upgrading them through multiple tiers of power.

## How It Works

The system is simple to use but designed for a long-term survival world.

### **Step 1: Apply the Perk (Tier 1)**

1.  Craft a specific **Perk Gem** (such as the `Lightweight Gem`, `Void Gem`, etc.).
2.  Hold your tool in your main hand and the Gem in your off-hand.
3.  Right-click to permanently apply the **Tier 1** Perk to that item.

### **Step 2: Upgrade the Tiers (Tier 2-5)**

1.  To evolve your Perks, you must craft powerful, universal **Essences**.
2.  Start by crafting the `Refined Essence` (Tier 2 Upgrade).
3.  Hold your tool (which already has a T1 Perk) and the Essence in your off-hand.
4.  Right-click to upgrade **all** eligible Perks on that item to the next Tier!
5.  Continue this process with `Pure Essence` (T3), `Legendary Essence` (T4), and finally the `Divine Essence` (T5) for ultimate power.

## Perks Included (Release 1.0)

This initial release includes three essential Perks:

* **Light Weight:** (Catalyst: `Lightweight Gem`)
    * Increases your mining and attack speed when holding the tool.
* **Reinforced Preservation:** (Catalyst: `Reinforced Gem`)
    * Grants a chance to *not* consume durability when using the tool in combat or breaking blocks.
* **Purifying Touch:** (Catalyst: `Blaze Gem`)
    * Has a chance to automatically **smelt** block drops (e.g., Iron Ore -> Iron Ingot).
    * Has a chance to apply a **Fire Aspect** effect to enemies in combat.
* **Void Leap:** (Catalyst: `Void Gem`)
    * If you hold shift and right click with the tool on your hand, you jump in the direction you are facing.
    * The tier acts as a multiplier, meaning tier 5 will make you jump double the size of tier 1.

## Crafting Your Legend

The path to power is designed for the end-game. These upgrades are expensive, requiring you to master all dimensions—from Nether Stars to End City loot.

**Check out the image gallery to see the crafting recipes** for the three starting Gems and the powerful Refined, Pure, and Legendary Essences!

### Future Plans

* More creative Perks are already in development (Magnetic Pull, Repulsion Strike, and more)!
### Feedback && Support
* If you want to give ideias or report problems, checkout our github repository and open an issue!

After extensive testing and fine-tuned performance configurations, this pack provides higher FPS, more stable frame times, and improved visual consistency across a wide range of PCs.

This modpack is intentionally designed to stay true to the classic Vanilla style, while still offering the flexibility of a customizable client. You are free to add any visual, QoL, or utility mods you like, and the pack remains fully server-friendly, ensuring safe and seamless multiplayer use.

Because the Vulkan renderer is the core of Esteban007XVulkan, updates are delivered quickly as soon as the Vulkan mod receives new improvements or fixes. Staying up to date with its versions ensures maximum performance, stability, and compatibility with the latest advancements in Minecraft optimization.

If you experience performance issues, crashes, or simply want help customizing your setup, support and feedback are always welcome. The goal of Esteban007XVulkan is to remain polished, flexible, and reliable for every type of player.

title: NoPunch
description: Blocks the Punch enchantment on bows.
body:
# 🏹 NoPunch

A simple **Minecraft Spigot/Paper plugin** that disables the **Punch enchantment** on bows.  
Ideal for PvP or competitive servers where knockback from bows should be removed for fair gameplay.

---

## ⚙️ Features

- 🚫 **Blocks Punch enchantment** from being applied at the enchantment table  
- 🧱 **Prevents combining Punch books** with bows in an anvil  
- ❌ **Cancels anvil results** that contain Punch  
- 💬 Sends a warning message to players when Punch is blocked  
- ⚡ Lightweight and configuration-based — no dependencies required  

---

## 📁 Installation

1. Download the plugin `.jar` file  
2. Place it inside your server’s `plugins/` folder  
3. Start or reload your server  
4. A default `config.yml` will be generated automatically  

---

## ⚙️ Configuration (`config.yml`)

```yaml
# Allow or block the Punch enchantment
allow-punch: false
```

- allow-punch: true → Punch can be applied normally

- allow-punch: false → Punch is completely disabled

## 💬 Example Message

When a player tries to add or use Punch:

§cPunch is disabled!

You can change this message in the code to match your preferred language.

## 🧩 Developer Information

Main plugin class:
de.scholle.noPunch.NoPunch

Event listener:
de.scholle.noPunch.PunchEnchantBlocker

Blocked enchantment:
Enchantment.ARROW_KNOCKBACK (Punch I & II)

## 🧰 Compatibility

- ✅ Works on Spigot, Paper, and Purpur

- 🧱 Tested on Minecraft 1.18+

- ⚙️ Requires Java 17+

title: EzShows
description: EzShows is a Minecraft plugin for creating immersive shows with music, effects, and OpenAudioMC integration. It features an intuitive GUI for managing tracks and show settings.
body:
# **EzShows - Create Immersive In-Game Shows and Events**

EzShows is a powerful and feature-rich Minecraft plugin designed to help server owners create immersive and dynamic in-game shows, events, and experiences. Whether you're hosting a fireworks display, a music concert, or a custom event, EzShows provides all the tools you need to captivate your players. With seamless OpenAudioMC integration, customizable effects, and an intuitive GUI, EzShows makes it easy to bring your creative visions to life.

---

## **Features**
- **Show Management**:
  - Create, edit, and delete shows directly in-game.
  - Manage show settings such as region name, center location, and action distance.

- **Dynamic Effects**:
  - Add fireworks, particles, fountains, blocks, and text displays to your shows.
  - Customize effects with detailed options like colors, motion, duration, and more.

- **Audio Integration**:
  - Seamless integration with OpenAudioMC for synchronized music playback.
  - Preload audio for nearby players to ensure smooth playback during shows.

- **Track Management**:
  - Create, edit, and delete audio tracks using an intuitive GUI.
  - Manage track properties such as name, URL, and duration.

- **Intuitive GUI**:
  - User-friendly interfaces for managing shows, tracks, and effects.
  - Pagination support for handling large numbers of actions or tracks.

- **Automation**:
  - Schedule actions and effects with precise tick-based timing.
  - Automatically stop shows when all actions and audio are completed.

---

## **Commands**
Here are the commands you can use with EzShows:

| **Command**               | **Description**                              | **Permission**       |
|---------------------------|----------------------------------------------|----------------------|
| `/show create [name]`     | Create a new show.                          | `ezshows.use`        |
| `/show edit [name]`       | Edit an existing show.                      | `ezshows.use`        |
| `/show start [name]`      | Start a show.                               | `ezshows.use`        |
| `/show stop [name]`       | Stop a running show.                        | `ezshows.use`        |
| `/show delete [name]`     | Delete a show.                              | `ezshows.use`        |
| `/show reloadtracks`      | Reload audio tracks from `tracks.yml`.      | `ezshows.admin`      |
| `/show reload`            | Reload all shows from `data.yml`.           | `ezshows.admin`      |

---

## **How to Set Up**
1. **Install the Plugin**:
   - Download the `EzShows.jar` file and place it in your server's `plugins` folder.
   - Restart your server to generate the necessary configuration files (`data.yml` and `tracks.yml`).

2. **Install OpenAudioMC (Optional)**:
   - If you want to use audio features, download and install OpenAudioMC on your server.
   - Ensure OpenAudioMC is configured correctly for audio playback.

3. **Configure Your Shows**:
   - Use `/show create [name]` to create a new show.
   - Use `/show edit [name]` to open the editor GUI and add effects, music, and settings to your show.

4. **Add Audio Tracks**:
   - Use the music selection GUI to create and manage audio tracks.
   - Add track URLs, set durations, and preview tracks before adding them to your show.

5. **Start Your Show**:
   - Use `/show start [name]` to start your show and watch the magic happen!

---

## **How to Use the GUI**
- **Show Editor**:
  - Open the editor GUI with `/show edit [name]`.
  - Add effects like fireworks, particles, fountains, blocks, and text displays.
  - Customize each effect with detailed options such as colors, motion, and duration.

- **Music Selection**:
  - Open the music selection GUI to manage audio tracks.
  - Preview tracks, set durations, and assign them to your shows.

---

## **Requirements**
- **Minecraft Version**: Compatible with 1.16+ (tested on 1.20).
- **Dependencies**: OpenAudioMC (required for audio features).

---

## **Configuration Files**
1. **`data.yml`**:
   - Stores all show data, including actions, effects, and settings.
   - Automatically generated when the plugin is installed.

2. **`tracks.yml`**:
   - Stores all audio track data, including names, URLs, and durations.
   - Automatically generated when the plugin is installed.

---

**Support**
If you encounter any issues or have questions about EzShows, we're here to help! Here's how you can get support:
- **Discord**: Join our community Discord server for real-time support and updates.
- **Email**: Contact us at [support@example.com] for assistance.
- **Documentation**: Check out our detailed documentation for setup guides and FAQs.

---

**Known Issues**
- Audio playback requires OpenAudioMC to be installed and configured correctly.
- Ensure valid URLs are used for audio tracks to avoid playback errors.
- Some effects may not work as expected if improperly configured.

---

**Why Choose EzShows?**
EzShows is designed to make creating in-game shows and events as easy and intuitive as possible. With its powerful features, seamless audio integration, and user-friendly GUI, EzShows is the perfect tool for server owners looking to create unforgettable experiences for their players.

---

body:
server is on whitelist mode so to join the minecraft server you have to join the discord listed at the bottom discord server is also in the the official cobblemon discord also

 # ⚔️ Faction Rules: Cobblemon: Elysium


**🛡️ I. Faction Creation Rules**
1. Faction Name & Theme
• Must be Pokémon-inspired (e.g., Team Glacium, The Verdant Order, Flare Syndicate).

2. Starter Requirements
• Must have at least 3 players to form a faction.
• Faction founder must have at least one Pokémon above level 60.
• Submit a short lore entry: include your faction's goals, Legendary Mascot Pokémon you wish to obtain, and relationship to other factions (neutral, hostile, allied).
(The legendary mascot must be a box art or a mythical. The base stat of the Legendary has to be 680. Mythicals are the exception to this rule.)

3. Base Construction
• Bases must be biome-aligned with your faction

*Your base must have:*
• A Pokécenter
• Training Grounds for battles (at least one battle arena).
• Three or more residential housing units for members.

**🧬 II. Faction Membership & Roles**
1. Ranks
• Leader: Oversees faction goals, diplomacy, and holds the Master Badge.
• Commander: Leads operations, defends territory, and can challenge other factions.
• Gym Leader(s): Hosts badge battles within the faction; must specialize in a type. (neutral rank, must be in a faction to open a gym)
• Trainer: Regular members can rise in rank by winning battles or quests.

2. Recruitment
• New members must complete a Pokémon Trial (custom challenge, e.g., defeat 3 trainers, catch a rare Pokémon, gather resources). (Optional)
• Faction must post a Faction Charter listing rules, values, and theme on a shared board in-game or faction-list channel.

**⚔️ III. Faction Diplomacy & PvP**
1. War Declarations
• Must be publicly posted 24 hours before combat.
• At least one Gym Leader or Commander must agree from each side.
• Allowed to either be a Pokémon battle or a Player Vs Player.
• If both sides can't agree, flip a coin.

*Winner of faction war can claim:*
• One “Badge Piece” (collect 4 to disable rival base protections for 1 raid).
• Territory expansion rights or forced neutrality treaty.
• Faction Leaders can be overthrown if the Master badge is taken.

2. Territory
• Factions can control one biome per 5 active members.
• Territory expands via exploration, diplomacy, or conquest.

3. Alliances
• Factions may form alliances or syndicates, pooling resources and Pokémon.
• Cross-faction raids require at least 1 badge earned from each allied group.

**🌿 IV. Progression & Perks**
1. Faction Leveling System
• Level 1: Starter Faction – 3 members, 1 biome. 3 Functional Housing Units
• Level 2: Established – 5 members, 1 Gym Leader, 5 Functional Housing Units, can claim 1 Legendary Pokémon.
• Level 3: Elite Faction – 8+ members, 8 Functional Housing Units, Town Hall, the ability to enlist for a seat on the Council of Kosmos
• Level 4: Champion Tier – 10+ members, 10+ Functional Housing Units, custom 5+ biome,  statue of your leader, 3+ members with a full level of a party of 6, ability to use Legendary Pokémon to win a fight. (Has a cooldown of 2 wars after use)

**📜 V. Faction Conduct**
1. Respect and RP Encouraged
• Stay in-character when interacting in faction zones.
• Roleplay battles, training sessions, and faction meetings.
• No Griefing
• Faction bases are protected unless war conditions are met.
• Raids must be honorable (no lava, TNT spam, or stealing items unrelated to war victory conditions).
• Dual-type teams are allowed for Gym Leaders and higher ranks.
• Legendary Pokémon must be used sparingly (max 2 per team in official wars or events).

# SIGHT – The Stunning Minecraft Project (Fabric 1.21.6)

**SIGHT is a lightweight yet visually breathtaking Minecraft modpack designed to transform the game’s visuals without changing core gameplay. Built on Fabric 1.21.6 with full shader support, this pack enhances your world with cinematic lighting, realistic soundscapes, better foliage, smoother animations, and immersive environmental detail — all while keeping performance smooth.

Whether you’re wandering through a foggy forest lit by fireflies or watching light reflect off a quiet lake, SIGHT makes every moment feel like a movie.
**
Features:

- Full shader support using Iris + Sodium (use shaders like Complementary or BSL)

- Enhanced visuals: glowing effects, fireflies, falling leaves, water splashes

- Sound upgrades: reverb, echo, ambient environmental audio

- Smooth third-person 

- Optimized with Sodium, Lithium, and other performance-boosting mods
 
- Full resource pack support:connected textures, custom skies
 
- Recommended Add-ons:
 
- Shader packs: Complementary Reimagined, BSL
 
- Resource packs: Fresh Animations, Dramatic Skys
 
Notes:

This is a visual modpack only. It does not add gameplay changes or major content mods.

All included mods are either hosted on Modrinth or use modpack-friendly licenses.

License:  Apache-2.0

If you want Minecraft to look like a AAA indie game while keeping the vanilla feel intact, SIGHT is your answer.

title: Survival Nerf
description: Minimalistic vanilla-flavored design and balance overhaul. Mostly reverting bad decisions the devs have made. Intended for use with Etomb's Better Survival modpack.
body:
Intended for use with [Etomb's Survival Nerf](https://modrinth.com/modpack/etombs-survival-nerf) modpack, and the experimental villager trade rebalance turned on.               
This is a compilation of small balance changes, many of which are uploaded individually on Modrinth.

You can still use the datapack without any mods, but part of the food rebalance will stop working                                                                               

Required mods:                                                                  
Mob Filter: https://modrinth.com/mod/mobfilter                        
Default Components: https://modrinth.com/mod/default-components

# Removing Progression Skipping:
-Overworld ruined portals now generate exclusively deep underground at lava level, with             increased frequency (this also looks MUCH better than having random netherrack on the surface)  
![underground portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0fe4f9c5d3442502f7d1adadc33bc6034b68b12.png)     
-All Strongholds generate in 1 ring 10k blocks from spawn                                  
-The nether roof is not buildable                                                                                                                                    

# Removal of CHEESE:
-dried kelp blocks are no longer a fuel source                   
-moss blocks will now replace clay instead of stone 
 (preventing easy bonemeal from stone generators)                 
-oozing potion now only works on hostile mobs  
 (no getting infinite slime from chicken farms)
-Disabled bed explosions and enabled respawn anchors in the End 
 (to prevent killing the end dragon with bed explosions)                           
-Shields block 50% damage taken instead of completely nullifying it                                       
This is sourced from https://modrinth.com/datapack/shield-nerf                          
-elytra are no longer enchantable with unbreaking                                                                                         
 This is sourced from https://modrinth.com/datapack/purpurpacks-no-unbreaking-on-elytra

# Fixing Bad design and Reducing Inventory clutter:
-Common loot from archaeology/brushing is now pottery sherds instead of random junk    
-Sniffers now have a 10% chance to dig up pottery sherds, making them renewable              
-Giant nether fungi and ambient nether foliage now require shears/silk touch to collect, (stems are still minable with an axe)             
-Crimson forest biome is now about as rare as Warped Forest (was previously very common)                     
-husks now drop 0-2 sand, making sand renewable without duping                    
-Less frequent natural kelp generation- this is for increased performance, reduction of inventory clutter when exploring, and reducing easy food access                                                                
![before](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed62ef95f3811cdf330f52e8deec0b23b19d91be_0.webp)![after](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5576b61c959c3809e61d7539afce6e0acf6ba785_0.webp)

-Stone tool hero of the village gifts have been replaced with iron tools 
 (why was gifting stone tools ever a thing?)     
                             
# Backports                                 
-Camels spawn rarely in deserts; spawning on chunk generation is however turned off with Mob         Filter                                                     
-Lodestone recipe from newer versions of the game; uses iron ingot instead of netherite ingot                                                                           

# Food rebalance:
-villages no longer have piles of hay, pumpkins, or melons                                   
-village farm plots only generate with beetroot unless taiga/savanna; those will have occasional pumpkin/melon farm plots                                                  
-food found in village chests is now exclusively small amounts of apples or beetroot (or sweetberries in taiga)                                                                    
-villages are now about 3x more rare                                               
-rabbit stew no longer requires cooked components                            
-ambient salmon and cod only drop bonemeal now                                      
-Polar Bears drop cod/salmon 50/50 instead of 50/16.666                            

	Changes dependent on Default Components mod:
	-golden carrots are now inedible the same as glistering melon               
	-mushroom stew, rabbit stew, and beetroot soup now stack up to 16 (suspicious stew is still unstackable)               
	-saturation ratio for beetroots and carrots nerfed to 0.6 (same as other raw plant foods)
	-pumpkin pie saturation ratio buffed to 1.2 (same as other prepared foods like bread)
	-rabbit stew saturation ratio buffed to 1.6 (same as cooked meat)                
	-rabbit stew gives the highest saturation of any food now, besides suspicious stew made with the saturation effect                   


	Changes dependent on Mob Filter mod:                      
	-Spawning on chunk generation for passive mobs that give meat is turned off;               
 	 regular spawning and passive mob farms still work                  
# Mobs:
-All mobs spawn with a 33.33% random variation in size, allowing some Enderman to chase you into 2 block high gaps for example.                                                                 
 This intentionally breaks a lot of mob farm designs.                                                                
 You could try designing YOUR OWN farms to compensate for this instead of copying pre-existing ones, or turn it off...                             
 This functionality is sourced from https://modrinth.com/datapack/random-mob-sizes-dp

# For fun:
-The Lie achievement is added back to the game                            
![the lie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b97afade34f75ead97d8d21c599f1a6f05b4f85e.png)    
-Giant warped fungi now generate hanging from the ceiling, matching the opposing theme with crimson, (planted fungi will grow the same as normal) check the gallery to see what this looks like                     
-You have 100 lives, (really more than you would ever need), can craft new lives, and can revive other players who run out of lives                           
 This is sourced from https://modrinth.com/datapack/hundred-lives

# Extra Setup:
-Set gamerule playersSleepingPercentage on world generation to 101 to prevent sleeping (you can still set your spawn)                         
-I recommend using the large biomes world type                                
-Turn on Experimental Villager Trade Rebalance                                                
-Add config file for Mob Filter to .minecraft/config, name it mobfilter.json5               (unnecessary step with Etomb's Survival Nerf modpack, it includes the config)                       
The file contents should be:                                                  

```
//
// mobfilter.json5
//
// This file controls the spawn filtering rules for mob-filter.  For details, see the docs at:
//   https://github.com/pcal43/mob-filter/blob/main/CONFIG.md
//
// Note that this file isn't parsed with a true json5 parser; rather it's parsed with google's gson
// in lenient mode:
//   https://javadoc.io/doc/com.google.code.gson/gson/latest/com.google.gson/com/google/gson/JsonParser.html
//

{
  "rules" : [
//      {
//          "name" : "No freshwater squid!",
//          "what" : "DISALLOW_SPAWN",
//          "when" : {
//              "entityId" : [ "minecraft:squid" ],
//              "biomeId"  : [ "minecraft:river", "minecraft:frozen_river" ]
//          }
//      },
      { 
          "name": "No passive mob spawns that drop food",
          "what": "DISALLOW_SPAWN",
          "when": {
                   "entityId" : [ 
                      "minecraft:chicken",
                      "minecraft:pig",
                      "minecraft:cow",
                      "minecraft:sheep",
                      "minecraft:rabbit",
                      "minecraft:camel"
                     ], 
                                 

                   "spawnReason": ["CHUNK_GENERATION"]
                  }
      },
  ],

  // If you"re having trouble, change this to DEBUG or TRACE
  // to output diagnostic information to debug.log.
  "logLevel" : "INFO"
}

```



-configure random mob sizes in game as needed by typing the command /function random_mob_sizes:config     
                                    
## Recommended companion mods/datapacks:
(included in Etomb's Survival Nerf modpack)

Game Progression/Progression skipping changes:                                  
-[Ruined Portals Only](https://modrinth.com/mod/ruined-portals-only)- You must use naturally generated nether portals                                                            
-[Seedguard](https://modrinth.com/mod/seedguard)- makes it so seedmaps don't work

Food Rebalance:                                  
-[Serene Seasons](https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-seasons)- adds seasons and makes foods grow seasonally                           
-[Natural Hungering](https://modrinth.com/mod/natural-hungering)- small passive hunger drain; saturation consumed when healing stays the same

Fixing bad design and inventory clutter:                              
-[Villager Transportation](https://modrinth.com/datapack/villager-transportation)- gives camels a purpose                              
-[Soaring Phantoms](https://modrinth.com/mod/soaring-phantoms) - no more insomnia, phantoms spawn at high y-levels like harpies in terraria   
-[Vaulted End](https://modrinth.com/mod/vaulted-end) - shulker trial spawner and vault generate on end ships, providing elytra (instead of it being in an item frame)                                                                     
-[Horseman](https://modrinth.com/mod/horseman)- horses are buffed, less buggy, and you can remove chests from mules/donkeys/llamas       
                         
For fun:                                                                        
-[Zombie Villagers from spawner](https://modrinth.com/mod/zombie-villagers-from-spawner)- self explanatory                                  
-[Farlands Reborn](https://modrinth.com/mod/farlands-reborn)- adds farlands back into game, doesn't really affect gameplay                  
-[Sniffer Ride](https://modrinth.com/mod/sniffer-ride)- ride sniffers like pigs                                                                                        
-[Glowing Torchflower](https://modrinth.com/mod/glowing-torchflower)- torchflower emits light like a torch

title: Honest Hardcore
description: No second chances. No fake Hardcore. This mod disables spectating after death in hardcore and invalidates all advancements if you ever cheat.
body:
Honest Hardcore is a gameplay mod that enforces real consequences in Minecraft's Hardcore mode.

It disables the "Spectate World" button after death and replaces it with a "Statistics" button.
You can no longer escape death by switching to Spectator or Survival mode.

In addition, the mod tracks the world's honesty status. If you ever enable cheats or enter Creative mode — the world becomes marked as dishonest. From that moment:

All advancements are permanently blocked

A single crossed-out advancement ("Honesty") remains as a reminder of your actions

For honest players, a chain of special advancements becomes available — one for creating the world, and more for surviving without cheating.

This mod is designed for singleplayer only. No server support.

title: AzHuntMan
description: The Most Advance Free ManHunt Plugin For Events
body:
# 🧱 AzHuntMan - Hunter vs Runner Plugin Transform your server into an adrenaline-pumping battleground where hunters track down runners in the ultimate survival game! --- ## ✨ Features 🎯 **Role-Based Gameplay** - Choose between Hunter, Runner, or Spectator 🧭 **Compass Tracking** - Hunters get tracking compasses to find their prey ✨ **Glow Effects** - Hunters glow with unique colors for easy identification 👑 **Admin Control Panel** - Complete game management through intuitive GUIs 🚫 **PvP Protection** - Prevents hunter-vs-hunter combat for fair gameplay ❄️ **Hunter Freeze** - 30-second head start for runners to escape 📊 **Dynamic Scoreboards** - Real-time game status and player information 🎨 **Full Customization** - Every message, color, and setting is configurable 📡 **PlaceholderAPI** - Integration for external plugin compatibility ⚡ **Auto-Start Games** - Automatic game initiation when minimum players join --- ## 📋 Commands & Permissions
🔧 Commands | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/huntman` or `/hm` | Open main role selection GUI | `huntman.use` | | `/huntman admin` | Access admin control panel | `huntman.admin` | | `/huntman force ` | Force assign player roles | `huntman.admin.force` | | `/huntman reload` | Reload plugin configurations | `huntman.admin.reload` | | `/huntman start` | Start the game manually | `huntman.admin.game` | | `/huntman stop` | Stop the current game | `huntman.admin.game` | | `/huntman finish` | End game with runners winning | `huntman.admin.game` | | `/huntman leave` | Leave game and remove items | `huntman.use` |
🔐 Permissions | Permission | Description | Default | |------------|-------------|---------| | `huntman.use` | Basic plugin usage | `true` | | `huntman.admin` | Admin GUI access | `op` | | `huntman.admin.force` | Force assign roles | `op` | | `huntman.admin.reload` | Reload configurations | `op` | | `huntman.admin.game` | Start/stop games | `op` |
--- ## 🎮 In-Game Messages Messages support Minecraft color codes and emojis: ```yaml # Example messages with colors and emojis game: started: "&8[&6🎯 &bᴀᴢʜᴜɴᴛᴍᴀɴ&8] &a▶ The hunt has begun! Hunters vs Runners!" hunter-freeze-started: "&8[&6🎯 &bᴀᴢʜᴜɴᴛᴍᴀɴ&8] &e🧊 Hunters are frozen for {time} seconds!" hunting-phase-started: "&8[&6🎯 &bᴀᴢʜᴜɴᴛᴍᴀɴ&8] &c🏹 Hunting phase has begun!" role: selected: hunter: "&8[&6🎯 &bᴀᴢʜᴜɴᴛᴍᴀɴ&8] &c🏹 You are now a Hunter!" runner: "&8[&6🎯 &bᴀᴢʜᴜɴᴛᴍᴀɴ&8] &b🏃 You are now a Runner!" ``` --- ## ⚙️ Requirements - **Minecraft Version:** 1.20 - 1.21.7+ - **Server Software:** Spigot/Paper/Bukkit - **Java Version:** 17+ - **Dependencies:** PlaceholderAPI (optional) --- ## 📁 Configuration
🎛️ config.yml Example ```yaml # 🎯 AzHuntMan Configuration 🚀 game: max-hunters: 3 # Maximum hunters (-1 = unlimited) max-runners: -1 # Maximum runners (-1 = unlimited) auto-start: true # Auto-start when min players join min-players: 2 # Minimum players to start hunter-freeze-time: 30 # Hunter freeze duration (seconds) features: compass-tracking: true # Enable hunter tracking compasses glow-effect: true # Add glow effects to hunters runner-tracking: true # Allow runners to track each other no-hunter-pvp: true # Prevent hunter vs hunter combat gui: use-small-font: true # Use Minecraft small font styling refresh-interval: 20 # GUI refresh rate (ticks) placeholders: enabled: true # Enable PlaceholderAPI integration debug: enabled: false # Enable debug console messages ```
💬 messages.yml Example ```yaml # Customize every message with colors and emojis prefix: "&8[&6🎯 &bᴀᴢʜᴜɴᴛᴍᴀɴ&8] " role-prefix: hunter: "&c[🏹 ʜᴜɴᴛᴇʀ] &f" runner: "&b[🏃 ʀᴜɴɴᴇʀ] &f" game: started: "{prefix}&a▶ The hunt has begun! Hunters vs Runners!" countdown-starting: "{prefix}&e⏰ Game starting in 10 seconds!" hunter-freeze-started: "{prefix}&e🧊 Hunters frozen for {time} seconds!" ```
--- ## 🚀 Installation 1. Download the latest `AzHuntMan-1.0.0.jar` from releases 2. Place in your server's `plugins/` folder 3. Restart your server 4. Configure `config.yml` and `messages.yml` to your liking 5. Use `/huntman reload` to apply changes without restart --- ## 🎯 PlaceholderAPI Support Available placeholders for external plugins: - `%azhuntman_role%` - Player's current role - `%azhuntman_hunters%` - Number of hunters - `%azhuntman_runners%` - Number of runners - `%azhuntman_game_status%` - Current game state --- ## 🎪 Discord Community Join our community for support, updates, and discussions: **Discord:** `https://discord.gg/R4XmFc9qCq` --- ## 📜 License & Credits **Version:** 1.0.0 **API Version:** 1.20+ **License:** All Rights Reserved ---

title: Allay & Vex Conversion
description: Allows the conversion of allays to vexes and vice versa
body:
It is very simple (kind of?)


<details>
<summary>Allay -> Vex</summary>

1. Give the allay any item
2. _Shift + Right-Click_ with an **Ominous Bottle** on the Allay to give it **Bad Omen**
3. Wait the duration of the effect (4min)
4. When the effect runs out the allay will become a vex

</details>


<details>
<summary>Vex -> Allay</summary>

1. Throw a **splash potion of regeneration and weakness** on the vex (if you are fast enough)
2. Feed the vex **Amethyst Shards**
3. Everytime you feed the vex 3 things could happen: It converts, it dies, or it chokes
   
- 1. If it chokes it takes 1hp of damage (half a heart)
- 2. If it dies, well it dies...
- 3. If it converts it will become an allay
</details>


<details>
<summary>Bonus</summary>

- Allays leave a particle trail that can be stopped by making it hold an **Echo Shard** or giving it **Bad Omen**
- _Shift + Right-Click_ with a **Milk Bucket** on the Allay to remove its effects
- 2 new gamerules ("allowAllayVexConversion" and "allayParticleEffects") both by default true
- Vexes that come from conversion are weaponless (still hostile)

</details>

title: Zip Fetcher
description: This is a mod for 1.12.2 which fetches and extracts archives from a given URL.
body: ## Purpose To provide directory patches to a Minecraft instance automatically via the contents of a `.zip` or `.7z` file. ## How to Use * Once you install the mod a file will be created inside your Minecraft directory called `zipfetcher.properties` add your URL which contains the archive and the mod will fetch & extract it where the configuration file is located `/minecraft/zipfetcher.properties/`. * Launch the game, the mod will download and extract the archive. Afterwards it'll delete the archive, removes itself and then exit the game. * Upon next launch your Minecraft instance is now patched. ## Security Statement **Archives can't be extracted outside the Minecraft instance and the download section by default is empty.**

🔹 How to Get Endium
 

 

Step 1: Mine Endium Ore

Deep within the End lies Endium Ore, a rare and valuable block that can only be found in the outer islands. It requires a Netherite pickaxe to mine.

Step 2: Smelt into Endium Scrap

Smelting Endium Ore in a furnace or blast furnace yields Endium Scrap, a crucial ingredient in crafting Endium Ingots.
![Smelting Endium Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d7d24a38142fbbade84ee14616ecb1838ae452f.png)

Step 3: Craft Endium Ingots

In a crafting table, combine 5 Endium Scrap and 5 Eyes of Ender to produce 1 Endium Ingot. This step ensures Endium remains an Endgame resource, both literally and mechanically.

![Crafting Endium Ingots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65ce2257028f7d2d35fe19e8c7cf2c67cc594a01.png)

title: KindlyTpa
description: Plugin that controls tpa, avoiding users from being tpakilled.
body:
# KindlyTPA

## Overview
KindlyTPA is a lightweight and simple plugin to control tpa in your server instead of installing other big plugins.

## Features.

### Protection System
- Players receive temporary invulnerability after teleportation (configurable duration)
- Prevents ambushes, traps, and _tpakilling _ after teleporting

### User-Friendly Experience
- Simple commands: `/tpa`, `/tpaccept`, `/tpadeny`, and `/tpacancel`
- Clear feedback messages for all actions
- Cooldown system to prevent spam

### Fully Customizable
- All messages are configurable in the config.yml

## Usage
1. Use `/tpa <player>` to send a teleport request
2. The recipient can accept with `/tpaccept` or deny with `/tpadeny`
3. The sender can cancel their request with `/tpacancel`

## Configuration
The plugin features a comprehensive configuration file where you can adjust:
- Protection duration after teleportation
- Request cooldown time
- All message texts with full color code support

```
# KindlyTPA Configuration

# Time in seconds that players will be invulnerable after teleportation
protection-duration: 5

# Cooldown in seconds between TPA requests
tpa-cooldown: 30

# Messages (supports color codes with '&')
messages:
  prefix: "&7[&bKindlyTPA&7] "
  
  # TPA request messages
  request:
    sent: "&aYou have sent a teleport request to &e%player%&a."
    received: "&e%player% &ahas requested to teleport to you. Type &e/tpaccept &aor &e/tpadeny&a."
    no-pending: "&cYou don't have any pending teleport requests."
    expired: "&cYour teleport request to &e%player% &chas expired."
    cooldown: "&cYou need to wait &e%time% &cseconds before sending another request."
    self: "&cYou cannot send a teleport request to yourself."
    not-found: "&cPlayer not found or is offline."
  
  # TPA accept messages
  accept:
    sender: "&aYour teleport request has been accepted. Teleporting in 3 seconds..."
    receiver: "&aYou have accepted the teleport request."
    no-request: "&cYou don't have any pending teleport request from this player."
  
  # TPA deny messages
  deny:
    sender: "&cYour teleport request has been denied."
    receiver: "&aYou have denied the teleport request."
    no-request: "&cYou don't have any pending teleport request from this player."
  
  # Protection message
  protection:
    enabled: "&aYou are now protected for &e%seconds% &aseconds after teleportation."
    disabled: "&cYour teleportation protection has ended."

  # Help message
  help:
    - "&b----- &eKindlyTPA Help &b-----"
    - "&e/tpa <player> &7- Send a teleport request to a player"
    - "&e/tpaccept [player] &7- Accept a teleport request"
    - "&e/tpadeny [player] &7- Deny a teleport request"
    - "&e/tpacancel &7- Cancel your sent teleport request"
```



## Permissions (by default are true)
- `kindlytpa.tpa` - Allows sending teleport requests
- `kindlytpa.tpaccept` - Allows accepting teleport requests
- `kindlytpa.tpadeny` - Allows denying teleport requests
- `kindlytpa.tpacancel` - Allows canceling sent teleport requests

title: Simple Player Badges
description: A simple Mod that allows you to create, assign and display Badges next to player names in Chat.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b10f3570663f401ed345908fadb0fda69ea4efe2_0.webp)

**Simple Player Badges** is a mod that enhances your in-game chat by allowing custom player badges to appear next to player names. This mod lets you assign various badges to players and adds a timestamp feature for better chat readability.
The timestamp functionality was inspired by [Beautified Chat by Serilum](https://modrinth.com/mod/beautified-chat-server). Thanks to Serilum for the inspiration, as some of their features were recreated into this mod.


## Configuration:
To configure the badges, you'll need to create a ```badgenames.json``` file in the ```config``` folder of your Minecraft Server. The JSON configuration contains two primary sections:

players: This is where you assign badges to specific players by name.

badges: Here you define the properties of each badge, including its symbol, color, and hover text.

Here's an example configuration:

```
{
    "players": [
        {
            "name": "Player1", 
            "badges": ["badge1", "badge2", "badge3"]
        },
        {
            "name": "Player2", 
            "badges": ["badge2"]
        }
    ],
    "badges": {
        "badge1": { 
            "symbol": "★",
            "color": "gold",
            "hover": "Badge1 Title" 
        },
        "badge2": { 
            "symbol": "α",
            "color": "blue",
            "hover": "Badge2 Title" 
        },
        "badge3": { 
            "symbol": "⚔",
            "color": "red",
            "hover": "Badge3 Title" 
        }
    }
}

```
The configuration file should be saved in UTF-8 format to ensure special characters display correctly.

Operators can use ```/badges reload``` on runtime to update any changes made to ```badgenames.json```.

## Explanation of Fields:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

### players:
- **name:** The Minecraft username of the player.
- **badges:** A list of badge names assigned to the player. Each badge name refers to a badge defined in the badges section.

### badges:
- **symbol:** The symbol or text that will be displayed as the badge next to the player's name in chat. This can include text and symbols.
- **color:** The color of the badge symbol. Use standard Minecraft color names (like gold, blue, red, etc.).
- **hover:** The text that appears when you hover over the badge in chat.

</details>






## To-Do:
- Automatic Config Generation if Config doesn't already exist
- Creating and assigning badges with commands
- Option to enable and disable certain features

title: ApeNet
description: A tiny upgrade to Minecraft Transfer Protocol.
body:
**ApeNet**
A tiny but necessary upgrade to Minecraft Transfer Protocol!

**What is ApeNet?**
ApeNet is a plugin which makes the Minecraft Transfer Protocol Introduced in 1.20.5, more accessible. It adds QoL functions like Server-list, **an EXPERIMENTAL security protocol** and more features to come. It's a really simple, yet useful plugin which can inspure a lot of new projects! 

**Setup Steps**
Easy as 1..2..oh.. It's done
1. Download and put ApeNet in your plugins folder.
2. Set accept-transfers: false --> true on your backend server. Configure and done!

**Config Example**

```
# Command to use for server transfer (default: apenet)
command: apenet

# Enable secure transfer system (default: false)
# VERY EXPERIMENTAL. USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.
# Generates a token.yml. Use the same generated token for every servers to enable a Secure Transfer in-between them.
# It's not full-proof and PROBABLY can be BYPASSED.
secure_transfer: false

# Is this a frontend server? (Only applicable if secure_transfer is true)
frontend_server: false

# Server configurations
servers:
  lobby:
    host: lobby.example.com
    port: 25565
  survival:
    host: survival.example.com
    port: 25566
  creative:
    host: creative.example.com
    port: 25567
```

 - Echoes are immune to most damage and vanish after 30 seconds without intervention.
- Right-clicking an Echo with an empty hand will cause it to vanish and grant a Soul Shard.
 - You can consume Soul Shards by right-clicking with one in hand.

> **Spirit Essence:**
> Using a Soul Shard on an Echo will extend its remaining life.


**Fury of The Damned:**
- After consuming a Soul Shard, your next few attacks deal additional Magic damage.
 - This damage is increased against Undead enemies.

> **Mercy in Death:** 
> Killing a creature with a deadly status effect will grant a Soul Shard


**Delay the Inevitable:**
- Consuming a Soul Shard will grant temporary health and briefly protect you from lethal damage.
 - You can share Soul Shards with others by sneaking before using them.

> **Life Transference:**
> Sneaking while using a shard of Prismarine, Quartz, or Glass (any vanilla pane) allows you to sacrifice a quarter of your health to create a Soul Shard.


**Hollow Resonance:**
- Whenever an Echo vanishes near you, you gain Grief. While grieving, you experience 15% fatigue.
 - Fatigue reduces movement speed, break speed, and attack speed.
- If the vanished Echo is one of your tamed creatures, you gain additional effects based on how it vanished.
 - Effects are listed in the Origin menu as tooltips.

> **Overwhelmed:**
> Filling your Grief meter causes you to take damage.


**Soulnumbed:** 
- You gain 15% passive damage resistance.
- You receive 30% less healing.
- You regenerate significantly slower but no longer need full hunger to regenerate.



To add, simply navigate to your world's "datapack" folder and slap this bad boy in there.

Agonia Atlas tar Agonias webbkarta och gör den till ett riktigt in-game verktyg.

Istället för att tabba ut kan du öppna kartan direkt i Minecraft och snabbt hitta spelare, huvudstäder, shops och andra viktiga platser medan du faktiskt spelar. Modden är gjord specifikt för Agonia och är byggd för att kännas naturlig att använda som en del av spelet.

Agonia Atlas lägger också till flera funktioner som gör kartan snabbare och smidigare att använda i praktiken.

## Funktioner
- Fullskärmskarta direkt inne i Minecraft
- Stöd för **Overworld, Nether och End**
- Se online-spelare live på kartan
- Spelarhuvuden samt visning av hp och armor när du klickar på en spelare
- Huvudstäder, shops och andra markeringar med tydligare ikoner
- Sökfunktion som hoppar till relevanta platser
- Favoriter för spelare och platser du vill hitta snabbt igen
- Sidomeny för online-spelare och huvudstäder
- Filter för att visa eller dölja olika typer av markeringar
- Minns var du senast var på kartan när du öppnar den igen
- Smidig zoom och panorering anpassad för att användas mitt i gameplay

## Viktigt
- Modden är **client-side only**
- Den kräver **ingen servermod**
- Den använder Agonias publika kartdata som redan finns tillgänglig via serverns webbkarta
- Gjord specifikt för **Agonia SMP**

Om du hittar buggar, problem eller har förslag kan du kontakta **ElmerLion**.



# Agonia Atlas - English

Agonia Atlas brings Agonia’s web map directly into Minecraft and turns it into a proper in-game tool.

Instead of tabbing out, you can open the map inside the game and quickly find players, capitals, shops, and other important locations while you are actually playing. The mod is made specifically for Agonia and is designed to feel like a natural part of Minecraft, not just a browser page inside the game.

So this is not only a copy of the website map. Agonia Atlas also adds several quality-of-life features that make the map faster and easier to use in real gameplay.

## Features
- Fullscreen map directly inside Minecraft
- Support for **Overworld, Nether, and End**
- Live online players shown on the map
- Player heads plus health and armor display when clicking a player
- Capitals, shops, and other markers with clearer icons
- Search that jumps to relevant locations
- Favorites for players and places you want to access quickly
- Sidebar for online players and capitals
- Filters to show or hide different marker categories
- Remembers your last map position when reopened
- Smooth zooming and panning designed for actual gameplay use

## Important
- The mod is **client-side only**
- It requires **no server-side mod**
- It uses Agonia’s public map data that is already available through the official web map
- Made specifically for **Agonia SMP**

If you find bugs, issues, or have suggestions, feel free to contact **ElmerLion**.

title: PVP-PVE Leveling System
description: Get rewarded when levelup with xp gained from players and mobs
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ef750682373de1f032e286ac89079cc8b62f96b.png)

A Minecraft plugin that adds a **PvP/PvE leveling system** with XP, levels, rewards, and group-based multipliers.  
Supports both **SQLite** and **MySQL** storage backends, integrates with **LuckPerms** for group multipliers, and **PlaceholderAPI** for custom placeholders.

---

## 📦 Dependencies

- **PaperMC** (1.21+ recommended)
- **LuckPerms** *(optional)*  
- **PlaceholderAPI** *(required)*  
- **bstats** *(included)*  

---

## 🎮 Commands

- `/leveling reload`
- `/leveling <xp|level> <add|remove|set> <amount> <player>`

---

## 📊 Placeholders (PlaceholderAPI)

- `%pvppvelevelingsystem_xp%` -> player's xp amount
- `%pvppvelevelingsystem_level%` -> player's level
- `%pvppvelevelingsystem_remaining_xp%` -> player's remaining xp to next level
- `%pvppvelevelingsystem_bar%` -> player's xp bar
- `%pvppvelevelingsystem_level_percent%` -> player's accomplishment level in percent
- `%pvppvelevelingsystem_next_level_xp%` -> player's next level xp requirement
- `%pvppvelevelingsystem_next_level%` -> player's next level

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

```yaml
# ==============================
# PvpPveLevelingSystem Config
# ==============================

# Available default are en_us, fr_fr.
# You can create others languages in /lang/<name>.yml.
lang: en_us

storage:
  provider: sql # sql, mysql

# Mysql configuration
mysql:
  host: "localhost"
  port: 3306
  database: "leveling"
  username: "root"
  password: "password"

xp-sources:
  player: 10
  zombie: 5
  skeleton: 5
  creeper: 5
  spider: 5
  blaze: 8
  enderman: 10
  # All other mobs not listed will give 0 XP by default.

bar:
  length: 5
  full: "&6-"
  empty: "&7-"

group-xp-multipliers:
  # Multipliers applied based on LuckPerms primary group.
  # Example: vip group multiplies the XP by 2.5.
  default: 1.0
  vip: 2.5
  vip_plus: 3.0

levels-xp:
  # If true, required XP per level is calculated using a multiplier.
  # Formula: requiredXP = baseXP + (level * multiplier * baseXP)
  use-multiplier: true
  multiplier: 0.1
  base-xp: 10

  # If use-multiplier is false, these values are used directly.
  # You can define XP requirements per level manually here.
  1: 10
  2: 20
  3: 30

# Example use: generic-level-command: title %player% actionbar {"text":"Levelup ! (lvl %level%)"}
generic-level-command: []

rewards:
  # Rewards given when reaching specific levels.
  # Commands are executed by the console.
  levels:
    1:
      commands:
        - "give %player% diamond 1"
    5:
      commands:
        - "eco give %player% 100"
    10:
      commands:
        - "eco give %player% 100"
        - "give %player% diamond 1"
```

body:
# Features

- **Multiple Profiles per Player**: Players can have multiple completely isolated profiles
- **Full Data Separation**: Each profile stores its own inventory, armor, XP, health, effects, and more
- **Permission-Based System**: Control who can create profiles and how many they can have
- **Combat Protection**: Prevents profile switching during combat with configurable combat tags
- **Warmup System**: Configurable warmup timers with movement and damage cancellation
- **LuckPerms Integration**: Seamless permission context switching (optional)
- **High Performance**: Async operations, multithreaded, optimized database queries
- **Public API**: Full API for developers to integrate with their plugins
- **Comprehensive Events**: Listen to profile creation, deletion, switching, and more.
  
# Requirements

- Minecraft Version: 1.21.4+
- Server Software: Paper or its forks (Purpur, Pufferfish, etc.)
- Java Version: 21+
- Optional Dependencies:
  - LuckPerms (for permission contexts)
  - Vault (for future economy integration)
  - PlayerPoints/ExecellentEconomy (alt)
  - PlaceHolderAPI
  - MiniPlaceholders
  
# Documentation and Support Discord

- [Documentation](https://github.com/sun-mc-dev/oumprofile).
- [Support Discord](https://discord.gg/maDcwPV6KB).

title: ReJoin
description: Instantly reconnect to your last multiplayer server after a kick or crash with one keypress. No more navigating through the server list or remembering IP addresses. Just press the key and you're back in the game.
body:
## ReJoin

Ever get kicked from your favorite server and have to click through the entire server list just to get back? ReJoin eliminates that entirely. As soon as you disconnect, it remembers where you were. One keypress or automatic retry and you are reconnecting with exponential backoff.

### What it does
- **Auto-reconnect** -- detects disconnects and reconnects automatically with configurable delay and retry limits
- **Live ping HUD** -- shows your current ping in the corner, color-coded green/yellow/red
- **Kick reason filter** -- optionally skip reconnect if you were banned or kicked for a specific reason
- **Keybind toggle** -- press R (rebindable) to manually trigger a reconnect at any time

### How to use
- Default keybind: **R** (rebindable in Controls)
- Config via Mod Menu -> ReJoin
- HUD appears automatically in the top-left corner during multiplayer

### Compatibility
Client-side only, works on any server. No server mod required.

## Changelog
### v1.1.0
- Re-added Minecraft 1.21.11 support.
### v1.0.0
- Initial release: auto-reconnect on disconnect/kick (with backoff) + a connection/ping HUD.

title: Storage Sacks
description: Vanilla-styled bundle upgrades
body:
Storage Sacks adds a collection of bundle upgrades that can hold more items, but are filtered to a specific resource type.

![A full rock sack from the mod, holding eight stacks of cobblestone and similar junk.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3tkHWu2g/images/d2fb43d58213e830166f6de1ddee96ad52296308.png)

## Getting Started

All sacks require an empty vanilla bundle of any colour to craft. All recipes are available on the [the wiki](https://docs.jackf.red/storage-sacks/types), the recipe book or your favourite recipe viewer.

Currently, there are 7 types of sacks:

- **Large Sack**: can hold up to 2 stacks worth of any item.
- **Builder's Sack**: the same as the **Large Sack**, but additionally can place from it's contents randomly.
- **Rock Sack**: can hold up to 8 stacks worth of cobblestone, dirt, and other mining detritus.
- **Mining Sack**: can hold up to 4 stacks worth of mined resources, gems and dusts.
- **Potion Sack**: can hold up to 4 potions.
- **Lumber Sack**: can hold up to 6 stacks of logs, saplings and sticks.
- **Seed Sack**: can hold up to 4 stacks of crops, seeds and saplings. Can also place from it's contents randomly.

## Dependencies

Storage Sacks requires Fabric Loader and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).
