title: SKFER PACK
description: focusing on performance optimizations and significant world generation enhancements. It integrates a vast array of structure and biome mods, such as Biomes O' Plenty, Terralith, and Tectonic, alongside numerous specialized dungeons
body:
SKFER PACK 1.21.11 is a performance-heavy exploration modpack built for Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric). It is designed to modernize the Minecraft experience by overhaulng world generation, enhancing visuals, and adding deep RPG-style exploration mechanics without losing the "Vanilla+" feel.

Here is a deeper look into its core components:

1. World Generation & Biomes
The pack focuses heavily on making the world feel massive and diverse. It combines several industry-standard generation mods:

Tectonic & Terralith: These transform the terrain by adding massive mountain ranges, deep canyons, and smoother river systems without adding new blocks.

Biomes O' Plenty & Biomes We've Gone: These add dozens of new unique biomes, providing a much wider variety of flora, trees, and atmospheres to discover.

2. Structures and Dungeons
To make exploration rewarding, the pack includes numerous structure mods:

Towns and Towers: Overhauls villages and pillager outposts to be more architecturally impressive.

Underground Villages & Sparse Structures: Encourages subterranean exploration and ensures that finding a structure feels like a rare, special event.

Vanilla Structure Overhauls: Updates classic locations like desert temples and jungle pyramids to be more complex and dangerous.

3. Performance & Optimization
This is a highly optimized pack. It utilizes the "Sodium" engine along with several companion mods:

Sodium & Iris: Provides massive FPS boosts and support for high-end shaders.

BadOptimizations & C2ME: These focus on back-end logic and chunk loading, reducing "stuttering" when flying or moving quickly through the world.

Lithium: Optimizes game physics and AI to ensure the server-side logic runs smoothly even with many entities.

4. Gameplay Enhancements (Quality of Life)
The pack includes several "essential" mods that improve the daily experience:

Traveler's Backpack & Storage Drawers: Advanced portable and stationary storage solutions to handle the influx of new items.

AppleSkin: Provides better visualization of hunger and saturation levels.

Veinminer (FTB Ultimine style): Allows you to mine entire veins of ore or chop down whole trees at once, reducing the grind.

Sophisticated Maps/Waypoints: Likely included to help players navigate the vast new terrains.

5. Immersion
With mods like Variants & Ventures and various sound overhaul configs (as seen in the file structure), the pack aims to make the world feel alive. You’ll find more animal variations, better ambient sounds in caves and forests, and a more polished UI.

Summary for a Player:
If you play this pack, you should expect a version of Minecraft that looks like a modern AAA game, where the mountains are taller, the caves are more dangerous, and there is a structure or a new biome around every corner, all while running smoother than the base game.

body:
🥔 Potato Cannon Mod
Weaponize your garden!

Tired of throwing away Poisonous Potatoes? Bored of the standard Bow and Crossbow? The Potato Cannon Mod introduces a high-quality, 3D-modeled launcher that turns your farm produce into heavy artillery. It fits perfectly into the vanilla style while adding a fun, explosive twist to combat.

✨ Features
Custom 3D Model: A realistic, "bazooka-style" launcher that looks great in first and third-person views.

4 Unique Ammo Types: Each vegetable has a different effect, damage, and particle style.

Balanced Gameplay: Features a cooldown system and durability, making it a fair weapon for Survival.

Custom Sounds & Particles: Satisfying "thump" sounds and smoke trails.

Advancements: Unlock the "Spud Gunner" advancement upon crafting.

🥕 Ammunition Types
The cannon automatically detects what's in your inventory. The priority order is:

Golden Carrot (The Sniper) 🎯

Effect: High velocity, massive damage (3.5 hearts), and almost no gravity drop.

Visual: Leaves a sparkling trail.

Best for: Long-range precision shots.

Baked Potato (The Incendiary) 🔥

Effect: Sets enemies on fire for 3 seconds.

Visual: Emits a smoke trail while flying.

Best for: Dealing damage over time.

Poisonous Potato (The Bio-Weapon) ☠️

Effect: Low impact damage but inflicts Poison for 4 seconds.

Best for: Weakening enemies or PvP annoyance. Finally, a use for poisonous potatoes!

Regular Potato (The Standard) 🥔

Effect: Standard impact damage (1 heart). Cheap and reliable.

Best for: General combat and mob farming.

🛠️ Crafting Recipe
Crafting the Potato Cannon is simple but requires some iron engineering.

Top Row: 3x Iron Ingots (Barrel)

Middle Row: Flint & Steel (Igniter) + Iron Ingot

Bottom Row: Log (Handle)


📦 Installation
Download and install Fabric Loader.

Download the Fabric API and put it in your mods folder.

Download the Potato Cannon Mod and put it in your mods folder.

Launch the game and start blasting!

title: NDuels
description: A simple but a all in one Duels Plugin
body:
# NDuels

  Fast, configurable duels plugin for Paper/Spigot.
  Designed for clean queues, flexible menus, and smooth arena resets.

  ## Core Features

  - Matchmaking & queues with /duel menu support
  - Custom kits per mode + in‑game editor
  - Configurable /duel menu layout via menu.layout
  - Lag‑safe arena reset (batch block restore)
  - And Much more! :D

  ## Important Notes

  - [TAB](https://modrinth.com/plugin/tab-was-taken) integration: duelists can see only opponent + spectators in tablist (if TAB is installed)
  - [PlaceHolderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi) support included

  ## Player Commands
<details>
<summary>Player Commands</summary>

```
  - /duel - show basic help
  - /duel queue <mode> - join queue for a mode
  - /duel leave - leave current queue
  - /duel unqueue - same as leave
  - /duel modes - list available modes
  - /duel menu - open duel menu
  - /duel preview <kitId> - preview a kit
  - /duel spectate <player|off> - spectate a player or stop spectating
  - /duel accept <player> - accept a duel request
  - /duel ready - confirm ready check
  - /duel stats [player] - view duel stats
  - /duel <player> <mode> - send duel request
```

</details>

  ## Admin Commands
  
<details>
<summary>Admin Commands</summary>
  
```
  - /dueladmin menu - open the admin GUI
  - /dueladmin placeholders - open placeholder list GUI
  - /dueladmin save <arenaName> - save selected arena positions
  - /dueladmin removearena <arenaName> - delete an arena
  - /dueladmin reload - reload config, modes, arenas, queues
  - /dueladmin victorymsg <all|players|none> - set who sees win message
  - /dueladmin startmsg <all|players|none> - set who sees start message
  - /dueladmin gdelay <mode> <time> - set glowing delay for a mode
  - /dueladmin casing <unbreakable|breakable> - toggle arena casing protection
  - /dueladmin modearena add <mode> <arena> - assign arena to a mode
  - /dueladmin modearena remove <mode> <arena> - remove arena from a mode
  - /dueladmin setspawn <arenaName> <1|2> - set arena spawn point
  - /dueladmin kit create <mode> - create kit from your inventory
  - /dueladmin kit preview <mode> - preview a kit
  - /dueladmin kit editor <kitId> - edit a kit
  - /dueladmin kit list - list all kits
  - /dueladmin mode delete <mode> - delete a mode
  - /dueladmin rdelay <seconds> - set respawn delay after duel
  - /dueladmin list - list arenas and their status
```

</details>

  ## Permissions
  
<details>
<summary>Permissions</summary>

```
  - nduels.bypass
  - nduels.admin
  - nduels.admin.legacy (deprecated)
  - nduels.admin.wand
  - nduels.admin.menu
  - nduels.admin.placeholders
  - nduels.admin.save
  - nduels.admin.arena.remove
  - nduels.admin.reload
  - nduels.admin.victorymsg
  - nduels.admin.gdelay
  - nduels.admin.kit.rename
  - nduels.admin.nosat
  - nduels.admin.modearena.add
  - nduels.admin.modearena.remove
  - nduels.admin.modearena.list
  - nduels.admin.setspawn
  - nduels.admin.kit.editor
  - nduels.admin.kit.create
  - nduels.admin.kit.preview
  - nduels.admin.kit.list
  - nduels.admin.rdelay
  - nduels.admin.list
```
  
</details>

  ## Placeholders (Using [PlaceHolderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi))
  
<details>
<summary>Placeholders</summary>

  
```
  - %nduels_queue%
  - %nduels_queuepos%
  - %nduels_queue_eta%
  - %nduels_queued_mode%
  - %nduels_in_duel%
  - %nduels_duel_mode%
  - %nduels_duel_mode_display%
  - %nduels_duel_opponent%
  - %nduels_ready%
  - %nduels_requests%
  - %nduels_arenas_total%
  - %nduels_arenas_free%
  - %nduels_arenas_inuse%
  - %nduels_arenas_resetting%
  - %nduels_modes_total%
  - %nduels_queued_total%
  - %nduels_online%
  - %nduels_wins%
  - %nduels_losses%
  - %nduels_kills%
  - %nduels_deaths%
  - %nduels_kd%
  - %nduels_wl%
  Per-mode (replace <mode> with mode id)
  - %nduels_queue_<mode>%
  - %nduels_queuepos_<mode>%
  - %nduels_wins_<mode>%
  - %nduels_losses_<mode>%
  - %nduels_kills_<mode>%
  - %nduels_deaths_<mode>%
  - %nduels_wl_<mode>%
```

</details>

  ## Menu Example:
  
<details>
<summary>Examples</summary>

  
![Example Menu 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/acaad6d7dbc903fd2ade4ed88e79d90db26bc384.png)
  ### Code:
```
menu:
  layout:
    row2: '[] [] [] m o a [] [] []'
    row3: '[] [] [] t r h [] [] []'
    row4: '[] [] [] [] [] [] [] [] []'
    row5: 'p [] [] c [] u [] [] n'
    row6: ''
  items:
    p: page_prev
    n: page_next
    c: close
    u: unqueue
    a: mode_axe
    r: mode_crystal1
    m: mode_mace1
    h: mode_helden2
    o: mode_only
    t: mode_uhc
```

</details>

  ## Default Config.yml
  
<details>
<summary>Config.yml</summary>
  
  ### U can change many settings/options with the ingame Admin Commands
```
#
# NDuels configuration
# Tips:
# - Most values can be changed and reloaded with /dueladmin reload
# - Times are in seconds unless stated otherwise
#
# Arena definitions (auto-filled by /dueladmin save)
arenas: {}
modes:
  # Example mode (copy this to add more)
  example:
    # Display name shown in menus & messages
    displayName: "&bExample"
    # Fallback icon material (if no icon-item is set)
    icon: DIAMOND_SWORD
    # Optional: glowing delay for this mode (seconds). 0 = off
    # glowing-delay-seconds: 0
    # Optional: disable hunger drain for this mode
    # no-saturation: false
    # Optional full item override (serialized ItemStack)
    # icon-item: {}
settings:
  # Block non-/duel commands while in a duel
  command-blocking: true
  # Make arena casing (border) unbreakable
  arena-shell-unbreakable: true
  # Broadcast duel start messages to the whole server
  broadcast-duels: true
  # Victory message scope: ALL / PLAYERS / NONE
  victory-message: PLAYERS
  # Start message scope: ALL / PLAYERS / NONE
  start-message: PLAYERS
  # Time after duel before returning to lobby (0 = instant)
  respawn-delay: 0
  # Seconds before killing players who leave the arena during a duel
  arena-exit-seconds: 3
  # How many blocks are reset per tick (higher = faster, more load)
  arena-reset-blocks-per-tick: 2000
  # Particle radius to show arena borders when near
  boundary-particle-radius: 3
  # Queue status actionbar update interval (ticks)
  queue-status-interval-ticks: 40
  # Average duel length used for ETA (seconds)
  queue-avg-duel-seconds: 60
  # Ready check timeout (seconds)
  ready-check-seconds: 10
  # Duel request timeout (seconds)
  duel-request-timeout-seconds: 30
  # Menu sound effects
  menu-click-sound: UI_BUTTON_CLICK
  menu-page-sound: ITEM_BOOK_PAGE_TURN
  menu-open-sound: BLOCK_CHEST_OPEN
  xp:
    # XP needed per level
    per-level: 100
    # XP for wins / losses / kills
    win: 10
    loss: 5
    kill: 2
menu:
  # /duel menu layout (up to 6 rows).
  # Use [] for empty (auto-filled with gray glass).
  # Set row6: "" to make a 5-row menu, row5: "" for 4 rows, etc.
  layout:
    row1: "[] [] [] [] [] [] [] [] []"
    row2: "[] [] [] [] [] [] [] [] []"
    row3: "[] [] [] [] [] [] [] [] []"
    row4: "[] [] [] [] [] [] [] [] []"
    row5: "[] [] [] [] [] [] [] [] []"
    row6: "p [] [] [] c [] [] n u"
  # Map layout letters to actions
  items:
    p: "page_prev"
    n: "page_next"
    c: "close"
    u: "unqueue"
    # Generic mode slot (auto-fills modes, with paging)
    s: "mode"
    # You can also pin specific modes:
    # x: "mode_sword"
```

</details>

title: BadSpectators
description: This mod is a preventative measure that removes the ability of teleportation and movement from spectators.
body:
_**Bad Spectators!**_

 

Ever get tired of spectators abusing their ability to teleport? Perhaps they fly around and find hidden structures or bases?  That is no longer an issue with this Mod! This Mod adds preventative measures to ensure that Spectators cannot abuse these powers within your minecraft server.

Bad Spectators!

Tired of spectators abusing their powers to scout hidden bases, locate secret structures, or relay unfair information? Bad Spectators! adds configurable restrictions to spectator mode to prevent abuse on multiplayer servers while still allowing legitimate moderation and observation.

🔒 What This Mod Does

This mod introduces server-side safeguards that limit what spectators can see and do, preventing them from gaining unfair advantages. Depending on configuration, the mod can:

Block spectator teleportation to players, preventing instant scouting of bases

Restrict free-flight movement, keeping spectators within allowed areas

Hide or obfuscate player-built structures from spectators

Prevent chunk loading caused by spectators, stopping exploration-based scouting

Optionally disable interaction-based exploits such as entity following or camera clipping

All restrictions are enforced server-side, meaning clients cannot bypass them.

⚙️ Fully Configurable

Server owners can fine-tune which spectator abilities are restricted, allowing:

Trusted moderators to spectate freely

Regular players to use spectator mode safely (e.g. after death)

Competitive or survival servers to prevent information leaks

🧠 Why Use Bad Spectators?

Stops base-finding abuse

Prevents unfair PvP advantages

Reduces meta-gaming and ghosting

Keeps spectator mode useful without breaking server integrity

title: EonIceAge
description: EonIceAge plugin Cold, winter & survival mechanics
body:
![a](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dbfde67eb79958f83d8dd5a58b2eb9bb8dbb511a.png)

---

## ❄️ EonIceAge

**EonIceAge** is a hardcore survival plugin for Minecraft that introduces a **realistic cold and temperature system**, fully compatible with **versions 1.18.2 up to the latest release**.

The plugin transforms your world into a **permanent icy age**, where players must manage warmth, shelter, and environment conditions to survive. Cold is no longer cosmetic — it directly affects gameplay, farming, and exploration.

Perfect for **Hardcore Survival**, **Realism**, **RPG**, and **Challenging SMP servers**.

---

## ✨ Features

* 🌡 **Advanced temperature system**

  * dynamic day/night temperature changes
  * depth-based cold (deeper = colder)
  * extra cold from water, rain, and hunger
* ❄️ **Freezing & hypothermia mechanics**

  * freeze damage when body temperature is too low
  * slowness, mining fatigue, and weakness effects
* 💧 **Wetness system**

  * rain and water make players wet
  * wet players freeze faster and warm up slower
* 🔥 **Heat sources system**

  * torches, campfires, furnaces, lava, lanterns, and more
  * distance-based heat calculation
  * configurable warmth values
* 🏠 **Shelter & room detection**

  * roof detection up to 7 blocks above
  * walls required to count as a room
  * leaves and natural blocks are ignored
  * indoor warmth and drying bonuses
* 🌱 **Farming restrictions**

  * saplings will not grow without a proper room
  * requires roof, walls, and nearby heat
  * bonemeal respects the same rules
* 🌨 **Permanent winter world**

  * automatic winter biome enforcement
  * snow stays on the ground
  * water freezes naturally
* ❄️ **Winter accelerator**

  * snow and ice spread faster near players during storms
* 🌬 **Cold breath visual effects**

  * visible breath in cold temperatures
* 🍲 **Warm food buffs**

  * certain foods provide temporary warmth bonuses
* 📊 **Clean action bar display**

  * current temperature
  * nearby heat amount
  * nearest heat source
  * fully customizable format and units (°C / °F)
* 📝 **Fully customizable**

  * `config.yml` – gameplay, units, action bar
  * `messages.yml` – all chat messages & heat source translations
* ♻ **Reload support**

  * reload configuration without restarting the server

---

## 🧠 Gameplay Philosophy

EonIceAge is designed to **slow down early-game progression** and reward:

* smart base building
* proper shelter design
* heat management
* strategic exploration

Surviving the cold becomes just as important as food and tools.

---

## ⚙ Configuration Highlights

* Toggle Celsius or Fahrenheit
* Customize action bar format and symbols
* Translate heat source names
* Adjust freezing speed, wetness effects, and warmth bonuses
* Control sapling growth rules

---

## 🎯 Best Use Cases

✔ Hardcore Survival
✔ Realism SMP
✔ RPG worlds
✔ Winter-themed servers
✔ Challenge-based gameplay

---

title: Expert Dimension Travel
description: Reworks travel between dimensions to be a little more challenging...
body:
![Demonstration of Nether Portals only being creatable via Ruined Portal structures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Indeterminance/ExpertDimensionTravel/refs/heads/1.20.1/gallery/ruined_portal.png)
# Expert Dimension Travel
Have you ever thought that the Nether is a little too easy to enter? Or maybe that the outer End islands being optional is a little silly? Expert Dimension Travel aims to resolve these by implementing the following changes:

- Nether Portals can only be activated in Ruined Portal structures. Including in the Nether!
- Nether Portals are one-way, and will generate "broken" portals where you come out!
- The central fountain in the End has been changed, with no exit portal generating after the Ender Dragon has been defeated!
- Using an End Gateway to access the outer End islands no longer generates a return gateway at the destination, however...
- ...using an End Gateway in the outer End islands returns you to the Overworld instead of merely teleporting you to the main End island.

Good luck!

title: MorTP
description: MorTP is basically a DeathSwap, a minigame originally created by SethBling where players swap positions periodically to kill each other! Unlimited players and many languages are supported.
body:
# ![splash](https://github.com/S2009-dev/MorTP/blob/main/splash.png?raw=true)

MorTP is basically a DeathSwap, a minigame originally created by SethBling where players swap positions periodically to kill each other! Unlimited players and many languages are supported.

## Supported languages

| Code    | Name                    |
|---------|-------------------------|
| `en_us` | English (United States) |
| `fr_fr` | Français (France)       |

## How to play

1. Download the [latest version](https://modrinth.com/datapack/mortp/version/1.0) of **MorTP** (ensure to download the [**required resourcepack**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/mortp/version/1.0-resources) too).
2. Move `MorTP Resources.zip` to your `resourcepacks` folder.
3. Move `MorTP v1.0.zip` to your world `datapacks` folder.
4. Apply the resourcepack to your game.
5. Create a new world with the datapack or start an existing one.
6. Run `/reload` command in chat (the datapack is loaded when you hear the experience orb sound effect).
7. You can now see a new button in your pause menu!
8. Run `/team join mortp.master` to use every [features](#features).

![pause](https://github.com/S2009-dev/MorTP/blob/main/screenshots/pause.png?raw=true)

## Features

### Game Master commands

| Name | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `/function mortp:config` | Open the config menu. |
| `/function mortp:game/start` | Start the game. |
| `/function mortp:game/stop` | Stop the game. |

### Debug commands

| Name | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `/function mortp:debug/start` | Start the debug mode. |
| `/function mortp:debug/stop` | Stop the debug mode. |
| `/function mortp:debug/spawn_player {id: <int>}` | Spawn a NPC with the specified id. |

## Screenshots

![home](https://github.com/S2009-dev/MorTP/blob/main/screenshots/home.png?raw=true)
![config](https://github.com/S2009-dev/MorTP/blob/main/screenshots/config.png?raw=true)

title: Chronicles of Creation
description: A reimagined Minecraft journey blending magic, industry, relic progression, and handcrafted exploration into a world that feels familiar—but transformed.
body:
#                                Chronicles of creation


Chronicles of Creation transforms Minecraft into a world that feels new yet familiar. Explore redesigned structures, uncover relics, master spellcraft, and build powerful factories using Create. This pack focuses on progression without grind, letting players grow through automation, magic, skills, and exploration. Every system feels like it belongs, creating a fresh journey that still feels authentically Minecraft. Perfect for players who want meaningful upgrades, stunning world generation, and medium-hard survival with real rewards.

🌍 **Rebuilt World, Real Discovery**

Chronicles of Creation reshapes exploration with upgraded structures like reworked strongholds, massive underground mineshafts, fortified monuments, and improved villages and temples. Biomes are more atmospheric, ruins tell stories, and every region feels handcrafted. Travel with purpose, return stronger, and uncover loot that actually matters.

⚙ **Industrial Ascension Through Create**

Automation isn’t just optional—it’s progression. Build centrifuges, crushers, bulk processors, belt-based machines, farms, and powered assembly. Create-focused expansions allow scaling late-game infrastructure, making your base something that evolves over time rather than sits static.

🪄 **Magic That Feels Earned**

Develop spells through study, not randomness. Build spellbooks, bind effects, generate mana, and unlock enhanced casting tools. Craft empowered robes, arcane materials, and rune-based upgrades that change how you play. Magic becomes a long-term skill path, not a one-click trick.

🧬 **Character Power That Actually Progresses**

Through relic upgrades, infused materials, armor tiers, and active skill leveling, your character increases strength over time. Whether your identity becomes:

✔ battlemage
✔ relic-powered explorer
✔ industrial titan
✔ defensive frontliner
✔ speed-driven assassin

You progress into a build—something unique to your world, not just “a player with better gear.”

🛠 **Balanced Difficulty**

This pack stays grounded—nothing overly brutal or punishing. Enemies challenge you, structures contain danger, and careless exploration can cost you, but growth is always fair and obtainable through skill, automation, and preparation.

🌟 **Why Play This Pack?**

Because it feels like Minecraft evolved. There’s always something to unlock, somewhere new to explore, and truly rewarding upgrades waiting at each stage. You will look back at your world and see progress—systems layered over systems, automation improving life, magic expanding, and equipment becoming legacy-level.

Chronicles of Creation is Minecraft—rebuilt with purpose.
Begin your world, start your journey, and watch it transform.

You can’t light Nether portals, ignite TNT, burn forests, or set mobs on fire. Loot chests won’t generate it, villagers won’t trade it, and ruined portals become useless unless another ignition method is added. Players must rely on rare alternatives like lightning, fire charges, or creative tricks to access the Nether. It turns progression, travel, and combat into a much tougher challenge without a simple way to create fire.

Advanced Minecraft plugin for Paper/Spigot 1.21+ that intelligently manages entities, items, and server performance.

## Features

✅ **Real-time TPS Monitoring** - Track server performance with color-coded indicators  
✅ **Smart Item Cleanup** - Configurable item removal with whitelist/blacklist support  
✅ **Cluster Detection** - Removes dense entity clusters to prevent lag  
✅ **Interactive GUI Dashboard** - Manage everything from an in-game menu  
✅ **Multi-World Support** - Different settings per world  
✅ **Scheduled Cleanup** - Automated cleanup with player warnings  
✅ **Permission System** - Granular control over who can use features  
✅ **Statistics Tracking** - Monitor cleanup history and performance  

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|

title: N0 Emeralds
description: This mod removes all emeralds from Minecraft, so you can’t mine them, find them, or use them for trading. Villagers become way harder to work with, and progression slows down a lot.
body: No Emeralds deletes emerald ore, emerald drops, and all emerald-based trades. Villagers won’t accept emeralds, won’t give them, and their entire trading system becomes useless or broken depending on how your mod handles it. Chest loot won’t generate emeralds, mining won’t give you any, and raids won’t drop them. This forces players to survive without trading, relying fully on crafting, looting, and farming instead. It completely changes village gameplay and makes the world feel more grindy and unforgiving.

title: No Bread
description: This mod removes all bread from Minecraft, so you can’t craft it, find it in chests, or use it as food. It takes away one of the easiest early-game food sources and makes survival tougher.
body: No Bread deletes every way to get bread in the game. Villagers won’t farm it, wheat can’t craft it, and loot chests won’t generate it. This forces players to rely on harder or slower food sources like meat, berries, or farming alternatives. It changes village gameplay, early survival, and speedruns since one of the most common foods is gone. A tiny change that makes the world feel way more unforgiving.

title: SphinxRiddle
description: Quiz Competition System for Minecraft Servers
body:
# Sphinx Riddle - Minecraft Quiz Competition Mod


🎮 Quiz Competition System for Minecraft Servers

--- ## Features - [x] **Auto Quiz System** - [x] Automatic question intervals with configurable timing - [x] Question timeout handling - [x] JSON-based question and reward configuration - [x] **Smart Answer Detection** - [x] Contains-based answer matching (e.g., "龟派气功" matches "气功") - [x] Case-insensitive matching - [x] First-correct-player wins system - [x] **Reward System** - [x] Random reward selection from configurable pool - [x] Variable reward amounts - [x] Item auto-completion with MC's item selector - [x] **Scoreboard & Ranking** - [x] Real-time scoreboard display on client side (configurable) - [x] Top 15 players ranking with colored positions - [x] Persistent score storage - [x] **Comprehensive Commands** - [x] Player commands: `/sr question` (configurable permission) - [x] Admin commands: Question/reward management, scoreboard control - [x] Permission-based command access - [x] **Easy Configuration** - [x] JSON configuration files - [x] Hot-reload support - [x] Customizable messages and intervals - [x] **Internationalization (i18n)** - [x] Full English and Chinese language support - [x] Automatic language detection based on client settings - [x] Easy to add more languages ## Quick Start ### Installation 1. Download the latest `sphinxriddle-x.x-NeoForge-1.21.x.jar` from [Releases](https://github.com/SkyDreamLG/SphinxRiddle/releases) 2. Place it in your server's `mods` folder 3. Restart the server ### Basic Usage **For Players:** - Answer questions directly in chat when they appear - Use `/sr question` to manually start a new question (if allowed by config) - Check your ranking on the right-side scoreboard (if enabled) **For Admins:** ```bash # Reload configuration /sr reload # Add questions /sr add question "What tool mines diamond?" "Iron Pickaxe" # Add rewards with auto-completion /sr add reward minecraft:diamond 5 # Manage rankings /sr list ranking /sr reset ranking ``` Configuration Main Configuration (config/sphinxriddle-client.toml) The mod uses NeoForge's configuration system with the following options: Setting Default Description questionInterval 300 Time between auto questions (seconds) questionTimeout 60 Time before question expires (seconds) autoQuestionEnabled true Enable automatic questions allowManualQuestion true Allow players to use /sr question showScoreboard true Display scoreboard on client side questionPrefix "&6[问答]&r " Prefix for question messages rewardMessage "&a恭喜 %player% 正确回答问题！获得奖励: %reward%" Reward announcement message newQuestionMessage "&e新问题: %question% &e(输入答案到聊天框)" New question announcement configReloadedMessage "&aSphinxRiddle 配置重载完成" Config reload message The prompt information in the configuration file defaults to Chinese. If you need other languages, please modify the configuration file accordingly Data Files (config/sphinxriddle/) · questions.json - Question and answer pairs · rewards.json - Reward items and maximum amounts · scoreboard.json - Player scores and rankings Example Configuration questions.json: ```json [ { "question": "What mob explodes in Minecraft?", "answer": "Creeper" } ] ``` rewards.json: ```json [ { "itemId": "minecraft:diamond", "maxAmount": 5 } ] ``` Commands Reference Player Commands Command Description Permission /sr question Start a new question All players (if allowManualQuestion=true) or OP only Admin Commands Command Description Permission /sr reload Reload configuration OP (2) /sr add question Add new question OP (2) /sr add reward Add reward item OP (2) /sr list question List all questions OP (2) /sr list reward List all rewards OP (2) /sr list ranking Show leaderboard OP (2) /sr reset ranking Reset scores OP (2) /sr remove question Remove question OP (2) /sr remove reward Remove reward OP (2) Language Support The mod supports multiple languages automatically based on the client's language setting: · English (en_us) - Default language · Chinese (zh_cn) - 简体中文 · Spanish (es_es) - Español · French (fr_fr) - Français · German (de_de) - Deutsch · Japanese (ja_jp) - 日本語 · Russian (ru_ru) - Русский · Portuguese (pt_br) - Português Brasileiro · Korean (ko_kr) - 한국어 · Italian (it_it) - Italiano The mod will automatically display text in the player's client language. If a language is not fully translated, it will fall back to English. Adding New Languages To add support for a new language: 1. Create a new JSON file in assets/sphinxriddle/lang/ (e.g., fr_fr.json) 2. Add translations using the same keys as in en_us.json 3. The mod will automatically detect and use the appropriate language Example language file structure: ```json { "sphinxriddle.command.help.title": "=== Commandes SphinxRiddle ===", "sphinxriddle.command.help.question": "/sr question - Démarrer une nouvelle question" // ... more translations } ``` Development Building from Source ```bash git clone https://github.com/SkyDreamLG/SphinxRiddle.git cd SphinxRiddle ./gradlew build ``` Requirements · Minecraft 1.20.1+ · NeoForge · Java 17+ Internationalization The mod uses Minecraft's Component.translatable() system for all user-facing text. When adding new features: · Use translation keys instead of hardcoded strings · Provide translations in both en_us.json and zh_cn.json · Use string interpolation with %s placeholders when needed Example: ```java // Instead of: Component.literal("Configuration reloaded") // Use: Component.translatable("sphinxriddle.command.reload.success") ``` Support · GitHub Discussions - For questions and support · Issue Tracker - For bug reports and feature requests License This project is licensed under the GNU LGPL 2.1 License - see the LICENSE file for details. --- Note: 1. The scoreboard display and manual question commands can be disabled in the configuration file for server customization. 2. The prompt information in the configuration file defaults to Chinese. If you need other languages, please modify the configuration file accordingly

title: Vampires: The datapack
description: An Among Us Style Minigame to play with your server mates.
body:
# Vampires: The Datapack

A halloween themed, Among Us like, minigame to add to your server. Contains unique abilities, custom models, and loot bags!

Add a competitive, but fun, minigame that can be customized to your servers likings for timings. Add some spooky to your days!

## The goal

### The Players

Each player will be given an item to place a 'Core' in their base. This is the lifeblood of your characters while the game is active. Defend it, hide it, do what you need to stop the vampires from finding your base.

### The Vampires
![Vampire Ability Icons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/99f90347304452662fb5eb73021cd3bac7a37449.png)

Using their abilities, the vampires must seek and convert each player to be one of their own kind. At the same time, they must find the players bases as this keep them strong.

### Rewards
![An image of a loot bundle and the tooltip which reads "A bundle full of legendary loot!"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8z0f5vGX/images/b8c9da170c434c5bce6720b9869595b7bf15c775.png)

When the vampires convert a player or find all the bases they are rewarded with a goodie bag to help them further. 

When players surive the night, they are rewarded for if they don't get infected, or if their base remains to be found.

Goodie bags will contain useful items, tools/weapons, and much more.

## How to setup
Setup is simple, install and enable the datapack, and every player will be given their base creation item and joined into the game on their first log in to the server. While not technically required, the [resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/vampires-resourcepack) should be used for best usecase as custom items will be missing their textures, and abilities will be viewable by non-vampires.

Once your players are ready, an admin can run one of the following commands to begin the game:

```
/function vampires:start
```
or

```
/function vampires:start_custom {delay:X}
```

Where X is the amount of seconds you wish a round to begin, by default this is set to 24000 seconds (just around 6.5 hours).

## Removal/Uninstall

```
/function vampires:utility/cleanup
```
This should remove most things added via the datapack and cleanup any bases in the world. Somethings may be left behind is some players are offline.

title: Rain in dry places
description: Allows rain to appear in biomes where it usually doesn't.
body:
# Rain in dry places

With this datapack rain can fall in the desert, savanna, badlands and all their variants (see below).
 

## How it works:
This datapack replaces some biome files with modified versions that change a single line concerning precipitation. This means if it rains or snows anywhere in the game it also rains in those modified biomes.

When adding this datapack to an existing world, it has to be loaded (of course) **and** the world needs to be reentered for rain to appear. The same goes for disabling the datapack.

## Changed Biomes:
badlands, desert, eroded_badlands, savanna, savanna_plateau, windswept_savanna, wooded_badlands

## Limitations and Issues:
Due to this approach the datapack also overwrites a biome's data for terrain generation, spawns, etc. and should therefore only be used in the correct minecraft version. Should any other datapack in use also replaces those biome files for badlands, etc., they will conflict.

In the latter case you can fix this yourself, by unpacking the other datapack, going to data\minecraft\worldgen\biome, and changing the value of single line in the biomes' .json files (listed above): 
```
"has_precipitation": false -> "has_precipitation": true
```
This way your other datapack will allow rain in desert etc. without needing this datapack in the first place.

title: Periodic Expansion
description: Adds elements from the periodic table into Minecraft.
body:
🔬 **Periodic Expansion**

Periodic Expansion is a Minecraft mod that aims to bring the Periodic Table of Elements into the game in a meaningful and expandable way.
Instead of adding random materials, this mod focuses on real chemical elements, their properties, and how they can be translated into Minecraft gameplay.

The project is designed to be educational, immersive, and progression-friendly, making it suitable for both survival gameplay and modpacks.

⚙️ **Current Features**

🧪 New Elements

The mod currently introduces the following elements:

Lithium (Li)

Beryllium (Be)

Each element is implemented as a new ore, found naturally in the world and processed into usable materials.

⛏️ Ores & Materials

Lithium Ore

Beryllium Ore

Refined Lithium Ingots

Refined Beryllium Ingots

These resources integrate into the vanilla mining progression and are balanced for survival gameplay.

🛡️ Equipment & Gear

Both Lithium and Beryllium can be used to craft full equipment sets, including:

Tools (Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Sword, Hoe)

Armor (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots)

Each material has its own stats and characteristics, inspired by real-world properties:

Lithium: Lightweight, fast tools, lower durability

Beryllium: Stronger, more durable, suitable for mid-game progression

🌍 World Integration

Ores spawn naturally in the Overworld

Spawn rates are carefully adjusted to avoid clutter and maintain balance

Compatible with vanilla terrain generation

🎯 Design Goals

Stay faithful to real chemical elements

Expand Minecraft’s material progression in a logical way

Provide a foundation for future content such as:

More elements

Element-based biomes

Special effects and reactions

Advanced crafting systems

🚧 Planned Features

The mod is actively developed, and planned additions include:

More elements from the periodic table

Element-themed biomes

Unique mechanics based on chemical properties

New mobs and environmental interactions

(Planned features are subject to change.)

📦 Compatibility

Designed for survival gameplay

Modpack-friendly

No vanilla features are overwritten

🧠 Why Periodic Expansion?

Periodic Expansion is not just about adding new ores — it is about building a systematic and expandable chemistry-based progression inside Minecraft.

If you enjoy mods that add depth, logic, and long-term expansion potential, this mod is for you.

title: Sculk Soul
description:
Sculk Souler is a plugin that adds one special feature
turns your soul into part sculk
body:
# SCULK SOUL
Sculk souler turns a player into a sculk souler which is a person who was infected by the sculk itself

How it works.



### /sculksoul invite <player> (Operator only)
- this command will send an invite to a person in order for them to become Sculk Souler.
- Its operator only just so people can't turn the entire server into Sculk Soulers. Especially when it is strong when used right
people who will be invited will have an option to Ignore it or write this command
### /sculksoul accept
- players will be able to accept this invitation to become Sculk Souler. Sculk Soulers will be available to use two more commands
### /sculksoul free (Operator only)
- this command will remove a person from being a sculk souler. instead of it being "Kick", I chose free as being a Sculk Souler could be count as an infection.

## Commands available for Sculk Soulers
### /sculksoul heartbeat true/false
- the heartbeat will let player play the warden heartbeat sound effect off of them. its basically just for a show to look cool
### /sculksoul sculkmode true/false
- sculkmode will grand several good effects but also bad side effects which are all part of the theme of sculk being an infection
- Player will gain 2 more hearts (4hp) as long as tehy're in sculkmode
- Player will gain power equal to strength 2 as long as tehy're in sculkmode (note: the buffs are not effects, player still can use strength potion)
- Player will gain speed equal to speed 1 effect
- Player will heal half a heart (1hp) per second when near sculk (20 blocks range)
- Player will heal 2 hearts (4hp) per second when standing on a sculk
### however bad side effects
- Player can no longer heal from anything that would grand "regeneration" effect. Even Golden apples, Totem of undying, Healing potion etc
- Player can no longer heal by having full saturation
- Player will starve more
- If player is not in range of sculk (20 blocks) the player will get timer of 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, the player will start taking damage of 1 heart (2hp) per second. This damage will not show any hit effect, so it can be easily missed.

SculkSoulers are weaker when the fight is moving a lot or when someone is running, but strong when the fight is in one place.

title: FableCraft
description: FableCraft adds magical blocks and tracking tools to Minecraft, letting you bounce higher, grow crops instantly, and keep tabs on anything that moves (along with other things!)
body: # FableCraft A Minecraft mod that adds a handful of quirky, magical items and blocks to spice up your adventures. Built for Fabric 1.21.10. ## Features ### Bouncy Wool Ever wanted to turn your base into a trampoline park? This wool block launches you skyward when you land on it. The harder you fall, the higher you bounce. Perfect for parkour courses or just messing around with friends. #### Crafting Recipe ![Bouncy Wool](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00479ee23ff7ccfdf4c564dd9fdb853791beb60c.png) ### Glimmer Lantern A mystical lantern that does more than just light up the night. Every few seconds, it pulses out a wave that makes nearby creatures glow for a bit, so you can spot that creeper lurking in the shadows. Hang it from the ceiling or place it on the ground - your choice. #### Crafting Recipe ![Glimmer Lantern](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b22102080e8a147ac1c28411eed5994cc111d53d.png) ### Seed Bomb Tired of waiting for your crops to grow? Toss one of these bad boys and watch your wheat, carrots, and potatoes instantly ripen in a 5-block radius. Works on pretty much any vanilla crop. Your inner farmer will thank you. #### Crafting Recipe ![Seed Bomb](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed93a23cce45120420b46b3bd74f5300d464ed3c.png) ### Tracker Right-click any mob or player with this item to start tracking them. You'll see their distance and exact location in your action bar, plus they'll glow periodically so you never lose sight of them. Great for keeping tabs on your pet wolf or that friend who keeps wandering off. #### Crafting Recipe ![Tracker](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62df5efd69fc0b47a3ccf32aa65daa2d943cc570.png) ### Umbrella Hold this in either hand while falling and you'll drift down slowly like Mary Poppins. No fall damage, plenty of style. Jump off cliffs with confidence. #### Crafting Recipe ![Umbrella](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da637330f9e3d349f43dca60d93765cb48881ffd.png) ## Installation 1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) for Minecraft 1.21.10 2. Download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) 3. Drop both Fabric API and FableCraft into your `mods` folder 4. Launch the game and you're good to go ## Technical Stuff - **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.10 - **Loader:** Fabric 0.17.2+ - **Dependencies:** Fabric API 0.135.0+ - **Java Version:** 21

body:
💀 The Dead World 💀

Step into a version of Minecraft where life has withered away and the land itself feels cursed. The Dead World adds sprawling dried-out forests and eerie wastelands that make your adventures feel darker, tougher, and way more atmospheric.

🔥 Key Features:

Withered Forests: Leafless trees claw at the sky, their bark gray and lifeless. Perfect for gathering resources—or setting up a haunted hideout.

Dried Earth: Grass and rivers fade into dust, coarse dirt, and cracked terrain that looks like it hasn’t seen rain in centuries.

Creepy Atmosphere: Silence hangs heavy. No birds, no buzzing bees—just you, the wind, and the creak of old wood.

Survival Twist: The wood, plants, and soil here can still be used, but everything feels decayed and strange, like a world past its prime.

✨ Why Play This Mod?
Because sometimes, the world doesn’t need to be lush and green. The Dead World is for survivors who want a harsher challenge, builders who love eerie scenery, and explorers searching for rare, unsettling lands.

title: Origins: Proxy
description: Main antagonists of the Slenderverse. They are people who are possessed or under the influence of Slender Man.
body:
# 🪓 Proxy
### (Impact 2)
"I like to stare at the sun and think about what I’ve done. I lie awake in my great escape. I like crossing the line and slowly losing my mind. Are you okay? ’Cause I feel fine."
- I'm Not Alright by Shinedown, the canonical theme song for Tobias Erin Rogers.

Born troubled and pushed to a breaking point, after your sister’s death and the loss of your remaining sanity, you turn to killing. Just as you were about to accept your own death in the flames, a strange, tall, faceless man appeared before you.

### REQUIRES RESOURCE PACK!

> Introducing the **Proxy** origin! An Impact 2 origin themed around proxies from Creepypasta. This was made for a horror jam and is full of movement inspired by games like Dead by Daylight and fun combat mechanics like parrying!

## Powerlist

<details>
<summary>Cognitive Insensitivity</summary>

"My favourite was the one that made me completely numb from any pain.."

When killed, you are placed on a timer; failing to kill a non-undead entity during this timer will result in your death playing out as usual. While achieving allows you to live.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Bludgeoner</summary>

"So anyways, I butchered dear old dad."

You deal +2 damage with axes by default; when you drop below 5 hearts, you enter Adrenaline, which increases this by an additional 2.
You're slightly more skilled with Iron Axes, and you can significantly improve your movement speed with them for a brief period of time.

Hatchet specialties include:
- A chance on crit to lodge the blade in your opponent's neck.
- The ability to parry attacks.
- The ability to move through leaves during your brief period of increased movement speed.

  > Right-clicking an Iron Axe with Redstone Dust will give you a special bleeding texture and item name.
  
  > Dual Wielding your Hatchets like Toby does will result in a small speed boost. You also swing faster with your Hatchets.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Sleeper Agent</summary>

"But then i blacked out. Woke up in the middle of the night in the forest. Next thing I know this thing is standing over me. It has no eyes, no mouth, no nose, nothing."

You cannot sleep on beds, but you may set your spawn wherever you are.
The Tall One will occasionally send you messages in chat, you may also hear screaming or the footsteps of something walking by you. Sometimes you may even see a figure, despite the fact that it is not real.

Hallucinations include:
- Figures, short or tall.
- Animals, like pets.
- Wailing, screams.
- Walking, teleporting.
- Messages, voices.
  > When defeating enemies, they will occasionally drop the Tall Ones Pages.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Troubled Kid</summary>

"And to think those pesky doctors tried to silence them.."

Because of your numerous disorders, you are immune to most potion effects, with the exception of:
- Wither
- Poison
- Mining Fatigue

</details>

<details>
<summary>Exhausted</summary>

"Who the fuck needs a social life."

You naturally exhaust faster when sprinting.

</details>

## Dependencies
This datapack does require the [Origins Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins).

It also requires a resource pack, which is linked with the download.

## Additional
This origin was created for a horror jam by Glitch Productions!

If you encounter any bugs or want to suggest something, dm me on discord!
> @cassettecat

It’s perfect for streamers, YouTubers, community servers, or anyone who wants to spice up vanilla Minecraft with fun, unique twists.

Randomize mob drops, block drops, and chest loot. Every item you break or loot could be something completely unexpected, making every run different.
	•	Chunk Effects
Every chunk applies a unique potion effect (levels 1–3) to players inside it. Crossing into a new chunk can give you Strength, Speed, or even harmful effects like Poison – no two chunks are alike.
	•	XP / Damage Border
The world border expands whenever players gain XP or take damage. This creates a dynamic, progressing play area that changes as you play.
	•	Extreme Survival Modes
	•	One Heart: Survive with only a single heart.
	•	One Slot: You can only carry one inventory slot.
	•	One Hunger Bar: Play with a single hunger bar for a truly hardcore experience.
Combine them for the ultimate challenge!

Start or stop challenges easily:

/challenge start <name>
/challenge stop <name>

Each challenge can be toggled individually, letting you customize your server events, speedruns, or mini-games. Mix and match challenges for endless possibilities.

You can change the Timer Design with:
/challenge timerdesign (here the design)
You can turn the Timer on/off with:
/challenge timer on/off

This plugin offers ready-to-use challenges that keep your players entertained without complicated setups.
It’s lightweight, easy to install, and gives your server an edge with unique gameplay modes.

### 🚀 Perfect For
	•	Content creators wanting unique video ideas
	•	Server owners hosting events or competitions
	•	Friends who want to spice up their survival worlds

Bring chaos, fun, and unpredictability to Minecraft with FrediFrets Challenges Plugin!

# EN / English
Path Creator Datapack for Minecraft

Tired of complex systems for creating movement paths? This datapack provides a simple and powerful tool to create custom paths for any entity to follow. Perfect for mapmakers, adventure creators, and server owners!

✨ **Key Features**

 - 🎯 Easily define custom routes by placing points in your world

 - ➡️ Command any entity **(except players)** to follow your path smoothly

 - 👥 Works with multiple entities simultaneously

⁉️ **How to Use**

🎯 Create a new path

```
/function path:path/new {"name":"YOURNAME"}
```

Start creating and placing points for a new Path

🗑️ Delete a path

```
/function path:path/delete {"name":"NAME"}
```

Remove an existing path

▶️ Play a path on entities

```
/execute as <selector> run function path:path/play {"name":"YOURNAME","speed":"YOURSPEED"}
```

Start path playback on selected entities
**💡 Recommended speed: 0.23**

title: easyban
description: Simple Cloud Blacklist with No Setup
body:
Most cloud blacklist plugins suffer from these issues:

•  Complicated Audits: Shared blacklists are hard to verify and manage, making them a hassle to use.

•  Limited Coverage: Small databases miss troublemakers, leaving your server vulnerable.

•  Unfair Bans: False positives can kick innocent players, harming your server’s reputation.


EasyBan solves these with a simple, efficient approach:

•  Zero-Config Integration: Seamlessly syncs with Minecraft’s built-in ban system—no setup or auditing required.

•  Automatic Operation: Extracts and uploads ban data from your server automatically, no manual input needed.

•  Tiered Management: Warns for low-risk players and lets you set a custom kick threshold to avoid unfair bans.

Get Started in Three Steps
1.  Download the EasyBan plugin JAR.
2.  Place it in your server’s plugins folder.
3.  Restart your server—it runs automatically!
Optional: Adjust the kick threshold in config.yml (default: 2, any value ≥1).

description: Most blocks can be returned to their original state, like ore blocks. New items have also been added to make Minecraft even more convenient.
body:
ほとんどのブロックは、鉱石ブロックのように元のアイテムに戻すことができるようになります。
新しくボスが追加され、ボスのドロップ品でモブを従えれるようになります。

ブロックには、スライムブロックや鉱石ブロックのような元のアイテムに戻せるものがあります。
しかし、中にはクォーツブロックやグロウストーンのように元に戻すことのできないブロックもあります。
このmodでは、それらのブロックもアイテムに戻せるようにします。

modで追加されるアイテムは、いくつかの特殊能力を持っています。
支配の杖
・経験値を消費する代わりにモブを味方にできます
(必要な経験値の量はモブの残り体力が少ないほど少なくなりますが、アイテムのクールタイムが長くなります)

支配の笛
・右クリックで味方にしたモブを呼び寄せます
・モブを攻撃すると味方にしたモブが一緒に戦います

召喚の目
・右クリックでボスを召喚します(1%の確立で強化されたボスが出現)

影のランタン
・手に持つと近くのファントムがデスポーンします

兵の証
・装備をすると攻撃力上昇が付与され、近くのピグリンとピグリンブルートに弱体化を付与します。
・このアイテムは、ピグリンとピグリンブルートからのドロップで手に入ります。

歪んだシチュー
・食べると火炎耐性を付与しますが、ブロックの設置と破壊ができなくなり、GUIが開けなくなります

Most blocks can be converted back to their original items, such as ore blocks.
New bosses have been added, and you can now enslave mobs using boss drop items.

Some blocks, such as slime blocks and ore blocks, can be converted back to their original items.
However, there are also blocks that cannot be converted back, such as quartz blocks and glowstone.
This mod allows you to convert those blocks back into items as well.

Items added by the mod have several special abilities.
Staff of Domination
• Instead of consuming experience points, you can make mobs your allies.
(The amount of experience points required decreases as the mob's remaining health decreases, but the item's cooldown time increases.)

Flute of Domination
• Right-click to summon allied mobs.
• When you attack a mob, allied mobs will fight alongside you.

Summoning Eye
• Right-clicking summons a boss (there is a 1% chance that an enhanced boss will appear).

Shadow Lantern
• Holding it causes nearby phantoms to despawn.

Soldier's Proof
• Equipping it grants increased attack power and applies debuffs to nearby piglins and piglin brutes.
• This item can be obtained from Piglin and Piglin Brute drops.

Distorted Stew
• Eating it grants fire resistance, but prevents block placement and destruction, and closes the GUI.

All mod items are in Japanese.

title: SimpleGroupChat
description: Plugin that adds text group chats where groupmates can communicate through toggleable group mode
body:
# SimpleGroupChat
[GitHub](https://github.com/Megaboysin/SimpleGroupChat/tree/master) | Future Links will be placed here

This plugin is **NOT** associated with SimpleVoiceChat

This plugin is a logical continuation of [SimpleGlobChat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simpleglobalchat). So if you plan to use any global chat alongside this plugin, SimpleGlobChat is the best choice. However, it's not required.

This plugin enables the creation of text-based group chats in Minecraft, where only members can send and receive messages.

All images in Gallery were done in the same server (if important)

You can choose language in config. Supported languages are ru and eng.

I wrote this code according to my needs and added the most useful features in my opinion. If you think that plugin needs some features feel free to suggest!

# Commands and Features
<details>
<summary>Ghelp</summary>
Shows a list of all available commands
  
Usage: `/ghelp`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Gchat</summary>
Enables, disables, or checks the status of group chat. When enabled, your messages are sent only to your group.

Usage: `/gchat on|off|status`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Gcreate</summary>
Creates a new group with the specified name. You will automatically become the owner of the group.

Usage: `/gcreate <Group name>`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Glist</summary>
Displays a list of all existing groups on the server. Useful for discovering groups you might want to join.

Usage: `/glist`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Glistmembers</summary>
Displays a paginated list of all members in your current group. If the group has many members, use the page number to navigate through the list.

Usage: `/glistmembers [page]`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Grequest</summary>
Sends a join request to a specific group. The group's owner can then accept or deny it.

Usage: `/grequest <Group name>`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Gacceptrequest</summary>
Accepts a join request from a player. Use this if you're a group owner.

Usage: `/gacceptrequest <Player>`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Gdenyrequest</summary>
Denies a pending join request from a specific player. Use this if you're a group owner.

Usage: `/gdenyrequest <Player>`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Ginvite</summary>
Invites a player to join your group.

Usage: `/ginvite <Player>`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Gacceptinvite</summary>
Accepts a pending group invitation you've received from groups owner.

Usage: `/gacceptinvite <Groupname>`

Altenative usage: `/gacceptinvite <Owner's nickname>`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Gdenyinvite</summary>
Declines a group invitation you've received from groups owner.

Usage: `/gdenyinvite <Groupname>`

Altenative usage: `/gdenyinvite <Owner's nickname>`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Gkick</summary>
Removes a player from your group. Only the owner can use this command.

Usage: `/gkick <Player>`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Ginvites</summary>
Shows a list of all group invitations you’ve received but haven't responded to yet.

Usage: `/ginvites`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Gleave</summary>
Leaves the group you are currently a member of. You will lose access to its chat and privileges.

Usage: `/gleave`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Grequests</summary>
Displays all incoming join requests to your group. Only visible to group owners.

Usage: `/grequests`
</details>

<details>
<summary>Hex colors support</summary>
This plugin supports not only minecraft color code §0-f (&0-f too)

But hex colors too! (For example: &#7cdaf7)
</details>

# Configuration

Turn off if you will not use placeholderapi
```
use-placeholderapi: true
```

You can change it between eng and ru
```
#available variants: eng and ru, you can find them in lang foulder
language: "ru"
```

You can turn off or slightly change this template. (List is providen bellow)
```
group:
  #for eng verion use "§7[§7{group} &#00ffccGROUP§7]"
  #for ru version use "§7[&#00ffccГруппа §7{group}§7]"
  prefix: "§7[§7{group} &#00ffccGROUP§7]"
  placeholder-prefix: "%luckperms_prefix%"
  name-color: "&#00ffcc"
  receiver-color: "§7"
  message-color: "&#ffffff"
  world-prefix:
    enabled: false
    format: "§8[{world}]"
  msgformat: "{prefix} §r{placeholder-prefix}{name-color}{player} §7>> {message-color}{message}"
```

Here is list of things that you can change.
```
#Available placeholders for usage:
#"{world-color}"
#{world-prefix}"
#"{prefix}"
#{group}"
#{placeholder-prefix}"
#name-color}"
#{message-color}"
#{player}"
#{receiver-prefix}"
#{receiver-color}"
#{receiver}"
#{sender}"
#{message}"
#You can change their order anyway you want, write them in msgformat or delete, and write them into each other as shown in:
#prefix: "§7[§7{group} &#00ffccGROUP§7]"
#Here {group} is used in {prefix}
```

# Language settings
You can change messages if you want. They will be provided in folder lang.
You can find there ru.yml and eng.yml files.

This is messages that will be shown when you use commands.
```
messages:
```

This is info that will be shown when you use "/ghelp" command. (Not recommended to change)
```
commands:
```

Helpful info to maintain and change content of messages.
```
#  Colors:
# 0 Black                 8 dark gray
# 1 dark blue             9 light blue
# 2 dark green            a light green
# 3 dark cyan (бирюзовый) b light cyan (голубой)
# 4 dark red              c light red
# 5 purple                d magenta
# 6 dark yellow           e light yellow
# 7 light gray            f white
# you can use hex colors with this syntax: "&#ffffff"
#f.e: "&#f2e77ePlayer not found."
```

# Compatibility with other plugins

If player have [LuckPerms](https://modrinth.com/plugin/luckperms) prefix and [PlaceholderAPI](https://github.com/PlaceholderAPI) is installed on server, it can be showed in chat.

If you want to use Global chat, it is highly recomended to use [SimpleGlobalChat
](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simpleglobalchat).

description: QuestionAndAnswer is a unique mod for Minecraft (Fabric) that turns your server into an intelligent game show! The mod is perfect for parties, streams, educational projects and just fun gatherings with friends.
body:
If you don't understand how the mod works, go to the **[WIKI](https://t.me/zdev_wiki/5)**

Main functions

- **Quiz with automatic construction:** Players answer questions, and their bridges are built according to the letters of the answer.
- **Flexible setup:** Everything from questions to effects and messages can be configured in a single file.
- **Continuation of construction:** Bridges continue to be built from where they left off until the round is stopped.
- **Reset progress:** Bridges and positions are reset only when the round is stopped or completely cleared.
- **Supports up to 4 players simultaneously** (can be expanded if necessary).

 How to set up

1. **Install the mod** as a regular Fabric mod (place the jar file in the mods folder).
2. **Configure the `config.json` file:**
- Add your questions to the `"questions"` array.
   - Specify the starting positions of the players in the "startPositions".
   - Customize bridge blocks, effects, messages and other parameters to your liking.
3. **Start the server or a single player game with Fabric.**
4. **Use the commands:**
- `/setpos` — each player must set his starting position.
   - `/question [question]` — the moderator asks a question.
   - `/stopround' — stop the round and reset the bridges.

**Download the mod, set up questions and arrange a real intellectual show right in Minecraft!**

Spvelocity — a Paper / Spigot plugin that **downloads and launches a Velocity proxy**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-blue) ![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-1.21.x-green) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-lightgrey)

---

## What is it?

Spvelocity is a Paper / Spigot plugin that automatically:

1. Downloads a Velocity jar from a given URL  
2. Starts Velocity in a separate process  
3. Lets you control it in-game / from console with `/proxy start|stop|status`

Perfect for quick network testing, CI pipelines, or ad-hoc test servers.

---

## Features

* **Auto-download** of `velocity.jar` on the very first `/proxy start`
* Works on Paper / Spigot 1.12 – latest (built against the 1.21.4 API)
* Requires only Java 11+, recommended Java 17 or 21
* Runs in a background thread – won’t block the main server
* Stops Velocity automatically when the Paper server stops
* Simple configuration via `plugins/Spvelocity/config.yml`

---

## Requirements

* A Paper or Spigot server  
  (1.12 – latest, built against Paper-1.21.4)  
* Java 11 or newer (Velocity itself needs 11+)  
* Internet access the first time you run `/proxy start` (to download Velocity)

---

## Getting started (pre-built jar)

1. Download `spvelocity-<version>-shaded.jar` from the Releases page  
2. Drop it into `<server>/plugins`  
3. Start your Paper / Spigot server with **Java 17 / 21** etc.  
4. Run in-game or in console:
   ```text
   /proxy start
   ```  
   → `velocity.jar` is downloaded to `plugins/Spvelocity/proxy/` and booted on port 25577

---

## Building from source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/<YOUR-USER>/spvelocity.git
cd spvelocity
mvn clean package    # produces target/spvelocity-*-shaded.jar
```

---

## Configuration — `config.yml`

```yml
velocity:
  download-url: "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/velocity/versions/3.3.0-SNAPSHOT/builds/261/downloads/velocity-3.3.0-SNAPSHOT-261.jar"
  jar-name: "velocity.jar"
  port: 25577
```

* Copy the download URL from PaperMC’s downloads page:  
  <https://papermc.io/downloads#Velocity>  
* Stable versions (`3.2.0`, etc.) keep the same URL.  
* For SNAPSHOTs you may want a script that queries the API for the latest build or update the URL manually.

---

## Commands & permissions

| Command            | Description                         | Permission              | Default |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------|-------------------------|---------|
| `/proxy start`     | Download & start Velocity           | `spvelocity.command`    | OP      |
| `/proxy stop`      | Stop the running Velocity instance  | `spvelocity.command`    | OP      |
| `/proxy status`    | Show proxy status                   | `spvelocity.command`    | OP      |

---

## How it works

1. `SpvelocityManager` checks whether `plugins/Spvelocity/proxy/velocity.jar` exists  
2. If not, it downloads it via **Apache Commons IO** from the configured URL  
3. Runs `java -jar velocity.jar --port <port>` through **ProcessBuilder**  
4. Redirects proxy output to the Paper console  
5. When the Paper server shuts down, the child process is destroyed via `destroy()`

---

## 🗑️ BinSlot – Crafting Table With Automatic Trash Slot

**BinSlot** is a Minecraft mod that adds a custom crafting table featuring a special "bin slot". This slot automatically handles leftover items produced during crafting, helping reduce inventory clutter.

### 🔍 How It Works

When crafting recipes that generate extra items (like empty buckets or bottles), BinSlot will attempt to return them to your inventory. If there's no available space, those items will be discarded automatically using the bin slot.

This behavior mimics the crafting logic of vanilla Minecraft, but improves usability for players who craft large amounts of items or play with recipe-heavy modpacks.

### 🧰 Features

- A custom crafting table with a standard 3x3 grid
- An extra output slot for handling recipe results
- Automatic cleanup of leftover items (e.g. buckets, bottles)
- Supports all vanilla Minecraft recipes
- Helps avoid manual inventory management during crafting

### 🛠 Requirements

- Minecraft Java 1.21.3
- Forge 53.1

### 📌 Notes

- The mod uses Minecraft's standard recipe system.
- It does not require any other mods to function.
- BinSlot is a lightweight quality-of-life addition, especially useful in survival and modded environments.

### 🔧 Future Plans

Planned features may include:
- Customization options for trash behavior
- Compatibility with other mods
- Integration with recipe automation tools

# skLib

**skLib** is a library designed to make it easier for developers to build Minecraft plugins. It provides a set of utility functions and classes that simplify common coding tasks, streamlining plugin development and reducing boilerplate code.
⚠️ skLib is NOT compatible with Spigot servers ⚠️

## Features

- Easy-to-use utility methods for common tasks.
- Provides robust and reusable functions for handling data structures, file I/O, and more.
- Designed to be lightweight and efficient, without unnecessary dependencies.
- Aims to improve code readability and reduce development time.

## Installation

To add **skLib** to your Minecraft plugin project, include it as a dependency in your `build.gradle` file:

```gradle
maven {
    url 'https://jitpack.io'
}
```

```gradle
dependencies {
    implementation 'com.github.lmaoskript:skLib:<version>'
}
```

Replace `<version>` with the version you want to use.

skLib is not affiliated with SkriptLang or any Skript addon.

# 🌻 PlacementPlugin 🌻

> **An intuitive building tool for Paper/Spigot 1.20+ that lets you place blocks creatively through a configurable GUI and a special “Placeler” wand – no WorldEdit required.**

---

### ✨ Features

- **GUI Selection** — `/farmplace` opens an inventory GUI with configurable blocks, plants, and water‑/lava‑source items.
- **Placeler Wand**
  - **Right‑click**: places blocks with `physics=false`; water/lava stay static.
  - **Left‑click**: re‑opens the GUI.
- **Radius Mode** — `/pradius <1‑20>`
  - *1* = single block
  - *>1* = square area of `(2r + 1) × (2r + 1)` blocks.
- **Undo & Redo** — `/plundo` & `/plredo` roll back or restore multiple steps (stack‑based).
- **Color‑coded Items & Flexible Config** — GUI titles and item labels accept Minecraft color codes (`&aGrass`). All materials, GUI size, defaults, and permissions live in `config.yml`.

---

### 🛠 Installation

1. Drop the **JAR** into your `plugins` folder.
2. Restart the server *or* run:
   ```bash
   /reload confirm
   ```
3. Adjust `plugins/PlacementPlugin/config.yml` as needed and restart again.

---

### 💻 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/farmplace` | Open the build GUI |
| `/pc` | Clear the current Placeler wand |
| `/pradius <n>` | Set placement radius (1 – 20) |
| `/plundo` | Undo last placement |
| `/plredo` | Redo last undo |

---

### 🔐 Permissions

| Node | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `farmplace.use` | Open GUI |
| `farmplace.clear` | Clear wand |
| `farmplace.radius` | Change radius |
| `farmplace.undo` | Run undo |
| `farmplace.redo` | Run redo |

---

title: Amnesia
description: have you ever wondered what would happen if steve stopped taking his meds?
body:
# Amnesia
![banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/modpotato-plugins/Amnesia/refs/heads/main/banner/banner.webp)
Amnesia is a highly configurable Minecraft plugin for PaperMC and Folia servers that shuffles crafting recipes. It offers two distinct shuffling modes: random item replacement and recipe result swapping.

## Features

- **Recipe Shuffling:** Two modes of recipe manipulation:
  - **Random Item Mode:** Recipe outputs are replaced with random items from the Minecraft item registry.
  - **Recipe Result Shuffle Mode:** Recipe outputs are shuffled amongst existing recipes.
- **Timer-Based Reshuffling:** Automatic reshuffling of recipes at configurable intervals with countdown notifications.
- **Seed-Based Rotations:** Ability to use seeds to generate and recall specific recipe shuffles.
- **Cross-Restart Synchronization:** Recipe shuffle state and timer settings persist across server restarts.
- **Client Recipe Synchronization:** Control how clients handle recipe changes with three different modes.
- **Command-Line Interface:** Comprehensive commands for managing shuffling, timer, seed, and configuration.
- **Configuration File:** YAML based configuration for persistent settings and customization.
- **Performance Focused:** Designed for minimal server impact, especially on Folia servers.
- **User Notifications:** Clear and informative messages to players about upcoming and executed recipe shuffles.

## Commands

- `/amnesia shuffle [mode] [seed <value>|random]` - Shuffles recipes using the specified mode and optionally a seed.
- `/amnesia timer [enable|disable|interval <seconds>]` - Manages the timer-based reshuffling.
- `/amnesia seed [view|set <seed>|random]` - Manages the shuffle seed.
- `/amnesia reload` - Reloads the plugin configuration.

## Permissions

- `amnesia.command.shuffle` - Allows use of `/amnesia shuffle` command.
- `amnesia.command.timer` - Allows use of `/amnesia timer` command.
- `amnesia.command.seed` - Allows use of `/amnesia seed` command.
- `amnesia.command.reload` - Allows use of `/amnesia reload` command.

## Configuration

The plugin uses a `config.yml` file for configuration settings and a `data.yml` file for persistent data. Here's an example configuration:

```yaml
# Shuffle mode: "random_item" or "recipe_result"
shuffle-mode: "random_item"

# Timer interval in seconds (default: 3600 - 1 hour)
timer-interval: 3600

# Whether the timer-based reshuffling is enabled by default
timer-enabled: false

# Client recipe synchronization mode:
# "resync" - Clients will be resynced with the new recipes (default)
# "clear" - Clients won't get any recipes
# "vanilla" - Don't touch client recipes and let Minecraft handle it
client-sync-mode: "vanilla"

# List of recipe keys to exclude from shuffling
excluded-recipes:
  # - "minecraft:stick"

# List of item keys to exclude from being selected in random_item shuffle mode
excluded-random-items:
  - "minecraft:air"
  - "minecraft:barrier"
  # ... more items

# Countdown intervals (in seconds) for timer notifications
notification-intervals:
  - 300 # 5 minutes
  - 60  # 1 minute
  - 30  # 30 seconds
  # ... more intervals

# Customizable notification messages
notification-messages:
  countdown-5-minutes: "<gold>5 minutes until recipes are shuffled!</gold>"
  # ... more messages
```

The `data.yml` file stores persistent data such as:

```yaml
# The seed used for recipe shuffling
seed: 123456789

# Whether the seed was set by the user (true) or generated randomly (false)
user-set-seed: false

# Whether recipes are currently shuffled
is-shuffled: false

# When recipes were last shuffled (milliseconds since epoch)
last-shuffle-time: 0
```

## Installation

1. Download the latest release from the releases page.
2. Place the JAR file in your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Start or restart your server.
4. Configure the plugin by editing the `config.yml` file in the `plugins/Amnesia` folder.

## Support

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please open an issue on the GitHub repository.

# **"Maybe In a New Life" - Advanced Minecraft Mod for Chat Moderation (1.21.x)**

## Overview

"Maybe In a New Life" is an advanced chat moderation Minecraft mod designed for version 1.21.x that aims to enhance player experience by ensuring safe and respectful communication within Minecraft servers. This mod uses a sophisticated API to automatically detect inappropriate, offensive, or harmful language in chat messages. With this mod installed, servers can automatically moderate player interactions by issuing warnings, enforcing a three-strike system, and utilizing a global messaging feature to ensure accountability.

## Features

### **1. Advanced Chat Filtering API**

The mod integrates a state-of-the-art API capable of detecting various types of harmful behavior in player chat. The API checks messages in real-time, analyzing their content for:

- **Offensive Language**: Includes but not limited to profanity, slurs, and abusive terms.
- **Spam**: Repeated phrases, excessive capitalization, and flood-like messages.
- **Harassment**: Aggressive or intimidating language targeting specific players or groups.
- **Toxicity**: Negative or harmful language meant to provoke, belittle, or upset others.
- **Expletives**: Automatically detects curse words or abusive phrases.
  
The API is updated regularly to adapt to new slang, toxic language trends, and emerging types of harmful behavior, ensuring up-to-date protection against inappropriate messages.

### **2. Warning System**

Upon detecting an offensive message, the mod issues a **warning** to the offending player. This serves as a first step in the disciplinary process. Players who are warned will receive a message in their chat stating that their behavior has been flagged as inappropriate. The warning includes helpful guidelines for players to avoid future infractions.

#### Warning Details:
- **First Warning**: The player receives a warning, but no in-game action is taken. The message is clear: "Warning: Your message contained inappropriate content. Please adhere to server rules."
- **Second Warning**: A second warning is issued for further inappropriate messages. 
- **Third Warning**: If the player violates the rules again, the mod triggers a penalty—**Player Death**.

### **3. Strike System: The Death Penalty**

To enforce the rules, the mod introduces a **three-strike system**, where players face more severe penalties after accumulating multiple warnings. On the third infraction, the mod automatically **kills** the offending player and issues a **global broadcast message** visible to everyone on the server.

#### The Death Penalty:
- **Strike 3 (Player Death)**: Upon the third warning, the player is killed by the server. The death is not simply a casual event—it's a system-enforced action intended to highlight the severity of violating community standards.
- **Global Broadcast**: A message is broadcast to all players on the server, notifying them of the player's death and the reason behind it. This serves as a public reminder of the server's commitment to maintaining a respectful environment.

### **4. Global Message Broadcast**

The mod includes a global messaging feature that ensures all server players are aware of repeated offenses. This adds a level of visibility to prevent toxic behavior from going unnoticed by the broader community. The broadcast system serves as both a reminder to players to follow the rules and a tool for community accountability.

#### Global Message Examples:
- **"<player> was removed for using inappropiate language. "**
- **"Maybe In a New Life they'll learn to be kinder."**

  
### **5. Configurable Permissions**

The mod supports various permissions for server moderators and admins, allowing them to have more control over the moderation process. Admins can easily:

- **View Warning Logs**: Access logs of previous warnings, penalties, and death broadcasts.
- **Manually Reset Warnings**: Reset player warning counters if needed (e.g., for server resets or player appeals).
- **Override Automatic Actions**: Manually override the automatic punishment system in case of special circumstances.

### **6. Lightweight and Performance-Friendly**

Despite its advanced functionality, "Maybe In a New Life" is optimized for performance. The mod runs smoothly even on large servers with many players, ensuring that chat moderation does not slow down the gameplay experience. The real-time detection and processing are designed to minimize lag or delays in message filtering.

### **7. Compatibility**

This mod is designed to be fully compatible with Minecraft version 1.21.x and can be installed on server-side clients.

## Conclusion

"Maybe In a New Life" is the ultimate solution for server owners looking to maintain a friendly, welcoming, and respectful environment in their Minecraft communities. Its advanced chat moderation system, configurable features, and real-time message filtering make it an essential tool for administrators. By implementing this mod, server owners can significantly reduce toxicity and ensure a positive experience for all players.
