title: BasaltWalker Reborn
description: New enchantment allows you to walk on lava.
body:
# BasaltWalkerReborn

A simple Minecraft mod that adds a new "Basalt Walker" enchantment, allowing you to (briefly) walk on lava.

## 📜 Introduction

Ever wished you could walk on lava just like Frost Walker lets you walk on water? This mod introduces a new boot enchantment, **Basalt Walker**, to do just that.

When you walk near lava while wearing enchanted boots, the lava beneath your feet will turn into temporary "Soft Basalt" blocks, creating a safe path for you.

## ✨ Features

### Enchantment: Basalt Walker

* **Name:** Basalt Walker
* **Applies to:** Boots only.
* **Max Level:** 2.
* **Effect:**
    * Converts lava blocks at the player's feet and in the surrounding area into "Soft Basalt" blocks.
    * **Level I:** Conversion radius is approximately 3 blocks.
    * **Level II:** Conversion radius is approximately 4 blocks (Radius = 2 + Enchantment Level).
* **How to get:** By default, this is a **Treasure Enchantment**. This means you cannot get it from an Enchanting Table. Instead, you must find it as an enchanted book in loot chests, from fishing, or by trading with villagers.

### Block: Soft Basalt

* **Name:** Soft Basalt
* **Temporary Block:** This block is temporary. It will begin to melt a short time after being created (after 60-120 ticks).
* **Melting Stages:** Soft Basalt has 4 melting stages (a `melt` value from 0 to 3), appearing more cracked as it decays.
* **Final Form:**
    * In hot dimensions (like The Nether), it will melt back into a **Lava** block.
    * In other dimensions (like The Overworld), it will melt and disappear (turning into **Air**).

## 🔧 Configuration

You can find the mod's configuration file (`basaltwalker-common.toml`) in your `config` folder.

* `treasure` (Default: `true`)
    * Controls whether the "Basalt Walker" enchantment is a treasure enchantment.
    * If you set this to `false`, you will be able to obtain the enchantment from a regular Enchanting Table.

## 💡 Inspiration
This project is a remake of the original "Basalt Walker" mod.

Original Author: [Hashtag233](https://github.com/Hashtag233/basalt-walker)

title: WanderingTraderAlert
description: This plugin send a message to the chat when a trader spawns
body:
# WanderingTraderAlert

A lightweight Paper plugin that broadcasts **Wandering Trader** spawns, shows **live coordinates**, adds a **direct Teleport button**, includes a configurable **despawn ETA**, and rates each trader's offers with a **custom star rating**.

---

## Features
- **Global spawn broadcast** when a Wandering Trader appears.
- **Despawn message as broadcast**
- **Nearest player** info (with distance in blocks).
- **[Show Coordinates]** → prints *current* position (auto-updates while the trader moves).
- **[Teleport]** button (runs immediately if you have permission).
- **Despawn ETA**: shows `(~MM:SS left)` based on loaded time (configurable).
- **Custom rating (★)** of offers via configurable item weights.
- **Config file** (`config.yml`) for messages, timing, rating weights, etc.
- **Reload command**: `/traderalert reload`

---

##  Commands
- `/tradercoords <uuid>` — show live coordinates (+ ETA & rating).
- `/traderteleport <uuid>` — teleport to the trader (instant).
- `/traderalert reload` — reload the config.

###  Permissions
- `traderalert.use` — use Show Coordinates *(default: true)*
- `traderalert.teleport` — use Teleport button / command *(default: op)*
- `traderalert.admin` — `/traderalert reload` *(default: op)*

---

##  Configuration (`config.yml`)
```yaml
despawn_millis: 2400000       # 40 minutes loaded time
update_period_ticks: 40       # update every ~2s

rating:
  enabled: true
  weights:
    NAUTILUS_SHELL: 5
    CORAL_BLOCK: 4
    MOSS_BLOCK: 3
    DRIPSTONE_BLOCK: 3
    PACKED_ICE: 2
    PODZOL: 2
    GLOW_BERRIES: 1
    SAND: 1
    DYE: 1

messages:
  spawn_title: "A Wandering Trader spawned!"
  closest_fmt: "The Wandering Trader is closest to {player} ({blocks} blocks)"
  no_players: "No players in the same world."
  click_show: "[Show Coordinates]"
  coords_fmt: "Wandering Trader @ {world}: x={x}, y={y}, z={z}"
  remaining_fmt: " (~{mm}:{ss} left)"
  rating_fmt: " [Rating: {stars}]"
  teleport_btn: "[Teleport]"
  no_perm_tp: "[Teleport]"
  no_perm_hover: "No permission. Ask an admin."
  teleport_hover: "Click to teleport"
  despawned: "A Wandering Trader despawned."
  reloaded: "WanderingTraderAlert config reloaded."
```

---

##  Installation
1. Download the latest JAR.
2. Drop it into your server's `plugins/` folder.
3. Start the server (first run will generate `config.yml`).

---

##  FAQ
**Q:** Does the Wandering Trader have levels?  
**A:** No — unlike villagers, Wandering Traders don't level up. The plugin provides a *custom* star rating based on the trades it spawns with.

**Q:** What if a trader unloads?  
**A:** Despawn ETA counts *loaded* time only. When the entity unloads, the timer pauses.

**Q:** Can I change messages/timings?  
**A:** Yes, everything lives in `config.yml`. Use `/traderalert reload` to apply changes.

---

##  Compatibility
- Paper 1.21.x. Other forks may work but aren't officially supported.

---

##  Changelog
- **1.1.0** — Config, reload, tab-completion, ETA & rating, instant TP button.
- **1.0.1** — Live updates, despawn broadcast, teleport command.
- **1.0.0** — Initial release (spawn broadcast, clickable coords, nearest player).

description: Add fake items and blocks into the Minecraft.
body:
该模组添加了可以伪装成其他物品或方块的 Meme 类型的物品和方块，已在 GitHub 开源。

你可以使用指令 /give-fake <item> (count) (damage) (player(s)) 或  /give <player(s)> <item>{fake_item:<item>} (count) 来生成伪装成指定物品的物品。
伪装成指定物品的假物品最大耐久值和物品堆叠上限，攻击动画等属性皆与伪装的物品相同，但是假物品不可使用，其实际攻击伤害为 0，挖掘速度为 1.0，而非物品提示框上所显示的数值。
当假物品被穿戴在玩家身上时，也并不会提供实际盔甲值，盔甲韧性等属性。
当假物品被伪装的物品为方块时，被放置的方块将自动变成假方块，假方块无掉落物，其硬度与 石头 相同。
提示：
1. 假物品并不会掉耐久，你可以通过这个方法来分辨指定物品是否为假物品；
2. 假方块将会在游戏存档被关闭时移除；
3. 图片内展示的物品皆为假物品.

This mod adds meme-type items and blocks that can be disguised as other items or blocks and has been open-sourced on GitHub.

You can use the commands /give fake <item> (count) (damage) (player(s)) or /give <player(s)> <item>{fake_item:<item>} (count) Generate items that disguise themselves as the specified items.
The maximum durability value, item stacking limit, attack animation and other attributes of the fake item disguised as the designated item are all the same as those of the disguised item. However, the fake item cannot be used. Its actual attack damage is 0 and the digging speed is 1.0, rather than the values displayed on the item prompt box.
When fake items are worn by players, they do not provide actual armor values, armor resilience and other attributes.
When the fake item is disguised as a block, the placed block will automatically become a fake block. The fake block has no dropped items and its hardness is the same as that of a stone.
Hint
1. Fake items do not lose durability. You can use this way to distinguish whether a specified item is a fake one.
2. False blocks will be removed when the game save is closed.
3. All the items shown in the gallery are fake.

I can't upload the fake things 1.2 version. You can download this version on the Github Releases.

# McAntiVPN

**McAntiVPN** is a plugin that protects your server against players using a VPN.  
It uses the Proxy & VPN detection API: [IPHub.info](https://iphub.info).  

⚠️ To use it, you must create an account on the website and get an **API key**.  
- The free plan allows **1000 requests/day**.  
- The plugin avoids multiple requests on the same IP, so this limit should be enough.  

---

## 🔗 Contribute
➡️ GitHub Repository: [TwitmundDev/McAntiVPN](https://github.com/TwitmundDev/McAntiVPN)  

## 🐞 Report an Issue
➡️ Issues: [Issues · TwitmundDev/McAntiVPN](https://github.com/TwitmundDev/McAntiVPN/issues)  

---

## ⚠️ Important
**Do not touch the `savedIps.json` file!**  
Any modification will **delete your data**.  
I will not be responsible for any data loss.  

---

## ⚙️ Configuration
The plugin has a `config.yml` file so you can customize it.  
You can use the `&` character to add colors in your messages.  

Available options:  

- **KickMessage**: The message shown when a player is kicked for using a VPN.  
- **CommandPermission**: Permission required to use the `/showiplist` command.  
- **PermissionNotify**: Permission needed to receive a notification when a player tries to connect with a VPN.  
- **DontHavePermissionMessage**: Message shown if a player does not have permission.  
- **PlayerWithVPNTriedToConnect**: Notification message when a player with a VPN tries to connect.  
- **API_KEY**: Your IPHub API key (get it from their website).  

---

# LiveMusicalInstruments

## About
Minecraft plugin that lets you play electronic instruments live and broadcast the performance to players in real time.

**Note**:

This plugin is **not intended for most shared Minecraft hosting providers** and may require some basic computer skills (running a Python script, configuring your router, editing a JSON file).

The plugin, originally developed for personal use, is now public and configurable for your own equipment (currently only drums are supported) and your own audio kit.  
Some latency may occur between playing and hearing the audio, due to the transfer of information from your electronic device to the Minecraft server.

Since Minecraft doesn't allow audio streaming, **MIDI is used instead**, combined with an audio kit inside a resource pack (a default drum kit is already included).

Future updates may include support for additional instruments if requested by users.

## Download
`LiveMusicalInstruments.jar` plugin [[Download on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/live-musical-instruments)] [[Download on GitHub](https://github.com/TheoDgb/LiveMusicalInstruments/releases/tag/v1.0.0)]

To work properly, this plugin requires:
- A `LiveMusicalInstrumentsPack.zip` server resource pack [[Download](https://github.com/TheoDgb/LiveMusicalInstruments/releases/download/v1.0.0/LiveMusicalInstrumentsPack.zip)]
- A first `ListDevices.py` script to detect the exact name of your MIDI-connected module [[Download](https://github.com/TheoDgb/LiveMusicalInstruments/releases/download/v1.0.0/ListDevices.py)]
- A second `LiveMidiToMinecraft.py` script to capture and send MIDI data to the plugin (tested on Windows 10) [[Download](https://github.com/TheoDgb/LiveMusicalInstruments/releases/download/v1.0.0/LiveMidiToMinecraft.py)]
- Python to run both scripts [[Download](https://www.python.org/downloads/)]

## Installation
The plugin opens a **Web Socket server** to receive MIDI data from the script. You'll therefore need to configure your router to create a **NAT/PAT FTP Data rule** on port **3000 TCP**.

1. Connect your device to your PC via MIDI.
2. Run the script `ListDevices.py` to check if your device is detected and to get its exact name.
3. On your router, create a NAT/PAT FTP Data rule for port 3000 TCP.
4. Open the script `LiveMidiToMinecraft.py` in a text editor and configure the following:
    - The public IP of your Minecraft server with `:3000`
    - Your Minecraft username (so the sound propagates from your player in-game)
    - The name of your MIDI device retrieved in step 2
    > By default, the plugin is configured for an Alesis Crimson II drum kit. You can configure your own device by editing `ǸOTE_MAP` (only modify the numbers, not the names). Other parameters can also be customized if needed.
5. Install the `LiveMusicalInstruments.jar` into the `plugins` folder of your Minecraft server and start your server once to generate the config file in `plugins/LiveMusicalInstruments/`.  
Edit if needed (restart the server after changes).
6. Download the `LiveMusicalInstrumentsPack.zip` resource pack in your `.minecraft/resourcepacks/` folder.  
There is already a default kit but,  
For custom kits:
    - In your resource pack, under `assets/minecraft/sounds/drums/`, create your own folder following the same structure and naming convention as `drum_kit_default`.
    - Then, in `assets/minecraft/sounds.json`, add your custom audio files by following the `drum_kit_default` example.
    - Configure your custom kit in `config.yml`.
7. Run in Minecraft `/live start drums`, then launch `LiveMidiToMinecraft.py`.  
A message should appear in Minecraft chat confirming that you are connected and ready to play.  
(All players must have the resource pack installed in order to hear you perform.)  
`/live stop drums` to stop.

If an error appears indicating that the WebSocket server is still running, restart the server and close the WebSocket properly.

title: LagSpike Guardian
description: Your Server's Silent Protector.
body:
# LagSpike Guardian
### Your All-in-One Solution for Server Stability
---
As a developer and server enthusiast, I know the biggest challenge for any server owner is lag. It can come from anywhere—a forgotten mob farm, a massive item spill, or a broken redstone machine. I created **LagSpike Guardian** to be a smarter, all-in-one solution. Instead of just blindly clearing entities, this plugin actively monitors your server's health and provides you with the tools to both automatically prevent lag and diagnose it yourself. It's powerful, lightweight, and designed to give you peace of mind.

---
### ⭐ Features
- ✅ **Automatic TPS Monitoring:** Intelligently clears entities only when your server's TPS drops below a configured threshold, preventing lag without disrupting gameplay.
- ✅ **Scheduled Item Sweeper:** Proactively cleans up dropped items on a timer, with configurable warnings and a protected-item list so valuable gear is never deleted.
- ✅ **Smart Redstone Limiter:** Detects and temporarily disables hyperactive redstone clocks that cause server lag, with whitelisted worlds to protect player builds.
- ✅ **Powerful Diagnostic Tools:** Use `/lagspike topchunks` to instantly find the 5 laggiest chunks on your server, helping you pinpoint the exact source of entity-based lag.
- ✅ **Full Admin Control:** Manually clear items or mobs on demand, and reload the entire plugin configuration without a server restart using `/lagspike reload`.
- ✅ **100% Configurable:** Every message, color, timer, and setting can be changed in the `config.yml`.
- ✅ **User-Friendly Commands:** All commands feature full tab-completion for ease of use.

---
### 📙 Commands & Permissions
| Command | Permission | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/lagspike status` | *(none)* | Shows the server's current TPS, entities, and memory. |
| `/lagspike reload` | `lagspike.admin` | Reloads the entire plugin configuration. |
| `/lagspike clear <items\|mobs>` | `lagspike.clear` | Manually clears all items or configured mobs. |
| `/lagspike topchunks` | `lagspike.diagnostics` | Shows the top 5 chunks with the most entities. |

*(All permissions default to OP)*

---
### ⚙️ Default Configuration
This plugin is fully customizable. See how much control you have by viewing the default `config.yml` below.

<details>
<summary>Click to view the default config.yml</summary>

```yaml
# LagSpike Guardian Configuration
tps-threshold: 18.5

entity-clearing:
  mobs-to-clear:
    - ZOMBIE
    - SKELETON
    - SPIDER
    - CREEPER
    - PHANTOM
    - CHICKEN
    - COW

item-clearing:
  enabled: true
  clear-interval-minutes: 15
  warning-times-seconds:
    - 60
    - 30
    - 10
  dont-clear-items:
    - DIAMOND
    - DIAMOND_BLOCK
    - NETHERITE_INGOT
    - NETHERITE_BLOCK
    - BEACON
    - ELYTRA

redstone-limiter:
  enabled: true
  pulse-threshold-per-second: 15
  disabled-worlds:
    - "skyblock_world"
    - "creative"
  disable-duration-seconds: 30

messages:
  prefix: "&8[&cGuardian&8] "
  no-permission: "&cYou do not have permission to use this command."
  reload-success: "&aLagSpike Guardian configuration reloaded!"
  unknown-command: "&cUnknown sub-command. Use /lagspike status, reload, clear, or topchunks."
  
  status-header: "&8--- &6LagSpike Guardian Status &8---"
  status-tps: "&eTPS: &a%tps%"
  status-entities: "&eTotal Entities: &a%amount%"
  status-memory: "&eMemory Usage: &a%used%MB / %max%MB"
  
  entity-clear-broadcast: "&eCleared %amount% entities to improve server health."
  
  item-clear-warning: "&eClearing ground items in %time% seconds!"
  item-clear-broadcast: "&aCleared %amount% ground items."

  topchunks-header: "&8--- &6Top 5 Laggiest Chunks &8---"
  topchunks-format: "&e%rank%. &bWorld&f: %world% &bX&f: %x% &bZ&f: %z% &8- &a%amount% entities"
  topchunks-calculating: "&eCalculating, please wait..."
  
  manual-clear-items: "&aSuccessfully cleared %amount% items."
  manual-clear-mobs: "&aSuccessfully cleared %amount% mobs."

description: A mod that adds a ton of stuff that has to do with "cringe".
body:
Summary
----------------------------------------------------
**This mod adds some stuff that has to do with "cringe".**

Documentation
------------------------------------------------------
**CringeCraft** is a Forge-only Minecraft mod that adds a collection of highly cursed and questionably powerful cringe-themed items and mechanics to your world. The core of the mod revolves around the concept of **“cringe”** as an energy source, a damage type, and a lifestyle. It introduces the **Orb of Cringe**, a _mystical_ item that radiates pure secondhand embarrassment, often accompanied by sparkly particles and regret. There’s also the **Orb of Immunity**, a _sacred_ relic that protects its bearer from **cringe-based** attacks and awkward social encounters. The mod features a custom damage type called Cringe Damage, which bypasses armor and affects entities on a spiritual level—unless, of course, they are holding the Orb of Immunity or have an unshakable sense of self-worth. To weaponize the cringe, players can use the Cringe Launcher, a janky yet powerful device that fires Cringe Projectiles. These projectiles deal Cringe Damage and may cause the target to suffer from a fictional status effect known as Cringe, which makes them behave erratically while questioning their life choices. The Cringe Launcher requires cringe essence (or any custom ammo you define) and the Orb of Cringe to craft. The mod is currently in development for Forge and is only compatible with Forge-based setups for now. CringeCraft is ideal for players who want to add a layer of chaotic humor to their Minecraft world, troll their friends with awkward energy blasts, or simply roleplay as the embodiment of “why did I do that.” Warning: may cause flashbacks to middle school behavior, and should be used responsibly by those prepared to embrace their inner cringe.

title: conduitfly
description: Conduitfly lets players fly within a set radius around a placed conduit block on BentoBox islands.
body:
# ConduitFly

**ConduitFly** is a Minecraft plugin designed for BentoBox -based skyblock servers. It allows players to place customizable **Conduit blocks** on their island to grant **temporary flight** in a configurable radius. Flight duration, area, and fall-damage protection are all customizable based on the player's **rank**.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🔗 **BentoBox integration**: Flight is managed per-island
- 🌀 **Placeable Conduit blocks** to grant flight in range
- 💸 **Rank system**: Players can upgrade ranks with Vault economy
- 🎯 **Visual particle area indicator**
- 🔧 Fully configurable via **YAML**
- 💾 Supports both **SQLite** and **MySQL**
- 🔄 `/conduitfly reload` to hot-reload changes
- 🖱️ Paginated **GUI menus** for rank interaction

---

## 🔧 Dependencies

| Dependency   | Purpose                                   |
|--------------|-------------------------------------------|
| BentoBox     | Island data access (currently required due to storage logic; may become a soft-depend in future versions) |
| Vault        | Economy integration                       |
| Economy plugin | (EssentialsX, CMI, etc.)                |

> The plugin will not load if required dependencies are missing.

---

## 💻 Installation

1. Drop `ConduitFly.jar` into your `plugins/` directory.
2. Start the server. The following files will be created:
   - `config.yml`
3. Adjust settings to your needs.
4. Use `/conduitfly reload` to apply changes without restarting.

---

## 🏆 Rank System

Players can open a GUI with `/conduitfly rankup` to view and upgrade their rank. Each rank defines:

- ✈️ **Flight duration** (in seconds)
- 🌀 **Conduit radius**
- 🛡️ Optional **fall damage prevention**
- 💰 **Upgrade cost**

---

## 🛠️ Commands

| Command               | Description                                       |
|-----------------------|---------------------------------------------------|
| `/conduitfly reload`  | Reload the configuration                         |
| `/conduitfly rankup`  | Open the GUI to view/upgrade ranks               |
| `/conduitfly area`    | Visually display the conduit’s active range      |

---

## 🧩 Support & Contribution

Found a bug, have a feature request, or just want to contribute?

📬 [Open an issue or pull request on GitHub](https://github.com/ogsammaenr/ConduitFly/issues)

We welcome all feedback and contributions!

## 📁 Config Overview

- `conduit.material`: Which block grants flight (default: `CONDUIT`)
- `ranks`: Defines each rank’s properties
- `particles`: Visual effect shown within conduit area
- `storage`: Choose between `sqlite` or `mysql`
- `rank-gui`: Customize GUI layout and icons

See the `config.yml` for full documentation.

---

## ⚙️ Storage Options

| Type    | Description                                  |
|---------|----------------------------------------------|
| SQLite  | Default. Lightweight and easy to use         |
| MySQL   | For external or large-scale server networks  |

---

## 📜 License

This project is licensed under the **MIT License**.  
You are free to use, modify, and distribute the plugin as long as the original license and copyright notice are included.

---

Give your players the freedom to fly — powered by conduits! 🛫✨

# Simple Modpack For Permabaran Absurd With Guns

_Author : Sorry for bad english, I will use AI translator for this description. I am not natively speak and/or writing by english language, still learning_

## **English (MTL)**

This modpack serves as the foundational modpack for all projects under the DumAdventure private server. I decided to create this base modpack to streamline the development process for the Private Server, especially since I've also been assigned to manage the Back-End aspects of the Server Hosting. And thus, this was created.

However, this journey has only just begun, as I've only prepared the alpha stage of this modpack. For future progress, I'll consider it when I have both the time and energy.
This modpack includes the standard mods I typically use, along with optimizations for both the client (still in progress) and server. Additionally, custom recipes and datapacks will be provided, but not at this time.

The content in this base modpack offers an 'Easy Survival' experience with a slight twist—almost akin to Vanilla++. However, what sets this modpack apart from typical Vanilla++ is the inclusion of firearms. I chose [Timeless And Classic Guns : Zero](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeless-and-classics-zero) since I’ve grown accustomed to using it since my days playing on version [1.16.5](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeless-and-classics-guns).

I’ve also frequently encountered issues with game progression being either too fast or too slow. To address this, I integrated [Pufferfish's Skill Tree](https://modrinth.com/mod/skills) (though it’s not fully configured by default) to introduce essential survival attributes. Additionally, mods like [Sophisticated Backpack](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks), [Tool Belt](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tool-belt), [Parcool](https://modrinth.com/mod/parcool) & [Paraglider](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/paragliders), dan [Legendary Survival Overhaul](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/legendary-survival-overhaul) enhance the experience, making it far more engaging than standard Vanilla gameplay.

Bongo's Emporium Lite
For the private server: Bongo's Emporium

Welcome to Bongo's Emporium Lite, a streamlined modpack built for comfort, creativity, and community. Designed specifically for the private Bongo's Emporium server, this lightweight collection enhances your vanilla Minecraft experience without overwhelming it—perfect for casual play, collaborative building, and laid-back adventures.

Key Features:

    🔮 Easy Magic – Simplified enchanting mechanics make it easier than ever to get the gear you want, with less grind and more fun.

title: ObsidianVault
description: A simple, easy-to-use Minecraft server backup plugin that offers automated, secure remote backups
body:
# ⚡ ObsidianVault - Automated Cloud Backups

![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.8%2B-brightgreen) ![Server](https://img.shields.io/badge/Server-Paper%20%7C%20Spigot%20%7C%20Purpur-orange) ![Storage](https://img.shields.io/badge/Storage-5GB%20Free-blue)

## 🛡️ Never Lose Your Server Data Again!

**ObsidianVault** is the ultimate backup solution for Minecraft servers. Automatically backup your worlds, plugins, and configurations to secure cloud storage with scheduled backups, instant restores, and enterprise-grade security.

### ✨ Key Features

- 🚀 **Automated Scheduled Backups** - Set it and forget it with cron-based scheduling
- ☁️ **Secure Cloud Storage** - Your backups are stored safely in the cloud with encryption
- 🌍 **World & Plugin Backups** - Backup entire worlds or individual plugins
- ⚡ **Instant Commands** - Create, download, and restore backups with simple commands
- 📊 **Backup History** - Track all your backup versions with detailed history
- 🔒 **Enterprise Security** - Client ID/Secret authentication with secure transmission
- 💾 **5GB Free Storage** - Generous free tier with affordable upgrade options
- 🔄 **Easy Restoration** - One-click restore from any backup point
- 📱 **Web Dashboard** - Manage your backups from any device
- ⚙️ **Flexible Configuration** - Customize backup schedules and world selection

---

## 🚀 Quick Start Guide

### 1. Installation
1. Download ObsidianVault.jar
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server or use `/reload confirm`
4. The plugin will generate `plugins/ObsidianVault/config.yml`

### 2. Get Your Credentials
1. **Create Account** - Visit [obsidianvault.io/auth](https://obsidianvault.io/auth) and sign up (5GB free storage)
2. **Access Dashboard** - Log into your [dashboard](https://obsidianvault.io/dashboard)
3. **Generate Credentials** - Click "Credentials" → "Generate New Credentials"
4. **Copy Values** - Save your Client ID and Client Secret immediately

### 3. Configure the Plugin

Edit `plugins/ObsidianVault/config.yml`:

```yaml
# ObsidianVault Configuration
auth:
  client-id: your-client-id-here      # From your dashboard
  client-secret: your-client-secret-here  # From your dashboard

backup:
  # Daily backups at midnight (cron format)
  cron: "0 0 * * *"
  # Worlds to backup automatically
  worlds:
    - world
    - world_nether
    - world_the_end
```

After configuration, reload with `/reload confirm` and start backing up!

---

## 🎮 Commands

All commands start with `/backup`:

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/backup list` | List all available backups | `obsidianvault.backup` |
| `/backup create world <name>` | Create a world backup | `obsidianvault.backup` |
| `/backup create plugin <name>` | Create a plugin backup | `obsidianvault.backup` |
| `/backup history <type> <name>` | View backup history | `obsidianvault.backup` |
| `/backup download <type> <name>` | Get download link | `obsidianvault.backup` |
| `/backup delete <type> <name>` | Delete a backup | `obsidianvault.admin` |
| `/backup status` | Check backup operations | `obsidianvault.backup` |

### Command Examples
```
# Create a backup of the main world
/backup create world world

# Create a backup of WorldEdit plugin
/backup create plugin WorldEdit

# View all backups for a world
/backup history world survival

# Download the latest backup
/backup download world survival

# Check current operations
/backup status
```

---

## ⏰ Automatic Scheduling

Configure automatic backups using cron expressions:

| Schedule | Cron Expression | Description |
|----------|----------------|-------------|
| Daily at midnight | `0 0 * * *` | Once per day |
| Every 6 hours | `0 */6 * * *` | 4 times per day |
| Every 30 minutes | `*/30 * * * *` | 48 times per day |
| Weekly (Sunday) | `0 0 * * 0` | Once per week |
| Weekdays at 2 AM | `0 2 * * 1-5` | Monday-Friday |

**Cron Format:** `minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week`

---

## 🔧 Advanced Configuration

<details>
<summary>Click to expand full configuration options</summary>

```yaml
# ObsidianVault Configuration File

# Authentication settings
auth:
  client-id: your-client-id-here
  client-secret: your-client-secret-here

# Backup configuration
backup:
  # Cron expression for scheduling
  cron: "0 0 * * *"
  
  # List of worlds to include in automated backups
  worlds:
    - world
    - world_nether
    - world_the_end
    - survival
    - creative
  
  # Enable debug logging
  debug: false
  
# Advanced options
storage:
  # Enable compression (recommended)
  compress: true
  
  # Maximum backup retention (days)
  retention-days: 30
  
  # Copy worlds before upload (for large worlds)
  copy-before-upload: true

# Performance settings
performance:
  # Maximum concurrent uploads
  max-uploads: 2
  
  # Upload timeout (seconds)
  timeout: 300
  
  # Chunk size for uploads (MB)
  chunk-size: 50
```

</details>

---

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `obsidianvault.backup` | Access to backup commands | op |
| `obsidianvault.admin` | Administrative commands | op |
| `obsidianvault.reload` | Reload configuration | op |

---

## 🆘 Troubleshooting

<details>
<summary>Authentication Failed</summary>

**Symptoms:** "Authentication failed" or "Invalid credentials" errors

**Solutions:**
- Verify client-id and client-secret are correct (copy-paste from dashboard)
- Check for extra spaces or special characters in config.yml
- Ensure your ObsidianVault account is active
- Regenerate credentials if needed
- Test credentials by logging into the web dashboard

</details>

<details>
<summary>Upload Failures</summary>

**Symptoms:** Backups fail to upload or timeout

**Solutions:**
- Check server internet connection and DNS resolution
- Verify you haven't exceeded storage quota (check dashboard)
- Ensure firewall allows HTTPS connections on port 443
- Check available disk space on server (need 2x world size temporarily)
- Increase timeout value in config for large worlds
- Enable compression to reduce upload size

</details>

<details>
<summary>Large World Issues</summary>

**Symptoms:** OutOfMemory errors or very slow backups

**Solutions:**
- Enable `copy-before-upload: true` in config
- Increase server memory allocation (-Xmx parameter)
- Schedule backups during low-activity periods
- Reduce `chunk-size` for slower connections
- Consider backing up worlds individually
- Enable compression to reduce memory usage

</details>

### Debug Mode
Enable detailed logging by setting `debug: true` in config.yml for troubleshooting.

---

## 💎 Why Choose ObsidianVault?

- 🔄 **Automated & Reliable** - Set your schedule and never worry about manual backups
- ☁️ **Cloud-First Design** - Your data is safe even if your server hardware fails
- 🚀 **Performance Optimized** - Minimal impact on server performance during backups
- 💰 **Cost-Effective** - 5GB free storage with affordable premium plans
- 🛡️ **Enterprise Security** - Your backups are encrypted and secure
- 📱 **Easy Management** - Web dashboard for backup management from anywhere

---

## 📞 Support & Resources

- 📖 **Documentation:** [obsidianvault.io/docs](https://obsidianvault.io/docs)
- 🌐 **Website:** [obsidianvault.io](https://obsidianvault.io)

- 📊 **Dashboard:** [obsidianvault.io/dashboard](https://obsidianvault.io/dashboard)

Join thousands of server administrators who trust ObsidianVault to protect their precious Minecraft worlds. Download now and never lose your server data again!

title: Nubz Corrected Curses
description: A small datapack providing a different take on Minecraft Curses, and adding 7 new ones. Now giving both a negative, and positive effect.
body:
# Nubz Corrected Curses
This datapack's goal is to make Curses in Minecraft a more interesting discovery. It aims to give players a chance to consider their options for using Curses, instead of instantly discarding all items enchanted with one. 

It changes the concept of a Curse from a purely negative effect, to a negative and positive effect. Each new Curse, and already existing Curses, will provide the players with interesting effects that will both negatively, and positively impact the player. 


## What Changed?
This datapack has only changed the base '_Curse of Binding_' a small amount. Each piece of armor with Curse of Binding will have 2 additional armor toughness, and 1 additional armor. This way, this Curse will provide the player with more protection at the cost of not being able to remove it. 

My goal is to change '_Curse of Vanishing_' aswell, but currently, I have not yet thought of something that I would consider fitting and fair. 


## New Curses
This datapack also provides 7 new curses, all with new unique effects to make curses a more interesting find as loot. All curses will be listed below within a spoiler tag. 

**Warning: This datapack changes ALL entity loot tables due to one Curse listed below. Due to the limitations within JSON and datapacks, this will cause conflicts with other datapacks changing entity loot tables. I am planning on making an alternate version of this datapack that will trade some reliability and consistancy for this specific Curse, but will allow you to combine it with other datapacks changing mob loot tables.**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- **_Curse of Diminishing:_** An armor unique Curse that will reduce the players max health, jump strength, and movement speed. In turn, they will become smaller! This effects stacks, meaning that with 1 piece, you can still jump up blocks, with 2 pieces you can sneak to become smaller then one block, and with 3 pieces you will always be smaller then one block.

- **_Curse of the Drowned:_** Tool exclusive Curse that slows down block breaking speed, except for when your underwater! then it increases it instead. Combining this with _Aqua Affinity_ will provide the player with a significant boost in block breaking speed underwater compared to on land. 

- **_Curse of Gluttony:_** This curse can be applied to everything except armor. it will continuously drain durability while holding the item, but there is a small chance it refills hunger whenever durability is consumed. Delicious!

- **_Curse of Greed:_** A melee weapon only Curse. It will change ALL mob drops to iron and gold nuggets. Feeling hungry, whoops, it's an iron nugget now. Really wanted that smithing template from the Elder Guardian, I hope you like gold! There are some small easter eggs though, see if you can find them!

- **_Curse of Infestation:_** A Curse exclusive to pickaxes. Whenever you hit a block, there is a chance a silverfish will spawn. It does allow you to pick of infested blocks, something even _Silk Touch_ can't do! Perfect for pranking your friends!

- **_Curse of Undeath:_** This Curse can only be found and applied on chestplates. All zombies and skeletons will become passive to the player. I do hope you dislike the sun though, because standing in direct sunlight will burn you now!

- **_Curse of Wrath:_** A simpler Curse that can only be applied on melee weapons. These weapons will deal more damage, but this damage isn't only to the targets you hit. You will also take damage everytime you hit something with an item that is affected by this Curse.

</details>

### This is a system for **ArtualCM**'s infamous 'Psych Ward' Multiplayer Server,
Features of the plugin include:

1. Player Tracker ( Done by Theo, Improved by Harful )
2. Player Compass Crafting Recipie: https://i.imgur.com/QHPc6ws.png (done in the compass listenr cs no)
3. Ender Chest dropping on Death ( Originally made by Theo, Fixed alot by Harful thx )
4. Claiming Chunks: Players can use the /claim command to claim chunks, with the maximum number of claims set in a configuration file. Anyone that has been /trusted while the user is in their claim, let them mine normally, for anyone else:

Breaking Blocks in Claimed Chunks:

    If an untrusted player tries to break a block in a claimed chunk, it will take a long time to break. This is achieved by temporarily replacing the block with reinforced deepslate and giving the player Haste I.
    Breaking this reinforced deepslate block starts a raid.

Raid Mechanics:

    When a raid starts, no blocks can be placed in the claimed chunk by either the raiding player or the claim owner for the next 20 minutes.
    The owner of the claimed chunk is alerted when a raid starts.
    A raid cannot start, and the reinforced deepslate cannot be broken, if the owner of the claim is not online.

Honeycomb Blocks:

    Any blocks broken during a raid are replaced with honeycomb, which has Mining Fatigue II.
    Breaking a honeycomb block resets the raid timer back to 20 minutes.

title: KcCommandBridge
description: Fix issues with command execution across servers in MultiPaper.
body:
## The plugin only supports MultiPaper 1.20.1 server.
### ​Plugin Introduction
- This is a command forwarding plugin developed specifically for MultiPaper servers, offering highly customizable features and compatibility with the majority of plugins.

### Reason for Development
- Many MultiPaper server owners may have encountered a situation where two players are on different sub-servers, and one player sends a TPA request to the other. While the recipient can see the request prompt, they receive a message stating there are no requests to accept when entering the accept command.
- This plugin aims to solve this issue. By defining commands in the configuration file, the plugin automatically forwards command requests to the target player's MultiPaper sub-server, ensuring normal execution.

### Command & Permissions
- **/commandbridge** - **kccommandbridge.reload** - Reload the configuration file.

### Configuration File

```
# Output debug logs
debug: false

# List of commands to forward
# Asterisks represent custom content
commands:
  - "cmi tpa *"
  - "trade *"
```

title: Selective Mining
description: Control what blocks a tool can break.
body:
# Selective Mining

This plugin allows easy configuration of a tool to only be capable of destroying certain blocks, featuring both a blacklist and whitelist feature (where blacklist takes priority--if a material is in both the blacklist and the whitelist, it will not be breakable).

## How to use

```
/sm enable -- Run this command while holding an item to enable selective mining for that item.
/sm disable -- Disable selective mining on an item that it has been enabled on.
/sm allow <material> -- Allow a material to be broken with the item the player is holding.
/sm deny <material> -- Prevent a material from being broken with the item the player is holding.
/sm list -- List all allowed and denied materials registered on this item.[/code]
```

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Selective Mining mod.

title: FSR Reloaded
description: A mod that adds support for AMDs FidelityFX Super Resolution.
body:
**FSR Upscaler for Minecraft**
**Get massive frame-per-second (FPS) boosts without turning your game into a blurry mess. This mod brings high-end, smart upscaling technology directly to Minecraft using pure, lightweight graphics card math.**

## Suported FSR versions:
1. FSR 1
2. FSR 2
3. FSR 3
4. FSR 3(frame generation)

## 🚀 Why You Want This Mod
Normally, if you want more FPS, you have to lower your game's resolution, which makes everything look pixelated and blurry. 

This mod fixes that. It forces Minecraft to render the world at a lower, high-performance resolution, but uses a smart **Temporal Reconstruction** algorithm to instantly rebuild the missing details. By blending information from past frames with the present frame, it deletes jagged edges and outputs a crystal-clear image. 

* **Razor-Sharp Graphics:** Includes a built-in sharpness filter (**RCAS**) so block textures, leaves, and item grids stay incredibly crisp instead of looking smeared.
* **Massive Performance Gains:** Gives your graphics card breathing room, resulting in huge FPS jumps—especially if you play at 1440p or 4K resolutions.
* **Perfect for Massive View Distances:** Fully compatible with Level-of-Detail (LOD) mods like **Voxy**. You can look out at endless, beautiful horizons with zero performance lag.
* **Super Lightweight:** Runs entirely inside clean, standard OpenGL code. No heavy or messy external requirements that will break your favorite modpacks.

## 🎮 How to Install
Getting the mod into your game takes less than a minute:

1. **Download the Mod:** Grab the `.jar` version file that matches your Minecraft version.
2. **Open your Mod Folder:** Press `Windows Key + R`, type `%appdata%\.minecraft\mods`, and press Enter. (If you use a launcher like Prism, Modrinth App, or CurseForge, just click "Open Folder" on your instance).
3. **Drop it in:** Move the downloaded mod file directly into that `mods` folder.
4. **Launch the Game:** Start Minecraft through your modded profile!

## ⌨️ Controls & Settings (How to Use)
You don't need to struggle with complex configuration menus—the upscaler is fully automated and activates the second you load into a world. 

* **How to configure** Use F8 to Enable/Diable the mod, F9 to switch video quality, F10 to switch bweteen FSR versions, and K and J to adjust sharpness. Alternatively, you can use F7 to get a settings UI
* **Shader Requirements:** Go into your Video Settings and ensure your standard shader packs (Iris or Oculus) are completely **Disabled**, as they will clash with the custom upscaling pipelines.
* **Fine-Tuning:** If you ever want to adjust the custom sharpness level or tweak resolution scales, you can easily change the numbers inside the mod's configuration layout files. 

## 💻 Hardware Requirements (Will it run?)
Because this mod runs entirely on **pure OpenGL compute shaders**, it does not need a specific brand of graphics card to work. However, it requires modern hardware structures to execute the math:

* **Supported Graphics Cards:** Requires an **NVIDIA GeForce GTX 700 series / AMD Radeon HD 7000 series or newer**. (Basically, any graphics card made after 2013).
* **Intel Integrated Graphics:** Works on Intel Haswell processors or newer (Intel HD Graphics 4600+), but dedicated graphics cards will see the biggest performance leaps.
* **Technical Requirement:** Your system and drivers must support **OpenGL 4.3 or higher**. If your computer can run modern versions of Minecraft smoothly, it can run this mod!

## ⚠️ The Catch: Shader Compatibility (Must Read!)
Because this mod completely alters how Minecraft builds and processes images under the hood, **it is incompatible with traditional OptiFine/Iris shaders (like Complementary, BSL, or SEUS).**

Shaders completely rewrite Minecraft's rendering code to add custom lighting and shadows. This mod *also* rewrites Minecraft's rendering code to handle smart upscaling. If you run both at the same time, they fight over the same graphics pipelines, resulting in a broken screen or a game crash. 

**Think of this mod as an alternative to shaders:** Install shaders if you want cinematic lighting; install this mod if you want **maximum performance, smooth gameplay, and sharp anti-aliasing** while keeping the classic, clean vanilla Minecraft aesthetic!

## 🛠️ How It Works (Simply Put)
Instead of just stretching out a small image like older upscalers do, this mod gently shakes Minecraft’s camera by a fraction of a pixel every single frame. It takes those tiny, overlapping snapshots, remembers what the world looked like a millisecond ago, and stitches them together to paint a high-resolution final picture on your monitor in real-time.

MtgCard brings the world of Magic: The Gathering into Minecraft as a fully interactive, in-game experience.

# Features
Open booster packs and collect real MTG cards pulled directly from official Magic: The Gathering sets. Can even store the cards in the Card Database, so that they don't needlessly fill up your chests.
Booster packs can be crafted or found in any loot chest.

If you don't want to always open up booster packs to get the cards, there is a card store that you can buy from. The price on the cards are based on their real value. $1 = 1 diamond
If you don't want the cards to cost diamonds, feel free to go into the config to change it to whatever item you want.

Everything is designed to feel diegetic — cards exist as real items, GUIs are styled like arcane terminals, and displays integrate seamlessly into bases, shops, and multiplayer hubs.

Block features:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Deckbox
  - Store your decks in these 100 slots boxes. They are designed to only hold cards and one slot to hold a bundle for tokens.
  - There are multiple wood variants for this block for decoration purposes.
- Graveyard
  - This block helps keep track of what cards are in the graveyard and exile during a game.
  - Block is designed to look like a crypt for graveyard builds.
- Deck Control
  - If placed between a deckbox and a graveyard, it will help you control your deck library in the deckbox by drawing, milling, and many more features.
  - Designed to be a light source for gardens. Has multiple color variants.
- Health Tracker
  - This will keep track of your health.
  - If in a pod you can have it randomly select who goes first and keeps track of commander damage if playing in the commander format.
- Display Block
  - Will display the health from the health tracker.
  - Also can have it be designed in a way for different looks.
- Card Database
  - Has infinite storage for holding all of the cards that you have collected.
  - If a deckbox is placed next to it, it has the deckbox screen show up beside the Card Database screen for cross comparing.
- Card Store
  - If you don't want to open booster packs all of the time, you can buy them as singles instead.
  - You can drag and drop a text file or a csv file onto the screen and it will load the cards into the cart instead.
  - The cards are based on their real value at that time. $1 = 1 diamond

</details>

# Customizability
There is even a functionality to import your own custom cards into the game using the import command.
```
/mtg custom import
```
Custom cards have a higher chance on showing up in booster packs when being opened unless configured diffeently.

If you don't want the cards to have a value in diamonds, then you can change the item in the configs as well.

# Info
This was designed to make the tcg game feel playable in Minecraft. You can place cards on floors or walls, keep track of your life total on displays, even some of the blocks has some redstone capabilites.

Whether you’re a Magic player, a Minecraft builder, or a server owner looking for a new way to play tabletop-style games in survival, MTG Card Mod turns your world into a living trading card game.

Collect. Display. Play. Build your Magic inside Minecraft.

I have also made a tutorial on the mod as well:

title: TheLandClaim
description: The Land Claim is a comprehensive land protection mod designed for Minecraft Java servers running fabric
body:
# **The Land Claim Mod**

**Lore:** Your land is your legacy. Protect it, manage it, and decide who gets to walk on it.

## The Land Claim: Coordinate-Based Land Management with Geyser Support

**The Land Claim** is a comprehensive land protection mod designed for Minecraft Java servers running Fabric. Unlike simple chunk-based claiming systems, this plugin offers 3d cube selecition claiming. It also has support for Bedrock players via GeyserMC.

This Mod features advanced TNT protection, block-break prevention

***

**Coordinate-Based Claiming:** Claim specific volumes of land by defining exact XYZ coordinates, not the chunk based.

*   **Geyser:** Bedrock players are fully supported
*   **Robust Protection:** Stops unauthorized block breaking, placing, and interacting (doors, buttons, chests)
*   **Permissions Management:** Easily manage who has access to your land and what they are allowed to do.

### Usage:

To protect your land, simply use the provided commands.

*   **To claim land (Java):** Use `/claim <x1> <y1> <z1> <x2> <y2> <z2>` to define the exact box you want to protect.
*   **To view claim info:** Type `/claiminfo` to see who owns the land you are currently standing on.
*   **To unclaim:** Use the `/unclaim` command while inside your claim.
*   Use /claimperms to change per-player permissions.

### Installation:

1.  Download the `.jar` file.
2.  Place it in your server's or game's `mods` folder.
3.  Restart your server. No client-side mods are required. Single Player also supported

This mod doesnt require any complex setup.

***

body:
FlameCraft pack takes Minecraft to a whole new level of adventure gameplay, emphasizing exploration, narrative, and character development. The world has been significantly expanded with new biomes, structures, and randomly generated dungeons that hide unique items, puzzles, and powerful bosses. Each expedition becomes a unique experience, allowing players to discover forgotten ruins, mystical kingdoms, and dangerous dungeons brimming with secrets.

The pack also introduces revamped gameplay mechanics, including an improved combat system, more complex crafting, [corpses](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/corpse) so as not to lose your progress, and expanded equipment progression. With new tools and special abilities, players can tailor their playstyle to their preferences, creating heroes capable of overcoming the most challenging challenges.

One key element of the pack is deeper and more dynamic interaction with settlers. NPCs have their own roles, dialogue, and needs, and building relationships with them unlocks special quests, unique goods, and support during expeditions. Settlements become living places that respond to player actions and can grow with them.

Despite its rich content, the pack maintains excellent optimization, ensuring the world runs smoothly even on low-mid-end computers. Advanced configuration tools allow you to tailor performance to your individual hardware capabilities without sacrificing gameplay quality.

This is the perfect option for players who dream of a full-fledged Minecraft adventure—full of discovery, challenges, and an immersive atmosphere.

title: Magnetron
description: Magneton is a simple magnet mod for Forge 1.20.1 that pulls nearby dropped items and XP orbs to players, with line-of-sight checks, smooth suction movement, and configurable radius.
body:
# Magneton
Magneton is a lightweight Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that adds a powerful item magnet feature to automatically attract dropped items and experience orbs towards nearby players. Inspired by popular magnet mods, it focuses on smooth gameplay, server performance, and configurability without breaking vanilla mechanics.

## Key Features
Automatic Attraction: Dropped items and XP orbs within range are pulled towards players with smooth, suction-like movement.

Line-of-Sight Checks: Items only attract if there's a clear line of sight (no attraction through walls or obstacles).

Pickup Delay Respect: Items with active pickup delay (e.g., from mob drops) are ignored until they become available.

Cube-Shaped Range: Attraction works in a configurable cube radius around the nearest eligible player.

Global and Per-Player Controls: Admins can enable/disable globally, while each player can opt-out individually.

Server-Side Only: All logic runs on the server for fair multiplayer play; no client-side cheats.

Performance Optimized: Efficient scanning and attraction every server tick without lag.

## Commands

Player Commands (Any Player)
/magneton toggle

Toggles your personal magnet on/off. By default, players start with the magnet enabled (opt-out model).

Example Output: "Magneton: ON" or "Magneton: OFF"
/magneton status

Shows your current personal magnet status, global magnet status, and current radius.
Example Output: "Magneton: ON | global=ON | radius=10"

Admin/OP Commands (Requires Permission Level 2)
/magneton global on

Enables the global magnet for all players (default state).

Example Output: "Magneton global: ON"
/magneton global off

Disables the global magnet for all players (overrides personal toggles).

Example Output: "Magneton global: OFF"
/magneton radius <0..64>

Sets the global attraction radius (in blocks). Range: 0 to 64. Default: 10.
Example: /magneton radius 15 → "Magneton radius set to 15"

## Default Settings
Global Magnet: Enabled (magnetonEnabled gamerule = true)
Radius: 10 blocks (magnetonRadius gamerule = 10)
Per-Player: Enabled by default; players can disable with /magneton toggle
Attraction Speed: Items accelerate gently towards players (max speed capped for smoothness)
Installation & Compatibility
Requires Forge 47.1.0+ for Minecraft 1.20.1
Server-side mod; works on dedicated servers and single-player
Compatible with other mods (no known conflicts)
No dependencies

## Notes
Attraction respects vanilla item behavior (e.g., no duplication, pickup delay honored)
XP orbs attract slightly faster than items for better gameplay feel
Use /gamerule magneton Enabled false or /gamerule magneton Radius 0 as alternatives for OP control
Personal settings persist across sessions using player data

title: Buzzy's Random Stuff
description: Buzzy's Random stuff adds some different features to the game with no clear theme or focus. At the moment there isn't much but with future updates I will add more and more to this mod.
body:
Buzzy's Random stuff adds some different features to the game with no clear theme or focus. At the moment there isn't much but with future updates I will add more and more to this mod.

**Features**
# Items
- Football: A non-living entity crafted from 4 leather, 2 white dye, and 2 black dye, which can be kicked around like a real-life football. Its kick distance is dependent on whether you're walking, sprinting, or sneaking, and it kicks in the direction you're looking. To pick it back up, punch it once to "kill" it and it will drop as an item.
- Marshmallow: A food made with water, a slimeball, and sugar. Can be cooked to make a roasted marshmallow and can be crafted into a marshmallow block
- Chocolate Bar: A food made from cocoa beans and sugar. Can be crafted into a block of chocolate
- Graham Cracker: A food made from wheat and sugar.
- S'more: A food made from crafting together the 3 foods listed above.
- Energy Drink: Crafted from 4 blocks of sugar, 2 cocoa beans, a water bucket, and 2 glass bottles. Gives Speed 10 and Jump Boost 2 for 4 seconds.
- Chisel: A tool which is used to turn blocks into their chiselled variant. Simply use it on any block that has a chiselled variant. For example, it will turn Stone Bricks into Chiselled Stone Bricks.
- Hammer: A tool which can unpack blocks that can't be unpacked by crafting or mining them like Nether Quartz, can separate things from blocks like Gold Nuggets from GIlded Blackstone, and can turn blocks into their "cracked" variant if they have one.
- Ice Shard: Equal to 1/9 of an ice block, can be obtained by hammering one, and can be crafted into an ice block.
Spray Bottle: When filled with water, oxidises unwaxed copper blocks by one level when used.
- Red Nether Brick: 4 of them are crafted like how the Red Nether Bricks block is in vanilla, and the block is now crafted with 4 of these.
- Rake: A tiered tool which tills a 3x3 area of dirt at once.
# Blocks
- Block of Chocolate: A decorative block crafted from 9 chocolate bars. Can also be crafted back into 9 cholocate bars
- Marshmallow Block: A block made from 9 marshmallows, same as chocolate. In the future I plan to make this block cushion all fall damage
- Block of Sugar: A block crafted with 9 sugar
- Support Beam: A decorative block which comes in all wood and brick types
- Purple Petals: A plant found in Grape Savannas. Similar to Pink Petals, up to 4 can be placed in one block space and they can be duplicated with bone meal.
- Tombstone: A block found above ground in cemetery biomes, marking each grave.
- Bone Litter: A block found buried in graves in cemetery biomes. Can only be obtained with Silk Touch, otherwise 2 bones are dropped instead.
- Wall Lantern: A version of the lantern that can hang on walls, crafted with any support beam and a lantern. All regular lantern variants have a wall lantern as well.
- Railing: A wooden or brick diagonal stacking block which works as a diagonal fence. They seamlessly connect to each other and regular fences.
- Railing Corner: A railing that turns. Comes in right and left variants.
- Railing Connector: A fence block that seamlessly connects the front of a railing to a fence.
- Banister: A wooden or brick girder block which can be used to decorate fences and railings.
- Window: A block similar to a door which can be opened and closed. Comes in all wood types, iron, copper, and silver.
- Beam: A wooden or brick pole block which can be placed in any orientation.
- Cross: Appears as two beams crossing; can be used as an intersection or corner.
- Black Petals: Another plant with the same format as Pink Petals and Purple Petals. Found in Blossom Caves
- Blossomlight: A unique plant found in Blossom Caves, which emits a light level of 12 and is used to brew the Potion of Luck
- Magma Cream Block: Crafted from 9 Magma Cream, used to brew the Potion of Eruption
- Redstone Lantern: A red lantern, crafted using a Redstone Torch
- Brick, Resin Brick, and Red Nether Brick fences
- Chiselled Bricks and Red Nether Bricks
- Cut Copper and Silver Walls
# Redstone components
- Comparer: This block has 2 faces on opposite sides. If the blocks in front of both faces match, block and state, it emits a signal of 15. (Currently this block also emits the signal from its faces, which may cause some unwanted behavior. This should be resolved eventually)
- Breaker: This block will mine the block in front of its face when powered, and the block's regular loot will be dropped. It can break any block instantly, except unbreakable blocks like bedrock.
- Detector: This block will constantly emit a signal of 15 if there is any block other than air in front of its face. It will turn off if the block is removed.
- Placer: This block has 1 slot of inventory, and if the item placed in it can be placed as a block, it will place it in front of its face when powered. For blocks with directions, the direction it's placed is based on the direction of the Placer.
# Structures
- Stables: A small abandoned village-like structure found in Badlands biomes. It has multiple different houses and other structures which it can generate, containing various loot.
- Nether Base: A small house found in the Nether, containing some workstations and materials.
- Lighthouse: Found in Beach biomes and contains loot.
Tomb: A small structure found in Cemetery biomes, and acts as a new grave variant.
# Block families
- Six new wood types: Grape, Joshua, Sequoia, Blue Oak, Caveblossom, and Gleam.
- A new mineral, Silver, which has many variants and uses.
# Biomes
## Overworld
- Grape Savanna: A warm, unique biome. Generates with purple Grape Blossom trees, which come in regular and huge sizes and give access to their own wood type. The Purple Petals flower can also be found here.
- Joshua Desert: A rare hot and dry biome with sharp and spiky Joshua trees, which give access to another new wood type.
- Cemetery: A rare grey biome with graves scattered around. No animals spawn here, and at night, only zombies and skeletons spawn here in increased numbers.
- Sequoia Forest: A unique forest with tall Sequoia trees, which give access to their wood type.
- Frosty Fields: A cold, snowy biome where you can find the Blue Oak trees and wood type.
- Blossom Caves: A cave biome where black plants grow. Here you can find Caveblossom trees and their wood type, Black Petals, and Blossomlights.
## Nether
- Glimmering Caverns: A quiet, green biome where only Striders can spawn. The Gleam wood type can be found here.
# Potions
- Potion of Bad Luck: Brewed by adding a Fermented Spider Eye to a Potion of Luck.
- Potion of Eruption: Gives the Erupting effect; causes three magma cubes of random size to spawn upon the entity's death, similar to Oozing.
# Music Discs
- "Conga Forest" by TDX; found in Jungle Temple chests
- "Desolate Area" by TDX; found in Desert Temple chests
# Advancements
- "What's The Rarest..."
- "Wood You Look At That!"
- "Definitely Very Healthy!"
- "Careful Bone Retrieval"
- "Certified Buzzplorer"
- "The Complete Discography"
- "Destruction of Property"
- "Kinda Sus"
- "Darken Down"
# Recipe tweaks and more
- Luck potions are brewable in Survival, using the Blossomlight.
- Backported from 26.1; Name tags are craftable using a piece of paper and any metal nugget
- Magma blocks are now crafted using a lava bucket and 4 cobblestone

It adds quality-of-life features like easier farming and faster navigation aswell as custom enchantments that fit in perfectly with vanilla minecraft. The HUD is easier to understand and there is new structures across the world to explore. It also supports playing with friends through the essential mod!

---

The modpack includes many shaders such as:
- **BSL Shaders**
- **Complementary Reimagined**
- **Solas Shader**
- **AstraLex Shaders**
- **Bliss Shaders**
- **Miniature Shader**
- **MakeUp – Ultra Fast**

---

- **RightClickHarvest** – Right-click to harvest and replant crops instantly
- **Forgiving Void** – Saves you from void death
- **Easy Anvils** – Removes "Too Expensive" and reduces anvil costs
- **Easy Shulker Boxes** – Open shulker boxes without placing them
- **Pickup Notifications** – Shows a small popup when items are picked up
- **Lighty** – Highlights blocks where mobs can spawn
- **Naturally Trimmed** – Mobs spawn wearing trimmed armor
- **Zoomify** – Adds a zoom key
- **Litematica** – Schematic tool for planning builds
- **Sound Physics Remastered** – Realistic reverb and sound occlusion
- **Do a Barrel Roll** – Changes the movement system with elytra
- **All Mob Heads** – Every mob has a chance to drop its head
- **Advancement Screenshot** – Auto-screenshots when you earn an advancement
- **[Shine](https://modrinth.com/project/uQgWIE6A)** - Replaces shaders by adding coloured lighting and bloom to your world
- **Punchy!** – Adds new first person animations

</details>

---

<details>
<summary>Performance</summary>

- **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/project/AANobbMI)** + **[Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/project/PtjYWJkn)** – Core rendering overhaul for more FPS
- **[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/project/gvQqBUqZ)** – Optimises game logic
- **[FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/project/uXXizFIs)** – Significantly reduces RAM usage
- **[Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/project/NNAgCjsB)** & **[More Culling](https://modrinth.com/project/51shyZVL)** – Skips rendering entities and blocks you can't see
- **[ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/project/5ZwdcRci)** – Speeds up GUI and rendering
</details>

---

## More Information

If you don't want to have custom structures you would have to turn off Dungeons and Taverns aswell as Stellerity in Modrinth **before** you create a world. If you create a world using Terralith, Tectonic and Continents removing those mods may cause issues for that world. Additionally to play with friends you need to sign in with an essential account. This modpack include mods such as Xaero's World Map, Xaero's Minimap and Freecam which may not be allowed on some servers. If you want to use shine you will have to disable shaders in video settings.

title: 永遠 EIEN
description: A Create-focused modpack built for the 永遠 EIEN multiplayer server.
body:
**永遠 EIEN is Eternity.** This modpack is a customized collection of mods focused around [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create), with custom quests explaining the mod's progression. There is also an emphasis on exploration, with aesthetic and exciting world-generation using [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/mod/terralith) and [Continents](https://modrinth.com/mod/continents). This landscape works great for connecting the world via train or airship. Many recipes have been customized to rely on Create methods, or to fit in better to the modpack's progression system. A number of optimization mods are also added in order to try and make it playable on less-powerful computers.

This modpack is designed to be used as part of a private, multiplayer server.

---

> ⚠️ The modpack does support some external mods that need to be downloaded _individually_ in order to get the full modpack experience. However, **these are not required**. These mods are FTB Backups, FTB Filters, FTB Library, FTB Quests, FTB Teams, and FTB XMod Compat. These mods serve as the backbone for the custom quest system. They can be found easily on CurseForge. Please contact me if you have any questions or concerns. I am on Discord as `oceanartemis`.

title: MCSpotify
description: The mod is focused on the Spotify + Minecraft connection
body:
# MCSpotify

Bring full Spotify control directly into Minecraft!

**MCSpotify** is a lightweight and intuitive mod that allows you to control your Spotify playback without leaving the game. Whether you're building, exploring, mining, or fighting mobs, your music is always just a click away.

## Features

### 🎵 HUD Overlay

Display information about the currently playing track directly on your screen.

### ⏯️ Play & Pause

Control music playback instantly without switching to Spotify or leaving Minecraft.

### ⏭️ Track Navigation

Skip to the next song or return to the previous one directly from within the game.

### 🔊 Volume Control

Adjust Spotify volume without minimizing Minecraft.

## Supported Version

* Minecraft **1.21.11**

## Why MCSpotify?

MCSpotify is designed for players who want a seamless music experience while playing Minecraft. The mod integrates Spotify controls directly into the game, allowing you to manage your music without interrupting gameplay.

Stay immersed in your world while keeping complete control over your soundtrack.

### Key Benefits

* Simple and easy-to-use interface
* Real-time track information
* In-game Spotify controls
* Lightweight and performance-friendly
* No need to switch between applications

Enjoy your favorite music while playing Minecraft with **MCSpotify**.

title: SuperTsunami
description: Makes water and lava from buckets spread rapidly and infinitely, causing instant flooding.
body:
**SuperTsunami** allows you to create massive, infinite floods using water, lava, and 
powder snow buckets. Watch the liquid automatically expand horizontally across your world!


![GIF](https://i.imgur.com/hcZzkxw.gif)
---

## ⚙️ Requirements
- Java 21 or higher is required.

---

## ✨ Features
- **Three liquid types:** 🌊 Water, 🔥 Lava, and ❄️ Powder Snow buckets all trigger a tsunami.
- **Configurable speed** — set spread delay individually for each liquid type.
- **Radius limit** — cap how far a flood can spread from its origin.
- **Block whitelist** — protect specific blocks from ever being replaced (bedrock, obsidian, barriers, etc.).
- **Replaceable blocks** — optionally make the wave sweep away grass, flowers, and other plants.
- **Admin commands** — reload config live or stop all active floods instantly.
- **Simple Mechanics** — no setup needed, just use a vanilla bucket.

---

## 📖 How to Use
1. Fly up or build a pillar — the liquid needs open space to spread.
2. Make sure to place the liquid **at least 3 blocks above the ground**.  
   *(If placed directly on the ground, the spread may be blocked by terrain.)*
3. Right-click with a Water, Lava, or Powder Snow bucket.
4. Watch the wave expand infinitely!

### Commands (op only)
| Command | Action |
|---|---|
| `/tsunami reload` | Reload `config.yml` without restarting |
| `/tsunami stop` | Instantly cancel all active tsunamis |

---

## ⚠️ WARNING
**Use with caution!** This plugin creates an infinite loop of block updates.
- **Do not** use this on a production server with important builds unless you have backups.
- It can cause **severe lag** or server crashes if the liquid spreads into too many unloaded chunks.
- Use `max-radius` in the config to keep things under control.

title: Stack Refill
description: Automatically refills your main hand, off-hand, armor, and tools when matching replacements are available.
body:
Stack Refill

Automatic stack and gear refilling for Minecraft.
Keep building, mining, fighting, and exploring without constant inventory interruptions.

What is Stack Refill?

Stack Refill is a lightweight Quality of Life mod that automatically replaces used-up item stacks, broken tools, armor pieces, and off-hand items from your inventory.

It helps keep your hotbar and equipment ready, so you can continue playing without stopping to manually move items around.

Why Players Install Stack Refill

  • Automatically refills used-up stacks from your inventory.
  • Replaces broken tools when another matching tool is available.
  • Refills armor slots and off-hand items.
  • Helps builders, miners, fighters, farmers, and survival players.
  • Reduces inventory interruptions during long play sessions.
  • Includes useful warnings, notifications, HUD counters, and optional sounds.

Feature Highlights

Automatic Stack Refill

When the last item in a stack is used, Stack Refill searches for a matching item and moves it into the same slot automatically.

Main Hand, Off-Hand, Armor, and Tools

The mod can refill the main hand, off-hand, armor slots, and tools when they break.

Configurable Search Priority

Choose how Stack Refill searches for replacements:

  • Inventory first
  • Hotbar first

Keep Slot Mode

Keep Slot mode keeps selected hotbar slots filled passively whenever matching items are available.

Item Blacklist

Add specific items to the blacklist if you do not want them to be refilled automatically.

Low Stock Warning

Get an actionbar warning when only one matching stack remains.

Refill Notifications

A clean actionbar notification can appear whenever a refill happens.

HUD Counter

When stock is low, Stack Refill can display a small counter on the hotbar slot.

Optional Refill Sound

Enable or disable a small sound effect when a refill happens.

Configuration

Stack Refill includes an in-game configuration screen.

Default config keybind:

R

The keybind can be changed from Minecraft’s controls menu.

Configurable options include:

  • Main hand refill
  • Off-hand refill
  • Armor refill
  • Tool replacement
  • Search priority
  • Item blacklist
  • Keep Slot mode
  • Low stock warning
  • Refill notifications
  • HUD counter
  • Optional refill sound
  • Server-side feature restrictions

Supported Versions

  • Minecraft: 1.21.1
  • Loaders: Forge, NeoForge
  • Java: 21+
  • Dependencies: None

Check the Files tab for the correct build for your loader.

Server-Side Control

Stack Refill includes server-side controls for multiplayer servers and modpacks.

Server administrators can:

  • Force-disable specific features
  • Restrict refill behavior
  • Control which client-side options are allowed

Compatibility Notes

  • Designed to be lightweight and modpack-friendly.
  • Does not create items or give free resources.
  • Only moves matching items that already exist in the player’s inventory.
  • No external dependencies required.
  • Recommended for both singleplayer and multiplayer modpacks.

Quick Install

  1. Install Forge or NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.1.
  2. Use Java 21 or newer.
  3. Place the Stack Refill jar file in your mods folder.
  4. Start the game.
  5. Press R in-game to open the configuration screen.

FAQ

Does Stack Refill work in multiplayer?

Yes. Stack Refill can work in multiplayer, but some features may be restricted by the server.

Does the mod create free items?

No. Stack Refill only moves matching items that already exist in your inventory.

Can I disable refill for specific items?

Yes. You can add items to the blacklist.

Can it refill tools?

Yes. Tools can be replaced automatically when they break, if a matching replacement is available.

Can it refill armor?

Yes. Armor slots can be refilled when armor breaks, if replacement armor is available.

What is Keep Slot mode?

Keep Slot mode keeps selected hotbar slots filled whenever possible. It is especially useful for building with many stacks of the same block.

Keep your slots filled. Keep your gameplay moving.
Stack Refill is a simple utility mod for smoother Minecraft sessions.

title: Livia Modpack

body:
# Livia Modpack

The official recommended client modpack for **Livia SMP**, built for **Minecraft 26.1.2** on **Fabric**.

This pack keeps the game close to vanilla while making the client smoother, cleaner, and better suited for playing on Livia SMP. It includes proximity voice chat, map tools, performance improvements, shader support, visual polish, and Livia-specific client quality-of-life fixes.

## Main features

### Plasmo Voice

Built-in proximity voice chat for a more natural SMP experience. Talk to nearby players in-game instead of relying only on text chat or external voice channels.

### JourneyMap

A full-featured minimap and world map for navigation, exploration, waypoints, and general quality of life while playing on the server.

### Quality of Livia

Livia's official client-side QoL mod for Livia SMP.

It adds small client-side adjustments that make the game match Livia's modified server behavior more closely. This includes anvil sync, Livia custom enchantment descriptions, Tree Stripper sync, villager trade price sync, pickup filtering, crawling controls, hotbar cycling, and an optional disable-offhand-use toggle.

Server-backed features only activate when connected to Livia SMP.

### Client quality of life

The pack includes small usability improvements for everyday play, including searchable controls, longer chat history, chat heads, inventory mouse tweaks, food information, durability display, armor HUD, improved book editing, and enchantment descriptions.

These changes are meant to make the client more comfortable without changing the core vanilla feel.

### Performance improvements

A curated Fabric performance stack is included to improve FPS, memory usage, chunk loading, lighting performance, networking, rendering efficiency, and general client smoothness.

This includes mods such as Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, C2ME, ImmediatelyFast, EntityCulling, MoreCulling, Krypton, ScalableLux, Bobby, and other supporting libraries.

### Visual polish

The pack includes shader support through Iris, Complementary Reimagined as the included shader pack, dynamic lights, connected texture support, low fire, a dark UI/resource-pack setup, and small visual cleanup mods.

It should feel cleaner and more polished without becoming a heavy gameplay overhaul.

## Notes

This modpack is made primarily for **Livia SMP**.

Most gameplay changes on the server are handled server-side. This pack exists to give players the recommended client setup: voice chat, map tools, performance improvements, visual polish, and Livia-specific client synchronization.

title: Spell Lib
description: Adds a bunch of spells for other projects to use, with customization. Makes projects that want to add spells easier to make, with any casting system.
body:
# Warning This is a library, not a content mod. It does not add gameplay functionality alone, and you will need to use commands or install a project that uses it to cast any of the spells it adds. # Description Adds spells to the game, to aid creators of magic mods and datapacks. Works in vanilla, but **there is no casting system built-in, as this is a library and meant to be a base for other projects, not used alone.**
To use the spells: Use ```/function spell_lib:spells/ {}```
Spell list with testing examples | description | : - sonic_boom | Makes a beam similar to the Warden's sonic boom attack. | owner, length, damage > ```/function spell_lib:spells/sonic_boom {owner:"@p",length:3,damage:5}```

- lightning_strike | Strikes lightning after a delay, giving particles as a warning. Take cover to protect you from the lightning. | target, time_until_strike, warning_period (the delay between bursts of particles) > ```/function spell_lib:spells/lightning_strike {target:"@p",time_until_strike:200,warning_period:10}```

- cloud_tp_and_invis | You vanish in a cloud of smoke and go invisible/teleport away from your location. | owner, tp, sound, radius, has_invis, invis_time > ```/function spell_lib:spells/cloud_tp_and_invis {owner:"@p",tp:true, sound:true,radius:10,has_invis:true,invis_time:3}```

(updated in v1.0)
# Using the library If using the library, please add it as a dependency, whether your project is a datapack or mod. Do **NOT** just copy the files inside. Feel free to use as many of my spells as you want, and add an interesting, unique way to cast them. You can even use them in ways other than spells. Before using it, remember to understand how the command arguments work and interact. For example, it won't work with @s (even when you run it yourself) or a selector without quotes (owner:Name works, owner:@p doesn't work, owner:"@p" works). You also need to run the command with every argument, even if one like has_invis in cloud_tp_and_invis cancels out others (like invis_time). Try the example commands in the spell list to understand each one. Also note that using a spell will cancel out active spells of that type (for example, if one player casts lightning_strike then another casts it before the first player is struck, only the second player will get struck.) However, one command can target multiple entities (owner:"@e" will cast the spell as *every* entity, but they will all run at the same time and with the same settings.) Since the library uses function macros, heavy use of spells may cause performance issues. If publishing a project using this, it would be helpful to mention this. Note that these macros are only run when spells are active, and not run every tick (updated in v1.0) # Versions Supports Java Edition 1.21.5 - 26.2 # Compatibility Incompatible with anything with the same filenames. Test the commands in singleplayer before using them, to understand how the commands work.
Casting a second spell of the same type before one has ended will overwrite the old spell and transfer it to the new owner, target, or config. **Uses function macros. May affect performance, although I don't know the extent. Test it on the computer running the datapack, and try things such as many spells targetting many entities to determine the effects. If you're using the library, please add this disclaimer.**
