title: ImproveMyMenus
description: A collection of small improvements to various aspects of Minecraft's menus.
body:
![Improve My Menus Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf7e0b55417dd0c2d0f31da7cf31de9b57f9d604.png)

A collection of small improvements to various aspects of Minecraft's menus.

# Why?

My aim with this mod was to improve the user experience of Minecraft's menus
while preserving the Vanilla feel and look.

Most features added by this mod only slightly tweak Vanilla behavior to feel smoother and more responsive.
There are also some bigger additions like indicators, but I tried to avoid big changes away from Vanilla.
Finally, I also added the ability to customize some normally hard-coded key bindings.

![Comparison between Vanilla and ImproveMyMenus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e96370c4123c42e5bb0ded85495694d7739885a7.jpeg)

# Features

This mod contains a variety of features split into different categories.

Feel free to create a [Feature Request](https://github.com/agent-LuluDodo/ImproveMyMenus/issues/new?template=feature-request.yml) if you want to request something new,
or alternatively you can create a [Bug Report](https://github.com/agent-LuluDodo/ImproveMyMenus/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml) if something's broken.

## Cycle Button

### Indicators

These allow you to instantly gauge the number of possible options and 
additionally provide a way to quickly navigate when pressed.

![A screenshot of the "World Type" cycle button with indicators visible.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46abc2de93caeb83f2d47a6dafbac95bc73db9f7.png)

### Colored On/Off text

Helps you to immediately recognize the value of an On/Off button. 

![A screenshot of the "Auto-Jump" cycle button with the word "OFF" colored red.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f24e7a59ac6842a453af58dc07bb7146c4f6e35.png)

### Switches

Transforms buttons that only contain the word ON or OFF into simpler, more recognizable switches.

![A screenshot of a switch in the on position](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a288221a2d89e230acc29162d8e68fae5d81676.png)

## Sliders

### Indicators

Sliders with few values will have indicators, helping you use them.

![A screenshot of the "Profile" slider with an indicator visible.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/22206d9fd603e9396e5b7791d64ad6997790a3db_0.webp)

### Snapping

Vanilla has a 600ms delay before snapping for some sliders.
ImproveMyMenus removes that delay making sliders feel more responsive.

|                | Comparison                                                                                                       |
|----------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Vanilla        | ![A screenshot of the "Biome Blend" slider with Vanilla snapping.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2227d2a1a5bcad4d9dc1cff53481fef16543d12.gif)         |
| ImproveMyMenus | ![A screenshot of the "Biome Blend" slider with improved snapping.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/72128bbd151dc0a9a255dacdf28a8c286953f6b2.gif) |

### Spacing

Vanilla leaves big gaps at the edges of sliders, which can act unintuitively.

|                | Comparison                                                                                             |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Vanilla        | ![A screenshot of the "Mipmap Levels" slider with area spacing.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/689bf7eb905fc4341c5bfb5335cfdf05d5d9b635_0.webp)     |
| ImproveMyMenus | ![A screenshot of the "Mipmap Levels" slider with visual spacing.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5151df78c81f607bdfce8caac1de3564b3ed332_0.webp) |

## Cursor

The cursor doesn't lose its arrow shape when dragging a slider or scrollbar outside its area.

## Improved Debug Options

Added translations for debug options, 
redesigned the tri-state toggle and 
restores the previous screen upon closing the settings.

![A screenshot of the improved "Debug Options" screen.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ed710ca26ab01cd450fb72b56ad9701acc7c9c4.jpeg)

## Improved Social Interactions

Replaced buttons emulating tabs with proper tabs.

![A screenshot of the improved "Social Interactions" screen.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/743b32d8a803297fb0c805a0fccbfe771b4aa9f0.jpeg)

## High Contrast Support

Built-in support for the "High Contrast" Vanilla resource pack.

![A screenshot of the "Video Settings" screen with the "High Contrast" resource pack enabled.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5f25e6751ba2aa3281fe35a69006f61d913f26b.png)

## Customization

Every visual change can be modified using a resource pack. None of them are hard-coded.
The "Debug Options" translations are extendable using a resource pack, which means,
you can add additional translations specific to other mods.
Furthermore, tooltips are supported.

Check out the [Resource Packs](https://github.com/agent-LuluDodo/ImproveMyMenus/wiki/Resource-Packs) for more information,
on how to customize ImproveMyMenus.

## And a lot more..

# Configuration

It's recommended to install [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) in order to access the mod's configuration screen.

Without Mod Menu you can also access the config by running the command `/improvemymenus-config`.

![A screenshot of the "Improve My Menus Config" screen.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d5516a3104042084c99115c183ba063897e2f50.jpeg)

Check out [Configuration](https://github.com/agent-LuluDodo/ImproveMyMenus/wiki/Configuration),
if you are interested in detailed explanations of every config option. 

# Feedback

Since my goal is to improve user experience with Minecraft's menus,
I would greatly appreciate feedback.
Feel free to fill out this [short form](https://forms.gle/7f7TYWbX2aogkBnu8) if you're interested in providing feedback.

[![© agent_LuluDodo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20acd8e24e5466dbdf5d4d85df3b16e1674cecab.png)](https://github.com/agent-LuluDodo/ImproveMyMenus?tab=MIT-1-ov-file)

title: No Anvil Expensive
description: Fixes the "Too Expensive!" anvil bug.
body:
# 🔨 NoAnvilExpensive — Break the Anvil Limits!

Have you ever spent hours grinding for perfect enchantments in your personal survival world, only to place your favorite netherite sword into an anvil and see those frustrating red words: **"Too Expensive!"**?

In vanilla Minecraft, the game imposes an arbitrary 40-level limit on anvil operations. Every time you repair an item or add an enchantment, its hidden "prior work penalty" increases. Eventually, the game completely locks you out, forcing you to watch your legendary gear break forever.

**NoAnvilExpensive** is a lightweight Fabric mod designed specifically for **Singleplayer** and **LAN** play. It completely deletes this restriction from the internal game logic, allowing you and your friends to use anvils without any limits!

---

## 🚀 Key Features

* **Complete Cap Removal:** Completely eradicates the vanilla 40-level restriction. If an operation costs 42, 75, or 120 levels, the anvil will let you do it, provided you have the experience.
* **Infinite Gear Longevity:** Repair your favorite armor, tools, and weapons an infinite number of times. You will never have to craft a replacement piece of gear just because an anvil rejected it.
* **Ultimate Enchantment Combining:** Want to combine five different enchanted books to create the ultimate bow or helmet? Go right ahead. The mod dynamically handles the scaling cost without ever cutting you off.
* **LAN Multiplayer Support:** Open your world to your friends and play together! As long as everyone has the mod installed, everyone can enjoy unlimited anvil repairs.

---

## 🎮 How It Changes Your Experience

Without this mod, you are forced to use hyper-specific, confusing enchantment order guides just to avoid hitting the cap. If you make a mistake, your hard-earned item is permanently ruined. 

With **NoAnvilExpensive**, you can experience your world with true freedom:
* **Endgame Security:** Your god-tier armor sets are safe forever. As long as you have an experience farm in your world, you can maintain your gear indefinitely.
* **Stress-Free Enchanting:** Order no longer matters. Combine books in whatever way is convenient for you.
* **Co-op Ready:** Perfect for small private sessions when you open your world to LAN to play with a friend.

---

## 🛠 Technical Specifications & Requirements

| Detail | Specification |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Mod Loader** | Fabric |
| **Supported Game Versions** | 1.21.4, 1.21.8, 1.21.11 |
| **Environment** | Client & Server (Integrated LAN) |

> ⚠️ **Important Requirement for LAN:** 
> If you open your world for friends to play over the local network (LAN), **every player** joining your world must have this mod installed in their game. 
> 
> *(Note: This mod is optimized for Singleplayer/LAN worlds and is not meant for dedicated standalone servers).*

title: MYTHIC MOUNTAIN
description: Dungeon & Structure Packs: Mods like When Dungeons Arise or Trek scatter massive castles, ruined ships, and intricate wizard towers across specific biomes.
body: The magic of Minecraft's world generation relies on a simple, tiered relationship:Biomes (The Foundation): Biomes dictate the climate, geography, block palette, and atmosphere (e.g., Deserts, Jungles, Mangrove Swamps). They determine where you are and what raw resources are available.Structures (The Points of Interest): Structures are spawned inside specific biomes to give players a destination. They provide visual storytelling, immediate shelter, and unique puzzles or dangers.Adventure (The Gameplay Loop): Adventure is the player's interaction with the other two pillars. It’s the act of gearing up, traveling across biomes, conquering a structure, and claiming rewards that allow you to explore even further.2. Iconic Combinations (Vanilla Minecraft)Certain biomes are famous specifically because of the unique adventure opportunities and structures they host:Biome TypeAssociated StructureKey Adventure / ThreatUnique RewardsDeep DarkAncient CityDodging the Warden via stealthEcho Shards, Swift Sneak, Notch ApplesOcean (Deep/Warm)Ocean Monument / RuinsUnderwater mining, drowning, Mining FatigueSponge, Prismarine, Armor Trims, Sniffer EggsDesert / BadlandsDesert Pyramid / Trail RuinsAvoiding TNT traps, careful brushing/archaeologyPottery Sherds, Diamonds, Enchanted BooksNether (Various)Nether Fortress / Bastion RemnantPiglin Brute combat, navigating lava hazardsBlaze Rods, Netherite Upgrades, Piglin TrimsThe End (Outer Islands)End CityShulker levitation, parkour challenges, void fallsElytra, Shulker Boxes, Dragon Head3. The Adventure Loop: Risk vs. RewardThe dynamic between these features creates a classic progression system:Preparation: You harvest resources from friendly biomes (like Plains or Forests) to craft armor, weapons, and food.Exploration: You brave harsh environmental biomes (like Frozen Oceans or Jagged Peaks) mapping out the world.Conquest: You locate and infiltrate a structure (like a Woodland Mansion or a Trial Chamber), testing your combat and puzzle-solving skills.Upgrading: You use the rare loot found in those structures (like Elytra, Netherite, or unique enchantments) to make future exploration vastly easier.4. Expanding with Mods and Add-onsBecause this loop is so satisfying, it is the most heavily modded aspect of Minecraft. If you are looking at community content, packs usually focus on expanding these three elements simultaneously:World-Gen Overhauls: Datapacks/mods like Terralith, Tectonic, or Biomes O' Plenty completely change the geography, adding grand canyons, volcanic plains, or realistic mountain ranges.Dungeon & Structure Packs: Mods like When Dungeons Arise or Trek scatter massive castles, ruined ships, and intricate wizard towers across specific biomes.Bedrock Add-ons: Modern Bedrock marketplace packs (like the Biomes + Structures add-on by Mythicus Studios) seamlessly inject custom biomes like Ash Forests and Enchanted Woodlands directly into the base game, complete with balanced loot and custom mob variants.Summary Takeaway: Biomes set the stage, structures provide the goals, and adventure is the story you create while moving between them.

The Hellcat recipe requires 6 Netherite Ingots, 1 Nether Star, 1 Dragon Head, and 1 Stick.

Ability reference
Ability	Effect
Fire	Sets target on fire for 5 seconds
Explosive	2-block radius explosion on hit, no terrain damage
Wither	Applies Wither II for 5 seconds
Poison	Applies Poison II for 5 seconds
Slow	Applies Slowness III for 4 seconds
Mark	Applies Glowing for 10 seconds — visible through walls
Knockback	Pushes target along the shot direction with per-gun strength
Piercing	Single shot can damage the first 2 targets in line
Soul Drain	Shooter heals 1 HP per hit
Void	Teleports the target 12 blocks straight up
Crafting recipes
The mod ships with a full recipe book — open the recipe book or use JEI/REI to view every recipe in-game. All ingredients are vanilla Minecraft items.

Requirements
Minecraft 1.21.11 (internal version 26.1.2)
Minecraft Forge 64.0.4 or higher
Java 25 (Mojang bundles this with the vanilla launcher; custom launchers need a JDK 25 install)
Installation
Install Forge 64.0.4+ for Minecraft 1.21.11.
Drop infernoguns-1.0.0.jar into your mods/ folder.
Launch the game.
Server install is identical — same jar, same mods/ folder. Required on both sides.

Compatibility
Works with vanilla Minecraft and any resource pack.
No mixins, no coremods, no access transformers — pure Forge events and registries.
No conflicts expected with mods that don't modify the item registry or player damage sources.
Known limitations
Bullets are a single universal type — there are no specialty rounds (incendiary, explosive, etc.). All gun abilities live on the gun, not the bullet.
Guns are item-based, not entity-based — bullets are hitscan and do not create projectile entities, so they cannot be deflected, caught, or dispensed.
No reloading mechanic. Durability and ammo are tracked separately.

Credits
Code, models, and integration written by the author with assistance from Anthropic's Claude AI.
Item textures hand-drawn by the author.

title: Paper Plane
description: Item-driven FTB Essentials teleport requests from craftable paper planes.
body:
# Paper Plane

**Send FTB Essentials teleport requests from a small craftable paper plane.**

Paper Plane adds an item-driven player picker for `/tpa` without replacing FTB Essentials' own teleport flow. The sender chooses an online player from an FTB Library screen; FTB Essentials creates the actual request and shows its normal clickable accept/deny chat prompt to the target player.

![Choose a player with the Paper Plane UI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ead9jIT4/images/ba4bada3211219cb16eaf0fb6c1d2433b181f746_350.webp)

## What it does

- Adds **Paper Plane**, **Paper Plane That Can't Fly?**, and **Ender Paper Plane** items.
- Right-click opens a simple FTB Library player picker.
- The selected target receives FTB Essentials' standard TPA request message.
- Shift-right-click throws the paper plane as a slow arrow-like projectile.
- Drop a Paper Plane into water to turn it into **Paper Plane That Can't Fly?** through a Lychee item-inside-liquid recipe.

![Lychee water recipe in JEI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ead9jIT4/images/3b3c34a32702ccf76a5a359ee96bf634d24007ad_350.webp)
- Ender Paper Plane can send requests without consuming the item.

![Paper Plane items in a Minecraft inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ead9jIT4/images/6d985b40655e5dab6f9494b1323bcc55471a694a_350.webp)

## Paper Plane recipe

Craft a Paper Plane from five pieces of paper.

![Paper Plane JEI recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ead9jIT4/images/09508b93a61ec294579aede795214711fd594dc1_350.webp)

Normal paper planes and Paper Plane That Can't Fly? are consumed after the target accepts the FTB Essentials TPA request. FTB Essentials owns the accept, deny, warmup, cooldown, and final teleport behavior.

![Paper Plane in hand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ead9jIT4/images/1a72ef13ddb4dece591c83995a63e0f8e135b9ae_350.webp)

## Ender Paper Plane recipe

Craft an Ender Paper Plane with eight ender pearls around one Paper Plane.

![Ender Paper Plane JEI recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ead9jIT4/images/88434938a6cfdf7d5d77494a40d3897c614a48a3_350.webp)

The Ender Paper Plane is reusable, so it can send FTB Essentials TPA requests without being consumed.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge
- FTB Essentials
- FTB Library
- Architectury API
- Lychee
- Kiwi

FTB Essentials, FTB Library, and Lychee are required on both client and server. Architectury API is required by FTB Library; Kiwi is required by Lychee. JEI is not required; it is used only for the recipe screenshots on this page.

## Source and issues

- Source: https://github.com/rinchanai/paper-plane
- Issues: https://github.com/rinchanai/paper-plane/issues

- Replaces bedrock with deepslate
- Correct top and side textures
- Seamless underground appearance
- Vanilla-friendly design
- Clean and minimal style
- No unnecessary visual clutter

## Included Changes
- Bedrock → Deepslate texture replacement
- Matching top texture
- Matching side textures

- Download the pack
- Move the ZIP file into your resourcepacks folder
- Enable the pack in Minecraft
- Load a world and enjoy the new look

This pack only changes the visual appearance of bedrock. It does not affect gameplay, world generation or block properties.

title: Ordinal
description: Track unique player join order and recognize your veteran community members! Assigns sequential member IDs with full PlaceholderAPI support for custom tablists and scoreboards.
body:
Ordinal

Track unique player join order and recognize your veteran community members! Assigns sequential member IDs with full PlaceholderAPI support for custom tablists and scoreboards.

*** **Ordinal** is a lightweight **utility plugin** designed to assign persistent, **sequential join IDs** (Ordinal Ranks) to every player on your server. This plugin is ideal for servers wanting to implement a **seniority system** to recognize long-time members, display distinct ranks in chat, or simply maintain an organized player database. ### Features Ordinal handles seniority tracking with a focus on these core functions: * It assigns unique **sequential IDs** (e.g., `#1`, `#67`) based on strict join order. * It includes a **smart migration** system that automatically calculates and backfills seniority for existing players based on historical join dates. * It features native **PlaceholderAPI** support to display seniority ranks using `%ordinal_rank%`. * It supports fully configurable messages using [MiniMessage](https://docs.papermc.io/adventure/minimessage/format) formatting. ### Prerequisites To use this plugin, your server must be running **Paper**, **Purpur**, or **Folia** on `1.21` or higher. It requires **Java 21**. #### Dependencies * [PlaceholderAPI](https://placeholderapi.com/) ### Documentation & Support For a complete guide on features, commands, and configuration, please visit our [Wiki](https://docs.maboroshi.org/). If you have questions or need to report a bug, join our [Discord server](https://discord.maboroshi.org) or open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/MaboroshiKobo/Ordinal/issues). ### Statistics This plugin utilizes [bStats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/Ordinal/28615) to collect anonymous usage metrics. ![bStats Metrics](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/Ordinal.svg)

**NoLeavesDecay** is a simple lightweight plugin that stops leaves from naturally decaying in all worlds.

It is meant for servers that want to preserve custom builds, trees, forests, spawn areas, and decorative landscaping without leaves disappearing over time. This makes it useful for hubs, RPG areas, creative servers, adventure maps, and any world where you want leaves to stay exactly how they were built.

The plugin includes simple commands to turn leaf decay blocking on or off at any time, check the current status, and reload the config. It also supports a permission node so you can control command access with permission plugins like LuckPerms.

* Disables natural leaf decay in all worlds
* Lightweight and straightforward
* Toggle leaf decay blocking with commands

* LuckPerms-friendly permission node
* Good for hubs, spawn builds, decorative maps, and protected environments

title: ChatNext
description: The next generation of Minecraft chat management. Multilingual, private, and highly customizable. Build the chat your community deserves with ChatNext.
body:
# ChatNext

The definitive chat management solution for modern Minecraft servers. ChatNext is a lightweight, efficient, and highly customizable chat plugin designed to replace cumbersome, outdated chat managers. Built from the ground up for compatibility with Spigot 1.20+, it offers the perfect balance between professional features and simplicity.

## Features

ChatNext launches with a robust core set of features designed to improve communication.

### Languages
ChatNext is multilingual. Out of the box, we support English (en), Spanish (es), and Portuguese (pt). All messages are separated into language files in the `/idiomas/` folder. This allows administrators to easily change the server language in the `config.yml` or create translations.

### Format
* **Placeholders:** Define your chat structure using `{prefix}`, `{player}`, and `{message}`.
* **Configurable:** Control exactly how the chat looks via the `config.yml`. Example: `&8[&bPrefix&8] {player} &8» &f{message}`.

### Private
* **System:** Includes native `/msg` (aliases: `tell`, `w`, `m`) and `/reply` (`r`) commands.
* **Tracking:** Conversations use player UUIDs, preventing memory leaks.
* **Toggleable:** Messaging can be disabled entirely via the config.
* **Block:** A clean prevention system stops players from messaging themselves.

### Alerts
* **Silent:** Completely disable Minecraft's default yellow join/quit messages.
* **Custom:** Define unique, colorful, and localized messages in the `config.yml` that appear when a player enters or leaves.

## Commands

### Core
* `/chatnext` (Alias: `/cn`): Base command.
* `/chatnext reload`: Reloads `config.yml` and language files instantly. Permission: `chatnext.admin`

### Messages
* `/msg <player> <message>`: Send a PM. Permission: `chatnext.msg`
* `/reply <message>`: Reply to the last conversation. Permission: `chatnext.msg`

## Installation

1. Download the `ChatNext-1.0.0.jar`.
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart your server.
4. Edit the generated `config.yml` to set your desired language.

```yaml
# Available languages in the 'idiomas' folder: en, es, pt
language: "en"

# Default Chat Format
chat-format: "{prefix} {player} &8» &f{message}"

private-messages:
  enabled: true
  format-send: "&8[&dMe &5-> &d{receiver}&8] &f{message}"
  format-receive: "&8[&d{sender} &5-> &dMe&8] &f{message}"

join-quit-messages:
  enabled: true
  join: "&8[&a+&8] &7{player} joined the server."
  quit: "&8[&c-&8] &7{player} left the server."

title: Targeting
description: Adds a feature to allow users to execute the command on the target who used the redstone (requires a command block)
body:
# Targeting 🎯

## Execute commands on the actual player who triggered them.

## Overview

Targeting introduces a new selector, @t, designed to solve one of Minecraft’s long-standing limitations: reliably identifying the player who activated a redstone-triggered command.

In vanilla behavior, command blocks triggered by buttons, pressure plates, or other redstone inputs lack direct context about who caused the activation. This mod bridges that gap by dynamically binding the triggering player to command execution.

## Key Feature:
@t Selector
Targets the player responsible for triggering the command block, whether via:
Button press
Lever toggle
Pressure plate
Any redstone interaction linked to a command block

## Why This Matters?

Without Targeting, mapmakers and server developers often rely on:

- Proximity-based selectors (@p)
- Complex scoreboards
- Detection loops

These approaches are unreliable, inefficient, or unnecessarily complex.

@t provides precision, simplicity, and performance in a single selector.

Example Usage
Scenario: Teleport the player who pressed a button

Command Block Command:

/tp @t 100 100 100

What Happens:

Player presses a button connected to the command block
The command executes
Only that specific player is teleported to (100, 100, 100)
Comparison
Selector	Behavior
@p	Nearest player (can be incorrect)
@a	All players
@s	Command executor (not useful in redstone context)
@t	✅ Player who triggered the command

title: DeathBeacon
description: A lightweight Paper plugin that marks death locations with infinite particle beams and dynamic Boss Bar timers for effortless item recovery.
body:
**DeathBeacon** is a lightweight Minecraft Paper plugin that creates a highly visible particle beam and a dynamic timer at the location of a player's death, making item recovery stress-free and reliable. ### Key Features * **Infinite Particle Beams:** A vertical beam of light marks your death spot, visible from any height (even if you died deep underground). * **Dynamic Boss Bar Timer:** A visual countdown appears at the top of your screen, showing exactly how long you have before your items despawn. * **Multi-Death Support:** If you die multiple times, the plugin tracks every location. Old beams remain active until you clear them. * **Smart Item Recovery:** Beacons extinguish automatically as soon as you gather your remains. * **Customizable Aesthetics:** Use commands to change the colors of both the beacon particles and the Boss Bar. * **Fully Server-Side:** No client mods required. ### Functionality In vanilla Minecraft, finding your items after death is often a race against a hidden clock. **DeathBeacon** removes the guesswork. When a player dies, a particle beam is spawned that reaches the top of the world, and a Boss Bar tracks the despawn timer. Unlike other plugins, **DeathBeacon** supports multiple death spots. If you die on your way back to your items, the new death won't overwrite the old one. The Boss Bar will track your most recent death, but all previous beams stay active until the items are recovered or they despawn naturally. ### Commands * `/db set beacon color ` – Change the color of the particle beam. * `/db set bar color ` – Change the color of the Boss Bar. * `/db set duration ` – Adjust the despawn timer length. * `/db clear ` – (Admin) Manually remove all active beacons for a player. * `/db reload` – Reload the configuration. ### Installation **DeathBeacon** is a server-side plugin. Simply drop it in your `plugins` folder and restart your server. No client installation is necessary. ### Disclaimer **DeathBeacon** is designed for Paper 1.21+. While it is highly optimized, having dozens of active beacons simultaneously may impact client-side FPS depending on the player's hardware. Admins can use the `/db clear` command to manage excessive beacons if necessary.

🛠 Support & Bug Reports

Found a bug or need help setting up the plugin?
Report issues directly on Discord.

title: After Fifteen
description: The timer adds a layer of difficulty to progression - when it runs out, radiation will cover the entire surface for a long time, disrupting any surface-level development.
body:
# AfterFifteen - Nuclear Apocalypse Survival

**AfterFifteen** is a hardcore survival mod that adds a personalized radiation system for each player. Every player has their own timer, their own radiation level, and their own consequences.

## 🌍 The Cycle

The mod works in a three-phase cycle for each player independently:

### ⏰ Phase 1: PROTECTION (Default: 15 minutes)
After first join, you have **15 minutes** to prepare. Gather resources, build a shelter, or dig deep. The countdown has begun...

### ☢️ Phase 2: RADIATION (Dimension dependent)
- **Overworld:** 7 days
- **Nether:** 21 days  
- **End:** 28 days

During this phase, the surface is contaminated! You'll accumulate radiation based on your height:
- **Above 64 blocks:** ×2.0 radiation (MOST DANGEROUS)
- **51-64 blocks:** ×1.5 radiation (DANGEROUS)
- **Below 50 blocks:** SAFE ZONE (no radiation)

### ⏳ Phase 3: IDLE
After radiation ends, you enter an idle phase. No timers, no radiation - just hallucinations from what you've experienced...

## 🩻 Radiation Sickness (10 stages)

As your radiation level increases, you'll experience worsening effects:

| Stage | Radiation | Effects |
|-------|-----------|---------|
| 1 | 5-14% | Nausea, Weakness I |
| 2 | 15-24% | Weakness II, Hunger I |
| 3 | 25-34% | Slowness I, Hunger II |
| 4 | 35-44% | Mining Fatigue I, Slowness II |
| 5 | 45-54% | Blindness, 1.0❤️ damage |
| 6 | 55-64% | Poison I, 1.5❤️ damage |
| 7 | 65-74% | Unluck, 2.0❤️ damage |
| 8 | 75-84% | Wither I, 2.5❤️ damage |
| 9 | 85-94% | Darkness, 3.0❤️ damage |
| 10 | 95%+ | DEATH APPROACHING! 4.0❤️ damage |

## 👻 Hallucinations

When radiation drops to zero, you'll experience **2 hours of hallucinations**:
- Fake mob sounds (zombies, skeletons, creepers)
- Herobrine sightings
- Explosion sounds
- Item pickup/drop sounds
- Chat messages from "unknown players"
- Random slot swapping
- And much more...

## 🎮 Commands

(Global command - in development, use {Nickname})

### Player Commands (`/af`)
- `/af status [player]` - Check your (or another player's) radiation status
  - Shows current phase
  - Time remaining
  - Accumulation rate per second
  - Current location

### Admin Commands (`/afc`)

#### Global Settings
- `/afc set protected global <time>` - Set default protection time
- `/afc set radiation global <time>` - Set default radiation time for all dimensions
- `/afc set multiplier accumulation global <value>` - Set global accumulation rate
- `/afc set multiplier decay global <value>` - Set global decay rate
- `/afc set dimension overworld/nether/end <time>` - Set radiation time per dimension

#### Player-specific Settings
- `/afc set protected <player> <time>` - Set protection time for specific player
- `/afc set radiation <player> <time>` - Set radiation time for specific player  
- `/afc set multiplier accumulation <player> <value>` - Personal accumulation multiplier
- `/afc set multiplier decay <player> <value>` - Personal decay multiplier

#### Information Commands
- `/afc get protected [global/player]` - Get protection time
- `/afc get radiation [global/player]` - Get radiation time
- `/afc get multiplier accumulation [global/player]` - Get accumulation multiplier
- `/afc get multiplier decay [global/player]` - Get decay multiplier
- `/afc get dimension overworld/nether/end` - Get dimension radiation times

#### Reset Commands
- `/afc reset player <player>` - Reset player to global defaults
- `/afc reset all` - Reset ALL online players

### Settings Commands (`/afsettings`)
- `/afsettings notifications on/off` - Toggle chat notifications
- `/afsettings status` - Check your current settings

## ⚙️ Configuration

All values can be changed in-game via commands or in the config file:
- Protection time
- Radiation time per dimension
- Accumulation/decay multipliers
- Hallucination settings

## 🌟 Features

✅ **Per-player timers** - Each player has their own independent cycle  
✅ **Persistent data** - Progress saves when you log out  
✅ **Multiplier system** - Personal and global multipliers  
✅ **Height-based radiation** - Go deep to stay safe!  
✅ **10-stage sickness system** - Increasingly dangerous effects  
✅ **Hallucinations** - Psychological horror after radiation exposure  
✅ **Fully localized** - English and Russian supported  
✅ **Admin friendly** - Full command control  
✅ **Lightweight** - No performance impact

## 📥 Installation

1. Install Minecraft Forge 1.20.1
2. Download the mod
3. Place in `.minecraft/mods` folder
4. Launch the game!

## 📝 Notes

- Timers only run when you're online
- Data saves when you log out
- You can customize everything via commands
- Safe zone is Y-level 50 and below
- Hallucinations can be disabled in config

## 📢 Feedback & Suggestions

You can also suggest ideas for future updates on our Discord server

title: VectorGuard
description: VectorGuard is a 100% server-side anti-cheat plugin focused exclusively on combat detection. It uses packet-level analysis, tick-based telemetry, and multi-signal detection to identify cheaters with high accuracy and minimal false positives.
body:
# VectorGuard

**Production-grade combat anti-cheat for Paper servers.**

VectorGuard is a 100% server-side anti-cheat plugin focused exclusively on **combat detection**. It uses packet-level analysis, tick-based telemetry, and multi-signal detection to identify cheaters with high accuracy and minimal false positives.

Built from the ground up for modern Paper servers (1.20.x–1.21.x) with Java 21.

---

## Product Overview

VectorGuard is a combat-only anti-cheat designed to catch the most common PvP exploits while staying light on performance and fair on legitimate players. Every check uses multiple independent signals (rotation, timing, movement, cooldown usage, and hit validation) and applies buffered violations with decay, so one-off spikes do not punish normal players. Ping-aware thresholds and packet-timing compensation reduce false positives for high-latency players.


Administrators get a fast response workflow: clickable in-game alerts with action buttons, a threat score that aggregates risk across checks, and a visual report command for quick evidence review. A built-in GUI lets staff adjust thresholds, toggle checks, and tune punishments without editing files or restarting the server. Alerts can also be mirrored to Discord for off-server monitoring.

VectorGuard ships as a single jar with no external dependencies. PacketEvents is embedded, and the plugin runs entirely server-side with no client mod required.

---


## Features

### Detection Engine
- **19 combat checks** targeting the most common cheat modules including Mace PvP exploits, crystal PvP automation, bow manipulation, and inventory exploits
- **Multi-signal compound detection** — each check combines multiple independent signals for high confidence
- **Buffered violation system** with configurable decay — prevents single-tick flukes from triggering punishments
- **Latency compensation** — all checks account for player ping to avoid false-flagging high-ping players
- **Tick-based analytics** with per-player position history and rotation profiling

### Admin Experience
- **Clickable chat alerts** with action buttons: `[TP]` `[VL]` `[DBG]` `[RPT]`
- **Threat score system** — composite 0–100% risk assessment across all checks
- **Visual threat reports** via `/vg report <player>`
- **Sound alerts** for online admins (configurable)
- **Discord webhook integration** for off-server monitoring
- **In-game GUI** for editing thresholds, toggling checks, and tuning punishments

### Architecture
- **100% server-side** — no client mod required
- **PacketEvents** embedded and shaded — zero external dependencies
- **Modular check system** — each check is independent and fully configurable
- **Performance profiler** built-in (`/vg profile`)
- **Multi-version support** — Paper 1.20.x through 1.21.x

---

## Checks

### Combat

| Check | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Aimbot** | Detects snap rotations, acceleration spikes, over-smooth curves, and precision patterns consistent with aim assistance |
| **TriggerBot** | Identifies automated attack timing with near-zero reaction delay after crosshair alignment |
| **AutoTotem** | Catches unrealistically fast offhand totem swaps during lethal damage windows |
| **Reach** | Eye-to-hitbox distance verification with ping, sprint, and movement leniency |
| **Velocity** | Detects Anti-Knockback by verifying displacement after server-sent velocity packets |
| **Criticals** | Identifies fake critical hits via spoofed position packets (abnormal crit rate, ground-flag oscillation, tiny Y offsets) |
| **AutoClicker** | Catches robotic click patterns through timing variance analysis (stddev, CPS, coefficient of variation) |
| **KillAura** | Detects multi-target attacks, angle mismatch, wall attacks, and perfect cooldown abuse |
| **Sprint** | Identifies backwards sprinting, KeepSprint, and sprint-toggle patterns around attacks |
| **MaceSpoof** | Detects spoofed fall-distance position packets for fake Mace smash damage (Criticals-Mace exploit) |
| **MaceNoFall** | Catches NoFall + Mace combos: players deal Mace fall-bonus damage but evade fall damage on landing |
| **MaceSwap** | Identifies automated weapon switching to Mace during falls (AttributeSwap / auto-swap patterns) |
| **CrystalAura** | Detects automated crystal place-and-break cycles (superhuman crystal attacks/sec, place→break pairing, fast-break ratio) |
| **BowManipulation** | Catches BowSpam and BowAimbot via charge variance analysis, fire rate, and abnormal hit rates at distance |
| **InventoryCleaner** | Identifies inhuman inventory manipulation speed (AutoTotem swaps, chest stealing, combat inventory use) |
| **AutoWeapon** | Detects automated weapon switching around attacks (pre-attack swap ratio, A→B→A swap-back patterns) |
| **HitboxExpand** | Catches expanded entity hitboxes via lateral offset analysis and edge-hit rate tracking |
| **AutoArmor** | Detects automated armor equipping during combat (rapid armor clicks, anti-break durability swaps) |

### Packet

| Check | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Timer** | Detects game speed manipulation via packet rate analysis (burst, sustained, and average rate monitoring) |

---

## Requirements

- **Java 21+**
- **Paper 1.20.x – 1.21.x** (or forks: Purpur, Pufferfish, etc.)
- No external dependencies — PacketEvents is embedded

---

## Installation

1. Download `VectorGuard-x.y.z.jar`
2. Place it in your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Start or restart the server
4. Edit `plugins/VectorGuard/config.yml` to customize thresholds
5. Use `/vg reload` to apply changes without restarting

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/vg reload` | Reload configuration |
| `/vg debug <player\|*>` | Toggle debug output for a player (or all) |
| `/vg vl <player>` | View violation levels |
| `/vg report <player>` | Generate a visual threat report |
| `/vg gui` | Open the in-game config editor |
| `/vg profile [seconds]` | Run performance profiler |

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|------------|---------|-------------|
| `vectorguard.admin` | op | Access to all `/vg` commands and GUI |
| `vectorguard.alert` | op | Receive in-game cheat alerts with action buttons |
| `vectorguard.debug.view` | op | View debug output |
| `vectorguard.report` | true | Allows using `/vg report` to generate threat reports |

---

## Configuration

All settings are in `plugins/VectorGuard/config.yml`.

### Check Configuration
Each check has:
- `enabled` — toggle the check on/off
- `buffer-threshold` — buffer must exceed this to flag
- `buffer-decay-per-tick` — buffer decreases each tick
- `vl-per-breach` — violation level added per flag
- `vl-decay-per-tick` — VL decreases each tick
- `thresholds.*` — check-specific tuning values

### Punishment Stages
```yaml
punishments:
  alert-vl: 2.5      # Send alert to admins
  setback-vl: 6.0     # Teleport player to last safe position
  punish-vl: 12.0     # Execute punishment command
  punish-command: "kick %player% Unfair combat behavior detected by VectorGuard."
```

### Discord Webhooks
```yaml
notifications:
  discord:
    enabled: true
    webhook-url: "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/..."
    min-vl: 5.0
    cooldown-ms: 10000
```

### Admin Alerts
```yaml
notifications:
  admin:
    sound-enabled: true
    clickable-actions: true
    show-threat-score: true
```

---

## GUI Config Editor

Run `/vg gui` to open an interactive GUI where you can:
- Toggle checks on/off
- Edit buffer thresholds and VL values
- Adjust punishment thresholds and cooldowns
- Save changes to config and reload

---

## FAQ

**Q: Does this require players to install anything?**
A: No. VectorGuard is 100% server-side.

**Q: Is PacketEvents required as a separate plugin?**
A: No. PacketEvents is embedded inside the VectorGuard jar.

**Q: Does it work with Purpur/Pufferfish/other Paper forks?**
A: Yes, any Paper fork should work.

**Q: Will it conflict with other anti-cheats?**
A: VectorGuard focuses only on combat. It can coexist with movement-focused anti-cheats, but running two combat anti-cheats may cause duplicate flagging.

**Q: How do I reduce false positives?**
A: Increase the `buffer-threshold` and `ping-cutoff-ms` values for checks that are flagging incorrectly. The defaults are tuned conservatively.

title: Botz Guild Manager
description: A mod for MMO style guild managment
body:
BotzGuildz — In-Depth Guild System for Forge Servers
BotzGuildz is a comprehensive, server-focused guild mod for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1. It goes far beyond simple group management — offering guild wars, arena battles, a fully datapack-driven upgrade shop, raid parties, duels, leaderboards, and deep economy integration. Whether you're running a small survival server or a large factions-style community, BotzGuildz gives your players something to work toward together.

🏰 Guilds
Create a guild with a custom name and tag, recruit members, and build your reputation. Guilds earn XP through logins, kills, and war victories — leveling up to unlock more powerful upgrades. Every action is logged in a persistent activity log so leaders always know what's happening.

Custom name + short tag shown in guild chat
Shared guild home teleport with configurable cooldown
Guild Message of the Day (MOTD)
Guild-only and officer-only chat channels (/gc, /goc)
Persistent activity log (last 50 events)
Level 1–25 progression system (configurable cap)
🎖️ Ranks & Permissions
Go beyond "leader/member" with a fully custom rank system. Create as many ranks as you want, assign them any priority, and grant them exactly the permissions they need — nothing more.

Permission nodes: INVITE · KICK · SET_HOME · MANAGE_RANKS · MANAGE_BANK · MANAGE_UPGRADES · MANAGE_ALLIES · DECLARE_WAR · TOGGLE_FF

Default ranks (Leader, Officer, Member, Recruit) are fully customizable and can be supplemented with as many custom ranks as your server needs.

💰 Guild Bank & Economy
Every guild has a shared bank that funds upgrades, wars, and alliances. The bank integrates with Numismatics if installed, or falls back to a built-in physical-item currency system.

Deposit, withdraw, and check balance at any time
Configurable bank cap (upgradeable to 2× or 3× via upgrades)
War wagers are automatically escrowed — locked until the war resolves
All transactions logged to guild history
⚔️ Guild Wars
Declare war on any guild, stake a currency wager, and fight for dominance. Choose your battlefield:

Open World — PvP happens anywhere. No time limit. First guild to deplete the opponent's total lives wins.

Arena Mode — Both guilds teleport into the dedicated guild_arena dimension. A Roman Colosseum is generated automatically. Fight for 5 minutes (configurable). Highest kill count wins.

Configurable lives per player, wager amounts, and cooldowns
War declarations require the opposing guild to accept within 120 seconds
Forfeit option — with the REDUCED_LOSS upgrade, you keep 25% of your wager even when losing
War wins reward the guild with XP and the full escrow pot
🧪 Upgrade System (Datapack-Driven)
The upgrade shop is a fully interactive GUI — a 6-row chest interface with category tabs, multi-page browsing, and live balance display. All upgrades are loaded from datapacks, making the system completely server-customizable without any code changes.

Built-in upgrade categories:

Category	Examples
⚔️ Combat	Damage Boost I/II, Defense I/II, Arena War
🔧 Utility	Member Cap I/II, Chunk Claims, Home Bypass
💰 Economy	Earn Rate I/II, Bank Cap I/II, War Shield
🛡️ Defense	XP Bonus I/II, Reduced War Loss
🔮 Arcane	Alliance System, Custom Chat Color
Upgrade effect types: passive stat modifiers, one-time item rewards, potion effects on purchase, and server command execution. All defined in JSON — no coding required.

🗂️ Full Datapack Guide is available in the wiki — create your own upgrade categories and upgrades with a few JSON files.

🤝 Alliances
Unlock the ALLIANCE upgrade and start forming partnerships with other guilds. Allied guilds cannot hurt each other and are visible in guild info. Maximum alliance count is configurable.

🐉 Raid Parties
Form a raid party before taking on a powerful boss — then let the system handle the rest. Any mob with 50+ hearts (100 HP) of max health automatically qualifies as a boss target. Works with vanilla bosses and any modded mob tuned to that threshold.

Form a party with /raid party create, invite with /raid party invite <player>
First party member to hit the boss claims it for the group
Damage is tracked per player throughout the entire fight
On boss death: normal drops are cancelled and redistributed proportionally by damage dealt
Each player receives their share directly in their inventory
Full summary message: damage dealt, percentage, and item count received
Use /raid party status to see live damage numbers mid-fight
🤺 Duels
Challenge any player to a 1v1 duel with configurable lives and an optional currency wager. A radius enforcement system keeps both players honest — flee the arena and you auto-forfeit.

Optional currency stakes with automatic pot payout to the winner
Configurable lives (1 to 999), accept timeout, and radius limit
Global duel win leaderboard (/duel top)
📊 Leaderboards
/guild top — Top 10 guilds by bank balance
/guild top wars — Top 10 guilds by war wins
/duel top — Top 10 players by duel wins (resolves offline player names)
🔗 FTB Chunks Integration (Optional)
If FTB Chunks is installed, the CHUNK_CLAIM_I and CHUNK_FORCE_LOAD upgrades automatically sync extra claim and force-load slots to the guild's FTB team.

⚙️ Highly Configurable
Nearly every value is adjustable in botzguildz-server.toml:

Currency name, symbol, and item
XP rates for kills, logins, and war wins
Max guild level, member cap, bank cap
War accept timeout, war cooldown, arena duration
Duel timeout and radius
Alliance cap, home cooldown, and more
📋 Requirements
Minecraft: 1.20.1
Forge: 47.4.16+
Java: 17+
FTB Chunks: Optional — for chunk-claim upgrade integration
📖 Wiki & Documentation
Full documentation is available on the GitHub Wiki, including:

Complete command reference
Datapack guide with JSON examples
Configuration reference
Upgrade system details
Built for server communities that want more than just a /clan command.

title: TECH!
description: a tech and magic based modpack.

TECH! is an expansive NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack crafted for players who want the ultimate fusion of advanced industry, deep progression systems, immersive exploration, and a spark of magic. Built around a powerful technological backbone, it delivers a layered experience where automation, engineering, energy production, storage networks, and complex machinery all interconnect into one massive ecosystem of innovation.

At its core, the pack emphasizes large-scale factory building and intelligent automation. You’ll design intricate production lines, manage advanced power systems, and construct highly optimized processing chains using a wide array of industrial and engineering mods. Logistics, storage networks, and machine customization allow you to scale from simple workshops to continent-spanning megabases that run like perfectly tuned engines.

Exploration and worldbuilding are just as important as machinery. Enhanced biomes, structures, relics, artifacts, and progression systems reward curiosity and discovery, while advanced mapping tools ensure you always know where your next expansion site lies. Decorative and building mods provide massive creative freedom, letting you shape your bases into anything from futuristic laboratories to arcane industrial citadels.

Magic exists as a complementary force rather than the main focus. Arcane systems enhance technology, grant powerful abilities, and unlock unique mechanics that blend seamlessly with machines and automation. Equipment upgrades, trinkets, spell systems, and relics add depth to character progression without ever overshadowing the technological theme.

Quality-of-life improvements, performance optimizations, visual upgrades, and interface enhancements ensure the experience feels smooth, polished, and modern even with its enormous content scope. Whether you’re an engineer, explorer, builder, or strategist, TECH! delivers a rich sandbox where every system connects, every discovery matters, and every invention pushes you one step closer to mastering a world powered by both science and wonder.

# 🌲 TimberLegion ### *The Ultimate Realistic Woodcutting Experience* ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0.0-2ecc71?style=for-the-badge&logo=minecraft) ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.13%20--%201.21+-3498db?style=for-the-badge&logo=spigot) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-f1c40f?style=for-the-badge)
**TimberLegion** revolutionizes survival gameplay by turning woodcutting into a satisfying, physics-based event.
*Say goodbye to floating tree tops and hello to immersive forestry!*
สวัสดี(ติดต่อได้ดิสคอร์ดfov23)

## 🔥 Key Features ### 🪓 **Realistic Mechanics** - **Chain Reaction:** Chop the bottom log, and the whole tree topples. - **Top-Down Breaking:** Logs break from top to bottom for visual realism. - **Smart Leaf Decay:** Leaves vanish smoothly around the tree. - **Auto-Replant:** Automatically replants saplings so your forests never run dry. ### 🎁 **RPG Reward System** *Turn lumberjacking into a treasure hunt!* - **Custom Loot:** Configurable drops from leaves (Apples, Sticks, or even Diamonds!). - **Biome Specific:** Different rewards for Overworld trees vs Nether fungus. - **Mythical Drops:** Rare drops trigger global sound effects and chat announcements. ### 🐔 **The "Chicken Bomb" Event** - **Easter Egg:** A configurable, rare chance (default 1%) for a tree to explode into a flock of glowing chickens! - **Fun Factor:** Adds a surprise element to the grind. ### ⚙️ **Player & Admin Friendly** - **In-Game GUI:** Players can toggle features personally via `/tc gui`. - **Admin Panel:** Edit config settings directly in-game without restarting. - **Safety:** Option to require sneaking (Shift) or double-break confirmation to prevent accidents. --- ## ✅ Compatibility & Support ### 🖥️ Server Software - **Supported:** Spigot, Paper, Purpur, Pufferfish - **Recommended:** Paper or Purpur (for best performance) ### 🎮 Minecraft Versions - **Range:** 1.13 - 1.21+ - **Note:** Fully supports new blocks like Cherry, Mangrove, and Nether stems. ### 🛡️ Protection Integration TimberLegion automatically respects region protections. title: XTpaz
description: XTpa is a Minecraft TPA plugin that lets players send teleport requests (/tpa, /tpahere) with auto-accept, GUI confirmation, cooldowns, and movement cancellation. It includes configurable messages, sounds, and an admin reload command
body:
# **XTpaz – TPA Plugin**

XTpaz is a TPA (Teleport Ask) plugin for Paper/Spigot 1.20+. It provides simple, configurable player teleports with an optional confirmation GUI and strong anti-abuse options.

---

## 🔥 Key Features

### 👤 User experience
- **Confirmation GUI:** Confirm or cancel before sending a request; shows target world, ping, and player head.
- **Teleport countdown:** Configurable delay with action bar and sounds.
- **Movement check:** Teleport is cancelled if the player moves during the countdown.
- **Sounds:** Separate sounds for request sent/received, accept/deny, teleport, cooldown, etc.

### ⚙️ Requests & toggles
- **TPA & TPAHere:** Request to go to another player or bring them to you.
- **Auto-accept:** `/tpauto` and `/tpahereauto` for trusted players.
- **TPA toggle:** `/tpatoggle` to disable receiving requests.
- **Confirm toggle:** `/tpaconfirmtoggle` to switch between GUI and direct requests.

### 📋 Safety & limits
- **Request expiry:** Requests automatically expire (default 60 seconds).
- **Cooldowns:** Configurable cooldown between requests.
- **Offline cleanup:** Pending requests cleared when players quit.

### 🔧 Backend
- **Configurable messages:** Hex color support and placeholders (`{player}`, `{target}`, `{time}`).
- **Live reload:** `/xtpaz reload` reloads config and messages without restart.

---

## 🔧 Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
|--------|-------------|------------|
| `/tpa <player>` | Request to teleport to a player | `xtpaz.tpa` |
| `/tpahere <player>` | Request a player to teleport to you | `xtpaz.tpahere` |
| `/tpaccept [player]` | Accept a pending TPA request | `xtpaz.tpaccept` |
| `/tpadeny [player]` | Deny a pending TPA request | `xtpaz.tpadeny` |
| `/tpacancel [player]` | Cancel your pending request | `xtpaz.tpacancel` |
| `/tpauto` | Toggle auto-accept for /tpa | `xtpaz.tpauto` |
| `/tpahereauto` | Toggle auto-accept for /tpahere | `xtpaz.tpahereauto` |
| `/tpatoggle` | Toggle receiving TPA requests on/off | `xtpaz.tpatoggle` |
| `/tpaconfirmtoggle` | Toggle confirmation GUI on/off | `xtpaz.tpaconfirmtoggle` |
| `/xtpaz reload` | Reload configuration | `xtpaz.reload` |

---

## 📁 Configuration files

- **`config.yml`** – Request timeout, auto-accept delay, cooldown, teleport countdown, sounds, and message texts.

---

## ⛏️ Requirements

- **Server:** Paper or Spigot 1.20+
- **Java:** 17 or higher

title: SpyHunt-Compass
description: Trackin Compass used in SpyHunts
body:
# SpyHunt-Compass 🧭

**SpyHunt-Compass** is a standalone, lightweight, and high-performance tracking compass plugin for Minecraft servers. Originally developed as a core mechanic for the **SpyHunts** manhunt gamemode, this plugin brings smart player tracking logic to any survival or minigame server.

## ✨ Features

### 🎯 **Smart Tracking Logic**
- **Real-Time Tracking**: The compass updates every second to point directly to the target player.
- **Cross-Dimension Support**:
  - **Overworld Tracking**: Points directly to the player.
  - **Nether/End Tracking**: If the target is in a different dimension, the compass tracks the **last known portal location** (or where they entered the dimension).
  - **Smart Recovery**: If a target disconnects or is in a different world without portal data, the compass points to their **last seen location**.

### 🛠️ **Advanced Management**
- **Multi-Target System**: Add multiple players to a single tracker.
  - **Cycle Targets**: Right-click your compass to switch between tracked players.
- **Auto-Inventory Management**: 
  - Automatically gives a compass if the player doesn't have one.
  - Updates existing compasses in the inventory.

## 📜 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/track <player>` | Instantly get a compass tracking a specific player (clears other targets). | `spyhuntcompass.use` (default: true) |
| `/tracker` | Get an empty tracker compass. | `spyhuntcompass.use` |
| `/tracker add <player>` | Add a player to your tracking list. | `spyhuntcompass.use` |
| `/tracker remove <player>` | Remove a player from your tracking list. | `spyhuntcompass.use` |
| `/tracker help` | View all available commands. | `spyhuntcompass.use` |

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the latest `SpyHunt-Compass.jar`.
2. Place it in your server's `plugins/` folder.
3. Restart your server.
4. Enjoy smart tracking!

## 🔧 Configuration

Currently, SpyHunt-Compass is designed to be plug-and-play with zero configuration required. All data is stored persistently on the compass items themselves.

---

title: DDoSDefenderLite
description: Injects a sophisticated custom network handler into the network pipeline to protect your server from Malicious Clients.
body:
**DDoSDefenderLite** provides high-performance mitigation by injecting an **optimised network handler** directly into the server’s Netty pipeline. By inspecting incoming handshake packets and source IPs in real time, it applies **dynamic rate limiting** and selective **packet cancellation** to neutralise malicious bursts. This ensures your server remains **resilient against floods** without impacting the connection quality for legitimate players.

While it is the **lightweight** entry point to our premium suite ([DDoSDefender](https://modrinth.com/plugin/ddosdefender)), **DDoSDefenderLite** delivers robust protection against individual client attacks, ensuring that no single Client can disrupt your **server's availability**.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2881511fc48443473ca01cd565eccaf3ae11b5a4.png)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a421482686155a96c2d0a7db942e06e7e182bcb8.png)

*DDoSDefenderLite focuses exclusively on managing and filtering application-level connection attempts. It is important to note that it does not—and cannot—protect your physical network infrastructure, as no software-level plugin can mitigate volumetric attacks at the ISP level.*

*For comprehensive protection, we strongly recommend a layered security strategy: pair DDoSDefender/DDoSDefenderLite with a network-level proxy like TCPShield. While TCPShield shields your IP and absorbs massive network-layer floods, DDoSDefender provides the "last mile" of defence by intelligently filtering the complex, Minecraft-specific handshake exploits that proxies might pass through.*

title: Vanilla Archery Resources
description: Contains the necessary textures for the Vanilla Archery datapack.
body:
![Vanilla Archery (Title Banner)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46e31aebc962bd4b733dfcb1a3542a0b863bd085.png)

**NOTE: THIS IS THE _RESOURCE PACK_ FOR VANILLA ARCHERY - ONLY THE DATAPACK ADDS IN-GAME CONTENT, THIS ONLY ADDS TEXTURES!**

Vanilla Archery adds over thirteen bows and crossbows and also adds other items archers can use.

**⚠️ Make sure to download [this](https://modrinth.com/datapack/vanilla-archery) datapack - it is required for Vanilla Archery to work! ⚠️**
---
# Overview
![This image contains all the items in Vanilla Archery when this was written.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/143d8ce712a215dff74af986fefc464db73effb5.png)
---
Currently included in Vanilla Archery are the following:
- Five tiered bows
- Five tiered crossbows
- Two specialized bows
- Two specialized crossbows
- Four items which assist archery

Vanilla Archery reworks the bow/crossbow system. Now, instead of bows being single-tier like the mace or trident, bows are _tiered_ items with wooden, copper, iron, gold, diamond, and netherite variants.

⚠️ **Make sure to view how to unlock the recipes at the end of this guide!** ⚠️

## Tiered Bows

Each tier deals 0.5 more damage than the previous one except for copper which deals one more damage than a wooden bow. Gold, doing the same amount of damage as Wood, instead is given a bonus of +7 enchantability. Tiered bows have more or less durability than the base wooden bow depending on their respective sword's durability when compared to a wooden sword.


|Tier     |Bonus     |      
|---------|---------|
|Wooden   |+0 Damage|
|Copper   |+1 Damage|
|Iron     |+1.5 Damage      |
|Diamond  |+2 Damage        |
|Netherite|+2.5 Damage      |
|Gold     |+7 Enchantability|

## Specialized Bows

There are two types of tiered bows currently implemented into Vanilla Archery, those being Trim Bows and Autobows.

### Trim Bows/Crossbows

Trim bows are bows themed around a structure's trim which require said trim to craft. Some examples are the Crossbow of the Turtle Master, requiring a Tide trim to craft, and the Breezebow, requiring a Flow trim to craft.

The Crossbow of the Turtle Master firing:
![The crossbow of the turtle master firing.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ced7dcaa56a76d09cd2d0a73202c6735327e0141.gif)

### Autobows/Crossbows

Autobows are bows that allow you to sprint while firing them. The base Autobow additionally gives the user 10s of invisibility if you attack while sneaking and lights its arrows on fire.

Autocrossbows are crossbows that instantly load and light their arrows on fire. The base Autocrossbow cannot have multishot and lights its arrows on fire. The main downside to autocrossbows is that they do not have the damage or enchantability bonuses tiered crossbows have.

An autocrossbow firing:
![An autocrossbow firing.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c7bf22abe0b0f5cd199dc0ec73b586b28704aa0.gif)

## Other items

Additionally currently included in Vanilla Archery are support items. When held in the offhand, these items give bonuses to the bow or crossbow you are holding in the mainhand.

### Quivers

In Vanilla Archery, there are two quivers: the normal quiver and heavy quiver. The normal variant is quite cheap while the heavy one requires a netherite upgrade and more costly materials. While held in the offhand, the normal quiver allows shooting three arrows at once while the heavy quiver allows shooting five angled closer together.

An iron bow being shot with a quiver in the offhand:
![An iron bow being shot with a quiver in the offhand.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dcb2d9564adc379ab3f365e424e6c8ec5df21571.gif)

### Cranequins

Historically the main downside to crossbows was the difficulty faced when loading them. To help with the force needed to load a crossbow sometimes a cranequin was used. In Vanilla Archery, there are two cranequins: the normal cranequin and the heavy cranequin. While held in the offhand, the normal cranequin shortens the time needed to load a crossbow by 1/4 of a second while the heavy cranequin shortens the time needed to load a crossbow by 3/4 of a second.

A netherite crossbow being shot with a heavy cranequin in the offhand:
![A netherite crossbow being shot with a heavy cranequin in the offhand.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aab40c1403ce189cc239aa3ad4ab49e59b399c3a.gif)

### Advancements

Vanilla Archery adds a bunch of advancements for crafting support items, bows, and crossbows. There are currently no secret or hidden advancements.

### Recipes

To unlock all of Vanilla Archery's recipes, you must craft a fletching table. Currently, all recipes are in the equipment tab.

body:
**__Overview__**
> Dracula’s Bedrock is a **streamer-friendly Minecraft texture pack** designed to protect players and communities on **faction and economy servers**.

On these servers, exposing **bedrock patterns** during a livestream or recorded session can allow viewers to locate exact base coordinates, putting your **faction, economy, and resources** at risk. This pack **obfuscates bedrock** with a bold **red, black, and white aesthetic**, making it impossible to deduce base locations from streamed content.

---

**__Why It’s Useful__**
- Prevents viewers from gathering **coordinates of your base** via livestream or video.
- Keeps both **you and your community safe** from griefing, raids, or other exploits.
- Ideal for **high-stakes faction and economy servers**, where resource security is critical.
- Lets you **stream or record confidently** without compromising gameplay security.

---

**__Features__**
- `Bedrock Obfuscation:` Replaces default textures with **glitched, red/black/white style**.
- `Streamer-Focused:` Safe for live content, protects sensitive in-game information.
- `Vanilla Feel:` Maintains the familiar Minecraft look while adding a modern edge.
- `Custom Splashes:` Adds a **unique, stylish flair** to your in-game menu.
- `Easy Installation:` Compatible with **Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1+**.

---

**__How It Works__**
```text
[Default Bedrock] → Visible on livestream → Coordinates leak
[Dracula's Bedrock] → Glitched Obfuscated Textures → Coordinates hidden
```
- Simply install the pack, activate it, and stream or record safely.
- All textures are designed to **retain game readability** while preventing exploits.

---

**__Ideal For__**
- Streamers and content creators on **faction servers**.
- Players on **economy-focused servers** with high-value bases.
- Anyone who wants to **protect their coordinates** while sharing gameplay publicly.

# TempElytra
Minecraft Java Plugin for WorldGuard that adds a flag allowing players to start flying without an elytra! Compatible with 1.21+.

## Installation
1. Download WorldEdit, WorldGuard, and TempElytra for your preferred version.
2. Place the `.jar` files into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Start the server and enjoy!

## Requirements
- WorldGuard (requires WorldEdit)
- Minecraft version 1.21 or higher

## How to use
1. Mark a region using WorldEdit's wand (right-click one corner, left-click the opposite corner).  
2. Create a region using WorldGuard: `/rg create <region> <player>` or use an existing one.  
3. Set the flag: `/rg flag <region> start-glide-without-elytra allow`.  
4. Fall at least 1.1 blocks in the region to start gliding.  
5. Press "Switch Hotbar" to boost.

## Important notice
- Make the region slightly larger than the intended area so players cannot jump out without entering glide mode.

## Config Options
- `boost` — Boost multiplier applied when launching or boosting.  
- `max-boosts` — Maximum free boosts available (use by pressing Switch Hotbar).  
- `allow-sneak-cancel` — Allow players to cancel flying with TempElytra midair.  
- `min-fall-distance` — Define which falldistance to trigger Elytra
- More options coming...

## Reload config
- `/tempelytra reload`


## Future additions
- More configurable options

title: Velocity Queue
description: The best free Velocity Queue you`ll find.
body:
# SecVers Queue System

A powerful Velocity queue system supporting multiple priority queues with full LuckPerms integration.

---

## FEATURES

- Supports multiple queues: Premium, VIP, Default, and Softban
- Fully compatible with LuckPerms MySQL database
- Modular queue enabling/disabling via config
- Automatic fallback to limbo server
- Queue priority processing: Premium -> VIP -> Default -> Softban (after 5min)
- Individual queue position messages for each player
- Designed for cracked and premium servers, with LibreLogin Support
- Lightweight, optimized for 500+ concurrent queued players

---

## HOW IT WORKS

1. Player joins the limbo/queue server (configure this in Velocity with limboserver setting).
2. The queue system checks the player's group via LuckPerms database (MySQL only).
3. The player is assigned to their respective queue:
   - Premium -> VIP -> Default -> Softban
4. Every tick (5s by default), the system checks if the target server is online and has available slots.
5. Players are sent to the target server based on queue priority.

---

## CONFIGURATION (config.yml)

```yaml
# SecVers Queue config.yml

# Enable LuckPerms support.
# Requires a MySQL or MariaDB connection without SSL.
enablelp: false

# The server players join to wait in queue
limboserver: queue

# The target server players will be sent to
targetserver: survival

# Group configuration
# Group names are retrieved from the 'luckperms_user_permissions' table.
# Example: use 'premium' not 'group.premium'.
Groups:
  softban: badgroup
  default: default
  vip: vip
  premium: premium
  displayname_softban: badgroup
  displayname_default: default
  displayname_vip: VIP
  displayname_premium: Premium

# Queue settings
# Enable or disable queues individually
# SoftbanQueueEnabled defaults to allowing join after 5 minutes if other queues are empty
QueueGroupSettings:
  premiumQueueEnabled: true
  vipQueueEnabled: true
  QueueEnabled: true
  SoftbanQueueEnabled: true

# Database connection for LuckPerms integration
database:
  host: 127.0.0.1
  port: 3306
  name: luckperms
  user: root
  pass: ''
```

---

## EXAMPLE FLOW

1. Player joins the limbo server queue.
2. Queue system retrieves their group from LuckPerms MySQL.
3. Adds them to their queue (Premium -> VIP -> Default -> Softban).
4. Every 5 seconds:
   - Checks target server status
   - Moves next player in priority order if slots are available.

---

## NOTES

- LuckPerms support requires MySQL or MariaDB.
- Softban queue enforces a 5-minute wait if other queues are empty.
- Designed for Velocity and supports LibreLogin setups.

title: a_mod cleaned
description: a mod with so much features you can't give it a proper title
body:
The mod added features for all branches of the game. **This description will show the intial things the mod has added. If you want to explore blindly, don't read the next paragraphs**.

New biomes added (redwood forest, rubber forest, nether infestation, deadlands, xtreme hills). Here is what each biome does.
**Redwood Forest**: Based on the redwood forests of northern California. The trees are massively tall.

**Rubber Forest**: The trees hold rubber logs, crafting it to planks. Use the planks to make rubber. It can make _erasers_ and _wheels_.

**Nether Infestation**: The ground is netherrack. Extra gold found and the sky is orange and hot. Water boils to a point of being orange.

**Deadlands**: The forest is dead like the pale garden, but there's still some life. Villages can spawn, and perhaps a dimension?

**Xtreme Hills**: THESE HILLS ARE ALL OVER THE PLACE!!!1!

There are a bunch of dimensions added and here are their biomes (All of these dimension portals are built like the nether portal).

**The Moon**: Built with the _moon portal igniter_ and a frame of stone. It is the moon along with space colonies (villages), alien temples (desert temples), UFOs that fell to the harsh moon (shipwrecks), and strongholds. There are caves to find special moon ores.

**Dead Dimension**: Built with the _Skull of Ra_ and a frame of _Dead Planks_. This dimension is a huge expanse of the deadlands, as if the deadlands of the overworld were actually from this dimension, and is invading to the overworld like the nether.

**HyperTravel**: Cheese. Cheese frame, and a cheesey cookie (_Inedible FarCookie_). The world is cheese. Cheese obelisks, the caves are cheese and everything. This dimension is for a use. 1 block here is worth 16 blocks of overworld, like the nether.

**Hardirt**: Built with _Stoned Dirt_, and a _Dirt Thing_ (both obtained by compressing dirt). This entire place looks like the overworld, but everything is hardened. The shard grass requires a pickaxe to mine, and the rock hard dirt is hard as a rock, so it also needs a pickaxe just to break. However, you can survive here. There are animals to kill and eat, and it looks like someone has tried surviving here already. There's 2 biomes, the hardirt plains, and hardirt forest. There are ores that make you progress in the dimension, like the overworld does with its progression. The top tier ore is _Fleshfin_. Use it to craft the _meated yield_ and a _dimensional flesh_ block frame to access...

**The Meatflesh**: This place is comparable to the nether. It has the same world type, and the endless amount of _biostone_ is to be seen. There is also the _bluefields_, with endless amount of blue. You'll find the _Finheads_ throughout the entire dimension, and the _blueze_ of the bluefields.

**Aether**: You heard of it. Glowstone frame and _aether bucket_.

**Micro**: Uses blocks of pure flesh as the frame, and an ultra microscope for the ignition. You'll be in the _microbiome_. Endless fields of skin and flesh below. Giant hair follicles protrude out of the flesh, and deep down you'll find _red blood cells_ and _bacteria_. This entire dimension is all in the frames of the portal, as you shrink down to the size of a cell.

**Alpha**: Uses grass blocks as a frame and _nostalgia_ to ignite. This place resembles the olden days of Alpha Minecraft. The neon green grass and the old textures of the world. Quite a simple place to be in.

Now for all the other goodies.
**New foods**: Cheese, Forbidden Cheese, Far Cookie, Inedible Far Cookie, Burgers and Fries, Beans, Cooked Organ, Cooked Tropical Fish, Flesh (rotten flesh without the rot), Fleshy Strips, Cooked Organism, TV Dinner, and Sausage (raw and cooked).

**Weapons and Tools**: Gun and bullets, Broom, Slingsot, Flail, Scissors, Knife

**Other items**: Trays, Coins, Medication, Bait, Grains, Written Paper, Pencil and Pen, Eraser, Plastic, Rocks, Hot rocks, Car Scraps, Engine, Wheel, Sludge, Brain, Heart, Tweezers, Gloves, Syringe, Stethoscope, and Abstraction.

There are also new materials with full sets of tools and armor.
**Uranium**: Strongest tools in the game. Found deep in the overworld. They emit light, but they are still very rare.

**Tack, Puepil, Fleshfin**: The 3 ores of progression of the Hardirt Dimension. Tack is the iron level, Puepil is between iron and diamond, and Fleshfin is diamond level.

**Ruby**: Found at the levels above deepslate, but are still quite deep. Tools and armor are quite good.

**Endite**: Ores of the End. Very high tier.

**Fart Flake**: They don't have anything. Very common, very useless.

New ores weren't just the things added. Every ore (except amythest) has a set of tools and armor. Even wood and stone has armor.

A new cool feature is the Egger. Use egg and sperm, sugar cane, red mushroom to craft this. This item can craft spawn eggs using an item related to the mob. Here is the list of mobs currently added to the list.
**Pig, Chicken**, Cow: use their meat to make the egg.

**Zombie, Human**: Use their flesh to make the egg.

**Skeleton**: Use bone to make the egg.

**Villager**: Use emeralds to make the egg.

**Creeper**: Use gunpowder to make the egg.

**Ghast**: Use ghast tears to make the egg.

More will be added, eventually all mobs will have their eggs.

There's also new blocks that can do things.
**Television**: Right now does nothing, but will eventually be functional.

**Stash**: Found in the _towers_. When broken, a random item will drop. Could it be diamonds, or maybe a cookie?

**Drawer**: Nice furniture piece. Using slabs and planks, you'll get a container with 15 slots. Less than a chest, but it does great for a house.

**Stack of Paper/Written Paper**: Looks cool for the office. When broken, the stack will break to 9 individual papers.

**Block of Greens**: Quite bushy, can be used for the garden.

**Table**: Looks like a table, and you can put stuff on top of it.

**Knife Sharpener**: Used to sharpen a knife. When a knife is low on durability, just sharpen it and it's all brand new!

There's also new types of blocks to pre-existing blocks. Gold, Diamond, and Emerald blocks, along with netherrack, all have a slab and stair variant. Flex your riches by finally making a proper emerald roof and diamond stairs to your throne.

Rocks are a new type of feature, you can find them anywhere in the world. Make a block of rocks with them, and use rocks as a projectile for slingshots.

New entities!
**Deer**: Passive creatures, and you'll find them in taigas and redwood forests.

**Cars**: Using an engine and iron and redstone, they will drive fast and far.

**Chairs**: Sit down the proper way.

**Humans**: These Steves will no longer make you the only player in the world.

New villager type: **Advertiser**! They will try to sell you items like _TV dinner_, A _useless block_, and some medication. Side effects may be present using the medication.

There are also some new structures.

**Abandoned Hardirt Base**: Found in the hardirt dimension, they are bases from players that couldn't handle the enviroment. A portion of the base is missing, as they died before they could sustain themselves.

**Tower**: Tall structures with _stash_ and little rooms. Great place to loot at.

**Obelisk**: Many types of obelisks. There are 11 types of obelisks found around the world. They are the Obelisk, Egyptian Obelisk, Cheese Obelisk, Logelisk, End Obelisk, Wooden Obelisk, Impossible Obelisk, Hardirt Obelisk, Preserved and Unpreserved Obelisk, and Librarian Obelisk.

**Car Dealership**: They have naturally spawning cars to take and go away with. No need to craft, when you can find!

**Conspirasist Lab**: This rundown house has a cheesey frame, and his chest includes a cookie and slice of cheese. What is he up to?

**City**: A big area with spanning roads, streets with houses and skyscrapers, and many buildings! There is life in the city, along with cars, so you can find a house for sale and be one with the citizens. The city is very rare, so you want to use /locate command. They are found in plains and deserts.

New fluids are present. There is blood, oil, and urine.

There are more things in the mod, but they aren't that interesting. This description has basically all you need to know on what this mod has to offer.

title: Bank Plus Plus / ZBank
description: BankPlusPlus is a Minecraft economy plugin developed by Mridul. It provides a tiered banking system that allows players to upgrade their account capacity through an exponential cost progression.
body:
BankPlusPlus is a Minecraft economy plugin developed by me.mridul. It provides a tiered banking system that allows players to upgrade their account capacity through an exponential cost progression.

Technical Architecture The plugin is structured around three specific internal classes found in the JAR file:


BankPlusPlus: The main class handling the plugin's lifecycle and core logic.


Tier: This class manages the upgrade levels, defining the benefits and costs associated with each bank rank.


PlayerBankData: Handles the persistence of individual player balances and their current tier status.

Economic Logic The system uses a specific mathematical formula for account upgrades:

Base Cost: The first account tier requires 1000 currency.

Progression: Each subsequent tier cost is calculated by multiplying the previous cost by 2 (e.g., 1000, 2000, 4000).

Configuration The plugin includes a config.yml file, which likely allows administrators to modify the starting cost (1000) and the multiplier (2) without editing the code directly.

use it by:

/bank open 
/bank create 1
