**Saro's Spawn Elytra** is a lightweight Paper/Spigot plugin that creates designated spawn zones where players can launch themselves into the air with elytra wings. Perfect for creating spawn points with an exciting gliding entrance!

- **Multiple World Support** 🌍  
  - Configure different spawn zones for each world on your server.
  
- **Customizable Launch Zones** 📍  
  - Define spawn coordinates, activation radius, and jump boost power per world.

- **Simple Activation** ✨  
  - Players swap hand items (default F key) within the spawn zone to launch with elytra.

- **Flexible Configuration** ⚙️  
  - Optional Y-level checks to create vertical or flat spawn zones.
  - Adjustable jump boost values for perfect launch trajectories.

- **Automatic Elytra Management** 🪂  
  - Plugin automatically enables gliding when activated and disables it when the player lands.

![Config](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Saros_Spawn_Elytra/MP_SarosSpawnElytra_config.webp)
Each world can be configured in `config.yml` with the following options:

```yaml
worlds:
  world:
    # Spawn coordinates - center of the spawn zone
    spawnx: 0
    spawny: 100
    spawnz: 0
    # Activation radius around spawn point
    radius: 50
    # Ignore Y coordinate when checking if player is in range
    ignoreYLevel: false
    # Launch power (higher = more vertical boost)
    jump_boost: 100
```

**Example Multi-World Setup:**
```yaml
worlds:
  world:
    spawnx: 0
    spawny: 100
    spawnz: 0
    radius: 50
    ignoreYLevel: false
    jump_boost: 100
    
  Farmwelt:
    spawnx: 12
    spawny: 157
    spawnz: 23

3. **Players enter the spawn zone** (within configured radius)
4. **Press F** (swap hand items) to launch with elytra

The plugin automatically gives players elytra flight when they activate the spawn zone and removes it when they land.

title: Yo's Trade Post
description: Adds a new trading block for Minecraft
body:
### 为我的世界添加类似星露谷物语出货箱的新交易方块。 Adds a new trading block similar to Stardew Valley selling bin for Minecraft.
### 出货箱(Selling Bin) yostradepost:tradepost 在创造模式下位于原版实用方块栏，可使用红色羊毛、白色羊毛、橡木木板和木桶合成。 Selling Bin (yostradepost:tradepost) is located in the original crafting bar in creative mode and can be synthesized using red wool, white wool, oak planks, and wooden barrels.
### 玩家将需要交易的物品放入后，出货箱会在新的一天处理交易，将指定的物品转换成另一种指定的物品（可在config文件夹内yostradepost.json中配置）。 After the player puts in the item to be traded, the Selling Bin will process the transaction on a new day, converting the specified item into another specified item (Configurable in the yostradepost.json in the config folder).
### 提供高度可自定义且简洁的配置方式。 Provides a highly customizable and clean way to configure. - 出货箱在新的一天会瞬间执行3次处理（视为1次交易），单次交易支持货币三级转换（物品-货币1-货币2-货币3）。
The Selling Bin will perform 3 processing times on a new day (considered as 1 transaction), and a single transaction supports three-level currency conversion (item - currency 1 - currency 2 - currency 3). - 配置格式 Configuration format： ["输入物品ID", "输入数量", "输出物品ID", "输出数量"]（数字可不用双引号） ["Input Item ID", "Input Quantity", "Output Item ID", "Output Quantity"] (Numbers can be used without double quotation marks) - 示例 Example： 8 铁锭（minecraft:iron_ingot）-> 1 绿宝石（minecraft:emerald） ["minecraft:iron_ingot", 8, "minecraft:emerald", 1] - 完整配置示意 Full text： 
{
  "trades": [
    ["输入物品ID", "输入数量", "输出物品ID", "输出数量"],
    ["minecraft:iron_ingot", 8, "minecraft:emerald", 1],
    ["minecraft:gold_ingot", 2, "minecraft:emerald", 1],
    ["minecraft:emerald", 8, "minecraft:diamond", 1]
  ]
}

In this configuration, the iron and gold ingots entered by the player will be converted into emeralds (first processing), and if the number of iron/gold ingots entered can be exchanged for more than 8 emeralds, it will be automatically converted to 1 diamond (second processing) without a third processing. ### 目前支持的版本： Fabric 1.20.1（需要 Fabric Loader 0.16.14 以及上版本，Fabric API任意版本）。 (requires Fabric Loader 0.16.14 or higher, any version of Fabric API).

title: Sun Compass
description: A vanilla-friendly survival tool that uses the sun's position and time to find North
body:
# Sun Compass
[![GitHub - Source](https://img.shields.io/static/v1?label=GitHub&message=Source&color=2ea44f&logo=github)](https://github.com/FireFingertips/SunCompassMod "Open mod source on GitHub")

**A vanilla-friendly survival tool for finding your way.**

The Sun Compass is a utility item that uses the position of the sun to cast a shadow on the board, helping you navigate during the day without relying on "magic" coordinate systems or debug screens.

![Sun Compass Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xBV5bzNr/images/37742e12b9d1cc8d281385527eb7fe2205fd2992.png)

## 🧭 Manual & Usage Guide

**The Sun Compass is not a magic item.** Unlike a standard compass that points to World Spawn, the Sun Compass works similarly to a real-world sun dial. It is a navigational tool that requires you to understand the position of the sun and the time of day.

### The Core Concept
The compass displays a shadow cast by the central stick. This shadow is **fixed to the world's sun position**. As you turn or as time passes, the shadow moves around the board. To find North, you must align the shadow correctly based on the current time.

### How to Find North

#### 1. The Sunrise Baseline (6:00 AM / Tick 0)
Vanilla Minecraft days start at **6:00 AM**. At this specific time:
* The Sun is rising in the **East**.
* **Instruction:** Rotate yourself until the shadow points to the **East** marker on the compass board.
* **Result:** You are now facing **North**.

#### 2. Compensating for Time (The Clockwise Shift)
As the day progresses, the sun moves across the sky. To keep finding North, you must manually compensate for the time passed since 6:00 AM.
* **The Rule:** For every in-game hour that passes, you must **shift the compass by 1 hour clockwise**.
* **Example:**
    * **Time:** 8:00 AM (2 hours after sunrise).
    * **Action:** Align the shadow to East, then rotate yourself (and the compass) roughly **30 degrees clockwise** (2 "hours" on a clock face) to find True North.

### Summary Table
| In-Game Time | Shadow Alignment for North |
| :--- | :--- |
| **6:00 AM** (Sunrise) | Align shadow to left 6 hour mark or **East** (E) |
| **12:00 PM** (Noon) | 6 hours has passed, so align shadow to the upper 12 hour mark, or **North** (N) |
| **6:00 PM** (Sunset) | 12 hours has passed, so align shadow to right 6 hour mark or **West** (W) |

*Note: This tool requires practice. Direction accuracy is entirely based on time estimation. To find other directions than north, simply rotate by some degrees after finding north. For example, west would be 90 degrees, or 6 hours right, from north.*

## 📦 Obtaining
**There is 4 ways to craft this item in survival**

![gif showing all crafting options](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xBV5bzNr/images/9929633ca10e12981a5cf3d52d0e6e74423771b5.gif)

To craft the Sun Compass, align any of these 4 different layouts from **bottom to top**:
- Any plank + torch
- Any plank + coal + stick
- Any plank + charcoal + stick
- Any plank + ink sac + stick

## Why is East and West swapped?
This serves the function of time shifting easier than if it was the other way around. For example, at noon (tick time 6000, or 12 PM), to find North you simply point to N (or the upper 12) then to find west you would also simply move the shadow to point W (or the right 6).
This way, shifting clockwise perserves directionality. Having it the "correct" way around would introduce extra mental calculations for no reason.

## ⚠️ Compatibility & Status
* **Version:** 0.2.0 (Pre-release)
* **Loader:** NeoForge (1.21.1)
* **Possible issues:** potentially might fail in situations where there is no sun or otherwise time logic has been modified.
* **Mod Compatibility:** There has no tests with other mods yet. Please suggest mods to pair this with and I will do my best to add compatibility (currently looking to add compatibility with TerraFirmaCraft).

## 🤝 Acknowledgements
**Special thanks to David Canterbury** for the original concept and for naming the "Sun Compass.".
* This is the video by him that specifically inspired this project: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7EfDYFDCl14&t=131s

## Final note
I'm new to modding, github, and while I'm familiar with programming, this is an entirely new level for me. But I'm looking to improve and hopefully keep adding new mods in the future!

---
*Built with NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.*

title: ControlPickup
description: You don't want to pickup a dirt block or other blocks? This mod helps you out!
body:
Purpose: Prevent unwanted automatic pickup of items/blocks (e.g., potted plants) by disabling pickup per block type. Works with servers — changes are sent as commands so server authority is respected when available, and client fallback keeps the UI responsive offline.
Key Features:
GUI: Openable via the Controls menu (assign a hotkey) — search blocks by localized name and add/remove entries.
Localized Search: Autocomplete searches by display name (not raw IDs) and shows block icons for easy selection.
Server-Compatible: Client sends /disablepickup and /enablepickup commands so the server enforces pickup rules when supported.
Persistence: Client-side lists persist between sessions for instant feedback and offline use.
German Localization: UI strings are included in German (plus English).
Lightweight Blur: Background is softly blurred behind the GUI while keeping icons and text sharp (configurable in source).
How To Use

Open Controls and bind the key for “Anti Pickup Settings”, or open the GUI from the client mod menu.
Type into the search box (use localized names like “Potted White Tulip”), pick a suggestion, and click Apply.
Toggle between disabling pickups or explicitly enabling pickups using the mode button.
On servers that support it, the client will send /disablepickup <namespace:block>namespace:block or /enablepickup <namespace:block>namespace:block automatically.
Commands (client → server)

 /disablepickup <block> — instructs server to disable pickup for that block type
 /enablepickup <block> — instructs server to re-enable pickup for that block type
Compatibility & Requirements

Platform: Fabric mod (tested on Minecraft 1.21.4).
Runtime: Java 21 (development setup uses Fabric Loom).
Notes: Server-side enforcement requires the server to accept the mod’s commands or run the corresponding server component; otherwise the client falls back to local behavior for convenience.
Files & Troubleshooting

GUI logic: AntiPickupConfigScreen.java
Client networking: AntiPickupClientNetworking.java
Local config: AntiPickupClientConfig (persists lists)
If the GUI looks blurry on your system, try adjusting the blur strength in AntiPickupConfigScreen.java (blurDownscale).
License & Credits

title: CustomPacks
description: Plugin which allows multiple selectable resourcepacks per player with persistence through logouts.
body:
# CustomPacks – Dynamic Resource Pack Manager for Spigot/Paper


CustomPacks is a lightweight and flexible Minecraft plugin that lets server owners and players manage multiple resource packs seamlessly. It automatically merges selected resource packs into a single download and supports persistent pack selection across logins.

This plugin aims to improve server resourcepack logic by adding to it a variety of choice. Unlike other projects, like ResourcePackManager, which aim to merge several packs into one for ALL players on server, CustomPacks offer EACH player a choice - all can have different sets of server resourcepacks enabled for themselves, selectable from shared pool.


## Key Features

- Multiple Pack Support: Enable multiple custom packs simultaneously, without overwriting previous selections.

- Persistent Pack Selection: Players’ selected packs are saved in a YAML file and automatically reapplied on login. Each player can have his own pack set!

- Dynamic Merging: Packs are merged on-the-fly when a player joins or updates their selection. No unnecessary duplication of files.

- Temporary Storage: Merged packs are stored temporarily and deleted on player logout to save disk space.

- HTTP Delivery: Uses an internal HTTP server to deliver merged resource packs efficiently to players.

## Commands:

- /custompacks:packlist – Show available packs and your enabled packs.

- /custompacks:packenable <pack1> [pack2…] – Enable one or more packs.

- /custompacks:packdisable [pack] – Disable a specific pack or all packs.

## Installation

1. Place CustomPacks.jar into your server’s plugins folder and restart the server to let it create all nescesary files.
1. Edit config.yml (set the HTTP server port and Oraxen pack path).
1. Restart the server.
2. Place all packs you want players to choose from into CustomPacks/packs folder

## Requirements

Tested and confirmed to work on 1.21.7 but theoretically should work on most 1.17–1.20 versions.
 
## Compatibility:
Oraxen - technically compatible, but you will need to disable Oraxen pack sending to players in it's config (NOT the pack generation, just delivery!). CustomPacks will search Oraxen folder for pack.zip and auto-add it to any player's list.

All other server resourcepack-related plugins will probably break due to clashing with priority onJoin pack load.

# ⚡ **SP Optimization (1.21.1)**
*A pure optimization and stability-focused modpack built for singleplayer.*

---

### ⚙️ **About**
**SP Optimization** is a **performance-first Fabric modpack** designed for **singleplayer gameplay**.  
It keeps Minecraft **completely vanilla in look and feel**, while making it **smoother, faster, and more stable** across all systems.

---

## 🧩 **Use it as:**
- A **lightweight standalone optimization pack**  
- A **foundation** for your own modpacks, worlds, or playthroughs  

---

## 🧠 **Every mod is hand-picked for:**
- 💨 Maximum performance  
- 🔒 High stability  
- 🧠 Compatibility  
- 🧼 A clean, minimal footprint  

---

## 🚀 **Core Features**
✅ **Performance Boosts** — higher FPS, faster chunk loading, smoother rendering  
✅ **Stability First** — no conflicting or duplicate optimization mods  
✅ **Lightweight** — no visual or gameplay changes  
✅ **Modular Design** — easy to expand with your favorite mods  
✅ **Singleplayer Priority** — tuned for consistent performance and frame pacing  

---

## 🎯 **Perfect For**
🎮 Players wanting **vanilla gameplay with top-tier performance**  
🏗️ Builders who need **smooth rendering and chunk loading**  
🧰 Modders looking for a **stable, conflict-free base**  
⚒️ Anyone wanting a **drop-in optimization layer** for their setup  

---

## 🧩 **Recommended Setup**
- **Minecraft:** `1.21.1`  
- **Loader:** `Fabric 0.15+`  
- **Java:** `21` (e.g., Temurin or Zulu builds)  
- **RAM Allocation:** `Max: Half of Available RAM | Min: 4GB (if possible)`  
- **Resolution:** 1080p or higher recommended for smooth UI scaling  

---

## 🧠 **Recommended JVM Arguments**
These JVM args maximize performance and stability for most systems (modern CPUs, 8–16 GB RAM total).  
Paste them in your launcher’s *“Java Arguments”* or *“JVM Settings”* field:
```-Xms4G -Xmx8G -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=100 -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1HeapWastePercent=5 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dfml.ignorePatchDiscrepancies=true -Dfml.ignoreInvalidMinecraftCertificates=true```

---

## 📝 **Tips:**
- Adjust `-Xmx` (max memory) to match your available RAM — e.g., `6G`, `8G`, or `10G`.  
- Keep `-Xms` (minimum) lower than or equal to half of your max allocation.  
- Avoid running background-heavy programs while Minecraft is open for the best results.  

---

## ⚡ **Optional Tweaks**
- 🧹 **LazyDFU Alternative:** Not needed — handled by **ModernFix** and similar mods.  
- 🔄 **Thread Tweaks:** Improves multithreading for chunk loading & world generation.  
- 🖥️ **VBOs + VSync:** Enable in settings for smoother frame pacing if screen tearing occurs.

title: ServerJoinPerms
description: A simple velocity plugin to require permissions for joining servers.
body:
# ServerJoinPerms

A Velocity proxy plugin that enforces server-specific join permissions for Minecraft servers.

## Features

- Restricts players from joining servers they don't have permission for
- Prevents server switching to unauthorized servers
- Simple permission-based access control
- Native Velocity integration

## Requirements

- Velocity 3.0.0 or higher
- Java 11 or higher

## Installation

1. Download the latest `ServerJoinPerms.jar` from the releases page
2. Place the JAR file in your Velocity server's `plugins` directory
3. Restart your Velocity proxy

## Usage

### Permissions

The plugin uses a simple permission structure:
- `server.<servername>` - Grants permission to join the specified server

### Examples

- To allow access to a server named `survival`: `server.survival`
- To allow access to a server named `creative`: `server.creative`

### Behavior

- Players without the required permission will be disconnected with an error message
- Permission checks occur on both initial join and server transfers
- The error message clearly indicates the reason for disconnection

## Configuration

No configuration file is needed. The plugin works out of the box with Velocity's permission system.

## Building from Source

1. Clone the repository
2. Run `mvn clean package`
3. Find the compiled JAR in the `target` directory

## Support

For support, please open an issue on the GitHub repository.

## License

This project is licensed under the MIT License.

## Author

**Creeper Extended** takes Minecraft’s already-chaotic creepers and cranks the dial up past eleven. Expect flashbangs, stun potions, custom effects, music discs, and creepers that beep and spin like they’re auditioning for an action movie. # VanillaAFK Plugin

A simple and lightweight AFK plugin with custom overhead messages for Paper servers.

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the `VanillaAFK.jar` file
2. Place it in your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Restart the server

## 🎮 Usage

### Basic Commands:
- `/afk` - toggle AFK mode
- `/afk [text]` - enter AFK with custom text
- `/afk reload` - reload configuration

### Examples:
- `/afk` - AFK with default text
- `/afk Gone for lunch` - AFK with custom text
- `/afk &cBe back soon` - AFK with colored text

## ⚙️ Configuration
All settings are located in `plugins/VanillaAFK/config.yml`:

### Messages:
```yaml
messages:
  afk-enabled: "&aYou entered AFK mode with text '&f<text>&a'"
  afk-disabled: "&aYou exited AFK mode"
  default-afk-text: "&7AFK"
```

## 🎨 Text Formatting
Supports standard Minecraft color codes:

### Colors:
&0 - Black

&1 - Dark Blue

&2 - Dark Green

&3 - Dark Aqua

&4 - Dark Red

&5 - Purple

&6 - Gold

&7 - Gray

&8 - Dark Gray

&9 - Blue

&a - Green

&b - Aqua

&c - Red

&d - Pink

&e - Yellow

&f - White

### Formatting:
&k - Obfuscated

&l - Bold

&m - Strikethrough

&n - Underlined

&o - Italic

&r - Reset

## 🔐 Permissions
vanillaafk.customtext - use custom AFK text

vanillaafk.reload - reload plugin configuration

## 📋 Features
Custom overhead messages with color formatting

Animated sandclock emoji (configurable)

Movement detection to exit AFK mode

Support for both Bukkit colors and HEX colors

Easy configuration reload

Lightweight and optimized

title: Mutagenic Menagerie
description: A datapack that adds a wide variety of Cow, Pig, and Chicken variants.
body:
![Mutagenic Menagerie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b04041eae8a16c124c8d6c6f077bbe2111656740.png)

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/8WblluxhWW8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

This datapack adds several unique variants of Cows, Chickens, and Pigs. These new variants can be unlocked by breeding animals using special **Mutagenic Foods**, then crossbred to unlock even more variants.

# Overview
There are three main categories of variants added in this datapack: **Chromatic**, **Luminous**, and **Mythical**. Each category has 16+ mob variants, as well as a set of custom foods (Seeds, Carrots, and Wheat) required to breed mobs of those variants.  

In general, breeding any two mobs with on tier of food will result in a child of that tier. Breeding mobs with ordinary wheat, seeds, or carrots will result in a child with the same variant as one of the parents.  

Unlocking new variants does more than give you a fun looking variant - each new variant also has new mechanics. Chickens lay unique new eggs, Cows give new types of milk, and Pigs gain a variety of buffs when ridden in different environments.  

# Mutagenic Crops
There are three tiers of **Mutagenic Crops** which are required to breed the new variants. These foods can be found by growing and harvesting the previous tier of crop in a specific location.  

If you want to make the process of finding these biomes less tedious, check out my [Biome Scanner](https://modrinth.com/datapack/biome-scanner) datapack!

## Chromatic Crops
Normal wheat and carrots harvested in a _Flower Forest_ have a chance to drop **Chromatic** seeds and carrots. Once found, these crops can be planted and grown in any biome. They grow like normal crops, and can be fed to mobs to unlock **Chromatic** variants!

## Luminous Crops
Harvesting **Chromatic** wheat and carrots in the _Deep Dark_ has a chance to drop **Luminous** seeds and carrots. These crops glow in the dark, and once found can be planted and grown in any biome. Feeding mobs these crops will result in a **Luminous** child!

## Mythical Crops
When you reach the _End_, growing and harvesting **Chromatic** wheat and carrots has a chance to drop **Mythical** seeds and carrots. Once found, these crops can be grown in any biome.

# Breeding
When you breed mobs using any of the **Mutagenic Crops**, the result will be one of the 50+ new variants, depending on a number of factors. Each variant has a tier (Chromatic, Luminous, or Mythical) and a base color (One of the 16 dye colors).

If either parent is fed a non-mutagenic crop, the variant of the child will be randomly chosen from one of the parents. Otherwise, the following process is used to determine the child's variant:

1. The tier of the child is determined based on the lowest tier food used to feed a parent.  
2. If both parents are a vanilla variant, the base color of will be Red, Yellow, or Blue.  
3. If one of the parents is a vanilla variant, the base color will be Red, Yellow, Blue, or the base color of the Mutagenic variant.  
4. If both of the parents are a Mutagenic variant:  
  a. If the child will be Chromatic, the child color will be determined from the parent colors using dye mixing rules (i.e. a Yellow and a Blue parent will have a Green child).  
  b. If the child will be Luminous, the child color will be determined from the parent colors using light mixing rules (i.e. a Red and a Green parent will have a Yellow child).
  c. Otherwise, the child color will be randomly chosen from one of the parent colors.
5. For Mythical variants, the Dimension the mob is born in may also impact their final variant.

# Variants
## Chromatic
![The Chromatic Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4761d764342f9bd459b7ddf26eb1bb66d79f76e.gif)  

The Chromatic variants are colored variants for the 16 dye colors in Minecraft.  
Chromatic pigs will travel faster on dyed blocks that match their color, and have an added bonus that they can be halted by pressing `jump` while riding them, to prevent them from running off of cliffs!
Chromatic Chickens lay colored eggs that can be used to change the color of dyeable blocks when thrown. They can also be fired from a dispenser to create redstone contraptions with color changing blocks!  
Chromatic Cows give Dyed Milk. Instead of removing all status effects, dyed milk only removes specific status effects when consumed. 

## Luminous
![The Luminous Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a73bac4bdd7ff997f41fa6d797a036057802aa00.gif)

The Luminous variants are glowing variants for the 16 dye colors in Minecraft. Luminous mobs have a permanent Glowing effect and will glow with their color. If the player has [VESE](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/vanilla-entity-shader-effects) installed, Luminous variants will have emissive textures in addition to the glowing outline.  
Luminous pigs will travel faster than their Chromatic counterparts on dyed blocks, and will give their passenger Night Vision while they are being ridden. Like Chromatic pigs, they can be halted by holding `jump`.  
Luminous Chickens lay glowing eggs that can be thrown at blocks or entities. When hitting most blocks, a glowing colored outline will appear for a couple of seconds. When hitting dyeable blocks, the outline will remain until the block is removed. When hitting entities, the entity will gain a glowing outline in the color of the egg for 15 seconds.  
Luminous Cows give Glowing Milk. Glowing milk will make a player who drinks it glow with the color of the milk for 15 seconds.  

## Mythical
There are 21 Mythical Variants, divided into a handful of subtypes.

### Ore Variants
![The Ore Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/61a26d081b9dbdd68ba334103b325071d2541de2.gif)  
There are 7 Ore Variants: Coal, Copper, Iron, Gold, Redstone, Emerald, and Diamond.  
Ore pigs travel faster on stone. Like other pigs, they can be halted by tapping `jump`. They can also mine the two blocks in front of them if their passenger taps `sprint`. When mining an ore that matches their variant, the drops are calculated as though they were mined with Fortune.  
Ore chickens will lay a mix of stone eggs, which can be thrown at entities to hurt them, and ore eggs, typically a retextured raw version of a resource.  
Ore cows give mineral enriched milk. Drinking mineral enriched milk will cause all nearby ores of that type to glow through walls, making mining more efficient.

### Dessert Variants
![The Dessert Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/379ba1fd55d81678038379ae896c2cddd9fbb1a3.gif)  
There are 3 Dessert Variants: Chocolate, Vanilla, and Berry.  
Dessert pigs will harvest and replant crops when walking over them.  
Dessert chickens lay cake eggs, which are a good source of food.  
Dessert cows give ice cream, which completely restores hunger but also gives the player slowness.  

### Nether Variants
![The Nether Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34ab6dc6821abe7bdf3b2b912f66c8335ae5a001.gif)  
There are 3 Nether Variants: Crimson, Warped, and Crying.  
All Nether variants are fireproof.    
**Crimson**  
Crimson pigs travel faster on common Nether blocks, crimson wood blocks, and crimson nylium.  Crimson chickens lay crimson eggs, which will cause the level of status effects on targets to increase, while causing the remaining duration to decrease. Crimson cows give crimson milk, which does the same thing to status effects on the player that drinks it.  
**Warped**  
Warped pigs travel faster on common Nether blocks, warped wood blocks, and warped nylium.  
Warped chickens lay warped eggs, which will cause status effects on targets they hit to be inverted. Warped cows give warped milk, which inverts status effects on the player that drinks it.  
**Crying**  
Crying pigs can teleport between the Nether and the Overworld when their passenger taps `sprint`.  
Crying chickens lay a mix of obsidian eggs, which can be thrown at entities to hurt them, and crying eggs, which will teleport entities they hit between the Nether and the Overworld.  
Crying cows give crying milk, which teleports the player that drinks it between the Nether and the Overworld.

### Elemental Variants
![The Elemental Variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8f4a6c20afb9cfe130316e678694f7ea89268ea.gif)  
There are 8 Elemental Variants: Water/Ice/Steam, Earth/Sand/Gravel, Fire, and Void.

**Water**  
Water pigs move very fast in water and don't sink.  
Water chickens lay water eggs, which function as splash water bottles with the range of a thrown egg.  
Water cows give buckets of water.  

**Ice**  
All Ice mobs are immune to powdered snow.  
Ice pigs move fast on snow and ice.  
Ice chickens lay egg-shaped snowballs.  
Ice cows give buckets of powdered snow.  

**Steam**  
Steam pigs can levitate by holding `space` while riding them.  
Steam chickens lay egg-shaped wind charges.  
Steam cows give buckets of steam, which when placed creates a cloud of levitation.  

**Earth**
Earth pigs move faster on dirt and grass blocks.  
Earth chickens lay dirt eggs, which can be thrown at entities to hurt them.  
Earth cows give buckets of dirt, which can be used to place a dirt block without triggering block updates.  

**Sand**  
Sand pigs move faster on sand and sandstone.  
Sand chickens lay sand eggs, which can be thrown at entities to hurt them and summon a large cloud of particles. Pocket Sand!  
Sand cows give buckets of sand, which can be used to place sand without triggering block updates.  

**Gravel**  
Gravel pigs move faster on gravel.  
Gravel chickens lay gravel eggs, which can be thrown at entities to hurt them and summon a large cloud of particles.
Sand cows give buckets of gravel, which can be used to place sand without triggering block updates.  

**Fire**  
All Fire mobs are immune to fire damage.  
Fire pigs swim on the surface of lava and give their passengers fire resistance.  
Fire chickens lay flaming eggs, which light entities they hit on fire.  
Fire coes give buckets of lava.  

**Void**
All Void mobs are immune to falling into the void, but take damage and teleport randomly when they touch water.  
Void pigs can teleport in the direction their passenger is looking when they tap `sprint`.  
Void chickens lay void eggs, which teleport entities they hit to the location the egg was thrown from.  
Void cows give buckets of air, which can be used to place air without triggering block updates.

title: Headlamps
description: ...No, not that kind of headlamp.
body:
![A banner of an Ancient Hunt from Minecraft Dungeons, featuring a lantern with a Magma Cube.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3bc3faf53562e2f8d4a6839625d4e1e657660953_0.webp)
# 🏮 Decorative Lanterns
First and foremost, **Headlamps** adds Lanterns with Magma Cubes and Slimes, inspired by the Nether decorations in Minecraft Dungeons (as shown above). You can craft those lanterns by surrounding a Magma Block or Slime Block with 8 Iron Nuggets in a Crafting Table.

You can place the lanterns down anywhere, although be aware that they might break if updated while not supported by a block. If you place one underneath a block, it'll hang from the bottom of said block by an iron chain. If you're playing the Copper Age drop (1.21.9) or later and the block above the lantern happens to be made of copper, the chain of the lantern (although not the lantern itself) will turn to copper matching the oxidization level and waxed state of the block above it.

Bored with Slimes and Magma Cubes? Looking for some more decor options? This is where the fun begins.
## 💀 Heads in Lanterns
If you've got a mob head from Wither Skeleton farming, Charged Creeper shenanigans, or End busting, you can craft it together with 8 Iron Nuggets to make a lantern with that same head. Alternatively, you can place down your Lantern with Magma Cube or Slime and throw the mob head on top of it -- the new head will be placed in the lantern, and you'll get your Magma or Slime Block back. If you don't like the new look, just throw the block back onto the lantern and the Magma Cube or Slime will take the head's place.
### 🙂 Player Heads
While you can't craft Lanterns with Player Heads, you can create them by throwing a Player Head onto an already placed lantern. Just like with mob heads, the Player Head will replace the previous head in the lantern, which will get dropped as an item. (Note: This only works with Player Heads attached to a profile, not the default Steve head in the Creative inventory.)

To supplement this pack, I'd recommend any one of the multitudinous Player Head data packs available on Modrinth, or the [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/datapacks/) option for Player Head Drops. Have fun decorating!

title: Player Pinger
description: A simple plugin for locating players using sounds! Fully customizable
body:
# Pinger

**Pinger** lets players **ping locations** in the world using directional note block sounds.  
The pitch of the sound changes with distance, helping players estimate how far away the ping is.  
Players can also mute or unmute pings from others, and server owners can fully customize behavior in the configuration file.  

---

## Features
- 🎵 **Directional note block pings** – sounds come from the correct direction relative to the player.  
- 📏 **Distance-based pitch** – closer pings are higher pitch, farther ones are lower.  
- 🔇 **Mute system** – toggle pings from other players.  
- ⚙️ **Fully configurable** – adjust cooldowns, repeat count, sound type, pitch scaling, and more.  

---

## Commands
- `/ping <player|@a>` – Send a ping to another player (or everyone).  
- `/pingmute` – Toggle pings from other players.  

---

## Configuration (`config.yml`)

```yaml
ping:
  # Cooldown between pings in seconds
  cooldown_seconds: 15

  # Number of times a ping sound is played
  repeat_count: 7

  # Interval between each ping sound (20 ticks = 1 second)
  interval_ticks: 20

  # Sound effect used for the ping
  sound: BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_PLING

  # Volume of the ping sound
  volume: 7.0

  # How much the pitch changes per chunk of distance
  pitch_per_chunk: 0.1

title: Buro
description: A simple, client-side visual mod that plunges your world into an endless, atmospheric night.
body:
# Buro

*A client-side mod for a world of atmospheric darkness.*

---

### Overview

**Buro** is a lightweight, client-side utility mod that gives you control over the world's atmosphere, allowing you to create a perpetual, moody darkness. If you've ever wanted a spooky setting for an adventure map or the perfect backdrop for cinematic shots, this mod is for you.

---

### Features

The mod combines two key visual effects to create its unique atmosphere, which can be enabled or disabled with a single click in the config menu:

*   **Pitch Black Fog:** Replaces the default distance fog with a solid, oppressive black void. What lurks in the darkness is for you to find out.
*   **Void Sky:** The sky is rendered as a pure black canvas. The sun, moon, and stars are completely hidden, creating a sense of timeless, endless night.

---

### Configuration

*   You must have **Mod Menu** and **Cloth Config API** installed.
*   Navigate to the Mods list from the main menu or pause screen.
*   Find **Buro** and click the config button (the gear icon).
*   Toggle the "Enable Mod" switch to turn the effects on or off instantly. *(A world reload may be required for all changes to apply correctly).*

title: EG Tools Expanded
description: Adds additional tools to Minecraft Java Edition - Paxel, Construction Hammer, Paints + Paintbrush
body:
Tools Expanded introduces a refined set of utilities designed to enhance both practical gameplay and creative building in Minecraft.

The mod adds iron, diamond, and netherite paxels—multi-purpose tools that function simultaneously as a pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, shears, and sword. These tools respond seamlessly to both left and right click actions, consolidating nearly all vanilla tool functions into a single implement.

Also included is the construction hammer, a specialized tool for altering block variants. It currently supports the full range of vanilla blocks found in the creative mode construction tab, as well as selected functional and redstone blocks. This allows players to cycle between block states with precision and efficiency, making architectural experimentation significantly more accessible. A few examples of this would be Oak Log > Oak Stairs, Cobblestone > Mossy Cobblestone, Andesite > Polished Andesite Stairs, etc etc. 

In addition, Tools Expanded introduces a way to repaint placed blocks. Players can craft an empty paint bucket, then fill it to produce buckets of paint corresponding to each vanilla dye color. The paint brush enables recoloring of a wide array of blocks, including terracotta, glass, concrete, beds, and others. The brush accepts up to four paint cans at once (32 uses per can), providing substantial flexibility before needing to reload. Testing has shown that shulker boxes retain their NBT data—including names and stored items—when recolored, although users should exercise caution and proceed at their own risk.

**All crafting recipes examples are provided in the gallery.**

Feedback, suggestions, or issue reports are welcome and may be directed to our Discord.

Paxels, Construction Hammer, and Paintbrush models created by Envy Games. Credit to MalcomRiley for the paint bucket textures.

title: SimpleAnnouncement
description: A lightweight Velocity announcement plugin that periodically sends custom-formatted announcement messages to all online players.
body:
# SimpleAnnouncement  
![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.16%2B-purple)
![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Velocity-yellow/)
![Languages](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supported_Languages-en%2Czh/Custom-blue)

SimpleAnnouncement is a lightweight Velocity announcement plugin that periodically sends custom-formatted announcement messages to all online players.  

## Features  
- 🕒 Scheduled announcement broadcasts  
- 🎨 Supports MiniMessage rich text formatting (gradients, click events, hover tooltips, etc.)  
- 🔄 Hot-reload configuration support  

## Configuration  
```properties
# Announcement interval (seconds)
interval = 300

# Announcement message list
announcements = [
  # Gradient text example
  "<gradient:red:blue>Welcome to the server!</gradient>",
  
  # Text with click event
  "<click:open_url:'https://example.com'><hover:show_text:'Click to visit'>Official Website</hover></click>",
  
  # Rainbow text
  "<rainbow>Daily events are ongoing!</rainbow>",
  
  # Bold text
  "<bold>Please follow server rules!</bold>",
  
  # Multi-line message example
  "<newline><gradient:gold:yellow>==== Server Notice ====</gradient><newline>Today's Event: <green>Survival Challenge</green><newline>Time: <aqua>20:00-22:00</aqua>"
]
```

## MiniMessage Format Guide  
MiniMessage enables rich text formatting:  

**Colors**:  
   - Named colors: `<red>Red text</red>`  
   - HEX colors: `<#ff0000>Red text</#ff0000>`  

**Gradients**:  
   ```
   <gradient:red:blue>Red-Blue gradient text</gradient>
   ```  

**Click Events**:  
   ```
   <click:open_url:'https://example.com'>Click to open website</click>
   <click:run_command:'/spawn'>Click to teleport</click>
   ```  

**Hover Tooltips**:  
   ```
   <hover:show_text:'Tooltip content'>Hover to view</hover>
   ```  

**Special Effects**:  
   ```
   <bold>Bold</bold>
   <italic>Italic</italic>
   <underlined>Underlined</underlined>
   <strikethrough>Strikethrough</strikethrough>
   <rainbow>Rainbow text</rainbow>
   ```  

**Line Breaks**:  
   ```
   Line 1<newline>Line 2
   ```  

More formats: [MiniMessage Documentation](https://docs.advntr.dev/minimessage/format.html)  

## Commands  
| Command | Permission | Description |  
|---------|------------|-------------|  
| `/simpleannouncementreload` or `/sar` | `simpleannouncement.reload` | Reload configuration file |  

---  
> 💡 Tip: Preview MiniMessage effects using [MiniMessage Viewer](https://webui.advntr.dev/)


---



# SimpleAnnouncement 简单公告

   ```

   ```

更多格式可参考：[MiniMessage 文档](https://docs.advntr.dev/minimessage/format.html)



## 命令

title: Auditor
description: Monitor, Analyze and Secure Your Server Economy
body:
Advanced Economy Monitoring & Analysis

Monitor, Analyze and Secure Your Server Economy










Auditor is a comprehensive economy monitoring plugin designed to help server administrators track, analyze, and manage their server's economic health. With advanced transaction monitoring, player behavior analysis, and real-time alerts, Auditor provides the tools needed to maintain a balanced and fair economy.








## Real-Time Monitoring - **Transaction Tracking** – Monitor all economy transactions in real time - **Player Profiles** – Automatic profile creation for every player with economic activity - **Risk Assessment** – Automatic risk scoring based on transaction patterns - **Live Alerts** – Instant notifications for suspicious activities
## Advanced GUI System - **Dashboard** – Comprehensive overview of server economy health - **Player Analysis** – Detailed player profiles with transaction history - **Alert Management** – Interactive alert system with resolution tracking - **Settings GUI** – Full configuration through intuitive interfaces - **No Chat Spam** – All features accessible through GUIs, keeping chat clean
## Security Features - **Fraud Detection** – Automatic detection of suspicious transaction patterns - **Flag System** – Mark players with customizable flags (SUSPICIOUS, BOT_SUSPECTED, TRUSTED, etc.) - **Admin Notes** – Add private notes to player profiles for staff reference - **Permission-Based Access** – Granular permission system for different staff levels
## Analytics & Reporting - **Economy Health Metrics** – Track inflation, wealth distribution, and market trends - **Player Rankings** – View top players by various metrics - **Transaction Volume Analysis** – Monitor server-wide economic activity - **Data Export** – Export data to CSV for external analysis
## Administration Tools - **Monitoring Toggle** – Enable enhanced monitoring for specific players - **Maintenance Mode** – Temporarily disable monitoring during maintenance - **Database Management** – Built-in cleanup and optimization tools - **Integration Support** – Works with Vault, DiscordSRV, PlaceholderAPI, and more








## Requirements - **Minecraft:** 1.13.2 or higher - **Vault:** Required for economy integration - **Economy Plugin:** Any Vault-compatible economy plugin (EssentialsX, CMI, etc.) - **Java:** 8 or higher








## Installation 1. Download `Auditor.jar` 2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder 3. Ensure **Vault** is installed 4. Restart your server 5. Configure using `/auditor settings` or edit `config.yml`








Click to view commands ```bash /auditor # Open the main dashboard /audit # Alias for /auditor /auditor player # Analyze specific player /auditor alerts # View active alerts /auditor settings # Open settings GUI /auditor reload # Reload configuration /auditor help # Show help message ```









Click to view permissions ``` auditor.admin # Full administrative access auditor.moderator # Staff access for monitoring auditor.dashboard # Access to main dashboard auditor.player.view # View player analysis auditor.player.others # Analyze other players auditor.alerts.view # View alerts auditor.alerts.manage # Manage and resolve alerts auditor.export # Export data auditor.monitor # Toggle player monitoring auditor.flag # Manage player flags auditor.note # Manage admin notes auditor.settings # Access settings auditor.reload # Reload configuration auditor.bypass # Bypass transaction monitoring ```









## Best For - Economy-focused servers - Servers with player shops/markets - RPG servers with complex economies - Any server wanting to prevent economy exploits - Administrators who need detailed economic insights








## Highlights - **100% GUI-Based** – No chat commands needed for daily use - **Real Player Heads** – Shows actual Minecraft player skins in GUIs - **Automatic Risk Assessment** – AI‑like pattern detection for suspicious behavior - **Zero-Setup Detection** – Works immediately after installation - **Performance Optimized** – Asynchronous database operations








Click to view monitored activities - All economy transactions (pay, shop, auction, etc.) - Balance changes - Transaction frequency and patterns - Large/unusual transactions - Player wealth accumulation - Cross-player transaction networks - Command usage related to economy - Time-based transaction patterns









Menus




Auditor Dashboard and Player Analyzer interfaces




Popups







Player Information, Risk Assessment, Current Status, Recent Transactions, and Alerts







## Why Choose Auditor? Unlike simple economy loggers, Auditor provides intelligent analysis and actionable insights. It's not just about recording transactions — it's about understanding your server's economic health and preventing problems before they impact gameplay. ### Key Advantages - ✅ Real‑time fraud detection - ✅ Beautiful GUI system - ✅ Comprehensive player profiles - ✅ Automatic risk assessment - ✅ Professional‑grade analytics - ✅ Active development & support





## Planned Features
View roadmap - Web panel integration - Machine learning fraud detection - Custom alert triggers - API for developers - Multi-server support - Advanced report generation









**Discord Support:** [Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/nY4ckCFBTQ) **GitHub Issues:** [Report bugs here](https://github.com/WiiZARDD/Auditor/issues) **Wiki:** [Full documentation](https://github.com/wiizardd/auditor)

A Minecraft Fabric mod that logs player login and logout events to a file, with special detection for first-time players.

title: Auto Team Chat
description: This client mod allows you to use shortcuts for switching between team and global chat
body:
# Auto Team Chat

A lightweight Fabric mod that automatically redirects your chat messages to your team channel by default, while still letting you drop a message in global chat with a single character.

---

## 🎯 Overview

On team‑based servers - Factions, Bed Wars, SkyBlock co‑op, and more - mis‑sent messages can cost you victories and spoil strategies. **Auto Team Chat** solves this by:

- **Defaulting** every message to your team chat command (e.g. `/teammsg`)  
- **Reserving** a single‑character override (`!`) to send global chat  

No more typing long commands or worrying if you slipped into the wrong channel!

---

## ✨ Features

- **Automatic Team Chat**  
  Every chat you type (e.g. `Hello team!`) is sent to `/teammsg Hello team!` by default.

- **Global Chat Override**  
  Start your message with `!` (e.g. `!Hello everyone!`) to send it as a normal global chat message; the `!` is stripped automatically.

- **Client‑Side Only**  
  No server plugin required - install on the client and go.

- **Lightweight & Fast**  
  Written in pure Fabric, minimal impact on performance.

- **Broad Compatibility**  
  Works on Minecraft **1.16.5 → 1.21.x** with Fabric Loader & Fabric API.

---

## 🚀 Why You'll Love It

- **Zero Mistakes**  
  Avoid accidentally broadcasting private team tactics to the whole server.

- **One‑Key Global Chat**  
  No need to reach for `/msg`, `/say`, or chat toggles - just `!`.

- **Focus on Gameplay**  
  Spend less time typing and more time building, fighting, or looting.

---

## 📥 Installation

1. **Install Fabric Loader** (any recent version) and **Fabric API**.  
2. Download `AutoTeamChat‑<version>.jar` from the [Modrinth page](https://modrinth.com/project/auto-team-chat).  
3. Move the JAR into your `mods/` folder.  
4. Launch Minecraft on the Fabric profile.

title: Harder Elytras
description: A simple mod that makes elytras harder to obtain!
body:
# About

This is a simple mod made to make obtaining elytras harder.

### Why?

I think many of us would agree that the Elytra is pretty OP, and they're quite easy to obtain once you get good at the game. You just have to beat the Ender Dragon (which isn't that hard), and then just run around and suddenly you have an Elytra! 

For some people this is too easy, and for me this meant that me and my friends had an Elytra Within the first day that we opened a new server. So i decided to fix it!


### How?

The first way elytras are harder to obtain is by making the recipe for Eyes of Ender a little harder. It still not too hard, but it slows the process of getting to the end a bit.

The main way elytras are harder to obtain are that elytras in end ships are replaced by a new item called an elytra core. This item can be used to craft an elytra, but you will need some additional resources (the recipe can be found in gallery along with the eye of ender recipe).

# Q&A

### Q: Is it just serverside (e.g. can i use it on a server without users having to install the mod)?

A: No, because the mod adds an item, both the client and the server has to have it installed. If you want to add it to a server without the user installing anyting you can find the datapack version [here.](https://modrinth.com/datapack/harder-elytras-datapack)

### Q: Can i change the recipes?

A: Yes, by making a datapack.

The recipes are located under ```data/harder-elytras/recipe/elytra.json``` and ```data/minecraft/recipe/ender_eye.json```.
For making the recipes i recommend using [TheDestruc7i0n's crafting recipe generator](https://crafting.thedestruc7i0n.ca/).

# 📖 What’s GuardianCore?
Say goodbye to limitations — GuardianCore is the next-generation replacement for EssentialsX, designed to give you total control over your server’s commands, customization, and player management.

Packed with all the essential commands you know and love, GuardianCore goes further with a full suite of advanced features — from powerful GUI-based editors to deep tracking tools, customizable kits, dynamic menus, and a fully configurable experience.

No extra plugins. No limitations. Just full power, right out of the box.

# ✅ Key Features
- Complete EssentialsX alternative — includes all standard commands with even more flexibility.
- Create unlimited custom commands in config.yml, with placeholders and conditions.
- Design fully interactive menus and GUIs in menus.yml — clickable items, lore, actions, and more.
- Full customization — every message can be edited via the messages folder (multi-language support included).
- GUI-powered item editors — rename items, edit lore (with color codes & multi-line support), enchant, and more.
- Kit system with full GUI control — set permissions, cooldowns, commands, and descriptions.
- Track player history — view last login/logout locations, teleport history, and actions.
- Rollback system — inspect and revert player actions like block breaking/placing.
- Built-in backup manager — create, list, and restore plugin data backups.
- Advanced teleportation system — includes TPA requests, TP history, and logs.
- All actions are logged — inventory views, teleportation, item changes, and more.
- Each player gets an individual data file, laying the groundwork for even deeper personalization in future versions.

body:
# Sword Blocking

This datapack brings back the ability to block with a sword in Minecraft! Originally a feature in older versions of the game, the ability to block attacks with a sword was removed. With this datapack, the classic sword-blocking mechanic is revived and seamlessly integrated into modern Minecraft versions.

### Features:
- **Sword Blocking**: Hold the right mouse button key while wielding a sword to block incoming attacks. Blocking significantly reduces the damage you take.
- **Compatible with All Sword Types**: Whether you're using a wooden, stone, iron, gold, diamond, or netherite sword – blocking works with all of them!
- **Strategic Combat**: Use blocking to gain tactical advantages in fights, especially against melee mobs or incoming projectiles like arrows.
- **Easy Installation**: No mods needed – just drop the datapack into your world folder and start playing!

### How to Install:
1. Download the datapack and place it in the `datapacks` folder of your world.
2. Reload the world or use the `/reload` command.

description: Amplified Dimension but the water level is really high.
body:
Basics

Adds a dimension that mirrors the overworld, but it uses the amplified terrain generator, except the water level is way higher! This dimension is as close as can be to the overworld in terms of biome placement, structure placement, and feature placement. 

Terrablender biomes seem to work in the amplified dimension.

Important Notes
This datapack/mod does not provide a way to enter the dimension! I recommend using the Datapack Portals Mod to make a datapack that allows you to construct a portal that leads to the dimension. The Dimension's namespace is "amplidimflooded:overworld" in case you want to use the execute command to teleport into it.

It does rain in the dimension, but for the /weather command to work, you have to execute it in the default overworld. The weather is synced between both dimensions, as well as time.

Other Recommendations
Any datapack that makes the overworld taller. It will apply to the amplified dimension too and allow you to build on the taller mountains, which stretch very close to build limit!
Also goes with my other datapack: Amplified Dimension! (Its just like this but without the extreme water level)

Tested on 1.20.1 but also might work on other versions.

Usage In Modpacks
You're more than welcome to put this in a modpack, just credit me if the modpack is public!

Note to Modpack Authors: since this dimension isn't exactly the overworld, some mods might need extra configuring to recognize it as a valid overworld dimension for some of their features!

title: Quill
description: A feature-filled library to streamline Minecraft plugin development.
body:
# Quill
[![](https://jitpack.io/v/xLevitate/Quill.svg)](https://jitpack.io/#xLevitate/Quill)

Quill is a comprehensive utility library for Paper plugins, providing a wide range of tools and systems to simplify plugin development. It offers everything from configuration management to advanced item creation, all with a clean and intuitive API.

## Features

- 🔧 **Configuration System** - Annotation-based configuration with automatic updating
- 💬 **Chat System** - Advanced message handling with MiniMessage support
- 💾 **JSON Storage** - Flexible and type-safe data storage system
- 📦 **Item Management** - Powerful item creation and manipulation
- 📋 **Scoreboard System** - Simple yet flexible scoreboard creation
- 🎮 **Events System** - Streamlined event handling with filtering
- 🛠️ **Utility Classes** - Comprehensive collection of utility methods
- 🔌 **Plugin Hooks** - Built-in integration with PlaceholderAPI and Vault

## Installation

### 1. Server Installation
First, download and install the Quill plugin on your server:
1. Download the latest version from [Releases](https://github.com/xLevitate/Quill/releases)
2. Place the JAR file in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server

### 2. Development Integration

#### Gradle (Kotlin DSL)
```kotlin
repositories {
    maven("https://jitpack.io")
}

dependencies {
    compileOnly("com.github.xLevitate:Quill:2.6.0")
}
```

#### Gradle (Groovy)
```groovy
repositories {
    maven { url 'https://jitpack.io' }
}

dependencies {
    compileOnly 'com.github.xLevitate:Quill:2.6.0'
}
```

#### Maven
```xml
<repositories>
    <repository>
        <id>jitpack.io</id>
        <url>https://jitpack.io</url>
    </repository>
</repositories>

<dependencies>
    <dependency>
        <groupId>com.github.xLevitate</groupId>
        <artifactId>Quill</artifactId>
        <version>2.6.0</version>
        <scope>provided</scope>
    </dependency>
</dependencies>
```

## Quick Start

### Chat System
```java
// Send formatted message
Chat.sendMessage(player, "<gradient:green:blue>Welcome to the server!</gradient>");

// Send title
Chat.sendTitle(player, "<gold>Welcome!", "<gray>Enjoy your stay");
```

### Configuration
```java
@Configuration("config.yml")
public class MyConfig {
    @Comment("Enable or disable the plugin")
    private boolean enabled = true;

    @Comment("Custom message")
    private String message = "<green>Hello!</green>";
}
```

### Item Creation
```java
ItemStack item = new ItemWrapper()
    .plugin(plugin)
    .material(Material.DIAMOND_SWORD)
    .name("<gradient:blue:purple>Mystic Blade</gradient>")
    .lore(Arrays.asList(
        "<gray>A legendary weapon",
        "<blue>Damage: +50</blue>"
    ))
    .build();
```

### Event Handling
```java
Events.listen(plugin, PlayerJoinEvent.class)
    .filter(event -> !event.getPlayer().hasPlayedBefore())
    .handle(event -> {
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        Chat.sendMessage(player, "<green>Welcome to the server!");
    });
```

## Documentation

For detailed documentation, please visit our [Wiki](https://github.com/xLevitate/Quill/wiki).

## Requirements

- Java 17 or higher
- Paper 1.20.4 or higher
- (Optional) PlaceholderAPI for placeholder support
- (Optional) Vault for economy support

## Support

If you encounter any issues or have questions:
1. Check the [Wiki](https://github.com/xLevitate/Quill/wiki)
2. Open an [Issue](https://github.com/xLevitate/Quill/issues)

description: Ever wanted someone to be able to Do Certian Things? Like /gamemode? but dont want to give out op? are you playing without plugins? well this datapack does just that
body:
# SkyePerms v0.7.1
## The Minecraft Tag-Based Datapack Permission Manager by NobleSkye
![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/SkyePerms?style=for-the-badge&logoSize=12&label=Modrinth) ![GitHub Downloads (all assets, all releases)](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/NobleSkye/SkyePerms/total?style=for-the-badge&label=Github)

# 1.20.6+ Version Coming Soon!

### Overview
SkyePerms is a Minecraft datapack designed to manage permissions using tags. It allows players to easily switch gamemodes, manage permissions, and execute functions. This is mainly designed for ```play.legitimoose.com``` which is a datapack creation network to share datapacks. 

### Installation
1. Download the `SkyePerms-v[version].zip` file from the [releases page](https://github.com/NobleSkye/SkyePerms/releases).
2. Extract the contents of the zip file.
3. Place the extracted folder in the `datapacks` directory of your Minecraft world. \
```/.minecraft/saves/world/datapacks/EXTRACT HERE```
3.5. Make sure the datapack files looks like ```datapacks/skyeperms/assets``` and other files. 
4. Play the world

### Usage
- Use `/tag [target] add [tag]` to add tags to players.
- Use the provided functions to kick or smite players.
- Utilize triggers to switch gamemodes if permitted.

### Tags
- `gmc`, `gmsp`, `gma`, `gms`: Allows players to switch gamemodes.
- `is_trusted`: Combination of all gamemode tags.
- `force.[gamemode tag]`: Forces the specified gamemode.
- `is_banned`: Bans the player.
- `whitelisted`: Adds player to the whitelist

### Functions
- `/function skye:kick {"player":"username"}`: Kicks the specified player.
- `/function skye:smite {"player":"username"}`: Smites the specified player with lightning.
- `/function skye:whitelist/enable`: enables whitelist
- `/function skye:whitelist/disable`: disables whitelist
- `/trigger [gamemode]`: Switches to the specified gamemode if permitted.

### Environment Variables
- `whitelist`: 0:false 1:true ; weather the whitelist is working

### Feedback and Contributions
Feedback and contributions are welcome! Feel free to open issues or submit pull requests on the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/NobleSkye/SkyePerms). 

### Credits
- [@NobleSkye](https://github.com/NobleSkye), creator of SkyePerms.
- [@loglot](https://github.com/loglot) For alot of changes and ideas

body:
# No Slime Superflat

No Slime Superflat is a simple utility mod for Minecraft that prevents slimes from spawning in Superflat world

## Features

- **Slime Prevention**: Automatically stops slimes from spawning in worlds detected as "Superflat"
- **In-game Configuration**: You can enable or disable the mod's functionality through the config menu without restarting the game
- **Custom Blacklist**: Adds an option to include other entity IDs that you want to block from spawning in Superflat worlds
- **Basic Statistics**: Includes a command (`/noslimesuperflat stats`) to see how many spawns have been prevented in the current session

## Technical Details

- **Standalone**: This mod does not require Collective or any other library to function
- **Logic**: The mod checks the world type and entity type before canceling a spawn event. It includes a basic internal timer to limit how often it checks the world type

## How to Use

1. Install the mod in your `mods` folder.
2. Start the game. Slimes will no longer spawn in Superflat worlds by default
3. Use `/noslimesuperflat reload` if you manually edit the configuration file

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft Version**: 1.12.2, 1.16.5, 1.21.1
- **Forge**: Requires a standard Forge installation for 1.12.2 or 1.16.5
- **Fabric**: It requires an installation of Fabric and also Fabric API for the mod to work in versions above 1.21.1
- Works on both single-player clients and dedicated servers

- This pack includes optimization for all instances like _Fast Noise_ & _Noisium_ for optimized noise generation, _Very Many Players_ for optimization on servers, _Sodium_ for optimized rendering everywhere, and includes other amazing mods such as _Entity Culling_, _Ferrite Core_, _Better Block Entities_ and more!

- This pack includes no extra packs (otherwise known as bloat) for changing the vannila experience, just the basics to make modern Minecraft run amazing on old hardware.

## Things to Note
- Vsync is recomended to avoid stuttering with low memory allocation.
- This pack can also help things run smoothly on modern hardware and for more optimzation, consider pairing this pack with other performance mods such as _Voxy, Distant Horizons,_ or _Nvidium_.
- Updating the mods in the pack works completely fine, just make sure that you also update your _Fabric_ version as well if it has any.

### Specs for Testing
- Proccessor: 4 × Intel® Core™ i5-4310U CPU @ 2.00GHz (Integrated Graphics)

title: HungerBridge
description: A secure and lightweight HTTP bridge for Paper & Fabric
body:
HungerBridge is a **tiny, zero‑noise, multiloader HTTP bridge** that lets external services communicate with your Minecraft server safely and efficiently. Designed for **automation** and engineered to stay completely out of your way.

---

## What it does
- Exposes a **minimal HTTP API** for remote automation
- Supports **Paper** and **Fabric** with a shared common module
- Provides **run** and **log** endpoints _(more coming soon!)_
- Zero commands, zero chat output, zero clutter
- Safe by default — **shared secret authentication**, no open RCON, no exposed internals  

---

## Why it exists
Traditional RCON is slow, fragile, and unsafe to expose publicly.  
HungerBridge replaces it with a **modern, stateless, authenticated HTTP layer** that works identically across loaders.

---

## Features
- 🔌 **Unified API** across all loaders
- 🧩 **Python library**
- 🔐 **Shared‑secret authentication**
- ⚡ **Fast, lightweight, no tick overhead**
- 📝 **Structured logging endpoint**
- 🏃 **Command execution endpoint**

---

## Usage
HungerBridge is designed to be paired with **HungerLib** or any external client that can send authenticated HTTP requests.

Example integrations:
- Automation scripts
- Server orchestration
- Custom dashboards
- Server monitoring tools

---

## HungerLib support
While **HungerBridge** can be used by any HTTP client, **HungerLib** is a Python library built for queries.

### Installation
```bash
pip install hungerlib
```

### Usage
```python
from hungerlib import BridgeClient

# Create the client
bridge = BridgeClient(url="http://example.com:1913", token="YOUR_SECRET")

# Run a command
out = bridge.runCommand("say Hello from HungerBridge!", silent=False)
print("Command output:", out)

# Log something
bridge.log("Example script ran successfully", level="info")

# Get status
bridge.getStatus()

# Get version
bridge.getVersion()
```

---

## Supported Platforms
| Platform | Supported | Version |
|----------|-----------|---------|
| Fabric   | ✔ Yes     | 1.21.10+|
| Quilt    | ✔ Yes     | 1.21.10+|
| Paper    | ✔ Yes     | 1.21.10+|
| Purpur   | ✔ Yes     | 1.21.10+|


## Security Guide
HungerBridge is designed to be exposed safely when paired with Cloudflare.
This guide shows the minimal, recommended setup for securing your API over HTTPS.

**Put HungerBridge Behind Cloudflare**  
Create a DNS record:

| Type | Name |      Value       |         Proxy          |
|:----:|:----:|:----------------:|:----------------------:|
|  A   | api  | <your-server-ip> | Proxied (orange cloud) |

This gives you:
- HTTPS
- DDoS protection
- Firewall
- IP masking

**Your API will be available at:**  
```https://api.example.com:1913```

title: FoMobToggle
description: Personal GUI and permission-controlled toggles for nearby natural mob spawns.
body:
![Cover Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79c11226349c1b77e45061425e6bef463b68d59f.png)
**Let players control nearby natural mob spawning with a clean GUI and permission-based overrides.**

FoMobToggle gives players three simple toggles: all mobs, monsters, and passive mobs. Server owners can let players manage the settings themselves, or lock the final behavior through permission nodes for ranks, perks, or protected areas.

![FoMobToggle GUI with all mobs, monsters, and passive mob toggles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97199c2699689f87653dc76faf687b72b92ef446.png)

## Features

- Give players a compact GUI for all mobs, hostile mobs, and passive mobs.
- Block natural and chunk-generation spawns around players based on their effective settings.
- Use permission nodes as final overrides when a setting should be rank-controlled.
- Save per-player GUI choices to user data files.
- Disable the GUI while keeping permission-based spawn blocking active.
- Tune the nearby-player spawn check radius from config.

![Toggle item lore showing current result, saved GUI state, and permission mode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/590bde0c2a297cc2b7bb89e3c0c8c443214ec594.png)


![Permission override example in the GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93b1658b9a5dc4017d40a08f98ff2e4bac6f2c6a.png)

## Dependencies

FoMobToggle has no required external plugin dependencies.

## Commands

- `/fomobtoggle` - Open the mob toggle menu.
- Aliases: `/mobtoggle`, `/togglemob`, `/mobstogle`, `/togglemobs`

## Permissions

- `fomobtoggle.use` - Open the FoMobToggle GUI.
- `fomobtoggle.spawn.mob` - Final override for all mob spawning around the player.
- `fomobtoggle.spawn.monster` - Final override for monster spawning around the player.
- `fomobtoggle.spawn.passive` - Final override for passive mob spawning around the player.

title: FoShop
description: GUI economy shops with buying, selling, and rotating boosts.
body:
![FoShop cover image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Fi0CQQOz/images/c167539484d283b2fee8445f66e0bcb46116ebad.png)

FoShop gives server owners a clean GUI economy shop with buying, selling, admin editing, and optional rotating sell boosts in one place. Players get simple shop and sell workflows, while admins can manage sections, products, prices, limits, and migrations without turning the page into a config-only project.

## Shop Menu
- Build organized `/shop` sections with custom icons, descriptions, pages, prices, stock, buy limits, and product types for items, permissions, enchantments, commands, or display-only entries.
- Let players buy the exact amount they need through the amount selector or the built-in Buy More stack preset menu.

![FoShop main shop menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Fi0CQQOz/images/750506cd1c5014fdb1ff80ae3c6c342af41d3c76.png)

## Selling
- Give players fast selling through `/sell`, `/sell all`, `/sell hand`, and `/sellgui`, with unsellable items returned safely.
- Add polished sale feedback with optional hover receipts, titles, action bars, sounds, and SellGUI transaction logs.

![FoShop SellGUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Fi0CQQOz/images/c7513b904c69f0a7d7020d6fa3531c35a8221990.png)

## Rotating Sell Boosts
- Run optional rotating sell boosts through `/rotatingshop`, with configurable reset timing and editor controls for which sections and items can appear.

![FoShop rotating shop](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Fi0CQQOz/images/5d9c3509dcfe6a645f85490f11283f7747bd3453.png)

## Admin Tools
- Manage shop sections, products, settings, rotating-shop pools, reloads, and conversions from `/foshopadmin editor`.

![FoShop admin editor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Fi0CQQOz/images/9fcb631e7ac704df05c2355212f88c21f02108aa.png)

## Dependencies
- `Vault` plus an economy plugin - required for buy and sell payments.
- `PlaceholderAPI` - optional; parses PlaceholderAPI values in configurable shop and GUI text.

## Commands
- `/foshop` or `/shop` - Open the main shop GUI.
- `/sell [all|hand|gui]` - Sell inventory items, hand items, or open the SellGUI.
- `/sellall` - Sell all sellable inventory items.
- `/sellhand` or `/sellheld` - Sell the item in your main hand.
- `/fosellgui` or `/sellgui` - Open the SellGUI directly.
- `/rotatingshop` or `/rshop` - Open the rotating boosted sell shop when enabled.
- `/foshopadmin editor` - Open the in-game admin editor.
- `/foshopadmin reload` - Reload config, messages, GUI files, and shops.
- `/foshopadmin rotatingshop reset` - Pick a new rotating boosted sell set.
- `/foshopadmin convert <ShopGUIPlus|EconomyShopGUI> [dryrun]` - Convert supported shop layouts, with dry-run support.

## Permissions
- `foshop.use` - Allows using `/foshop`.
- `foshop.sellgui.use` - Allows using `/fosellgui` and `/sell gui`.
- `foshop.sellall` - Allows using `/sellall` and `/sell all`.
- `foshop.sellhand` - Allows using `/sellhand` and `/sell hand`.
- `foshop.rotatingshop` - Allows using `/rotatingshop`.
- `foshop.admin` - Allows using `/foshopadmin` and receiving admin update notices.

# Craftable Capes (Neo)Forge

title: SmartTriggers
description: Create custom triggers & automatic actions from in-game events
body:
Create powerful custom triggers based on chat, action bar, scoreboard, titles and more.
Automatically run actions like messages, titles, sounds, commands or state changes.

---

### What is SmartTriggers?
SmartTriggers is a fully client side mod, that lets you create your own automation system inside Minecraft. The Mod takes many diffrent Triggers and executes actions according to what you have set up.

The full list of Sources includes:
- Chat
- Action Bar
- Title
- Scoreboard (Sidebar)
- Tablist


The full list of Actions includes:
- Writing something in your Chat
- Setting an Action Bar
- Sending a Title
- Playing a Sound
- Executing a Command

Minecraft Formatting Codes will also work with these actions


You can also let the Mod do the following things:
- Toggling a Flag
- Starting/Stopping a Timer
- Incrementing/Resetting a Counter

Triggers can also react to these states. With these commands you can remove active states:
- /smarttriggers clear all - removes all active states
- /smarttriggers clear flags/timers/counters - removes all active flags/timers/counters
- /smarttriggers clear flags/timers/counters <key> - removes the flag/timer/counter with the specified key

---

### Configuration:
- **/smarttriggers** -> opens the main config screen
- **/smarttriggers gui** -> for moving the around the hud elements

### Example use cases:
- Show a title when a specific chat message appears
- Play a sound when something shows up in the scoreboard
- Start a Timer when someone joins your server

### Note:
- Client-side only
- Designed with Hypixel Skyblock in mind, but works on most servers and in singleplayer
- Automatic command execution actions may not be allowed on some servers

### Why this mod?
Unlike simple alert mods, SmartTriggers gives you a full rule-based system, that lets you fully customize what you want to have happen
