title: ForestCore
description: API for my plugins
body:
# ForestCore

A plugin that adds several features at once for my plugins

## Key Features

### 1. Update system
- Automatic update check via Modrinth
- Notifications about available updates in the console
- Support for all plugins connected to ForestCore

### 2. Color system
- HEX color support (&#000000)
- Vanilla color support (&f)
- Convenient `ColorUtils.colorize()` method for use in plugins

### 3. Plugin management menu
- View all connected plugins
- Display information about each plugin:
  - Name
  - Version
  - Plugin ID
  - Operation status
- Ability to edit plugin configuration directly from the menu

### 4. Command system
- `/fcore` - basic information about ForestCore
- `/fcore help` - list of all commands
- `/fcore help <plugin-id>` - commands of a specific plugin
- `/fcore reload <plugin-id>` - reload plugin configuration
- `/fcore menu` - open plugin management menu
- `/fcore <plugin-id>` - information about a specific plugin

## Installation

### For servers
1. Download the latest version of `ForestCore-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar` from the `target` folder after building the project
2. Place the file in the `plugins` folder of your server
3. Restart the server
4. ForestCore is ready to use!

### For developers

## Connecting the plugin to ForestCore

### 1. Adding a dependency
In your plugin's `pom.xml` add:

```xml
<repositories>
    <repository>
        <id>github</id>
        <name>GitHub Packages</name>
        <url>https://maven.pkg.github.com/camper_crafting/ForestCore</url>
    </repository>
</repositories>

<dependencies>
    <dependency>
        <groupId>ru.forestcore</groupId>
        <artifactId>ForestCore</artifactId>
        <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
        <scope>provided</scope>
    </dependency>
</dependencies>
```

### 2. Adding dependency to plugin.yml
```yaml
depend: [ForestCore]
```

### 3. Registering the plugin
In the `onEnable()` method of your plugin:

```java
ForestCore forestCore = (ForestCore) Bukkit.getPluginManager().getPlugin("ForestCore");
if (forestCore != null) {
    ForestPlugin forestPlugin = new ForestPlugin(
        "Plugin Name",           // plugin name
        getDescription().getVersion(), // plugin version
        "plugin-id",                  // Unique plugin ID
        "camper_crafting",            // author's name
        "https://modrinth.com/plugin/your-plugin", // link to Modrinth
        "https://github.com/your-username/your-plugin", // link to GitHub
        Arrays.asList(                // List of plugin commands
            "/command1 - Command Description 1",
            "/command2 - Command Description 2"
        )
    );
    forestCore.getPluginManager().registerPlugin("plugin-id", forestPlugin);
}
```

## Use of colors

### HEX colors
```java
String message = ColorUtils.colorize("&#FF0000Red text");
```

### Vanilla colors
```java
String message = ColorUtils.colorize("&cRed text");
```

### Color combination
```java
String message = ColorUtils.colorize("&#FF0000Red text &aand green text");
```

## Plugin Example

There is an `example-plugin.yml` in the repository called `ExamplePlugin` that demonstrates:
- Connecting to ForestCore
- Using colors
- Registering commands
- Integrating with ForestCore menus

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.16.5
- Paper/Spigot server
- Java 8 or higher

## Support

If you have any problems or questions, please create an Issue in the GitHub repository.

title: Valhal4o1331's Vanilla+ Modpack
description: Valhal4o1331's Vanilla+ Modpack is a lightweight Minecraft modpack that stays true to the vanilla experience while enhancing gameplay with subtle improvements. It includes quality-of-life mods, visual enhancements, and performance optimizations.
body:
# Valhal4o1331's Vanilla+ Modpack

**Valhal4o1331's Vanilla+ Modpack** is designed for players who love the core essence of Minecraft but want a touch of enhancement to improve their experience. This modpack stays true to the **vanilla gameplay** while carefully adding features that **enhance visuals, optimize performance**, and introduce subtle **quality-of-life improvements**—without overwhelming the player with major content overhauls.

## 🎮 Core Philosophy

The modpack aims to preserve the original Minecraft feel. Unlike heavy modpacks that completely overhaul gameplay, Vanilla+ is lightweight and accessible, making it perfect for casual players, survival worlds, or small multiplayer servers. It adds polish without changing the soul of the game.

## ✨ Features

- **Visual Enhancements**  
  Enjoy improved lighting, smoother animations, better particles, and aesthetic tweaks that make the game feel modern while retaining its iconic blocky look.

- **Quality of Life Mods**  
  Useful additions such as inventory sorting, tooltips, better UI, and easier item management that make everyday gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.

- **Performance Optimization**  
  Includes client-side mods that reduce lag, improve FPS, and enhance load times—perfect for both high-end and low-end systems.

- **Lightweight and Fast**  
  With a small mod count, the pack runs efficiently and doesn’t require powerful hardware or long loading times.

- **Multiplayer Friendly**  
  Designed to work well on servers with friends or in solo play, without causing compatibility issues or server lag.

## 🔧 Ideal For...

- Players who want Minecraft to feel fresh without losing the classic vibe.
- Builders looking for visual polish and smoother mechanics.
- Survivalists who enjoy challenge but appreciate quality-of-life perks.
- Streamers or YouTubers seeking a visually appealing but faithful modded experience.

title: NoobGlist
description: Glist plugin for velocity proxy!
body:
# NoobGlist – Advanced Global Player List for Velocity
NoobGlist is a lightweight and customizable /glist command for Velocity-powered proxy servers. It allows server admins and players to view a list of online players across all servers in the network, with clickable server links for easy switching.

## 🔹 Features:

✔ Display all online players grouped by server           
✔ Clickable server names to join instantly (/server or /queue integration)               
✔ Fully customizable messages using MiniMessage formatting             
✔ Permission-based config reload command (/glist reload)           
✔ Supports aliases: /glist, /nglist, /players, /nplayers, /nlist              

## 🔹 Usage:

/glist – View the online players across all servers             
/glist reload – Reloads configuration (Requires noobglist.reload)             

## 🔹 Installation:

1️⃣ Download NoobGlist.jar and place it in your Velocity plugins folder             
2️⃣ Restart the server           
3️⃣ Customize the messages in config.yml         
4️⃣ Use /glist to see player activity across the network          

## 💡 Customizable Config:
Modify the player list format, hover text, and more in config.yml. Default placeholders:

%server% – Server name

%playersnum% – Number of players on a server

%players% – List of player names

%totalplayers% – Total online players

### 🚀 Enhance your Velocity proxy with a powerful global player list!

title: WikiCraft
description: WikiCraft is a Minecraft plugin that integrates MediaWiki functionality directly into your server.
body:
# WikiCraft

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

[![Java Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-blue.svg)](https://openjdk.org/projects/jdk/21/)

[![PaperMC Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/PaperMC-1.21.8-blue.svg)](https://papermc.io/downloads)

WikiCraft is a Minecraft plugin that integrates MediaWiki functionality directly into your server.

## Table of Contents

- [WikiCraft](#wikicraft)
  - [Table of Contents](#table-of-contents)
  - [Features](#features)
  - [Installation](#installation)
  - [Usage](#usage)
    - [Basic Commands](#basic-commands)
    - [Permissions](#permissions)
  - [Contributing](#contributing)
    - [Requirements](#requirements)
    - [Building](#building)
  - [License](#license)
  - [Support](#support)

## Features

- Search MediaWiki pages directly from Minecraft
- Verify edits with Minecraft accounts
- Basic page viewing functionality
- Configurable search result limits

## Installation

1. **Create Bot Account**:
   - Log in to your MediaWiki instance as an administrator
   - Go to [Special:CreateAccount](https://yourwiki.com/Special:CreateAccount) (https://yourwiki.com/Special:CreateAccount)
   - Create a new account with:
     - Username: `WikiCraftBot` (recommended)
     - Password: [secure password]
     - Email: [any valid email]
     - Real Name: `WikiCraftBot` (optional)
     - Reason: `WikiCraftBot initial creation` (optional)

2. **Configure Bot Permissions**:
   - Visit [Special:UserRights](https://yourwiki.com/Special:UserRights/WikiCraftBot) (https://yourwiki.com/Special:UserRights/WikiCraftBot)
   - Grant the bot account:
     - `bot` rights
     - `administrator` rights
   - Save changes

3. **Verify Email**:
   - Visit [Special:ConfirmEmail](https://yourwiki.com/Special:ConfirmEmail) (https://yourwiki.com/Special:ConfirmEmail)
   - Follow the email verification instructions

4. **Install Plugin**:
   - Place WikiCraft.jar in your server's plugins folder
   - Edit config.yml:
     - Set `wiki-url` to your wiki's base URL
     - Set `wiki-bot-username` to your bot's username
     - Set `wiki-bot-password` to your bot's password
   - Restart the server

## Usage

### Basic Commands

- `/wiki search [query]` - Search the wiki
- `/wiki account link` - Link your Minecraft account to wiki account
- `/wiki help` - Show command help

### Permissions

- `wikicraft.anonymous` - Basic user permissions (default)
- `wikicraft.user` - Basic user permissions (default)
- `wikicraft.admin` - Administrative permissions

## License

This project is licensed under the [MIT License](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT).

## Support

For issues or feature requests, please open an issue on my [GitHub repository](https://github.com/WOFTNW/WikiCraft), or DM me on Discord at `iheron`.

If you would like to offer monetary support, consider seeing my personal [Ko-fi page](https://ko-fi.com/iheron), or supporting my work directly on the [WOFTNW Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/woftnw).

description: Difficult survival pack with cottagecore elements
body:
## **[Music pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/trial-by-farmer-music-pack) HIGHLY recommended**
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/qDJL_ARS9Uk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# Overview
**Trial by Farmer** is a modpack that combines cottagecore aesthetics, farming, and peaceful building with the danger and progression styling of more survival-oriented packs. It offers a weak-feeling early-game and mid-game experience, but nothing feels unfair and with sufficient preparation and survival skills you'll find yourself rising above the horrors of the dark.

In combination with Minecraft's data pack system, over **80** CraftTweaker script files were written to fully integrate mods with each other and make sure they follow the progression path properly. Extensive care was taken to make sure nothing feels unfinished or inconsistent.

### Key Features

- A long, thorough progression path using mechanical technology (Better with Time) heavily inspired by Valheim, Rebirth of the Night and Vintage Story

- A different world generator (Expanded Ecosphere), including features from the Spring to Life update and new mobs (LivingThings, Spring to Life Backport, Wildernature)

- A realistic skybox in both the Overworld and Paradise Lost (Astrocraft) which syncs with the in-game day and season

- Beautiful atmospherics (Better Clouds, Dynamic Surroundings, Fog, Mai)
  
- ReactiveMusic is included to enhance the fantasy vibe (the custom songpack for this pack can be found [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/trial-by-farmer-music-pack))
<details>
<summary>Survival Elements</summary>
  
- Tougher, smarter mobs (Nox: Renoxed, Zombie Awareness) that break blocks and will stop at nothing to reach you
  
- Horde nights every in-game week to test your skills (UndeadNights)
  
- A season system (Fabric Seasons) which affects crop growth, client-side cloud density and weather event frequencies, with day/night lengths changing depending on the current time of year

- Tons of new crops (Farmer's Delight, Flora Delight, Paradise Delight) with rebalanced hunger values that incentivize making more complicated dishes
  
- A dangerous mining dimension: **The Deep Underground**, with structures exclusive to the pack
</details>

<details>
<summary>Cottagecore Elements</summary>
  
- Massive amounts of block variants for building and decorating (Every Compat). Make your base cozy!
  
- Cobblemon roaming every dimension that can be battled and caught
  
- Many new foods, dishes and drinks to prepare (some of which can manipulate cobblemon spawns)

- Plenty of options for quick travel (Hang Glider, Horseshoes, Immersive Aircraft)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Compatibility/Parity Features</summary>
  
- EMI Biome icons for almost every single biome (over 180 custom-made ones)
  
- Progression is designed to slowly open up more features and options
  
- Many structures (both vanilla and modded) incorporate blocks from other mods
  
- Block, item, biome and crafting sound tags are all properly defined, including for mods that do not natively have them
  
- Modded world generation is not confined to vanilla biomes
</details>

### Notes
Trial by Farmer requires 4GB or 5GB of RAM allocated for the best experience. Also, please give the game around 20 seconds to first load into new worlds.


<details>
<summary>Credits</summary>

The required resource pack contains derivatives of textures from Farmer's Delight, specifically for recoloring blocks/items to match their changed recipes. This project uses the [MIT license](https://choosealicense.com/licenses/mit/). Additionally, some textures from Better With Time (a mod included in the pack) were edited for use on other items (this mod is under  [CC-BY-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)).

Custom EMI icons are derivative of the icons on the Minecraft Wiki, licensed under [CC BY-NC-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/).
</details>

title: SmpRules
description: Server-side rule pack for a PVP-style SMP: a single craftable Mace, no pvp damage for End Crystals and Respawn Anchors, openable Nether & End, combat-log and elytra-mace protection, and a 3000-block border — all tweakable from the console.
body:
# SmpRules

A server-side rule pack for a hardcore-style SMP. Everything is configurable, and most of it can be changed live from the console — no restarts needed.

## Features

### Items
- **One Mace per server.** Only a single Mace can ever be crafted. The holder shows up on everyone's locator bar, so the only way to get it is to hunt them down.
- **End Crystals & Respawn Anchors banned** — can't be crafted, placed, or used. Their explosions also deal no damage to players.
- **Command-driven item limits.** Ban or limit *any* item live:
  - `/smprules ban <item>` — no crafting, placing, or use
  - `/smprules limit <item> <count>` — only N craftable server-wide
  - `/smprules allow <item>` — remove a limit
  - `/smprules list | info | reset | reload`

### Dimensions
- **Open and close the Nether and End** on your schedule:
  - `/dimension open <nether|end>` / `/dimension close <nether|end>` / `/dimension status`
- Both start **closed**. A closed dimension can't be portaled into, and closing one sends anyone inside back to the overworld.

### Combat
- **No combat logging** — disconnecting in combat kills you (and drops your gear).
- **No elytra in combat** — you can't glide while combat-tagged.
- **No elytra-macing** — Mace hits set up by gliding are blocked.

### World
- **3000-block world border** (Nether auto-scaled to match coordinates).
- **Locator bar disabled** for everyone except the current Mace holder.

## Commands & permissions
| Command | Permission |
|---|---|
| `/smprules ...` | `smprules.admin` (op) |
| `/dimension ...` (alias `/dim`) | `smprules.dimensions` (op) |
| Ignore item limits | `smprules.items.bypass` |

## Requirements
- Paper server

## Thoả thuận người dùng
Bạn, với tư cách là người dùng, có thể làm những điều sau với plugin/mod này mà không cần xin phép tôi:
- Bạn có thể tạo video hoặc chụp ảnh màn hình và đăng tải chúng ở bất cứ đâu bạn muốn, tôi chỉ yêu cầu bạn ghi chú plugin/mod này là gì và cho mọi người biết nơi để tải nó.
- Bạn có thể sử dụng plugin/mod này như một phần phụ thuộc của plugin/mod khác, miễn là bạn ghi công và liên kết trở lại trang này.
- Bạn đồng ý rằng tôi sẽ sửa đổi đầy đủ hơn với phần tiếng Việt thay vì tiếng Anh, vì vậy bạn nên sử dụng các công cụ của bên thứ 3 như Google Translate, A.I (để phiên dịch tự động) hoặc các dịch vụ khác để tránh sự hiểu lầm hoặc các phần bị thiếu sót ở phiên bản dịch tiếng Anh).

Bạn, với tư cách là người dùng, KHÔNG được phép làm những điều sau với plugin/mod này:
- Bạn không được phép phân phối lại hoặc tải lên lại plugin/mod này khi không được cho phép!
- Bạn không được phép dịch ngược mã hoặc sửa đổi để chạy chung được với plugin/mod khác, trường hợp đặc biệt có thể được cho phép tuỳ theo yêu cầu!

Tôi, với tư cách là chủ sở hữu Paybot có quyền làm những việc sau:
- Plugin/mod của tôi sẽ có khả năng thu thập ip server của bạn và lưu nó về file với mục đích chặn/khoá sử dụng với các hành vi vi phạm pháp luật, vi phạm thoả thuận người dùng này (hoặc cũng là hành vi tôi cảm thấy là vi phạm, mặc dù không được liệt kê trên này).
- Plugin/mod của tôi có quyền thu thập các thông tin nhạy cảm như thông tin player (tên, uuid,...), thông tin thẻ cào người dùng gửi lên hệ thống (bao gồm số serial, mã thẻ cào, thông tin nhà mạng,...) chi tiết bên dưới, và các thông tin về tài khoản Sepay của bạn (với mục đích xác thực thông tin, tự động hoá hệ thống), ví dụ như tên ngân hàng, tên chủ tài khoản, số tài khoản.
- Tôi có quyền từ chối cung cấp mã nguồn, các thông tin nhạy cảm được thu thập đối với các cá nhân/tổ chức đối với toàn bộ Project Paybot.
- Tôi có quyền từ chối việc sửa đổi riêng cho từng server để phù hợp hơn với từng server (thường thì là không, sẽ được chấp nhận trong hầu hết trường hợp).
- Tôi có quyền thay đổi điều khoản bất kì lúc nào mà không cần sự cho phép của bạn, từ lúc bạn tải và sử dụng Paybot, bạn đồng ý rằng điều khoản có thể thay đổi bất kì lúc nào.

Tôi, với tư cách là chủ sở hữu Paybot sẽ không làm những việc sau:
- Plugin/mod/bot không có khả năng raid/phá server.
- Plugin/mod/bot sẽ không thu thập các thông tin khác ngoài những thông tin đã được công bố phía bên trên.
- Plugin/mod/bot sẽ không sửa đổi thông tin (thông tin player nhập, thông tin QR ngân hàng,...) với mục đích cá nhân hoặc bất cứ mục đích nào (mà không được user cho phép), tức tôi sẽ không có khả năng tự tạo QR trong server của bạn với mục đích scam/ăn cắp tiền từ player của bạn.

**Bằng cách sử dụng Paybot và các dịch vụ mở rộgn của Paybot, bạn đã đồng ý với các điều kiện/điều khoản trên!
Ngày sửa đổi cuối cùng: 05/07/2026 (Theo múi giờ UTC+7)**

## 📡 Công khai dữ liệu chia sẻ (Data Disclosure)

Plugin/Mod Paybot và Discord Bot này gửi các dữ liệu sau đến máy chủ bên thứ ba để xử lý giao dịch:

**Dữ liệu gửi từ Plugin/Mod → Discord Bot (dịch vụ mở rộng, chỉ khi đã `/connect`):**
- **Tên người chơi (player_name)** — để xác định ai đã thực hiện giao dịch
- **Định danh server (server_id)** — để bot nhận diện đúng server gửi yêu cầu
- **URL callback của plugin/mod** *(tuỳ chọn)* — nếu server tự mở port công khai được, bot sẽ gửi trả kết quả giao dịch trực tiếp về server (nhanh hơn, không qua bước trung gian); nếu không mở được thì plugin/mod tự hỏi lại bot khi cần (không gửi định kỳ "phòng hờ" nữa)
- **Thông tin thẻ cào** *(chỉ khi dùng /napthe)*: nhà mạng (telco), mệnh giá (denom), mã thẻ (card_code), số serial thẻ (card_serial)
- **Số tiền giao dịch** *(chỉ khi dùng /napbank)*: giá trị người chơi nhập vào
- **Trạng thái online của 1 người chơi cụ thể** — chỉ hỏi đúng lúc cần (khi người chơi đó dùng `/napbank` hoặc `/napthe` **từ Discord**, để biết route đúng server) — **không còn gửi danh sách toàn bộ người chơi định kỳ như trước**

**Dữ liệu gửi từ Discord Bot → Dịch vụ bên thứ ba:**
- **[SePay](https://sepay.vn/)** — nhận IPN webhook xác nhận giao dịch ngân hàng/ví điện tử *(tuỳ chọn)*; ngoài ra bot/plugin/mod còn **tự đọc** lịch sử giao dịch qua SePay API (dùng API Token do admin tự tạo tại my.sepay.vn) để tự xác minh thanh toán mà **không bắt buộc phải cấu hình webhook**
- **[TheSieuRe](https://thesieure.com/)** — xử lý đổi thẻ cào sang tiền; nhận: partner_id, partner_key, telco, mệnh giá, mã thẻ, serial thẻ, request_id
- **[GachThePro](https://gachthepro.com)** — xử lý đổi thẻ cào sang tiền (nhà cung cấp thay thế); nhận dữ liệu tương tự TheSieuRe
- **[GachTheFast](https://gachthefast.com)** — sẽ được hỗ trợ trong phiên bản tới; dữ liệu gửi đi sẽ được cập nhật khi tích hợp hoàn tất

Không có dữ liệu nào được gửi đi khi admin chưa cấu hình plugin/mod qua `/SePaySetup` hoặc `/CardSetup`. Người chơi không tự động kết nối với bất kỳ máy chủ từ xa nào.

> ⚠️ **Lưu ý kỹ thuật:** Plugin/Mod mở một HTTP server nội bộ trên port **25580** (mặc định, đổi được trong `config.yml`) để nhận callback từ bot Discord và webhook từ SePay. Admin cần đảm bảo port này được mở trên firewall của server nếu muốn dùng đường truyền nhanh (callback trực tiếp) — **không mở port này vẫn dùng được bình thường**, hệ thống tự chuyển sang cách hỏi-khi-cần thay thế.
> Mọi request giữa plugin/mod và bot đều được xác thực bằng API Key riêng — không cấu hình đúng key thì bot sẽ từ chối request.

## 📌 Mô tả Plugin/Mod

Yêu cầu server Minecraft sử dụng **Fabric**, từ **1.18+** và Java 17+ (sẽ hỗ trợ range version support).
### Tính năng:

**🟢 Lệnh người chơi** *(mặc định mọi người dùng được)*

- **/napbank** — Nạp tiền qua chuyển khoản ngân hàng: mở giao diện GUI hiển thị mã QR VietQR, nội dung chuyển khoản và hướng dẫn chi tiết. Hỗ trợ toàn bộ ngân hàng/ví điện tử Việt Nam qua [SePay](https://sepay.vn/)
- **/napthe** — Nạp thẻ cào: mở GUI chọn nhà mạng (Viettel, Mobifone, Vinaphone, Zing, Gate, Garena, Vcoin, Appota), rồi nhập mã thẻ và serial. Xử lý qua [TheSieuRe](https://thesieure.com/), [GachThePro](https://gachthepro.com) và các nhà cung cấp khác
- **/ok** — Xác nhận gửi thẻ cào lên hệ thống sau khi đã nhập đủ thông tin (dùng kèm `/napthe` ở chế độ text, thay thế cho nút bấm trong GUI)
- **/rewardclaim [confirm]** — Xem trước và nhận phần thưởng đang chờ (đơn được duyệt khi bạn đang offline). Gõ không có tham số để xem trước đơn cũ nhất, gõ `confirm` để xác nhận nhận thưởng
- **/paybotplaceholder** — Mở bảng thống kê nạp tiền trực tiếp trong game (tổng số tiền đã nạp, top người nạp nhiều nhất, …) — không cần cài PlaceholderAPI
- **/paybotowner \<mã\>** — Đăng nhập quyền owner bằng mã một lần (100 ký tự) lấy từ lệnh `/ownerlogin` trên Discord. Session có hiệu lực 30 phút. Dùng `/paybotowner logout` để đăng xuất sớm, `/paybotowner status` để xem thời gian còn lại

---

**🔧 Lệnh admin — Thiết lập** *(yêu cầu quyền `naptien.admin`, mặc định OP)*

- **/sepaysetup** — Cấu hình SePay: chỉ cần dán duy nhất **API Token** từ my.sepay.vn — plugin tự xác thực token, tự lấy danh sách ngân hàng/số tài khoản đã liên kết, không cần nhập tay. Có hướng dẫn từng bước tích hợp sẵn
- **/cardsetup** — Wizard cấu hình trung gian gạch thẻ (chọn TheSieuRe / GachThePro / …) và nhập API key, bao gồm cả việc xem và chỉnh mệnh giá thưởng tương ứng
- **/cardapisetup** — Mở GUI nhanh để chọn hoặc đổi site API gạch thẻ đang dùng (TheSieuRe / GachThePro)
- **/chinhsuamenhgianap** — Mở GUI chỉnh sửa danh sách mệnh giá và lệnh thưởng tương ứng cho từng mệnh giá (hỗ trợ tối đa 10 lệnh/mệnh giá, áp dụng riêng cho thẻ và bank)
- **/PayBotSetup** — Xem tổng quan trạng thái cấu hình hiện tại: SePay (ngân hàng, số tài khoản), Card API (site đang dùng), port webhook, chế độ hoạt động (Standalone hay Bot)

---

**📋 Lệnh admin — Quản lý đơn nạp** *(yêu cầu quyền `naptien.admin`)*

- **/bankcheck \[player\]** — Xem danh sách đơn ngân hàng dưới dạng GUI. Không có tham số → xem tất cả; thêm tên player → lọc theo người chơi đó
- **/cardcheck \[player\]** — Xem danh sách đơn thẻ cào dưới dạng GUI. Không có tham số → xem tất cả; thêm tên player → lọc theo người chơi đó
- **/topuplist all** — Xem toàn bộ đơn đang chờ (cả bank lẫn thẻ) trong một GUI duy nhất; cho phép duyệt thưởng trực tiếp từ đây (chỉ ở Standalone mode)
- **/approve \<invoice\_id\>** — Duyệt và cấp thưởng thủ công cho một đơn nạp cụ thể bằng ID đơn (chỉ dùng ở **Standalone mode** — khi chưa kết nối Discord bot). Nếu người chơi đang offline, thưởng sẽ được lưu lại và trao tự động khi họ vào lại

---

**🔗 Lệnh admin — Kết nối Discord Bot** *(yêu cầu quyền `naptien.admin`)*

- **/connect discord \<guild\_id\>** — Kết nối plugin với Discord bot bằng guild ID (lấy guild ID bằng lệnh `/id` trong Discord của hệ thống tự động), yêu cầu setup bằng lệnh `/Sepay` và lệnh `/connect` sau khi add bot trước khi có thể kết nối!
- **/disconnect \[--force\]** — Gửi yêu cầu ngắt kết nối đến Discord bot, chờ bot xác nhận rồi xoá cấu hình. Thêm `--force` để xoá cấu hình cục bộ ngay lập tức mà không cần liên hệ bot
- **/confirm** — Xác nhận hoàn tất quá trình ngắt kết nối sau khi bot đã phản hồi (dùng sau `/disconnect`)
- **/naptienid** — Xem thông tin định danh của server: server-id, guild-id đang kết nối, URL bot, port webhook và chế độ hoạt động hiện tại

- Note: Phải cấu hình Sepay trên bot bằng lệnh `/sepay` và cấu hình nạp thẻ qua lệnh `/connect` trên bot Discord thì mới dùng lệnh `/connect` trên server Minecraft được

---

**🧪 Lệnh admin — Debug / Test** *(yêu cầu OP)*

- **/testnapbank \[mệnh giá\]** — Mở UI nạp bank như bình thường, nhưng khi chọn mệnh giá sẽ giả lập giao dịch thành công ngay (không tạo QR thật, không gọi SePay). Dùng để kiểm tra chuỗi reward và hiệu ứng (pháo hoa, âm thanh, thông báo) hoạt động đúng
- **/testnapthe \[nhà mạng\] \[mệnh giá\]** — Mở UI nạp thẻ như bình thường, nhưng khi chọn mệnh giá sẽ giả lập gạch thẻ thành công ngay (không hỏi mã thẻ/serial, không gọi API thật). Dùng để kiểm tra chuỗi reward và hiệu ứng
- **/muapaybot** — Hiển thị thông tin và link mua plugin PayBot (Modrinth, Spigot, Hangar) — link có thể click trực tiếp trong chat (1.16+)

---

**👑 Lệnh Owner** *(chỉ dùng được khi đang trong phiên `/paybotowner` hợp lệ)*

- **/disablepaybot** — Chặn vĩnh viễn PayBot trên server này theo địa chỉ IP máy chủ thật. Hiệu lực ngay cả khi admin xoá plugin, đổi port hoặc cài lại bản mới — mọi lần khởi động tiếp theo trên cùng máy đó sẽ bị nhận diện và tự ngừng
- **/enablepaybot** — Gỡ chặn PayBot (xoá IP khỏi danh sách chặn của BanGuard) và kích hoạt lại toàn bộ tính năng ngay lập tức, không cần reload hay restart server

---

Plugin/mod giúp admin server tự động xử lý donate, cấu hình lệnh thưởng riêng, số tiền tương ứng cho từng mệnh giá, và tuỳ biến được nội dung chuyển khoản (tiền tố, độ dài, định dạng mã đơn) để khớp với hệ thống quản lý riêng của từng server.

Reward chờ xử lý được tự động giao ngay khi đủ điều kiện (không cần lệnh thủ công), kèm cơ chế chống giao trùng.

---

## 🤖 Discord Bot (Dịch vụ Tự động hóa — Tùy chọn)

Bot Discord hoạt động như một lớp trung gian giữa plugin/mod Minecraft và các nhà cung cấp thanh toán, giúp tự động hóa toàn bộ quy trình xử lý giao dịch. Không thay đổi kết cấu plugin/mod!

**Cách Bot hoạt động:**
- Nhận yêu cầu giao dịch từ plugin/mod qua HTTP (nạp thẻ hoặc nạp bank)
- Gửi thông tin thẻ cào đến TheSieuRe/GachThePro để đổi; nhận kết quả và cập nhật trạng thái
- Nhận IPN webhook từ SePay khi người chơi chuyển khoản thành công, **và/hoặc tự đọc lịch sử giao dịch qua SePay API** để xác minh thanh toán dù webhook không khả dụng
- Gửi lệnh thưởng về plugin/mod ngay khi giao dịch hoàn tất (ưu tiên gửi thẳng nếu server cho phép, tự chuyển sang cách hỏi-lại nếu không)
- Lưu hàng đợi reward offline — nếu server Minecraft tạm offline, bot giữ reward lại và tự động trao khi server kết nối lại
- Gửi thông báo giao dịch về Discord (webhook) để admin theo dõi
- Xác minh người chơi có đang online không **đúng lúc cần** (lúc họ nạp từ Discord) để đảm bảo reward trao đúng người, đúng lúc

**Dữ liệu Bot lưu trữ nội bộ:** cấu hình guild Discord, lịch sử giao dịch thẻ/bank, hàng đợi reward chờ xử lý, thông tin license, danh sách server kết nối.

Plugin/mod này không trực tiếp xử lý thanh toán. Tất cả các giao dịch tài chính đều được xử lý độc quyền bởi các dịch vụ bên thứ ba được liệt kê trong phần Tiết lộ dữ liệu ở trên.

## 📡 Data Disclosure

This plugin/mod and its companion Discord Bot transmit the following data to third-party servers for transaction processing:

**Data sent from Plugin/Mod → Discord Bot (extended automation service, only after `/connect`):**
- **Player username (player_name)** — to identify who initiated the transaction
- **Server identifier (server_id)** — so the bot can route requests to the correct server
- **Plugin/mod callback URL** *(optional)* — if the server can expose a public port, the bot pushes results straight back to it (faster); otherwise the plugin/mod asks the bot only when actually needed (no more periodic "just in case" reporting)
- **Prepaid card details** *(only when using /napthe)*: carrier (telco), denomination (denom), card code (card_code), card serial (card_serial)
- **Transaction amount** *(only when using /napbank)*: the value entered by the player
- **Online status of one specific player** — queried only at the moment it's needed (when that player runs `/napbank` or `/napthe` **from Discord**, to route the request to the right server) — **no longer sends the full online-player list on a timer**

**Data sent from Discord Bot → Third-party services:**
- **[SePay](https://sepay.vn/)** — receives IPN webhooks confirming bank/e-wallet transactions *(optional)*; the bot/plugin/mod can also **actively read** transaction history via the SePay API (using an admin-issued API Token) to verify payments **without requiring webhook setup**
- **[TheSieuRe](https://thesieure.com/)** — handles prepaid card exchange; receives: partner_id, partner_key, carrier, denomination, card code, card serial, request_id
- **[GachThePro](https://gachthepro.com)** — handles prepaid card exchange (alternative provider); receives the same data as TheSieuRe
- **[GachTheFast](https://gachthefast.com)** — support coming in a future update; data transmitted will be documented here upon integration

No data is transmitted until the server admin configures the plugin/mod via `/SePaySetup` or `/CardSetup`. Players are not automatically connected to any remote server.

> ⚠️ **Technical note:** This plugin/mod opens an internal HTTP server on port **25580** (default, configurable in `config.yml`) to receive callbacks from the Discord Bot and webhooks from SePay. Opening this port is **optional** — if it isn't reachable, the system automatically falls back to an ask-when-needed model instead. Every request between plugin/mod and bot is authenticated with a dedicated API key; a mismatched key is rejected.

---

## 📌 Plugin/Mod Description

Requires a Minecraft server running **Fabric**, version **1.18+** and Java 17+ (version range support included).

### Features:

**🟢 Player Commands** *(available to all players by default)*

- **/napbank** — Deposit via bank transfer: opens a GUI displaying a VietQR code, transfer content, and step-by-step instructions. Supports all Vietnamese banks and e-wallets via [SePay](https://sepay.vn/)
- **/napthe** — Prepaid card top-up: opens a GUI to select carrier (Viettel, Mobifone, Vinaphone, Zing, Gate, Garena, Vcoin, Appota), then enter the card code and serial. Processed via [TheSieuRe](https://thesieure.com/), [GachThePro](https://gachthepro.com), and other providers
- **/ok** — Confirm and submit a prepaid card after entering all details (used with `/napthe` in text mode as an alternative to the GUI button)
- **/rewardclaim [confirm]** — View and claim pending rewards (orders approved while you were offline). Run without arguments to preview the oldest pending reward; add `confirm` to claim it
- **/paybotplaceholder** — Open an in-game statistics panel showing total deposits, top depositors, and more — no PlaceholderAPI installation required
- **/paybotowner \<code\>** — Log in as owner using a one-time 100-character code from the `/ownerlogin` Discord command. Session lasts 30 minutes. Use `/paybotowner logout` to end the session early, `/paybotowner status` to check remaining time

---

**🔧 Admin Commands — Setup** *(requires `naptien.admin` permission, OP by default)*

- **/sepaysetup** — Configure SePay: paste a single **API Token** from my.sepay.vn — the plugin auto-validates the token and auto-fetches your linked bank accounts, no manual input needed. Includes a built-in step-by-step guide
- **/cardsetup** — Step-by-step wizard to configure the card exchange provider (TheSieuRe / GachThePro / …), enter your API key, and review denomination reward settings
- **/cardapisetup** — Quick GUI to select or change the active card exchange site (TheSieuRe / GachThePro)
- **/chinhsuamenhgianap** — Open the denomination reward editor GUI: configure reward commands per denomination (up to 10 commands per denomination, configured separately for card and bank)
- **/PayBotSetup** — View a status overview of the current configuration: SePay (bank name, account number), Card API (active provider), webhook port, and current operating mode (Standalone or Bot-connected)

---

**📋 Admin Commands — Order Management** *(requires `naptien.admin` permission)*

- **/bankcheck [player]** — View bank transfer orders in a GUI. No argument = view all orders; add a player name to filter by that player
- **/cardcheck [player]** — View prepaid card orders in a GUI. No argument = view all orders; add a player name to filter by that player
- **/topuplist all** — View all pending orders (both bank and card) in a single GUI; allows approving rewards directly from here (Standalone mode only)
- **/approve \<invoice\_id\>** — Manually approve and deliver a reward for a specific order by its ID (**Standalone mode only** — when not connected to the Discord bot). If the player is offline, the reward is saved and delivered automatically when they log back in

---

**🔗 Admin Commands — Discord Bot Connection** *(requires `naptien.admin` permission)*

- **/connect discord \<guild\_id\>** — Connect the plugin to the Discord bot using the guild ID (retrieve the guild ID with the `/id` command in the automation system's Discord), requires setup using the `/Sepay` and `/connect` commands after adding the bot before a connection can be established!
- **/disconnect [--force]** — Send a disconnect request to the Discord bot and wait for confirmation before clearing local config. Add `--force` to immediately clear the local config without contacting the bot
- **/confirm** — Confirm the disconnect process after the bot has responded (use after `/disconnect`)
- **/naptienid** — Display the server's identity information: server-id, connected guild-id, bot URL, webhook port, and current operating mode

---

**🧪 Admin Commands — Debug / Test** *(requires OP)*

- **/testnapbank [amount]** — Opens the bank deposit UI as normal, but simulates a successful transaction immediately upon selecting a denomination (no real QR generated, no SePay calls made). Use to verify that reward commands and effects (fireworks, sounds, messages) are working correctly
- **/testnapthe [carrier] [denomination]** — Opens the card top-up UI as normal, but simulates a successful card exchange immediately upon selecting a denomination (no card code/serial required, no real API calls made). Use to verify reward commands and effects
- **/muapaybot** — Display purchase information and links for PayBot (Modrinth, Spigot, Hangar) — links are clickable directly in chat (1.16+)

---

**👑 Owner Commands** *(only usable during an active `/paybotowner` session)*

- **/disablepaybot** — Permanently block PayBot on this server by the machine's real public IP address. This persists even if the admin removes the plugin, changes the port, or reinstalls a new version — any future startup on the same machine will be detected and automatically halted
- **/enablepaybot** — Unblock PayBot (removes this machine's IP from BanGuard's block list) and immediately re-activates all features without requiring a server reload or restart

---

The plugin/mod lets server admins automate donation handling, configure custom reward commands and amounts per denomination, and customize the bank transfer content format (prefix, length, character set) to match each server's own tracking system.

Pending rewards are delivered automatically as soon as conditions are met (no manual command needed), with built-in double-delivery protection.

---

## 🤖 Discord Bot (Extended Automation Service — Optional)

The Discord Bot acts as a middleware layer between the Minecraft plugin/mod and payment providers, fully automating the transaction workflow.

**How the Bot works:**
- Receives transaction requests from the plugin/mod over HTTP (card top-up or bank transfer)
- Forwards card data to TheSieuRe/GachThePro for processing; receives results and updates transaction status
- Receives IPN webhooks from SePay when a player completes a bank transfer, **and/or actively polls the SePay API** to verify payments even when a webhook isn't set up
- Sends reward commands back to the plugin/mod as soon as a transaction is confirmed (pushes directly when possible, falls back to an ask-when-needed model otherwise)
- Maintains an offline reward queue — if the Minecraft server is temporarily offline, the bot holds rewards and delivers them automatically when the server reconnects
- Sends transaction notifications to Discord (webhook) for admin monitoring
- Verifies a player's online status exactly when needed (when they top up from Discord) to ensure rewards reach the right player at the right time

**Data stored internally by the Bot:** Discord guild configuration, card/bank transaction history, pending reward queue, license information, connected server list.

This plugin/mod does not directly process payments. All financial transactions are processed exclusively by the third-party services listed in the Data Disclosure section above.

Process: Players use /napbank or /napthe → the plugin/mod saves the relevant information (detailed above) and sends it to SePay/TheSieuRe,... → Once the transaction is confirmed, the admin or Discord Bot automatically executes the preconfigured reward command.

title: Ranziomon
description: A progression-focused Cobblemon multiplayer modpack with all 1025 Pokémon, Megas, Dynamax, Z-Moves, custom gyms, dimensional leagues, exploration, structures, and server-focused performance.
body:
# RanzioMon

RanzioMon is a Cobblemon-based multiplayer modpack built around progression, exploration, and competitive-style battles.

This pack is designed for a private server / content series experience, where players advance through a structured challenge route instead of simply rushing freely from the beginning. Train your team, explore the world, unlock stronger encounters, defeat custom trainers, and prepare for increasingly difficult gym leaders and league battles across multiple dimensions.

- Support for all 1025 Pokémon through Cobblemon and additional compatible content.
- Mega Evolution, Dynamax, Gigantamax, Z-Moves, and expanded battle mechanics.
- A custom progression-focused gym and league system built around Radical Cobblemon Trainers.
- Competitive-inspired trainer teams with custom movesets, EVs, IVs, abilities, held items, and battle formats.
- Dimension-based progression, including Overworld gyms, Nether challenges, End leagues, and late-game distortion-themed content.
- Expanded exploration with new biomes, structures, monuments, loot, and world-generation features.
- Multiplayer-friendly systems such as voice chat, waystones, maps, shared exploration tools, and server-side optimization.
- Extra building, decoration, farming, storage, and quality-of-life features to support long-term server play.
- Performance-focused client and server optimizations for a smoother modded Cobblemon experience.

## Progression

RanzioMon is not intended to be a completely open-ended Cobblemon sandbox from the first minute.

The pack is built around a progressive challenge structure where players grow stronger over time, earn access to harder battles, and prepare for stronger opponents. Gym leaders, elite trainers, and league members are designed to test team building, type coverage, held items, and battle strategy.

Players are encouraged to explore, train, trade, build, and prepare together before taking on each major step of the server progression.

## Exploration & World

The world is expanded with new terrain, structures, landmarks, loot systems, and dimensional content. Exploration is meant to matter: players can search for resources, discover important locations, travel between key areas, and prepare for harder stages of the adventure.

The server-side setup is designed with pregeneration and performance in mind, helping reduce world-loading issues during active multiplayer sessions.

## Multiplayer Focus

RanzioMon is primarily balanced around a dedicated multiplayer server and content-series environment.

Single-player may work, but the intended experience is server-based, with progression, exploration, battles, and community interaction all happening together. Some systems may feel different outside of the dedicated server setup.

## Credits

RanzioMon is built using Cobblemon and many community-made mods. All mods, libraries, APIs, textures, models, and assets belong to their respective authors.

RZGyms is the custom progression mod created for this pack.

title: TicTac Buttons
description: Plays a crisp sound when hovering over buttons.
body:
Buttons in Minecraft are very quiet, they only play a sound effect when you click them.  
If you want Minecraft to provide clear auditory feedback when you hover over a button (like most modern games do), then this mod is for you!

This mod plays a sound effect when the mouse hovers over a button, or when a button is selected using the `Tab` key.  
The default sound is a pitch‑shifted version of the *Hat* note‑block sound (`minecraft:note/hat`).  
You can replace it with a custom resource pack:

`assets/tictac_buttons/sounds.json`:
``` json
{
  "default": {
    "replace": true,
    "sounds": [
      "tictac_buttons:custom"
    ]
  }
}
```

Then place your sound file, named `custom.ogg`, in the folder `assets/tictac_buttons/sounds/custom/`.  
Load the resource pack in the game, and the mod’s sound effect will be replaced!

title: Sensible Inventory Tweaks
description: Cleaning up many of Minecraft's loot tables, crafting recipes, and adding meaningful storage blocks + other fun, logical additions in between
body:
![Sensible Inventory Tweaks Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87680ab97b1713bd8314a912c1bc7fbc28c43200.png)

----------------------------------
Sensible Inventory Tweaks makes a ton of adjustments to loot tables and recipes across the game, aiming to free up space in the players inventory on a journey, be more generous with crafting recipes to have more materials to work with, and streamlining mob drops to give the player more freedom in their playstyle.

The amount of recipe changes, including entirely new recipes is about 180+, while loot table changes sit at 100+. A list of most major adjustments can be viewed [here](https://github.com/astral-wayfarer727/sensible_inv_tweaks) on the GitHub, or the full list of changes through the source code, but to give some examples;

- Structures like Ruined Portals and Shipwrecks have player gear removed that likely wouldn't of been used anyway. 
- Abandoned Mineshaft chests have raw ores instead of ingots, and older structures like Desert and Jungle temples can occasionally have a block of gold or emerald respectively in their loot chests. 
- All basic animal meat have been merged into three groups. Beef, Pork and Mutton into Flank, Rabbit and Chicken into Haunch and Cod and Salmon into Fish.
- Many blocks in Lush Caves and the Nether Fungi Forests now only drop with shears or Silk Touch
- Rabbits additionally no longer drop rabbit hide and instead drop leather in it's place, and the warm animal temperature variants drop more meat while the cold variants drop more hide. 
- Buried Treasure has been reworked to be simple supply chests with crops in them, while the Heart of the Sea have been moved to be an Elder Guardian drop.
- Lapis given a blockset similar to Quartz'
- Beetroot (almost) entirely removed (can only be obtained in trail ruins as a fail-safe for villager trades needing them, or of course in villager farms)

-------------------------------------------------------

### To-do list
- Implement an elegant way to get the legacy meat types for villager trades that need them _or_ alter villager trades to use the SIT meats instead
- Add more compact blocks with unqiue uses, including giving the Breeze Rod block ambient wind sounds
- Add Programmer Art support
- Tweak/Add/Alter more recipes based on player feedback. I made this mod with a specific vision but I'm open to making tweaks and adjustments if I think they're reasonable :) And of course, if anything is not working as intended please [raise an issue](https://github.com/astral-wayfarer727/sensible_inv_tweaks/issues) on the Github!

-------------------------------------------------------

Due to the recipe and loot table changes, be wary about other mods that do the same, as it may break them. Some should be ok, like Serilums [Wool Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/wool-tweaks) since recipes relating to Wool have not been touched in my project. I would like to personally thank the [Debloat](https://modrinth.com/mod/debloat) mod by armet06 for being a huge source of inspiration for this mod, espeically the merging of meat items, and a handful of other changes!

title: Foggy
description: This project adds a omniscient fear feeding fog monster named Foggy! This creature adds a fear factor to the game to spice up vanilla experience without mods.
body:
Foggy is a horror datapack for Minecraft 26.1.2 that layers an escalating Attention system over supernatural manifestations. The deeper you linger in darkness, rain, and underground tunnels, the more the fog schemes; rolling through four tense tiers of events: ambient dread, doors moving on their own, lights snuffing out, phantom strikes, corrupted food, false sounds, and finally The Watcher. It stays light on resources, and every manifestation can be force-tested via the debug commands so you can double-check every effect.

Installation:
1) Drop the datapack zip into `/saves/<World>/datapacks/`
2) Run `/reload`
3) Confirm with `/datapack list`
4) Run `/function foggy:config` to customize settings

Quick Verification:
After installing, run `/function foggy:test` to verify the datapack is working correctly, or use `/function foggy:status` to check your current attention and dread levels with helpful feedback.

Debug Commands:
- `/function foggy:status` - Check your attention/dread levels with emoji-based feedback
- `/function foggy:test` - Diagnostic test to verify the system is working
- `/tag @s add foggy.debug` - Enable debug overlay for detailed information

Configuration:
The full configuration menu includes shortcuts for intensity, volume, streamer toggles, dread panel (enable/disable, multiplier tiers, decay speeds, and radius presets), ambient events, echo whispers, and ritual bell features.

Streamer Mode:
Streamer Mode feeds action-bar updates showing total and per-player dread, with warnings before jump scares to help content creators prepare their audience.

For a detailed changelog please check the Github Repository

title: Dispersion
description: Dispersion is a deep RPG mod for Minecraft 1.16.5 Forge. Choose from unique classes, collect Soul Scepters, equip Hotbar items, and master a rarity system with cursed gear. Monsters can growing stronger each day.
body:
**Dispersion is a dark RPG overhaul that drags Minecraft into a world of madness, sacrifice, and tactical choice. No two heroes are the same — every attribute point, every talent, and every cursed piece of gear tells a story of risk versus reward. The land itself shifts with time, and only those who master their class will endure.**

Why Download Dispersion?
Dispersion is built for players who want their choices to matter. It's not a simple stat-stick mod — it's a system of interlocking trade-offs. If you enjoy deep character building, theorycrafting unique builds, and overcoming brutal mechanics through smart decisions rather than mindless grinding, this mod is for you. Every death teaches a lesson, every victory is earned. Whether you're looking for a fresh challenge in singleplayer or a foundation for a hardcore RPG server, Dispersion delivers an experience Minecraft has never seen before.

What makes Dispersion unique? Everything is a trade-off. Power is earned through difficult decisions, not just grinding. Will you equip a legendary item that amplifies your damage but cripples your endurance? Will you take a talent that heals you on kills or one that makes you immune to debuffs? The world does not forgive, and neither does your build.

⚔️ 14 UNIQUE CLASSES
Each class comes with its own passive and active ability, plus a talent tree that branches at levels 30, 40, 50, and 60. No two classes play the same — some rely on brute force, others on control, vampirism, or pure damage.

📊 DEEP ATTRIBUTE SYSTEM
You start with 40 attribute points to distribute across Strength, Agility, Intelligence, and Endurance. Every point matters:
• Strength increases melee damage and max health.
• Agility boosts movement speed and critical strike damage.
• Intelligence grants magic resistance and bonus experience from all sources.
• Endurance expands your stamina pool and accelerates stamina regeneration.
Your choices define your survival.

**_Critical Information: You can freely reallocate your attribute points only until level 10. After that, you must find a special trader who sells the ability to reset them. Plan your build carefully, or be prepared to hunt for this rare merchant._**

💎 SOUL SCEPTERS
Each class can obtain a unique Soul Scepter — a one-time-use artifact that permanently changes how your class works. Some Scepters let you stack Strength on kills, others enable you to disable enemy passives, leech health, or even choose between defensive and offensive paths. Once activated, a Scepter's effect is bound to your class until you reset it with a special item.

🔮 RARITY & CURSES
Every crafted piece of armor, weapon, or tool receives a random rarity — from Common to Mythical. Rarer items grant bigger attribute bonuses and special effects like increased weapon damage or armor durability.
Epic and Legendary items can become Cursed: all bonuses are multiplied by 1.5, but a massive penalty is applied to a random attribute. Mythical items cannot be cursed. This system turns crafting into a hunt for perfectly rolled gear, where the most powerful items may also break your build.

🛡️ RESISTANCE AGAINST REFLECTED DAMAGE
Negative effect resistance (e.g., Paladin's Faith passive, Slasher's Battle Trance immunity) now also reduces incoming reflected and counter-attack damage. A Paladin with 40% resistance will only receive 60% of the damage Fury would normally reflect. At 100% resistance, reflected damage is completely ignored. This makes tank and anti-debuff builds much more resilient against certain threats.

🔥 DAMAGE TYPES MATTER
Physical, Magical, and Pure damage each follow distinct rules:
• Physical damage is reduced by standard armor.
• Magical damage ignores regular armor but is mitigated by gold armor, the Anti-Magic enchantment, and Intelligence.
• Pure damage cannot be reduced by any means — it always hits for full value.
Your choice of gear and attributes must account for all three.

How do I remove curses?
You cannot. Once an item is cursed, the curse is permanent. The only way to get rid of a cursed item is to recraft it entirely.

How do I start?

Open the class selection GUI and distribute your 40 attribute points.

Choose a class that fits your playstyle.

Read the built-in tutorial book (given on first spawn).

Kill mobs, mine, and craft to level up.

At level 30, unlock your first talents and begin shaping your build.

Can I change my class later?
Yes, but it requires a rare "Tome of Relearning" item, which can be found in dungeon chests or bought from a special trader. This also resets any active Soul Scepter effects.

What are Soul Scepters?
Soul Scepters are powerful, one-time-use artifacts unique to each class. Once activated, they permanently alter your class mechanics — for example, stacking Strength on kills or disabling enemy passives. Their effects are bound to your class until you reset it with a Tome of Relearning.

Does this mod require any additional libraries?
No. Dispersion works completely standalone. No extra dependencies are needed.

Is this mod compatible with servers?
Yes, Dispersion is fully compatible with dedicated servers. All mechanics work server-side.

title: Zenith Shaders
description: A lightweight, highly optimized shaderpack focusing on soft procedural 3D clouds, immersive underwater distortion, cozy light-source blooming, and beautifully balanced, non-blinding exposures for day and night.
body:
# 🌅 Zenith Shaders

Welcome to **Zenith Shaders**, a lightweight, highly-optimized, and cinematic shaderpack built from the ground up for standard/mid-range gaming PCs. 

Designed to enhance the vanilla Minecraft experience with soft, natural lighting, Zenith Shaders delivers a beautifully balanced, cozy, and atmospheric world without sacrificing your frame rates. 

---

### 🌟 Key Features

*   **World-Space 3D Clouds:** Features procedural, drifting 3D clouds (generated using FBM noise) that sit flat in the sky. The clouds fade naturally as they reach the horizon to prevent stretching or warping, giving you a beautiful 3D sky dome.
*   **Custom Round Sun & Moon:** Replaces vanilla's blocky sky boxes with perfect world-space glowing circles. These scale naturally and are fully compatible with OptiFine's zoom feature.
*   **Physical 3D Water Waves:** Water is no longer flat! It features physical 3D waves that bob up and down, paired with smooth specular reflections that warp realistically with the water surface.
*   **Auto-Focus Depth of Field (DoF):** A cinematic camera blur effect that dynamically adjusts its focus based on exactly where your crosshair is looking, keeping your hand and held items in perfect focus.
*   **Cozy Light Bloom:** Bright emissive blocks like torches, lanterns, glowstone, and lava emit a soft, realistic glow that makes caving and nighttime exploration incredibly atmospheric.
*   **Underwater Ripple & Fog:** Diving underwater triggers an active screen-space ripple distortion and wraps the camera in a deep blue-green aquatic fog that gets thicker the further away things are.
*   **Balanced Exposure & ACES Color:** Say goodbye to flat daytime lighting and washed-out textures. Zenith Shaders blends a cinematic ACES color curve with vanilla's natural colors for rich, deep foliage and a bright (but not blinding) daytime experience. Nighttime is naturally dark, making torches essential.

---

### 🛠️ Compatibility & Setup

Zenith Shaders is built to run smoothly on standard mid-range PCs and is compatible with both **Iris** and **OptiFine** pipelines.

*   **Automatic Configuration:** The shaderpack includes a built-in `shaders.properties` configuration file. When you load the shader, it will automatically tell Minecraft to disable the blocky vanilla clouds, sun, and moon so they don't overlap with Zenith's custom sky. 
*   **How to Reload:** If you make any in-game adjustments, simply press **`F3 + R`** to reload the shader instantly.

title: Project-Regon⛰️
description: An advanced vanilla-style world generator that transforms the Overworld into a dramatic but realistic landscape filled with huge formations, unique terrain shapes, and natural-looking environments, making every seed and every location feel perfect.
body:
![Project-Regon main image.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/997ae9eb77cbcfdb87dff69992e1652feb8a8d67_0.webp)

## Introduction to the datapack
This datapack creates a **more realistic and exploration-focused Overworld,** with special attention to **hills, slopes, and connected terrain.** Hills are shaped to feel like real landforms, with slopes, ridges, valleys, and natural paths between high areas. The terrain forms walkable ridges, saddles, or slopes between those hills.

### ✨Main Features
- Adds **errosion.**
- Adds **errosion noise.**
- Generates **hydraulic terrain.**
- **More terrain features** like:
  - mountain ranges
  - valleys
  - cliffs
  - plateaus
  - underground rivers
  - **new combined** realistic looking terrain shapes
- More variation, so every world and every place feels different and perfect.
- Deeper oceans, larger landmasses, and overall **a more realistic world structure.**
- Improves **natural terrain flow** between hills, mountains, valleys, plains, savanna biomes and **all other minecraft biomes.**
- Generates **more mountain rings.**
- Generates more natural and realistic terrain **instead of overly smoothed landscapes like other world generation mods or datapacks.**

![Underground river generated with Project-Regon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d04bffc4de0f4b8614c64c07495795d310b28811_0.webp)

### 🛠️How it works:


**Minecraft Perlin Noise:**

```
small hills → normal rivers → normal mountains → normal oceans
```


**Project-Regon World Generator:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

```
continents → huge mountain systems → deeper oceans → valleys → plateaus → underground rivers
```

</details>

![A mountain with hydraulic erosion layers visible. Generated with Project-Regon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/934bb8f14a38a6aabe4aa469015db879b2780f1c_0.webp)

![Example terrain generated with Project-Regon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32c8ba193ff3279c4784db4da5786530d99d3a27_0.webp)

### 💡Informations:

The terrain is also inspired by real landscapes and erosion-shaped environments. Softer terrain such as sand can appear more naturally worn down or shaped compared to harder stone areas.
Hills, cliffs, valleys, and large formations make the world more interesting, but still playable. Instead, you can look at the terrain, find a natural way up, and choose your path. Unlike some terrain generators that make everything overly smooth, this datapack keeps the terrain natural and varied.

title: Catsnip
description: Catnip enhances Minecraft cats with a dynamic bonding system and smarter AI.
body:
# Catnip

**Catnip** is a specialized **PaperMC plugin** designed to enhance **cat behavior** and introduce a **comprehensive bonding system** between players and their tamed cats.

---

## Features

### 🐾 Bonding System

Catnip introduces a **persistent bonding mechanic** for tamed cats. Bonding levels influence cat behavior and can be tracked by players.

- **Bond Increases**  
  Players can improve their bond with their cats through positive interactions, such as **feeding** or **playing** with them.

- **Bond Decreases**  
  Hitting a tamed cat results in a **significant reduction** in the bonding level.

- **Bond Decay**  
  Bonding levels naturally **decrease over time** if a cat is neglected for extended periods.

---

### 🧠 Enhanced AI and Behaviors

Catnip introduces several **custom goals and behaviors** for tamed cats:

- **Hugging**  
  Cats with high bonding levels (**85% or higher**) may occasionally approach their owner to **hug them**, accompanied by **purring sounds** and **heart particles**.

- **Play Fighting**  
  Cats with low bonding levels (**below 35%**) may engage in **playful fights** with their owner, involving **minor damage** and **hissing sounds**.

- **Item Interaction**  
  Cats actively play with dropped items, specifically:
  - **String**
  - **Fish (Cod and Salmon)**

- **Environmental Interaction**  
  Cats may choose to sit on **warm blocks**, such as:
  - Furnaces
  - Blast Furnaces
  - Smokers  

  They may also rest on **red carpets**.

- **Fish Theft**  
  Cats have a chance to **steal fish from nearby chests** when they are opened, running away with the item.

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `/catbond [player]` | Displays the bonding levels, names, and collar colors of all cats owned by the specified player. If no player is specified, the sender's cats are shown. |

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|-----------|-------------|--------|
| `catnip.bond` | Allows a player to check their own cat bonding levels. | `true` |
| `catnip.admin` | Allows checking bonding levels of other players' cats and receives update notifications on join. | `op` |

---

## Technical Requirements

- **Platform:** PaperMC  
- **API Version:** 1.21  
- **Dependencies:** Utilizes **bStats** for anonymous metrics collection.

body:
This data pack removes the enchantment glint automatically applied to written books. Compatible with any texture pack :)

# Does it hog resources?
Not at all! The way the data pack is designed renders it inactive until a book is signed, at which point it activates for a split second before going inactive again.

# How does it work?
Glintless Books uses two custom advancements to detect when a player's inventory gains a written book, then immediately modifies the newly created book to remove the enchantment glint. The advancement triggered changes depending on the hand being used to write the book, but they work the exact same way.

# Does it do anything else?
The only other feature it adds is an advancement called "Shakespeare" that players obtain upon writing their first book. This advancement is fitted into the vanilla Adventure progression.

body:
**No Slimes on Superflat world**

**Tired of slime mobs constantly spawning in your Superflat world?**

**No Slimes on Superflat** disables natural slime spawning in flat worlds by default, making your building and survival experience much more peaceful.

Features:

* Prevents slimes from spawning naturally in Superflat worlds.
* Lightweight and server-friendly.
* Toggle slime spawning at any time using a gamerule.
* Works without requiring world regeneration.

### Gamerule

Control slime spawning with:

/gamerule slimspawning true

Enables slime spawning in Superflat worlds.


/gamerule slimspawning false

Disables slime spawning in Superflat worlds.


### Default Behavior

* `slime spawning = false`
* Slimes will not spawn naturally in flat worlds unless the gamerule is enabled.

Perfect for builders, creative projects, skyblock-style maps, and anyone who wants a cleaner Superflat experience without endless slime invasions.

title: ChunkVisualizer
description: A lightweight tool to visualize chunk boundaries without F3+G. Database support
body:
# ChunkVisualizer

**ChunkVisualizer** is a lightweight and powerful Minecraft plugin that allows players to visualize chunk boundaries in real-time without using the debug menu (`F3 + G`). 

It is a perfect companion for **Towny** or other land-claim systems, as it allows players to see specific chunk edges clearly without cluttering the screen with a global grid.

---

## 🎥 Demonstration

### 1. Dynamic Chunk Tracking
The visualization automatically follows the player when crossing chunk borders, ensuring seamless territory control.

<video src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cb20d246-9a1f-4386-9fc9-e4cfc821f9fe" autoplay loop muted playsinline width="100%"></video>

### 2. Full GUI Customization
Use the `/cv settings` command to open an intuitive interface that allows you to:
* **Toggle** visibility with a single click.
* **Adjust height** of the boundary blocks relative to your current position.
* **Change materials** used for the visualization.
* **Reset** all settings to server defaults.

<video src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/61dedf24-954d-4cf6-b2c6-2c204fe4b0c6" autoplay loop muted playsinline width="100%"></video>

### 3. Non-Intrusive "Ghost" Blocks
Built using modern packets and **Display Entities**, these blocks have no collision. They **do not interfere with gameplay**: you can mine ores or interact with items directly through the visualization.

<video src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/aaa02b17-89bb-414d-a703-321bd537e738" autoplay loop muted playsinline width="100%"></video>

---

## 🛠 Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/cv` | Main command (Help menu) | `chunkvisualizer.use` |
| `/cv settings` | Open the customization GUI | `chunkvisualizer.use` |
| `/cv reload` | Reload configuration files | `chunkvisualizer.admin` |

---

## ⚙️ Installation
1. Download the latest `.jar` file from the [Releases](https://github.com/SawaPlayGO/ChunkVisualizer/releases/tag/v0.1) page.
2. Place it into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart the server or load it using a plugin manager.

---

## 📝 Roadmap
- Persistent user settings storage (Database/Flatfile support). ✅
- Color support for boundary block outlines/highlights.

# ZenFights 2.0.7

[![Supported Loaders](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loaders-Bukkit%20%7C%20Spigot%20%7C%20Paper%20%7C%20Purpur-blue)](#)
[![Minecraft Versions](https://img.shields.io/badge/MC-1.21.x%20–%2026.1.x-brightgreen)](#)
[![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21%20%7C%2025-orange)](#)

**ZenFights** is a high-performance, competitive duel engine built exclusively for the every ecosystem including Paper, Spigot, Bukkit and Purpur. It transforms standard PvP into a highly isolated, professional matchmaking experience, supporting all modern server versions.

Version 2.0.7 introduces network-level combat isolation, dynamic Elo-style "Zen" ratings, a fully integrated AI Practice Bot, and an active Discord gateway bridge.


[![Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05fe664c676a12a0c6ee7a86b31d81be49b09a5c.png)](https://discord.gg/ReqqvMpuHh)

[Wiki](https://zenstudios.xo.je)


## 🌟 Key Features

* **Universal Version Support:** Fully optimized for seamless performance across modern PaperMC releases (1.20.x – 1.21.x).
* **Network-Level Arena Isolation:** When a duel begins, bystanders vanish. Fighters are network-isolated, preventing third-party interference, stray projectiles, and visual clutter.
* **Smart Rollback Sandbox:** Explosions from end crystals/beds and broken blocks are visually hidden from the rest of the server and instantly rolled back when the match concludes.
* **AI Practice Bot (Zen Master):** Train your pacing offline. The practice bot features an action-bar virtual health pool (2000 HP), automatic boundary containment, and mimics your selected kit.
* **Advanced Spectator Mode:** Server members can spectate live matches using a dedicated `/fight spec` routing engine that bypasses network invisibility while safely locking their commands.
* **Elo "Zen" Rating System:** A mathematical ranking system. Players start at `3000` Zen, gaining or losing points dynamically based on the skill gap of their opponent.
* **Discord Integration:** A built-in JDA Discord Bot that syncs your server's live match data, offering `/zfbot-top` and `/zfbot-stats` slash commands straight from your Discord server.
* **High-Precision Kit Serialization:** Admins can save their entire current state—**Inventory, Armor, and Offhand**—as custom, reusable kits directly from the game.

---

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Installation
1. Download the latest `ZenFights-2.0.x.jar` file.
2. Ensure you have **PlaceholderAPI** installed on your server.
3. Place ZenFights into your server's `plugins/` folder.
4. Restart your server to generate the default `config.yml`.

### Commands & Permissions

#### Player Commands
| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/fight <player>` | Opens the Kit Selection GUI to challenge a player. | `zenfights.fight` |
| `/fight accept <player>` | Accept an incoming duel request. | `zenfights.fight` |
| `/fight practice <kit>` | Start an isolated combat simulation against the AI. | `zenfights.fight` |
| `/fight practice exit` | Forcibly exit your active simulation early. | `zenfights.fight` |
| `/fight spec <player>` | Spectate an active duel in Gamemode 3. | `zenfights.command.spectate` |
| `/fight spec leave` | Safely disconnect from the spectator perspective. | `zenfights.command.spectate` |

#### Admin Commands
| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/zf savekit <name>` | Saves your current inventory layout as a global kit. | `zenfights.admin` |
| `/zf deletekit <name>` | Permanently deletes a kit profile. | `zenfights.admin` |
| `/zf listkits` | View all active kit templates loaded in memory. | `zenfights.admin` |
| `/zf reload` | Reloads the configuration and memory state safely. | `zenfights.admin` |
| `/zf loadkit <name>` | Manually equip a saved server kit profile. | `zenfights.base` |

*(Note: Give staff members the `zenfights.spectate.bypasscommands` permission to allow them to execute other server commands while locked in spectator mode).*

---

## 📊 PlaceholderAPI Integration

ZenFights comes with a built-in expansion. You do **not** need to download anything from the eCloud. Use these anywhere (Scoreboards, TAB, Holograms, Chat):

| Placeholder | Output / Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `%zenfights_zen%` | Displays the player's current Elo/Zen score (Default: 3000). |
| `%zenfights_status%` | Returns `§bIn Fight` or `§7Idle` based on combat state. |
| `%zenfights_wins%` | Total number of recorded duel victories. |
| `%zenfights_losses%` | Total number of recorded duel defeats. |
| `%zenfights_deaths%` | Alias for losses. |
| `%zenfights_matches_played%` | The combined total of all historical matches logged. |

---

## ⚙️ Default Configuration (`config.yml`)

The configuration file handles your physical arena parameters, reward hooks, and database tracking. 

```yaml
# ==============================================================================
#                         ZENFIGHTS CONFIGURATION
# ==============================================================================

arena:
  # The maximum blocks a practice bot can wander before bouncing off the border
  border-radius: 15.0

# sandbox-radius: How far the worldborder extends from the duel center
sandbox-radius: 32.0
# spawn-immunity-seconds: Invulnerability window in seconds upon match start
spawn-immunity-seconds: 3
# match-timeout-minutes: Max duration in minutes before a duel is auto-cancelled
match-timeout-minutes: 20

# zen-k-factor: Determines how much Zen is won/lost (higher = more volatile)
zen-k-factor: 32.0
# default-zen: The starting score for new players
default-zen: 3000

# win-commands: Commands executed by Console when a player wins.
# Use %player% to target the winner.
win-commands:
  - "eco give %player% 100"

discord-bot:
  enabled: false
  bot-token: "YOUR_BOT_TOKEN_HERE"
  embed-color-leaderboard: "#FFD700"
  embed-color-stats: "#00FF7F"
```
## Discord Bot Setup

```
🤖 Discord Bot Setup Guide
ZenFights includes a native Discord gateway hook to display leaderboards and live match stats directly in your Discord server.

Creating the Bot: Go to the Discord Developer Portal, create a new application, and generate your Bot Token under the "Bot" tab. Paste this into your config.yml.

Privileged Gateway Intents: Under the "Bot" tab, toggle ON Server Members Intent and Message Content Intent.

Inviting the Bot: Navigate to the OAuth2 > URL Generator tab, select bot and applications.commands scopes, and add the Send Messages and Embed Links permissions. Use the generated link to add it to your server.

Set enabled: true in your config.yml and run /zf reload to register commands.
```

title: Cornball's Music Player
description: This mod adds a music GUI that allows you to play most of the music without a jukebox.
body:
## Cornball’s Music Player

Cornball’s Music Player is a client-side Fabric mod that gives you a simple, polished way to play vanilla and custom music from anywhere in-game. Instead of placing a jukebox or manually swapping discs, you can open the mod’s custom music player GUI at any time by pressing **`M`** and instantly browse the full supported library from one screen.

The interface is designed to feel clean and easy to use. The left side displays a scrollable library of vanilla and custom music with each songs icon, name, and song title, while the right side gives you dedicated playback controls and a live view of the current track. Clicking a song starts playing it immediately, and the mod makes sure only one track plays at a time so audio stays organized and never overlaps.

Cornball’s Music Player also includes quality-of-life features that make it much more convenient than a normal jukebox setup. You can pause, resume, stop, adjust volume, monitor playback progress with a built-in progress bar, and keep track of what is currently playing through a compact HUD overlay. The HUD can be moved anywhere on your screen through a placement mode with **Save** and **Cancel** options, or disabled entirely if you prefer a cleaner look.

Everything runs client-side, so the mod is lightweight and easy to use. There’s no extra block to place, no complicated setup, and no required config files to get started. Install the mod, launch the game with Fabric, and press **`M`** to open the music player.

### Features
- Open the music player GUI anywhere by pressing **`M`**
- Browse supported vanilla and custom music in a custom scrollable menu
- View song icons, song names, and song titles in the selector
- Instantly play tracks by clicking them
- Dedicated **Play**, **Pause**, and **Stop** controls
- Only one track plays at a time (at the moment)
- Built-in volume slider
- Playback progress bar and time display
- Small movable HUD overlay for current song and progress
- HUD placement mode with **Save** and **Cancel**
- Button to enable or disable the HUD
- Custom .ogg music support

### Requirements
- Fabric
- Fabric API

To access custom music you first need to put your .ogg into the "tracks" folder found in the "musicplayer" folder inside your Minecraft instance file. Then simply navigate into the local tab inside the mods in-game menu.

Feedback is appreciated and the mod will continue to update with even more music.

title: Bounty Enchantment
description: Server sided enchantment that increases mob XP drops.
body:
![Icon](https://github.com/FireDragon91245/Bounty-Enchantment/raw/1.21.3/src/main/resources/assets/bounty_enchantment/icon.png)
# Bounty Enchantment

**Items:**  
![Sword](https://github.com/FireDragon91245/Bounty-Enchantment/raw/1.21.3/src/main/resources/assets/bounty_enchantment/sword.png)
![Axe](https://github.com/FireDragon91245/Bounty-Enchantment/raw/1.21.3/src/main/resources/assets/bounty_enchantment/axe.png)

A simple server-sided enchantment that increases the amount of dropped XP from mobs.
The multipliers for levels 1–5 are configurable in the `bounty_enchantment.json` inside the server’s config directory.

## Config
```json
{
  "levelMultipliers": [
    1.25,
    1.5,
    1.75,
    2.0,
    2.5
  ],
  "maxXpCap": 32767,
  "allowOffhand": false,
  "debug": false
}
```
`levelMultipliers`: Configure the multipliers for each level, where the index is the level  
`maxXpCap`: A hard cap to limit XP per mob (must not exceed a god particle’s worth (`2^15-1` or `32767`))  
`allowOffhand`: If set to true, allows the use of the offhand item bug. (Offhanded item takes over enchantments from main-hand item (for example, bow takes Looting from sword); in this case, ranged weapons would also take over the Bounty enchantment if an item with Bounty is held in the main hand)  
`debug`: Print calculated XP amounts in the server logs (only for debugging)

---

<center>

# 🧱 BlockHunt (Classic Hide & Seek)

**Hide in plain sight! Blend in with the environment or hunt down the survivors!**
*Transform your server into a thrilling arena of hide and seek. Become a block or lead a global hunt!*

</center>

---

## ✨ Features

* **🎯 Flawless Block Disguise:** Players instantly transform into their chosen block using the powerful LibsDisguises API. To everyone else, they look exactly like real blocks!
* **📦 Solid Block System:** If a block-player stands still for 4 seconds, the plugin automatically snaps them perfectly to the Minecraft block grid, allowing them to blend seamlessly into the map.
* **🎒 Custom Block Selector GUI:** Administrators can configure a unique pool of available blocks for each arena using an intuitive custom graphical interface.
* **📊 Dynamic Scoreboard:** The sidebar displays essential live game statistics: arena name, the player's current role, and the exact time remaining in the round.
* **⚔️ Gameplay Balance:** Hunters spawn with iron gear at the start, while Blocks receive swords for self-defense only after a configurable delay (e.g., halfway through the round).
* **🌍 Full Localization:** Every single message, menu title, and UI element is fully customizable within the configuration files.
* **🛡️ Anti-Grief Protection:** Automatically blocks breaking/placing blocks, dropping items, and executing external commands during an active match.

---

## 🎮 Commands

### 👥 For Players:
* `/bh join [arena_name]` — Join the game queue for a specific arena.
* `/bh leave` — Leave the current game and return to the main spawn.

### 🛠️ For Administrators:
* `/bh create [arena_name]` — Create a brand new arena.
* `/bh setlobby` — Set the waiting lobby spawn point where players wait for the countdown.
* `/bh setreturn` — Set the exit spawn point where players are sent after the game ends.
* `/bh [arena_name] pos1 / pos2` — Set the physical boundaries of the arena map.
* `/bh [arena_name] setspawn blocks` — Set the spawn location for the Blocks team.
* `/bh [arena_name] setspawn hunters` — Set the spawn location for the Hunters team.
* `/bh [arena_name] blocks add` — Open the setup GUI for available arena blocks (put blocks inside and click the Nether Star to save).

---

## 🔑 Permissions

* `bh.player` — Grants access to basic player commands (`/bh join`, `/bh leave`) and allows participating in games. Recommended for all regular players.
* `bh.admin` — Grants full access to all administrative setup commands, arena creation, and configuration management. Recommended for administrators/OPs.

---

## 🛠️ Installation

1. Download the plugin and drop it into your `/plugins/` folder.
2. Ensure you have **ProtocolLib** and **LibsDisguises** installed (check the version matrix above!).
3. Restart your server to generate the configuration files.
4. Set the global coordinates using `/bh setlobby` and `/bh setreturn`.
5. Create an arena, set up team spawns, configure allowed blocks via the GUI, and you are ready! Minimum players required to auto-start a match is 2.
